verses.text: A <transChange type="added">good</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">rather to be chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">than great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">riches</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">loving</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">rather than silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>loving…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">favour is better than</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06223">The rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06298" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">meet together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the maker</w> of them all.

verses.name: Proverbs 22:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06175">A prudent</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">foreseeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05641 strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8738">and hideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06612">himself: but the simple</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pass on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06064" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and are punished</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06118">By</w> <w lemma="strong:H06038">humility</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03374">the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06239">riches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and honour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and life</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>By…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">The reward of humility</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06791">Thorns</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06341">snares</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06141">of the froward</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that doth keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be far</w> from them.

verses.name: Proverbs 22:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02596" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Train up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">a child</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">he should go</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and when he is old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he will not depart</w> from it.<note type="study"><catchWord>Train…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Catechise</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in his way</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06223">The rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ruleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">over the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and the borrower</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03867 strong:H0376" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to the lender</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the lender</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the man that lendeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that soweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall reap</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">vanity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07626">and the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">of his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fail</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the rod…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">with the rod of his anger he shall be consumed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">He that hath a bountiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be blessed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of his bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">to the poor</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Good of eye</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">Cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">the scorner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04066">and contention</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go out</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01779">yea, strife</w> <w lemma="strong:H07036">and reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall cease</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 22:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889 strong:H02890" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">pureness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of heart</w>, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02580">the grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of his lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his friend</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and hath grace in his lips</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">The eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05557" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he overthroweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the transgressor</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the words</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the matters</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06102">The slothful</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w>, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0738">a lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">I shall be slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">the streets</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 22:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">The mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of strange women</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06013">a deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07745">pit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02194" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">he that is abhorred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> therein.

verses.name: Proverbs 22:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0200">Foolishness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of a child</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">of correction</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall drive it far</w> from him.

verses.name: Proverbs 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that oppresseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to increase</w> his <transChange type="added">riches</transChange>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06223">to the rich</w>, <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> surely <transChange type="added">come</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04270">to want</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 22:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and apply</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">unto my knowledge</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 22:18
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05273">a pleasant thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">them within</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">thee; they shall withal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be fitted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">in thy lips</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>within…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in thy belly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04009">That thy trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">may be in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have made known</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to thee this day</w>, even to thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>even…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">trust thou also</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Have not I written</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032">to thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H07991">excellent things</w> <w lemma="strong:H04156">in counsels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">and knowledge</w>,

verses.name: Proverbs 22:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">That I might make thee know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07189">the certainty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">of the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">of truth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that thou mightest answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">of truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that send</w> unto thee?<note type="study"><catchWord>to them…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to those that send thee?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Rob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">not the poor</w>, because he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01800">poor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither oppress</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 22:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">their cause</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06906" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06906" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of those that spoiled</w> them.

verses.name: Proverbs 22:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Make no friendship</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">with an angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02534">and with a furious</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not go</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 22:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0502" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Lest thou learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and get</w> <w lemma="strong:H04170">a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">to thy soul</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 22:26
verses.text: Be not thou <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that strike</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hands</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that are sureties</w> <w lemma="strong:H04859">for debts</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 22:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">If thou hast nothing to pay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">why should he take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">thy bed</w> from under thee?

verses.name: Proverbs 22:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05253" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">not the ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">landmark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">which thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have set</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>landmark</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bound</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thou a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04106">diligent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">in his business</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">he shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">he shall not stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02823">mean</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mean…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">obscure men</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen698" osisID="Prov.22"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou sittest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with a ruler</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">diligently</w> what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee:

verses.name: Proverbs 23:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07915">a knife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03930">to thy throat</w>, if thou <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01167">a man given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">to appetite</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Be not desirous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04303">of his dainties</w>: for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03577">deceitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">meat</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not to be rich</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">from thine own wisdom</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05774 strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">Wilt thou set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> upon that which is not? for <transChange type="added">riches</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">themselves wings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05774 strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8687 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">they fly away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">as an eagle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">toward heaven</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cause thine eyes to fly upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">thou not the bread</w> of <transChange type="added">him that hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eye</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">neither desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04303">thou his dainty meats</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 23:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08176" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For as he thinketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">in his heart</w>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">he: Eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">he to thee; but his heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not with thee.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06595">The morsel</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06958" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shalt thou vomit up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and lose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05273">thy sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">not in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of a fool</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0936" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he will despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07922">the wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">of thy words</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05253" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">not the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">landmark</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">not into the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">of the fatherless</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>landmark</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bound</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For their redeemer</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02389">mighty</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">their cause</w> with thee.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Apply</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">unto instruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">and thine ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">to the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">of knowledge</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Withhold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">not correction</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">from the child</w>: for <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou beatest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">him with the rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not die</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt beat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">him with the rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shalt deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">from hell</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">if thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0589">even mine</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>even…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">even I will rejoice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03629">Yea, my reins</w> <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08193">when thy lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04339">right things</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Let not thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">envy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02400">sinners</w>: but <transChange type="added">be thou</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03374">in the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w> long.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">For surely there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">an end</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08615">and thine expectation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be cut off</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>end</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">reward</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou, my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and guide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05433 strong:H03196" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Be not among winebibbers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02151" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">among riotous eaters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of flesh</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>of flesh</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of their flesh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05433" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For the drunkard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02151" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the glutton</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall come to poverty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05124">and drowsiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall clothe</w> <transChange type="added">a man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07168">with rags</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0936" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, and despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">not thy mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when she is old</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">the truth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sell</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> not; <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04148">and instruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0998">and understanding</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">The father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01524">shall greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he that begetteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">a wise</w> <transChange type="added">child</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall have joy</w> of him.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and thy mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be glad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and she that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee shall rejoice</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">me thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and let thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341 strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8799">observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my ways</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For a whore</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06013">a deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07745">ditch</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05237">and a strange woman</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06862">a narrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">pit</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">She also lieth in wait</w> as <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02863">a prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and increaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the transgressors</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">among men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as for…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">as a robber</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0188">Who hath woe</w>? <w lemma="strong:H017">who hath sorrow</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04066 strong:H04079" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">who hath contentions</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07879">who hath babbling</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06482">who hath wounds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">without cause</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02448">who hath redness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of eyes</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 23:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">They that tarry long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">at the wine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04469">mixed wine</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Look</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">not thou upon the wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0119" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">when it is red</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when it giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his colour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03599 strong:H03563" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">in the cup</w>, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">it moveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04339">itself aright</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0319">At the last</w> <w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it biteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">like a serpent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06567" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and stingeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06848">like an adder</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a cockatrice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">strange women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08419">perverse things</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 23:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">or as he that lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02260">of a mast</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the midst…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the heart of the sea</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">They have stricken</w> me, <transChange type="added">shalt thou say</transChange>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I was not sick</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01986" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have beaten</w> me, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I felt</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">not: when shall I awake</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it yet</w> again.<note type="study"><catchWord>I felt…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I knew it not</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen699" osisID="Prov.23"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Be not thou envious</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">against evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">neither desire</w> to be with them.

verses.name: Proverbs 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">For their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">studieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07701">destruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08193">and their lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">of mischief</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 24:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02451">Through wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">is an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">builded</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08394">and by understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">it is established</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 24:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01847">And by knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">shall the chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03368">with all precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H05273">and pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">riches</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 24:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">A wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">strong</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">yea, a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">of knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">increaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">strength</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>is strong</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is in strength</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>increaseth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strengtheneth might</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08458">For by wise counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">thy war</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07230">and in multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of counsellors</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08668">safety</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 24:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02454">Wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">too high</w> <w lemma="strong:H0191">for a fool</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he openeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">not his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 24:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He that deviseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to do evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04209">a mischievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">person</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 24:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02154">The thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0200">of foolishness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">sin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and the scorner</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">to men</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 24:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">If</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">thou faint</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of adversity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03581">thy strength</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06862">small</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>small</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">narrow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou forbear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to deliver</w> <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">drawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">unto death</w>, and <transChange type="added">those that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H02027">to be slain</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 24:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou sayest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, we knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it not; doth not he that pondereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03826">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">consider</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he that keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w>, doth <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he know</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>? and shall <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he render</w> to <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">according to his works</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 24:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">thou honey</w>, because <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05317">and the honeycomb</w>, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04966">sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02441">to thy taste</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon thy palate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:14
verses.text: So <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">the knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">unto thy soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when thou hast found</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">then there shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">a reward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08615">and thy expectation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be cut off</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 24:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Lay not wait</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">O wicked</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05116">against the dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07258">not his resting place</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 24:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">For a just</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">falleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and riseth up again</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">but the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">into mischief</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 24:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">not when thine enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">falleth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and let not thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when he stumbleth</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 24:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Lest the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it displease</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him, and he turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">his wrath</w> from him.<note type="study"><catchWord>it displease…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">it be evil in his eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Fret</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">not thyself because of evil</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither be thou envious</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">at the wicked</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>Fret…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Keep not company with the wicked</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0319">For there shall be no reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">to the evil</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05216">the candle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01846" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be put out</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>candle</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">lamp</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thou the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">meddle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">not with them that are given to change</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>them…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">changers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0343">For their calamity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">suddenly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and who knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06365">the ruin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of them both</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 24:23
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">things</transChange> also <transChange type="added">belong</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">to the wise</w>. <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to have respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of persons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in judgment</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 24:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">unto the wicked</w>, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">him shall the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03816">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H02194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall abhor</w> him:

verses.name: Proverbs 24:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">But to them that rebuke</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05276" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be delight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> upon them.<note type="study"><catchWord>a good…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a blessing of good</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:26
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Every man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall kiss</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05228">a right</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">answer</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that answereth right words</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">thy work</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06257" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and make it fit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">for thyself in the field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterwards</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thine house</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 24:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05707">Be not a witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">against thy neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">without cause</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and deceive</w> <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">with thy lips</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 24:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so to him as he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to me: I will render</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">according to his work</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 24:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">by the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06102 strong:H0376">of the slothful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03754">and by the vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02638">void</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of understanding</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 24:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And, lo, it was all grown over</w> <w lemma="strong:H07063">with thorns</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02738">nettles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">had covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">thereof, and the stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01444">wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thereof was broken down</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 24:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I saw</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> considered <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">well</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I looked</w> upon <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">received</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">instruction</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>considered…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set my heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:33
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H08142">sleep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H08572">slumber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H02264">folding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sleep</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 24:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07389">So shall thy poverty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">one that travelleth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04270">and thy want</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">as an armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man of shield</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 24." eID="gen700" osisID="Prov.24"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:1
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04912">also proverbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">which the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">of Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06275" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">copied out</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to conceal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a thing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03519">but the honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of kings</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to search out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a matter</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">The heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07312">for height</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06011">for depth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of kings</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02714">unsearchable</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>is…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">there is no searching</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01898" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05509">the dross</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">from the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there shall come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">a vessel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for the finer</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01898" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03678">and his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">in righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01921" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Put not forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thyself in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">not in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of great</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Put…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Set not out thy glory</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">For better</w> <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that it be said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto thee, Come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">hither; than that thou shouldest be put lower</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H05081">of the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">whom thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have seen</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Go not forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04118">hastily</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to strive</w>, lest <transChange type="added">thou know not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">in the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thereof, when thy neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">hath put thee to shame</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Debate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">thy cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">with thy neighbour</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and discover</w> <w lemma="strong:H05475">not a secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">to another</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>a secret…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the secret of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Lest he that heareth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02616" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">put thee to shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01681">and thine infamy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turn not away</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">A word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0655 strong:H0212" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">fitly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">spoken</w> <transChange type="added">is like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08598">apples</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04906">in pictures</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fitly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">spoken upon his wheels</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05141">an earring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02481">and an ornament</w> <w lemma="strong:H03800">of fine gold</w>, <transChange type="added">so is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">reprover</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon an obedient</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">ear</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06793">As the cold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07950">of snow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">of harvest</w>, <transChange type="added">so is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06735">messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him: for he refresheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of his masters</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Whoso</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">boasteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">himself of a false</w> <w lemma="strong:H04991">gift</w> <transChange type="added">is like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05387">clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">and wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">without rain</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of a…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in a gift of falsehood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0753">By long</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">forbearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07101">is a prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">persuaded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07390">and a soft</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">breaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01634">the bone</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast thou found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">honey</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">so much as is sufficient</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thee, lest thou be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06958" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">therewith, and vomit</w> it.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03365" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Withdraw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">thy foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">from thy neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest he be weary</w> of thee, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hate</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>Withdraw…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Let thy foot be seldom in</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>weary…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">full of thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">A man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that beareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">false</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">against his neighbour</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04650">a maul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">and a sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08150" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and a sharp</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">arrow</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04009">Confidence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in an unfaithful man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w> <transChange type="added">is like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07465">a broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">tooth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">and a foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04154">out of joint</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05710" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that taketh away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">a garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07135">in cold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">weather</w>, <transChange type="added">and as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02558">vinegar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05427">upon nitre</w>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that singeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">songs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">to an heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">If thine enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07457">be hungry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">give him bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to eat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06771">and if he be thirsty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">give him water</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to drink</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 25:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02846" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For thou shalt heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H01513">coals of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall reward</w> thee.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06828">The north</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">driveth away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">rain</w>: so <transChange type="added">doth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02194" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">an angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">a backbiting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>driveth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bringeth forth rain: so doth a backbiting tongue an angry countenance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:24
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">in the corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">of the housetop</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04066 strong:H04079" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">than with a brawling</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02267">and in a wide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:25
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07119">cold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05889">to a thirsty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">news</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">from a far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">A righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">man falling down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07515" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04599">fountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">and a corrupt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04726">spring</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:27
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">honey</w>: so <transChange type="added">for men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02714">to search</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">their own glory</w> <transChange type="added">is not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 25:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">He</w> that <transChange type="added">hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04623">no rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">over his own spirit</w> <transChange type="added">is like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">broken down</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02346">without walls</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 25." eID="gen701" osisID="Prov.25"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07950">As snow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">in summer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04306">and as rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">in harvest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">so honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05000">is not seemly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">for a fool</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 26:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06833">As the bird</w> <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by wandering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01866">as the swallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by flying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07045">so the curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">causeless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not come</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 26:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07752">A whip</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">for the horse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04964">a bridle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">for the ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">and a rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">for the fool’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01460">back</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 26:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">not a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H0200">according to his folly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest thou also be like</w> unto him.

verses.name: Proverbs 26:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H0200">according to his folly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02450">lest he be wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his own conceit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>conceit</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that sendeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a message</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H07096" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">cutteth off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">the feet</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">drinketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">damage</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>damage</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">violence</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07785">The legs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06455">of the lame</w> <w lemma="strong:H01809" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are not equal</w>: so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04912">a parable</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>are…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">are lifted up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06887 strong:H06872" morph="strongMorph:TH8800 strongMorph:TH8675">As he that bindeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">a stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H04773">in a sling</w>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">to a fool</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bindeth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">putteth a precious stone in an heap of stones</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02336">a thorn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">goeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07910">of a drunkard</w>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04912">a parable</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 26:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">The great</w> <transChange type="added">God</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">that formed</w> all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">both rewardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">the fool</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and rewardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">transgressors</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The great…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A great man grieveth all, and he hireth the fool, he hireth also transgressors</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03611">As a dog</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">returneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06892">to his vomit</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03684">a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">returneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0200">to his folly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>returneth to his folly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">iterateth his folly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thou a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his own conceit</w>? <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08615">more hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of a fool</w> than of him.

verses.name: Proverbs 26:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06102">The slothful</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w>, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07826">a lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0738">a lion</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the streets</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 26:14
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06735">upon his hinges</w>, so <transChange type="added">doth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06102">the slothful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">upon his bed</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 26:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06102">The slothful</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> in <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06747">bosom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">it grieveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">him to bring it again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to his mouth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it grieveth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he is weary</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06102">The sluggard</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wiser</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his own conceit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">than seven men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that can render</w> <w lemma="strong:H02940">a reason</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 26:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that passeth by</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">meddleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">with strife</w> <transChange type="added">belonging</transChange> not to him, <transChange type="added">is like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">one that taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">a dog</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">by the ears</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>meddleth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">is enraged</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03856" morph="strongMorph:TH8700">As a mad</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who casteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02131">firebrands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02671">arrows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04194">and death</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>firebrands</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">flames</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">sparks</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:19
verses.text: So <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07411" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">deceiveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Am not I in sport</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 26:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0657">Where no</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> is, <transChange type="added">there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">goeth out</w>: so where <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05372">no talebearer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04066">the strife</w> <w lemma="strong:H08367" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ceaseth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Where no…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Without wood</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>talebearer</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">whisperer</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>ceaseth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is silent</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:21
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06352">coals</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01513">to burning coals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">to fire</w>; so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04066 strong:H04079" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">a contentious</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02787" morph="strongMorph:TH8771">to kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">strife</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 26:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05372">of a talebearer</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03859" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">as wounds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">into the innermost parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of the belly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>innermost…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">chambers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01814" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and a wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <transChange type="added">are like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02789">a potsherd</w> <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">with silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05509">dross</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 26:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that hateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">dissembleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">with his lips</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and layeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">deceit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> him;<note type="study"><catchWord>dissembleth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">is known</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">When he speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">fair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">believe</w> him not: for <transChange type="added">there are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>speaketh…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">maketh his voice gracious</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:26
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Whose</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08135">hatred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">is covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04860">by deceit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">his wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be shewed</w> before the <transChange type="added">whole</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06951">congregation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in secret</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whoso diggeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">a pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">therein: and he that rolleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">a stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it will return</w> upon him.

verses.name: Proverbs 26:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08267">A lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hateth</w> <transChange type="added">those that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01790">afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02509">by it; and a flattering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">worketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04072">ruin</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 26." eID="gen702" osisID="Prov.26"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Boast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">not thyself of to morrow</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">not what a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may bring forth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to morrow day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Let another man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">thee, and not thine own mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05237">a stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08193">and not thine own lips</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H068">A stone</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03514">heavy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02344">and the sand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05192">weighty</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0191">but a fool’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">wrath</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03515">heavier</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">than them both</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>heavy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heaviness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02534">Wrath</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0395">cruel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">and anger</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07858">outrageous</w>; but who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">able to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">envy</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Wrath…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Wrath is cruelty, and anger an overflowing</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>envy</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">jealousy?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">Open</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">rebuke</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">than secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">love</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Faithful</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06482">the wounds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of a friend</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05390">but the kisses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of an enemy</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06280" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">deceitful</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>deceitful</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">earnest</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">frequent</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07649">The full</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">loatheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05317">an honeycomb</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07457">but to the hungry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">every bitter thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04966">is sweet</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>loatheth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">treadeth under foot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06833">As a bird</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that wandereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07064">from her nest</w>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that wandereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">from his place</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08081">Ointment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">and perfume</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w>: so <transChange type="added">doth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04986">the sweetness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of a man’s friend</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">by hearty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">counsel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from the counsel of the soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07453">Thine own friend</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">friend</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not; neither go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">into thy brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0343">of thy calamity</w>: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07934">a neighbour</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">than a brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far off</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and make my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">glad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that I may answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him that reproacheth</w> me.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06175">A prudent</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">foreseeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hideth</w> himself; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06612">the simple</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pass on</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06064" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are punished</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that is surety</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">for a stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take a pledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">of him for a strange woman</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He that blesseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his friend</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">rising early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">a curse</w> to him.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02956" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">A continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H01812">dropping</w> <w lemma="strong:H05464">in a very rainy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04066 strong:H04079" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and a contentious</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8739">are alike</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whosoever hideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">her hideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and the ointment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">of his right hand</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bewrayeth</w> <transChange type="added">itself</transChange>.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01270">Iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H02300" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sharpeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">iron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">so a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02300" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">sharpeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of his friend</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whoso keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">the fig tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thereof: so he that waiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">on his master</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be honoured</w>.
