verses.name: Proverbs 27:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">As in water</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w> <transChange type="added">answereth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">so the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">to man</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07585">Hell</w> <w lemma="strong:H010 strong:H011" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">are never</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">full</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">so the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are never satisfied</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>never</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">not</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:21
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04715">the fining pot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03564">and the furnace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">for gold</w>; so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H04110">his praise</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03806" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Though thou shouldest bray</w> <w lemma="strong:H0191">a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H04388">in a mortar</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H07383">wheat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05940">with a pestle</w>, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0200">will not his foolishness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">depart</w> from him.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Be thou diligent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the state</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of thy flocks</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">look</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">well</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">to thy herds</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>look…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set thy heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02633">For riches</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">not for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05145">and doth the crown</w> <transChange type="added">endure</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to every</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>riches</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strength</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to generation and generation?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02682">The hay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">appeareth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01877">and the tender grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">itself, and herbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are gathered</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03532">The lambs</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03830">for thy clothing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06260">and the goats</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04242">the price</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 27:27
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">thou shalt have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05795">goats’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">enough</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">for thy food</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">for the food</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of thy household</w>, and <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the maintenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">for thy maidens</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>maintenance</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">life</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 27." eID="gen703" osisID="Prov.27"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when no man pursueth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06662">but the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are bold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">as a lion</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06588">For the transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">thereof: but by a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of understanding</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03651">the state</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall be prolonged</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">by men of understanding and wisdom shall they likewise be prolonged</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">A poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that oppresseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w> <transChange type="added">is like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05502" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a sweeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">which leaveth no food</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">without food</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They that forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but such as keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H01624" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">contend</w> with them.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">Evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">not judgment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">but they that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">understand</w> all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">Better</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">in his uprightness</w>, than <transChange type="added">he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06141">perverse</w> <transChange type="added">in his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w>, though he <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06223">rich</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whoso keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that is a companion</w> <w lemma="strong:H02151" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of riotous</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shameth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>is a companion…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">feedeth gluttons</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05392">He that by usury</w> <w lemma="strong:H08636">and unjust gain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">increaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">his substance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he shall gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it for him that will pity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unjust…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by increase</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He that turneth away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">his ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from hearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08605">even his prayer</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03477">Whoso causeth the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to go astray</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">in an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07816">himself into his own pit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08549">but the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">shall have good</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in possession</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06223">The rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his own conceit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01800">but the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that hath understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">searcheth him out</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>own…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">When righteous</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05970" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">do rejoice</w>, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">glory</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">but when the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">rise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">is hidden</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hidden</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sought for</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He that covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">his sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not prosper</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">but whoso confesseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and forsaketh</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall have mercy</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Happy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that feareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">alway</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">but he that hardeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">into mischief</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05098" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a roaring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08264" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and a ranging</w> <w lemma="strong:H01677">bear</w>; <transChange type="added">so is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07563">a wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">over the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05057">The prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H02638">that wanteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">understanding</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">also a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04642">oppressor</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that hateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">covetousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall prolong</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">A man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that doeth violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">to the blood</w> of <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">person</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">to the pit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let no man stay</w> him.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whoso walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">uprightly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be saved</w>: but <transChange type="added">he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06140" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">perverse</w> <transChange type="added">in his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">at once</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that tilleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">his land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall have plenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">but he that followeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07386">after vain</w> <transChange type="added">persons</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07389">shall have poverty enough</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0530">A faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">shall abound</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">with blessings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0213" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">but he that maketh haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to be rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be innocent</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>innocent</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">unpunished</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To have respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of persons</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06595">for for a piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01397">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will transgress</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">He</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that hasteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">to be rich</w> <transChange type="added">hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eye</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and considereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02639">not that poverty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> upon him.<note type="study"><catchWord>hasteth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hath and evil eye hasteth to be rich</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He that rebuketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">afterwards</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">more favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">than he that flattereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">with the tongue</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whoso robbeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">or his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and saith</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06588">no transgression</w>; the same <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02270">the companion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843 strong:H0376" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of a destroyer</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a destroyer</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man destroying</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07342">He that is of a proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01624" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">stirreth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04066">strife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that putteth his trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01878" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be made fat</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that trusteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his own heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">is a fool</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but whoso walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">he shall be delivered</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04270">shall not lack</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">but he that hideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">shall have many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03994">a curse</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 28:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">When the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">rise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">themselves: but when they perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">increase</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 28." eID="gen704" osisID="Prov.28"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">He</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08433">that being often reproved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">hardeneth</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06203">neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06621">shall suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be destroyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04832">and that without remedy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">A man of reproofs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">When the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">are in authority</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">but when the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">beareth rule</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0584" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">mourn</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">increased</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Whoso</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">rejoiceth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that keepeth company</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with harlots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spendeth</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01952">substance</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">by judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">establisheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">but he</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">that receiveth gifts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">overthroweth</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man of oblations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01397">A man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that flattereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">spreadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07568">a net</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">for his feet</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06588">In the transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04170">a snare</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06662">but the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doth sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08056">and rejoice</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">considereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01779">the cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">of the poor</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">regardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">not to know</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03944">Scornful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06315" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-325">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06315" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-325">into a snare</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02450">but wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">wrath</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bring…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">set a city on fire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">If</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">contendeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0191">with a foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whether he rage</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or laugh</w>, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05183">no rest</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01818 strong:H0582">The bloodthirsty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08535">the upright</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03477">but the just</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The bloodthirsty</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Men of blood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03684">A fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">uttereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">all his mind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02450">but a wise</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07623" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">it in till afterwards</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">If a ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267 strong:H01697">to lies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">all his servants</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07563">wicked</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H08501">and the deceitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06298" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">meet together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">lighteneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">their eyes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the deceitful…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the usurer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">that faithfully</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">judgeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03678">his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07626">The rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">and reproof</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05288">but a child</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">left</w> <transChange type="added">to himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">bringeth his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to shame</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">When the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">are multiplied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06588">transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">increaseth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06662">but the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04658">their fall</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Correct</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he shall give thee rest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, he shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04574">delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">unto thy soul</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:18
verses.text: Where <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02377">no vision</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">perish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0835">happy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he.<note type="study"><catchWord>perish</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">is made naked</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">A servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">will not be corrected</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">by words</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for though he understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04617">he will not answer</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thou a man</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0213" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">hasty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in his words</w>? <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08615">more hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of a fool</w> than of him.<note type="study"><catchWord>words</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">matters?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06445" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He that delicately bringeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05290">from a child</w> shall have him become <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04497">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">at the length</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">An angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01624" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">stirreth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04066">strife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">and a furious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">aboundeth in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">transgression</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">A man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01346">pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall bring him low</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03519">but honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall uphold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08217">the humble</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">in spirit</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whoso is partner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01590">with a thief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his own soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">cursing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and bewrayeth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> not.

verses.name: Proverbs 29:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02731">The fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04170">a snare</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but whoso putteth his trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be safe</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>safe</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set on high</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the ruler’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">favour</w>; but <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <transChange type="added">cometh</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the ruler’s…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the face of a ruler</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05766">An unjust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">to the just</w>: and <transChange type="added">he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">to the wicked</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 29." eID="gen705" osisID="Prov.29"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H094">of Agur</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03348">of Jakeh</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04853">the prophecy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01397">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0384">unto Ithiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0384">even unto Ithiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0401">and Ucal</w>,

verses.name: Proverbs 30:2
verses.text: Surely I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01198">more brutish</w> than <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0998">and have not the understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 30:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I neither learned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor have</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">the knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">of the holy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>have</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">know</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who hath ascended up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">into heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or descended</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hath gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H02651">in his fists</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hath bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">in a garment</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">who hath established</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">all the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>? what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>, and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou canst tell</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 30:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0565">Every word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">of God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">pure</w>: he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04043">a shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them that put their trust</w> in him.<note type="study"><catchWord>pure</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">purified</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Add</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thou not unto his words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lest he reprove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03576" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thee, and thou be found a liar</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 30:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">Two</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I required</w> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of thee; deny</w> me <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not before I die</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>deny…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">withhold not from me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Remove far</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">from me vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577 strong:H01697">and lies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07389">me neither poverty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">nor riches</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">me with food</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">convenient</w> for me:<note type="study"><catchWord>convenient…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of my allowance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Lest I be full</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and deny</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">or lest I be poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and steal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of my God</w> <transChange type="added">in vain</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>deny…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">belie thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03960" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Accuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">not a servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto his master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">lest he curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and thou be found guilty</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Accuse…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hurt not with thy tongue</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">a generation</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">curseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and doth not bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">their mother</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 30:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">a generation</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in their own eyes</w>, and <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is not washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06675">from their filthiness</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 30:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">a generation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">O how lofty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">are their eyes</w>! <w lemma="strong:H06079">and their eyelids</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">are lifted up</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 30:14
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">a generation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08127">whose teeth</w> <transChange type="added">are as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">swords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04973">and their jaw teeth</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03979">knives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from off the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H034">and the needy</w> from <transChange type="added">among</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 30:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05936">The horseleach</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">hath two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>, <transChange type="added">crying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">give</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07969">There are three</w> <transChange type="added">things that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are never satisfied</w>, <transChange type="added">yea</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">say</w> not, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01952">enough</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>It is…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Wealth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07585">The grave</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06115">and the barren</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">womb</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is not filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0784">and the fire</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> not, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01952">enough</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 30:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">The eye</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">mocketh</w> at <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0936" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and despiseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03349">to obey</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06158">the ravens</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H05365" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pick it out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the young</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">eagles</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>the valley</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the brook</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">There be three</w> <transChange type="added">things which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are too wonderful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">for me, yea, four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I know</w> not:

verses.name: Proverbs 30:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">of an eagle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the air</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">of a serpent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">upon a rock</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">of a ship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01870">and the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">of a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05959">with a maid</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>midst</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:20
verses.text: Such <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of an adulterous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she eateth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wipeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">her mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">no wickedness</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 30:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">For three</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is disquieted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and for four</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">bear</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 30:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">For a servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when he reigneth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05036">and a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when he is filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">with meat</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 30:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">For an odious</w> <transChange type="added">woman</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">when she is married</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08198">and an handmaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that is heir</w> <w lemma="strong:H01404">to her mistress</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 30:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0702">There be four</w> <transChange type="added">things which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06996">little</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>, but they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>exceeding…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wise, made wise</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05244">The ants</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05794">not strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet they prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">their meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">in the summer</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 30:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08227">The conies</w> <transChange type="added">are but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06099">a feeble</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">folk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">they their houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">in the rocks</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 30:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0697">The locusts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">have no king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet go they forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02686" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all of them by bands</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gathered together</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08079">The spider</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">taketh hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with her hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and is in kings’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">palaces</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 30:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">There be three</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06806">which go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">yea, four</w> <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">are comely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in going</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 30:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03918">A lion</w> <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">strongest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">among beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and turneth not away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for</w> any;

verses.name: Proverbs 30:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02223 strong:H04975">A greyhound</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08495">an he goat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0176">also</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and a king</w>, against whom <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0510">no rising up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>greyhound</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">horse</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">girt in the loins</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If thou hast done foolishly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">in lifting up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02161" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thyself, or if thou hast thought evil</w>, <transChange type="added">lay</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">upon thy mouth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 30:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04330">Surely the churning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">of milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bringeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02529">butter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04330">and the wringing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of the nose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bringeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04330">so the forcing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bringeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">strife</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 30." eID="gen706" osisID="Prov.30"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03927">Lemuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04853">the prophecy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">that his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">taught</w> him.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01248">What, my son</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01248">and what, the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of my womb</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01248">and what, the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">of my vows</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 31:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">not thy strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">nor thy ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to that which destroyeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">not for kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03927">O Lemuel</w>, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">not for kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0176 strong:H0335" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">nor for</w> <w lemma="strong:H07336" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941">strong drink</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 31:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Lest they drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and pervert</w> <w lemma="strong:H01779">the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040 strong:H01121">of any of the afflicted</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pervert</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">alter</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>of any…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of all the sons of affliction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941">strong drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto him that is ready to perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">and wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">unto those that be of heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">hearts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bitter of soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let him drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H07389">his poverty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">his misery</w> no more.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">thy mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0483">for the dumb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01779">in the cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of all such as are appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02475">to destruction</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>such…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the sons of destruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteously</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the cause of the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who can find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">a virtuous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04377">for her price</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H06443">above rubies</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">The heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">of her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">doth safely trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in her, so that he shall have no need</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">of spoil</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">She will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">him good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and not evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of her life</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">She seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06785">wool</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06593">and flax</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and worketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">willingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">with her hands</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">She is like the merchants’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">ships</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">she bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">her food</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">from afar</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">She riseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">also while it is yet night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to her household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">and a portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">to her maidens</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02161" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">She considereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">a field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and buyeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">it: with the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">of her hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she planteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">a vineyard</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>buyeth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">taketh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">She girdeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">her loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">with strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and strengtheneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">her arms</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02938" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">She perceiveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05504">that her merchandise</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05216">her candle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">goeth not out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>She…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">She tasteth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">She layeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">her hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03601">to the spindle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and her hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06418">the distaff</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">She stretcheth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">her hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">to the poor</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">yea, she reacheth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">her hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">to the needy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>She…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">She spreadeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">She is not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07950">of the snow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for her household</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">for all her household</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08144">with scarlet</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>scarlet</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">double garments</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">She maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04765">herself coverings of tapestry</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03830">her clothing</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08336">silk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01167">Her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is known</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">among the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">She maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05466">fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and selleth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and delivereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02289">girdles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">unto the merchant</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05797">Strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">and honour</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03830">her clothing</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she shall rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">to come</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">She openeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">her mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">with wisdom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03956">and in her tongue</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of kindness</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">She looketh well</w> <w lemma="strong:H01979 strong:H01979" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">to the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of her household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">not the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06104">of idleness</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Her children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">arise up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and call her blessed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01167">her husband</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he praiseth</w> her.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">virtuously</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but thou excellest</w> them all.<note type="study"><catchWord>have…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">have gotten riches</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02580">Favour</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08267">deceitful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03308">and beauty</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vain</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a woman</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03373">feareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">she shall be praised</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 31:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">her of the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of her hands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04639">and let her own works</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">her in the gates</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 31." eID="gen707" osisID="Prov.31"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen676" osisID="Prov" type="book"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06953">of the Preacher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01892">Vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">of vanities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H06953">the Preacher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">of vanities</w>; all <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03504">What profit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">hath a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">of all his labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05998" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>?

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">One</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passeth away</w>, and <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935 strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8802">cometh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">but the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">abideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">The sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also ariseth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08121">and the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">goeth down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07602" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and hasteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to his place</w> <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">where he arose</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hasteth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">panteth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">The wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01864">toward the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and turneth about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">unto the north</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it whirleth about continually</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">returneth again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">according to his circuits</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05158">All the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">run</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">into the sea</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03220">yet the sea</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04392">not full</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">from whence the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thither they return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">again</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>return…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">return to go</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">All things</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03023">full of labour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">utter</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is not satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with seeing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">nor the ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with hearing</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:9
verses.text: The thing that hath been, it <transChange type="added">is that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which shall be; and that which is done</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that which shall be done</w>: and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02319">no new</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">Is there</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whereof it may be said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02319">new</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03528">it hath been already</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">which was before</w> us.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02146">no remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of former</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange>; neither shall there be <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02146">remembrance</w> of <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0314">that are to come</w> with <transChange type="added">those</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0314">that shall come after</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06953">I the Preacher</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">was king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and search out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">by wisdom</w> concerning all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that are done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">under heaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07451">this sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H06045">travail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">hath God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be exercised</w> therewith.<note type="study"><catchWord>to be…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to afflict them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">all the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that are done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>; and, behold, all <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07469">and vexation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of spirit</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">That which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05791" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">crooked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H08626" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be made straight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02642">and that which is wanting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">be numbered</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that which is wanting</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">defect</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I communed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">with mine own heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Lo, I am come to great estate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and have gotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">more wisdom</w> than all <transChange type="added">they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">that have been before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">me in Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">yea, my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">had great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">experience</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">and knowledge</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>had…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">had seen much</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01947">madness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05531">and folly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H01571">that this</w> <w lemma="strong:H07475">also is vexation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of spirit</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">For in much</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07230">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">grief</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he that increaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">increaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04341">sorrow</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen709" osisID="Eccl.1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in mine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go to now</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will prove</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">thee with mirth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">therefore enjoy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">pleasure</w>: and, behold, this also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07814">of laughter</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">mad</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08057">and of mirth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02090">What</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doeth</w> it?

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">myself</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">unto wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">yet acquainting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">with wisdom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to lay hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05531">on folly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">till I might see</w> what <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">that good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which they should do</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">under the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of their life</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to give…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to draw my flesh with wine</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the number of the days of their life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I made me great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">works</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">me houses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">me vineyards</w>:

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01593">me gardens</w> <w lemma="strong:H06508">and orchards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w> in them of all <transChange type="added">kind of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06529">fruits</w>:

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01295">me pools</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">therewith the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bringeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w>:

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I got</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">and maidens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and had servants born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in my house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">also I had great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">possessions</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">and small cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">above all that were in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> me:<note type="study"><catchWord>servants born…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sons of my house</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03664" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">me also silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05459">and the peculiar treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">and of the provinces</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I gat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me men singers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and women singers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08588">and the delights</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07705 strong:H07705">musical instruments</w>, and that of all sorts.<note type="study"><catchWord>musical…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">musical instrument and instruments</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">So I was great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">more than all that were before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">me in Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02451">also my wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">remained</w> with me.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">And whatsoever mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">desired</w> <w lemma="strong:H0680" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not from them, I withheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">not my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">from any joy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03820">for my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08056">rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">in all my labour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02506">and this was my portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">of all my labour</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then I looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">on all the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">that my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had wrought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05999">and on the labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05998" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I had laboured</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w>: and, behold, all <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07469">and vexation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of spirit</w>, and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03504">no profit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">myself to behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01947">and madness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05531">and folly</w>: for what <transChange type="added">can</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">the man</w> <transChange type="added">do</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>? <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03528">that which hath been already</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">done</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>even…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in those things which have been already done</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03504">excelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05531">folly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">as far as light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03504">excelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that there is an excellency in wisdom more than in folly</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">The wise man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eyes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in his head</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03684">but the fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">in darkness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I myself perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">also that one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04745">event</w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">happeneth</w> to them all.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:15
