verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0227">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">I in my heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04745">As it happeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">to the fool</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so it happeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01571">even to me</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03148">and why was I then more</w> <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wise</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Then I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in my heart</w>, that this also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>happeneth even…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">happeneth to me, even to me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:16
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02146">no remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">more than</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of the fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03528">seeing that which now</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall all be forgotten</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And how dieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">the wise</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H03684">as the fool</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore I hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04639">because the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that is wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">grievous</w> unto me: for all <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07469">and vexation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of spirit</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yea, I hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">all my labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06001">which I had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">because I should leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">it unto the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">that shall be after</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>taken</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">laboured</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And who knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">whether he shall be a wise</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05530">or a fool</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07980" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet shall he have rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">over all my labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05998" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein I have laboured</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wherein I have shewed myself wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">also vanity</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore I went about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02976" morph="strongMorph:TH8763" type="x-split-326">to cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02976" morph="strongMorph:TH8763" type="x-split-326">to despair</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">of all the labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05998" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">For there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">whose labour</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02451">in wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01847">and in knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03788">and in equity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0120">yet to a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05998" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that hath not laboured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein shall he leave</w> it <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">his portion</w>. This also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">and a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>leave</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">give</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01933" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For what hath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">of all his labour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07475">and of the vexation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01931">wherein</w> <w lemma="strong:H06001">he hath laboured</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>?

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For all his days</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04341">sorrows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06045">and his travail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">grief</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03820">yea, his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">taketh not rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01892">This is also vanity</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">nothing better</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">for a man</w>, <transChange type="added">than</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he should eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and drink</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">he should make his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">enjoy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">in his labour</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02090">This</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also I saw</w>, that it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>should make…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">delight his senses</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For who can eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or who else can hasten</w> <transChange type="added">hereunto</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02351">more</w> than I?

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:26
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">God</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">to a man</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in his sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01847">and knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08057">and joy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but to the sinner</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06045">travail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H03664" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to heap up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he may give</w> to <transChange type="added">him that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>. This also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07469">and vexation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of spirit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before him</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen710" osisID="Eccl.2"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:1
verses.text: To every <transChange type="added">thing there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02165">a season</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">to every purpose</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">under the heaven</w>:

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">A time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be born</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06256">a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to plant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06131" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to pluck up</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">planted</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>to be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to bear</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">A time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to kill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to heal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06256">a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to break down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build up</w>;

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">A time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to weep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to laugh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06256">a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to mourn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07540" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dance</w>;

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">A time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cast away</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03664" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-327">to gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03664" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-327">together</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06256">a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02263" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to embrace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to refrain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02263" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">from embracing</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>to refrain from</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to be far from</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">A time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to get</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to lose</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06256">a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cast away</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>get</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">seek</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">A time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to rend</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08609" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sew</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06256">a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep silence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to speak</w>;

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">A time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hate</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06256">a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03504">What profit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hath he that worketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">in that wherein</w> <w lemma="strong:H06001">he laboureth</w>?

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06045">the travail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">which God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be exercised</w> in it.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath made</w> every <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03303">beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in his time</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also he hath set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in their heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01097">so that</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can find out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">from the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05490">to the end</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> that <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">no good</w> in them, but for <transChange type="added">a man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">in his life</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">And also that every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and enjoy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">of all his labour</w>, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04991">the gift</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">that, whatsoever God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">it shall be for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0369">nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">can be put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to it, nor any thing taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">from it: and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">doeth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, that <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03528">That which hath been is now</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03528">and that which is to be hath already</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">been; and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">requireth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that which is past</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that which is past</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that which is driven away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And moreover I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07562">wickedness</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">there; and the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of righteousness</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07562">iniquity</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> there.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in mine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">and the wicked</w>: for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">there for every purpose</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">and for every work</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01700">concerning the estate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">might manifest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, and that they might see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01992">that they</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">themselves are beasts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that God…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that they might clear God, and see</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04745">For that which befalleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04745">befalleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">beasts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">even one thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04745">befalleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">them: as the one dieth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04194">so dieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">the other</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">yea, they have all one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">breath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0120">so that a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04195">hath no preeminence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">above a beast</w>: for all <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">All go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">unto one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06083">all are of the dust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-328">and all turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">to dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-328">again</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120 strong:H01121">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of the beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">downward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>of man</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of the sons of man</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>goeth upward</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is ascending</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore I perceive</w> that <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">nothing better</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">than that a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">in his own works</w>; for that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">his portion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for who shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">what shall be after</w> him? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen711" osisID="Eccl.3"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">So I returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and considered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06217">all the oppressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that are done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01832">and behold the tears</w> of <transChange type="added">such as were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">oppressed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and they had no comforter</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">and on the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their oppressors</w> <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">but they had no comforter</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>side</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07623" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Wherefore I praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">the dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03528">which are already</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">more than the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H05728">which are yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">alive</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">Yea, better</w> <transChange type="added">is he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">than both</w> <w lemma="strong:H05728">they, which hath not yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">been, who hath not seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that is done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Again, I considered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">all travail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03788">and every right</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that for this a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">is envied</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of his neighbour</w>. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">also vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07469">and vexation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of spirit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>every…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all the rightness of work</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>for this…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">this is the envy of a man from his neighbour</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03684">The fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H02263" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-329">foldeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02263" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-329">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">his own flesh</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">Better</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">an handful</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05183">quietness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02651">than both the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">full</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05999">travail</w> <w lemma="strong:H07469">and vexation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of spirit</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then I returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">There is</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <transChange type="added">alone</transChange>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08145">not a second</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">yea, he hath neither child</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">nor brother</w>: yet <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07093">no end</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">of all his labour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">neither is his eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">with riches</w>; neither <transChange type="added">saith he</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06001">For whom do I labour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and bereave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">of good</w>? This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">also vanity</w>, yea, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">a sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H06045">travail</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08147">Two</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">than one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03426">because they have</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">for their labour</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For if they fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02270">his fellow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0337">but woe</w> to him <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">alone</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when he falleth</w>; for <transChange type="added">he hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08145">not another</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to help him up</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01571">Again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">if two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lie together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then they have heat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">but how can one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03179" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be warm</w> <transChange type="added">alone</transChange>?

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And if one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08630" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prevail</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">against him, two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall withstand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08027" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">him; and a threefold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02339">cord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">is not quickly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">broken</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02896">Better</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04542">a poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">and a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">child</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">than an old</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">and foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who will</w> <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">no more be admonished</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>who…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">who knoweth not to be admonished</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004 strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">For out of prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to reign</w>; whereas also <transChange type="added">he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">born</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">in his kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">becometh poor</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I considered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">all the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08145">with the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">child</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall stand up</w> in his stead.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:16
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07093">no end</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of all that have been before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">them: they also that come after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not rejoice</w> in him. Surely this also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07475">and vexation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of spirit</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen712" osisID="Eccl.4"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">thy foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07138">and be more ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">than to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for they consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not that they do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Be not rash</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and let not thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">be hasty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to utter</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and thou upon earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">therefore let thy words</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">be few</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thing</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">word</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02472">For a dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">through the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H06045">of business</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03684">and a fool’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w> <transChange type="added">is known</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07230">by multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of words</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou vowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">a vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">defer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">not to pay</w> it; for <transChange type="added">he hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02656">no pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">in fools</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that which thou hast vowed</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">Better</w> <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou shouldest not vow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">than that thou shouldest vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and not pay</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">not thy mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">to cause thy flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to sin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thou before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the angel</w>, that it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07684">an error</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">wherefore should God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">at thy voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hands</w>?

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">For in the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">of dreams</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w> <transChange type="added">there are</transChange> also <transChange type="added">divers</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanities</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">but fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thou God</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06233">the oppression</w> <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01499">and violent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">perverting of judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">and justice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">in a province</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08539" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">marvel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">not at the matter</w>: for <transChange type="added">he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01364">higher</w> <w lemma="strong:H01364">than the highest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">regardeth</w>; and <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01364">higher</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">than they</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>at the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at the will</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">purpose</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03504">Moreover the profit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">is for all: the king</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is served</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">by the field</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not be satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">with silver</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor he that loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">with increase</w>: this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">also vanity</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">When goods</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">increase</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03788">them: and what good</w> <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01167">to the owners</w> <w lemma="strong:H0518">thereof, saving</w> <w lemma="strong:H07212 strong:H07207" morph="strongMorph:TH8801 strongMorph:TH8675">the beholding</w> <transChange type="added">of them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with their eyes</w>?

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08142">The sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of a labouring man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04966">sweet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whether he eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">little</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">or much</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07647">but the abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06223">of the rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">will not suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him to sleep</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">There is</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>, <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06239">riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">for the owners</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">thereof to their hurt</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06239">But those riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">by evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06045">travail</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he begetteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03972">nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">As he came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">womb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06174">naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as he came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">of his labour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which he may carry away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02090">And this</w> also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05980">in all points</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as he came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so shall he go</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03504">and what profit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05998" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath he that hath laboured</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">for the wind</w>?

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">All his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also he eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">in darkness</w>, and <transChange type="added">he hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07110">and wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">with his sickness</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>Behold <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have seen</w>: <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">and comely</w> <transChange type="added">for one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to enjoy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">of all his labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05998" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">which God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">giveth</w> him: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">his portion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it is good…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">there is a good which is comely</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>all the days</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the number of the days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">also to whom God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05233">and wealth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07980" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and hath given him power</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof, and to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">his portion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">in his labour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02090">this</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04991">the gift</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">For he shall not much</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">because God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">answereth</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08057">in the joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of his heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>For…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Though he give not much, yet he remembereth</rdg>, etc</note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen713" osisID="Eccl.5"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">There is</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>, and it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">common</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">among men</w>:

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">A man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to whom God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">riches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05233">wealth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and honour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02638">so that he wanteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">nothing for his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">of all that he desireth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">yet God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07980" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">giveth him not power</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237 strong:H0376">thereof, but a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eateth</w> it: this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>, and it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">disease</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">beget</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <transChange type="added">children</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and live</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">so that the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of his years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">be many</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">with good</w>, and also <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06900">he have no burial</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I say</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05309">an untimely birth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> than he.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For he cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">in with vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and departeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">in darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">with darkness</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Moreover he hath not seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor known</w> <transChange type="added">any thing</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H02088">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H05183">hath more rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">than</w> the other.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0432">Yea, though</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he live</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">twice</w> <transChange type="added">told</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet hath he seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">no good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">do not all go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>?

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05999">All the labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">for his mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and yet the appetite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is not filled</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>appetite</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">For what hath the wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03148">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">than the fool</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06041">what hath the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">before the living</w>?

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02896">Better</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">than the wandering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of the desire</w>: this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">also vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07469">and vexation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of spirit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>than…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">than the walking of the soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034 strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">That which hath been is named</w> <w lemma="strong:H03528">already</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and it is known</w> that it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither may</w> <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he contend</w> <w lemma="strong:H08623">with him that is mightier</w> than he.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03426">Seeing there be</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">things</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>, what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03148">the better</w>?

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For who knoweth</w> what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">for man</w> in <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">of his vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he spendeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">as a shadow</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for who can tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">what shall be after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">him under the sun</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the number of the days of the life of his vanity</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen714" osisID="Eccl.6"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">A good name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">than precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">ointment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">and the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">than the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">of one’s birth</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">of mourning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">than to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">of feasting</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0834">for</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05490">the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of all men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02416">and the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will lay</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">to his heart</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03708">Sorrow</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H07814">than laughter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07455">for by the sadness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of the countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is made better</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Sorrow</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Anger</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">The heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">of mourning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03820">but the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">of mirth</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01606">the rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">than for a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">the song</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">For as the crackling</w> <w lemma="strong:H05518">of thorns</w> <w lemma="strong:H05518">under a pot</w>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07814">the laughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of the fool</w>: this also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>crackling</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sound</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06233">Surely oppression</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">maketh a wise man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">mad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04979">and a gift</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">destroyeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">Better</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0319">the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of a thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">than the beginning</w> thereof: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0750">the patient</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">in spirit</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H01362">than the proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">in spirit</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Be not hasty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">in thy spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be angry</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03708">for anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">resteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">in the bosom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Say</w> not thou, What is <transChange type="added">the cause</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">that the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">were better</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">than these? for thou dost not enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisely</w> concerning this.<note type="study"><catchWord>wisely</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">out of wisdom</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02451">Wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">with an inheritance</w>: and <transChange type="added">by it there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03148">profit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that see</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>good…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">as good as an inheritance, yea, better too</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02451">For wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06738">a defence</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06738">a defence</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03504">but the excellency</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">of knowledge</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">giveth life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">to them that have</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>defence</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shadow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for who can</w> make <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08626" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">straight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05791" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he hath made crooked</w>?

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">of prosperity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">be joyful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">but in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of adversity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">consider</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also hath set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05980">the one over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01700">the other, to the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should find</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>set</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:15
verses.text: All <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">of my vanity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03426">there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">a just</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that perisheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">in his righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">and there is a wicked</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that prolongeth</w> <transChange type="added">his life</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">in his wickedness</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">Be not righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">over much</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03148">neither make thyself over</w> <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">wise</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">why shouldest thou destroy</w> thyself?<note type="study"><catchWord>destroy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be desolate?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">Be not over much</w> <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05530">neither be thou foolish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">why shouldest thou die</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">before thy time</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>before…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">not in thy time?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou shouldest take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">of this; yea, also from this</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">withdraw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">not thine hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03373">for he that feareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come forth</w> of them all.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02451">Wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05810" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">strengtheneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">the wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">more than ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07989">mighty</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">which are in the city</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:20
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">not a just</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sinneth</w> not.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Also take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">no heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto all words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that are spoken</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest thou hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">curse</w> thee:<note type="study"><catchWord>take…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">give not thine heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227 strong:H06471">For oftentimes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">also thine own heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that thou thyself likewise hast cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">others</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02090">All this</w> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have I proved</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">by wisdom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will be wise</w>; but it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far</w> from me.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07350">That which is far off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06013">and exceeding deep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who can find it out</w>?

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I applied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to know</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to search</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to seek out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02808">and the reason</w> <transChange type="added">of things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03689">of folly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05531">even of foolishness</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01947">madness</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>I applied…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I and mine heart compassed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And I find</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">more bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">than death</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">whose heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04685">snares</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">and nets</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">her hands</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0612">bands</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H02896">whoso pleaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from her; but the sinner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be taken</w> by her.<note type="study"><catchWord>whoso…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">he that is good before God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this have I found</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H06953">the preacher</w>, <transChange type="added">counting</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">by one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to find out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02808">the account</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>counting…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">weighing one thing after another, to find out the reason</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">Which yet my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">seeketh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but I find</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">not: one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">among a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I found</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802">but a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">among all those have I not found</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0905">this only</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I found</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">upright</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">but they have sought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H02810">inventions</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen715" osisID="Eccl.7"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:1
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">as the wise</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and who knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06592">the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of a thing</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">maketh his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to shine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05797">and the boldness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H08132" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be changed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the boldness</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:2
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">counsel thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">commandment</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01700">in regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">of the oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Be not hasty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of his sight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">not in an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whatsoever pleaseth</w> him.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Where the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of a king</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07983">power</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and who may say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, What doest</w> thou?

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whoso keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall feel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">no evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02450">and a wise man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">discerneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">both time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgment</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall know</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02656">Because to every purpose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">therefore the misery</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> upon him.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For he knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">not that which shall be: for who can tell</w> him when it shall be?<note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">how it shall be?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07989">that hath power</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">over the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to retain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w>; neither <transChange type="added">hath he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07983">power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w>: and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04917">no discharge</w> in <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07562">neither shall wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">those that are given</w> to it.<note type="study"><catchWord>discharge</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">casting off weapons</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">All this have I seen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and applied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">unto every work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that is done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">wherein one man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ruleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">over another to his own hurt</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03651">And so</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">buried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who had come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">from the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">of the holy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and they were forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">where they had so done</w>: this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">also vanity</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06599">Because sentence</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">against an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is not executed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">speedily</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">therefore the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fully set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in them to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Though a sinner</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred times</w>, and his <transChange type="added">days</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">be prolonged</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">yet surely I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">that it shall be well</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">with them that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him:

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">But it shall not be well</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">with the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">neither shall he prolong</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <transChange type="added">which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06738">as a shadow</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03373">because he feareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">not before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">There is</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">a vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which is done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06662">that there be just</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">unto whom it happeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">according to the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03426">again, there be</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">wicked</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to whom it happeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">according to the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01571">that this also</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07623" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Then I commended</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">mirth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">because a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">hath no better thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">than to eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to be merry</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for that shall abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">with him of his labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">which God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">him under the sun</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When I applied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06045">the business</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that is done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>: (for also <transChange type="added">there is that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">neither day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nor night</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08142">sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with his eyes</w>:)

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then I beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">all the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">that a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">find out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that is done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0834">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07945">though</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05998" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">labour</w> to seek <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet he shall not find</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H02450">yea further; though a wise</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">think</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to know</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet shall he not be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to find</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen716" osisID="Eccl.8"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For all this I considered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0952" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">even to declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">all this, that the righteous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02450">and the wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05652">and their works</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0120">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01571">either</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08135">or hatred</w> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> all <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>I considered…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I gave</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">set to my heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:2
