verses.text: All <transChange type="added">things come</transChange> alike to all: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04745">event</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">to the righteous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">and to the wicked</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02896">to the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">and to the clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02931">and to the unclean</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to him that sacrificeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">and to him that</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sacrificeth</w> not: as <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the sinner</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">he that sweareth</w>, as <transChange type="added">he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03373">that feareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">an oath</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:3
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> among all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that are done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>, that <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04745">event</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">unto all: yea, also the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01947">and madness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">while they live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> that <transChange type="added">they go</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">to the dead</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04310">For</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">to him that is</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977 strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8792 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8792">joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">to all the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0986">there is hope</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02416">for a living</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">dog</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">is better</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">than a dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">lion</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">For the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they shall die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">but the dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">not any thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07939">neither have they any more a reward</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02143">for the memory</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">of them is forgotten</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0160">Also their love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08135">and their hatred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07068">and their envy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03528">is now</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">perished</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02506">neither have they any more a portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> in any <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that is done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go thy way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">thy bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with joy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">thy wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">with a merry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03528">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">accepteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">thy works</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0899">Let thy garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">be always</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07218">and let thy head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lack</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">no ointment</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">Live</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">joyfully</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">with the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom thou lovest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">of thy vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">thee under the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">of thy vanity</w>: for that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">thy portion</w> in <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05999">and in thy labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06001">which thou takest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Live…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">See</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Enjoy life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Whatsoever thy hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">findeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">with thy might</w>; for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">no work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02808">nor device</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01847">nor knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02451">nor wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07585">in the grave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither thou goest</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04793">that the race</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07031">not to the swift</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">nor the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">to the strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">neither yet bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">to the wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06239">nor yet riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">to men of understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02580">nor yet favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to men of skill</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06256">but time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06294">and chance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">happeneth</w> to them all.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">For man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">not his time</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01709">as the fishes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that are taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">in an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04685">net</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06833">and as the birds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that are caught</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">in the snare</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01992">so</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03369" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">snared</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">in an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when it falleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">suddenly</w> upon them.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02090">This</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">also under the sun</w>, and it <transChange type="added">seemed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> unto me:

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:14
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06996">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04592">and few</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">within it; and there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against it, and besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, and built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04685">bulwarks</w> against it:

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Now there was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04542">in it a poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02451">and he by his wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0120">yet no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04542">that same poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">I, Wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">than strength</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04542">nevertheless the poor man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">despised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and his words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">are not heard</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of wise</w> <transChange type="added">men are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05183">in quiet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02201">more than the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that ruleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">among fools</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02451">Wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">than weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07128">of war</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">but one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sinner</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">destroyeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen717" osisID="Eccl.9"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04194">Dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H02070">flies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">cause the ointment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07543" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the apothecary</w> <w lemma="strong:H05042" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to send forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">a stinking savour</w>: <transChange type="added">so doth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05531">folly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03368">him that is in reputation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">for wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">honour</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Dead…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Flies of death</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">A wise man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">at his right hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03684">but a fool’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">at his left</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05530">Yea also, when he that is a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">his wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02638">faileth</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he saith</w> to every one <transChange type="added">that</transChange> he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05530">a fool</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">If the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against thee, leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">not thy place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04832">for yielding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">pacifieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">offences</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">There is</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">under the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07684">as an error</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">proceedeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H07989">the ruler</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>from</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from before</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05529">Folly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">in great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">dignity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06223">and the rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08216">in low place</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in great…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in great heights</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">upon horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">walking</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">as servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that diggeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01475">a pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">into it; and whoso breaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01447">an hedge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05175">a serpent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall bite</w> him.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Whoso removeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be hurt</w> therewith; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that cleaveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05533" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be endangered</w> thereby.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01270">If the iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06949" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">be blunt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">and he do not whet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the edge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">then must he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">to more strength</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02451">but wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03504">profitable</w> <w lemma="strong:H03787" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to direct</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05175">Surely the serpent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will bite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03908">without enchantment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01167 strong:H03956">and a babbler</w> <w lemma="strong:H03504">is no better</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a babbler</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the master of the tongue</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of a wise man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02580">gracious</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08193">but the lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will swallow up</w> himself.<note type="study"><catchWord>gracious</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">grace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08462">The beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his mouth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05531">foolishness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0319">and the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his talk</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">mischievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01948">madness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his talk</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05530">A fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">also is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of words</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cannot tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">what shall be; and what shall be after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, who can tell</w> him?<note type="study"><catchWord>is full…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">multiplieth words</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05999">The labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of the foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wearieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">every one of them, because he knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not how to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to the city</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0337">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to thee, O land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">when thy king</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">a child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and thy princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>!

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thou, O land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">when thy king</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02715">of nobles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and thy princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in due season</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">for strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08358">and not for drunkenness</w>!

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06103">By much slothfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04746">the building</w> <w lemma="strong:H04355" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">decayeth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08220">and through idleness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01811" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">droppeth through</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03899">A feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07814">for laughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">and wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416 strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">maketh merry</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03701">but money</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answereth</w> all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>maketh…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">maketh glad the life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">not the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04093">no not in thy thought</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06223">not the rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904 strong:H02315">in thy bedchamber</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05775">for a bird</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01167">and that which hath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the matter</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thought</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">conscience</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen718" osisID="Eccl.10"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">thy bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thou shalt find</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">it after many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>upon…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon the face of the waters</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">a portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">to seven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08083">and also to eight</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">not what evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">shall be upon the earth</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05645">If the clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be full</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">of rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they empty</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06086">and if the tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01864">toward the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">or toward the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">where the tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">falleth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01933" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there it shall be</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that observeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not sow</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he that regardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">the clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not reap</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">As thou knowest</w> not what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of the spirit</w>, <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06106">how the bones</w> <transChange type="added">do grow</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0990">in the womb</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">of her that is with child</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">even so thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">not the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who maketh</w> all.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">In the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">thy seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06153">and in the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">withhold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">not thine hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0335">not whether</w> <w lemma="strong:H03787" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall prosper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">either this or that, or whether they both</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">alike</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall prosper</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall be right</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0216">Truly the light</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04966">sweet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and a pleasant</w> <transChange type="added">thing it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">for the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w>:

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">But if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in them all; yet let him remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">of darkness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">for they shall be many</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">All that cometh</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0970">O young man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03208">in thy youth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03820">and let thy heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cheer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0979">of thy youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">and in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of thine eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">but know</w> thou, that for all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thee into judgment</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Therefore remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">from thy heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">from thy flesh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03208">for childhood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07839">and youth</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sorrow</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">anger</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen719" osisID="Eccl.11"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">now thy Creator</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0979">of thy youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">while the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">not, nor the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">draw nigh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when thou shalt say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02656">I have no pleasure</w> in them;

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">While the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">or the light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03394">or the moon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03556">or the stars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not darkened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05645">nor the clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">the rain</w>:

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when the keepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02111" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall tremble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">and the strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05791" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">shall bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02912" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">themselves, and the grinders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because they are few</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and those that look out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0699">of the windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be darkened</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>the grinders…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the grinders fail, because they grind little</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01817">And the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">shall be shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H07784">in the streets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">when the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H02913">of the grinding</w> <w lemma="strong:H08217">is low</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">at the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">of the bird</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and all the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of musick</w> <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be brought low</w>;

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:5
verses.text: Also <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall be afraid</w> of <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01364">high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02849">and fears</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08247">and the almond tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall flourish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02284">and the grasshopper</w> <w lemma="strong:H05445" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall be a burden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H035">and desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall fail</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0120">because man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">to his long</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">home</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the mourners</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go about</w> <w lemma="strong:H07784">the streets</w>:

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03808">Or ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">cord</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368 strong:H07576" morph="strongMorph:TH8735 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8735">be loosed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">or the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01543">bowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03537">or the pitcher</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04002">at the fountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01534">or the wheel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">at the cistern</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06083">Then shall the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">as it was: and the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who gave</w> it.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01892">Vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">of vanities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H06953">the preacher</w>; all <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03148">And moreover</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06953">because the preacher</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">was wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he still taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0239" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">yea, he gave good heed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and sought out</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08626" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">set in order</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">proverbs</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>moreover…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the more wise the preacher was</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06953">The preacher</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to find out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">acceptable</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>: and <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03476">upright</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">of truth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>acceptable…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">words of delight</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01861">as goads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04930">and as nails</w> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">fastened</w> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01167">the masters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0627">of assemblies</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">from one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shepherd</w>.

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03148">And further</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01992">by these</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">be admonished</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of making</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">books</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07093">no end</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and much</w> <w lemma="strong:H03854">study</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03024">a weariness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of the flesh</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>study</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">reading</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05490">the conclusion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the whole matter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w>: for this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the whole <transChange type="added">duty</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Let…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">The end of the matter, even all that hath been heard, is</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">For God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">every work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">into judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">with every secret thing</w>, whether <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, or whether <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen720" osisID="Eccl.12"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen708" osisID="Eccl" type="book"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07892">The song</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of songs</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon’s</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let him kiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H05390">me with the kisses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01730">for thy love</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">than wine</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thy loves</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07381">Because of the savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">of thy good</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">ointments</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08081">ointment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">poured forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05959">therefore do the virgins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">love</w> thee.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, we will run</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">thee: the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">me into his chambers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">in thee, we will remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">thy love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">more than wine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04339">the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">love</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>the upright…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they love thee uprightly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:5
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07838">black</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05000">but comely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O ye daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">as the tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H06938">of Kedar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03407">as the curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Look</w> not upon me, because I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07840">black</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08121">because the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H07805" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">upon me: my mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02787" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with me; they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05201" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me the keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">of the vineyards</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03754">mine own vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I not kept</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">me, O thou whom my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where thou feedest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0349">where</w> thou makest <transChange type="added">thy flock</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">at noon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04100">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">why should I be as one that turneth aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">by the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H02270">of thy companions</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>as one…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">as one that is veiled</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">not, O thou fairest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">among women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go thy way forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06119">by the footsteps</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01429">thy kids</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">beside the shepherds’</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">tents</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have compared</w> <w lemma="strong:H07474">thee, O my love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05484">to a company of horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">in Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03895">Thy cheeks</w> <w lemma="strong:H04998" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">are comely</w> <w lemma="strong:H08447">with rows</w> <transChange type="added">of jewels</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06677">thy neck</w> <w lemma="strong:H02737">with chains</w> <transChange type="added">of gold</transChange>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08447">thee borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05351">with studs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">While the king</w> <transChange type="added">sitteth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04524">at his table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05373">my spikenard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sendeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">the smell</w> thereof.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06872">A bundle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04753">of myrrh</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01730">my wellbeloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me; he shall lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">all night betwixt my breasts</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01730">My beloved</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> unto me <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0811">a cluster</w> <w lemma="strong:H03724">of camphire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">in the vineyards</w> <w lemma="strong:H05872">of En–gedi</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>camphire</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cypress</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:15
verses.text: Behold, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03303">fair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07474">my love</w>; behold, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03303">fair</w>; thou <transChange type="added">hast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03123">doves’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eyes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my love</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">my companion</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:16
verses.text: Behold, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03303">fair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01730">my beloved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05273">yea, pleasant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06210">also our bed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07488">green</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06982">The beams</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of our house</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedar</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07351 strong:H07351" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">our rafters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01266">of fir</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rafters</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">galleries</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen722" osisID="Song.1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:1
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02261">the rose</w> <w lemma="strong:H08289">of Sharon</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07799">the lily</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">of the valleys</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07799">As the lily</w> <w lemma="strong:H02336">among thorns</w>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07474">my love</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">among the daughters</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08598">As the apple tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">among the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the wood</w>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01730">my beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among the sons</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">down under his shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">with great delight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and his fruit</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04966">sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02441">to my taste</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I sat…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I delighted and sat down</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>taste</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">palate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">me to the banqueting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01714">and his banner</w> over me <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0160">love</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>banqueting…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">house of wine</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0809">me with flagons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07502" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H08598">me with apples</w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sick</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">of love</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>comfort…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">straw me with apples</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08040">His left hand</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">under my head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">and his right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02263" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">doth embrace</w> me.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">you, O ye daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06643">by the roes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0176">and</w> <w lemma="strong:H0355">by the hinds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that ye stir not up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">nor awake</w> <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0160">love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">till he please</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I charge…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I adjure you</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06963">The voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">of my beloved</w>! <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, he cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01801" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">leaping</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07092" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">skipping</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">upon the hills</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01730">My beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is like</w> <w lemma="strong:H06643">a roe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06082">or a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H0354">hart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, he standeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03796">our wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07688" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he looketh forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">at the windows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06692" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">shewing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02762">himself through the lattice</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shewing…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">flourishing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01730">My beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Rise up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07474">my love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03303">my fair one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come away</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05638">For, lo, the winter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is past</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01653">the rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is over</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gone</w>;

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05339">The flowers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06256">the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02158">of the singing</w> <transChange type="added">of birds</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08449">of the turtle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in our land</w>;

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08384">The fig tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H02590" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">putteth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06291">her green figs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01612">and the vines</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05563">the tender grape</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">give</w> a <transChange type="added">good</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07381">smell</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07474">my love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03303">my fair one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come away</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03123">O my dove</w>, <transChange type="added">that art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02288">in the clefts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05643">in the secret</w> <transChange type="added">places</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04095">of the stairs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">let me see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">thy countenance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">let me hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thy voice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06156">for sweet</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thy voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">and thy countenance</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05000">comely</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07776">us the foxes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">the little</w> <w lemma="strong:H07776">foxes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">the vines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03754">for our vines</w> <transChange type="added">have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05563">tender grapes</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01730">My beloved</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mine, and I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his: he feedeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07799">among the lilies</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Until the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06315" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">break</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06752">and the shadows</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">flee away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01730">my beloved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be thou like</w> <w lemma="strong:H06643">a roe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06082">or a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H0354">hart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H01336">of Bether</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of Bether</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of division</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen723" osisID="Song.2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03915">By night</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">on my bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">him whom my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loveth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, but I found</w> him not.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">now, and go about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07784">in the streets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07339">and in the broad ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">him whom my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loveth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, but I found</w> him not.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The watchmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that go about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">found</w> me: <transChange type="added">to whom I said</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">ye him whom my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loveth</w>?

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">but a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from them, but I found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">him whom my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loveth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I held</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and would not let him go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">until I had brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">him into my mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02315">and into the chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of her that conceived</w> me.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">you, O ye daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06643">by the roes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0176">and</w> <w lemma="strong:H0355">by the hinds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that ye stir not up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">nor awake</w> <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0160">love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">till he please</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">this that cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">out of the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08490">like pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06227">of smoke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">perfumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04753">with myrrh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">and frankincense</w>, <w lemma="strong:H081">with all powders</w> <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the merchant</w>?

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04296">Behold his bed</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon’s</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">valiant</w> men <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">it, of the valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">They all hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">swords</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">expert</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in war</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <transChange type="added">hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">his sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">upon his thigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">because of fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">King</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0668">himself a chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a chariot</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a bed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">the pillars</w> thereof <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07507">the bottom</w> thereof <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04817">the covering</w> of it <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0713">purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07528" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thereof being paved</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0160">love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">for the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O ye daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05850">with the crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">wherewith his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H05849" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">crowned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02861">of his espousals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">of the gladness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of his heart</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen724" osisID="Song.3"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:1
verses.text: Behold, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03303">fair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07474">my love</w>; behold, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03303">fair</w>; thou <transChange type="added">hast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03123">doves’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H06777">thy locks</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08181">thy hair</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05739">as a flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of goats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01570">that appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that eat of</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08127">Thy teeth</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05739">like a flock</w> <transChange type="added">of sheep that are even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07094" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shorn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07367">from the washing</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08382" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">whereof every one bear twins</w>, and none <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07909">barren</w> among them.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08193">Thy lips</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02339">like a thread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08144">of scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">and thy speech</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05000">comely</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07541">thy temples</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06400">like a piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">of a pomegranate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H06777">thy locks</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06677">Thy neck</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04026">like the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08530">for an armoury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">whereon there hang</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">bucklers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07982">all shields</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of mighty men</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">Thy two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">breasts</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">like two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06082">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06646">roes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08380">that are twins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07799">among the lilies</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Until the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06315" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">break</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06752">and the shadows</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">flee away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will get</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">me to the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04753">of myrrh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and to the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">of frankincense</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>break</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">breathe</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:7
verses.text: Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03303">all fair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07474">my love</w>; <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03971">no spot</w> in thee.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">with me from Lebanon</w>, <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03618">spouse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03844">with me from Lebanon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">look</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">from the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H0549">of Amana</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">from the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H08149">of Shenir</w> <w lemma="strong:H02768">and Hermon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0738">from the lions’</w> <w lemma="strong:H04585">dens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02042">from the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05246">of the leopards</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou hast ravished my heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">my sister</w>, <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03618">spouse</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast ravished my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">with one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">with one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06060">chain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">of thy neck</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ravished</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">taken away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03302" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">How fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">is thy love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">my sister</w>, <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03618">spouse</w>! <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">how much better</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">is thy love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">than wine</w>! <w lemma="strong:H07381">and the smell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of thine ointments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01314">than all spices</w>!

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08193">Thy lips</w>, O <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03618">spouse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drop</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05317">the honeycomb</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01706">honey</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">and milk</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03956">under thy tongue</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07381">and the smell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08008">of thy garments</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07381">like the smell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01588">A garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05274" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">inclosed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0269">my sister</w>, <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03618">spouse</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01530">a spring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05274" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shut up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04599">a fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">sealed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>inclosed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">barred</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>shut up</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">barred</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07973">Thy plants</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06508">an orchard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">of pomegranates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04022">with pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">fruits</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03724">camphire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05373">with spikenard</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>camphire</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cypress</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05373">Spikenard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03750">and saffron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07070">calamus</w> <w lemma="strong:H07076">and cinnamon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">with all trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">of frankincense</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04753">myrrh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0174">and aloes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">with all the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01314">spices</w>:

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04599">A fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">of gardens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0875">a well</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of living</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and streams</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">from Lebanon</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">O north wind</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08486">thou south</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06315" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">upon my garden</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01314">the spices</w> <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof may flow out</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01730">Let my beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">into his garden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04022">his pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">fruits</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen725" osisID="Song.4"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">into my garden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">my sister</w>, <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03618">spouse</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0717" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04753">my myrrh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01313">with my spice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">my honeycomb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">with my honey</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">my wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with my milk</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07453">O friends</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yea, drink abundantly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01730">O beloved</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>yea…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and be drunken with loves</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03463">I sleep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">but my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">waketh</w>: <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">of my beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01849" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that knocketh</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Open</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">to me, my sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07474">my love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03123">my dove</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08535">my undefiled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07218">for my head</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">with dew</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06977">my locks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07447">with the drops</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">of the night</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have put off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">my coat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0349">how</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall I put it on</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">my feet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0349">how</w> <w lemma="strong:H02936" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall I defile</w> them?

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01730">My beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">put in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04480">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H02356">the hole</w> <transChange type="added">of the door</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04578">and my bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were moved</w> for him.<note type="study"><catchWord>for him</catchWord>: or, (as some read) <rdg type="alternate">in me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to open</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">to my beloved</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">and my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dropped</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04753">myrrh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0676">and my fingers</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sweet smelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04753">myrrh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">upon the handles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04514">of the lock</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sweet…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">passing</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">running about</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">to my beloved</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01730">but my beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H02559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had withdrawn</w> himself, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was gone</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">failed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when he spake</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, but I could not find</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him; I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, but he gave me no answer</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The watchmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that went about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">me, they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06481" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, they wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me; the keepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">of the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07289">my veil</w> from me.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">you, O daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if ye find</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">my beloved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that ye tell</w> him, that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sick</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">of love</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that ye</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">what</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01730">thy beloved</w> more than <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01730">beloved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03303">O thou fairest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">among women</w>? what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01730">thy beloved</w> more than <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01730">beloved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03602">that thou</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">dost so charge</w> us?

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01730">My beloved</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06703">white</w> <w lemma="strong:H0122">and ruddy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01713" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the chiefest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07233">among ten thousand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the chiefest</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a standard-bearer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07218">His head</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03800">the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06337">fine gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06977">his locks</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08534">bushy</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07838">black</w> <w lemma="strong:H06158">as a raven</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bushy</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">curled</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:12
