verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">His eyes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> as <transChange type="added">the eyes</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03123">of doves</w> <w lemma="strong:H0650">by the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04402 strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fitly set</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fitly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sitting in fulness</rdg>, that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">fitly placed, and set as a precious stone in the foil of a ring</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03895">His cheeks</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06170">as a bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01314">of spices</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04840">sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">flowers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08193">his lips</w> <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07799">lilies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dropping</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sweet smelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04753">myrrh</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sweet flowers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">towers of perfumes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">His hands</w> <transChange type="added">are as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01550">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08658">with the beryl</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04578">his belly</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06247">bright</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">ivory</w> <w lemma="strong:H05968" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">overlaid</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05601">sapphires</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07785">His legs</w> <transChange type="added">are as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">of marble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">upon sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H06337">of fine gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04758">his countenance</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03844">as Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">as the cedars</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02441">His mouth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04477">most sweet</w>: yea, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04261">altogether lovely</w>. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01730">my beloved</w>, and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">my friend</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mouth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">palate</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen726" osisID="Song.5"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01730">Whither is thy beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03303">O thou fairest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">among women</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01730">whither is thy beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turned aside</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that we may seek</w> him with thee.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01730">My beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is gone down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">into his garden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06170">to the beds</w> <w lemma="strong:H01314">of spices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">in the gardens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H07799">lilies</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:3
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01730">my beloved’s</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01730">and my beloved</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">mine: he feedeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07799">among the lilies</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03303">beautiful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07474">O my love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08656">as Tirzah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05000">comely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">as Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0366">terrible</w> as <transChange type="added">an army</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01713" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">with banners</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01992">from me, for they</w> <w lemma="strong:H07292" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have overcome</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">me: thy hair</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05739">as a flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of goats</w> <w lemma="strong:H01570">that appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">from Gilead</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>overcome…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">puffed me up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08127">Thy teeth</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05739">as a flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07353">of sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07367">from the washing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08382" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">whereof every one beareth twins</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07909">not one barren</w> among them.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06400">As a piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">of a pomegranate</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07541">thy temples</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H06777">thy locks</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08346">There are threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">queens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08084">and fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">concubines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05959">and virgins</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">without number</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03123">My dove</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08535">my undefiled</w> is <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the <transChange type="added">only</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of her mother</w>, she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01249">the choice</w> <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of her that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">her. The daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">her, and blessed</w> her; <transChange type="added">yea</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queens</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">and the concubines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they praised</w> her.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> she <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">looketh forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">as the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03303">fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H03842">as the moon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01249">clear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02535">as the sun</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0366">terrible</w> as <transChange type="added">an army</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01713" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">with banners</w>?

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01594">into the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H093">of nuts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03">the fruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the valley</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">whether the vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">flourished</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07416">the pomegranates</w> <w lemma="strong:H05132" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">budded</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Or ever I was aware</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> me <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04818">the chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H05993">of Amminadib</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Or ever…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I knew not</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">set me on the chariots of my willing people</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07759">O Shulamite</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may look</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon thee. What will ye see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07759">in the Shulamite</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04246">As it were the company</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of two armies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of Mahanaim</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen727" osisID="Song.6"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03302" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">How beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">are thy feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">with shoes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05081">O prince’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>! <w lemma="strong:H02542">the joints</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">of thy thighs</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02481">like jewels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0542">of a cunning workman</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08326">Thy navel</w> <transChange type="added">is like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05469">a round</w> <w lemma="strong:H0101">goblet</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wanteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04197">not liquor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0990">thy belly</w> <transChange type="added">is like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06194">an heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">of wheat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05473" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">set about</w> <w lemma="strong:H07799">with lilies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>liquor</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mixture</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">Thy two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">breasts</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">like two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06082">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06646">roes</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08380">twins</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06677">Thy neck</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04026">as a tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">of ivory</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01295">the fishpools</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">in Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">by the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01337">of Bath–rabbim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0639">thy nose</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04026">as the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">Damascus</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07218">Thine head</w> upon thee <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03760">like Carmel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01803">and the hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of thine head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0713">like purple</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">held</w> <w lemma="strong:H07298">in the galleries</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Carmel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">crimson</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>held</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bound</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03302" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">How fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H05276" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and how pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">art thou, O love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08588">for delights</w>!

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06967">This thy stature</w> <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is like</w> <w lemma="strong:H08558">to a palm tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07699">and thy breasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0811">to clusters</w> <transChange type="added">of grapes</transChange>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08558">to the palm tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05577">of the boughs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">thereof: now also thy breasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0811">shall be as clusters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">of the vine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07381">and the smell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of thy nose</w> <w lemma="strong:H08598">like apples</w>;

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02441">And the roof of thy mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">like the best</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">for my beloved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that goeth</w> <transChange type="added">down</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04339">sweetly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08193">causing the lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H03463">of those that are asleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01680" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to speak</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sweetly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">straightly</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>of those…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of the ancient</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01730">my beloved’s</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08669">and his desire</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> toward me.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01730">my beloved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03723">in the villages</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Let us get up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">to the vineyards</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">if the vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">flourish</w>, <transChange type="added">whether</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05563">the tender grape</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">appear</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07416">the pomegranates</w> <w lemma="strong:H05132" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">bud forth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">thee my loves</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>appear</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">open</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01736">The mandrakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">a smell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06607">and at our gates</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04022">all manner of pleasant</w> <transChange type="added">fruits</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02319">new</w> <w lemma="strong:H03465">and old</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have laid up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">for thee, O my beloved</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen728" osisID="Song.7"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">O that</w> thou <transChange type="added">wert</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">as my brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sucked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">the breasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of my mother</w>! <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I should find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">thee without</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I would kiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H0936" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee; yea, I should not be despised</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I should not…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they should not despise me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I would lead</w> thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">thee into my mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">would instruct</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me: I would cause thee to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H07544">of spiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06071">of the juice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">of my pomegranate</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08040">His left hand</w> <transChange type="added">should be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">under my head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">and his right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02263" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">should embrace</w> me.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">you, O daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that ye stir not up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">nor awake</w> <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0160">love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">until he please</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">why should ye stir up</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">why</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:5
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">this that cometh up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">from the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07514" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">leaning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">upon her beloved</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">I raised</w> <w lemma="strong:H08598">thee up under the apple tree</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0517">there thy mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">brought thee forth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">there she brought thee forth</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> thee.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02368">me as a seal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">upon thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02368">as a seal</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">upon thine arm</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0160">for love</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05794">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">as death</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07068">jealousy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07186">cruel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">as the grave</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07565">the coals</w> thereof <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07565">coals</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>, <transChange type="added">which hath</transChange> a <w lemma="strong:H07957">most vehement flame</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cruel</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hard</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">quench</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">neither can the floods</w> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drown</w> it: if a <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">would give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">all the substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">for love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0936" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it would utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0936" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be contemned</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06996">We have a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07699">and she hath no breasts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what shall we do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">for our sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">when she shall be spoken for</w>?

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:9
verses.text: If she <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02346">a wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will build</w> <w lemma="strong:H02918">upon her a palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>: and if she <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01817">a door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will inclose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">her with boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of cedar</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:10
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02346">a wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07699">and my breasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">like towers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">then was I in his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as one that found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">favour</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>favour</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">had a vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01174">at Baal–hamon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he let out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">the vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05201" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto keepers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">for the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof was to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <transChange type="added">pieces</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03754">My vineyard</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mine, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">me: thou, O Solomon</w>, <transChange type="added">must have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05201" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and those that keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">thereof two hundred</w>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Thou that dwellest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">in the gardens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02270">the companions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to thy voice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">cause me to hear</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Make haste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01730">my beloved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be thou like</w> <w lemma="strong:H06643">to a roe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06082">or to a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H0354">hart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H01314">of spices</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Make…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Flee away</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen729" osisID="Song.8"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen721" osisID="Song" type="book"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02377">The vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">of Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0531">of Amoz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">concerning Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">of Uzziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03147">Jotham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03169">Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">O heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and give ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">O earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have nourished</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">and brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they have rebelled</w> against me.

verses.name: Isaiah 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07794">The ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his owner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and the ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">his master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H018">crib</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">doth not know</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8712">doth not consider</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Ah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sinful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">laden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">with iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">a seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of evildoers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that are corrupters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-330">they have provoked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-330">unto anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they are gone away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">backward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>laden</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of heaviness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>gone…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">alienated</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">separated</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">Why should ye be stricken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05627">any more? ye will revolt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">more and more</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07218">the whole head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">is sick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">and the whole heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01742">faint</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>revolt…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">increase revolt</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03709">From the sole</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of the foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">even unto the head</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04974">no soundness</w> in it; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06482">wounds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02250">and bruises</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02961">and putrifying</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">sores</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02115" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have not been closed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">neither bound up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07401" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">neither mollified</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with ointment</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ointment</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">oil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Your country</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">your cities</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0127">your land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">devour</w> it in your presence, and <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04114">as overthrown</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">by strangers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>overthrown…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the overthrow of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01323">And the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">as a cottage</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">in a vineyard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04412">as a lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04750">in a garden of cucumbers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">as a besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03884">Except</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had left</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">unto us a very small</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">remnant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we should have been</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">as Sodom</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we should have been like</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">unto Gomorrah</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 1:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07101">ye rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">give ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">unto the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">ye people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">of Gomorrah</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04100">To what</w> purpose <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07230">the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of your sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me? saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am full</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04806">of fed beasts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">not in the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of bullocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03532">or of lambs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06260">or of he goats</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he goats</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">great he goats</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When ye come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">me, who hath required</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">this at your hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to tread</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">my courts</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>to appear</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to be seen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">oblations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">is an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">unto me; the new moons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">and sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">the calling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">of assemblies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cannot away with</w>; <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06116">even the solemn meeting</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>iniquity</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">grief</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02320">Your new moons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">and your appointed feasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hateth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02960">they are a trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">unto me; I am weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bear</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And when ye spread forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">your hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">from you: yea, when ye make many</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">prayers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I will not hear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">your hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are full</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>make…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">multiply prayer</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H02135" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">you, make you clean</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07455">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of your doings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to do evil</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to do well</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">relieve</w> <w lemma="strong:H02541">the oppressed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">for the widow</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>relieve</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">righten</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come now</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and let us reason together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H02399">though your sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H08144">be as scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03835" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they shall be as white</w> <w lemma="strong:H07950">as snow</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0119" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">though they be red</w> <w lemma="strong:H08438">like crimson</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06785">they shall be as wool</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 1:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If ye be willing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and obedient</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">But if ye refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and rebel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">ye shall be devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">for the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 1:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">How is the faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">city</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">become an harlot</w>! <w lemma="strong:H04392">it was full</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lodged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">in it; but now murderers</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 1:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03701">Thy silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05509">is become dross</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05435">thy wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H04107" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mixed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with water</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 1:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Thy princes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05637" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">rebellious</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02270">and companions</w> <w lemma="strong:H01590">of thieves</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">gifts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and followeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08021">after rewards</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">not the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07379">neither doth the cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">of the widow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> unto them.

verses.name: Isaiah 1:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Therefore saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H046">the mighty One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01945">Ah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">I will ease</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">me of mine adversaries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and avenge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me of mine enemies</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 1:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I will turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01253">upon thee, and purely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">purge away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05509">thy dross</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0913">all thy tin</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>purely</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to pureness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I will restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">as at the first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and thy counsellors</w> <w lemma="strong:H08462">as at the beginning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thou shalt be called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">The city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">city</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 1:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">with judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and her converts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">with righteousness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>her…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they that return of her</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07667">And the destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the transgressors</w> <w lemma="strong:H02400">and of the sinners</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be consumed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destruction</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">breaking</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For they shall be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of the oaks</w> <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye have desired</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall be confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01593">for the gardens</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye have chosen</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 1:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0424">For ye shall be as an oak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05929">whose leaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fadeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01593">and as a garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">that hath no water</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 1:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02634">And the strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H05296">shall be as tow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06467">and the maker</w> <w lemma="strong:H05213">of it as a spark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and they shall both</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and none shall quench</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>maker…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and his work</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen731" osisID="Isa.1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">that Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0531">of Amoz</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">concerning Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0319">And it shall come to pass in the last</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and shall be exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">above the hills</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01471">and all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05102" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall flow</w> unto it.<note type="study"><catchWord>established</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prepared</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">And many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye, and let us go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he will teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">us of his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we will walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">in his paths</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06726">for out of Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and they shall beat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">their swords</w> <w lemma="strong:H0855">into plowshares</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02595">and their spears</w> <w lemma="strong:H04211">into pruninghooks</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">against nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall they learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w> any more.<note type="study"><catchWord>pruninghooks</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">scythes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye, and let us walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">in the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 2:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thou hast forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they be replenished</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">from the east</w>, and <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06049" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">soothsayers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">like the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05606" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they please</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">themselves in the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">of strangers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">more than the</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>please…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">abound with the</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">also is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>, neither <transChange type="added">is there any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">of their treasures</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is also full</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">of horses</w>, neither <transChange type="added">is there any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">end</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">of their chariots</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">also is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H0457">of idols</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">they worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their own hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0676">that which their own fingers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have made</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">And the mean man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">boweth down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the great man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">humbleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself: therefore forgive</w> them not.

verses.name: Isaiah 2:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">into the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">thee in the dust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01926">and for the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">of his majesty</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01365">The lofty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">looks</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be humbled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07312">and the haughtiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be bowed down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">alone shall be exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> upon every <transChange type="added">one that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01343">proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and lofty</w>, and upon every <transChange type="added">one that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">lifted up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall be brought low</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0730">And upon all the cedars</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>, <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">high</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and lifted up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0437">and upon all the oaks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And upon all the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and upon all the hills</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">lifted up</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01364">And upon every high</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">tower</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and upon every fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">wall</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0591">And upon all the ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">of Tarshish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02532">and upon all pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07914">pictures</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pictures of desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01365">And the loftiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be bowed down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07312">and the haughtiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be made low</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">alone shall be exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 2:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0457">And the idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H03632">he shall utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abolish</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shall utterly pass away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">into the holes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">of the rocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04247">and into the caves</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01926">and for the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">of his majesty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he ariseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06206" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to shake terribly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of the earth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of the dust</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0457">his idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0457">and his idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, which they made <transChange type="added">each one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for himself</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to worship</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06512 strong:H02661">to the moles</w> <w lemma="strong:H05847">and to the bats</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>his idols of silver…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the idols of his silver</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>each…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05366">into the clefts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">of the rocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05585">and into the tops</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of the ragged rocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01926">and for the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">of his majesty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he ariseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06206" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to shake terribly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">ye from man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05397">whose breath</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in his nostrils</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">for wherein is he to be accounted of</w>? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen732" osisID="Isa.2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">For, behold, the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">doth take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and from Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04937">the stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04938">and the staff</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04937">the whole stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03605">and the whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H04937">stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01368">The mighty man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the judge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the prudent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the ancient</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">The captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of fifty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and the honourable</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the counsellor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02450">and the cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02791">artificer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and the eloquent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03908">orator</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the honourable…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man eminent in countenance</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>eloquent…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">skilful of speech</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">children</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">their princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08586">and babes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rule</w> over them.

verses.name: Isaiah 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be oppressed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">by another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">by his neighbour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05288">the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H07292" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall behave himself proudly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">against the ancient</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07034" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and the base</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">against the honourable</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">When a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08071">Thou hast clothing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07101">be thou our ruler</w>, and <transChange type="added">let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04384">this ruin</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under thy hand</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he swear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I will not be an healer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">for in my house</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">neither bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">nor clothing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07101">me not a ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>swear</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lift up the hand</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>healer</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">binder up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03389">For Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is ruined</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fallen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03956">because their tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">and their doings</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to provoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of his glory</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 3:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01971">The shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of their countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">doth witness against them</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and they declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">their sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">as Sodom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they hide</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0188">not. Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">unto their soul</w>! <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they have rewarded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> unto themselves.

verses.name: Isaiah 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">ye to the righteous</w>, that <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">well</w> <transChange type="added">with him</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of their doings</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0188">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">unto the wicked</w>! <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">ill</w> <transChange type="added">with him</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H01576">for the reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be given</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>given…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">done to him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">As for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">children</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their oppressors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over them. O my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">they which lead</w> thee cause <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to err</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">of thy paths</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lead…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">call thee blessed</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>destroy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">swallow up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">standeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to plead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and standeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">into judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">with the ancients</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thereof: for ye have eaten up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">the vineyard</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01500">the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">of the poor</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in your houses</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>eaten</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">burnt</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:15
verses.text: What mean ye <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-331">ye beat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-331">to pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and grind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">of the poor</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 3:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">Moreover the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03282">Because</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are haughty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">with stretched forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01627">necks</w> <w lemma="strong:H08265" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and wanton</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">walking</w> <w lemma="strong:H02952" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and mincing</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05913" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and making a tinkling</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">with their feet</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>wanton…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">deceiving with their eyes</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>mincing</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">tripping nicely</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Therefore the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H05596" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">will smite with a scab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06936">the crown of the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will discover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06596">their secret parts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>discover</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">make naked</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">the bravery</w> of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05914">tinkling ornaments</w> <transChange type="added">about their feet</transChange>, and <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07636">cauls</w>, and <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07720">round tires like the moon</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>cauls</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">networks</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05188">The chains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08285">and the bracelets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07479">and the mufflers</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>chains</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sweet balls</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>mufflers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spangled ornaments</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06287">The bonnets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06807">and the ornaments of the legs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07196">and the headbands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004 strong:H05315">and the tablets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03908">and the earrings</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>tablets</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">houses of the soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02885">The rings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">and nose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05141">jewels</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 3:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04254">The changeable suits of apparel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04595">and the mantles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04304">and the wimples</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02754">and the crisping pins</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 3:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01549">The glasses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05466">and the fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06797">and the hoods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07289">and the vails</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 3:24
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01314">instead of sweet smell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04716">there shall be stink</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02290">and instead of a girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05364">a rent</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04639">and instead of well set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04748">hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H07144">baldness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06614">and instead of a stomacher</w> <w lemma="strong:H04228">a girding</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">of sackcloth</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03587">burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">instead of beauty</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 3:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04962">Thy men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and thy mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in the war</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mighty</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">might</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06607">And her gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H0578" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall lament</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and mourn</w>; and she <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the ground</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>desolate</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">emptied</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cleansed</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen733" osisID="Isa.3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We will eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">our own bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">our own apparel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">only let us be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">our reproach</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>let…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">let thy name be called upon us</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to take…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">take thou away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06780">shall the branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06643">be beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">and glorious</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01347">excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">and comely for</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">them that are escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>beautiful…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">beauty and glory</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>them…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the escaping</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:3
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>, and <transChange type="added">he that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">every one that is written</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">among the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>among…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">When the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall have washed away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06675">the filth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01740" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall have purged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">thereof by the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and by the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of burning</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will create</w> <w lemma="strong:H04349">upon every dwelling place</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04744">and upon her assemblies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">a cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06227">and smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">by day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05051">and the shining</w> <w lemma="strong:H03852">of a flaming</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03519">for upon all the glory</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02646">a defence</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>upon all</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">above all</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>defence</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">covering</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05521">And there shall be a tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">for a shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">in the daytime</w> <w lemma="strong:H02721">from the heat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04268">and for a place of refuge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04563">and for a covert</w> <w lemma="strong:H02230">from storm</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">and from rain</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen734" osisID="Isa.4"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now will I sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03039">to my wellbeloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">a song</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">of my beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">touching his vineyard</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03039">My wellbeloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">hath a vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081 strong:H01121">in a very fruitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">hill</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>a very…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the horn of the son of oil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:2
