verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">it, and gathered out the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, and planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08321">it with the choicest vine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">a tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of it, and also made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03342">a winepress</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">therein: and he looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that it should bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06025">grapes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0891">wild grapes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fenced</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">made a wall about</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>made</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hewed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And now, O inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">judge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03754">I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">What could have been done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">more to my vineyard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have not done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04069">in it? wherefore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">when I looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that it should bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06025">grapes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">brought it forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0891">wild grapes</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And now go to; I will tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">you what I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">to my vineyard</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">I will take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04881">the hedge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thereof, and it shall be eaten up</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">break down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01447">the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H04823">thereof, and it shall be trodden down</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>trodden…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for a treading</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01326">it waste</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02168" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall not be pruned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05737" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor digged</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but there shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08068">briers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07898">and thorns</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will also command</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">the clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that they rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">no rain</w> upon it.

verses.name: Isaiah 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03754">For the vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08191">his pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05194">plant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">for judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04939">but behold oppression</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06666">for righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06818">but behold a cry</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">plant of his pleasures</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>oppression</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a scab</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">unto them that join</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to house</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">to field</w>, till <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0657">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">that they may be placed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">alone in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>they</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ye</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0241">In mine ears</w> <transChange type="added">said</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">Of a truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">shall be desolate</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and fair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">without inhabitant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>In…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">This is in mine ears, saith the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>Of a…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">If not</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03588">Yea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06776">acres</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">of vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01324">bath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">of an homer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">an ephah</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 5:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">unto them that rise up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they may follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941">strong drink</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that continue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05399">until night</w>, <transChange type="added">till</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01814" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">inflame</w> them!<note type="study"><catchWord>inflame</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pursue</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03658">And the harp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05035">and the viol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08596">the tabret</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02485">and pipe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">and wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04960">are in their feasts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but they regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">not the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the operation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hands</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 5:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">Therefore my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are gone into captivity</w>, because <transChange type="added">they have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01847">no knowledge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03519">and their honourable</w> <w lemma="strong:H04962">men</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07458">famished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">and their multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H06704">dried up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06772">with thirst</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>honourable…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">glory are men of famine</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07585">Therefore hell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath enlarged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">herself</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06473" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">her mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">without measure</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01926">and their glory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">and their multitude</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07588">and their pomp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05938">and he that rejoiceth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall descend</w> into it.

verses.name: Isaiah 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">And the mean man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be brought down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the mighty man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be humbled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01364">of the lofty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be humbled</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">that is holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">in righteousness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>God…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the holy God</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the God the holy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03532">Then shall the lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01699">after their manner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02723">and the waste places</w> <w lemma="strong:H04220">of the fat ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 5:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them that draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">with cords</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">of vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">as it were with a cart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">rope</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 5:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">That say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Let him make speed</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hasten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">his work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06098">and let the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">of the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">draw nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may know</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>!

verses.name: Isaiah 5:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them that call</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">for light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">and light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">for darkness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04966">for sweet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04966">and sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">for bitter</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>call…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">say concerning evil, It is good</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> unto <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in their own eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and prudent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in their own sight</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>in their own sight</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before their face</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> unto <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H04537" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to mingle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941">strong drink</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 5:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Which justify</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06118">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">reward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">the righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> from him!

verses.name: Isaiah 5:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">Therefore as the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">devoureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07179">the stubble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03852 strong:H03956">and the flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">consumeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02842">the chaff</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08328">their root</w> <w lemma="strong:H04716">shall be as rottenness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06525">and their blossom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H080">as dust</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they have cast away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">of the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fire</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tongue of fire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">Therefore is the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">against his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he hath stretched forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against them, and hath smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">them: and the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did tremble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05038">and their carcases</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05478">torn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">of the streets</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0639">For all this his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is not turned away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">but his hand</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">stretched out</w> still.<note type="study"><catchWord>torn</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">as dung</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he will lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">an ensign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">to the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">from far</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08319" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will hiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">unto them from the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and, behold, they shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">with speed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07031">swiftly</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 5:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05889">None shall be weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor stumble</w> <w lemma="strong:H05123" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">among them; none shall slumber</w> <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor sleep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0232">neither shall the girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02504">of their loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be loosed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08288">nor the latchet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">of their shoes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be broken</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 5:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02671">Whose arrows</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08150" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sharp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198">and all their bows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">bent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">their horses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">hoofs</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">like flint</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01534">and their wheels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05492">like a whirlwind</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 5:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07581">Their roaring</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03833">like a lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07580 strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">they shall roar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">like young lions</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05098" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, they shall roar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">of the prey</w>, and shall carry <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">away safe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and none shall deliver</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 5:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05098" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall roar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05100">against them like the roaring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>: and if <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">look</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02822">behold darkness</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06862">sorrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">and the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is darkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06183">in the heavens</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>sorrow</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">distress</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>and the light…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when it is light, it shall be dark in the destructions thereof</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen735" osisID="Isa.5"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141">In the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">Uzziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0853">also</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon a throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">high</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and lifted up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07757">and his train</w> <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H04392">filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">the temple</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the skirts thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04605">Above</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08314">the seraphims</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">each one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">had six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">with twain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and with twain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">his feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and with twain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">he did fly</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And one cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto another, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">Holy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">the whole earth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04393">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of his glory</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>one…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">this cried to this</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the whole…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his glory is the fulness of the whole earth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0520">And the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">of the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">at the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06227">with smoke</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>door</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thresholds</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0188">I, Woe</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">me! for I am undone</w>; because I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">of unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and I dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">of unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">for mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the King</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>undone</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cut off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then flew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08314">of the seraphims</w> <w lemma="strong:H07531">unto me, having a live coal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04457">with the tongs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">from off the altar</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>having…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and in his hand a live coal</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he laid</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">upon my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Lo, this hath touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">thy lips</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05771">and thine iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is taken away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and thy sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">purged</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>laid…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">caused it to touch</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Also I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Whom shall I send</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and who will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for us? Then said</w> I, Here <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I; send</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>Here…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">behold me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ye indeed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">not; and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ye indeed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but perceive</w> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>indeed, but understand</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">without ceasing</rdg>, etc: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in hearing</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Make the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08080" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">and make their ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">heavy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08173" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">their eyes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest they see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with their eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">with their ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with their heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and convert</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be healed</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">I, Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">how long? And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">Until the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H07582" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be wasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">without inhabitant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">without man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">be utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07582" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">desolate</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>utterly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">desolate with desolation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-332">have removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-332">far away</w>, and <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05805">forsaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 6:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>But yet in it <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06224">a tenth</w>, and <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and shall be eaten</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0424">as a teil tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0437">and as an oak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04678">whose substance</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07995">in them, when they cast</w> <transChange type="added">their leaves</transChange>: <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04678">the substance</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>and it…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when it is returned, and hath been broused</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>substance</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stock</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">stem</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen736" osisID="Isa.6"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it came to pass in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">of Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03147">of Jotham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">of Uzziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07526">Rezin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06492">and Pekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07425">of Remaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">toward Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to war</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against it, but could</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">not prevail</w> against it.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0758">Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is confederate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">with Ephraim</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03824">And his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was moved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">and the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">as the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">are moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>is confederate…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">resteth on</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">unto Isaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">now to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07610">thou, and Shear–jashub</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07097">at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08585">of the conduit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">of the upper</w> <w lemma="strong:H01295">pool</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">in the highway</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the fuller’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>Shear–jashub</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The remnant shall return</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>highway</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">causeway</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">unto him, Take heed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and be quiet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824 strong:H07401" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">not, neither be fainthearted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">for the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02180">tails</w> <w lemma="strong:H06226">of these smoking</w> <w lemma="strong:H0181">firebrands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02750">for the fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07526">of Rezin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">with Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07425">of Remaliah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>neither…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">let not thy heart be tender</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0758">Because Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07425">of Remaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">have taken evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against thee, saying</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">against Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06973" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and vex</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it, and let us make a breach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therein for us, and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> of it, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02870">of Tabeal</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>vex</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">waken</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03541">Thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">It shall not stand</w>, neither shall it come to pass.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07218">For the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01834">Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07526">Rezin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08346">and within threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">shall Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">that it be not a people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from a people</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07218">And the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07425">Remaliah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">If ye will not believe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">surely ye shall not be established</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>If…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Do ye not believe? it is because ye are not stable</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">Moreover the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">unto Ahaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Moreover…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName> added to speak</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">thee a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H06009" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">it either in the depth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">or in the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ask it…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">make thy petition deep</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0271">But Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not ask</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither will I tempt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">ye now, O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>; <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a small thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">for you to weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but will ye weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w> also?

verses.name: Isaiah 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Therefore the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">you a sign</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05959">Behold, a virgin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02030">shall conceive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410 strong:H06005">Immanuel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall call</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thou, O virgin, shalt call</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02529">Butter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">For before the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06973" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">that thou abhorrest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of both</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">her kings</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">upon thee, and upon thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and upon thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that have not come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">that Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">from Judah</w>; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08319" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall hiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H02070">for the fly</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">in the uttermost part</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01682">and for the bee</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01327">all of them in the desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">valleys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05357">and in the holes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of the rocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05285">and upon all thorns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05097">and upon all bushes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bushes</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">commendable trees</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the same day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">shall the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08593">with a razor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07917">that is hired</w>, <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05676">by them beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">by the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08181">and the hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of the feet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it shall also consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H02206">the beard</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall nourish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H05697">cow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 7:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">And it shall come to pass, for the abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">of milk</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02529">butter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02529">for butter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall every one eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that is left</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the land</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the midst of the land</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">every place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">shall be, where there were a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">vines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">at a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silverlings</w>, it shall <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08068">be for briers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07898">and thorns</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02671">With arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">and with bows</w> shall <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thither; because all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08068">shall become briers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07898">and thorns</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:25
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">on</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">all hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H05737" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that shall be digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H04576">with the mattock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there shall not come thither</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08068">of briers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07898">and thorns</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04916">but it shall be for the sending forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">of oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04823">and for the treading</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">of lesser cattle</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen737" osisID="Isa.7"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Moreover the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">thee a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01549">roll</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and write</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">in it with a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02747">pen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04122">concerning Maher–shalal–hash–baz</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Maher–shalal–hash–baz</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">In making speed to the spoil he hasteneth the prey</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Make speed</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-333">And I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">unto me faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witnesses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-333">to record</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0223">Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02148">and Zechariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03000">of Jeberechiah</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05031">unto the prophetess</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to me, Call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04122">Maher–shalal–hash–baz</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>went</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">approached</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">For before the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall have knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">My father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">and my mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">the riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">and the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the riches…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he that is before the king of Assyria shall take away the riches, etc</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">also unto me again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03282">Forasmuch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">as this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">refuseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07975">of Shiloah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0328">softly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04885">and rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07526">in Rezin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07425">and Remaliah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Now therefore, behold, the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">bringeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">upon them the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">of the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06099">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">and many</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and all his glory</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0650">over all his channels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H01415">all his banks</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">through Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall overflow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall reach</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06677">to the neck</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04298">and the stretching out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of his wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">shall fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410 strong:H06005">O Immanuel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stretching…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fulness of the breadth of thy land shall be the stretchings out of his wings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Associate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">yourselves, O ye people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and ye shall be broken in pieces</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and give ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03605">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">ye of far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">countries</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0247" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">gird</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0247" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">gird</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>people, and</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">people, yet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05779" morph="strongMorph:TH8798" type="x-split-334">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05779" morph="strongMorph:TH8798" type="x-split-334">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">and it shall come to nought</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it shall not stand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0410">for God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with us.

verses.name: Isaiah 8:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02393">thus to me with a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and instructed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me that I should not walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in strength of hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07195">ye not, A confederacy</w>, to all <transChange type="added">them to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">whom this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07195">A confederacy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04172">ye their fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06206" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">nor be afraid</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> himself; and <transChange type="added">let</transChange> him <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04172">your fear</w>, and <transChange type="added">let</transChange> him <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06206" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">your dread</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04720">And he shall be for a sanctuary</w>; <w lemma="strong:H068">but for a stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H05063">of stumbling</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">and for a rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H04383">of offence</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">to both</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06341">for a gin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04170">and for a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">And many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">among them shall stumble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and be broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03369" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and be snared</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and be taken</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Bind up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08584">the testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">seal</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03928">among my disciples</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02442" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that hideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and I will look</w> for him.

verses.name: Isaiah 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03206">Behold, I and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> me <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">for signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">and for wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 8:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto you, Seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0178">unto them that have familiar spirits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03049">and unto wizards</w> <w lemma="strong:H06850" morph="strongMorph:TH8772">that peep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and that mutter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">should not a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto their God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02416">for the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">to the dead</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 8:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08451">To the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H08584">and to the testimony</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if they speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not according to this word</w>, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> because <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07837">no light</w> in them.<note type="study"><catchWord>no…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">no morning</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">through it, hardly bestead</w> <w lemma="strong:H07457">and hungry</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">they shall fret</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">themselves, and curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">their king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">and their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and look</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">upward</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 8:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06869">and behold trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H02825">and darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04588">dimness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06695">of anguish</w>; and <transChange type="added">they shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0653">to darkness</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen738" osisID="Isa.8"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04155">Nevertheless the dimness</w> <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> such as <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04164">in her vexation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">when</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">at the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he lightly afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0314">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did more grievously afflict</w> <transChange type="added">her by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05676">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01551">in Galilee</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of the nations</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">populous</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">The people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">in darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06757">of the shadow of death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">upon them hath the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H05050" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shined</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Thou hast multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nation</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">not increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">the joy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">thee according to the joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">in harvest</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> as <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when they divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the spoil</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>not</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">For thou hast broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">the yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05448">of his burden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and the staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">of his shoulder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of his oppressor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>For…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">When thou brakest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05430">For every battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05431" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the warrior</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07494">with confused noise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08071">and garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8775">rolled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in blood</w>; but <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08316">shall be with burning</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03980">fuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>For…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">When the whole battle of the warrior was</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>but…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and it was</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>fuel</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">meat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03206">For unto us a child</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is born</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto us a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is given</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04951">and the government</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">shall be upon his shoulder</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06382">Wonderful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Counsellor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">The mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05703">The everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">Father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">The Prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of Peace</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04766">Of the increase</w> of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04951">government</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">and peace</w> <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07093">no end</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">and upon his kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to order</w> <w lemma="strong:H05582" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it, and to establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">it with judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and with justice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">from henceforth even for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07068">The zeal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will perform</w> this.

verses.name: Isaiah 9:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0136">The Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">into Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it hath lighted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">upon Israel</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall know</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01346">in the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H01433">and stoutness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of heart</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03843">The bricks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are fallen down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but we will build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01496">with hewn stones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08256">the sycomores</w> <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">are cut down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but we will change</w> <transChange type="added">them into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedars</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">the adversaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H07526">of Rezin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8770" type="x-split-335">against him, and join</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8770" type="x-split-335">together</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>join</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mingle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0758">The Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">before</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">and the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">behind</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with open mouth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0639">For all this his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is not turned away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">but his hand</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">stretched out still</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>open</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">whole</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">For the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">not unto him that smiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, neither do they seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">from Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02180">and tail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03712">branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0100">and rush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">The ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375 strong:H06440" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and honourable</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01931">he</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05030">and the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that teacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lies</w>, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02180">the tail</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">For the leaders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of this people</w> cause <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to err</w>; and <transChange type="added">they that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">led</w> of them <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">destroyed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the leaders</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they that call them blessed</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>led of</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">called blessed of</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>destroyed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">swallowed up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Therefore the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall have no joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">in their young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither shall have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">on their fatherless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">and widows</w>: for every one <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02611">an hypocrite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and an evildoer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">and every mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05039">folly</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0639">For all this his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is not turned away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">but his hand</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">stretched out still</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>folly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">villany</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07564">For wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">burneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">as the fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08068">the briers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07898">and thorns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05442">in the thickets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the forest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H055" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and they shall mount up</w> <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01348">the lifting up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06227">of smoke</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05678">Through the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">is the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06272" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">darkened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03980">shall be as the fuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of the fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fuel</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">meat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01504" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall snatch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07457">and be hungry</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">on the left hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall not be satisfied</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">of his own arm</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>snatch</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cut</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0669">and Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03162">they together</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">against Judah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0639">For all this his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is not turned away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">but his hand</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">stretched out still</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen739" osisID="Isa.9"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them that decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">unrighteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02711">decrees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and that write</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">grievousness</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they have prescribed</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>that write…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to the writers that write grievousness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To turn aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the needy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01779">from judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">from the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">that widows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">may be their prey</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they may rob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">the fatherless</w>!

verses.name: Isaiah 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And what will ye do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">of visitation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07722">and in the desolation</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">from far</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to whom will ye flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">for help</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and where will ye leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">your glory</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01115">Without me they shall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0616">under the prisoners</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">under the slain</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0639">For all this his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is not turned away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">but his hand</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">stretched out still</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 10:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01945">O</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">Assyrian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of mine anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and the staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">is mine indignation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>O…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Woe to the Assyrian</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Asshur</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>and</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">though</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H02611">him against an hypocritical</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and against the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">of my wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I give him a charge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">the prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04823 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to tread them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">like the mire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">of the streets</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>tread…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lay them a treading</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Howbeit he meaneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">not so, neither doth his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">think</w> so; but <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">not a few</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he saith</w>, <transChange type="added">Are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">not my princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">altogether</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 10:9
