verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03641">not Calno</w> <w lemma="strong:H03751">as Carchemish</w>? <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02574">not Hamath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0774">as Arpad</w>? <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08111">not Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">as Damascus</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">As my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0457">of the idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06456">and whose graven images</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">did excel them of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">and of Samaria</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Shall I not, as I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">unto Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H0457">and her idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06091">and her idols</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 10:12
verses.text: Wherefore it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">when the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01214" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hath performed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">his whole work</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and on Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01433">of the stout</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08597">and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H07312">of his high</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">looks</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>punish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visit upon</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>stout…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">greatness of the heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For he saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03581">By the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have done</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02451">and by my wisdom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for I am prudent</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I have removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01367">the bounds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08154" morph="strongMorph:TH8782">and have robbed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06264 strong:H06259" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">their treasures</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I have put down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03524 strong:H047">like a valiant</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>:<note type="study"><catchWord>a valiant…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">many people</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07064">as a nest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">the riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and as one gathereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01000">eggs</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and there was none that moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">the wing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06475" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">or opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">the mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06850" morph="strongMorph:TH8772">or peeped</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 10:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01631">Shall the axe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06286" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">boast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">itself against him that heweth</w> therewith? <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04883">shall the saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">magnify</w> <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">itself against him that shaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">it? as if the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">should shake</w> <transChange type="added">itself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">against them that lift it up</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">as if the staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">should lift up</w> <transChange type="added">itself</transChange>, <transChange type="added">as if it were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">no wood</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the rod…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a rod should shake them that lift it up</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>itself, as if…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that which is not wood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">Therefore shall the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068 strong:H0136" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04924">among his fat ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H07332">leanness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03519">and under his glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03344" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03350">a burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">like the burning of a fire</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0216">And the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">shall be for a fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">and his Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03852">for a flame</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07898">his thorns</w> <w lemma="strong:H08068">and his briers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And shall consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of his forest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03759">and of his fruitful field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">both soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">and body</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05263" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they shall be as when a standardbearer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">fainteth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>both…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from the soul, and even to the flesh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07605">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of his forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">shall be few</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">that a child</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may write</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>few</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">number</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07605">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06413">and such as are escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall no more again</w> <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">upon him that smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">them; but shall stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0571">in truth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 10:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07605">The remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07605">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">unto the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 10:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">For though thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02344">be as the sand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07605">a remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them shall return</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03631">the consumption</w> <w lemma="strong:H02782" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">decreed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall overflow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">with righteousness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of them</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">among</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>with</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">For the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">a consumption</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02782" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">even determined</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the land</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 10:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">O my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwellest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of the Assyrian</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">thee with a rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">his staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">against thee, after the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and shall…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">but he shall lift up his staff for</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04213">For yet a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">little while</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02195">and the indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall cease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">and mine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H08399">in their destruction</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 10:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">shall stir up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07752">a scourge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">for him according to the slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">at the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06159">of Oreb</w>: and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">his rod</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">upon the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so shall he lift it up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">after the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 10:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05448">his burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">from off thy shoulder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05923">and his yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">from off thy neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05923">and the yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">shall be destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of the anointing</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be taken…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">remove</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">to Aiath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he is passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04051">to Migron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04363">at Michmash</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he hath laid up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">his carriages</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 10:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They are gone over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04569">the passage</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04411">they have taken up their lodging</w> <w lemma="strong:H01387">at Geba</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07414">Ramah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is afraid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01390">Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fled</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 10:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06670" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thy voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01554">Gallim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">cause it to be heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03919">unto Laish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06041">O poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06068">Anathoth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Lift…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Cry shrill with</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04088">Madmenah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is removed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01374">of Gebim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05756" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">gather themselves to flee</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 10:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">As yet shall he remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05011">at Nob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">he shall shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <transChange type="added">against</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004 strong:H01323" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 10:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">Behold, the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05586" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">shall lop</w> <w lemma="strong:H06288">the bough</w> <w lemma="strong:H04637">with terror</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the high ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">of stature</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hewn down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01364">and the haughty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be humbled</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 10:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And he shall cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05442">the thickets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">with iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03844">and Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0117">by a mighty one</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mightily</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen740" osisID="Isa.10"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And there shall come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02415">a rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H01503">out of the stem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05342">and a Branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall grow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">out of his roots</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">And the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">upon him, the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">and understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">of counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">and might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">of knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">and of the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07306" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">And shall make him of quick understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">in the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall not judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">after the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">neither reprove</w> <w lemma="strong:H04926">after the hearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">of his ears</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>quick…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">scent</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">smell</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06664">But with righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall he judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and reprove</w> <w lemma="strong:H04334">with equity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06035">for the meek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">with the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and with the breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of his lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall he slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>reprove</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">argue</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06664">And righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0232">shall be the girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">of his loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0530">and faithfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0232">the girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02504">of his reins</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02061">The wolf</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">with the lamb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05246">and the leopard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01423">with the kid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05695">and the calf</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">and the young lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04806">and the fatling</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06996">and a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">child</w> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall lead</w> them.

verses.name: Isaiah 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06510">And the cow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01677">and the bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall feed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03206">their young ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0738">and the lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08401">straw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">like the ox</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the sucking child</w> <w lemma="strong:H08173" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">shall play</w> <w lemma="strong:H02352">on the hole</w> <w lemma="strong:H06620">of the asp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and the weaned child</w> <w lemma="strong:H01911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06848">on the cockatrice’</w> <w lemma="strong:H03975">den</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cockatrice’</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">adder’s</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They shall not hurt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">nor destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in all my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">for the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be full</w> <w lemma="strong:H01844">of the knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">as the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 11:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">there shall be a root</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">for an ensign</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01471">to it shall the Gentiles</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">seek</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04496">and his rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">shall be glorious</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>glorious</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">glory</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-336">shall set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-336">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to recover</w> <w lemma="strong:H07605">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which shall be left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0804">from Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and from Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06624">and from Pathros</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03568">and from Cush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05867">and from Elam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08152">and from Shinar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02574">and from Hamath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0339">and from the islands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">an ensign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">for the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H01760" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the outcasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and gather together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the dispersed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">from the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>corners</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07068">The envy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">also of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall depart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the adversaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be cut off</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall not envy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not vex</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But they shall fly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">upon the shoulders</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">toward the west</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">them</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04916">they shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">upon Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">and Moab</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04928">shall obey</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>them of</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the children of</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>they shall lay…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Edom and Moab shall be the laying on of their hand</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>shall obey…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their obedience</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall utterly destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">the tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptian</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05868">and with his mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall he shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">over the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">it in the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">streams</w>, and make <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">dryshod</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dryshod</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in shoes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04546">And there shall be an highway</w> <w lemma="strong:H07605">for the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0804">from Assyria</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">like as it was to Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen741" osisID="Isa.11"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou shalt say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0599" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee: though thou wast angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">with me, thine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is turned away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and thou comfortedst</w> me.

verses.name: Isaiah 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">Behold, God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03444">my salvation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will trust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not be afraid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03050">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Jehovah</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">my strength</w> and <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02176">song</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03444">he also is become my salvation</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08342">Therefore with joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall ye draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H04599">out of the wells</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">of salvation</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">upon his name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">his doings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">make mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">that his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is exalted</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>call…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">proclaim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01348">excellent things</w>: this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045 strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8794 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8716">known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the earth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06670" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Cry out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and shout</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01419">for great</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> of thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>inhabitant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">inhabitress</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen742" osisID="Isa.12"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03470">which Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0531">of Amoz</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did see</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lift ye up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">a banner</w> <w lemma="strong:H08192" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">upon the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">exalt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto them, shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">into the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H05081">of the nobles</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">my sanctified ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have also called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">my mighty ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">for mine anger</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05947">them that rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01346">in my highness</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">The noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">of a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01823">like as</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07588">a tumultuous</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">gathered together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">mustereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of the battle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>like…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the likeness of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">from a far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07097">from the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and the weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">of his indignation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the whole land</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Howl</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">ye; for the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">at hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07701">as a destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">from the Almighty</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Therefore shall all hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be faint</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and every man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall melt</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>be faint</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fall down</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And they shall be afraid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06735">pangs</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">and sorrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them; they shall be in pain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as a woman that travaileth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08539" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall be amazed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">at another</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">their faces</w> <transChange type="added">shall be as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03851">flames</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be amazed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wonder</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>one…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">every man at his neighbour</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>flames</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">faces of the flames</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cometh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0394">cruel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">both with wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">and fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">desolate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02400">the sinners</w> thereof out of it.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03556">For the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03685">and the constellations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof shall not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">their light</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be darkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in his going forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03394">and the moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">shall not cause her light</w> <w lemma="strong:H05050" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to shine</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">the world</w> for <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">and the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for their iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01347">and I will cause the arrogancy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02086">of the proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to cease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and will lay low</w> <w lemma="strong:H01346">the haughtiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">of the terrible</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">I will make a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03365" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">more precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H06337">than fine gold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0120">even a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03800">than the golden wedge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0211">of Ophir</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Therefore I will shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">out of her place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05678">in the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">of his fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">And it shall be as the chased</w> <w lemma="strong:H06643">roe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and as a sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that no man taketh up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">they shall every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to his own people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into his own land</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Every one that is found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01856" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be thrust through</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and every one that is joined</w> <transChange type="added">unto them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05768">Their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07376" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">also shall be dashed to pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before their eyes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">their houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08155" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be spoiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and their wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H07693 strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8735 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8735">ravished</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will stir up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04074">the Medes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against them, which shall not regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>; and <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall not delight</w> in it.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07198">bows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07376" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-337">also shall dash</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07376" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-337">to pieces</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they shall have no pity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">on the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of the womb</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">their eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0894">And Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06643">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of kingdoms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08597">the beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldees’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">excellency</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">shall be as when God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04114">overthrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">and Gomorrah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as the overthrowing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05331">It shall never</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be inhabited</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall it be dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in from generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to generation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06163">neither shall the Arabian</w> <w lemma="strong:H0167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">pitch tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">there; neither shall the shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">make their fold</w> there.

verses.name: Isaiah 13:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06728">But wild beasts of the desert</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">there; and their houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be full</w> <w lemma="strong:H0255">of doleful creatures</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03284 strong:H01323">and owls</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">there, and satyrs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall dance</w> there.<note type="study"><catchWord>wild…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Ziim</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>doleful…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Ochim</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>owls</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ostriches</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">daughters of the owl</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0338">And the wild beasts of the islands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">in their desolate houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08577">and dragons</w> in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06027">pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">palaces</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">and her time</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and her days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be prolonged</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the wild…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Iim</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>desolate…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">palaces</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen743" osisID="Isa.13"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">on Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will yet choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">them in their own land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01616">and the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H05596" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">with them, and they shall cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">them to their place</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">them in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">and handmaids</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they shall take them captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whose captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they were; and they shall rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">over their oppressors</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>whose…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that had taken them captives</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">shall give thee rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06090">from thy sorrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07267">and from thy fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07186">and from the hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">bondage</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">wherein thou wast made to serve</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 14:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">That thou shalt take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">this proverb</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">How hath the oppressor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ceased</w>! <w lemma="strong:H04062">the golden city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ceased</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>proverb</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">taunting speech</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>golden…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">exactress of gold</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the sceptre</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the rulers</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He who smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">in wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05627 strong:H01115">with a continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">stroke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that ruled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04783">is persecuted</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01097">none</w> <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hindereth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a continual…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a stroke without removing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The whole earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is at rest</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is quiet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06476" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they break forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">into singing</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01265">Yea, the fir trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rejoice</w> at thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0730">the cedars</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Since thou art laid down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">no feller</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is come up</w> against us.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07585">Hell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from beneath is moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for thee to meet</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at thy coming</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">it stirreth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07496">the dead</w> for thee, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06260">all the chief ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">it hath raised up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">from their thrones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hell</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">The grave</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>chief…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">leaders</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">great goats</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">All they shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">unto thee, Art thou also become weak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">as we? art thou become like</w> unto us?

verses.name: Isaiah 14:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01347">Thy pomp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">is brought down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">to the grave</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01998">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">of thy viols</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07415">the worm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03331" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">is spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08438">under thee, and the worms</w> <w lemma="strong:H04374">cover</w> thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">How art thou fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01966">O Lucifer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03213 strong:H07837" morph="strongMorph:TH8685 strongMorph:TH8676">of the morning</w>! <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">art thou cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02522" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which didst weaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>O Lucifer</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">O day star</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thou hast said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will ascend</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">into heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will exalt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">my throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">also upon the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03411">in the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will ascend</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">above the heights</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">of the clouds</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">I will be like</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">the most High</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">Yet thou shalt be brought down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">to hell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03411">to the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">of the pit</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They that see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07688" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee shall narrowly look</w> upon thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">consider</w> thee, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">this the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">that made the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to tremble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that did shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">kingdoms</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 14:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">That</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">as a wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> thereof; <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">not the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0615">of his prisoners</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>opened…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">did not let his prisoners loose homeward?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">All the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">all of them, lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">in glory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his own house</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">But thou art cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">of thy grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">like an abominable</w> <w lemma="strong:H05342">branch</w>, <transChange type="added">and as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03830">the raiment</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of those that are slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02944" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">thrust through</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with a sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">to the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">of the pit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06297">as a carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0947" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">trodden under feet</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03161" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not be joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H06900">with them in burial</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because thou hast destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thy land</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02233">the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of evildoers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall never</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be renowned</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04293">slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01077">that they do not</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">of the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892 strong:H06145" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">with cities</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I will rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">against them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">from Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07605">and remnant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05209">and son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05220">and nephew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will also make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04180">it a possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H07090">for the bittern</w>, <w lemma="strong:H098">and pools</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02894" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">and I will sweep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04292">it with the besom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">of destruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath sworn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Surely as I have thought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall it stand</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 14:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">That I will break</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">the Assyrian</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in my land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and upon my mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">tread him under foot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05923">then shall his yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05448">from off them, and his burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">from off their shoulders</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:26
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06098">the purpose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that is purposed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the whole earth</w>: and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that is stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">upon all the nations</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath purposed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and who shall disannul</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H03027">and his hand</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">stretched out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and who shall turn it back</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 14:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141">In the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">was this burden</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06429">not thou, whole Palestina</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">because the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of him that smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thee is broken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05175">for out of the serpent’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">root</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06848">a cockatrice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and his fruit</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08314" type="x-split-338">a fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">flying</w> <w lemma="strong:H08314" type="x-split-338">serpent</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cockatrice</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">adder</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01060">And the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">of the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall feed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H034">and the needy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">in safety</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">thy root</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">with famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">thy remnant</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 14:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">O gate</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">O city</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06429">thou, whole Palestina</w>, <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">dissolved</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for there shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">from the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06227">a smoke</w>, and none <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0909" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">alone</w> <w lemma="strong:H04151">in his appointed times</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>none…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he shall not be alone</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>appointed…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">assemblies</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:32
verses.text: What shall <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nation</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">That the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath founded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06041">and the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall trust</w> in it.<note type="study"><catchWord>trust…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">betake themselves unto it</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen744" osisID="Isa.14"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03915">Because in the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H06144">Ar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is laid waste</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">brought to silence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03915">because in the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H07024">Kir</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is laid waste</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">brought to silence</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>brought…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cut off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He is gone up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01006">to Bajith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01769">and to Dibon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01116">the high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01065">to weep</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04124">Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall howl</w> <w lemma="strong:H05015">over Nebo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04311">and over Medeba</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07218">on all their heads</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07144">baldness</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02206">every beard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">cut off</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02351">In their streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall gird</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">themselves with sackcloth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01406">on the tops</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">of their houses, and in their streets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">every one shall howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01065">weeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">abundantly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>weeping…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">descending into weeping</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">coming down with weeping</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02809">And Heshbon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0500">and Elealeh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be heard</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03096">unto Jahaz</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">therefore the armed soldiers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall cry out</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05315">his life</w> <w lemma="strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be grievous</w> unto him.

verses.name: Isaiah 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">My heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall cry out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">for Moab</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01280">his fugitives</w> <transChange type="added">shall flee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06820">unto Zoar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05697">an heifer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">of three years old</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04608">for by the mounting up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03872">of Luhith</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">with weeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they go it up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01870">for in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02773">of Horonaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">they shall raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02201">a cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">of destruction</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to the borders thereof, even to Zoar, as an heifer</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>destruction</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">breaking</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">For the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05249">of Nimrim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04923">shall be desolate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02682">for the hay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is withered away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01877">the grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">faileth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03418">there is no green thing</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>desolate</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">desolations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03502">Therefore the abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have gotten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06486">and that which they have laid up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they carry away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">to the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06155">of the willows</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brook…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">valley of the Arabians</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02201">For the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is gone round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03215">the howling</w> <w lemma="strong:H097">thereof unto Eglaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03215">and the howling</w> <w lemma="strong:H0879">thereof unto Beer–elim</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 15:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">For the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01775">of Dimon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be full</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H01775">upon Dimon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0738">lions</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">upon him that escapeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07611">and upon the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>more</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">additions</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen745" osisID="Isa.15"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Send</w> <w lemma="strong:H03733">ye the lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05554">from Sela</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">to the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Sela</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Petra</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">A rock</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:2
verses.text: For it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as a wandering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">bird</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07064">of the nest</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04569">shall be at the fords</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">of Arnon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cast…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a nest forsaken</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">counsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H06415">judgment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">thy shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">as the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">of the noonday</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the outcasts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">bewray</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">not him that wandereth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Take</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Bring</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Let mine outcasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">with thee, Moab</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01933" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">thou a covert</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to them from the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the spoiler</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04160" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">for the extortioner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0656" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is at an end</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07701">the spoiler</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ceaseth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the oppressors</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>extortioner</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wringer</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the oppressors</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the treaders down</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">And in mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">shall the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">be established</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">upon it in truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">judging</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and seeking</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04106">and hasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>established</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prepared</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">of the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>; <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01341">proud</w>: <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01346">of his haughtiness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01347">and his pride</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05678">and his wrath</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0907">his lies</w> <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> so.

verses.name: Isaiah 16:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04124">Therefore shall Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">howl</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">for Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">every one shall howl</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0808">for the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07025">of Kir–hareseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye mourn</w>; surely <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05218">stricken</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mourn</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mutter</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07709">For the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">of Heshbon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">languish</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01612">the vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07643">of Sibmah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01167">the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01986" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have broken down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08291">the principal plants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, they are come</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03270">unto Jazer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they wandered</w> <transChange type="added">through</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04057">the wilderness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07976">her branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are stretched out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are gone over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stretched…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">plucked up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore I will bewail</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">with the weeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H03270">of Jazer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">the vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07643">of Sibmah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07301" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will water</w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">thee with my tears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02809">O Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0500">and Elealeh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01959">for the shouting</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">for thy summer fruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">and for thy harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fallen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the shouting…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the alarm is fallen upon</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08057">And gladness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is taken away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01524">and joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03759">out of the plentiful field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03754">and in the vineyards</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">there shall be no singing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8783">neither shall there be shouting</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the treaders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall tread out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">no wine</w> in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03342">presses</w>; I have made <transChange type="added">their vintage</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01959">shouting</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to cease</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 16:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04578">Wherefore my bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">like an harp</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">for Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07130">and mine inward parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07025">for Kir–haresh</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 16:12
