verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And it shall come to pass, when it is seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">that Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">on the high place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">to his sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to pray</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he shall not prevail</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 16:13
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">concerning Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0227">since that time</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 16:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But now the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">Within three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">as the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07916">of an hireling</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07034" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be contemned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">with all that great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">multitude</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07605">and the remnant</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H04213">small</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03524 strong:H03808">feeble</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>feeble</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">not many</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen746" osisID="Isa.16"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01834">Behold, Damascus</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">is taken away</w> from <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04654">and it shall be a ruinous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04596">heap</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 17:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">The cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H06177">of Aroer</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">forsaken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05739">they shall be for flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which shall lie down</w>, and none shall make <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">afraid</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04013">The fortress</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">also shall cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">from Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">and the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">from Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07605">and the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03519">they shall be as the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And in that day</w> it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01809" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be made thin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04924">and the fatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07329" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall wax lean</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 17:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07105">And it shall be as when the harvestman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">gathereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07054">the corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and reapeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">with his arm</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and it shall be as he that gathereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of Rephaim</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 17:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05955">Yet gleaning grapes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05363">in it, as the shaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">of an olive tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01620">berries</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H0534">of the uppermost bough</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in the outmost fruitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05585">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thereof, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 17:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">At that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">shall a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08159" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">look</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to his Maker</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall have respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">to the Holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">One of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 17:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08159" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall not look</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">to the altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall respect</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0676">which his fingers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0842">either the groves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02553">or the images</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sun images</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">shall his strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">be as a forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02793">bough</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0534">and an uppermost branch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they left</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08077">and there shall be desolation</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 17:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because thou hast forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of thy salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast not been mindful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">of the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">of thy strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore shalt thou plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05282">pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05194">plants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shalt set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">it with strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H02156">slips</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 17:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05194">shalt thou make thy plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07735" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">to grow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">and in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">shalt thou make thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to flourish</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07105">the harvest</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05067">a heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of grief</w> <w lemma="strong:H0605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and of desperate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03511">sorrow</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a heap…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">removed in the day of inheritance, and there shall be deadly sorrow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">to the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make a noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">like the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the seas</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07588">and to the rushing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">of nations</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07582" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">make a rushing like the rushing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03524">of mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>multitude</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">noise</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>mighty</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">many</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03816">The nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07582" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall rush</w> <w lemma="strong:H07588">like the rushing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>: but <transChange type="added">God</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and they shall flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">far off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">and shall be chased</w> <w lemma="strong:H04671">as the chaff</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01534">and like a rolling thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05492">the whirlwind</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a rolling…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thistledown</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06153 strong:H06256">And behold at eveningtide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01091">trouble</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01242">before the morning</w> he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H08154" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">us, and the lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that rob</w> us. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen747" osisID="Isa.17"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06767">shadowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">with wings</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">of Ethiopia</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">That sendeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06735">ambassadors</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">by the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">even in vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01573">of bulrushes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07031">ye swift</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">to a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04178" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and peeled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">to a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H01973">from their beginning hitherto</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01471">a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06978">meted out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04001">and trodden down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">whose land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0958" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have spoiled</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>scattered…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">outspread and polished</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>meted…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that meteth out and treadeth down</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of line, line, and treading under foot</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>have…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">despise</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">All ye inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">of the world</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and dwellers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ye, when he lifteth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">an ensign</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">on the mountains</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when he bloweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">a trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hear</w> ye.

verses.name: Isaiah 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03541">For so</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, I will take my rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H04349">in my dwelling place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06703">like a clear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02527">heat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">upon herbs</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05645">like a cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">of dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02527">in the heat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">of harvest</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>consider…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">regard my set dwelling</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>upon…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">after rain</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">For afore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">the harvest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06525">when the bud</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is perfect</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01155">and the sour grape</w> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is ripening</w> <w lemma="strong:H05328">in the flower</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall both cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02150">the sprigs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04211">with pruning hooks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and take away</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08456" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05189">the branches</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 18:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">They shall be left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05861">unto the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and to the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05861">and the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H06972" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall summer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">upon them, and all the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall winter</w> upon them.

verses.name: Isaiah 18:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256">In that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07862">shall the present</w> <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04178" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and peeled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and from a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H01973">from their beginning hitherto</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01471">a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06978">meted out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04001">and trodden under foot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">whose land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0958" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have spoiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">to the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>scattered…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">outspread and polished</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen748" osisID="Isa.18"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">Behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">rideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07031">upon a swift</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0457">and the idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at his presence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">and the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall melt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> of it.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">And I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">against the Egyptians</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and they shall fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">against his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">against his neighbour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against city</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04467">kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">against kingdom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mingle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">And the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01238" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thereof; and I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof: and they shall seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0457">to the idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0328">and to the charmers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0178">and to them that have familiar spirits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03049">and to the wizards</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fail</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be emptied</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>destroy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">swallow up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0853">And</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05534" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">will I give over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07186">of a cruel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">lord</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05794">and a fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">over them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>give…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shut up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">And the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05405" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">from the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">and the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be wasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dried up</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-339">And they shall turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-339">far away</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02975">the brooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H04693">of defence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01809" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be emptied</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dried up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07070">the reeds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">and flags</w> <w lemma="strong:H07060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall wither</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06169">The paper reeds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">by the brooks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">by the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of the brooks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04218">and every thing sown</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">by the brooks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall wither</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05086" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be driven away</w>, and be no <transChange type="added">more</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and shall not be</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01771">The fishers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0578" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also shall mourn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and all they that cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02443">angle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">into the brooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall lament</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04365">nets</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">shall languish</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Moreover they that work</w> <w lemma="strong:H08305">in fine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06593">flax</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0707" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that weave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02355">networks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be confounded</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>networks</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">white works</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">And they shall be broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08356">in the purposes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thereof, all that make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07938">sluices</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H099">ponds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for fish</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>purposes</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">foundations</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>for fish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of living things</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08269">Surely the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06814">of Zoan</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0191">fools</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06098">the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">counsellors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is become brutish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">how say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">ye unto Pharaoh</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 19:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0335">Where</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0645">they? where</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">thy wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and let them tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee now, and let them know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">what the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath purposed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">upon Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">The princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06814">of Zoan</w> <w lemma="strong:H02973" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are become fools</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05297">of Noph</w> <w lemma="strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are deceived</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they have also seduced</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w>, <transChange type="added">even they that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06438">the stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribes</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>they that…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">governors</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">corners</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04537" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05773">a perverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">thereof: and they have caused Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to err</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">in every work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07910">thereof, as a drunken</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">staggereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06892">in his vomit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a perverse…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a spirit of perversities</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:15
verses.text: Neither shall there be <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">for Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">which the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02180">or tail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03712">branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0100">or rush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may do</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">shall Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">be like unto women</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H08573">of the shaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which he shaketh</w> over it.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0127">And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02283">shall be a terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">unto Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">every one that maketh mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof shall be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in himself, because</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">of the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which he hath determined</w> against it.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">shall five</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">the language</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">The city</w> <w lemma="strong:H02041">of destruction</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the language</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the lip</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>of destruction</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of Heres</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">of the sun</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">shall there be an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04676">and a pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">at</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thereof to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0226">And it shall be for a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">and for a witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they shall cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the oppressors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall send</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">them a saviour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and a great one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he shall deliver</w> them.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">and oblation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, they shall vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">a vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and perform</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and heal</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall return</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and he shall be intreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of them, and shall heal</w> them.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">shall there be a highway</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">to Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0804">and the Assyrian</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and the Egyptian</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">into Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">with the Assyrians</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">shall Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">be the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">with Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">and with Assyria</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01293">a blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 19:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall bless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0804">and Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of my hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">mine inheritance</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen749" osisID="Isa.19"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141">In the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08661">that Tartan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0795">unto Ashdod</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H05623">when Sargon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">him,) and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0795">against Ashdod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> it;

verses.name: Isaiah 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">At the same time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0531">of Amoz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and loose</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">the sackcloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">from off thy loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">thy shoe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">from thy foot</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did so</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">walking</w> <w lemma="strong:H06174">naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03182">and barefoot</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 20:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Like as my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06174">naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03182">and barefoot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">and wonder</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">upon Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">and upon Ethiopia</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">So shall the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lead away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">prisoners</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03568">and the Ethiopians</w> <w lemma="strong:H01546">captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">and old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06174">naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03182">and barefoot</w>, even with <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08357">buttocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H02834" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">uncovered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06172">to the shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the Egyptians…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the captivity of Egypt</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>shame</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">nakedness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">of Ethiopia</w> <w lemma="strong:H04007">their expectation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">their glory</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">of this isle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03541">Behold, such</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04007">our expectation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whither we flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">for help</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and how shall we escape</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>isle</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">country</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen750" osisID="Isa.20"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the desert</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05492">As whirlwinds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">in the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">pass</w> through; <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">from the desert</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">from a terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07186">A grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02380">vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">is declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto me; the treacherous dealer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dealeth treacherously</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the spoiler</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">spoileth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05867">O Elam</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">besiege</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04074">O Media</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0585">all the sighing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof have I made to cease</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>grievous</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hard</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04975">Therefore are my loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02479">with pain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06735">pangs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have taken hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06735">upon me, as the pangs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of a woman that travaileth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I was bowed down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at the hearing</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I was dismayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at the seeing</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03824">My heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">panted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06427">fearfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">affrighted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05399">me: the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H02837">of my pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath he turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02731">into fear</w> unto me.<note type="study"><catchWord>heart…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mind wandered</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>turned</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">put</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">the table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06844">in the watchtower</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">drink</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">ye princes</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">the shield</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">For thus hath the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">a watchman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">let him declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what he seeth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">a chariot</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06776">a couple</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">of horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">a chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">of asses</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07393">a chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">of camels</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07182">diligently</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">with much</w> <w lemma="strong:H07182">heed</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 21:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0738">A lion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0136">My lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H04707">upon the watchtower</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">in the daytime</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and I am set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">in my ward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">whole nights</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>he…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cried as a lion</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>whole…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">every night</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And, behold, here cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">a chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of men</w>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06776">a couple</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">of horsemen</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0894">Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fallen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fallen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06456">and all the graven images</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of her gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the ground</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 21:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04098">O my threshing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">of my floor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that which I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have I declared</w> unto you.<note type="study"><catchWord>corn</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">son</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01746">of Dumah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He calleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">to me out of Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Watchman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">what of the night</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Watchman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">what of the night</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 21:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The watchman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">The morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cometh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">and also the night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01158" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if ye will enquire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01158" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye: return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 21:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06152">upon Arabia</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03293">In the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06152">in Arabia</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye lodge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0736">O ye travelling companies</w> <w lemma="strong:H01720">of Dedanim</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 21:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08485">of Tema</w> <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to him</w> <w lemma="strong:H06771">that was thirsty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they prevented</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">with their bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him that fled</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brought</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bring ye</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For they fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the swords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the drawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and from</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the bent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03514">the grievousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from the swords</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for fear</rdg>, etc: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from the face</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">For thus hath the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">unto me, Within a year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">according to the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07916">of an hireling</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and all the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H06938">of Kedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fail</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 21:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07605">And the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">of the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">of archers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">the mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06938">of Kedar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be diminished</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>archers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bows</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen751" osisID="Isa.21"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">of the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H02384">of vision</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0645">What aileth thee now</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou art wholly gone up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">to the housetops</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 22:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04392">Thou that art full</w> <w lemma="strong:H08663">of stirs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a tumultuous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05947">a joyous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02491">thy slain</w> <transChange type="added">men are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">not slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">nor dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in battle</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07101">All thy rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">they are bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">by the archers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">all that are found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">in thee are bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">from far</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of the bow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08159" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I, Look away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">from me; I will weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">bitterly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">not to comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H07701">me, because of the spoiling</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>weep…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be bitter in weeping</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:5
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04103">of trouble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04001">and of treading down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03998">and of perplexity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">by the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H02384">of vision</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06979" morph="strongMorph:TH8772">breaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">down the walls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07771">and of crying</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to the mountains</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05867">And Elam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0827">the quiver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">with chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06571">horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07024">and Kir</w> <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">uncovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">the shield</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>uncovered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made naked</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:7
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04005">thy choicest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">valleys</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be full</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">and the horsemen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">themselves in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at the gate</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the choice of thy valleys</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>at</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">toward</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he discovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04539">the covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thou didst look</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05402">to the armour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the forest</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01233">also the breaches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they are many</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and ye gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08481">of the lower</w> <w lemma="strong:H01295">pool</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye have numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have ye broken down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to fortify</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04724">also a ditch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">between the two walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">for the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03465">of the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H01295">pool</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but ye have not looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto the maker</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, neither had respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto him that fashioned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">it long ago</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">did the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">to weeping</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04553">and to mourning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07144">and to baldness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to girding</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">with sackcloth</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 22:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08342">And behold joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">and gladness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">slaying</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and killing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">eating</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and drinking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">let us eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and drink</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04279">for to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we shall die</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And it was revealed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in mine ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">Surely this iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall not be purged</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from you till ye die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get</w> <w lemma="strong:H05532" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee unto this treasurer</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07644">unto Shebna</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over the house</w>, <transChange type="added">and say</transChange>,

verses.name: Isaiah 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">a sepulchre</w> <w lemma="strong:H06311">here</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that heweth him out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">a sepulchre</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">on high</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that graveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">an habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">for himself in a rock</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>as…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">O he</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02904" morph="strongMorph:TH8772">will carry thee away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">with a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02925">captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cover</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>will carry…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">who covered thee with an excellent covering, and clothed thee gorgeously, (next verse) shall surely</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>a mighty…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the captivity of a man</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06801" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">He will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06801" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">violently turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06802">and toss</w> thee <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01754">a ball</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H07342">into a large</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there shalt thou die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04818">and there the chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of thy glory</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07036">the shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of thy lord’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>large</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">large of spaces</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will drive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04673">thee from thy station</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04612">and from thy state</w> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he pull thee down</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I will call</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0471">Eliakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">of Hilkiah</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 22:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will clothe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">him with thy robe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H073">him with thy girdle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04475">thy government</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">and he shall be a father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04668">And the key</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will I lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">upon his shoulder</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so he shall open</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and none shall shut</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall shut</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and none shall open</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will fasten</w> him <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03489">a nail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">in a sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03519">and he shall be for a glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall hang</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">upon him all the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06631">the offspring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06849">and the issue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">all vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">of small</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">quantity, from the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H0101">of cups</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">even to all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">of flagons</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>vessels of flagons</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">instruments of viols</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03489">shall the nail</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that is fastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">in the sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be removed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and be cut down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fall</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04853">and the burden</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">upon it shall be cut off</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen752" osisID="Isa.22"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyre</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0591">ye ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">of Tarshish</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">for it is laid waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">so that there is no house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">no entering in</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03794">of Chittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">it is revealed</w> to them.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be still</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">of the isle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou whom the merchants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">of Zidon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have replenished</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>still</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">silent</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">And by great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07883">of Sihor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07105">the harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of the river</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08393">her revenue</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05505">and she is a mart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of nations</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be thou ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06721">O Zidon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03220">for the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath spoken</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04581">the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I travail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not, nor bring forth children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">neither do I nourish up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">young men</w>, <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">virgins</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08088">As at the report</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">concerning Egypt</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they be sorely pained</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">at the report</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyre</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Pass ye over</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">to Tarshish</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">of the isle</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05947">this your joyous</w> <transChange type="added">city</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06927">whose antiquity</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07272">her own feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">her afar off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sojourn</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>afar…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from afar off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who hath taken this counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">against Tyre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05849" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">the crowning</w> <transChange type="added">city</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whose merchants</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03667">whose traffickers</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the honourable</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 23:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath purposed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">it, to stain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H06643">of all glory</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring into contempt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">all the honourable</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to stain</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to pollute</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">as a river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">of Tarshish</w>: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04206">no more strength</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strength</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">girdle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">over the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he shook</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdoms</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath given a commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">against the merchant</w> <transChange type="added">city</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">the strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">holds</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>against…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">concerning a merchantman</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the merchant city</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Canaan</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>strong…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">strengths</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">O thou oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">virgin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">of Zidon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03794">to Chittim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there also shalt thou have no rest</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Behold the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w> was not, <transChange type="added">till</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0804">the Assyrian</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">founded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06728">it for them that dwell in the wilderness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0971">the towers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06209" morph="strongMorph:TH8782">thereof, they raised up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">the palaces</w> thereof; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04654">it to ruin</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0591">ye ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">of Tarshish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04581">for your strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is laid waste</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06865">that Tyre</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall be forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">according to the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07093">after the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">of seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">shall Tyre</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as an harlot</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall Tyre…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">it shall be unto Tyre as the song of an harlot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">an harp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou harlot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that hast been forgotten</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">make sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05059" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">melody</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">sing many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">songs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that thou mayest be remembered</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07093">And it shall come to pass after the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">of seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">Tyre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and she shall turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0868">to her hire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall commit fornication</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">with all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05504">And her merchandise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0868">and her hire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">shall be holiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0686" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall not be treasured</w> <w lemma="strong:H02630" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor laid up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05504">for her merchandise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall be for them that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07654">sufficiently</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06266">and for durable</w> <w lemma="strong:H04374">clothing</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>durable</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">old</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen753" osisID="Isa.23"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">maketh the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01238" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">empty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01110" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and maketh it waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it upside down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and scattereth abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>turneth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">perverteth the face thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And it shall be, as with the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">so with the priest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05650">as with the servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">so with his master</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08198">as with the maid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01404">so with her mistress</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as with the buyer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">so with the seller</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">as with the lender</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">so with the borrower</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05383" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as with the taker of usury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">so</w> <w lemma="strong:H05378" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">with the giver of usury</w> to him.<note type="study"><catchWord>priest</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prince</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:3
