verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01238" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">shall be utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01238" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">emptied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">and utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">spoiled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this word</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">mourneth</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fadeth away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08398">the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">languisheth</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fadeth away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04791">the haughty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">do languish</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the haughty…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the height of the people</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02610" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also is defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">under the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof; because they have transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the laws</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">the ordinance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">the everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0423">Therefore hath the curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein are desolate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">therefore the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02787" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are burned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04213">and few</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">left</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08492">The new wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">mourneth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01612">the vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">languisheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H08056">all the merryhearted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0584" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">do sigh</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04885">The mirth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08596">of tabrets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ceaseth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07588">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05947">of them that rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">endeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04885">the joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">of the harp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ceaseth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall not drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">with a song</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07941">strong drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that drink</w> it.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07151">The city</w> <w lemma="strong:H08414">of confusion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is broken down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">every house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is shut up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that no man may come in</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06682">a crying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">for wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">in the streets</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08057">all joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06150" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is darkened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04885">the mirth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is gone</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">In the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">is smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07591">with destruction</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07130">When thus it shall be in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05363">as the shaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">of an olive tree</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05955">as the gleaning grapes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01210">when the vintage</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is done</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">for the majesty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06670" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall cry aloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">from the sea</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Wherefore glorify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0217">in the fires</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">in the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fires</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">valleys</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03671">From the uttermost part</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have we heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02158">songs</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06643">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">to the righteous</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07334">My leanness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07334">my leanness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0188">woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto me! the treacherous dealers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have dealt treacherously</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">yea, the treacherous dealers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">have dealt very</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">treacherously</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>uttermost…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wing</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>My leanness</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Leanness to me</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">My secret to me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06343">Fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06354">and the pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06341">and the snare</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon thee, O inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:18
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">he who fleeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">from the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">of the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06354">into the pit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he that cometh up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06354">of the pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">in the snare</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0699">for the windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">from on high</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are open</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04146">and the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do shake</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8712">broken down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8707">dissolved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">is moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">exceedingly</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall reel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to and fro</w> <w lemma="strong:H07910">like a drunkard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8712">and shall be removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04412">like a cottage</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06588">and the transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof shall be heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon it; and it shall fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and not rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">of the high ones</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04791">on high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">upon the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>punish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visit upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">And they shall be gathered together</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0616">prisoners</w> <w lemma="strong:H0626">are gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">in the pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">and shall be shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04525">in the prison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">and after many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall they be visited</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as prisoners…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with the gathering of prisoners</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>pit</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dungeon</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>visited</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">found wanting</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03842">Then the moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be confounded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02535">and the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and before his ancients</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">gloriously</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>before…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">there shall be glory before his ancients</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 24." eID="gen754" osisID="Isa.24"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">I will exalt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee, I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H06382">wonderful</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange>; <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06098">counsels</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">of old</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0530">faithfulness</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0544">truth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">an heap</w>; <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">a defenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04654">a ruin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0759">a palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to be no city</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05769">it shall never</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be built</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05794">Therefore shall the strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">glorify</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">thee, the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">of the terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fear</w> thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04581">For thou hast been a strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">to the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04581">a strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">to the needy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">in his distress</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04268">a refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02230">from the storm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06738">a shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02721">from the heat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">when the blast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">of the terrible ones</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02230">as a storm</w> <transChange type="added">against</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07023">the wall</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt bring down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07588">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of strangers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02721">as the heat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06724">in a dry place</w>; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02721">the heat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">with the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">of a cloud</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02159">the branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">of the terrible ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be brought low</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02022">And in this mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">shall the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of fat things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04960">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08105">of wines on the lees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">of fat things</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">full of marrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08105">of wines on the lees</w> <w lemma="strong:H02212" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">well refined</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And he will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in this mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03875">of the covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03874" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cast over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04541">and the vail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05259" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that is spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">over all nations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">swallow up</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cast</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">covered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">He will swallow up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">death</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">in victory</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0136">and the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will wipe away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">tears</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from off all faces</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02781">and the rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall he take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from off all the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And it shall be said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>, Lo, this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">we have waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for him, and he will save</w> us: this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">we have waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for him, we will be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">in his salvation</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">For in this mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">shall the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04124">and Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01758" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">shall be trodden down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04963">under him, even as straw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01758" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is trodden down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325 strong:H04087 strong:H01119" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">for the dunghill</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>trodden down under</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">threshed</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>trodden down for…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">threshed in Madmenah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And he shall spread forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07811" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them, as he that swimmeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spreadeth forth</w> <transChange type="added">his hands</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07811" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to swim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he shall bring down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01346">their pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H0698">together with the spoils</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their hands</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04013">And the fortress</w> <w lemma="strong:H04869">of the high fort</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">of thy walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall he bring down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">lay low</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06083">to the dust</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 25." eID="gen755" osisID="Isa.25"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">shall this song</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be sung</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05797">We have a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03444">salvation</w> will <transChange type="added">God</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">appoint</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02346">walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H02426">and bulwarks</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Open</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">ye the gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06662">that the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0529">the truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may enter in</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>truth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">truths</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou wilt keep</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>, <transChange type="added">whose</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03336">mind</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">stayed</w> <transChange type="added">on thee</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">because he trusteth</w> in thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>perfect…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">peace, peace</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>mind</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thought</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">imagination</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03050">for in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Jehovah</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">strength</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>everlasting…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the rock of ages</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">For he bringeth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">on high</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the lofty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he layeth it low</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he layeth it low</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he bringeth</w> it <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06083">to the dust</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07272">The foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall tread it down</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">the feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">of the poor</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06471">the steps</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">of the needy</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0734">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the just</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04339">uprightness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03477">thou, most upright</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06424" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">dost weigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04570">the path</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the just</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0734">Yea, in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of thy judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have we waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H08378">for thee; the desire</w> of <transChange type="added">our</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">to thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02143">and to the remembrance</w> of thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">With my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have I desired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">thee in the night</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07307">yea, with my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H07836" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me will I seek thee early</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04941">for when thy judgments</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">of the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">Let favour be shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">to the wicked</w>, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01077">will he not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05229">of uprightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05765" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will he deal unjustly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01077">and will not</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01348">the majesty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thy hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is lifted up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they will not see</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be ashamed</w> for <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07068">envy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">at the people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0784">yea, the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">of thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall devour</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>at…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">toward thy people</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08239" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou wilt ordain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for us: for thou also hast wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">all our works</w> in us.<note type="study"><catchWord>in us</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for us</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H02108">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee have had dominion</w> over us: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">by thee only will we make mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of thy name</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:14
verses.text: <transChange type="added">They are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall not live</w>; <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07496">deceased</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall not rise</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore hast thou visited</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02143">them, and made all their memory</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to perish</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thou art glorified</w>: thou hadst removed <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">far</w> <transChange type="added">unto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07099">all the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06862">in trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have they visited</w> <w lemma="strong:H06694" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, they poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03908">a prayer</w> <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04148">thy chastening</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> upon them.<note type="study"><catchWord>prayer</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">secret speech</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03644">Like</w> <w lemma="strong:H02030">as a woman with child</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">draweth near</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">the time of her delivery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is in pain</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">crieth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">in her pangs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">so have we been in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have been with child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we have been in pain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03644">we have as it were</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we have not wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">any deliverance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01077">neither</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">have the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">of the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fallen</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Thy dead</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall live</w>, <transChange type="added">together with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05038">my dead body</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they arise</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Awake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and sing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">in dust</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02919">for thy dew</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02919">the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0219">of herbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07496">the dead</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">thou into thy chambers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">thy doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H02247" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">about thee: hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">thyself as it were for a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H07281">moment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02195">until the indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be overpast</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For, behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cometh out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of his place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for their iniquity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">also shall disclose</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">her blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and shall no more cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">her slain</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 26." eID="gen756" osisID="Isa.26"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07186">with his sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">and strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03882">leviathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01281">the piercing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">serpent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03882">even leviathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06129">that crooked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">serpent</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">the dragon</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">in the sea</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>piercing</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">crossing like a bar</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">ye unto her, A vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02531 strong:H02561" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">of red wine</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">do keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it; I will water</w> <w lemma="strong:H07281">it every moment</w>: lest <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hurt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, I will keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">it night</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">and day</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02534">Fury</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not in me: who would set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08068">the briers</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07898">thorns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">against me in battle</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06585" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I would go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06702" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">through them, I would burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">them together</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>go…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">march against</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Or let him take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">of my strength</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he may make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> with me; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> with me.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He shall cause them that come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H08327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to take root</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06692" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall blossom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">of the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H08570">with fruit</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Hath he smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">him, as he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">those that smote</w> him? <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is he slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02027">according to the slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of them that are slain</w> by him?<note type="study"><catchWord>as…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to the stroke of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05432">In measure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when it shooteth forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou wilt debate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with it: he stayeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07186">his rough</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">of the east wind</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it shooteth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thou sendest it forth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>he…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when he removeth it with</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02063">By this</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">therefore shall the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">be purged</w>; and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06529">all the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">his sin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">all the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01615">as chalkstones</w> <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">that are beaten in sunder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0842">the groves</w> <w lemma="strong:H02553">and images</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not stand up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sun images</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Yet the defenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0910">desolate</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05116">the habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">forsaken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and left</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">like a wilderness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05695">there shall the calf</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there shall he lie down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H05585">the branches</w> thereof.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07105">When the boughs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof are withered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall be broken off</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0802">the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">set them on fire</w>: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">of no understanding</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">therefore he that made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them will not have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">on them, and he that formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them will shew them no favour</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02251" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall beat off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">from the channel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">of the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto the stream</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">and ye shall be gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">by one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">O ye children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be blown</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which were ready to perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and the outcasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and shall worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 27." eID="gen757" osisID="Isa.27"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05850">to the crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H01348">of pride</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07910">to the drunkards</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06643">whose glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">beauty</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a fading</w> <w lemma="strong:H06731">flower</w>, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">valleys</w> <w lemma="strong:H01986" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of them that are overcome</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">with wine</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>overcome</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">broken</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Behold, the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">hath a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0533">and strong one</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02230">as a tempest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01259">of hail</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06986">a destroying</w> <w lemma="strong:H08178">storm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02230">as a flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03524">of mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">overflowing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with the hand</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05850">The crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H01348">of pride</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07910">the drunkards</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be trodden</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">under feet</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>under…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with feet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06643">And the glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">beauty</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall be a fading</w> <w lemma="strong:H06733">flower</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01061">as the hasty fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">before the summer</w>; which <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon it seeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">while it is yet in his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he eateth it up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>eateth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">swalloweth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">shall the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05850">be for a crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H06643">of glory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06843">and for a diadem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">of beauty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07605">unto the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 28:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">And for a spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to him that sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and for strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to them that turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">to the gate</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0428">But they</w> <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also have erred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">through wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07941">and through strong drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are out of the way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">and the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have erred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941">through strong drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they are swallowed up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04480">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are out of the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941">through strong drink</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they err</w> <w lemma="strong:H07203">in vision</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06328" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they stumble</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06417">judgment</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07979">For all tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are full</w> <w lemma="strong:H06892">of vomit</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06675">filthiness</w>, <transChange type="added">so that there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">no place</w> <transChange type="added">clean</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Whom shall he teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01844">knowledge</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and whom shall he make to understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">doctrine</w>? <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">weaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">from the milk</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06267">drawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">from the breasts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>doctrine</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the hearing?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06673">For precept</w> <transChange type="added">must be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06673">upon precept</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06673">precept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06673">upon precept</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06957">line</w> <w lemma="strong:H06957">upon line</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06957">line</w> <w lemma="strong:H06957">upon line</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02191">here a little</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02191">there a little</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>must be</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hath been</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03934">For with stammering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will he speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to this people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stammering…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stammerings of lip</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>will…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he hath spoken</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">To whom he said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04496">the rest</w> <transChange type="added">wherewith</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05889">ye may cause the weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to rest</w>; and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04774">the refreshing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet they would</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not hear</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">But the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06673">was unto them precept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06673">upon precept</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06673">precept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06673">upon precept</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06957">line</w> <w lemma="strong:H06957">upon line</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06957">line</w> <w lemma="strong:H06957">upon line</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02191">here a little</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02191">there a little</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they might go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">backward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and be broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03369" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and snared</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and taken</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Wherefore hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03944">ye scornful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because ye have said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">with death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07585">and with hell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are we</w> <w lemma="strong:H02374">at agreement</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when the overflowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07885 strong:H07752" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">scourge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674 strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">shall pass through</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto us: for we have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">lies</w> <w lemma="strong:H04268">our refuge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08267">and under falsehood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">have we hid</w> ourselves:

verses.name: Isaiah 28:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Behold, I lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">for a foundation a stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0976">a tried</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03368">a precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">corner</w> <transChange type="added">stone</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">a sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04143">foundation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that believeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not make haste</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04941">Judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also will I lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06957">to the line</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04949">to the plummet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01259">and the hail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03261" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall sweep away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04268">the refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">of lies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">and the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall overflow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">the hiding place</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01285">And your covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">with death</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">shall be disannulled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02380">and your agreement</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">with hell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not stand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when the overflowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07752">scourge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pass through</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04823">then ye shall be trodden down</w> by it.<note type="study"><catchWord>trodden…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a treading down to it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01767">From the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that it goeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">you: for morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">by morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall it pass over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">by day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and by night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02113">and it shall be a vexation</w> only <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">the report</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when he shall make you to understand doctrine</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04702">For the bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is shorter</w> than that <transChange type="added">a man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08311" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">can stretch</w> himself <transChange type="added">on it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H04541">and the covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">narrower</w> <w lemma="strong:H03664" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">than that he can wrap</w> himself <transChange type="added">in it</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rise up</w> as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06559">Perazim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall be wroth</w> as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06010">the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">of Gibeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he may do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">his work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">his strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and bring to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">his act</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05237">his strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">act</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8698">Now therefore be ye not mockers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04147">lest your bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be made strong</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">from the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">a consumption</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02782" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">even determined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the whole earth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Give ye ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">hearken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">my speech</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Doth the plowman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">plow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sow</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">doth he open</w> <w lemma="strong:H07702" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and break the clods</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of his ground</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 28:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">When he hath made plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof, doth he not cast abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07100">the fitches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03646">the cummin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07795">in the principal</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">wheat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05567" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and the appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H03698">and the rie</w> <w lemma="strong:H01367">in their place</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>the principal…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the wheat in the principal place, and barley in the appointed place</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>rie</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spelt</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>place</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">border?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">For his God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">doth instruct</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">him to discretion</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">doth teach</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>For…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">And he bindeth it in such sort as his God doth teach him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07100">For the fitches</w> <w lemma="strong:H01758" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">are not threshed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">with a threshing instrument</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05699">neither is a cart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">wheel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">turned about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03646">upon the cummin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07100">but the fitches</w> <w lemma="strong:H02251" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">are beaten out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">with a staff</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03646">and the cummin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">with a rod</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03899">Bread</w> <transChange type="added">corn</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01854" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">is bruised</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05331">because he will not ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01758 strong:H0156" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8800">be threshing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02000" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, nor break</w> <transChange type="added">it with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01536">the wheel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">of his cart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01854" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor bruise</w> it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06571">his horsemen</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">This also cometh forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is wonderful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">in counsel</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08454">in working</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 28." eID="gen758" osisID="Isa.28"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0740">to Ariel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0740">to Ariel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07151">the city</w> <transChange type="added">where</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w>! <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">add</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">ye year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">to year</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">sacrifices</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Woe…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">O Ariel</rdg>, that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">the lion of God</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the city</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of the city</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>kill</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cut off the heads of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06693" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Yet I will distress</w> <w lemma="strong:H0740">Ariel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08386">and there shall be heaviness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0592">and sorrow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0740">and it shall be unto me as Ariel</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01754">against thee round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will lay siege</w> <w lemma="strong:H04674">against thee with a mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will raise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04694">forts</w> against thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt be brought down</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shalt speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0565">and thy speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be low</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">out of the dust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and thy voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0178">shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0565">and thy speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H06850" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">shall whisper</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">out of the dust</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>whisper</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">peep</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">chirp</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01995">Moreover the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of thy strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01851">shall be like small</w> <w lemma="strong:H080">dust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">and the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">of the terrible ones</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04671">as chaff</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that passeth away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06621">yea, it shall be at an instant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">suddenly</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Thou shalt be visited</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07482">with thunder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07494">and with earthquake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">noise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05492">with storm</w> <w lemma="strong:H05591">and tempest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03851">and the flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of devouring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01995">And the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06633" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0740">against Ariel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06638" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">even all that fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04685">against her and her munition</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06693" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and that distress</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">her, shall be as a dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">of a night</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">vision</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07457">It shall even be as when an hungry</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dreameth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, he eateth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but he awaketh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07386">is empty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0834">or as when</w> <w lemma="strong:H06771">a thirsty man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dreameth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, he drinketh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but he awaketh</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05889">faint</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08264" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hath appetite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01995">so shall the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06633" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">be, that fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">against mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04102" morph="strongMorph:TH8697">Stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H08539" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yourselves, and wonder</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08173" morph="strongMorph:TH8697">cry ye out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08173" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and cry</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are drunken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">but not with wine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they stagger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07941">but not with strong drink</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cry ye…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">take your pleasure, and riot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">upon you the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08639">of deep sleep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and hath closed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">your eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">and your rulers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02374">the seers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath he covered</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rulers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heads</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02380">And the vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of all is become unto you as the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of a book</w> <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that is sealed</w>, which <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to one that is learned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Read</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this, I pray thee: and he saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cannot</w>; for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">sealed</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>book</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">letter</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05612">And the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612 strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to him that is not learned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Read</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this, I pray thee: and he saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am not learned</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0136">Wherefore the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03282">Forasmuch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">as this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">draw near</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with their mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08193">and with their lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">do honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-340">me, but have removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-340">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">from me, and their fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">toward me is taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">by the precept</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of men</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 29:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Therefore, behold, I will proceed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to do a marvellous work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among this people</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">a marvellous work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06382">and a wonder</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02451">for the wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of their wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0998">and the understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of their prudent</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall be hid</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>proceed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">add</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06009" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">unto them that seek deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">their counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">and their works</w> <w lemma="strong:H04285">are in the dark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">us? and who knoweth</w> us?

verses.name: Isaiah 29:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02017" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Surely your turning of things upside down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be esteemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as the potter’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">clay</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04639">for shall the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, He made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03336">me not? or shall the thing framed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that framed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">it, He had no understanding</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 29:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04213">it not yet a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">little while</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03844">and Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03759">into a fruitful field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03759">and the fruitful field</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be esteemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">as a forest</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 29:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02795">shall the deaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of the book</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05787">of the blind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0652">out of obscurity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02822">and out of darkness</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06035">The meek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also shall increase</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08057">joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H034">and the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">among men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">in the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>increase</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">add</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06184">For the terrible one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0656" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is brought to nought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and the scorner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is consumed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08245" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all that watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">for iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are cut off</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 29:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">That make a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">an offender</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">for a word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06983" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">for him that reproveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and turn aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the just</w> <w lemma="strong:H08414">for a thing of nought</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">concerning the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not now be ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">neither shall his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H02357" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">now wax pale</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:23
