verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">But when he seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">his children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of mine hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of him, they shall sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06206" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They also that erred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">in spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">to understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07279" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and they that murmured</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03948">doctrine</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>come…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">know understanding</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 29." eID="gen759" osisID="Isa.29"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05637" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">counsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but not of me; and that cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">with a covering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">but not of my spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they may add</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">to sin</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 30:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">That walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have not asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">at my mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05810" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">themselves in the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">in the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>!

verses.name: Isaiah 30:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04581">Therefore shall the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">be your shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02622">and the trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">in the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03639">confusion</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">For his princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06814">were at Zoan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">and his ambassadors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02609">to Hanes</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">They were all ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of a people</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">could not profit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05828">them, nor be an help</w> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">nor profit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01322">but a shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02781">and also a reproach</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06695">and anguish</w>, from whence <transChange type="added">come</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03833">the young</w> <w lemma="strong:H03918">and old lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0660">the viper</w> <w lemma="strong:H08314" type="x-split-341">and fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">flying</w> <w lemma="strong:H08314" type="x-split-341">serpent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they will carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">their riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">upon the shoulders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05895">of young asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">and their treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H01707">upon the bunches</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">of camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">to a people</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not profit</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">For the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall help</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">in vain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07385">and to no purpose</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore have I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">concerning this</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01992">Their</w> <w lemma="strong:H07293">strength</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07674">to sit still</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>concerning…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to her</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">write</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">it before them in a table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and note</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">it in a book</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">that it may be for the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">and ever</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the latter day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:9
verses.text: That this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04805">a rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03586">lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 30:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Which say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the seers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">See</w> <w lemma="strong:H02374">not; and to the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05229">not unto us right things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">unto us smooth things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04123">deceits</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 30:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">turn aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">out of the path</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">cause the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> us.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Because ye despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H06233">in oppression</w> <w lemma="strong:H03868" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and perverseness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and stay</w> thereon:<note type="study"><catchWord>oppression</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fraud</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05771">Therefore this iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">shall be to you as a breach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ready to fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01158" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">swelling out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">in a high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07667">whose breaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06621">at an instant</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall break</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">it as the breaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the potters’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">vessel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that is broken in pieces</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not spare</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">so that there shall not be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04386">in the bursting</w> <w lemma="strong:H02789">of it a sherd</w> <w lemma="strong:H02846" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03344" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">from the hearth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02834" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">or to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <transChange type="added">withal</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01360">out of the pit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the potters’…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the bottle of potters</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07729">In returning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05183">and rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall ye be saved</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">in quietness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0985">and in confidence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">shall be your strength</w>: <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye would</w> not.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But ye said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">No; for we will flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">upon horses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore shall ye flee</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and, We will ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H07031">upon the swift</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">therefore shall they that pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">you be swift</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">One</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">shall flee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at</w> <w lemma="strong:H01606">the rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">at</w> <w lemma="strong:H01606">the rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">of five</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye flee</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">till ye be left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08650">as a beacon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of a mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05251">and as an ensign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">on an hill</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a beacon</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a tree bereft of branches</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">boughs</rdg>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a mast</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And therefore will the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wait</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he may be gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto you, and therefore will he be exalted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that he may have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon you: for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0835">blessed</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02442" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all they that wait</w> for him.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">For the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">no more</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he will be very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto thee at the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of thy cry</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, he will answer</w> thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:20
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">you the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">of adversity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">and the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03906">of affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">yet shall not thy teachers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03670" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be removed into a corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">any more, but thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">thy teachers</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>affliction</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">oppression</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0241">And thine ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, saying</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">walk ye in it</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0541" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when ye turn to the right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08041" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and when ye turn to the left</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Ye shall defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H06826">also the covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">of thy graven images</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0642">and the ornament</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">of thy molten images</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt cast them away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01739">as a menstruous cloth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto it, Get thee hence</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thy graven…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the graven images of thy silver</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cast</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">scatter</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shall he give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">the rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of thy seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou shalt sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">withal; and bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">of the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01879">and it shall be fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08082">and plenteous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">shall thy cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">in large</w> <w lemma="strong:H03733">pastures</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0504">The oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05895">likewise and the young asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02548">clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H01098">provender</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which hath been winnowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07371">with the shovel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04214">and with the fan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>clean</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">savoury</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">leavened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01364">And there shall be upon every high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and upon every high</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06388">rivers</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02988">streams</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02027">slaughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04026">when the towers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">fall</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>high hill</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lifted up</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0216">Moreover the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03842">of the moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">shall be as the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02535">of the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">and the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02535">of the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H07659">shall be sevenfold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">as the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">of seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">bindeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">the breach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and healeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04273">the stroke</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">of their wound</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08034">Behold, the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">from far</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">burning</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">his anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04858">and the burden</w> <transChange type="added">thereof is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03514">heavy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08193">his lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">of indignation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">and his tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as a devouring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>burden…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">grievousness of flame</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>heavy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heaviness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">And his breath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as an overflowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">stream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall reach to the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">of the neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to sift</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05299">with the sieve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">of vanity</w>: and <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07448">a bridle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03895">in the jaws</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, causing <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to err</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07892">Ye shall have a song</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">as in the night</w> <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8692" type="x-split-342">a holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">solemnity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8692" type="x-split-342">is kept</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08057">and gladness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as when one goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02485">with a pipe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06697">to the mighty One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mighty…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Rock</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01935">shall cause his glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to be heard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05183">the lighting down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">of his arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02197">with the indignation</w> of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>, and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03851">the flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of a devouring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05311">scattering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02230">and tempest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01259 strong:H068">and hailstones</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his glorious…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the glory of his voice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">For through the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">shall the Assyrian</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be beaten down</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">with a rod</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:32
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03605">every place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04145">where the grounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H04569">shall pass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall lay</w> upon him, <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08596">shall be with tabrets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">and harps</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04421">and in battles</w> <w lemma="strong:H08573">of shaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">will he fight</w> with it.<note type="study"><catchWord>in every…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">every passing of the rod founded</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>lay…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cause to rest upon</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>with it</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">against them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08613">For Tophet</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">ordained</w> <w lemma="strong:H0865">of old</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">yea, for the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">it is prepared</w>; he hath made <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06009" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">deep</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">large</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04071">the pile</w> thereof <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and much</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05397">the breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">like a stream</w> <w lemma="strong:H01614">of brimstone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doth kindle</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>of old</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from yesterday</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 30." eID="gen760" osisID="Isa.30"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">for help</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">on horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">in chariots</w>, because <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06571">and in horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">because they are very</w> <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">strong</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08159" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they look</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">not unto the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>!

verses.name: Isaiah 31:2
verses.text: Yet he also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will not call back</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his words</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but will arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">against the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of the evildoers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05833">and against the help</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>call…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">remove</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">Now the Egyptians</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">and not God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05483">and their horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and not spirit</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">When the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">both he that helpeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and he that is holpen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fall down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they all shall fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For thus hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">unto me, Like as the lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">and the young lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">roaring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">on his prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04393">when a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is called forth</w> against him, <transChange type="added">he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">will not be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">of their voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor abase</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">himself for the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of them: so shall the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06633" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">for mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and for the hill</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>noise</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">multitude</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06833">As birds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">flying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">so will the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01598" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">defend</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01598" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">defending</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">also he will deliver</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06452" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">passing over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he will preserve</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn</w> ye unto <transChange type="added">him from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">whom the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06009" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have deeply</w> <w lemma="strong:H05627">revolted</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall cast away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0457">his idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0457">and his idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">which your own hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have made</w> unto you <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02399">a sin</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his idols of gold</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the idols of his gold</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0804">Then shall the Assyrian</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">not of a mighty man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02719">and the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">not of a mean man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him: but he shall flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0970">and his young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04522">shall be discomfited</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for fear of</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>discomfited</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">tributary</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for melting</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">tribute</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">to his strong hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04032">for fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and his princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">of the ensign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0217">whose fire</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08574">and his furnace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his rock shall pass away for fear</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>his strong hold</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">his strength</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 31." eID="gen761" osisID="Isa.31"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Behold, a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">in righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in judgment</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04224">shall be as an hiding place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">from the wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05643">and a covert</w> <w lemma="strong:H02230">from the tempest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06388">as rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w> <w lemma="strong:H06724">in a dry place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06738">as the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">of a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05889">in a weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>great</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heavy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">And the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that see</w> <w lemma="strong:H08159" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not be dim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">and the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall hearken</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03824">The heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">also of the rash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">and the tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05926">of the stammerers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall be ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06703">plainly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rash</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hasty</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>plainly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">elegantly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05036">The vile person</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be no more called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05081">liberal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03596">nor the churl</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">said</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07771">bountiful</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05036">For the vile person</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05039">villany</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to practise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02612">hypocrisy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08442">error</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to make empty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07457">of the hungry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04945">and he will cause the drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H06771">of the thirsty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to fail</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03627">The instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03596">also of the churl</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he deviseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">wicked devices</w> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06035 strong:H06041" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">with lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H034">even when the needy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">right</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the needy…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he speaketh against the poor in judgment</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05081">But the liberal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">deviseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05081">liberal things</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05081">and by liberal things</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he stand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stand</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">be established</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rise up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">ye women</w> <w lemma="strong:H07600">that are at ease</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye careless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">give ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">unto my speech</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Many days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">and years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye be troubled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye careless women</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01210">for the vintage</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0625">the gathering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not come</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Many…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Days above a year</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Tremble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07600">ye women that are at ease</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be troubled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye careless ones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">strip</w> <w lemma="strong:H06209" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">you, and make you bare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02290">and gird</w> <transChange type="added">sackcloth</transChange> upon <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02504">loins</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They shall lament</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">for the teats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02531">for the pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">fields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for the fruitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">vine</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fields of desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0127">Upon the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06975">thorns</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08068">briers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">yea, upon all the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04885">of joy</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05947">the joyous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">city</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>yea…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">burning upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0759">Because the palaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">shall be forsaken</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01995">the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">shall be left</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06076">the forts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0975">and towers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">shall be for dens</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04885">a joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06501">of wild asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04829">a pasture</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">of flocks</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>forts…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">clifts and watchtowers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">Until the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">upon us from on high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">and the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03759">be a fruitful field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03759">and the fruitful field</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">for a forest</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04941">Then judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03759">in the fruitful field</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04639">And the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">of righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">shall be peace</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05656">and the effect</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">of righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">quietness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">and assurance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in a peaceable</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">habitation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04009">and in sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">dwellings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07600">and in quiet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04496">resting places</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 32:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01258" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When it shall hail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">coming down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">on the forest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be low</w> <w lemma="strong:H08218">in a low place</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>low in…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">utterly abased</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye that sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">beside all waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that send forth</w> <transChange type="added">thither</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">the feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">of the ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">and the ass</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 32." eID="gen762" osisID="Isa.32"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to thee that spoilest</w>, and thou <transChange type="added">wast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">not spoiled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and dealest treacherously</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they dealt not treacherously</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">with thee! when thou shalt cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">thou shalt be spoiled</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05239" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when thou shalt make an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to deal treacherously</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall deal treacherously</w> with thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">unto us; we have waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">for thee: be thou their arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">every morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03444">our salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">also in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">At the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">of the tumult</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07427">at the lifting up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of thyself the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were scattered</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07998">And your spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">shall be gathered</w> <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0625">the gathering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02625">of the caterpiller</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04944">as the running to and fro</w> <w lemma="strong:H01357">of locusts</w> <w lemma="strong:H08264" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall he run</w> upon them.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is exalted</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for he dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">on high</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">with judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02451">And wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">and knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">shall be the stability</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">of thy times</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02633">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">of salvation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03374">the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0214">his treasure</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>salvation</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">salvations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0691">Behold, their valiant ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04397">the ambassadors</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">bitterly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>valiant…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">messengers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04546">The highways</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">lie waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0734 strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the wayfaring man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ceaseth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he regardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">no man</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">mourneth</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">languisheth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03844">Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is ashamed</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hewn down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08289">Sharon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">is like a wilderness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01316">and Bashan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">and Carmel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05287" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shake off</w> <transChange type="added">their fruits</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hewn…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">withered away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now will I rise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07426" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">now will I be exalted</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">now will I lift up</w> myself.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall conceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02842">chaff</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07179">stubble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07307">your breath</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall devour</w> you.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> shall be <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04955">the burnings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07875">of lime</w>: <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06975">thorns</w> <w lemma="strong:H03683" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">cut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they be burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, ye <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what I have done</w>; and, ye <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">acknowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">my might</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02400">The sinners</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are afraid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07461">fearfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath surprised</w> <w lemma="strong:H02611">the hypocrites</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who among us shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with the devouring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who among us shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">with everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H04168">burnings</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 33:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">righteously</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04339">uprightly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that despiseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">the gain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04642">of oppressions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05287" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that shaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from holding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">of bribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0331" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">that stoppeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">his ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from hearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and shutteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from seeing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>righteously</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in righteousnesses</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>uprightly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">uprightnesses</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>oppressions</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">deceits</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">on high</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04869">his place of defence</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04679">the munitions</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of rocks</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">him; his waters</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">sure</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>high</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heights</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">high places</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">in his beauty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">that is very far off</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of far distances</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall meditate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0367">terror</w>. Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>? where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the receiver</w>? where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">the towers</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>receiver</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">weigher?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03267" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06012">of a deeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">than thou canst perceive</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of a stammering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w>, <transChange type="added">that thou canst</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0998">not understand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stammering</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ridiculous</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Look</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">upon Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07151">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of our solemnities</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07600">a quiet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">habitation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">a tabernacle</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06813" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not be taken down</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03489">not one of the stakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">thereof shall ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be removed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02256">neither shall any of the cords</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thereof be broken</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0117">But there the glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto us a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H07342">of broad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">rivers</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02975">streams</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherein shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01077">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H0590">galley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07885">with oars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0117">neither shall gallant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06716">ship</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pass</w> thereby.<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">broad of spaces</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">hands</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">our judge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">our lawgiver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">our king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he will save</w> us.<note type="study"><catchWord>lawgiver</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">statutemaker</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02256">Thy tacklings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are loosed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03653">they could not well</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08650">their mast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they could not spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">the sail</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05706">then is the prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H04766">of a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">divided</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06455">the lame</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">the prey</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Thy…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">They have forsaken thy tacklings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07934">And the inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am sick</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwell</w> therein <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">forgiven</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 33." eID="gen763" osisID="Isa.33"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">ye nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and hearken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03816">ye people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">let the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04393">and all that is therein</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08398">the world</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06631">and all things that come forth</w> of it.<note type="study"><catchWord>all that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the fulness thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07110">For the indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">upon all nations</w>, and <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02534">fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">upon all their armies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath utterly destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, he hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02874">them to the slaughter</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02491">Their slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">also shall be cast out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0889">and their stink</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06297">out of their carcases</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be melted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with their blood</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04743" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be dissolved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">and the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be rolled together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">as a scroll</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06635">and all their host</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05929">as the leaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">falleth off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">from the vine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and as a falling</w> <transChange type="added">fig</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08384">from the fig tree</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02719">For my sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07301" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall be bathed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in heaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">behold, it shall come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">upon Idumea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and upon the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">of my curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">to judgment</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02719">The sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01878" morph="strongMorph:TH8719">it is made fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">with fatness</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03733">of lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06260">and goats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">with the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">of the kidneys</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of rams</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">hath a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01224">in Bozrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02874">slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Idumea</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07214">And the unicorns</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">with them, and the bullocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H047">with the bulls</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">and their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07301" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall be soaked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06083">and their dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H01878" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">made fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">with fatness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unicorns</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">rhinocerots</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>soaked</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">drunken</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:8
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05359">vengeance</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H07966">of recompences</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">for the controversy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05158">And the streams</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thereof shall be turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02203">into pitch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06083">and the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H01614">thereof into brimstone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thereof shall become burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02203">pitch</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">It shall not be quenched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">night</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">nor day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06227">the smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof shall go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01755">from generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall lie waste</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none shall pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">it for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">and ever</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06893">But the cormorant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07090">and the bittern</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H03244">it; the owl</w> <w lemma="strong:H06158">also and the raven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in it: and he shall stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06957">upon it the line</w> <w lemma="strong:H08414">of confusion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068">and the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0922">of emptiness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cormorant</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pelican</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall call</w> <w lemma="strong:H02715">the nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">thereof to the kingdom</w>, but none <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">there, and all her princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">shall be nothing</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05518">And thorns</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">in her palaces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07057">nettles</w> <w lemma="strong:H02336">and brambles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">in the fortresses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">thereof: and it shall be an habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">of dragons</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02681">a court</w> <w lemma="strong:H03284 strong:H01323">for owls</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>owls</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ostriches</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">daughters of the owl</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06728">The wild beasts of the desert</w> <w lemma="strong:H06298" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall also meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0338">with the wild beasts of the island</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08163">and the satyr</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to his fellow</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03917">the screech owl</w> <w lemma="strong:H07280" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">also shall rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there, and find</w> <w lemma="strong:H04494">for herself a place of rest</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The wild beasts of the desert</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Ziim</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the wild beasts of the island</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Ijim</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>screech…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">night monster</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07091">There shall the great owl</w> <w lemma="strong:H07077" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">make her nest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and lay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hatch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01716" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">under her shadow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01772">there shall the vultures</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">also be gathered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07468">with her mate</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Seek ye out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and read</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">no one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">of these</w> <w lemma="strong:H05737" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall fail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">none</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall want</w> <w lemma="strong:H07468">her mate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">for my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">it hath commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and his spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">it hath gathered</w> them.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he hath cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">the lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">for them, and his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H06957">it unto them by line</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">it for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01755">from generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they dwell</w> therein. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 34." eID="gen764" osisID="Isa.34"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04057">The wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06723">and the solitary place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">for them; and the desert</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and blossom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02261">as the rose</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">It shall blossom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">abundantly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01525">even with joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07444" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and singing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03519">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">unto it, the excellency</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">of Carmel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08289">and Sharon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01926">the excellency</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07504">ye the weak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and confirm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the feeble</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">knees</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> to them <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of a fearful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not: behold, your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will come</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05359">vengeance</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01576">a recompence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he will come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and save</w> you.<note type="study"><catchWord>fearful</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hasty</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Then the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05787">of the blind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be opened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">and the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H02795">of the deaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be unstopped</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06455">Then shall the lame</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01801" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">leap</w> <w lemma="strong:H0354">as an hart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">and the tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0483">of the dumb</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04057">for in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">shall waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">break out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">and streams</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the desert</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08273">And the parched ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H098">shall become a pool</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06774">and the thirsty land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04002">springs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05116">in the habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">of dragons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07258">where each lay</w>, <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02682">grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">with reeds</w> <w lemma="strong:H01573">and rushes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>grass…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a court for reeds</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04547">And an highway</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">shall be there, and a way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and it shall be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of holiness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02931">the unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not pass over</w> it; but it <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for those: the wayfaring men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0191">though fools</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not err</w> <transChange type="added">therein</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>but…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for he shall be with them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0738">No lion</w> shall be there, nor <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06530">ravenous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thereon, it shall not be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">there; but the redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall walk</w> <transChange type="added">there</transChange>:

verses.name: Isaiah 35:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">And the ransomed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">to Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">with songs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">and everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon their heads</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they shall obtain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">and gladness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03015">and sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0585">and sighing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall flee away</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 35." eID="gen765" osisID="Isa.35"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">Now it came to pass in the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05576">Sennacherib</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">against all the defenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> them.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:2
