verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07262">Rabshakeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">from Lachish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02426">army</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08585">by the conduit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">of the upper</w> <w lemma="strong:H01295">pool</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">in the highway</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the fuller’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0471">unto him Eliakim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02518">Hilkiah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">which was over the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07644">and Shebna</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03098">and Joah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0623">Asaph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">the recorder</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>scribe</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">secretary</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07262">And Rabshakeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">ye now to Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0986">What confidence</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this wherein thou trustest</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I say</w>, <transChange type="added">sayest thou</transChange>, (but <transChange type="added">they are but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>) <transChange type="added">I have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06098">counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">and strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">for war</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">now on whom dost thou trust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou rebellest</w> against me?<note type="study"><catchWord>vain…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a word of lips</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>I have…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">but counsel and strength are for the war</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Lo, thou trustest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04938">in the staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of this broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">on Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">whereon if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">lean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">into his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and pierce</w> it: so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to all that trust</w> in him.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to me, We trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>: <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01116">not he, whose high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">and whose altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath taken away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">to Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Ye shall worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">this altar</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Now therefore give pledges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">I pray thee, to my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thee two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">on thy part to set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">riders</w> upon them.<note type="study"><catchWord>pledges</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hostages</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">How then wilt thou turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06346">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">of the least</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put thy trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">on Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">for chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">and for horsemen</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And am I now come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01107">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">against this land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it? the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">against this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and destroy</w> it.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0471">Eliakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H07644">and Shebna</w> <w lemma="strong:H03098">and Joah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07262">unto Rabshakeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">I pray thee, unto thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0762">in the Syrian language</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for we understand</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03066">not to us in the Jews’ language</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02346">on the wall</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07262">But Rabshakeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">Hath my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">me to thy master</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to thee to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w>? <transChange type="added">hath he</transChange> not <transChange type="added">sent me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">to the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06675 strong:H02716" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">their own dung</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H07890 strong:H07272 strong:H04325" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">their own piss</w> with you?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07262">Then Rabshakeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03066">in the Jews’ language</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">ye the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02396">Let not Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you: for he shall not be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> you.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02396">Neither let Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">make you trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">us: this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">not to Hezekiah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Make</w> <transChange type="added">an agreement</transChange> with me <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01293">a present</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to me: and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">of his vine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">of his fig tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">of his own cistern</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>Make…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Seek my favour by a present</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Make with me a blessing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Until I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take you away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">like your own land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">of corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">and wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">and vineyards</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Beware</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02396">lest Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">persuade</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">us. Hath any</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">his land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:19
verses.text: Where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0774">and Arphad</w>? where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05617">of Sepharvaim</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and have they delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of my hand</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:20
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">are they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">among all the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of these lands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that have delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of my hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">should deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of my hand</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">But they held their peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him not a word</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Answer</w> him not.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0471">Eliakim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">of Hilkiah</w>, that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over the household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07644">and Shebna</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03098">and Joah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">the recorder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02396">to Hezekiah</w> with <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0899">clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">rent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07262">of Rabshakeh</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 36." eID="gen766" osisID="Isa.36"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And it came to pass, when king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">himself with sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0471">Eliakim</w>, who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over the household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07644">and Shebna</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">with sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03470">unto Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0531">of Amoz</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">This day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08433">and of rebuke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05007">and of blasphemy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04866">to the birth</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">not strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bring forth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blasphemy</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">provocation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">It may be the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07262">of Rabshakeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">his master</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will reprove</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath heard</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherefore lift up</w> <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08605">prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">for the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that is left</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>left</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">So the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">to Isaiah</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03470">And Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Thus shall ye say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto your master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Be not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast heard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">wherewith the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H01442" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have blasphemed</w> me.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">a blast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon him, and he shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">a rumour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to his own land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cause him to fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in his own land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>send…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">put a spirit into him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07262">So Rabshakeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">warring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03841">against Libnah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he had heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he was departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">from Lachish</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H08640">concerning Tirhakah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">of Ethiopia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He is come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to make war</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee. And when he heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">to Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shall ye speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">to Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">Let not thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in whom thou trustest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, thou hast heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">what the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to all lands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">by destroying them utterly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and shalt thou be delivered</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 37:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Have the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">them which my fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have destroyed</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01470">Gozan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02771">and Haran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07530">and Rezeph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05729">of Eden</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08515">in Telassar</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 37:13
verses.text: Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0774">of Arphad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05617">of Sepharvaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02012">Hena</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05755">and Ivah</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 37:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02396">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">received</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">of the messengers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and read</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">it: and Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02396">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwellest</w> <transChange type="added">between</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03742">the cherubims</w>, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04467">thou alone, of all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">open</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05576">of Sennacherib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0551">Of a truth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have laid waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and their countries</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>nations</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lands</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And have cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">into the fire</w>: for they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">no gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">but the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">and stone</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">therefore they have destroyed</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>cast</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">given</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Now therefore, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">us from his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">that all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may know</w> that thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> thou only.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03470">Then Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0531">of Amoz</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">unto Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">Whereas thou hast prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05576">to me against Sennacherib</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 37:22
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">concerning him; The virgin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath despised</w> thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">laughed thee to scorn</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath shaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">her head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">at thee</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Whom hast thou reproached</w> <w lemma="strong:H01442" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and blasphemed</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and against whom hast thou exalted</w> <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">on high</w>? <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">against the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">By</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hast thou reproached</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hast said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">By the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of my chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">am I come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">to the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03411">to the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">the tall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedars</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04005">the choice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01265">fir trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof: and I will enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">into the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">of his border</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03293">the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">of his Carmel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>By thy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">By the hand of thy servants</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the tall…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the tallness of the cedars thereof and the choice of the fir trees thereof</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the forest…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the forest and his fruitful field</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06979" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have digged</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03709">and with the sole</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">of my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">have I dried up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">all the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04693">of the besieged places</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>besieged</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fenced and closed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast thou not heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">long ago</w>, <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have done</w> it; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">it? now have I brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07582" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">defenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <transChange type="added">into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05327" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">ruinous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">heaps</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hast…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hast thou not heard how I have made it long ago, and formed it of ancient times? should I now bring it to be laid waste, and defenced cities to be ruinous heaps?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Therefore their inhabitants</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07116">of small</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they were dismayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and confounded</w>: they were <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06212">the grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03419">the green</w> <w lemma="strong:H01877">herb</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02682">the grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">on the housetops</w>, and <transChange type="added">as corn</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07709">blasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07054">it be grown up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of small…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">short of hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thy abode</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and thy going out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and thy coming in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">and thy rage</w> against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>abode</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sitting</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">Because thy rage</w> <w lemma="strong:H07600">against me, and thy tumult</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">into mine ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore will I put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02397">my hook</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in thy nose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04964">and my bridle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">in thy lips</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will turn thee back</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">by which thou camest</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:30
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, Ye shall eat</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05599">such as groweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of itself; and the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H07823">that which springeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">of the same: and in the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, and reap</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> thereof.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">that is escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall again</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">take root</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">downward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">upward</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>the remnant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the escaping of the house of Judah that remaineth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03389">For out of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">a remnant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06413">and they that escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">out of mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07068">the zeal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall do</w> this.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the escaping</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">concerning the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">nor shoot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">an arrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">there, nor come before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">it with shields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05550">a bank</w> against it.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">By the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by the same shall he return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01598" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I will defend</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">it for mine own sake, and for my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> sake.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">Then the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of the Assyrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">a hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">and fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and when they arose early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, behold, they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">all dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H06297">corpses</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:37
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05576">So Sennacherib</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05210">at Nineveh</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">And it came to pass, as he was worshipping</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05268">of Nisroch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0152">that Adrammelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H08272">and Sharezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">him with the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and they escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0780">of Armenia</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0634">and Esar–haddon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.<note type="study"><catchWord>Armenia</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Ararat</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 37." eID="gen767" osisID="Isa.37"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">was Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sick</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto death</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03470">And Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0531">of Amoz</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">Set thine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">in order</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">for thou shalt die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not live</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Set…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Give charge concerning thy house</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02396">Then Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">toward the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 38:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">now, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0577">I beseech</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">thee, how I have walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">thee in truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">and with a perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have done</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02396">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065 strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">sore</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sore</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with great weeping</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Then came the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">to Isaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 38:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">to Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">thy prayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">thy tears</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, I will add</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto thy days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">fifteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">thee and this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01598" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will defend</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:7
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto thee from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he hath spoken</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 38:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of the degrees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which is gone down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">in the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">dial</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">of Ahaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">degrees</w> <w lemma="strong:H0322">backward</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08121">So the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">degrees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04609">by which degrees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it was gone down</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sun dial</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">degrees by</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">with the sun</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04385">The writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">of Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he had been sick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was recovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">of his sickness</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 38:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01824">in the cutting off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of my days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">to the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">of the grave</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">I am deprived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">of the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of my years</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I shall not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03050">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I shall behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">no more with the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02309">of the world</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01755">Mine age</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and is removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07473">from me as a shepherd’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">tent</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07088" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0707" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like a weaver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">my life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01214" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he will cut me off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01803">with pining sickness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">from day</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03915">to night</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">wilt thou make an end</w> of me.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from the thrum</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I reckoned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">till morning</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0738">as a lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">so will he break</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">all my bones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">from day</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03915">to night</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">wilt thou make an end</w> of me.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05483">Like a crane</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05693">a swallow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06850" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">so did I chatter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I did mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">as a dove</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01809" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fail</w> <transChange type="added">with looking</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04791">upward</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06234">I am oppressed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">undertake</w> for me.<note type="study"><catchWord>undertake…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ease me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">What shall I say</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath both spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, and himself hath done</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H01718" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">I shall go softly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">all my years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">in the bitterness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of my soul</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, by these <transChange type="added">things men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w>, and in all these <transChange type="added">things is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of my spirit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so wilt thou recover</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">me, and make me to live</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07965">Behold, for peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H04843 strong:H04751" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I had great bitterness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02836" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but thou hast in love</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">to my soul</w> <transChange type="added">delivered it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07845">from the pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01097">of corruption</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for thou hast cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">all my sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01460">thy back</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for peace…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">on my peace came great bitterness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>thou hast in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thou hast loved my soul from the pit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07585">For the grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cannot praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">thee, death</w> can <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">celebrate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee: they that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">into the pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07663" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">cannot hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">for thy truth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">The living</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">the living</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall praise</w> thee, as I <transChange type="added">do</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">thy truth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">was ready</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05058">me: therefore we will sing my songs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05059" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to the stringed instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of our life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03470">For Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01690">a lump</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">of figs</w>, and lay <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04799" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for a plaister</w> <w lemma="strong:H07822">upon the boil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall recover</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also had said</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">the sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I shall go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 38." eID="gen768" osisID="Isa.38"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 39:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">At that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04757">Merodach–baladan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01081">of Baladan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">and a present</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">to Hezekiah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he had heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had been sick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was recovered</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02396">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of them, and shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">them the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05238">of his precious things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and the gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01314">and the spices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and the precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">ointment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">of his armour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and all that was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">in his treasures</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">there was nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04475">nor in all his dominion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02396">that Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shewed</w> them not.<note type="study"><catchWord>precious things</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spicery</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>armour</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">jewels</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vessels</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">instruments</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 39:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, What said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">these men</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0370">and from whence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">they unto thee? And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">from a far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w> unto me, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0894">from Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he, What have they seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thine house</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02396">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, All that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in mine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have they seen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">there is nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">among my treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I have not shewed</w> them.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">to Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 39:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, that all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thine house</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">which thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0686" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have laid up in store</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">until this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall issue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">from thee, which thou shalt beget</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they take away</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05631">and they shall be eunuchs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">in the palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">to Isaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">Good</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which thou hast spoken</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">moreover, For there shall be peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in my days</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 39." eID="gen769" osisID="Isa.39"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">ye, comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">ye my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">ye comfortably</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">unto her, that her warfare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is accomplished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">that her iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is pardoned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for she hath received</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03718">double</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for all her sins</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>comfortably</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to the heart</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>warfare</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">appointed time</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06963">The voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that crieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ye the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">make straight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the desert</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">a highway</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">for our God</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01516">Every valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be exalted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and every mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">and hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be made low</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06121">and the crooked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04334">shall be made straight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07406">and the rough places</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">plain</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>straight</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a straight place</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>plain</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a plain place</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03519">And the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be revealed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">and all flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">for the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">The voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Cry</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What shall I cry</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01320">All flesh</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02682">grass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02617">and all the goodliness</w> thereof <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06731">as the flower</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 40:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02682">The grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">withereth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06731">the flower</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fadeth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07307">because the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05380" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bloweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0403">upon it: surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02682">grass</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02682">The grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">withereth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06731">the flower</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fadeth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">but the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06726">O Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that bringest good tidings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01364">into the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03389">O Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that bringest good tidings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thy voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">with strength</w>; lift <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not afraid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">Behold your God</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>O Zion…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">O thou that tellest good tidings to Zion</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>O Jerusalem…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">O thou that tellest good tidings to Jerusalem</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Behold, the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">with strong</w> <transChange type="added">hand</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02220">and his arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">for him: behold, his reward</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06468">with him, and his work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>with strong…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">against the strong</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>his work</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">recompence for his work</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">his flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like a shepherd</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he shall gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H02922">the lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">with his arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and carry</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02436">in his bosom</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05095" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall gently lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05763" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">those that are with young</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that give suck</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who hath measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08168">in the hollow of his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and meted out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H02239">with the span</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and comprehended</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07991">in a measure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and weighed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06425">in scales</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H03976">in a balance</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>a measure</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a tierce</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Who hath directed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, or <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06098 strong:H0376">his counsellor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath taught</w> him?<note type="study"><catchWord>his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">man of his counsel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">With whom took he counsel</w>, and <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">instructed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">him in the path</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">him knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">to him the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">of understanding</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>instructed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made him understand</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>understanding</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">understandings?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">Behold, the nations</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04752">as a drop</w> <w lemma="strong:H01805">of a bucket</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and are counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07834">as the small dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03976">of the balance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">behold, he taketh up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H01851">as a very little thing</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03844">And Lebanon</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0369">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">sufficient</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to burn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">nor the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">thereof sufficient</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">All nations</w> before him <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">as nothing; and they are counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">to him less than nothing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08414">and vanity</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">To whom then will ye liken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01823">or what likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will ye compare</w> unto him?

verses.name: Isaiah 40:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02796">The workman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">melteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">a graven image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the goldsmith</w> <w lemma="strong:H07554" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spreadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">it over with gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and casteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07577">chains</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:20
verses.text: He that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05534 strong:H05533" morph="strongMorph:TH8765 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8794">so impoverished</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">that he hath no oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">chooseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">a tree</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07537" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not rot</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">unto him a cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02796">workman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">a graven image</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be moved</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>is so…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is poor of oblation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Have ye not known</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have ye not heard</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">hath it not been told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">you from the beginning</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have ye not understood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04146">from the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 40:22
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02329">upon the circle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> thereof <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02284">as grasshoppers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that stretcheth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H01852">as a curtain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04969" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spreadeth them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">as a tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell in</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>It is…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Him that</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">That bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07336" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to nothing; he maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08414">as vanity</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Yea, they shall not be planted</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">yea, they shall not be sown</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01503">yea, their stock</w> <w lemma="strong:H08327" morph="strongMorph:TH8782">shall not take root</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall also blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon them, and they shall wither</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05591">and the whirlwind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07179">them away as stubble</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">To whom then will ye liken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, or shall I be equal</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">your eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">on high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hath created</w> these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that bringeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">their host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">by number</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he calleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">them all by names</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">by the greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0202">of his might</w>, for that <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0533">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">in power</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">not one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05737" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">faileth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:27
