verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Why sayest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">thou, O Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and speakest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">My way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and my judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">from my God</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 40:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast thou not known</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou not heard</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">the everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the Creator</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">of the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03286" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fainteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, neither is weary</w>? <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02714">no searching</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">of his understanding</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03287">to the faint</w>; and to <transChange type="added">them that have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0202">no might</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he increaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06109">strength</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">Even the youths</w> <w lemma="strong:H03286" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall faint</w> <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be weary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0970">and the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">fall</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 40:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But they that wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall renew</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">strength</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall mount up</w> <w lemma="strong:H083">with wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">as eagles</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall run</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not be weary</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall walk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03286" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not faint</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>renew</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">change</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 40." eID="gen770" osisID="Isa.40"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Keep silence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">before me, O islands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03816">and let the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">renew</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">strength</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them come near</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">then let them speak</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">to judgment</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Who raised up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">the righteous</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04217">from the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">him to his foot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him, and made <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">over kings</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he gave</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06083">as the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">to his sword</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05086" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">as driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07179">stubble</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">to his bow</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the righteous…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">righteousness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He pursued</w> them, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">safely</w>; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0734">by the way</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he had not gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">with his feet</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>safely</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who hath wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and done</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">calling</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">from the beginning</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">the first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0314">and with the last</w>; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> he.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0339">The isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and feared</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07098">the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">drew near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They helped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w>; and <transChange type="added">every one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be of good courage</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Be strong</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02796">So the carpenter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">encouraged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the goldsmith</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that smootheth</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06360">the hammer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01986" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him that smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">the anvil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saying</w>, It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H01694">for the sodering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he fastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04548">it with nails</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it should not be moved</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>goldsmith</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">founder</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>him…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the smiting</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>saying…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">saying of the soder, It is good</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">But thou, Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom I have chosen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">my friend</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Thou</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom I have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">from the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0678">thee from the chief men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, and said</w> unto thee, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and not cast thee away</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> thou not; for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08159" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">with thee: be not dismayed</w>; for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I will strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee; yea, I will help</w> <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee; yea, I will uphold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">thee with the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of my righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Behold, all they that were incensed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against thee shall be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and confounded</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">they shall be as nothing; and they</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">that strive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee shall perish</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they that strive…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the men of thy strife</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and shalt not find</w> them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">them</w> <w lemma="strong:H04695">that contended</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">with thee: they that war</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>them that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the men of thy contention</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the men of thy war</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">will hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">thy right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not; I will help</w> thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08438">not, thou worm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04962">ye men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will help</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and thy redeemer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>men</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">few men</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">thee a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">sharp</w> <w lemma="strong:H04173">threshing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">instrument having</w> <w lemma="strong:H06374">teeth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01758" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt thresh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w>, and beat <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01854" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">small</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H04671">as chaff</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>teeth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mouths</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt fan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">them, and the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall carry them away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05591">and the whirlwind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them: and thou shalt rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shalt glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">in the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">When</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> none, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03956">their tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05405" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">faileth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06772">for thirst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will hear</w> them, <transChange type="added">I</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not forsake</w> them.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will open</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08205">in high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04599">and fountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">of the valleys</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H098">a pool</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06723">and the dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04161">springs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">the cedar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07848">the shittah tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01918">and the myrtle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and the oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the desert</w> <w lemma="strong:H01265">the fir tree</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08410">the pine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08391">and the box tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 41:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That they may see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and know</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and consider</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">that the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">this, and the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath created</w> it.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Produce</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">your cause</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06110">your strong</w> <transChange type="added">reasons</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the King</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Produce</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Cause to come near</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:22
verses.text: Let them bring <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us what shall happen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">let them shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the former things</w>, what they <transChange type="added">be</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">the latter end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">of them; or declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">us things for to come</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>consider…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set our heart upon them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the things that are to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">hereafter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may know</w> that ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yea, do good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">or do evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08159" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">that we may be dismayed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and behold</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:24
verses.text: Behold, ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0369">of nothing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06467">and your work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0659">of nought</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <transChange type="added">is he that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">chooseth</w> you.<note type="study"><catchWord>of nothing</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">worse than nothing</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>of nought</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">worse than of a viper</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have raised up</w> <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06828">from the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall come</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04217">from the rising</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">of the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">upon my name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05461">upon princes</w> as <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02563">morter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and as the potter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">treadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02916">clay</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Who hath declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">from the beginning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may know</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06440">and beforetime</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may say</w>, <transChange type="added">He is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w>? yea, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none that sheweth</w>, yea, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none that declareth</w>, yea, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none that heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">your words</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">The first</w> <transChange type="added">shall say</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06726">to Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02009">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02009">behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them: and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">one that bringeth good tidings</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For I beheld</w>, and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w>; even among them, and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">no counsellor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that, when I asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of them, could answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a word</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>answer</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">return</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:29
verses.text: Behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0205">all vanity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04639">their works</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0657">nothing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05262">their molten images</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H08414">and confusion</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 41." eID="gen771" osisID="Isa.41"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">Behold my servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom I uphold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0972">mine elect</w>, <transChange type="added">in whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delighteth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">upon him: he shall bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">to the Gentiles</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall not cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor lift up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">nor cause his voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to be heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">in the street</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">A bruised</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he not break</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03544">and the smoking</w> <w lemma="strong:H06594">flax</w> <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall he not quench</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">unto truth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>smoking</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dimly burning</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>quench</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">quench it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03543" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall not fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor be discouraged</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">till he have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0339">and the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">for his law</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>discouraged</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">broken</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that created</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and stretched them out</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07554" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that spread forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06631">and that which cometh out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of it; he that giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05397">breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">upon it, and spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that walk</w> therein:

verses.name: Isaiah 42:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">thee in righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and will hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">thee for a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">for a light</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the Gentiles</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 42:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To open</w> <w lemma="strong:H05787">the blind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0616">the prisoners</w> <w lemma="strong:H04525">from the prison</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">in darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03608">out of the prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:8
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03519">and my glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08416">neither my praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">to graven images</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">Behold, the former things</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are come to pass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02319">and new things</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">do I declare</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">before they spring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I tell</w> you of them.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">song</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08416">his praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">from the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">to the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04393">and all that is therein</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0339">the isles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the fulness thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04057">Let the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof lift up</w> <transChange type="added">their voice</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">the villages</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06938">Kedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doth inhabit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">let the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06681" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them shout</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">from the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">his praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">in the islands</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">as a mighty man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall stir up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">like a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06873" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yea, roar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">he shall prevail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against his enemies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prevail</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">behave himself mightily</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05769">I have long time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">holden my peace</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I have been still</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0662" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">refrained</w> myself: <transChange type="added">now</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06463" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like a travailing woman</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08074 strong:H05395" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8799">I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07602" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">at once</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>devour</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">swallow</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">sup up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will make waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">and hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and dry up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">all their herbs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">islands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will dry up</w> <w lemma="strong:H098">the pools</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05787">the blind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by a way</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">not; I will lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">them in paths</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have not known</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04285">darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04625">them, and crooked things</w> <w lemma="strong:H04334">straight</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01697">These things</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, and not forsake</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>straight</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">into straightness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05472" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">They shall be turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01322">they shall be greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">in graven images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that say</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">to the molten images</w>, Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our gods</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02795">ye deaf</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and look</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05787">ye blind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that ye may see</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:19
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05787">blind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">but my servant</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02795">or deaf</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">as my messenger</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I sent</w>? who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05787">blind</w> as <transChange type="added">he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">perfect</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05787">and blind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 42:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200 strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8800">Seeing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but thou observest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not; opening</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">the ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he heareth</w> not.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is well pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">for his righteousness’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">sake; he will magnify</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w>, and make <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0142" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">honourable</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:22
verses.text: But this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">robbed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08154" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and spoiled</w>; <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06351" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">all of them snared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970 strong:H02352" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">in holes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">and they are hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03608">in prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0957">they are for a prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and none delivereth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04933">for a spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and none saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Restore</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they are all…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in snaring all the young men of them</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>for a spoil</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a treading</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Who among you will give ear</w> to this? <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">for the time to come</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>for…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for the after time?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H04882 strong:H04933" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">for a spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the robbers</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">did not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02098">he against whom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we have sinned</w>? <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they would</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither were they obedient</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">unto his law</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore he hath poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">upon him the fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of his anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05807">and the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of battle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03857" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and it hath set him on fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet he knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not; and it burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, yet he laid</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">not to heart</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 42." eID="gen772" osisID="Isa.42"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But now thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that created</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">thee, O Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he that formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">thee, O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not: for I have redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, I have called</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by thy name</w>; thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> mine.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou passest through</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w>, I <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05104">with thee; and through the rivers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall not overflow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee: when thou walkest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01119">through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03554" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thou shalt not be burned</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03852">neither shall the flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kindle</w> upon thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:3
verses.text: For I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">thy Saviour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03724">thy ransom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03568">Ethiopia</w> <w lemma="strong:H05434">and Seba</w> for thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03365" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Since thou wast precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thou hast been honourable</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I have loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee: therefore will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">for thee, and people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for thy life</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>life</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">person</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> not: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">with thee: I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">from the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H04628">thee from the west</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 43:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">to the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08486">and to the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Keep not back</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">from far</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and my daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">from the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 43:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03605">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by my name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have created</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">him for my glory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him; yea, I have made</w> him.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05787">the blind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">that have</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02795">and the deaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">that have ears</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">Let all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03816">and let the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be assembled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who among them can declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">this, and shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">us former things</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">their witnesses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may be justified</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or let them hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and say</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">truth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:10
verses.text: Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">my witnesses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom I have chosen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and understand</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">he: before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">me there was no God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">formed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">neither shall there be after</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>no…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">nothing formed of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:11
verses.text: I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> I, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01107">and beside</w> me <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">no saviour</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have declared</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and have saved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I have shewed</w>, when <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">no strange</w> <transChange type="added">god</transChange> among you: therefore ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">my witnesses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Yea, before the day</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> he; and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none that can deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of my hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and who shall let</w> it?<note type="study"><catchWord>let it</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">turn it back?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">your redeemer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">For your sake I have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and have brought down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01281">all their nobles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03778">and the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07440">whose cry</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0591">in the ships</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>nobles</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bars</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:15
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">your Holy One</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the creator</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">your King</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">a way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">in the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05410">and a path</w> <w lemma="strong:H05794">in the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 43:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Which bringeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">the chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">and horse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H05808">and the power</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall not rise</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01846" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are extinct</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are quenched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06594">as tow</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">ye not the former things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">neither consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H06931">the things of old</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">a new thing</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">now it shall spring forth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye not know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it? I will even make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">a way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05104">rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03452">in the desert</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">The beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">me, the dragons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03284 strong:H01323">and the owls</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05104">rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03452">in the desert</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to give drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0972">my chosen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>owls</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ostriches</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">daughters of the owl</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02098">This</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">for myself; they shall shew forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">my praise</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But thou hast not called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">upon me, O Jacob</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but thou hast been weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of me, O Israel</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Thou hast not brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">me the small cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of thy burnt offerings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">neither hast thou honoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">me with thy sacrifices</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have not caused thee to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">with an offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">nor wearied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">thee with incense</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>small…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lambs</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">kids</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">me no sweet cane</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">with money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07301" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">neither hast thou filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">me with the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of thy sacrifices</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but thou hast made me to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">with thy sins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast wearied</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">me with thine iniquities</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>filled…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made me drunk</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">abundantly moistened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:25
verses.text: I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> I, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that blotteth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">thy transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for mine own sake, and will not remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">thy sins</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Put me in remembrance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let us plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou, that thou mayest be justified</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">Thy first</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and thy teachers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have transgressed</w> against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>teachers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">interpreters</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Therefore I have profaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">to the curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01421">to reproaches</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>princes…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">holy princes</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 43." eID="gen773" osisID="Isa.43"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Yet now hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">O Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom I have chosen</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 44:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee, and formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">thee from the womb</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will help</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee; Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">not, O Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03484">and thou, Jesurun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom I have chosen</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For I will pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H06771">upon him that is thirsty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and floods</w> <w lemma="strong:H03004">upon the dry ground</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">upon thy seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01293">and my blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06631">upon thine offspring</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 44:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall spring up</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0996">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H02682">the grass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06155">as willows</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">by the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H02988">courses</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">One shall say</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and another shall call</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and another shall subscribe</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03655" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and surname</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the King</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his redeemer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the first</w>, and I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0314">the last</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01107">and beside</w> me <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">no God</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And who, as I, shall call</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, and set it in order</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for me, since I appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">the ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the things that are coming</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">let them shew</w> unto them.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07297 strong:H07297" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8799">ye not, neither be afraid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have not I told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0227">thee from that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and have declared</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>? ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">even my witnesses</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03426">Is there</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01107">beside</w> me? yea, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">no God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> not <transChange type="added">any</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>God; I</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rock</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They that make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">a graven image</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08414">all of them vanity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and their delectable things</w> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not profit</w>; and they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">their own witnesses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, nor know</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may be ashamed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>delectable</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">desirable</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who hath formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">a god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or molten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">a graven image</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">is profitable</w> <w lemma="strong:H01115">for nothing</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 44:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02270">Behold, all his fellows</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be ashamed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02796">and the workmen</w>, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">let them all be gathered together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them stand up</w>; <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall fear</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02796 strong:H01270">The smith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04621">with the tongs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">both worketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06352">in the coals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fashioneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04717">it with hammers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and worketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">it with the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">of his arms</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07457">yea, he is hungry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03581">and his strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H0369">faileth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he drinketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">no water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03286" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and is faint</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with the tongs</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">with an axe</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06086 strong:H02796">The carpenter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stretcheth out</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06957">rule</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he marketh it out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08279">with a line</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he fitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04741">it with planes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he marketh it out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04230">with the compass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08403">it after the figure</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08597">according to the beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that it may remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">He heweth him down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08645">the cypress</w> <w lemma="strong:H0437">and the oak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">which he strengtheneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">for himself among the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the forest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he planteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0766">an ash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01653">and the rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">doth nourish</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strengtheneth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">taketh courage</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Then shall it be for a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to burn</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02552" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, and warm</w> <w lemma="strong:H05400" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">himself; yea, he kindleth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and baketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, he maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">a god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshippeth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">it a graven image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and falleth down</w> thereto.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He burneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">part</w> <w lemma="strong:H01119">thereof in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02677">with part</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof he eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06740" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he roasteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06748">roast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and is satisfied</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02552" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, he warmeth</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01889">Aha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am warm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0217">the fire</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 44:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07611">And the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof he maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">a god</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06459">his graven image</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he falleth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">unto it, and worshippeth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and prayeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto it, and saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Deliver</w> me; for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">my god</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have not known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor understood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02902" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he hath shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">their eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they cannot see</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03826">their hearts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that they cannot understand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shut</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">daubed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And none considereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>, neither <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">nor understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">part</w> <w lemma="strong:H01119">of it in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, also I have baked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01513">upon the coals</w> <w lemma="strong:H06740" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof; I have roasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and eaten</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">thereof an abomination</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall I fall down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0944">to the stock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of a tree</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>considereth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">setteth to his heart</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the stock…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that which comes of a tree?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He feedeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">on ashes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02048" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">a deceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath turned him aside</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he cannot deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor say</w>, <transChange type="added">Is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08267">not a lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">in my right hand</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 44:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">these, O Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w>; for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have formed</w> thee; thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05382" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thou shalt not be forgotten</w> of me.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have blotted out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05645">as a thick cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06588">thy transgressions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">and, as a cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">thy sins</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me; for I have redeemed</w> thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">O ye heavens</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath done</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">shout</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08482">ye lower parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06476" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">break forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">into singing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">ye mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03293">O forest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and every tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">therein: for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06286" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and glorified</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">himself in Israel</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy redeemer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he that formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">thee from the womb</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that maketh</w> all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that stretcheth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H07554" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">alone; that spreadeth abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> by myself;

verses.name: Isaiah 44:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">That frustrateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">the tokens</w> <w lemma="strong:H0907">of the liars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and maketh diviners</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">mad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0268">backward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01847">and maketh their knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05528" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">foolish</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 44:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">That confirmeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and performeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">of his messengers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">Thou shalt be inhabited</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05892">and to the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Ye shall be built</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">and I will raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">the decayed places</w> thereof:<note type="study"><catchWord>decayed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wastes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">That saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H06683">to the deep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be dry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will dry up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">thy rivers</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 44:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">That saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03566">of Cyrus</w>, <transChange type="added">He is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">my shepherd</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">all my pleasure</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">even saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Thou shalt be built</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01964">and to the temple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Thy foundation shall be laid</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 44." eID="gen774" osisID="Isa.44"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">to his anointed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03566">to Cyrus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">whose right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have holden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07286" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to subdue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him; and I will loose</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">the loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">him the two leaved gates</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08179">and the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be shut</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>have…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">strengthened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03474" type="x-split-343">thee, and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01921" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the crooked places</w> <w lemma="strong:H03474 strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8762">straight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will break in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H05154">of brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cut in sunder</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">the bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 45:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">thee the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">of darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04301">and hidden riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H04565">of secret places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou mayest know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that I, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which call</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by thy name</w>, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:4
