verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">For Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">sake, and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0972">mine elect</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I have even called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thee by thy name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03655" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I have surnamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, though thou hast not known</w> me.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> none else, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">no God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02108">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H0247" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me: I girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, though thou hast not known</w> me:

verses.name: Isaiah 45:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That they may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">from the rising</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">of the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04628">and from the west</w>, that <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0657">none</w> <w lemma="strong:H01107">beside</w> me. I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> none else.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I form</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">the light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and create</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and create</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">do</w> all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07491" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Drop down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">ye heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04605">from above</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07834">and let the skies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pour down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">let the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">open</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let them bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and let righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">spring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have created</w> it.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">unto him that striveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with his Maker</w>! <transChange type="added">Let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02789">the potsherd</w> <transChange type="added">strive</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02789">with the potsherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02563">Shall the clay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to him that fashioneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, What makest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">thou? or thy work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">He hath no hands</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 45:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto him that saith</w> unto <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">What begettest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thou? or to the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What hast thou brought forth</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 45:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his Maker</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me of things to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">concerning my sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06467">and concerning the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">command</w> ye me.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and created</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> upon it: I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">and all their host</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have I commanded</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have raised him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">in righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will direct</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">all his ways</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall build</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">my city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he shall let go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01546">my captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04242">not for price</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">nor reward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>direct</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">make straight</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03018">The labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05505">and merchandise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">of Ethiopia</w> <w lemma="strong:H05436">and of the Sabeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">of stature</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02131">thee; in chains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall come over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and they shall fall down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">unto thee, they shall make supplication</w> unto thee, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">Surely God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in thee; and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> none else, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0657">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0403">Verily</w> thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">that hidest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thyself, O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">the Saviour</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They shall be ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and also confounded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">all of them: they shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">to confusion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02796">makers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06736">of idols</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">with an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">salvation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall not be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">world</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">without end</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that created</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">himself that formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">it; he hath established</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, he created</w> <w lemma="strong:H08414">it not in vain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it to be inhabited</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> none else.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have not spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">in secret</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02822">in a dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">not unto the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H08414">ye me in vain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">I declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04339">things that are right</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yourselves and come</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">draw near</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, ye <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06412">escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have no knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">of their graven image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto a god</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cannot save</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Tell</w> ye, and bring <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">near</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">yea, let them take counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">who hath declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">this from ancient time</w>? <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath told</w> it from that time? <transChange type="added">have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">no God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01107">else beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">me; a just</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and a Saviour</w>; <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0369">none</w> <w lemma="strong:H02108">beside</w> me.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Look</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">unto me, and be ye saved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0657">all the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> none else.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I have sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">by myself, the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of my mouth</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06666">righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01290">That unto me every knee</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">every tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall swear</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:24
verses.text: Surely, shall <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">have I righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">and strength</w>: <transChange type="added">even</transChange> to him shall <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and all that are incensed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against him shall be ashamed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Surely…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Surely he shall say of me, In the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is all righteousness and strength</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>righteousness</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">righteousnesses</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">In the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">shall all the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be justified</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and shall glory</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 45." eID="gen775" osisID="Isa.45"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01078">Bel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">boweth down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05015">Nebo</w> <w lemma="strong:H07164" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stoopeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06091">their idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">were upon the beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and upon the cattle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05385">your carriages</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06006" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">heavy loaden</w>; <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04853">a burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05889">to the weary</w> <transChange type="added">beast</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07164" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They stoop</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">not deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">the burden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">but themselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">into captivity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>themselves</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto me, O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07611">and all the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06006" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">which are borne</w> <transChange type="added">by me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0990">from the belly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">which are carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">from the womb</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 46:4
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">even</transChange> to <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02209">old age</w> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> he; and <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07872">to hoar hairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05445" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I carry</w> <transChange type="added">you</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will bear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05445" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">even I will carry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and will deliver</w> <transChange type="added">you</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">To whom will ye liken</w> me, and make <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">equal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and compare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, that we may be like</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 46:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02107" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">They lavish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03599">out of the bag</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and weigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">in the balance</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a goldsmith</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">it a god</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they fall down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">yea, they worship</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">him upon the shoulder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05445" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and set him in his place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he standeth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04725">from his place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall he not remove</w>: yea, <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, yet can he not answer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">nor save</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">him out of his trouble</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H0377" morph="strongMorph:TH8695">this, and shew yourselves men</w>: bring <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">to mind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O ye transgressors</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the former things</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old</w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> none else; <transChange type="added">I am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0657">none</w> <w lemma="strong:H03644">like</w> me,

verses.name: Isaiah 46:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Declaring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">from the beginning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06924">and from ancient times</w> <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> that are not <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06098">My counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall stand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">all my pleasure</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 46:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Calling</w> <w lemma="strong:H05861">a ravenous bird</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">from the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">that executeth my counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">from a far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">yea, I have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will also bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it to pass; I have purposed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will also do</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of my counsel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H047">unto me, ye stouthearted</w>, that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far from</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">righteousness</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 46:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I bring near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">my righteousness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall not be far off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08668">and my salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall not tarry</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will place</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">my glory</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 46." eID="gen776" osisID="Isa.46"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">in the dust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01330">O virgin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the ground</w>: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03678">no throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for thou shalt no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07390">tender</w> <w lemma="strong:H06028">and delicate</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07347">the millstones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02912" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and grind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07058">meal</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06777">thy locks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02834" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">make bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07640">the leg</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H07785">the thigh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the rivers</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06172">Thy nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be uncovered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02781">yea, thy shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be seen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05359">vengeance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will not meet</w> <transChange type="added">thee as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">our redeemer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01748">thou silent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and get</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">thee into darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for thou shalt no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01404">The lady</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of kingdoms</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I was wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">mine inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into thine hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou didst shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">them no mercy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02205">upon the ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">hast thou very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">heavily</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">laid thy yoke</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou saidst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01404">I shall be a lady</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou didst not lay</w> these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">to thy heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither didst remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">the latter end</w> of it.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore hear</w> now this, <transChange type="added">thou that art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05719">given to pleasures</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwellest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">carelessly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sayest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0657">and none else</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">beside me; I shall not sit</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0490">a widow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07908">the loss of children</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 47:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">But these two</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07281">to thee in a moment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07908">the loss of children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0489">and widowhood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">upon thee in their perfection</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H03785">of thy sorceries</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">for the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06109">abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02267">of thine enchantments</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For thou hast trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">in thy wickedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">None seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">me. Thy wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">and thy knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">it hath perverted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee; and thou hast said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in thine heart</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0657">and none else</w> beside me.<note type="study"><catchWord>perverted…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">caused thee to turn away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07451">Therefore shall evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon thee; thou shalt not know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">from whence it riseth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01943">and mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon thee; thou shalt not be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to put it off</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07722">and desolation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">upon thee suddenly</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not know</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the morning thereof</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>put</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">expiate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02267">now with thine enchantments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">and with the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H03785">of thy sorceries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">wherein</w> <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast laboured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">from thy youth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if so be thou shalt be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to profit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06206" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if so be thou mayest prevail</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Thou art wearied</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">of thy counsels</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08064 strong:H01895" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Let now the astrologers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03556 strong:H02374">the stargazers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">the monthly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">prognosticators</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stand up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and save</w> thee from <transChange type="added">these things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall come</w> upon thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>astrologers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">viewers of the heavens</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the monthly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that give knowledge concerning the months</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07179">Behold, they shall be as stubble</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them; they shall not deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">themselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03852">of the flame</w>: <transChange type="added">there shall</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01513">a coal</w> <w lemma="strong:H02552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to warm</w> at, <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0217">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sit</w> before it.<note type="study"><catchWord>themselves</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their souls</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy merchants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05271">from thy youth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall wander</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">to his quarter</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none shall save</w> thee. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 47." eID="gen777" osisID="Isa.47"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">ye this, O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which are called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and are come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">out of the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and make mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">not in truth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">nor in righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">For they call</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">themselves of the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">themselves upon the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the former things</w> <w lemma="strong:H0227">from the beginning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them; I did</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06597">suddenly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came to pass</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01847">Because I knew</w> that thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07186">obstinate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06203">and thy neck</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01270">an iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01517">sinew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04696">and thy brow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05154">brass</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>obstinate</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hard</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0227">I have even from the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">declared</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thee; before it came to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I shewed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee: lest thou shouldest say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06090">Mine idol</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">them, and my graven image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and my molten image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w> them.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast heard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">all this; and will not ye declare</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">thee new things</w> <w lemma="strong:H06258">from this time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">even hidden things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou didst not know</w> them.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">They are created</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">now, and not from the beginning; even before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when thou heardest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them not; lest thou shouldest say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I knew</w> them.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yea, thou heardest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not; yea, thou knewest</w> not; yea, from that time <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">was not opened</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou wouldest deal very</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">treacherously</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">and wast called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a transgressor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">from the womb</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08034">For my name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">sake will I defer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">mine anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08416">and for my praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02413" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I refrain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">for thee, that I cut thee not off</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have refined</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">thee, but not with silver</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03564">thee in the furnace</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">of affliction</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for silver</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:11
verses.text: For mine own sake, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for mine own sake, will I do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: for how should <transChange type="added">my name</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be polluted</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">my glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto another</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto me, O Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">my called</w>; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> he; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the first</w>, I also <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0314">the last</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also hath laid the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">and my right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02946" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spanned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>: <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I call</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, they stand up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the palm of my right hand hath spread out</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">All ye, assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yourselves, and hear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which among them hath declared</w> these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: he will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">his pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">on Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02220">and his arm</w> <transChange type="added">shall be on</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03778">the Chaldeans</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:15
verses.text: I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I, have spoken</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, I have called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him: I have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">him, and he shall make his way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">prosperous</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye near</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">ye this; I have not spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">in secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">from the beginning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06256">from the time</w> that it was, there <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">I: and now the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and his Spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> me.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy Redeemer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which teacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thee to profit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which leadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee by the way</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shouldest go</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03863">O that</w> <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hadst hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">to my commandments</w>! <w lemma="strong:H07965">then had thy peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">been as a river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and thy righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">as the waves</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 48:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">Thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02344">also had been as the sand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06631">and the offspring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">of thy bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04579">like the gravel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thereof; his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">should not have been cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> me.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go ye forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">ye from the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">with a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">of singing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">ye, tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">this, utter</w> it <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">to the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06770" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they thirsted</w> not <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he led</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">them through the deserts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04325">he caused the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to flow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">out of the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for them: he clave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">also, and the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gushed out</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:22
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">no peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">unto the wicked</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 48." eID="gen778" osisID="Isa.48"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Listen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0339">O isles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto me; and hearken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03816">ye people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07350">from far</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">me from the womb</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04578">from the bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of my mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath he made mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of my name</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02299">like a sharp</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06738">in the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath he hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">me a polished</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">shaft</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0827">in his quiver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath he hid</w> me;

verses.name: Isaiah 49:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> unto me, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06286" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">in whom I will be glorified</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have laboured</w> <w lemma="strong:H07385">in vain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have spent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">my strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H08414">for nought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01892">and in vain</w>: <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0403">surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgment</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06468">and my work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">with my God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my work</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">my reward</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And now, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">me from the womb</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8788" type="x-split-344">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8788" type="x-split-344">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to him, Though Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be not gathered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">yet shall I be glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">shall be my strength</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Though…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">That Israel may be gathered to him, and I may</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">It is a light thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">that thou shouldest be my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H05336 strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8803">the preserved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will also give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">thee for a light</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">to the Gentiles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03444">that thou mayest be my salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">unto the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>It is…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Art thou lighter than that thou shouldest</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>preserved</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">desolations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the Redeemer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">his Holy One</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">to him whom man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0960">despiseth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">to him whom the nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">abhorreth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">to a servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of rulers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">Kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">also shall worship</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that is faithful</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall choose</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>whom man…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that is despised in soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07522">In an acceptable</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee, and in a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">of salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I helped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee: and I will preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">thee for a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cause to inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">heritages</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>establish</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">raise up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">That thou mayest say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">to the prisoners</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go forth</w>; to them that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02822">in darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yourselves. They shall feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04830">and their pastures</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08205">in all high places</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall not hunger</w> <w lemma="strong:H06770" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor thirst</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08273">neither shall the heat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">nor sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">them: for he that hath mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">on them shall lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04002">them, even by the springs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05095" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall he guide</w> them.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">all my mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">a way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04546">and my highways</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be exalted</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, these shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">from far</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06828">and, lo, these from the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">and from the west</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">and these from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05515">of Sinim</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">O heavens</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be joyful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">O earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06476" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and break forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">into singing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">O mountains</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath comforted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and will have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">upon his afflicted</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06726">But Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">me, and my Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath forgotten</w> me.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">Can a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H05764">her sucking child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that she should not have compassion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">on the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of her womb</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, they may forget</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet will I not forget</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from having compassion</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have graven</w> thee upon the palms of <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02346">thy walls</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> before me.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make haste</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">thy destroyers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and they that made thee waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go forth</w> of thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">all these gather themselves together</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> to thee. <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt surely clothe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05716">thee with them all, as with an ornament</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and bind</w> them <transChange type="added">on thee</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03618">as a bride</w> <transChange type="added">doeth</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02723">For thy waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and thy desolate places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02035">of thy destruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03334" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall even now be too narrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">by reason of the inhabitants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and they that swallowed thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be far away</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07923">which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">the other, shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">again in thine ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">The place</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06862">too strait</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">for me: give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to me that I may dwell</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shalt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who hath begotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">me these, seeing I have lost my children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01565">and am desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a captive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and removing to and fro</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and who hath brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">these? Behold, I was left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0375">alone; these, where</w> <transChange type="added">had</transChange> they <transChange type="added">been</transChange>?

verses.name: Isaiah 49:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, I will lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">to the Gentiles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">my standard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and they shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy sons</w> in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02684">arms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and thy daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be carried</w> upon <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03802">shoulders</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>arms</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bosom</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall be thy nursing fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08282">and their queens</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">thy nursing mothers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">they shall bow down</w> to thee with <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">toward the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03897" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and lick up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of thy feet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they shall not be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that wait</w> for me.<note type="study"><catchWord>nursing fathers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">nourishers</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>queens</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">princesses</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04455">Shall the prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">from the mighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06662">or the lawful</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">delivered</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>lawful…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">captivity of the just</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07628">Even the captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall be taken away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04455">and the prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">of the terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be delivered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will contend</w> <w lemma="strong:H03401">with him that contendeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">with thee, and I will save</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy children</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>captives</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">captivity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">them that oppress</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">thee with their own flesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall be drunken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with their own blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06071">as with sweet wine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01320">and all flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">thy Saviour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and thy Redeemer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H046">the mighty One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sweet</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">new</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 49." eID="gen779" osisID="Isa.49"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the bill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of your mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03748">divorcement</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whom I have put away</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05383" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">or which of my creditors</w> <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to whom I have sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">you? Behold, for your iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">have ye sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">yourselves, and for your transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">is your mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">put away</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore, when I came</w>, <transChange type="added">was there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when I called</w>, <transChange type="added">was there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none to answer</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03027">Is my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shortened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at all</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06304">that it cannot redeem</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03581">or have I no power</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01606">behold, at my rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I dry up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">a wilderness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01710">their fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stinketh</w>, because <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">no water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06772">for thirst</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I clothe</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H06940">with blackness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">sackcloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03682">their covering</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">The Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">me the tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03928">of the learned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I should know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05790" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">how to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a word</w> in season to <transChange type="added">him that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03287">weary</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he wakeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">by morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he wakeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">mine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03928">as the learned</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0136">The Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">mine ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I was not rebellious</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05472" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">neither turned away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">back</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01460">my back</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to the smiters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03895">and my cheeks</w> <w lemma="strong:H04803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that plucked off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">the hair: I hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">not my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">from shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H07536">and spitting</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0136">For the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will help</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">me; therefore shall I not be confounded</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore have I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H02496">like a flint</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I shall not be ashamed</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that justifieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me; who will contend</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with me? let us stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>: who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941 strong:H01167">mine adversary</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him come near</w> to me.<note type="study"><catchWord>mine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the master of my cause?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Behold, the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will help</w> me; who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall condemn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01086" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me? lo, they all shall wax old</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">as a garment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06211">the moth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat them up</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03373">among you that feareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that obeyeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that walketh</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02825">darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05051">and hath no light</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">upon his God</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06919" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, all ye that kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w>, that compass <transChange type="added">yourselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0247" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02131">with sparks</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0217">in the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of your fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02131">and in the sparks</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">ye have kindled</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03027">This shall ye have of mine hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04620">in sorrow</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 50." eID="gen780" osisID="Isa.50"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to me, ye that follow after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">ye that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">look</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">unto the rock</w> <transChange type="added">whence</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">ye are hewn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04718">and to the hole</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">of the pit</w> <transChange type="added">whence</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05365" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">ye are digged</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Look</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08283">and unto Sarah</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you: for I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">him alone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and increased</w> him.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he will comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">all her waste places</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">her wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05731">like Eden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06160">and her desert</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">like the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08342">joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">and gladness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">therein, thanksgiving</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02172">of melody</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto me, my people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and give ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">unto me, O my nation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08451">for a law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall proceed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">from me, and I will make my judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07280" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">for a light</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06664">My righteousness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03468">my salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is gone forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02220">and mine arms</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0339">the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">upon me, and on mine arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall they trust</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:6
