verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">your eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">to the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and look</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">beneath: for the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H04414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall vanish away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06227">like smoke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01086" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall wax old</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">like a garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H03644">in like</w> <w lemma="strong:H03654">manner</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03444">but my salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall be for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and my righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be abolished</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto me, ye that know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in whose heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">my law</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">ye not the reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">neither be ye afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01421">of their revilings</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06211">For the moth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">like a garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05580">and the worm</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06785">them like wool</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06666">but my righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall be for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03444">and my salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">from generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to generation</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02220">O arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06924">as in the ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01755">in the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old</w>. <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">thou not it that hath cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H07294">Rahab</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">the dragon</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 51:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">thou not it which hath dried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">deep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04615">the depths</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">a way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">for the ransomed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to pass over</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 51:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Therefore the redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">with singing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">unto Zion</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05769">and everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">joy</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon their head</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they shall obtain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">gladness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">and joy</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03015">sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0585">and mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall flee away</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:12
verses.text: I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> I, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">he that comforteth</w> you: who <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou, that thou shouldest be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of a man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be made</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02682">grass</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 51:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And forgettest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy maker</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that hath stretched forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and laid the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and hast feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">every day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">of the fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H06693" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of the oppressor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">as if</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">he were ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w>? and where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02534">the fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H06693" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of the oppressor</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>were…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">made himself ready</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06808" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The captive exile</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hasteneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that he may be loosed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and that he should not die</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">in the pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">nor that his bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should fail</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:15
verses.text: But I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07280" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01530">whose waves</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">roared</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I have put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and I have covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">thee in the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I may plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and lay the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">unto Zion</w>, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8708">Awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8708">awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">stand up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">O Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which hast drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">of his fury</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast drunken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06907">the dregs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">of the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H08653">of trembling</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> wrung <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04680" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">out</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05095" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">none to guide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">her among all the sons</w> <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she hath brought forth</w>; neither <transChange type="added">is there any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">her by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of all the sons</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">she hath brought up</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">These two</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee; who shall be sorry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07701">for thee? desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07667">and destruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">and the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">and the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">by whom shall I comfort</w> thee?<note type="study"><catchWord>are…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">happened</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>destruction</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">breaking</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05968" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">have fainted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">at the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">of all the streets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08377">as a wild bull</w> <w lemma="strong:H04364">in a net</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04392">they are full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">of the fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01606">the rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of thy God</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">now this, thou afflicted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and drunken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">but not with wine</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 51:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thy Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and thy God</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pleadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the cause of his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have taken out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H08653">of trembling</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06907">the dregs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">of the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">of my fury</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">drink it again</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 51:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But I will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03013" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of them that afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee; which have said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">to thy soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Bow down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may go over</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou hast laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01460">thy body</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">as the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02351">and as the street</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that went over</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 51." eID="gen781" osisID="Isa.51"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">awake</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">thy strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06726">O Zion</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">thy beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">O Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for henceforth there shall no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">into thee the uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">and the unclean</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05287" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">thyself from the dust</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">arise</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">sit down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">O Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">loose</w> <w lemma="strong:H04147">thyself from the bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">of thy neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07628">O captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Ye have sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">yourselves for nought</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and ye shall be redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">without money</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">My people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">aforetime</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">there; and the Assyrian</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">them without cause</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Now therefore, what have I here, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">that my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">for nought</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">over them make them to howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">and my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">every day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8711">blasphemed</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Therefore my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w>: therefore <transChange type="added">they shall know</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">he that doth speak</w>: behold, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> I.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04998" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">How beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">are the feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of him that bringeth good tidings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that publisheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that bringeth good tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">of good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that publisheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">salvation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">unto Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">Thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigneth</w>!

verses.name: Isaiah 52:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Thy watchmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06963">with the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall they sing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">to eye</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06476" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Break forth into joy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02723">ye waste places</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath comforted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02834" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath made bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of all the nations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0657">and all the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">the salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, go ye out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from thence, touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">no unclean</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go ye out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">of her; be ye clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For ye shall not go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02649">with haste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04499">by flight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">you; and the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">your rereward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gather you up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05650">Behold, my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall deal prudently</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall be exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and extolled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and be very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">high</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>deal…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prosper</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">As many</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were astonied</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">at thee; his visage</w> <w lemma="strong:H04893">was so marred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">more than any man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08389">and his form</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">more than the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 52:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">So shall he sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07092" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">their mouths</w> at him: for <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">which had not been told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them shall they see</w>; and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they had not heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8712">shall they consider</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 52." eID="gen782" osisID="Isa.52"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Who hath believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">our report</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02220">and to whom is the arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">revealed</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>report</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">doctrine?</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hearing?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he shall grow up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03126">him as a tender plant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08328">and as a root</w> <w lemma="strong:H06723">out of a dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">ground</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08389">he hath no form</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">nor comeliness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when we shall see</w> him, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">no beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we should desire</w> him.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">He is despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H02310">and rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04341">of sorrows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and acquainted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">with grief</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04564" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and we hid as it were</w> <transChange type="added">our</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">from him; he was despised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and we esteemed</w> him not.<note type="study"><catchWord>we hid…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he hid as it were his face from us</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as an hiding of faces from him</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">from us</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0403">Surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath borne</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">our griefs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05445" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04341">our sorrows</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet we did esteem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">him stricken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and afflicted</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:5
verses.text: But he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8775">wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">for our transgressions</w>, <transChange type="added">he was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">bruised</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for our iniquities</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04148">the chastisement</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of our peace</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02250">upon him; and with his stripes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">we are healed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wounded</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">tormented</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>stripes</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bruise</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06629">All we like sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have gone astray</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we have turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">to his own way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">on him the iniquity</w> of us all.<note type="study"><catchWord>laid…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made the iniquity of us all to meet on him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">He was oppressed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and he was afflicted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet he opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">not his mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">he is brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">as a lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H02874">to the slaughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07353">and as a sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01494" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">her shearers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0481" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is dumb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so he openeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">not his mouth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">He was taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06115">from prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and from judgment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">and who shall declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">his generation</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01504" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for he was cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06588">for the transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">was he stricken</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from prison…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">away by distress and judgment: but</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>was he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was the stroke upon him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">his grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">with the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06223">and with the rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">in his death</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">no violence</w>, neither <transChange type="added">was any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04820">deceit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in his mouth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>death</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">deaths</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet it pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to bruise</w> him; he hath put <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to grief</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">an offering for sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall see</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall prolong</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02656">and the pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thou…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">his soul shall make an offering</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">of the travail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of his soul</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be satisfied</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01847">by his knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">shall my righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">justify</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05445" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">their iniquities</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Therefore will I divide</w> him <transChange type="added">a portion</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">with the great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he shall divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">with the strong</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because he hath poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">unto death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and he was numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with the transgressors</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made intercession</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for the transgressors</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 53." eID="gen783" osisID="Isa.53"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06135">O barren</w>, thou <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">didst not bear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06476" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">break forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">into singing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06670" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and cry aloud</w>, thou <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">didst not travail with child</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07227">for more</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">than the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of the married wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Enlarge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of thy tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and let them stretch forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">the curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of thine habitations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">not, lengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04340">thy cords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03489">thy stakes</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 54:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For thou shalt break forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">and on the left</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02233">and thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the Gentiles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and make the desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to be inhabited</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not; for thou shalt not be ashamed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">neither be thou confounded</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for thou shalt not be put to shame</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thou shalt forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">the shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H05934">of thy youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shalt not remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">the reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0491">of thy widowhood</w> any more.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For thy Maker</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thine husband</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and thy Redeemer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">The God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the whole earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall he be called</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Maker</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Makers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thee as a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and grieved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">in spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">when thou wast refused</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06996">For a small</w> <w lemma="strong:H07281">moment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">thee; but with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I gather</w> thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08241">In a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H07110">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H07281">from thee for a moment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05769">but with everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">will I have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">on thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy Redeemer</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:9
verses.text: For this <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">of Noah</w> unto me: for <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I have sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">that the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">of Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">should no more go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">so have I sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I would not be wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01605" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with thee, nor rebuke</w> thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">For the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall depart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be removed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02617">but my kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">from thee, neither shall the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of my peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be removed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that hath mercy</w> on thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06041">O thou afflicted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05590" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">tossed with tempest</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">not comforted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">behold, I will lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">thy stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06320">with fair colours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lay thy foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05601">with sapphires</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">thy windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H03539">of agates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and thy gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H0688 strong:H068">of carbuncles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and all thy borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">of pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And all thy children</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03928">taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">and great</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">the peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of thy children</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06666">In righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">shalt thou be established</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thou shalt be far</w> <w lemma="strong:H06233">from oppression</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thou shalt not fear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04288">and from terror</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for it shall not come near</w> thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Behold, they shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gather together</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0657">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H04310">by me: whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall gather together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against thee shall fall</w> for thy sake.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have created</w> <w lemma="strong:H02796">the smith</w> <w lemma="strong:H05301" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bloweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06352">the coals</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and that bringeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">an instrument</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">for his work</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I have created</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">the waster</w> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03627">No weapon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">that is formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against thee shall prosper</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03956">and every tongue</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">against thee in judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt condemn</w>. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and their righteousness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 54." eID="gen784" osisID="Isa.54"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Ho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06771">every one that thirsteth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">ye to the waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and he that hath no money</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, buy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and eat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yea, come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">and milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">without money</w> <w lemma="strong:H04242">and without price</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore do ye spend</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> for <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">not bread</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03018">and your labour</w> for <transChange type="added">that which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07654">satisfieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">not</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">diligently</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, and eat</w> ye <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and let your soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06026" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01880">itself in fatness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>spend</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">weigh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">your ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me: hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and your soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall live</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w> with you, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have given</w> him <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">a witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">to the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05057">a leader</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and commander</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">to the people</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, thou shalt call</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">a nation</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">not, and nations</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not thee shall run</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto thee because of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">and for the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06286" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for he hath glorified</w> thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">while he may be found</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">ye upon him while he is near</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 55:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">Let the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0205">and the unrighteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">his thoughts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let him return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he will have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">upon him; and to our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for he will abundantly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">pardon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the unrighteous…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the man of iniquity</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>abundantly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">multiply to pardon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04284">For my thoughts</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04284">not your thoughts</w>, neither <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">your ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:9
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are higher</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">than the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">so are my ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">higher</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">than your ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04284">and my thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">than your thoughts</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01653">For as the rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07950">and the snow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07301" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">not thither, but watereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and maketh it bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that it may give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the sower</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">and bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the eater</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 55:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">So shall my word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be that goeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of my mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall not return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">unto me void</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but it shall accomplish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that which I please</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and it shall prosper</w> <transChange type="added">in the thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whereto I sent</w> it.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For ye shall go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with joy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">and be led forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">with peace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">and the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H06476" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall break forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">you into singing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and all the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H04222" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall clap</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hands</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05285">Instead of the thorn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01265">the fir tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05636">and instead of the brier</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01918">the myrtle tree</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and it shall be to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for a name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">for an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">sign</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be cut off</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 55." eID="gen785" osisID="Isa.55"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">ye judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">justice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03444">for my salvation</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and my righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to be revealed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>judgment</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">equity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">this, and the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">layeth hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">on it; that keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">from polluting</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it, and keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from doing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">any evil</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">Neither let the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">of the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that hath joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">himself to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">hath utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">me from his people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05631">neither let the eunuch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w>, Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03002">a dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">unto the eunuchs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">my sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and choose</w> <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that please</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">me, and take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of my covenant</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 56:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Even unto them will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in mine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">and within my walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">and a name</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">than of sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and of daughters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">them an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that shall not be cut off</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Also the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">of the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that join</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">themselves to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, and to love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">to be his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one that keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">from polluting</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">it, and taketh hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of my covenant</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 56:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Even them will I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">to my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and make them joyful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in my house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">of prayer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05930">their burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">and their sacrifices</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07522">accepted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon mine altar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">for mine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">of prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for all people</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">The Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which gathereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01760" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the outcasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Yet will I gather</w> <transChange type="added">others</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">to him, beside those that are gathered</w> unto him.<note type="study"><catchWord>beside…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to his gathered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02416">All ye beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to devour</w>, <transChange type="added">yea</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">all ye beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">in the forest</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">His watchmen</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05787">blind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are all ignorant</w>, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0483">all dumb</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">dogs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05024" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">bark</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01957" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sleeping</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lying down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">loving</w> <w lemma="strong:H05123" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to slumber</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sleeping</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dreaming</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">talking in their sleep</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:11
verses.text: Yea, <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315 strong:H05794">greedy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">dogs</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">can</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">never have</w> <w lemma="strong:H07654">enough</w>, and they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shepherds</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">cannot understand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they all look</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">to their own way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">for his gain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07097">from his quarter</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>greedy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strong of appetite</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>can…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">know not to be satisfied</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> ye, <transChange type="added">say they</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05433" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we will fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941">ourselves with strong drink</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04279">and to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">shall be as this day</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">abundant</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 56." eID="gen786" osisID="Isa.56"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">perisheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">layeth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">to heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">and merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">taken away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none considering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">that the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <transChange type="added">to come</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>merciful…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">men of kindness</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">godliness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from that which is evil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">into peace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">in their beds</w>, <transChange type="added">each one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">walking</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05228">his uprightness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>enter into</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">go in</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in his…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">before him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">But draw near</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">hither, ye sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06049" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">of the sorceress</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of the adulterer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and the whore</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06026" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Against whom do ye sport</w> <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yourselves? against whom make ye a wide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">draw out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">the tongue</w>? <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03206">ye not children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">of transgression</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">a seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">of falsehood</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 57:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02552" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Enflaming</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">yourselves with idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H07488">under every green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">slaying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">in the valleys</w> <w lemma="strong:H05585">under the clifts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of the rocks</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">among the oaks</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02511">Among the smooth</w> <transChange type="added">stones</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the stream</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">thy portion</w>; they, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01486">thy lot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">even to them hast thou poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">a drink offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Should I receive comfort</w> in these?

verses.name: Isaiah 57:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01364">Upon a lofty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">thy bed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">even thither wentest thou up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifice</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">Behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H04201">also and the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02146">thy remembrance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for thou hast discovered</w> <transChange type="added">thyself to another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">than me, and art gone up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast enlarged</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">thy bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> thee <transChange type="added">a covenant</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with them; thou lovedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">their bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">where</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou sawest</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hewed it for thyself larger than theirs</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>where…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thou providedst room</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07788" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou wentest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with ointment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and didst increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H07547">thy perfumes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and didst send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06735">thy messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and didst debase</w> <transChange type="added">thyself even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07585">unto hell</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thou…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thou respectedst</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou art wearied</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in the greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of thy way</w>; <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saidst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02976" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thou not, There is no hope</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore thou wast not grieved</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>life</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">living</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And of whom hast thou been afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or feared</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03576" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that thou hast lied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast not remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, nor laid</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">to thy heart</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">have not I held my peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">even of old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou fearest</w> me not?

verses.name: Isaiah 57:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">thy righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">and thy works</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for they shall not profit</w> thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When thou criest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06899">let thy companies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">thee; but the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall carry them all away</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall take</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that putteth his trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in me shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 57:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05549" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Cast ye up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05549" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">cast ye up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04383">the stumblingblock</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">out of the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and lofty One</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that inhabiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">eternity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">Holy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">in the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">and holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, with him also <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01793">of a contrite</w> <w lemma="strong:H08217">and humble</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to revive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08217">of the humble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to revive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of the contrite ones</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For I will not contend</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05331">neither will I be always</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wroth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07307">for the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05397">me, and the souls</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have made</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05771">For the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">of his covetousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was I wroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">him: I hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and was wroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went on</w> <w lemma="strong:H07726">frowardly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of his heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>frowardly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">turning away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will heal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him: I will lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him also, and restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H05150">comforts</w> <w lemma="strong:H057">unto him and to his mourners</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I create</w> <w lemma="strong:H05108">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of the lips</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07965">Peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> to <transChange type="added">him that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far off</w>, and to <transChange type="added">him that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will heal</w> him.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">But the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">like the troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when it cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">whose waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cast up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07516">mire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02916">and dirt</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:21
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">no peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">to the wicked</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 57." eID="gen787" osisID="Isa.57"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01627">aloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">not, lift</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">up thy voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">like a trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">their transgression</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">their sins</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>aloud</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with the throat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yet they seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">me daily</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">as a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that did</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">not the ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of their God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of me the ordinances</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of justice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they take delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07132">in approaching</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to God</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 58:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore have we fasted</w>, <transChange type="added">say they</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou seest</w> not? <transChange type="added">wherefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have we afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">our soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou takest no knowledge</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">of your fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">pleasure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and exact</w> <w lemma="strong:H06092">all your labours</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>labours</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">things wherewith ye grieve others</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">griefs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:4
