verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, ye fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">for strife</w> <w lemma="strong:H04683">and debate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0106">with the fist</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">of wickedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall not fast</w> as <transChange type="added">ye do this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">to make your voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to be heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">on high</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ye shall…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ye fast not as this day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06685">Is it such a fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I have chosen</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">for a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w>? <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03721" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0100">as a bulrush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03331" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and to spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">sackcloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">and ashes</w> <transChange type="added">under him</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou call</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">a fast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07522">and an acceptable</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>a day…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to afflict his soul for a day?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06685">not this the fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I have chosen</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to loose</w> <w lemma="strong:H02784">the bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">of wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05425" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to undo</w> <w lemma="strong:H04133">the heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H092">burdens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and to let the oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02670">free</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and that ye break</w> <w lemma="strong:H04133">every yoke</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>the heavy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the bundles of the yoke</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>oppressed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">broken</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06536" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">thy bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07457">to the hungry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and that thou bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04788">that are cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to thy house</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when thou seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06174">the naked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that thou cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">him; and that thou hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">not thyself from thine own flesh</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>cast…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">afflicted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0216">Then shall thy light</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">break forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">as the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0724">and thine health</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall spring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">speedily</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06664">and thy righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">thee; the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be thy rereward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gather thee up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then shalt thou call</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall answer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall say</w>, Here I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">If thou take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04133">of thee the yoke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">the putting forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">of the finger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">vanity</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 58:10
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06329" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou draw out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07457">to the hungry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and satisfy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0216">then shall thy light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">in obscurity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0653">and thy darkness</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06672">as the noonday</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 58:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall guide</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">thee continually</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and satisfy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06710">in drought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and make fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">thy bones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07302">and thou shalt be like a watered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">garden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04161">and like a spring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">whose waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03576" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">fail</w> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>drought</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">droughts</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>fail</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lie</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">deceive</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:12
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">they that shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of thee shall build</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">waste places</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">thou shalt raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04146">the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">and thou shalt be called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01443" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The repairer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">of the breach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">The restorer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">of paths</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell in</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 58:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">If thou turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">thy foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">from the sabbath</w>, <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">doing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">thy pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">on my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and call</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06027">a delight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">honourable</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shalt honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, not doing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thine own ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">nor finding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">thine own pleasure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">nor speaking</w> <transChange type="added">thine own</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 58:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06026" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Then shalt thou delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thyself in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cause thee to ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">upon the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">thee with the heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">for the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 58." eID="gen788" osisID="Isa.58"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02005">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is not shortened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that it cannot save</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0241">neither his ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heavy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that it cannot hear</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 59:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05771">But your iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">have separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">between</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">you and your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and your sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have hid</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from you, that he will not hear</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>have hid</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">have made him hide</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03709">For your hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H01351" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0676">and your fingers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">with iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08193">your lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">your tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath muttered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">perverseness</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">None calleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">for justice</w>, nor <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">pleadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">for truth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H08414">in vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">lies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they conceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">mischief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">They hatch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06848">cockatrice’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01000">eggs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0707" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and weave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05908">the spider’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06980">web</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01000">of their eggs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dieth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02116">and that which is crushed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">breaketh out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0660">into a viper</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cockatrice’</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">adder’s</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>crushed…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sprinkled is as if there brake out a viper</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06980">Their webs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">shall not become garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">neither shall they cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">themselves with their works</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04639">their works</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">works</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06467">and the act</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">of violence</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in their hands</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07272">Their feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">run</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">to evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they make haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04284">their thoughts</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04284">thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07701">wasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">and destruction</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04546">in their paths</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destruction</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">breaking</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they know</w> not; and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">no judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04570">in their goings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06140" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they have made them crooked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">paths</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whosoever goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therein shall not know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>judgment</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">right</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04941">Therefore is judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">from us, neither doth justice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">overtake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">us: we wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">for light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02822">but behold obscurity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05054">for brightness</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">we walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0653">in darkness</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01659" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">We grope</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">for the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05787">like the blind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01659" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and we grope</w> as if <transChange type="added">we had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">no eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we stumble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">at noonday</w> <w lemma="strong:H05399">as in the night</w>; <transChange type="added">we are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0820">in desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">places as dead</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We roar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01677">all like bears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">like doves</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">we look</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">for judgment</w>, but <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03444">none; for salvation</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it is far off</w> from us.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06588">For our transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">before thee, and our sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">testify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">against us: for our transgressions</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with us; and <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">our iniquities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we know</w> them;

verses.name: Isaiah 59:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">In transgressing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05253" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and departing away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H06233">oppression</w> <w lemma="strong:H05627">and revolt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8780">conceiving</w> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8774">and uttering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">from the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">of falsehood</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04941">And judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05253" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">is turned away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">backward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and justice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">standeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0571">for truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the street</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05229">and equity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">enter</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0571">Yea, truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05737" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">faileth</w>; and he <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">departeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8711">maketh himself a prey</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it displeased</w> him that <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">no judgment</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>maketh…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">is accounted mad</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>it displeased…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">it was evil in his eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he saw</w> that <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">and wondered</w> that <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">no intercessor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02220">therefore his arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">unto him; and his righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it sustained</w> him.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08302">as a breastplate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03553">and an helmet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">of salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">the garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05359">of vengeance</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08516">clothing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was clad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">with zeal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">as a cloke</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05921">According to</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01578">deeds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">accordingly he will repay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">to his adversaries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01576">recompence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to his enemies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0339">to the islands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he will repay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01576">recompence</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>deeds</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">recompences</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So shall they fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04628">from the west</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and his glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">from the rising</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">of the sun</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06862">When the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">like a flood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">shall lift up a standard</w> against him.<note type="study"><catchWord>lift…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">put him to flight</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the Redeemer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">to Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and unto them that turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">from transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">in Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:21
verses.text: As for me, this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07307">My spirit</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">upon thee, and my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">nor out of the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of thy seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">nor out of the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of thy seed’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05704">from henceforth and for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 59." eID="gen789" osisID="Isa.59"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">shine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0216">for thy light</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is risen</w> upon thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>shine…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">be enlightened; for thy light cometh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02822">For, behold, the darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06205">and gross darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">upon thee, and his glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be seen</w> upon thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">And the Gentiles</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">to thy light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05051">to the brightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02225">of thy rising</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">all they gather themselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to thee: thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">from far</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and thy daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be nursed</w> at <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06654">side</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372 strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">Then thou shalt see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05102" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and flow together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">and thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be enlarged</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01995">because the abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be converted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">unto thee, the forces</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the Gentiles</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>abundance…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">noise of the sea shall be turned toward thee</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>forces</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wealth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08229">The multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">of camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H01070">thee, the dromedaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w> <w lemma="strong:H05891">and Ephah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07614">all they from Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">and incense</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they shall shew forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">the praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06629">All the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06938">of Kedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">unto thee, the rams</w> <w lemma="strong:H05032">of Nebaioth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee: they shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">with acceptance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">on mine altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06286" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will glorify</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">of my glory</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:8
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> these <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">as a cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03123">and as the doves</w> <w lemma="strong:H0699">to their windows</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 60:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0339">Surely the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">for me, and the ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">of Tarshish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">from far</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">their silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and their gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">with them, unto the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">and to the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06286" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because he hath glorified</w> thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">of strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall build up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">thy walls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and their kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H07110">unto thee: for in my wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">thee, but in my favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have I had mercy</w> on thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08179">Therefore thy gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall be open</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall not be shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nor night</w>; that <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">may bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">unto thee the forces</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the Gentiles</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">their kings</w> <transChange type="added">may be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">brought</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>forces</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wealth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">For the nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">and kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that will not serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee shall perish</w>; yea, <transChange type="added">those</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall be utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wasted</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03519">The glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01265">unto thee, the fir tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08410">the pine tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08391">and the box</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06286" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to beautify</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">of my sanctuary</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04725">and I will make the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">glorious</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">also of them that afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">bending</w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">unto thee; and all they that despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">thee shall bow themselves down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">at the soles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of thy feet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall call</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">thee, The city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06726">The Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">of the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08478">Whereas</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thou hast been forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and hated</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">so that no man went through</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">thee an eternal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">excellency</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04885">a joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou shalt also suck</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">the milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the Gentiles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shalt suck</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">the breast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of kings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">thy Saviour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and thy Redeemer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H046">the mighty One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05178">For brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01270">and for iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and for wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068">and for stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">iron</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will also make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">thy officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and thine exactors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02555">Violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall no more be heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07701">wasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">nor destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">within thy borders</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but thou shalt call</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">thy walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">Salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and thy gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">Praise</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">The sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">shall be no more thy light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">by day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05051">neither for brightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03394">shall the moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">give light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto thee: but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall be unto thee an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">thy glory</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">Thy sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall no more go down</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03391">neither shall thy moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">withdraw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">itself: for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall be thine everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">of thy mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be ended</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Thy people</w> also <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">all righteous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05342">the branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04302">of my planting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of my hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06286" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">that I may be glorified</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06996">A little one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">shall become a thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06810">and a small one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will hasten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">it in his time</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 60." eID="gen790" osisID="Isa.60"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">The Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon me; because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">me to preach good tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06035">unto the meek</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me to bind up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the brokenhearted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01865">liberty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">to the captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06495">and the opening of the prison</w> to <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">bound</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 61:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">the acceptable</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05359">of vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H057">all that mourn</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 61:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H057">unto them that mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06287">unto them beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">for ashes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">the oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">of joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">for mourning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04594">the garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">of praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">for the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03544">of heaviness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">that they might be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04302">the planting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06286" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">that he might be glorified</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall build</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">wastes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">they shall raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">desolations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02318" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and they shall repair</w> <w lemma="strong:H02721">the waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the desolations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">And strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">your flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">of the alien</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0406">your plowmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03755">and your vinedressers</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">But ye shall be named</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the Priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">you the Ministers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">the riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the Gentiles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and in their glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03235" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall ye boast</w> yourselves.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01322">For your shame</w> <transChange type="added">ye shall have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04932">double</w>; and <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03639">confusion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">in their portion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">therefore in their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">the double</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05769">everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">joy</w> shall be unto them.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">love</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01498">robbery</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for burnt offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will direct</w> <w lemma="strong:H06468">their work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">in truth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w> with them.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">And their seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be known</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the Gentiles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06631">and their offspring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them shall acknowledge</w> them, that they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">the seed</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath blessed</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I will greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be joyful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">in my God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for he hath clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">me with the garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03271" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">me with the robe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">of righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02860">as a bridegroom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">decketh</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06287">with ornaments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03618">and as a bride</w> <w lemma="strong:H05710" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">adorneth</w> <transChange type="added">herself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with her jewels</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>decketh</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">decketh as a priest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">For as the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bringeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06780">her bud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01593">and as the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H02221">causeth the things that are sown</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">in it to spring forth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0136">so the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">will cause righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">and praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to spring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">before all the nations</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 61." eID="gen791" osisID="Isa.61"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06726">For Zion’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sake will I not hold my peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and for Jerusalem’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sake I will not rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06664">until the righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05051">as brightness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03444">and the salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03940">thereof as a lamp</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">burneth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">And the Gentiles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">thy righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and all kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">thy glory</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">and thou shalt be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">by a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">which the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">shall name</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05850">Thou shalt also be a crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">of glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04410">and a royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H06797 strong:H06797" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">diadem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of thy God</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Thou shalt no more be termed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Forsaken</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">neither shall thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">any more be termed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">Desolate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">but thou shalt be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02657">Hephzi–bah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Beulah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delighteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in thee, and thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be married</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hephzi–bah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">My delight is in her</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Beulah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Married</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>For <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0970">a young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">marrieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">a virgin</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">shall thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">marry</w> thee: and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02860">the bridegroom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04885">rejoiceth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">over the bride</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">shall thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w> over thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>as the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with the joy of the bridegroom</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">watchmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon thy walls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">O Jerusalem</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">shall never</w> <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hold their peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nor night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">ye that make mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01824">keep not silence</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>make…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">are the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName> remembrancers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01824">him no rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">till he establish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and till he make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">a praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rest</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">silence</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">by his right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02220">and by the arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of his strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0518">Surely I will</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">no more give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">thy corn</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03978">meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for thine enemies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">of the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">thy wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for the which thou hast laboured</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Surely…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">If I give</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">But they that have gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">it, and praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and they that have brought it together</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">it in the courts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of my holiness</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go through</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go through</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gates</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ye the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05549" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">cast up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05549" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">cast up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">the highway</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">gather out</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">the stones</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">a standard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath proclaimed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">unto the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the world</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">ye to the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03468">Behold, thy salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cometh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07939">behold, his reward</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06468">with him, and his work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>work</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">recompence</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall call</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">them, The holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">The redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and thou shalt be called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Sought out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">A city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">not forsaken</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 62." eID="gen792" osisID="Isa.62"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:1
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">this that cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">from Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02556" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">with dyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01224">from Bozrah</w>? this <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01921" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">in his apparel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06808" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">travelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in the greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">of his strength</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">I that speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">in righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to save</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>glorious</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">decked</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:2
verses.text: Wherefore <transChange type="added">art thou</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0122">red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">in thine apparel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">and thy garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like him that treadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01660">in the winefat</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 63:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have trodden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06333">the winepress</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">alone; and of the people</w> <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">none</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with me: for I will tread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">them in mine anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and trample</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">them in my fury</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05332">and their blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">upon my garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01351" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will stain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04403">all my raiment</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05359">of vengeance</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in mine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">and the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of my redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I looked</w>, and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none to help</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">and I wondered</w> that <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none to uphold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02220">therefore mine own arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">unto me; and my fury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it upheld</w> me.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will tread down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in mine anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and make them drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">in my fury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will bring down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05332">their strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">the lovingkindnesses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08416">the praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">according to all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath bestowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">on us, and the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">toward the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath bestowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">on them according to his mercies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">and according to the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of his lovingkindnesses</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he said</w>, Surely they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08266" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will not lie</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">so he was their Saviour</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06869">In all their affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">he was afflicted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">and the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of his presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">them: in his love</w> <w lemma="strong:H02551">and in his pity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05190" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them; and he bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them, and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">them all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But they rebelled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and vexed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">Spirit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">therefore he was turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to be their enemy</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">he fought</w> against them.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that brought them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">out of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with the shepherd</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of his flock</w>? where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> him?<note type="study"><catchWord>shepherd</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shepherds</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">That led</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">by the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">with his glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dividing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">himself an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 63:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">That led</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">them through the deep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">as an horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they should not stumble</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 63:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0929">As a beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">goeth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">into the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">caused him to rest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">so didst thou lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">thyself a glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Look down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02073">from the habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of thy holiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">and of thy glory</w>: where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07068">thy zeal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">and thy strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">the sounding</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">of thy bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">and of thy mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0662" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">toward me? are they restrained</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>the sounding</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the multitude</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03588">Doubtless</w> thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">our father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">though Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045 strong:H03808" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be ignorant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of us, and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">acknowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">us not: thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">our father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">our redeemer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">from everlasting</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>our redeemer…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">our redeemer from everlasting is thy name</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">why hast thou made us to err</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">from thy ways</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07188" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">our heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">from thy fear</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for thy servants’</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">sake, the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of thine inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">The people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of thy holiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have possessed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04705">but a little while</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06862">our adversaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H0947" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">have trodden down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">thy sanctuary</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:19
verses.text: We are <transChange type="added">thine</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05769">thou never</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">barest rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">over them; they were not called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by thy name</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thy name was not called upon them</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 63." eID="gen793" osisID="Isa.63"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03863">Oh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou wouldest rend</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou wouldest come down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">that the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02151" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">might flow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at thy presence</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 64:2
verses.text: As <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02003">the melting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06919" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">burneth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">causeth the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01158" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to boil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">to make thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">known</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">to thine adversaries</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may tremble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at thy presence</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>the melting…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the fire of meltings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When thou didst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">terrible things</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">we looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not for, thou camest down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02151" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">flowed down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at thy presence</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05769">For since the beginning of the world</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have not heard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">nor perceived by the ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">neither hath the eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">seen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02108">beside</w> thee, <transChange type="added">what</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he hath prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H02442" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">for him that waiteth</w> for him.<note type="study"><catchWord>seen…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">seen a God beside thee, which doeth so for him</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou meetest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">him that rejoiceth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and worketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>, <transChange type="added">those that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee in thy ways</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">behold, thou art wroth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for we have sinned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05769">in those is continuance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and we shall be saved</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02931">But we are all as an unclean</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and all our righteousnesses</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05708">as filthy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">rags</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01101 strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8799">and we all do fade</w> <w lemma="strong:H05929">as a leaf</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05771">and our iniquities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">like the wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have taken us away</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:7
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none that calleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">upon thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8711">that stirreth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">himself to take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">of thee: for thou hast hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from us, and hast consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">us, because</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">of our iniquities</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>consumed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">melted</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>because</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But now, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">our father</w>; we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02563">the clay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and thou our potter</w>; and we all <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thy hand</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Be not wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very sore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">behold, see</w>, we beseech thee, we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all thy people</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06944">Thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">are a wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">is a wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">a desolation</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06944">Our holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">and our beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">where our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H08316">thee, is burned up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04261">and all our pleasant things</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">are laid waste</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0662" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Wilt thou refrain</w> thyself for these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou hold thy peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">us very sore</w>? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 64." eID="gen794" osisID="Isa.64"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am sought</w> of <transChange type="added">them that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">not</w> <transChange type="added">for me</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am found</w> of <transChange type="added">them that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">me not</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">Behold me, behold me, unto a nation</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was not called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by my name</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have spread out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05637" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto a rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in a way</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">their own thoughts</w>;

verses.name: Isaiah 65:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">A people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that provoketh me to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to my face</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sacrificeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01593">in gardens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and burneth incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H03843">upon altars of brick</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>upon…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon bricks</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Which remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">among the graves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">in the monuments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02386">swine’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06564 strong:H04839" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and broth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06292">of abominable</w> <transChange type="added">things is in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">their vessels</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>broth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pieces</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Which say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by thyself, come not near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to me; for I am holier</w> than thou.
