These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06227">a smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in my nose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03344" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that burneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>nose</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">anger</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:6
verses.text: Behold, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me: I will not keep silence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">but will recompense</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">even recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">into their bosom</w>,

verses.name: Isaiah 65:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05771">Your iniquities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">and the iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which have burned incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and blasphemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">me upon the hills</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore will I measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">their former</w> <w lemma="strong:H06468">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">into their bosom</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">As the new wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0811">in the cluster</w>, and <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">it not; for a blessing</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in it: so will I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for my servants’</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">sakes, that I may not destroy</w> them all.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">a seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">out of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and out of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">an inheritor</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of my mountains</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0972">and mine elect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">it, and my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> there.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08289">And Sharon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">shall be a fold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06010">and the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H05911">of Achor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">a place for the herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07258">to lie down in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">for my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that have sought</w> me.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>But ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07913">that forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">a table</w> <w lemma="strong:H01408 strong:H01409" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">for that troop</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and that furnish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04469">the drink offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04507">unto that number</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>troop</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Gad</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>number</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Meni, a pagan god</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore will I number</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">you to the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall all bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02874">to the slaughter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because when I called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye did not answer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">when I spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye did not hear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and did choose</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein I delighted</w> not.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Behold, my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but ye shall be hungry</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05650">behold, my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06770" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but ye shall be thirsty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05650">behold, my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but ye shall be ashamed</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 65:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">Behold, my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">for joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but ye shall cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03511">for sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall howl</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">for vexation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of spirit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>vexation</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">breaking</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And ye shall leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">your name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">for a curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0972">unto my chosen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0136">for the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, and call</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">by another</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>:

verses.name: Isaiah 65:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">That he who blesseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">himself in the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">himself in the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0543">of truth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and he that sweareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">by the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0543">of truth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07223">because the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">troubles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are forgotten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and because they are hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">from mine eyes</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For, behold, I create</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">new</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">and a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07223">and the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be remembered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">into mind</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>come…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">come upon the heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">But be ye glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w> <transChange type="added">in that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I create</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for, behold, I create</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01525">a rejoicing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and her people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04885">a joy</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">in my people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">of weeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be no more heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">in her, nor the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02201">of crying</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05764">There shall be no more thence an infant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">nor an old man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that hath not filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">his days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05288">for the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but the sinner</w> <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be accursed</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and inhabit</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> of them.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall not build</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0312">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">inhabit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall not plant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0312">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for as the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of a tree</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0972">and mine elect</w> <w lemma="strong:H01086" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall long enjoy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their hands</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall long…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall make them continue long</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">shall wear out</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall not labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07385">in vain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0928">for trouble</w>; for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of the blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06631">and their offspring</w> with them.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it shall come to pass, that before they call</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will answer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and while they are yet speaking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will hear</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02061">The wolf</w> <w lemma="strong:H02924">and the lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0738">and the lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08401">straw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">like the bullock</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06083">and dust</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05175">the serpent’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">meat</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They shall not hurt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">nor destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in all my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 65." eID="gen795" osisID="Isa.65"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">The heaven</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03678">my throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01916 strong:H07272">my footstool</w>: where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye build</w> unto me? and where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04496">of my rest</w>?

verses.name: Isaiah 66:2
verses.text: For all those <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hath mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w>, and all those <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">have been, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: but to this <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I look</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> to <transChange type="added">him that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06041">poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05223">and of a contrite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02730">and trembleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">at my word</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that killeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">an ox</w> <transChange type="added">is as if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that sacrificeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">a lamb</w>, <transChange type="added">as if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06202" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-345">he cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">a dog’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06202" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-345">neck</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that offereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">an oblation</w>, <transChange type="added">as if he offered</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02386">swine’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that burneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">incense</w>, <transChange type="added">as if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">he blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">an idol</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yea, they have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">their own ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and their soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delighteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">in their abominations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lamb</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">kid</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>burneth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">maketh a memorial of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I also will choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H08586">their delusions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04035">their fears</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon them; because when I called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none did answer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">when I spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they did not hear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but they did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and chose</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in which I delighted</w> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>delusions</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">devices</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02730">ye that tremble</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">at his word</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0251">Your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H05077" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">you, that cast you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for my name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sake, said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Let the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be glorified</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">but he shall appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">to your joy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall be ashamed</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">A voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07588">of noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">from the temple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that rendereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01576">recompence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to his enemies</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Before she travailed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she brought forth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02256">before her pain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">she was delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">of a man child</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who hath heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">such a thing? who hath seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">such things? Shall the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be made to bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>? <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">shall a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be born</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">at once</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01571">for as soon as</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">travailed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">her children</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Shall I bring to the birth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and not cause to bring forth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0589">shall I</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">cause to bring forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shut</w> <transChange type="added">the womb</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>not…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">not beget?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">ye with Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with her, all ye that love</w> <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">her: rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04885">for joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">with her, all ye that mourn</w> for her:

verses.name: Isaiah 66:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That ye may suck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">with the breasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H08575">of her consolations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04711" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye may milk out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06026" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and be delighted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02123">with the abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of her glory</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>abundance</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">brightness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will extend</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">to her like a river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the Gentiles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like a flowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">stream</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shall ye suck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">ye shall be borne</w> upon <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06654">sides</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08173" morph="strongMorph:TH8746">and be dandled</w> upon <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01290">knees</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">As one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">whom his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">comforteth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">so will I comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">you; and ye shall be comforted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And when ye see</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">your heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">and your bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall flourish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01877">like an herb</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">and the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be known</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">toward his servants</w>, and <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02194" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">toward his enemies</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For, behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04818">and with his chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H05492">like a whirlwind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to render</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">with fury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01606">and his rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03851">with flames</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">For by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">and by his sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">will the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">with all flesh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02491">and the slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be many</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">They that sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">themselves, and purify</w> <w lemma="strong:H01593">themselves in the gardens</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <transChange type="added">tree</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">eating</w> <w lemma="strong:H02386">swine’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08263">and the abomination</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05909">and the mouse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05486" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>behind…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">one after another</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:18
verses.text: For I <transChange type="added">know</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">their works</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">and their thoughts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that I will gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">and tongues</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">my glory</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">among them, and I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06412">those that escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of them unto the nations</w>, <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08659">Tarshish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06322">Pul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03865">and Lud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">the bow</w>, <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08422">Tubal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03120">and Javan</w>, <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0339">the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that have not heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">my fame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">my glory</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and they shall declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">my glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the Gentiles</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And they shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">all your brethren</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">out of all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">upon horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">and in chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06632">and in litters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06505">and upon mules</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03753">and upon swift beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">to my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">as the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">in a clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>litters</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">coaches</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will also take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of them for priests</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03881">for Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02319">For as the new</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">and the new</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I will make</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">so shall your seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">and your name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remain</w>.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:23
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01767">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">one new moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01767">and from</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">one sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">shall all flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from one new…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from new moon to his new moon, and from sabbath to his sabbath</rdg></note>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall go forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and look</w> <w lemma="strong:H06297">upon the carcases</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that have transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08438">against me: for their worm</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">neither shall their fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be quenched</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01860">and they shall be an abhorring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">unto all flesh</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 66." eID="gen796" osisID="Isa.66"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen730" osisID="Isa" type="book"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">of Hilkiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06068">in Anathoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">To whom the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">came in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0526">of Amon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">in the thirteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of his reign</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">It came also in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H06249">of the eleventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">of Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-346">unto the carrying away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-346">captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">in the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Then the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02962">Before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">thee in the belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee; and before thou camest forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">out of the womb</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I sanctified</w> thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I ordained</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">thee a prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">unto the nations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ordained</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gave</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0162">I, Ah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>! <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">behold, I cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">speak</w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">a child</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, Say</w> not, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">a child</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thou shalt go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to all that I shall send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee, and whatsoever I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee thou shalt speak</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Be not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of their faces</w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">with thee to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Then the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, Behold, I have put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in thy mouth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">I have this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">thee over the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">and over the kingdoms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to root out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to pull down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to destroy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to throw down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to plant</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Moreover the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">what seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou? And I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04731">a rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H08247">of an almond tree</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto me, Thou hast well</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">seen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08245" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for I will hasten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my word</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to perform</w> it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">came unto me the second time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">What seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou? And I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05301" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">a seething</w> <w lemma="strong:H05518">pot</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">and the face</w> thereof <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">the north</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>toward…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from the face of the north</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Then the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">unto me, Out of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall break forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall be opened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For, lo, I will call</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">all the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02346">and against all the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and against all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">against them touching</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all their wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me, and have burned incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their own hands</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0247" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou therefore gird up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">thy loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto them all that I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thee: be not dismayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at their faces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lest I confound</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thee before</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>confound</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">break to pieces</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0589">For, behold, I</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">a defenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01270">and an iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">and brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">against the whole land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">against the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">against the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">thereof, against the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thereof, and against the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And they shall fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against thee; but they shall not prevail</w> against thee; for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">with thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> thee. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen798" osisID="Jer.1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Moreover the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came to me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">thee, the kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of thy youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0160">the love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03623">of thine espousals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou wentest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">me in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in a land</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">not sown</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thee</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for thy sake</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07225">the firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">of his increase</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him shall offend</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">upon them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">ye the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">and all the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05766">What iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">have your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in me, that they are gone far</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from me, and have walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and are become vain</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Neither said</w> they, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that brought us up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that led</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">us through the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">through a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">of deserts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07745">and of pits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">through a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06723">of drought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06757">and of the shadow of death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">through a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">that no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passed through</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">and where no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03759">you into a plentiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">thereof and the goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof; but when ye entered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">ye defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">my land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">mine heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a plentiful…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the land of Carmel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">The priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> not, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that handle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me not: the pastors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">against me, and the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">by Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <transChange type="added">things that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">do not profit</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore I will yet plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">with you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and with your children’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I plead</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">For pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03794">of Chittim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06938">unto Kedar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8708">and consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">diligently</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> if there be such a thing.<note type="study"><catchWord>over</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">over to</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">Hath a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">changed</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">yet no gods</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05971">but my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04171" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">their glory</w> for <transChange type="added">that which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">doth not profit</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be astonished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">O ye heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08175" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">at this, and be horribly afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">be ye very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">For my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evils</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04726">me the fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of living</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">hewed them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0877">cisterns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0877">cisterns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that can hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">no water</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">a servant</w>? <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03211 strong:H01004">he a homeborn</w> <transChange type="added">slave</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H04069">why</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">is he spoiled</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>spoiled</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">become a spoil?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03715">The young lions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">roared</w> upon him, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963 strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yelled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">his land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">waste</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05892">his cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">without inhabitant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>yelled</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gave out their voice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Also the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05297">of Noph</w> <w lemma="strong:H08471">and Tahapanes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06936">the crown of thy head</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>have…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">feed on thy crown</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Hast thou not procured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">when</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he led</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee by the way</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">And now what hast thou to do in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07883">of Sihor</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01870">or what hast thou to do in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">of the river</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">Thine own wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall correct</w> <w lemma="strong:H04878">thee, and thy backslidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall reprove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thee: know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">therefore and see</w> that <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04751">and bitter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou hast forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06345">and that my fear</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">not in thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05769">For of old time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">thy yoke</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">burst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04147">thy bands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou saidst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647 strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">I will not transgress</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01364">when upon every high</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H07488">and under every green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H06808" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou wanderest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">playing the harlot</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>transgress</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">serve</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet I had planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08321">thee a noble vine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0571">wholly a right</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">how then art thou turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05494">into the degenerate plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">of a strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">vine</w> unto me?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">For though thou wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H05427">thee with nitre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and take thee much</w> <w lemma="strong:H01287">soap</w>, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">thine iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03799" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is marked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How canst thou say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am not polluted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baalim</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thy way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">in the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what thou hast done</w>: <transChange type="added">thou art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07031">a swift</w> <w lemma="strong:H01072">dromedary</w> <w lemma="strong:H08308" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">traversing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">her ways</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>thou art…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">O swift dromedary</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06501">A wild ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03928">used</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">to the wilderness</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07602" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">snuffeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315 strong:H0185">at her pleasure</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08385">in her occasion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who can turn her away</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">all they that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03286" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her will not weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">themselves; in her month</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall find</w> her.<note type="study"><catchWord>A wild…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">O wild ass</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>used</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">taught</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>her pleasure</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the desire of her heart</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>turn…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">reverse it?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Withhold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">thy foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03182">from being unshod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01627">and thy throat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06773">from thirst</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but thou saidst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02976" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">There is no hope</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">no; for I have loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">strangers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them will I go</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>There…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Is the case desperate?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01590">As the thief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">is ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">when he is found</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">so is the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">ashamed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">they, their kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">their princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and their priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and their prophets</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">to a stock</w>, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>; <w lemma="strong:H068">and to a stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast brought me forth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they have turned</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06203">back</w> unto me, and not <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">but in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of their trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they will say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and save</w> us.<note type="study"><catchWord>brought…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">begotten me</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>their back</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the hinder part of the neck</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:28
verses.text: But where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee? let them arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">if they can save</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">thee in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of thy trouble</w>: for <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of thy cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">are thy gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">O Judah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>trouble</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">evil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore will ye plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with me? ye all have transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">against me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07723">In vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have I smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">your children</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they received</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">no correction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02719">your own sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">your prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">like a destroying</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">lion</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01755">O generation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">ye the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H04057">Have I been a wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03991">of darkness</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherefore say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07300" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We are lords</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will come</w> no more unto thee?<note type="study"><catchWord>We are…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">We have dominion</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01330">Can a maid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H05716">her ornaments</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03618">a bride</w> <w lemma="strong:H07196">her attire</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05971">yet my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">without number</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Why trimmest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thou thy way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">love</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">therefore hast thou also taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the wicked ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thy ways</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03671">Also in thy skirts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">of the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">innocents</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04290">it by secret search</w>, but upon all these.<note type="study"><catchWord>secret…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">digging</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yet thou sayest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Because I am innocent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">surely his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">from me. Behold, I will plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with thee, because thou sayest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not sinned</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Why gaddest thou about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">so much</w> <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to change</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thy way</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou also shalt be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as thou wast ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yea, thou shalt go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from him, and thine hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon thine head</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H04009">thy confidences</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thou shalt not prosper</w> in them. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen799" osisID="Jer.2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">They say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and she go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">from him, and become another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man’s</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he return unto her again</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0776">shall not that land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02610" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">polluted</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but thou hast played the harlot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">with many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">lovers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">yet return again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">to me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>They say</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Saying</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08205">unto the high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0375">where</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901 strong:H07693" morph="strongMorph:TH8795 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8795">thou hast not been lien</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">with. In the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06163">for them, as the Arabian</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02610" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thou hast polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02184">with thy whoredoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and with thy wickedness</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07241">Therefore the showers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">have been withholden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04456">and there hath been no latter rain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802 strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and thou hadst a whore’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04696">forehead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou refusedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to be ashamed</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wilt thou not from this time cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto me, My father</w>, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">the guide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of my youth</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Will he reserve</w> <transChange type="added">his anger</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will he keep</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05331">to the end</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Behold, thou hast spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil things</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">as thou couldest</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">also unto me in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast thou seen</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04878">which backsliding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath done</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">she is gone up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01364">upon every high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08478">and under</w> <w lemma="strong:H07488">every green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there hath played the harlot</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">she had done</w> all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou unto me. But she returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0901">not. And her treacherous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I saw</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0182">when for all the causes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04878">whereby backsliding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">committed adultery</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I had put her away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">her a bill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03748">of divorce</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">yet her treacherous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, but went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and played the harlot</w> also.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">And it came to pass through the lightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02184">of her whoredom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that she defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and committed adultery</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">with stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">and with stocks</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lightness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fame</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0901">And yet for all this her treacherous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">unto me with her whole heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08267">but feignedly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>feignedly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in falsehood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04878">unto me, The backsliding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath justified</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">herself</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">more than treacherous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04878">thou backsliding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">I will not cause mine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to fall</w> upon you: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02623">merciful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not keep</w> <transChange type="added">anger</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Only acknowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">thine iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06340" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and hast scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thy ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">to the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07488">under every green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye have not obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:14
