verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07726">O backsliding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I am married</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto you: and I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">you one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of a city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of a family</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">you to Zion</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">you pastors</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">according to mine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which shall feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01844">you with knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and understanding</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it shall come to pass, when ye be multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in those days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">no more, The ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall it come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">to mind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall they remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it; neither shall they visit</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; neither shall <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be done</w> any more.<note type="study"><catchWord>come to mind</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">come upon the heart</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">it be magnified</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">At that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall call</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01471">and all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto it, to the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall they walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">any more after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08307">the imagination</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of their evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>imagination</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stubbornness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I have given for an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto your fathers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>given…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">caused your fathers to possess</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How shall I put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thee among the children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02532">thee a pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06643">a goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of nations</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt call</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">me, My father</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shalt not turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from me</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from me</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from after me</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a goodly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an heritage of glory</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">beauty</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">land of desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0403">Surely</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">treacherously</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">departeth from her husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so have ye dealt treacherously</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with me, O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>husband</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">friend</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">A voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08205">upon the high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01065">weeping</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08469">supplications</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for they have perverted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">their way</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07726">ye backsliding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will heal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04878">your backslidings</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, we come</w> unto thee; for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0403">Truly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">in vain</w> <transChange type="added">is salvation hoped for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01389">from the hills</w>, <transChange type="added">and from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01995">the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of mountains</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0403">truly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08668">the salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01322">For shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H03018">the labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">from our youth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06629">their flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and their herds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">their sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and their daughters</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">in our shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03639">and our confusion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us: for we have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">we and our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05271">from our youth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">even unto this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have not obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen800" osisID="Jer.3"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou wilt return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto me: and if thou wilt put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">thine abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">out of my sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then shalt thou not remove</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And thou shalt swear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0571">in truth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">in judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and in righteousness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01471">and the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">shall bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">themselves in him, and in him shall they glory</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05214" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Break up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05215">your fallow ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06975">not among thorns</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Circumcise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">yourselves to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">the foreskins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of your heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02534">lest my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">like fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that none can quench</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07455">of the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of your doings</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">ye in Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and publish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">ye the trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">gather together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yourselves, and let us go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">into the defenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">the standard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">toward Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05756" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">retire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">not: for I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">from the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">destruction</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>retire</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">strengthen</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>destruction</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">breaking</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0738">The lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05441">from his thicket</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and the destroyer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the Gentiles</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is on his way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he is gone forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">from his place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">desolate</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">thy cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05327" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be laid waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">without an inhabitant</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">For this gird</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">you with sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">lament</w> <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and howl</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02740">for the fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is not turned back</w> from us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass at that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the princes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be astonished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H08539" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall wonder</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0162">I, Ah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>! <w lemma="strong:H0403">surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thou hast greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">deceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">Ye shall have peace</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02719">whereas the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">unto the soul</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">At that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall it be said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06703">A dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H08205">of the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to fan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">nor to cleanse</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04392">a full</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> from those <transChange type="added">places</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto me: now also will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">sentence</w> against them.<note type="study"><catchWord>a full…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a fuller wind than those</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>give…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">utter judgments</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, he shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">as clouds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04818">and his chariots</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05492">as a whirlwind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05483">his horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are swifter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">than eagles</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0188">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">unto us! for we are spoiled</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03389">O Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that thou mayest be saved</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0205">How long shall thy vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> thee?

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">For a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">declareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">from Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and publisheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Make ye mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">to the nations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">behold, publish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">watchers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">from a far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and give out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">As keepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of a field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05439">are they against her round about</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because she hath been rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">against me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">Thy way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">and thy doings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have procured</w> these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> unto thee; this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">thy wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04751">because it is bitter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because it reacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">unto thine heart</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04578">My bowels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04578">my bowels</w>! <w lemma="strong:H03176 strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">I am pained</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">at my very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">maketh a noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">in me; I cannot hold my peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because thou hast heard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">O my soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08643">the alarm</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my very…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the walls of my heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07667">Destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">upon destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is cried</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">for the whole land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is spoiled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06597">suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">are my tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">spoiled</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03407">my curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07281">in a moment</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How long shall I see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">the standard</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">For my people</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0191">foolish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have not known</w> me; they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05530">sottish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and they have none understanding</w>: they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to do evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">but to do good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have no knowledge</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, and, lo, <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08414">without form</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0922">and void</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08064">and the heavens</w>, and they <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0216">no light</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and, lo, they trembled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and all the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8701">moved lightly</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I beheld</w>, and, lo, <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">no man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and all the birds</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were fled</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I beheld</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03759">and, lo, the fruitful place</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04057">a wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thereof were broken down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02740">by his fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For thus hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">The whole land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">shall be desolate</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet will I not make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">a full end</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">For this shall the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">mourn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">and the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be black</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because I have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02161" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have purposed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and will not repent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither will I turn back</w> from it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">The whole city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">for the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">of the horsemen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07411 strong:H07198" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and bowmen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">into thickets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and climb up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03710">upon the rocks</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05892">every city</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">forsaken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and not a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02004">therein</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:30
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">when</transChange> thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">spoiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what wilt thou do</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Though thou clothest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08144">thyself with crimson</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05710" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">though thou deckest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05716">thee with ornaments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">though thou rentest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06320">with painting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07723">in vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03302" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shalt thou make thyself fair</w>; <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05689" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lovers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee, they will seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy life</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>face</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as of a woman in travail</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06869">the anguish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01069" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">as of her that bringeth forth her first child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03306" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">bewaileth</w> herself, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spreadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">her hands</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0188">Woe</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">me now! for my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05888" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is wearied</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because of murderers</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen801" osisID="Jer.4"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07751" morph="strongMorph:TH8786">Run ye to and fro</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">through the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now, and know</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the broad places</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, if ye can find</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">if there be</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that executeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">the truth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will pardon</w> it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And though they say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">surely they swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsely</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">not thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">upon the truth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast stricken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, but they have not grieved</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast consumed</w> them, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they have refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">correction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06440">they have made their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">harder</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">than a rock</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they have refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to return</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore I said</w>, Surely these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01800">poor</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02973" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they are foolish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">not the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of their God</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will get</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">me unto the great men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and will speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them; for they have known</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of their God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03162">but these have altogether</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">the yoke</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">burst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04147">the bonds</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0738">Wherefore a lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">out of the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall slay</w> them, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02061">a wolf</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">of the evenings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05246">them, a leopard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08245" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">over their cities</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one that goeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">thence shall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be torn in pieces</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06588">because their transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are many</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04878">their backslidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are increased</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>evenings</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">deserts</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>are increased</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">are strong</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0335">How</w> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall I pardon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">thee for this</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">me, and sworn</w> by <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03808">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when I had fed them to the full</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they then committed adultery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01413" morph="strongMorph:TH8704">and assembled themselves by troops</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in the harlots’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:8
verses.text: They were <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02109" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07904" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">in the morning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06670" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neighed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">after his neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall I not visit</w> for these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">and shall not my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">be avenged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">on such a nation</w> as this?

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go ye up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08284">upon her walls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and destroy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">not a full end</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05189">her battlements</w>; for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">For the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">have dealt very</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">treacherously</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">against me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">They have belied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">not he; neither shall evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon us; neither shall we see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">nor famine</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">And the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">shall become wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and the word</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">not in them: thus shall it be done</w> unto them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">Because ye speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in thy mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall devour</w> them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Lo, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">upon you from far</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0386">a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">an ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">whose language</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, neither understandest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">what they say</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0827">Their quiver</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">as an open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">sepulchre</w>, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">all mighty men</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall eat up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">thine harvest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">and thy bread</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and thy daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall eat up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">thy flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and thine herds</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall eat up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">thy vines</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">and thy fig trees</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07567" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">they shall impoverish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">thy fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02007">wherein thou</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">trustedst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Nevertheless in those days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">a full end</w> with you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04100 strong:H08478">Wherefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto us? then shalt thou answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, Like as ye have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in your land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so shall ye serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in a land</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> not yours.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">this in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and publish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">it in Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05530">now this, O foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and without understanding</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">which have eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">not; which have ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hear</w> not:<note type="study"><catchWord>understanding</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">ye not me? saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will ye not tremble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at my presence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which have placed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02344">the sand</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">by a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">decree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that it cannot pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">it: and though the waves</w> <w lemma="strong:H01607" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thereof toss</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">themselves, yet can they not prevail</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">though they roar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet can they not pass over</w> it?

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">But this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05637" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hath a revolting</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and a rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are revolted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gone</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Neither say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">they in their heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us now fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03138">both the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H04456">and the latter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">in his season</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he reserveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">unto us the appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">weeks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">of the harvest</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05771">Your iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have turned away</w> these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and your sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have withholden</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange> from you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">For among my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">wicked</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they lay wait</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07918" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as he that setteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03353">snares</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04889">a trap</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they catch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they lay…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they pry as fowlers lie in wait</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03619">As a cage</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">of birds</w>, so <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">their houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">of deceit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore they are become great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and waxen rich</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cage</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">coop</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08080" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They are waxen fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, they overpass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the deeds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of the wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01779">not the cause</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">the cause of the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet they prosper</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04941">and the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">of the needy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do they not judge</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall I not visit</w> for these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">shall not my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">be avenged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">on such a nation</w> as this?

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08047">A wonderful</w> <w lemma="strong:H08186">and horrible thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>A wonderful…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Astonishment and filthiness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">The prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bear rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by their means</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">love</w> <transChange type="added">to have it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so: and what will ye do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">in the end</w> thereof?<note type="study"><catchWord>bear…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">take into their hands</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen802" osisID="Jer.5"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">O ye children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05756" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">gather yourselves to flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">the trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08620">in Tekoa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04864">a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01021">of fire in Beth–haccerem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07451">for evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">appeareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">out of the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">destruction</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have likened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">to a comely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06026" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and delicate</w> <transChange type="added">woman</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>comely</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dwelling at home</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">with their flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto her; they shall pitch</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">against her round about</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his place</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">ye war</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">against her; arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">at noon</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0188">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto us! for the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">goeth away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06752">for the shadows</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">of the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">are stretched out</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and let us destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">her palaces</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">For thus hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hew ye down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06097">trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05550">a mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>: this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">to be visited</w>; she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06233">wholly oppression</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> of her.<note type="study"><catchWord>cast…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pour out the engine of shot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0953">As a fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06979" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">casteth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">her waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06979" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">so she casteth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">her wickedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02555">violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H07701">and spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in her; before me</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02483">grief</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">and wounds</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Be thou instructed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">O Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">lest my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03363" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from thee; lest I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">thee desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">not inhabited</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>depart</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be loosed</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">disjointed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8780">They shall throughly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">glean</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">as a vine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">turn back</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as a grapegatherer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05552">into the baskets</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">To whom shall I speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and give warning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may hear</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0241">behold, their ear</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06189">uncircumcised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">hearken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">behold, the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">is unto them a reproach</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they have no delight</w> in it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04392">Therefore I am full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">of the fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">with holding in</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I will pour it out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05768">upon the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05475">and upon the assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">of young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">for even the husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">with the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be taken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">the aged</w> with <transChange type="added">him that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of days</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And their houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto others</w>, <transChange type="added">with their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for I will stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06996">For from the least</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of them even unto the greatest</w> of them every one <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01214" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">to covetousness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05030">and from the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">even unto the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one dealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsely</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">They have healed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">also the hurt</w> <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H01323" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">of the daughter</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">slightly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">Peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>; when <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">no peace</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hurt</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bruise</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">breach</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Were they ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when they had committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01571">nay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they were not at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01571">neither</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">could</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">they blush</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore they shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">among them that fall</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">at the time</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">them they shall be cast down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ye in the ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">paths</w>, where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">therein, and ye shall find</w> <w lemma="strong:H04771">rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for your souls</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">We will not walk</w> <transChange type="added">therein</transChange>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Also I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">watchmen</w> over you, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">We will not hearken</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">ye nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and know</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">O congregation</w>, what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> among them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">O earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">upon this people</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">of their thoughts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because they have not hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto my words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">nor to my law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but rejected</w> it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">To what purpose cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">there to me incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H07614">from Sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and the sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">cane</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">from a far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05930">your burnt offerings</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07522">not acceptable</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">nor your sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H06149" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sweet</w> unto me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04383">stumblingblocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">before this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07934">upon them; the neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">and his friend</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall perish</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">Behold, a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">from the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be raised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">from the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They shall lay hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">on bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03591">and spear</w>; they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0394">cruel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and have no mercy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">roareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">like the sea</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">upon horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">set in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">as men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">for war</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">against thee, O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08089">the fame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thereof: our hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wax feeble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06869">anguish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath taken hold</w> of us, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02427">pain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as of a woman in travail</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Go not forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02719">for the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the enemy</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04032">fear</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">on every side</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">gird</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08242">with sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06428" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and wallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">thyself in ashes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">thee mourning</w>, <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03173">an only son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08563">most bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04553">lamentation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for the spoiler</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">shall suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> upon us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have set</w> thee <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0969">a tower</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04013">a fortress</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou mayest know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and try</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">their way</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:28
verses.text: They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05637" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">revolters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">walking</w> <w lemma="strong:H07400">with slanders</w>: <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">and iron</w>; they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">all corrupters</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04647">The bellows</w> <w lemma="strong:H02787" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are burned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05777">the lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784 strong:H0800">of the fire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">the founder</w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">melteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">in vain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07451">for the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are not plucked away</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Reprobate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> shall <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them, because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath rejected</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>Reprobate…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Refuse silver</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen803" osisID="Jer.6"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">that came to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">there this word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, all <transChange type="added">ye of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that enter in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at these gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Amend</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">your ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">and your doings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will cause you to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in this place</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">ye not in lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01964">The temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01964">The temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01964">The temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> these.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">For if ye throughly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">amend</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">your ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">and your doings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">if ye throughly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">between a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">and his neighbour</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">If</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye oppress</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">not the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">and the widow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">not innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">to your hurt</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Then will I cause you to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">and ever</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, ye trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">in lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that cannot profit</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Will ye steal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">murder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and commit adultery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">and swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and burn incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">unto Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom ye know</w> not;

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">me in this house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">We are delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">all these abominations</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">whereupon my name is called</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">Is this house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04631">become a den</w> <w lemma="strong:H06530">of robbers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in your eyes</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, even I have seen</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">But go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">ye now unto my place</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07887">in Shiloh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">where I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">at the first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what I did</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to it for</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And now, because ye have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">all these works</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">unto you, rising up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and speaking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but ye heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not; and I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you, but ye answered</w> not;

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore will I do</w> unto <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wherein ye trust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">and unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to you and to your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">to Shiloh</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will cast you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of my sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">as I have cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">all your brethren</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">the whole seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:16
