verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Therefore pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">not thou for this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">nor prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">for them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither make intercession</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to me: for I will not hear</w> thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou not what they do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">and in the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H03888" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">knead</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01217">dough</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03561">cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04446">to the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">drink offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that they may provoke me to anger</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>queen…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">frame</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">workmanship of heaven</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Do they provoke me to anger</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <transChange type="added">do they</transChange> not <transChange type="added">provoke</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01322">themselves to the confusion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of their own faces</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0639">Behold, mine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">and my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall be poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">upon this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">upon man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and upon beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and upon the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and upon the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the ground</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall burn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not be quenched</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">your burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">unto your sacrifices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">For I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">not unto your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">nor commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">them in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I brought them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">concerning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">or sacrifices</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>concerning</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">concerning the matter of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">But this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and I will be your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and ye shall be my people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ye in all the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that I have commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, that it may be well</w> unto you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But they hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">not, nor inclined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">their ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04156">in the counsels</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08307">in the imagination</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of their evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0268">and went backward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and not forward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>imagination</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stubbornness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>went</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Since the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">that your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came forth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I have even sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto you all my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">rising up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and sending</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet they hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">not unto me, nor inclined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">their ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">their neck</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they did worse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">than their fathers</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Therefore thou shalt speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them; but they will not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to thee: thou shalt also call</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them; but they will not answer</w> thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But thou shalt say</w> unto them, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that obeyeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor receiveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">correction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0530">truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is perished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and is cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">from their mouth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>correction</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">instruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01494" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">thine hair</w>, <transChange type="added">O Jerusalem</transChange>, and cast <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07015">a lamentation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08205">on high places</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">the generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">of his wrath</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">For the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">their abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to pollute</w> it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H08612">of Tophet</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01516">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02011">of Hinnom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">their sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and their daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I commanded</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not, neither came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">it into my heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>came…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">came it upon my heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">Therefore, behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that it shall no more be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08612">Tophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01516">nor the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02011">of Hinnom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01516">but the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H02028">of slaughter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they shall bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H08612">in Tophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0369">till there be no</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05038">And the carcases</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">shall be meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">for the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and for the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; and none shall fray <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">away</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Then will I cause to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02351">and from the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">of mirth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">of gladness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02860">of the bridegroom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">of the bride</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">for the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">shall be desolate</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen804" osisID="Jer.7"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">At that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they shall bring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">and the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of his princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">and the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">and the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">and the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06913">out of their graves</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07849" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">them before the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03394">and the moon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">and all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom they have loved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and whom they have served</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom they have walked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and whom they have sought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and whom they have worshipped</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall not be gathered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor be buried</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01828">they shall be for dung</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04194">And death</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">rather than life</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">by all the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of them that remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of this evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">family</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in all the places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whither I have driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Moreover thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall they fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not arise</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he turn away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not return</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:5
verses.text: Why <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">is this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">slidden back</w> <w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">by a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H04878">backsliding</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08649">fast deceit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to return</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and heard</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they spake not aright</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">repented</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">him of</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">his wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">What have I done</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">every one turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04794">to his course</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">as the horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">rusheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">into the battle</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02624">Yea, the stork</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">her appointed times</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08449">and the turtle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">and the crane</w> <w lemma="strong:H05693">and the swallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of their coming</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">but my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">not the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How do ye say</w>, We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">and the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0403">with us? Lo, certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">in vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> he <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05842">the pen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the scribes</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08267">in vain</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in vain made…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the false pen of the scribes worketh for falsehood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">The wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">are ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are dismayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and taken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lo, they have rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02451">and what wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in them?<note type="study"><catchWord>The wise…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Have they been ashamed</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>what…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the wisdom of what thing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">their wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto others</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">their fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that shall inherit</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06996">for every one from the least</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">even unto the greatest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01214" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">to covetousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">from the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">even unto the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one dealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsely</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">For they have healed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">the hurt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">slightly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">Peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>; when <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">no peace</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Were they ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when they had committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">nay, they were not at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither could</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">they blush</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore shall they fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">among them that fall</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">of their visitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall be cast down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I will…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">In gathering I will consume</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05486" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06025">no grapes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">on the vine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08384">nor figs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">on the fig tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05929">and the leaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fade</w>; and <transChange type="added">the things that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them shall pass away</w> from them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Why do we sit still</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yourselves, and let us enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">into the defenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and let us be silent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">there: for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath put us to silence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">and given us water</w> <w lemma="strong:H07219">of gall</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because we have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gall</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">poison</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">We looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">for peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">but no good</w> <transChange type="added">came</transChange>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">for a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04832">of health</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01205">and behold trouble</w>!

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05170">The snorting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">of his horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">from Dan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">the whole land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">trembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">at the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H04684">of the neighing</w> <w lemma="strong:H047">of his strong ones</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they are come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04393">and all</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">that is in it; the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and those that dwell</w> therein.<note type="study"><catchWord>all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the fulness thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">For, behold, I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">serpents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06848">cockatrices</w>, among you, which <transChange type="added">will</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03908">charmed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and they shall bite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">When</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04010">I would comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H03015">myself against sorrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01742">faint</w> in me.<note type="study"><catchWord>in</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">Behold the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07775">of the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">because of them that dwell in a far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>? <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">not her king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">in her? Why have they provoked me to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">with their graven images</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05236">with strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanities</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>them…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the country of them that are far off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07105">The harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is past</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07019">the summer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is ended</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and we are not saved</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07667">For the hurt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">am I hurt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am black</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08047">astonishment</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath taken hold</w> on me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:22
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06875">no balm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">in Gilead</w>; <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">no physician</w> <w lemma="strong:H03588">there? why then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0724">is not the health</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">recovered</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>recovered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gone up?</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen805" osisID="Jer.8"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Oh that</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">my head</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">were waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04726">a fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">of tears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I might weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">for the slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>Oh…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Who will give my head</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Oh that</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">I had in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04411">a lodging place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0732" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of wayfaring men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I might leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and go</w> from them! for they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">all adulterers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06116">an assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of treacherous men</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they bend</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">their tongues</w> <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07198">their bow</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they are not valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">for the truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they proceed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">to evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">not me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Take ye heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">ye not in any brother</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0251">for every brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H06117" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">will utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">supplant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07453">and every neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H07400">with slanders</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>neighbour</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">friend</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02048" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they will deceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and will not speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">the truth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they have taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">their tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lies</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">themselves to commit iniquity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>deceive</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mock</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Thine habitation</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">of deceit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04820">through deceit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will melt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and try</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them; for how shall I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03956">Their tongue</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02671">an arrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shot out</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">it speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">deceit</w>: <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peaceably</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with his mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07130">but in heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he layeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0696">his wait</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in heart</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the midst of him</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>his wait</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wait for him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall I not visit</w> them for these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">shall not my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">be avenged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">on such a nation</w> as this?

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">For the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">a weeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H05092">and wailing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04999">and for the habitations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07015">a lamentation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">because they are burned up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">so that none</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">can pass</w> through <transChange type="added">them</transChange>; neither can <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">of the cattle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05775">both the fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and the beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are fled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are gone</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>habitations</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pastures</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>burned up</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">desolate</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>both…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from the fowl even to</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">heaps</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04583">a den</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">of dragons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">without an inhabitant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>desolate</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">desolation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">the wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that may understand</w> this? and <transChange type="added">who is he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to whom the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he may declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">it, for what the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">perisheth</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is burned up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">like a wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that none passeth through</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Because they have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">my law</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and have not obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither walked</w> therein;

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But have walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08307">the imagination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of their own heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baalim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">which their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">taught</w> them:<note type="study"><catchWord>imagination</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stubbornness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will feed</w> them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03939">with wormwood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">and give them water</w> <w lemma="strong:H07219">of gall</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to drink</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I will scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">them also among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">whom neither they nor their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have known</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">them, till I have consumed</w> them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8708">Consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, and call</w> <w lemma="strong:H06969" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">for the mourning women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may come</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and send</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">for cunning</w> <transChange type="added">women</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may come</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And let them make haste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05092">a wailing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">for us, that our eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may run down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">with tears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06079">and our eyelids</w> <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gush out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with waters</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">For a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05092">of wailing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">out of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">How are we spoiled</w>! <w lemma="strong:H03966">we are greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">confounded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because we have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04908">because our dwellings</w> have cast <transChange type="added">us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">out</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Yet hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">O ye women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">and let your ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">your daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05092">wailing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07468">her neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07015">lamentation</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04194">For death</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">into our windows</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">into our palaces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05768">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">from without</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0970">the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">from the streets</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05038">Even the carcases</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01828">as dung</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the open</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05995">and as the handful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the harvestman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and none shall gather</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02450">Let not the wise</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">in his wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">neither let the mighty</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">in his might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06223">let not the rich</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">in his riches</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">But let him that glorieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">in this, that he understandeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and knoweth</w> me, that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which exercise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">lovingkindness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>: for in these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I delight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I will punish</w> all <transChange type="added">them which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">circumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">with the uncircumcised</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>punish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visit upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0123">and Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04124">and Moab</w>, and all <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07112" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">in the utmost</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">corners</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>: for all <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06189">uncircumcised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06189">uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in the utmost…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cut off into corners</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">having the corners of their hair polled</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen806" osisID="Jer.9"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">ye the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto you, O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">not the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and be not dismayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">at the signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01471">for the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">are dismayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01992">at them</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02708">For the customs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vain</w>: for <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cutteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">a tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">out of the forest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02796">of the workman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04621">with the axe</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>customs…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">statutes</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">ordinances are vanity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03302" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">They deck</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">it with silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and with gold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they fasten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04548">it with nails</w> <w lemma="strong:H04717">and with hammers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06328" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that it move</w> not.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:5
verses.text: They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04749">upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H08560">as the palm tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">but speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not: they must needs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be borne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06805" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">because they cannot go</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Be not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of them; for they cannot do evil</w>, neither also <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">in them to do good</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:6
verses.text: Forasmuch as <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">none like unto thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and thy name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">in might</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who would not fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">thee, O King</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of nations</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02969" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for to thee doth it appertain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02450">forasmuch as among all the wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04438">and in all their kingdoms</w>, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> none like unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">it liketh thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">But they are altogether</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">brutish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03688" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and foolish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06086">the stock</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04148">a doctrine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">of vanities</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>altogether</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in one</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">at once</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03701">Silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07554" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">spread into plates</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">is brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">from Tarshish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0210">from Uphaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H02796">of the workman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and of the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the founder</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03830">their clothing</w>: they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">all the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of cunning</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">the true</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">and an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07110">at his wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall tremble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">and the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not be able to abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">his indignation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>true…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">God of truth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>living God</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">living Gods</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>everlasting…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">king of eternity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01836">Thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall ye say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">unto them, The gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">that have not</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H0778">and the earth</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">they shall perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">from the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08460">and from under</w> <w lemma="strong:H0429">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">heavens</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">by his power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he hath established</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">by his wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">by his discretion</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When he uttereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01995">a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">and he causeth the vapours</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to ascend</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">from the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">lightnings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">with rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and bringeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">out of his treasures</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>multitude</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">noise</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>with</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is brutish</w> in <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every founder</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">by the graven image</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05262">for his molten image</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsehood</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">no breath</w> in them.<note type="study"><catchWord>brutish in his knowledge</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">more brutish than to know</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:15
verses.text: They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H08595">of errors</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">of their visitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall perish</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02506">The portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not like them: for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the former</w> of all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of his inheritance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Gather up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03666">thy wares</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">of the fortress</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>inhabitant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">inhabitress</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07049" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will sling</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">out the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">at this once</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will distress</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, that they may find</w> <transChange type="added">it so</transChange>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0188">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">is me for my hurt</w>! <w lemma="strong:H04347">my wound</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is grievous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0389">Truly</w> this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02483">a grief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I must bear</w> it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0168">My tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is spoiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04340">and all my cords</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are broken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">my children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are gone forth</w> of me, and they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none to stretch forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">my tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">any more, and to set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">my curtains</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For the pastors</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are become brutish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have not sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">therefore they shall not prosper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04830">and all their flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be scattered</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">Behold, the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">of the bruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07494">commotion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">out of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04583">a den</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">of dragons</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">that the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not in himself: <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not in man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to direct</w> <w lemma="strong:H06806">his steps</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">correct</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">me, but with judgment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0639">not in thine anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lest thou bring me to nothing</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bring…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">diminish me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">thy fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">upon the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">thee not, and upon the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">not on thy name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they have eaten up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">him, and have made his habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">desolate</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen807" osisID="Jer.10"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">that came to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">ye the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of this covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and to the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that obeyeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of this covenant</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Which I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">I brought them forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01270">from the iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03564">furnace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them, according to all which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">you: so shall ye be my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and I will be your God</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">That I may perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">the oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which I have sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">flowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">So be it</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>So…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Amen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Then the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02351">and in the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">ye the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of this covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">For I earnestly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">protested</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">I brought them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">rising early</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and protesting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet they obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">not, nor inclined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">their ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08307">in the imagination</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of their evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">upon them all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of this covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I commanded</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they did</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>imagination</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stubbornness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07195">unto me, A conspiracy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">among the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and among the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They are turned back</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">to the iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01 strong:H07223">of their forefathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">them: the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with their fathers</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon them, which they shall not be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to escape</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and though they shall cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, I will not hearken</w> unto them.<note type="study"><catchWord>to escape</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to go forth of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">Then shall the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">unto whom they offer incense</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but they shall not save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">them at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of their trouble</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>trouble</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">evil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:13
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of thy cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">were thy gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">O Judah</w>; and <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">of the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have ye set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altars</w> to <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01322">shameful thing</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to burn incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">unto Baal</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shameful…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shame</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Therefore pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">not thou for this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">a cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">or prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for them: for I will not hear</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">unto me for their trouble</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>trouble</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">evil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03039">What hath my beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to do in mine house</w>, <transChange type="added">seeing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">she hath wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04209">lewdness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">with many</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">and the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from thee? when thou doest evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then thou rejoicest</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>What…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">What is to my beloved in my house</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when thy evil is</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07488">A green</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">olive tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03303">fair</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08389">of goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">fruit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06963">with the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01999">tumult</w> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01808">upon it, and the branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of it are broken</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thee, hath pronounced</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01558">against thee, for</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">against themselves to provoke me to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in offering incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">unto Baal</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath given me knowledge</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I know</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then thou shewedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">me their doings</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:19
verses.text: But I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03532">like a lamb</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">an ox</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">is brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02873" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to the slaughter</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not that they had devised</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">devices</w> against me, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Let us destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">the tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">with the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, and let us cut him off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">that his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">may be no more remembered</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the tree…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the stalk with his bread</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:20
