verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that judgest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteously</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that triest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">the reins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">and the heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let me see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">thy vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">on them: for unto thee have I revealed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">my cause</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06068">of Anathoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">not in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou die</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">not by our hand</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">them: the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">their sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and their daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">by famine</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>punish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visit upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07611">And there shall be no remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of them: for I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">upon the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06068">of Anathoth</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">of their visitation</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen808" osisID="Jer.11"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">Righteous</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when I plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">with thee: yet let me talk</w> with thee of <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgments</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01870">Wherefore doth the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">prosper</w>? <transChange type="added">wherefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07951" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are all they happy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">that deal very</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">treacherously</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>talk…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">reason the case with thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08327" morph="strongMorph:TH8776">them, yea, they have taken root</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they grow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, they bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">fruit</w>: thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in their mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07350">and far from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">their reins</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they grow</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they go on</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me: thou hast seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, and tried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">toward thee: pull them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">like sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02878">for the slaughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">them for the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02028">of slaughter</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>toward…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">How long shall the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">mourn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06212">and the herbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of every field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wither</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">for the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">therein? the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are consumed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and the birds</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">our last end</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If thou hast run</w> <w lemma="strong:H07273">with the footmen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they have wearied</w> <w lemma="strong:H08474" morph="strongMorph:TH8807">thee, then how canst thou contend</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">with horses</w>? and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w>, <transChange type="added">wherein</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou trustedst</w>, <transChange type="added">they wearied thee</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then how wilt thou do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">in the swelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">For even thy brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">even they have dealt treacherously</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee; yea, they have called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee: believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them not, though they speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">fair words</w> unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>they have called…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they cried after thee fully</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>fair…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">good things</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">mine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">mine heritage</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03033">the dearly beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of her enemies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the dearly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the love</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05159">Mine heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">is unto me as a lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">in the forest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06963 strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it crieth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against me: therefore have I hated</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>crieth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">yelleth</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">giveth out his voice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05159">Mine heritage</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> unto me <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06641">a speckled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05861">bird</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05861">the birds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">against her; come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">all the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0402">to devour</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>speckled</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">taloned</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>come to</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cause them to come to</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">pastors</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">my vineyard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0947" morph="strongMorph:TH8790" type="x-split-347">they have trodden</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">my portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0947" morph="strongMorph:TH8790" type="x-split-347">under foot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02532">my pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">a desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">wilderness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">portion of desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08076">it desolate</w>, <transChange type="added">and being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it mourneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto me; the whole land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is made desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">because no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">layeth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">to heart</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The spoilers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08205">upon all high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">through the wilderness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02719">for the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall devour</w> from the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> even to the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01320">no flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">shall have peace</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have sown</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but shall reap</w> <w lemma="strong:H06975">thorns</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they have put themselves to pain</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not profit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">of your revenues</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">because of the fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they shall</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ye shall</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">against all mine evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07934">neighbours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">which I have caused my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to inherit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will pluck them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of their land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pluck out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And it shall come to pass, after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I have plucked them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and have compassion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">on them, and will bring them again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">to his heritage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to his land</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as they taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">by Baal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">then shall they be built</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if they will not obey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I will utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pluck up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">that nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen809" osisID="Jer.12"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and get</w> <w lemma="strong:H06593">thee a linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0232">girdle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">it upon thy loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">it not in water</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So I got</w> <w lemma="strong:H0232">a girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04975">on my loins</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">came unto me the second time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0232">the girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast got</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04975">upon thy loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">to Euphrates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05357">it there in a hole</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of the rock</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So I went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">it by Euphrates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07093">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">to Euphrates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0232">the girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">from thence, which I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to hide</w> there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">to Euphrates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and digged</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0232">the girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">from the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">where I had hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0232">it: and, behold, the girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was marred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it was profitable</w> for nothing.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Then the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">After this manner will I mar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">This evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03987">which refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08307">in the imagination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of their heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">them, and to worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H0232">them, shall even be as this girdle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which is good</w> for nothing.<note type="study"><catchWord>imagination</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stubbornness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0232">For as the girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cleaveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">to the loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">so have I caused to cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto me the whole house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the whole house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">that they might be unto me for a people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and for a name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08416">and for a praise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08597">and for a glory</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they would not hear</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thou shalt speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto them this word</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05035">Every bottle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">with wine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, Do we not certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">that every bottle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">with wine</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shalt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Behold, I will fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">even the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">upon David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07943">with drunkenness</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will dash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">them one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">against another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">even the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not pity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor spare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">nor have mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">but destroy</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>one…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man against his brother</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>but…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from destroying them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">ye, and give ear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not proud</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">before he cause darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">and before your feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">stumble</w> <w lemma="strong:H05399">upon the dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and, while ye look</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">for light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06757">it into the shadow of death</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07896 strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8798">make</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06205">gross darkness</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if ye will not hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">it, my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04565">in secret places</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for</w> <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01466">pride</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">and mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H01830" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01830" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and run down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">with tears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is carried away captive</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01377">and to the queen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Humble</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yourselves, sit down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04761">for your principalities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come down</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05850">the crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">of your glory</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>principalities</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">head tires</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">The cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">shall be shut up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and none shall open</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">shall be carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">all of it, it shall be wholly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">carried away captive</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">your eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">from the north</w>: where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05739">the flock</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was given</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">thee, thy beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">flock</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What wilt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when he shall punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thee? for thou hast taught</w> them <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">captains</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">as chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">over thee: shall not sorrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thee, as a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in travail</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>punish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visit upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">these things upon me? For the greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">of thine iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07757">are thy skirts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">discovered</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06119">thy heels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02554" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">made bare</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shall be violently taken away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03569">Can the Ethiopian</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">change</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">his skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05246">or the leopard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02272">his spots</w>? <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">ye also do good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03928">that are accustomed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to do evil</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>accustomed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">taught</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Therefore will I scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07179">them as the stubble</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that passeth away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">by the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:25
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01486">thy lot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04490">the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04055">of thy measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">from me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because thou hast forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">in falsehood</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02834" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore will I discover</w> <w lemma="strong:H07757">thy skirts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon thy face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07036">that thy shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">may appear</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05004">thine adulteries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04684">and thy neighings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02154">the lewdness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02184">of thy whoredom</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08251">thine abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">on the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the fields</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0188">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto thee, O Jerusalem</w>! <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou not be made clean</w>? when <transChange type="added">shall it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H05750">once</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange>?<note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">after when yet?</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen810" osisID="Jer.13"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">that came to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">concerning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01226">the dearth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the dearth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the words of the dearths</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">restraints</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">mourneth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">thereof languish</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are black</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the ground</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06682">and the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is gone up</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0117">And their nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06810">their little ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">to the waters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01360 strong:H01356" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">to the pits</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">no water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with their vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">empty</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they were ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">and confounded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02645" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">their heads</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0127">Because the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is chapt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01653">for there was no rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0406">the plowmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02645" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">their heads</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0365">Yea, the hind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also calved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and forsook</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01877">because there was no grass</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06501">And the wild asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08205">in the high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07602" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they snuffed up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">like dragons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">their eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did fail</w>, because <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06212">no grass</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">though our iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">testify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">against us, do</w> thou <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for thy name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04878">sake: for our backslidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are many</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we have sinned</w> against thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04723">O the hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">the saviour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">thereof in time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">why shouldest thou be as a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0732" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and as a wayfaring man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turneth aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to tarry for a night</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Why shouldest thou be as a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01724" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">astonied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">as a mighty man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">save</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">yet thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">of us, and we are called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by thy name</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">leave</w> us not.<note type="study"><catchWord>we…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thy name is called upon us</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus have they loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to wander</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have not refrained</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">their feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">doth not accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them; he will now remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">their iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">their sins</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">unto me, Pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">not for this people</w> for <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When they fast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I will not hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">their cry</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and when they offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">and an oblation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I will not accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">them: but I will consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">them by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">and by the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and by the pestilence</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0162">I, Ah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>! <w lemma="strong:H05030">behold, the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Ye shall not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">neither shall ye have famine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">you assured</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in this place</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>assured…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">peace of truth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Then the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">unto me, The prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in my name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them not, neither have I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them, neither spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">unto them: they prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">unto you a false</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H07081">and divination</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0434 strong:H0457" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and a thing of nought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08649">and the deceit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of their heart</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">concerning the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them not, yet they say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">Sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">and famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">shall not be in this land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02719">By sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">and famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">shall those prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be consumed</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">to whom they prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">shall be cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">in the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">of the famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">and the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and they shall have none to bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H01992">them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">them, their wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">nor their sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">nor their daughters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I will pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">their wickedness</w> upon them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">unto them; Let mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">run down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">with tears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">night</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">and day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let them not cease</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01330">for the virgin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">breach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">with a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">blow</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If I go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02491">then behold the slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>! <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and if I enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08463">then behold them that are sick</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">with famine</w>! <w lemma="strong:H05030">yea, both the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go about</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they know</w> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>go about…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">make merchandise against a land, and men acknowledge it not</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Hast thou utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05315">hath thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01602" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">why hast thou smitten</w> us, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04832">no healing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">for us? we looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">for peace</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">no good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06256">and for the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04832">of healing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01205">and behold trouble</w>!

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We acknowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07562">our wickedness</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for we have sinned</w> against thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Do not abhor</w> <transChange type="added">us</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">for thy name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sake, do not disgrace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of thy glory</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">remember</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">not thy covenant</w> with us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">Are there</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">among the vanities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the Gentiles</w> <w lemma="strong:H01652" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that can cause rain</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08064">or can the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07241">showers</w>? <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not thou he, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">therefore we will wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon thee: for thou hast made</w> all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen811" osisID="Jer.14"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto me, Though Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">and Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> me, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my mind</w> <transChange type="added">could</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">toward this people</w>: cast <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of my sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let them go forth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it shall come to pass, if they say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, Whither shall we go forth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then thou shalt tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; Such as <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">for death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04194">to death</w>; and such as <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">for the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">to the sword</w>; and such as <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07458">for the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">to the famine</w>; and such as <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07628">for the captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07628">to the captivity</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">over them four</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">kinds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to slay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03611">and the dogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05498" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to tear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and destroy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>kinds</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">families</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H02113 strong:H02189" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">them to be removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">into all kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01558">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03169">of Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, for <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cause…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">give them for a removing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For who shall have pity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">upon thee, O Jerusalem</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or who shall bemoan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee? or who shall go aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">how thou doest</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>how…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of thy peace?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou art gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">backward</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore will I stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against thee, and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thee; I am weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">with repenting</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will fan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04214">them with a fan</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I will bereave</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">of children, I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <transChange type="added">since</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">not from their ways</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>children</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">whatsoever is dear</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0490">Their widows</w> <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H02344">to me above the sand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the seas</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">upon them against the mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">of the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a spoiler</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">at noonday</w>: I have caused <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">upon it suddenly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0928">and terrors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">upon the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the mother…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the mother city a young man spoiling</rdg>, etc, or, <rdg type="alternate">the mother and the young men</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">She that hath borne</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">languisheth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05301" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she hath given up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the ghost</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08121">her sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is gone</w> down while <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03119" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">yet day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she hath been ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and confounded</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07611">and the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them will I deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">to the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0188">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">is me, my mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast borne</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">me a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">of strife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">and a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04066">of contention</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the whole earth</w>! <w lemma="strong:H05383" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have neither lent on usury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05383" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor men have lent to me on usury</w>; <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">every one of them doth curse</w> me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0518 strong:H03808">Verily</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">it shall be well</w> <w lemma="strong:H08293 strong:H08281" morph="strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8765">with thy remnant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0518">verily</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I will cause the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to entreat</w> thee <transChange type="added">well</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">and in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of affliction</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cause…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">intreat the enemy for thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01270">Shall iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">break</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">the northern</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">and the steel</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02428">Thy substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">and thy treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">to the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04242">without price</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for all thy sins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">even in all thy borders</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:14
verses.text: And I will make <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into a land</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">not: for a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06919" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in mine anger</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03344" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall burn</w> upon you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou knowest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">me, and visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">me, and revenge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me of my persecutors</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take me not away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0750 strong:H0639">in thy longsuffering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that for thy sake I have suffered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">rebuke</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Thy words</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were found</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">them; and thy word</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">was unto me the joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">and rejoicing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of mine heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for I am called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I am…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thy name is called upon me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05475">not in the assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of the mockers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor rejoiced</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0910">alone</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thy hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for thou hast filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">me with indignation</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03511">Why is my pain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">perpetual</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04347">and my wound</w> <w lemma="strong:H0605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">incurable</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">refuseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to be healed</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0391">wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar</w>, <transChange type="added">and as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">fail</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>fail</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be not sure?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">then will I bring thee again</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me: and if thou take forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03368">the precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H02151" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from the vile</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">thou shalt be as my mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee; but return</w> not thou unto them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thee unto this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">a fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">wall</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and they shall fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against thee, but they shall not prevail</w> against thee: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">with thee to save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thee and to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thee out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">thee out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">of the terrible</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen812" osisID="Jer.15"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came also unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thee a wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">neither shalt thou have sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">or daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in this place</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">concerning the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and concerning the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that are born</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">and concerning their mothers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">them, and concerning their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03209">that begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them in this land</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H08463">of grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04463">deaths</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall not be lamented</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">neither shall they be buried</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01828">they shall be as dung</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall be consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">and by famine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05038">and their carcases</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">shall be meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">for the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and for the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">not into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04798">of mourning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to lament</w> <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor bemoan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: for I have taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">my peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">lovingkindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">and mercies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mourning</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mourning feast</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">Both the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">and the small</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in this land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall not be buried</w>, neither shall <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lament</w> <w lemma="strong:H01413" morph="strongMorph:TH8704">for them, nor cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H07139" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">themselves, nor make themselves bald</w> for them:

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:7
verses.text: Neither shall <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06536" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">tear</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H060">for them in mourning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">them for the dead</w>; neither shall <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03563">give them the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H08575">of consolation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">for their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">or for their mother</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>tear…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">break bread for them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not also go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">of feasting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with them to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to drink</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will cause to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">out of this place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in your eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and in your days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">of mirth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">of gladness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02860">of the bridegroom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">of the bride</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto thee, Wherefore hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">pronounced</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">all this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> against us? or what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">our iniquity</w>? or what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">our sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that we have committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shalt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto them, Because your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have served</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">them, and have worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, and have not kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">my law</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And ye have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">worse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">than your fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02009">for, behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08307">the imagination</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of his evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they may not hearken</w> unto me:<note type="study"><catchWord>imagination</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stubbornness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02904" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Therefore will I cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you out of this land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye know</w> not, <transChange type="added">neither</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">ye nor your fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and there shall ye serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where I will not shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02594">you favour</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">Therefore, behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that it shall no more be said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and from all the lands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whither he had driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them: and I will bring them again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">into their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto their fathers</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">for many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01728 strong:H01771" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">fishers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01770" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">them; and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">for many</w> <w lemma="strong:H06719">hunters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall hunt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">them from every mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and from every hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05357">and out of the holes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of the rocks</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">For mine eyes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">upon all their ways</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they are not hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from my face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">neither is their iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">And first</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I will recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">their iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">and their sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">double</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">because they have defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">my land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">mine inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">with the carcases</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">of their detestable</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">and abominable things</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05797">my strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04581">and my fortress</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04498">and my refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">the Gentiles</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">unto thee from the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">Surely our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have inherited</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>, and <transChange type="added">things</transChange> wherein <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">no profit</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Shall a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> unto himself, and they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">no gods</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06471">Therefore, behold, I will this once</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">cause them to know</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will cause them to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">and my might</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">that my name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The <divineName>Lord</divineName></catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate"><divineName>Jehovah</divineName></rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen813" osisID="Jer.16"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:1
