verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02403">The sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05842">with a pen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06856">with the point</w> <w lemma="strong:H08068">of a diamond</w>: <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">graven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">upon the table</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of their heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07161">and upon the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of your altars</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>point</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">nail</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Whilst their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">their altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">and their groves</w> <w lemma="strong:H07488">by the green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01364">upon the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">hills</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02042">O my mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">thy substance</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0214">all thy treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">to the spoil</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01116">thy high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">throughout all thy borders</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">from thine heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee; and I will cause thee to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06919" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not: for ye have kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in mine anger</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03344" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thyself</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in thyself</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01397">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that trusteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">in man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">his arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and whose heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06199">For he shall be like the heath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the desert</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">when good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but shall inhabit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02788">the parched places</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04420">a salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not inhabited</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01397">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that trusteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04009">and whose hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> is.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06086">For he shall be as a tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H08362" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">by the waters</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spreadeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">her roots</w> <w lemma="strong:H03105">by the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02527">when heat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05929">but her leaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H07488">shall be green</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not be careful</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01226">of drought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">neither shall cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from yielding</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">fruit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>drought</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">restraint</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03820">The heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06121">deceitful</w> above all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and desperately wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who can know</w> it?

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">search</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w>, <transChange type="added">I</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">try</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">the reins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">even to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">according to his ways</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06529">according to the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of his doings</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07124">the partridge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01716" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sitteth</w> <transChange type="added">on eggs</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hatcheth</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> not; <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that getteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">riches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and not by right</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">them in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of his days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0319">and at his end</w> <w lemma="strong:H05036">shall be a fool</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sitteth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">gathereth young which she hath not brought forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03519">A glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">from the beginning</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">of our sanctuary</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04723">the hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee shall be ashamed</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03249">they that depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">from me</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be written</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04726">the fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of living</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Heal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and I shall be healed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">me, and I shall be saved</w>: for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08416">my praise</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, they say</w> unto me, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let it come</w> now.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">As for me, I have not hastened</w> from <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a pastor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">to follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">thee: neither have I desired</w> <w lemma="strong:H0605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the woeful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou knowest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04161">that which came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of my lips</w> was <transChange type="added">right</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05227">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thee</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">after thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04288">Be not a terror</w> unto me: thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04268">my hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of evil</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them be confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that persecute</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, but let not me be confounded</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let them be dismayed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">but let not me be dismayed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">upon them the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">them with double</w> <w lemma="strong:H07670">destruction</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">break them with a double breach</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me; Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">whereby the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and by the which they go out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and in all the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">ye the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">ye kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and all Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that enter in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">by these gates</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">to yourselves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">no burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">nor bring</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in by the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Neither carry forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">a burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of your houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">ye any work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">but hallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">ye the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your fathers</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But they obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">not, neither inclined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">their ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06203">but made their neck</w> <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">stiff</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they might not hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">nor receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">instruction</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">in no burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">through the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">but hallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01115">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w> therein;

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shall there enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">into the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">riding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">in chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">and on horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">they, and their princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05892">and this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05439">and from the places about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08219">and from the plain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and from the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and from the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">bringing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">and sacrifices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and meat offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03828">and incense</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and bringing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">sacrifices of praise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if ye will not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto me to hallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and not to bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">a burden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">even entering in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then will I kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, and it shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">the palaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it shall not be quenched</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen814" osisID="Jer.17"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">which came to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the potter’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and there I will cause thee to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the potter’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02009">and, behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">a work</w> <w lemma="strong:H070">on the wheels</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wheels</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">frames</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">seats</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03627">And the vessel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">of clay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was marred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the potter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">as seemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the potter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of clay…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">was marred, as clay in the hand of the potter</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>made it…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">returned and made</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Then the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came to me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with you as this potter</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H02563">Behold, as the clay</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in the potter’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, so <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">ye in mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">At what</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07281">instant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">concerning a nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">and concerning a kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to pluck up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to pull down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to destroy</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">If that nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">against whom I have pronounced</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from their evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I will repent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> unto them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:9
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">at what</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07281">instant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">concerning a nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">and concerning a kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to plant</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If it do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that it obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not my voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">then I will repent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">of the good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherewith I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">I would benefit</w> them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore go to, speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and to the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I frame</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against you, and devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">a device</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">against you: return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye now every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from his evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">and make your ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">and your doings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">good</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02976" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">There is no hope</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but we will walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">our own devices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and we will every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H08307">the imagination</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of his evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">ye now among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hath heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">such things: the virgin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H08186">horrible thing</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:14
verses.text: Will <transChange type="added">a man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07950">the snow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w> <transChange type="added">which cometh</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">from the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>? <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07119">shall the cold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">flowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">that come from another place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be forsaken</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>the snow…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">my fields for a rock, or for the snow of Lebanon? shall the running waters be forsaken for the strange cold waters?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Because my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me, they have burned incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">to vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they have caused them to stumble</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in their ways</w> <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">the ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H07635 strong:H07635" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">paths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">in paths</w>, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">a way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05549" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">not cast up</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">desolate</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H08292 strong:H08292" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">hissing</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one that passeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereby shall be astonished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and wag</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">them as with an east</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">them the back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and not the face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0343">of their calamity</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">they, Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">devices</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">against Jeremiah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08451">for the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">from the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06098">nor counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">from the wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">nor the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">from the prophet</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and let us smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">him with the tongue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and let us not give heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">to any of his words</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for the tongue</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Give heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03401">of them that contend</w> with me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">Shall evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">be recompensed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for good</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they have digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07745">a pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for my soul</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thee to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> for them, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">thy wrath</w> from them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore deliver up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">to the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05064" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and pour out</w> their <transChange type="added">blood</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the force</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802">and let their wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H07909">be bereaved</w> of their children, and <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0490">widows</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0582">and let their men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">be put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">to death</w>; <transChange type="added">let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0970">their young men</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in battle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pour…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pour them out</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02201">Let a cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from their houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">a troop</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon them: for they have digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07882 strong:H07745" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">a pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, and hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">snares</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">for my feet</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Yet, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">all their counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">against me to slay</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">not their iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">neither blot out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">their sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">but let them be overthrown</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thee; deal</w> <transChange type="added">thus</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">with them in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of thine anger</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to slay…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for death</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen815" osisID="Jer.18"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and get</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a potter’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02789">earthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01228">bottle</w>, and <transChange type="added">take</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the ancients</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and of the ancients</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">unto the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02011">of Hinnom</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">by the entry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02777">of the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">there the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that I shall tell</w> thee,<note type="study"><catchWord>the east…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the sun gate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">ye the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">upon this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the which whosoever heareth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">his ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H06750" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall tingle</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because they have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me, and have estranged</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and have burned incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">in it unto other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">whom neither they nor their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have known</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">nor the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">this place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">of innocents</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">also the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">their sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">unto Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">not, nor spake</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither came</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">into my mind</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Therefore, behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">that this place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall no more be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08612">Tophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01516">nor The valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02011">of Hinnom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01516">but The valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H02028">of slaughter</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01238" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make void</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in this place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cause them to fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and by the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of them that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their lives</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05038">and their carcases</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">to be meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">for the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and for the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08322">and an hissing</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one that passeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereby shall be astonished</w> <w lemma="strong:H08319" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">because of all the plagues</w> thereof.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will cause them to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of their sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">and the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of their daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of his friend</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">in the siege</w> <w lemma="strong:H04689">and straitness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wherewith their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and they that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their lives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06693" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall straiten</w> them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shalt thou break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01228">the bottle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that go</w> with thee,

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03602">Even so</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I break</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">and this city</w>, as <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">breaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a potter’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">be made whole again</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall bury</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08612">in Tophet</w>, till <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">no place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bury</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be made…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be healed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus will I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and to the inhabitants</w> thereof, and <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H08612">as Tophet</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02931">shall be defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">as the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H08612">of Tophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">because of all the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">upon whose roofs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they have burned incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">unto all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and have poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">drink offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08612">from Tophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whither the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">him to prophesy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to all the people</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">upon this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">and upon all her towns</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I have pronounced</w> <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">against it, because they have hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">their necks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they might not hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen816" osisID="Jer.19"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06583">Now Pashur</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0564">of Immer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06496">also chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">that Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06583">Then Pashur</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04115">him in the stocks</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05945">in the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">by the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04283">And it came to pass on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06583">that Pashur</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04115">out of the stocks</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto him, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H06583">Pashur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04036">but Magor–missabib</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Magor–missabib</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Fear round about</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04032">thee a terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to thyself, and to all thy friends</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall behold</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he shall carry them captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">into Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">them with the sword</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Moreover I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02633">all the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03018">and all the labours</w> <w lemma="strong:H03366">thereof, and all the precious things</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">thereof, and all the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which shall spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, and carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">them to Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06583">And thou, Pashur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">into captivity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there thou shalt die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and shalt be buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">there, thou, and all thy friends</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">to whom thou hast prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lies</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast deceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">me, and I was deceived</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou art stronger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">than I, and hast prevailed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07814">I am in derision</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">daily</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one mocketh</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>was deceived</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">was enticed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01767">For since</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cried out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H07701">and spoil</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01697">because the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">was made a reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07047">unto me, and a derision</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">daily</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not make mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">of him, nor speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">any more in his name</w>. But <transChange type="added">his word</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">was in mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as a burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">in my bones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and I was weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8771">with forbearing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I could</w> not <transChange type="added">stay</transChange>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01681">the defaming</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04032">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">on every side</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Report</w>, <transChange type="added">say they</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and we will report</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965 strong:H0582">it. All my familiars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">watched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06761 strong:H06763" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">for my halting</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">Peradventure he will be enticed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we shall prevail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against him, and we shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">our revenge</w> on him.<note type="study"><catchWord>All…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Every man of my peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">with me as a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">terrible one</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">therefore my persecutors</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall stumble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall not prevail</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03966">they shall be greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ashamed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for they shall not prosper</w>: <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">confusion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall never be forgotten</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that triest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">the reins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">and the heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let me see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">thy vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">on them: for unto thee have I opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">my cause</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for he hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">of the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of evildoers</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">wherein I was born</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">let not the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">wherein my mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">me be blessed</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">who brought tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02145">A man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">child</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is born</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto thee; making him very</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">glad</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And let that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">be as the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">overthrew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and repented</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not: and let him hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02201">the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08643">and the shouting</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672 strong:H06256">at noontide</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">Because he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">me not from the womb</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0517">or that my mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">might have been my grave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07358">and her womb</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">always</w> <w lemma="strong:H02030">great</w> <transChange type="added">with me</transChange>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore came I forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">out of the womb</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03015">and sorrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">that my days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should be consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">with shame</w>? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen817" osisID="Jer.20"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">which came unto Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">when king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06583">unto him Pashur</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04441">of Melchiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06846">and Zephaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04641">of Maaseiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Enquire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">I pray thee, of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">for us</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05019">for Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">maketh war</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against us; if so be that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">with us according to all his wondrous works</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he may go up</w> from us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Thus shall ye say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">to Zedekiah</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will turn back</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">the weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in your hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">wherewith ye fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, and <transChange type="added">against</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03778">the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which besiege</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">you without</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the walls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">them into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of this city</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And I myself will fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">against you with an outstretched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">and with a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">even in anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">and in fury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and in great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07110">wrath</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">both man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">pestilence</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And afterward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and such as are left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">from the pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">from the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">and from the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of those that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">them with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, neither have pity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">nor have mercy</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">And unto this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">you the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">and the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that abideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">and by the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and by the pestilence</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that goeth out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and falleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">to the Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that besiege</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421 strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">you, he shall live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and his life</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">shall be unto him for a prey</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">for evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and not for good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">it with fire</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01004">And touching the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <transChange type="added">say</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">ye the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and deliver</w> <transChange type="added">him that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the oppressor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">lest my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">like fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that none can quench</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07455">of the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of your doings</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Execute</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Judge</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:13
verses.text: Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against thee, O inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">of the valley</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H04334">of the plain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who shall come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against us? or who shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04585">into our habitations</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>inhabitant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">inhabitress</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">you according to the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of your doings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">in the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, and it shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">all things round about</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>punish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visit upon</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen818" osisID="Jer.21"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">there this word</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sittest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">thou, and thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in by these gates</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">ye judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06216">of the oppressor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and do no wrong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02554" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do no violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">to the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">nor the widow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in this place</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For if ye do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">indeed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shall there enter in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">by the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of this house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">riding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">in chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">and on horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">he, and his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and his people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>upon…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for David upon his throne</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if ye will not hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">by myself, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">that this house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">shall become a desolation</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w> unto me, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>: <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">surely I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">thee a wilderness</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427 strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8737 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8738">are not inhabited</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">destroyers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">against thee, every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with his weapons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04005">thy choice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and cast</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">into the fire</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">And many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">by this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Wherefore hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">thus unto this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then they shall answer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because they have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">ye not for the dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither bemoan</w> him: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for him that goeth away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">no more, nor see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04138">his native</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">touching</w> <w lemma="strong:H07967">Shallum</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">instead of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">out of this place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall not return</w> thither any more:

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But he shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whither they have led him captive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">this land</w> no more.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto him that buildeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">unrighteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05944">and his chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">by wrong</w>; <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">useth his neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">service</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">without wages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">him not for his work</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:14
