verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">That saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will build</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">me a wide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07304" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and large</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">chambers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and cutteth him out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">windows</w>; and <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05603" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">cieled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">with cedar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and painted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08350">with vermilion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>large</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">through-aired</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>windows</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">my windows</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shalt thou reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08474" morph="strongMorph:TH8808">because thou closest</w> <transChange type="added">thyself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0730">in cedar</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01">did not thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and justice</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> then <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">well</w> with him?

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01779">the cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">of the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w>; then <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">well</w> <transChange type="added">with him</transChange>: <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01847">not this to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">me? saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">But thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">and thine heart</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01215">not but for thy covetousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and for to shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06233">and for oppression</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04835">and for violence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>violence</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">incursion</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">concerning Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall not lament</w> for him, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01945">Ah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brother</w>! <w lemma="strong:H01945">or, Ah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w>! <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall not lament</w> for him, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01945">Ah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">lord</w>! <w lemma="strong:H01945">or, Ah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01935">his glory</w>!

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">He shall be buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06900">with the burial</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">of an ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05498" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">drawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and cast forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01973">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">to Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and cry</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thy voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">from the passages</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">for all thy lovers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are destroyed</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07962">unto thee in thy prosperity</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou saidst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not hear</w>. This <transChange type="added">hath been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thy manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">from thy youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou obeyedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not my voice</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prosperity</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">prosperities</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">The wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all thy pastors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and thy lovers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">into captivity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">surely then shalt thou be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">for all thy wickedness</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07077" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">that makest thy nest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">in the cedars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">how gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">shalt thou be when pangs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02427">upon thee, the pain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as of a woman in travail</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>inhabitant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">inhabitress</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:24
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03659">though Coniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02368">were the signet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">upon my right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet would I pluck</w> thee thence;

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thee into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of them that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hand</w> <transChange type="added">of them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">whose face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03016" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">thou fearest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">even into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02904" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will cast thee out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">and thy mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">thee, into another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">where ye were not born</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there shall ye die</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">But to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8764">whereunto they desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thither shall they not return</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>desire</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lift up their mind</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:28
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">this man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03659">Coniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06089">idol</w>? <transChange type="added">is he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">a vessel</w> wherein <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02656">no pleasure</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">wherefore are they cast out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">he and his seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02904" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">and are cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they know</w> not?

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">O earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Write</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye this man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06185">childless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01397">a man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in his days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">for no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall prosper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and ruling</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">any more in Judah</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen819" osisID="Jer.22"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">be unto the pastors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04830">of my pasture</w>! <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against the pastors</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Ye have scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">my flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and driven them away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have not visited</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them: behold, I will visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07455">upon you the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of your doings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I will gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of my flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of all countries</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whither I have driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, and will bring them again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">to their folds</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall be fruitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and increase</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">over them which shall feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them: and they shall fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">no more, nor be dismayed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">neither shall they be lacking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I will raise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">a righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H06780">Branch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and a King</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and prosper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and justice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be saved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safely</w>: and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whereby he shall be called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03072">THE <divineName>LORD</divineName> OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>THE <divineName>LORD</divineName>…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Jehovah–tsidkenu</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Therefore, behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they shall no more say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and which led</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">out of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and from all countries</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whither I had driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them; and they shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in their own land</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03820">Mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">me is broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">because of the prophets</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06106">all my bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H07363" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shake</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07910">I am like a drunken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01397">and like a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">whom wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath overcome</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and because of the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of his holiness</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">For the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of adulterers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">for because</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">of swearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">mourneth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04999">the pleasant places</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are dried up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04794">and their course</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">is evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and their force</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not right.<note type="study"><catchWord>swearing</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cursing</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>course</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">violence</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">For both prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">and priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02610" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are profane</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">yea, in my house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">their wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">Wherefore their way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02519">shall be unto them as slippery</w> <transChange type="added">ways</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0653">in the darkness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01760" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall be driven on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therein: for I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> upon them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">of their visitation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08604">folly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">in the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">they prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">in Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and caused my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to err</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>folly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">an absurd thing</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">unsavoury</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">also in the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08186">an horrible thing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they commit adultery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">in lies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">also the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of evildoers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that none</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">doth return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from his wickedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05467">they are all of them unto me as Sodom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">thereof as Gomorrah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">filthiness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">concerning the prophets</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03939">them with wormwood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and make them drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H07219">of gall</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05030">for from the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02613">is profaneness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gone forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into all the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>profaneness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hypocrisy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not unto the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01891" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">unto you: they make you vain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">a vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of their own heart</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">not out of the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">still</w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">unto them that despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">Ye shall have peace</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto every one that walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08307">after the imagination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of his own heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">No evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> upon you.<note type="study"><catchWord>imagination</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stubbornness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For who hath stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05475">in the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hath perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his word</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">who hath marked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>?<note type="study"><catchWord>counsel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">secret</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05591">Behold, a whirlwind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is gone forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">in fury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8711">even a grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05591">whirlwind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall fall grievously</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">The anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until he have executed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and till he have performed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04209">the thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of his heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0319">in the latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">ye shall consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">it perfectly</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">these prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet they ran</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have not spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">to them, yet they prophesied</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But if they had stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05475">in my counsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and had caused my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">then they should have turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">them from their evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07455">and from the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of their doings</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:23
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">I a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">at hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and not a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Can any</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04565">himself in secret places</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I shall not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">him? saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H04392">Do not I fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">what the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have dreamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have dreamed</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:26
verses.text: How long shall <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03426">be</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lies</w>? yea, <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H08649">of the deceit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of their own heart</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Which think</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to cause my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">by their dreams</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">which they tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">as their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">for Baal</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">The prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">that hath a dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">let him tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">a dream</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01697">and he that hath my word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">let him speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">faithfully</w>. What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08401">the chaff</w> <w lemma="strong:H01250">to the wheat</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that hath a dream</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with whom is</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:29
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not my word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03541">like</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">as a fire</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06360">and like a hammer</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8787" type="x-split-348">breaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8787" type="x-split-348">in pieces</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:30
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">against the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that steal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">from his neighbour</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:31
verses.text: Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">against the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that use</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">their tongues</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">He saith</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that smooth their tongues</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:32
verses.text: Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">against them that prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">false</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">dreams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and do tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">them, and cause my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to err</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">by their lies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06350">and by their lightness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them not, nor commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them: therefore they shall not profit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">at all</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">And when this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">or the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">or a priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, saying</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04853">the burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou shalt then say</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">unto them, What burden</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will even forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:34
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will even punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and his house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>punish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visit upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shall ye say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">What hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">answered</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">and, What hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spoken</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04853">And the burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no more: for every man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">shall be his burden</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for ye have perverted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shalt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">to the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">What hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee? and, What hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spoken</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0518">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">since ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Because ye say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto you, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05382" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you, and I will forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">you, and the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">you and your fathers</w>, <transChange type="added">and cast you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">out of my presence</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">upon you, and a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H03640">shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which shall not be forgotten</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen820" osisID="Jer.23"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">me, and, behold, two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01736">baskets</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">of figs</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">that Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">had carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03204">Jeconiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02796">with the carpenters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04525">and smiths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and had brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">them to Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">One</w> <w lemma="strong:H01731">basket</w> <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">figs</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08384">like the figs</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01073">first ripe</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H01731">basket</w> <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">naughty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">figs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which could not be eaten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07455">they were so bad</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for badness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto me, What seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">thou, Jeremiah</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08384">Figs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">figs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07451">and the evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that cannot be eaten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07455">they are so evil</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Again the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02896">Like these good</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">figs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so will I acknowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01546">them that are carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whom I have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">out of this place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w> for <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>them…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the captivity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">upon them for good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring them again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to this land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will build</w> them, and not pull <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">down</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will plant</w> them, and not pluck <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">up</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">them an heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to know</w> me, that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and they shall be my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and I will be their God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">unto me with their whole heart</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07451">And as the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">figs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which cannot be eaten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07455">they are so evil</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">surely thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and his princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07611">and the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and them that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02113 strong:H02189" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">them to be removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">into all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> for <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">hurt</w>, <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02781">a reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">and a proverb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08148">a taunt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">and a curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">in all places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">whither I shall drive</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>to be removed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for removing</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">vexation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and the pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">among them, till they be consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">from off the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto them and to their fathers</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 24." eID="gen821" osisID="Jer.24"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">that came to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">concerning all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07243">in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07224">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03414">The which Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and to all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">From the thirteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0526">of Amon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">even unto this day</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hath come unto me, and I have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">unto you, rising early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and speaking</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but ye have not hearkened</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto you all his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">rising early</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and sending</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but ye have not hearkened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">nor inclined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">your ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hear</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">They said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn ye again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">now every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from his evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07455">and from the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of your doings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto you and to your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">and ever</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">not after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">them, and to worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and provoke me not to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">with the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of your hands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will do you no hurt</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet ye have not hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that ye might provoke me to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">with the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of your hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">to your own hurt</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because ye have not heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">all the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05019">and Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them against this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and against the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">thereof, and against all these nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will utterly destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">them an astonishment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08322">and an hissing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">and perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">desolations</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Moreover I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">from them the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">of mirth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">of gladness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02860">of the bridegroom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">of the bride</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07347">of the millstones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">and the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">of the candle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I will…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I will cause to perish from them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And this whole land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">shall be a desolation</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08047">an astonishment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01471">and these nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07657">And it shall come to pass, when seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">are accomplished</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">and that nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">for their iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">it perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>punish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visit upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon that land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I have pronounced</w> against it, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">all that is written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in this book</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03414">which Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">against all the nations</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">For many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">themselves of them also: and I will recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">them according to their deeds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">and according to the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their own hands</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me; Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">the wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">of this fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at my hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">and cause all the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to whom I send</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee, to drink</w> it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01607" morph="strongMorph:TH8707">and be moved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8703">and be mad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I will send</w> among them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">I the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">at the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">and made all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had sent</w> me:

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">To wit</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">thereof, and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof, to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">them a desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08047">an astonishment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08322">an hissing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07045">and a curse</w>; as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and his princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all his people</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06153">And all the mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">people, and all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05780">of Uz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0831">and Ashkelon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05804">and Azzah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06138">and Ekron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07611">and the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0795">of Ashdod</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0123">Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04124">and Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyrus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">of Zidon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">of the isles</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>isles</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">region by the sea side</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01719">Dedan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08485">and Tema</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0938">and Buz</w>, and all <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07112" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">in the utmost</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">corners</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cut off into corners</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">having the corners of the hair polled</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06152">of Arabia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">of the mingled people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the desert</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02174">of Zimri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05867">of Elam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04074">of the Medes</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07350">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">and near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">and all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the world</w>, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08347">of Sheshach</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, and be drunken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07006" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and spue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">no more, because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I will send</w> among you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And it shall be, if they refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shalt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Ye shall certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drink</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">For, lo, I begin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">on the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">and should ye be utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">unpunished</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">Ye shall not be unpunished</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for I will call</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">for a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon which my name is called</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Therefore prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thou against them all these words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto them, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall roar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">from on high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">from his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04583">habitation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall mightily</w> <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">roar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">upon his habitation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01959">a shout</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as they that tread</w> <transChange type="added">the grapes</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07588">A noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">to the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">hath a controversy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">with the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">he will plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">with all flesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he will give</w> them <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07563">wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">to the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">Behold, evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">from nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">to nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05591">whirlwind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be raised up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">from the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02491">And the slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">shall be at that day</w> from <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> even unto the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall not be lamented</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">neither gathered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor buried</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01828">they shall be dung</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the ground</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:34
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye shepherds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and cry</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06428" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and wallow</w> yourselves <transChange type="added">in the ashes</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0117">ye principal</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flock</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02873" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of your slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08600">and of your dispersions</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are accomplished</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02532">like a pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the days…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">your days for slaughter</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a pleasant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a vessel of desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H04498">shall have no way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to flee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0117">nor the principal</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">to escape</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the shepherds…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">flight shall perish from the shepherds, and escaping from</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">A voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06818">of the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the shepherds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03215">and an howling</w> <w lemma="strong:H0117">of the principal</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flock</w>, <transChange type="added">shall be heard</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hath spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04830">their pasture</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07965">And the peaceable</w> <w lemma="strong:H04999">habitations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">of the fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05520">his covert</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03715">as the lion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">for their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">is desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">of the fierceness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the oppressor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">of his fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>desolate</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a desolation</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 25." eID="gen822" osisID="Jer.25"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07225">In the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04468">of the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">came this word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thee to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them; diminish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not a word</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If so be they will hearken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from his evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that I may repent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">me of the evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I purpose</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto them because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07455">of the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of their doings</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If ye will not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to me, to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in my law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> you,

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">to the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whom I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">unto you, both rising up early</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and sending</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but ye have not hearkened</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then will I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">this house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">like Shiloh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">a curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">to all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">So the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">and the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03414">Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">that the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">and the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Why hast thou prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">This house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">shall be like Shiloh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">without an inhabitant</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">against Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08269">When the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then they came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">from the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">in the entry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">of the new</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">house</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">at the door</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">and the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">unto the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and to all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">This man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">worthy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">to die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for he hath prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as ye have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">with your ears</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>This man…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">The judgment of death is for this man</rdg></note>
