verses.name: Jeremiah 26:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">unto all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and to all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">me to prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">against this house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">and against this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye have heard</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Therefore now amend</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">your ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">and your doings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">will repent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">him of the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he hath pronounced</w> against you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:14
verses.text: As for me, behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in your hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with me as seemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">and meet</w> unto you.<note type="study"><catchWord>as…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as it is good and right in your eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ye for certain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that if ye put me to death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye shall surely bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">upon yourselves, and upon this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and upon the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">thereof: for of a truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">me unto you to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in your ears</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">and to the prophets</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">This man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">not worthy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">to die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for he hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">to us in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">to all the assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04320">Micah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04183">the Morasthite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">of Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be plowed</w> <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">a field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05856">shall become heaps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">as the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of a forest</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02396">Did Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">put him at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to death</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03373">did he not fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and besought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">repented</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">him of the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he had pronounced</w> <w lemma="strong:H0587">against them? Thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">might we procure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">against our souls</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and the</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the face of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And there was also a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">that prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0223">Urijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">of Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07157">of Kirjath–jearim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">who prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and against this land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03079">And when Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">with all his mighty men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and all the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to put him to death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0223">but when Urijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, he was afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03079">And Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0494">Elnathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05907">of Achbor</w>, and <transChange type="added">certain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">with him into Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they fetched forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">Urijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">him unto Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">him with the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">his dead body</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">into the graves</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the common</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>common…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sons of the people</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Nevertheless the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">of Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">was with Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they should not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to put him to death</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 26." eID="gen823" osisID="Jer.26"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07225">In the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">came this word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">unto Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to me; Make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04147">thee bonds</w> <w lemma="strong:H04133">and yokes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">them upon thy neck</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>saith…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName> said</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">them to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983 strong:H01121">of the Ammonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyrus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">of Zidon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">of the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">unto Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And command</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them to say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto their masters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shall ye say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto your masters</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>to say…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">concerning their masters, saying</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and the beast</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">by my great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and by my outstretched</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">it unto whom it seemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">meet</w> unto me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And now have I given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">all these lands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02416">and the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him also to serve</w> him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">And all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">him, and his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">until the very time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of his land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">come</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07227">and then many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall serve</w> themselves of him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:8
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">and kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which will not serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">the same Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and that will not put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">their neck</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">under the yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">that nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I punish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">and with the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and with the pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until I have consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them by his hand</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">not ye to your prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor to your diviners</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02472">nor to your dreamers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06049" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">nor to your enchanters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03786">nor to your sorcerers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto you, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>dreamers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">dreams</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">For they prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">a lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">unto you, to remove you far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">from your land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and that I should drive you out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye should perish</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">But the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">their neck</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">under the yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him, those will I let remain still</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in their own land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall till</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, and dwell</w> therein.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">also to Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to all these words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">your necks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">under the yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">him and his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and live</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Why will ye die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">thou and thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">by the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and by the pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">against the nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that will not serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not unto the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto you, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">for they prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">a lie</w> unto you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I have not sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">yet they prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">a lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in my name</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I might drive you out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and that ye might perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">ye, and the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that prophesy</w> unto you.<note type="study"><catchWord>a lie</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in a lie</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">lyingly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Also I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">to the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and to all this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not to the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of your prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto you, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">Behold, the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">shall now shortly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">be brought again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">from Babylon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">for they prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">a lie</w> unto you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">not unto them; serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and live</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05892">wherefore should this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">be laid waste</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:18
verses.text: But if they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and if the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">be</w> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with them, let them now make intercession</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">that the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which are left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, and <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">not to Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">concerning the pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">and concerning the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04350">and concerning the bases</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">and concerning the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">of the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in this city</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05019">Which Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not, when he carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03204">Jeconiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02715">and all the nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yea, thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">concerning the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that remain</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, and <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and of Jerusalem</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">They shall be carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and there shall they be until the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then will I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them up, and restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">them to this place</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 27." eID="gen824" osisID="Jer.27"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141">And it came to pass the same year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07225">in the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">of Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07243">in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02549">in the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02608">Hananiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05809">of Azur</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01391">of Gibeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto me in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and of all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">the yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Within two full</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">will I bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">into this place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05019">that Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">from this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">them to Babylon</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>two…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">two years of days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And I will bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to this place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03204">Jeconiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01546">with all the captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">into Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will break</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">the yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>captives</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">captivity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05030">Then the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">unto the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02608">Hananiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">Even the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">so: the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which thou hast prophesied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01473">and all that is carried away captive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0894">from Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">into this place</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Nevertheless hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thou now this word</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in thine ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">and in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">The prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">that have been before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">me and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">thee of old</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">both against many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">countries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and against great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">kingdoms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and of evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and of pestilence</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">The prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which prophesieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">when the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall come to pass</w>, <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H0227">then</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">shall the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be known</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">hath truly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02608">Then Hananiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04133">the yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">from off the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brake</w> it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02608">And Hananiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Even so will I break</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">the yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">from the neck</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">within the space of two full</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05030">And the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Then the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">came unto Jeremiah</w> <transChange type="added">the prophet</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02608">that Hananiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04133">the yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">from off the neck</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02608">Hananiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04133">the yokes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of wood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04133">for them yokes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">a yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">upon the neck</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of all these nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they may serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him: and I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">him the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> also.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02608">unto Hananiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02608">now, Hananiah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thee; but thou makest this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">in a lie</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Behold, I will cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thee from off the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08141">this year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">thou shalt die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because thou hast taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H05627">rebellion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rebellion</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">revolt</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02608">So Hananiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the same year</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 28." eID="gen825" osisID="Jer.28"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:1
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of the letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">that Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">unto the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">which were carried away captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and to the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and to the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and to all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">whom Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:2
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H03204">that Jeconiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01377">and the queen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05631">and the eunuchs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02796">and the carpenters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04525">and the smiths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w>;)<note type="study"><catchWord>eunuchs</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chamberlains</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">By the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0501">of Elasah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">of Shaphan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01587">and Gemariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">of Hilkiah</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H06667">whom Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">unto Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">to Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>) <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01473">unto all that are carried away captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom I have caused to be carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">unto Babylon</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">ye houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and dwell</w> <transChange type="added">in them</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01593">gardens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> of them;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">ye wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and beget</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for your sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">your daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">to husbands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and daughters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">that ye may be increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there, and not diminished</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">the peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whither I have caused you to be carried away captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">for it: for in the peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">thereof shall ye have peace</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05030">Let not your prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and your diviners</w>, that <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of you, deceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, neither hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">to your dreams</w> <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which ye cause to be dreamed</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">For they prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsely</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto you in my name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>falsely</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in a lie</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">That after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be accomplished</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">at Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">you, and perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">my good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">toward you, in causing you to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to this place</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">the thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I think</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">toward you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04284">thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and not of evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">you an expected</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">end</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>expected…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">end and expectation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shall ye call</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon me, and ye shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, and I will hearken</w> unto you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And ye shall seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, and find</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when ye shall search</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">for me with all your heart</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And I will be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622 strong:H07622" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">your captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and I will gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">you from all the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">and from all the places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whither I have driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring you again</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">into the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whence I caused you to be carried away captive</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because ye have said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath raised us up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">in Babylon</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:16
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Know</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and of all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in this city</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that are not gone forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">with you into captivity</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Behold, I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">upon them the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and the pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08182">them like vile</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">figs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that cannot be eaten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07455">they are so evil</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will persecute</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">them</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">with the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and with the pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02113 strong:H02189" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">them to be removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">to all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0423">to be a curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08047">and an astonishment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08322">and an hissing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02781">and a reproach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">among all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whither I have driven</w> them:<note type="study"><catchWord>to be a curse</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for a curse</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because they have not hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">to my words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto them by my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">rising up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and sending</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but ye would not hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">ye therefore the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01473">all ye of the captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whom I have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06964">of Kolaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06667">and of Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04641">of Maaseiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">a lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto you in my name</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">them before your eyes</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">And of them shall be taken up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">a curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01546">by all the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0894">in Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">thee like Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">and like Ahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07033" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">roasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because they have committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05039">villany</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">adultery</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">with their neighbours’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I have not commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them; even I know</w>, and <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">a witness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">Thus</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou also speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">to Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05161">the Nehelamite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Nehelamite</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dreamer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because thou hast sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06846">and to Zephaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04641">of Maaseiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and to all the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">thee priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">in the stead of Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06496">that ye should be officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">for every man</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07696" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">mad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and maketh himself a prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou shouldest put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04115">him in prison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06729">and in the stocks</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Now therefore why hast thou not reproved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06069">of Anathoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">which maketh himself a prophet</w> to you?

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For therefore he sent</w> unto us <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0894">Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01931">This</w> <transChange type="added">captivity is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0752">long</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">ye houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and dwell</w> <transChange type="added">in them</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01593">gardens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> of them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06846">And Zephaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">read</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">this letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Then came the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">unto Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Send</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">to all them of the captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">concerning Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05161">the Nehelamite</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08098">Because that Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto you, and I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him not, and he caused you to trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">in a lie</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05161">the Nehelamite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and his seed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">he shall not have a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall he behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because he hath taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H05627">rebellion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rebellion</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">revolt</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 29." eID="gen826" osisID="Jer.29"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">that came to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Write</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thee all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">unto thee in a book</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For, lo, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I will bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cause them to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall possess</w> it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">concerning Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and concerning Judah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02731">of trembling</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06343">of fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">and not of peace</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of fear…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">there is fear, and not peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye now, and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">whether a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doth travail with child</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherefore do I see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02504">on his loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as a woman in travail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and all faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03420">into paleness</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>a man</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a male</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Alas</w>! <w lemma="strong:H03117">for that day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0369">so that</w> none <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like it: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">even the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">trouble</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">but he shall be saved</w> out of it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will break</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">his yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">from off thy neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and will burst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04147">thy bonds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall no more serve</w> themselves of him:

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But they shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">their king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">whom I will raise up</w> unto them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thou not, O my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">neither be dismayed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">for, lo, I will save</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">thee from afar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">of their captivity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall be in rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07599" morph="strongMorph:TH8768">and be quiet</w>, and none shall make <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">afraid</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:11
verses.text: For I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">with thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to save</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee: though I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">a full end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whither I have scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, yet will I not make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">a full end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">of thee: but I will correct</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thee in measure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and will not leave thee altogether</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unpunished</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07667">Thy bruise</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">incurable</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04347">thy wound</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">grievous</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none to plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01779">thy cause</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04205">that thou mayest be bound up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08585">thou hast no healing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07499">medicines</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for binding up</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">pressing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">All thy lovers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee; they seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee not; for I have wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">thee with the wound</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of an enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04148">with the chastisement</w> <w lemma="strong:H0394">of a cruel one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">for the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">of thine iniquity</w>; <transChange type="added">because</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">thy sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were increased</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Why criest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">thou for thine affliction</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04341">thy sorrow</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">incurable</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">of thine iniquity</w>: <transChange type="added">because</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">thy sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were increased</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have done</w> these things unto thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Therefore all they that devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thee shall be devoured</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06862">and all thine adversaries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">every one of them, shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">into captivity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08154 strong:H07601" morph="strongMorph:TH8802 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8802">and they that spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04933">thee shall be a spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all that prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon thee will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">for a prey</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For I will restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0724">health</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, and I will heal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">thee of thy wounds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thee an Outcast</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whom no man seeketh after</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">on his dwellingplaces</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08510">upon her own heap</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0759">and the palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">after the manner</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>heap</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">little hill</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And out of them shall proceed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">thanksgiving</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of them that make merry</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and they shall not be few</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I will also glorify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and they shall not be small</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">also shall be as aforetime</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">and their congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, and I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">all that oppress</w> them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0117">And their nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall be of themselves, and their governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall proceed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">of them; and I will cause him to draw near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and he shall approach</w> unto me: for who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this that engaged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to approach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto me? saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And ye shall be my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and I will be your God</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05591">Behold, the whirlwind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">goeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">with fury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01641" morph="strongMorph:TH8706">a continuing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05591">whirlwind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall fall with pain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>continuing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cutting</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>fall…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">remain</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02740">The fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until he have done</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and until he have performed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04209">the intents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of his heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0319">in the latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">ye shall consider</w> it. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 30." eID="gen827" osisID="Jer.30"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">At the same time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">will I be the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of all the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and they shall be my people</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">The people</w> <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08300">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07280" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cause him to rest</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">of old</w> unto me, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yea, I have loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">thee with an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">love</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">therefore with lovingkindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I drawn</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from afar</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>with lovingkindness…</catchWord>: <rdg type="x-literal">have I extended lovingkindness unto thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Again I will build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thee, and thou shalt be built</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01330">O virgin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05710" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt again be adorned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08596">with thy tabrets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04234">in the dances</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of them that make merry</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>tabrets</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">timbrels</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:5
