verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt yet plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">vines</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the planters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall plant</w>, and shall eat <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as common things</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>eat…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">profane them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">For there shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the watchmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye, and let us go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">to Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with gladness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">for Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06670" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and shout</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">among the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">publish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">ye, praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07611">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">them from the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">them from the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05787">with them the blind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06455">and the lame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02030">the woman with child</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and her that travaileth with child</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">company</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return</w> thither.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">with weeping</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08469">and with supplications</w> <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them: I will cause them to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">by the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">in a straight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">wherein they shall not stumble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">for I am a father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0669">and Ephraim</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">my firstborn</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>supplications</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">favours</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">O ye nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and declare</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0339">in the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">afar off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He that scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him, as a shepherd</w> <transChange type="added">doth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05739">his flock</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ransomed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him from the hand</w> of <transChange type="added">him that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02389">stronger</w> than he.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore they shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">in the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05102" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall flow together</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">to the goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01715">for wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">and for wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">and for oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and for the young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and of the herd</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">and their soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07302">shall be as a watered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">garden</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01669" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and they shall not sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">any more</w> at all.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01330">Then shall the virgin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04234">in the dance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0970">both young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">and old</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I will turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">their mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">into joy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and will comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them, and make them rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03015">from their sorrow</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07301" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will satiate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01880">with fatness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">with my goodness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06963">A voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">in Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05092">lamentation</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08563">bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">weeping</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07354">Rahel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">weeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for her children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to be comforted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for her children</w>, because they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> not.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Refrain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thy voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">from weeping</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">from tears</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06468">for thy work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">rewarded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the enemy</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">And there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">in thine end</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">that thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">to their own border</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I have surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8711">bemoaning</w> himself <transChange type="added">thus</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou hast chastised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">me, and I was chastised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05695">as a bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925 strong:H03808" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">unaccustomed</w> <transChange type="added">to the yoke</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou me, and I shall be turned</w>; for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">Surely after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I was turned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I repented</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that I was instructed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05606" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I smote</w> upon <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03409">thigh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I was ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">yea, even confounded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because I did bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">the reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of my youth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H03357">my dear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>? <transChange type="added">is he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08191">a pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">child</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01767">for since</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against him, I do earnestly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">him still: therefore my bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">for him; I will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">upon him, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>are…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sound</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Set thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06725">waymarks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08564">thee high heaps</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">toward the highway</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou wentest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01330">O virgin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to these thy cities</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02559" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">How long wilt thou go about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07728">O thou backsliding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath created</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">a new thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05347">A woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">shall compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">a man</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">As yet they shall use</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">and in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof, when I shall bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">their captivity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">thee, O habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of justice</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of holiness</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And there shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">itself, and in all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">thereof together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0406">husbandmen</w>, and they <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">with flocks</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07301" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">For I have satiated</w> <w lemma="strong:H05889">the weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and I have replenished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01669" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">every sorrowful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Upon this I awaked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and beheld</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08142">and my sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06149" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was sweet</w> unto me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I will sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">with the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and with the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of beast</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:28
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">like as I have watched over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, to pluck up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to break down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to throw down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to destroy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to afflict</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08245" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so will I watch over</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, to build</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to plant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">no more, The fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01155">a sour grape</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">teeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06949" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are set on edge</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">But every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for his own iniquity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0120">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01155">the sour grape</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08127">his teeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06949" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be set on edge</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and with the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01285">Not according to the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01285">which my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they brake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">although I was an husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>although…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">should I have continued an husband unto them?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:33
verses.text: But this <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">those days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">my law</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in their inward parts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and write</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">it in their hearts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">and will be their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and they shall be my people</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they shall teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no more every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they shall all know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">me, from the least</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of them unto the greatest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">their iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">their sin</w> no more.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">for a light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">by day</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">the ordinances</w> <w lemma="strong:H03394">of the moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">and of the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">for a light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07280" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which divideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">when the waves</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof roar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02706">If those ordinances</w> <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also shall cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">from being a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me for ever</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08064">If heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">can be measured</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04146">and the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">searched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">beneath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will also cast off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">all the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for all that they have done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:38
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">that the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be built</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">from the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H02606">of Hananeel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">unto the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">of the corner</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04060">And the measuring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06961 strong:H06957" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">line</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall yet go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">over against it upon the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01619">Gareb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and shall compass about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01601">to Goath</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06010">And the whole valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H06297">of the dead bodies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01880">and of the ashes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08309 strong:H07709" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and all the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06939">of Kidron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06438">unto the corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">of the horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">toward the east</w>, <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall not be plucked up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor thrown down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">any more for ever</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 31." eID="gen828" osisID="Jer.31"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">that came to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06224">in the tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">of Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H06240 strong:H08083">the eighteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadrezzar</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">For then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">army</w> <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03414">and Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">was shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">of the prison</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06667">For Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had shut him up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Wherefore dost thou prophesy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall take</w> it;

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06667">And Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">but shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with him mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he shall lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and there shall he be until I visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">him, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">though ye fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">with the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall not prosper</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03414">And Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02601">Behold, Hanameel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07967">of Shallum</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">thine uncle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">thee my field</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06068">in Anathoth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04941">for the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H01353">of redemption</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thine to buy</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02601">So Hanameel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">mine uncle’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">to me in the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">of the prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">my field</w>, I pray thee, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06068">in Anathoth</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04941">for the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03425">of inheritance</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01353">thine, and the redemption</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thine; buy</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thyself. Then I knew</w> that this <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H02601">of Hanameel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">my uncle’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06068">in Anathoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and weighed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">him the money</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235 strong:H07651">seventeen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>seventeen…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">seven shekels and ten pieces of silver</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I subscribed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the evidence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sealed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witnesses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and weighed</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H03976">in the balances</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>subscribed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wrote in the book</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the evidence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04736">of the purchase</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that which was sealed</w> <transChange type="added">according</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04687">to the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">and custom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and that which was open</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the evidence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04736">of the purchase</w> <w lemma="strong:H01263">unto Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05374">of Neriah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04271">of Maaseiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02601">of Hanameel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">mine uncle’s</w> <transChange type="added">son</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">of the witnesses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that subscribed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04736">of the purchase</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">all the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">of the prison</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01263">Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">these evidences</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05612">this evidence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04736">of the purchase</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">both which is sealed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05612">and this evidence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">which is open</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02789">them in an earthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may continue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">Houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">and fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">and vineyards</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be possessed again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in this land</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">Now when</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I had delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the evidence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04736">of the purchase</w> <w lemma="strong:H01263">unto Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05374">of Neriah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">I prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0162">Ah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>! <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">behold, thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">by thy great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">there is nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">too hard</w> for thee:<note type="study"><catchWord>too…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hid from thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Thou shewest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">lovingkindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">unto thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and recompensest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">into the bosom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">them: the Great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">the Mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">Great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">in counsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05950">in work</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">for thine eyes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">open</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">upon all the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">according to his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and according to the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of his doings</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>work</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">doing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Which hast set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">and wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and in Israel</w>, and among <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thee a name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as at this day</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And hast brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">with signs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04159">and with wonders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">and with a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and with a stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0248">arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04172">terror</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which thou didst swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them, a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">flowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it; but they obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not thy voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in thy law</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">nothing of all that thou commandedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them to do</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07451">therefore thou hast caused all this evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to come</w> upon them:

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05550">Behold the mounts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">it; and the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">against it, because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">and of the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and of the pestilence</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and what thou hast spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mounts</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">engines of shot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou hast said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">unto me, O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">thee the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witnesses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05892">for the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for the</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">though the</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Then came the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">unto Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:27
verses.text: Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of all flesh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">is there any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">too hard</w> for me?

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall take</w> it:

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03778">And the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">on this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">it with the houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01406">upon whose roofs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they have offered incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">unto Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">drink offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to provoke me to anger</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">For the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">have only done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">me from their youth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">have only provoked me to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">with the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">For this city</w> hath been to me <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">a provocation of mine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">and of my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they built</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">it even unto this day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I should remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it from before my face</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>a provocation…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for my anger</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">Because of all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to provoke me to anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">they, their kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">their princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">their priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and their prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they have turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">unto me the back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and not the face</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">though I taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">them, rising up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and teaching</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">yet they have not hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">instruction</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>back</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">neck</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But they set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">their abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to defile</w> it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01516">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02011">of Hinnom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">to cause their sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and their daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to pass</w> through <transChange type="added">the fire</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04432">unto Molech</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them not, neither came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">it into my mind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they should do</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">this abomination</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">to cause Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to sin</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:36
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And now therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">concerning this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whereof ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">It shall be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">and by the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and by the pestilence</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Behold, I will gather them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all countries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whither I have driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">them in mine anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">and in my fury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and in great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07110">wrath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring them again</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cause them to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safely</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And they shall be my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and I will be their God</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">them one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they may fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">for the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of them, and of their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> them:<note type="study"><catchWord>for ever</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with them, that I will not turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to do them good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but I will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">my fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in their hearts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they shall not depart</w> from me.<note type="study"><catchWord>from them</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from after them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yea, I will rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">over them to do them good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them in this land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">assuredly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">with my whole heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with my whole soul</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>assuredly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in truth</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">stability</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Like as I have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">all this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">upon this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">so will I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">upon them all the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I have promised</w> them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07704">And fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whereof ye say</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">without man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">or beast</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">it is given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Men shall buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and subscribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">evidences</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and seal</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witnesses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05439">and in the places about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08219">of the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07622">for I will cause their captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 32." eID="gen829" osisID="Jer.32"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Moreover the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">came unto Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">time, while he was yet shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">of the prison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the maker</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thereof, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">it, to establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it; the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate"><divineName>Jehovah</divineName></rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Call</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, and I will answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee, and shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">thee great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and mighty things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou knowest</w> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>mighty</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hidden</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">concerning the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and concerning the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">which are thrown down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05550">by the mounts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">and by the sword</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">with the Chaldeans</w>, but <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06297">them with the dead bodies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom I have slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in mine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">and in my fury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and for all whose wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from this city</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0724">it health</w> <w lemma="strong:H04832">and cure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will cure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them, and will reveal</w> <w lemma="strong:H06283">unto them the abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07622">And I will cause the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">and the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will build</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">them, as at the first</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">them from all their iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whereby they have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against me; and I will pardon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">all their iniquities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whereby they have sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and whereby they have transgressed</w> against me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08034">And it shall be to me a name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">of joy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08416">a praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">and an honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">before all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">all the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them: and they shall fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and tremble</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for all the goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">and for all the prosperity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I procure</w> unto it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Again there shall be heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which ye say</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02720">desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">without man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and without beast</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02351">and in the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that are desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">without man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and without inhabitant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and without beast</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">The voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">of joy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">of gladness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02860">of the bridegroom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">of the bride</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of them that shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">the sacrifice of praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For I will cause to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">as at the first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04725">Again in this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02720">which is desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">without man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and without beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and in all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">thereof, shall be an habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of shepherds</w> causing <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06629">flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to lie down</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">In the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08219">of the vale</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05439">and in the places about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">shall the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pass again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that telleth</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I will perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">that good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I have promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06780">will I cause the Branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">of righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to grow up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">shall Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be saved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safely</w>: and this <transChange type="added">is the name</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherewith she shall be called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03072">The <divineName>Lord</divineName> our righteousness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The <divineName>Lord</divineName>…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Jehovah–tsidkenu</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">shall never</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">want</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>David…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">There shall not be cut off from David</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Neither shall the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">want</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">me to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and to kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">meat offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">continually</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">came unto Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">If ye can break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of the day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01285">and my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">of the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03119">and that there should not be day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in their season</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:21
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01285">may also my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">with David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">that he should not have a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon his throne</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03881">and with the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">my ministers</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">As the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">cannot be numbered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02344">neither the sand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">measured</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so will I multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that minister</w> unto me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Moreover the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">came to Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Considerest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thou not what this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">The two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">families</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath chosen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he hath even cast them off</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thus they have despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">that they should be no more a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01285">If my covenant</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03119">not with day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w>, <transChange type="added">and if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">the ordinances</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01571">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I cast away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I will not take</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of his seed</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">over the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03446">Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07622">for I will cause their captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">to return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and have mercy</w> on them. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 33." eID="gen830" osisID="Jer.33"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">which came unto Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05019">when Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">and all his army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">and all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04475 strong:H03027">of his dominion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and against all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof, saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>of his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the dominion of his hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">to Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">it with fire</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And thou shalt not escape out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be taken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into his hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">and thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with thee mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he shall…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his mouth shall speak to thy mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:4
