verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Yet hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06667">O Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of thee, Thou shalt not die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt die</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04955">and with the burnings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">which were before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, so shall they burn</w> <transChange type="added">odours</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thee; and they will lament</w> thee, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01945">Ah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">lord</w>! <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for I have pronounced</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03414">Then Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">unto Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">When the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">army</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and against all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that were left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03923">against Lachish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05825">and against Azekah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04013">for these defenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">This is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">that came unto Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with all the people</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01865">liberty</w> unto them;

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">That every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">should let his manservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">his maidservant</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05680">an Hebrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">or an Hebrewess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02670">free</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that none should serve</w> himself of them, <transChange type="added">to wit</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03064">of a Jew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Now when all the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which had entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">into the covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">that every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">should let his manservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">his maidservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02670">free</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that none should serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">themselves of them any more, then they obeyed</w>, and let <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">go</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">But afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they turned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and caused the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">and the handmaids</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whom they had let go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02670">free</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03533 strong:H03533" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">and brought them into subjection</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">and for handmaids</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Therefore the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">came to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I brought them forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of bondmen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07093">At the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">of seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">let ye go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">an Hebrew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which hath been sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto thee; and when he hath served</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">thee six</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou shalt let him go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02670">free</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">from thee: but your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">not unto me, neither inclined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">their ear</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hath been…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hath sold himself</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And ye were now</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in proclaiming</w> <w lemma="strong:H01865">liberty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to his neighbour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">me in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by my name</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>now</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to day</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">whereupon my name is called</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But ye turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and caused every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">his handmaid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whom ye had set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02670">at liberty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">at their pleasure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03533" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brought them into subjection</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">to be unto you for servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">and for handmaids</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have not hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, in proclaiming</w> <w lemma="strong:H01865">liberty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to his neighbour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, I proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01865">a liberty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">for you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">to the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">to the pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">and to the famine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02113 strong:H02189" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">you to be removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">into all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for a removing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that have transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which have not performed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, when they cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">the calf</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">in twain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01335">between the parts</w> thereof,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">The princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05631">the eunuchs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01335">between the parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">of the calf</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will even give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of them that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05038">and their dead bodies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">shall be for meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">unto the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and to the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06667">And Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and his princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of them that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which are gone up</w> from you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Behold, I will command</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and cause them to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to this city</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and they shall fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against it, and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">it with fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">a desolation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">without an inhabitant</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 34." eID="gen831" osisID="Jer.34"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">which came unto Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07397">of the Rechabites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto them, and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">them into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">into one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">of the chambers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">and give them wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to drink</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02970">Jaazaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02262">of Habaziniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and all his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the whole house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07397">of the Rechabites</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">them into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03957">into the chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02605">of Hanan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03012">of Igdaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">the chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the princes</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">the chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H04641">of Maaseiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07967">of Shallum</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">of the door</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>door</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">threshold</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">vessel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07397">of the Rechabites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01375">pots</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03563">and cups</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">ye wine</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We will drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">no wine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03122">for Jonadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07394">of Rechab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">our father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">us, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">no wine</w>, <transChange type="added">neither</transChange> ye, <w lemma="strong:H01121">nor your sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither shall ye build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">vineyard</w>, nor have <transChange type="added">any</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">but all your days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in tents</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye may live</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the land</w> where ye <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">strangers</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus have we obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03082">of Jonadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07394">of Rechab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">our father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">in all that he hath charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">us, to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">no wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all our days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">we, our wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">our sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">nor our daughters</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Nor to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for us to dwell in</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03754">neither have we vineyard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">nor field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">nor seed</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But we have dwelt in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have obeyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03122">according to all that Jonadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">our father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05019">But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and for fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so we dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Then came the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">unto Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Will ye not receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">instruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">to my words</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03082">of Jonadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07394">of Rechab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">are performed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">for unto this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">none, but obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">commandment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">notwithstanding I have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">unto you, rising early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and speaking</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but ye hearkened</w> not unto me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">also unto you all my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">rising up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and sending</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye now every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from his evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and amend</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">your doings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">not after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">them, and ye shall dwell in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to you and to your fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but ye have not inclined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">your ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor hearkened</w> unto me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Because the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03082">of Jonadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07394">of Rechab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have performed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">them; but this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not hearkened</w> unto me:

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">upon Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and upon all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I have pronounced</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">against them: because I have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, but they have not heard</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I have called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, but they have not answered</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03414">And Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07397">of the Rechabites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because ye have obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03082">of Jonadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all his precepts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and done</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">according unto all that he hath commanded</w> you:

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03122">Jonadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07394">of Rechab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not want</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jonadab…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">There shall not a man be cut off from Jonadab the son of Rechab to stand</rdg>, etc</note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 35." eID="gen832" osisID="Jer.35"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07243">And it came to pass in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">came unto Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">thee a roll</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of a book</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and write</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">therein all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto thee against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and against Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">and against all the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto thee, from the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">even unto this day</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">It may be that the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I purpose</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them; that they may return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from his evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I may forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">their iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">and their sin</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03414">Then Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01263">Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05374">of Neriah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01263">and Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">from the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">unto him, upon a roll</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of a book</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03414">And Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01263">Baruch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shut up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou, and read</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">in the roll</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast written</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">from my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">upon the fasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and also thou shalt read</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">them in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of their cities</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">It may be they will present</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">their supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from his evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01419">for great</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">and the fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath pronounced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">against this people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their supplication shall fail</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01263">And Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05374">of Neriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">according to all that Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, reading</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02549">And it came to pass in the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08671">in the ninth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they proclaimed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">a fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and to all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then read</w> <w lemma="strong:H01263">Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03957">in the chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H01587">of Gemariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">of Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05945">in the higher</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the entry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">of the new</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>entry</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">door</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04321">When Michaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01587">of Gemariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">of Shaphan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">out of the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">into the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">into the scribe’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">chamber</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08269">and, lo, all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sat</w> there, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0476">Elishama</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01806">and Delaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">of Shemaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0494">and Elnathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05907">of Achbor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01587">and Gemariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">of Shaphan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06667">and Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02608">of Hananiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and all the princes</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04321">Then Michaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto them all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had heard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01263">when Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">read</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Therefore all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03065">Jehudi</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08018">of Shelemiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03570">of Cushi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01263">unto Baruch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">the roll</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein thou hast read</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01263">So Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05374">of Neriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">the roll</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> unto them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Sit down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now, and read</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">it in our ears</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01263">So Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">read</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in their ears</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Now it came to pass, when they had heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they were afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">and other</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01263">unto Baruch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">We will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of all these words</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01263">Baruch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us now, How didst thou write</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">at his mouth</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01263">Then Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, He pronounced</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">unto me with his mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and I wrote</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01773">with ink</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01263">unto Baruch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">thee, thou and Jeremiah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and let no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0375">where</w> ye be.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">into the court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but they laid up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">the roll</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">in the chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H0476">of Elishama</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03065">Jehudi</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">the roll</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0476">it out of Elishama</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">chamber</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03065">And Jehudi</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">read</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">it in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">and in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Now the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02779 strong:H01004">in the winterhouse</w> <w lemma="strong:H08671">in the ninth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>: and <transChange type="added">there was a fire</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0254">on the hearth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:23
verses.text: And it came to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03065">when Jehudi</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had read</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">or four</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">leaves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608 strong:H08593" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it with the penknife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and cast</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">into the fire</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0254">on the hearth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04039">until all the roll</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0254">on the hearth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet they were not afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">their garments</w>, <transChange type="added">neither</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">nor any of his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0494">Nevertheless Elnathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01806">and Delaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01587">and Gemariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had made intercession</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he would not burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">the roll</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he would not hear</w> them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">But the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03396">Jerahmeel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04429">of Hammelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08304">and Seraiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05837">of Azriel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08018">and Shelemiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05655">of Abdeel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01263">Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">and Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hid</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>of Hammelech</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of the king</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Then the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">came to Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">the roll</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01263">which Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">at the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thee again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">roll</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and write</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">in it all the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">that were in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">roll</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03079">which Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath burned</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">to Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">this roll</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Why hast thou written</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">therein, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall cause to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">from thence man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He shall have none to sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05038">and his dead body</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">shall be cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02721">to the heat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">and in the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H07140">to the frost</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">him and his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">and his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for their iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon them, and upon the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and upon the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I have pronounced</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against them; but they hearkened</w> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>punish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visit upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">roll</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01263">it to Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05374">of Neriah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">therein from the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">which Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and there were added</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">besides unto them many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01992">like</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>like</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as they</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 36." eID="gen833" osisID="Jer.36"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03659">instead of Coniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05019">whom Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">made king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">But neither he, nor his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">nor the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of the prophet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06667">And Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03081">Jehucal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08018">of Shelemiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06846">and Zephaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04641">of Maaseiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">to the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">now unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> for us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03414">Now Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they had not put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03628 strong:H01004">him into prison</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">Then Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">army</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03778">and when the Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">of them, they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Then came the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">unto the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shall ye say</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you unto me to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of me; Behold, Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which is come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">to help</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you, shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into their own land</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03778">And the Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">it with fire</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Deceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">not yourselves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03778">The Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from us: for they shall not depart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>yourselves</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">your souls</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">For though ye had smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">the whole army</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">against you, and there remained</w> <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01856" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> among them, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should they rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in his tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wounded</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thrust through</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02428">And it came to pass, that when the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was broken up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">army</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>broken…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made to ascend</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03414">Then Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">out of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to separate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">himself thence in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>separate…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to slip away from thence in the midst of the people</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08179">And when he was in the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01167">a captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06488">of the ward</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">there, whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03376">Irijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08018">of Shelemiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02608">of Hananiah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Thou fallest away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">to the Chaldeans</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08267">false</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I fall not away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">to the Chaldeans</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But he hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03376">not to him: so Irijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">him to the princes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>false</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">falsehood</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">a lie</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Wherefore the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">with Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0612">him in prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">of Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03608">that the prison</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03414">When Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953 strong:H01004">into the dungeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02588">and into the cabins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03414">and Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">there many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>cabins</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cells</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06667">Then Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took him out</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">him secretly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Is there <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H03414">And Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">There is</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for, said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">he, thou shalt be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03414">Moreover Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">What have I offended</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">against thee, or against thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">or against this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye have put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03608 strong:H01004">me in prison</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:19
verses.text: Where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0346">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">your prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto you, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">against you, nor against this land</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">now, I pray thee, O my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08467">let my supplication</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, be accepted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee; that thou cause me not to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">of Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest I die</w> there.<note type="study"><catchWord>let…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">let my supplication fall</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06667">Then Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that they should commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">into the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">of the prison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and that they should give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">a piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">out of the bakers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">street</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">until all the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were spent</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03414">Thus Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">of the prison</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 37." eID="gen834" osisID="Jer.37"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08203">Then Shephatiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04977">of Mattan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01436">and Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06583">of Pashur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03116">and Jucal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08018">of Shelemiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06583">and Pashur</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04441">of Malchiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">that Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">by the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and by the pestilence</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that goeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">to the Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall live</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05315">for he shall have his life</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">for a prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02425 strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">and shall live</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">This city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which shall take</w> it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Therefore the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">We beseech thee, let this man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03651">for thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">he weakeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">such words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto them: for this man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">not the welfare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">but the hurt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>welfare</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06667">Then Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, Behold, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in your hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not <transChange type="added">he that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can</w> do <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> against you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">they Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">him into the dungeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04441">of Malchiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of Hammelech</w>, that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">of the prison</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they let down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">with cords</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0953">And in the dungeon</w> <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">no water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02916">but mire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03414">so Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02883" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02916">in the mire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of Hammelech</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of the king</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05663">Now when Ebed–melech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03569">the Ethiopian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">of the eunuchs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">which was in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they had put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">in the dungeon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">then sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05663">Ebed–melech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">out of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">My lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">these men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have done evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in all that they have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom they have cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">into the dungeon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he is like to die</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">hunger</w> <w lemma="strong:H08478">in the place</w> where he is: for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">no more bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he is like…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">he will die</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05663">Ebed–melech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03569">the Ethiopian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">from hence thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">out of the dungeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">before he die</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with thee</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in thine hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05663">So Ebed–melech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">under the treasury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01094">thence old</w> <w lemma="strong:H05499">cast clouts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01094">and old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04418">rotten rags</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and let them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">by cords</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">into the dungeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">to Jeremiah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05663">And Ebed–melech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03569">the Ethiopian</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">unto Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Put</w> now <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01094">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H05499">cast clouts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04418">and rotten rags</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H0679">under thine armholes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">under the cords</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03414">And Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> so.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they drew up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">with cords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and took him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">out of the dungeon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03414">and Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">of the prison</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:14
