verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06667">Then Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">unto him into the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">entry</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">unto Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I will ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thee a thing</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hide</w> nothing from me.<note type="study"><catchWord>third</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">principal</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03414">Then Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">unto Zedekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">If I declare</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">unto thee, wilt thou not surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">put me to death</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and if I give thee counsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou not hearken</w> unto me?

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06667">So Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">secretly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">unto Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">us this soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not put thee to death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thee into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of these men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy life</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">unto Zedekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">If thou wilt assuredly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">then thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and thine house</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if thou wilt not go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">then shall this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">it with fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and thou shalt not escape out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their hand</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06667">And Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">unto Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I am afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">of the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that are fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">to the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest they deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">me into their hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and they mock</w> me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03414">But Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall not deliver</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Obey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">I beseech thee, the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee: so it shall be well</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">unto thee, and thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall live</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03986">But if thou refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go forth</w>, this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath shewed</w> me:

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And, behold, all the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that are left</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w>, and those <transChange type="added">women</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965 strong:H0582">Thy friends</w> <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have set thee on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">against thee: thy feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02883" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">are sunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01206">in the mire</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05472" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they are turned away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">back</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Thy friends</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Men of thy peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">So they shall bring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">all thy wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">to the Chaldeans</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and thou shalt not escape out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">but shalt be taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05892">and thou shalt cause this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to be burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thou shalt cause…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thou shalt burn</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">unto Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">Let no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of these words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt not die</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">But if the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I have talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee, and they come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto thee, and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto thee, Declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">unto us now what thou hast said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it not from us, and we will not put thee to death</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">also what the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">said</w> unto thee:

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">unto them, I presented</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">my supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that he would not cause me to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">to Jonathan’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to die</w> there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">unto Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him: and he told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">them according to all these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">So they left off speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">with him; for the matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was not perceived</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they were silent from him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03414">So Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">of the prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">until the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">that Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was taken</w>: and he was <transChange type="added">there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">when Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was taken</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 38." eID="gen835" osisID="Jer.38"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08671">In the ninth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">of Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06224">in the tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">and all his army</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they besieged</w> it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H06249">in the eleventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">of Zedekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07243">in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08672">the ninth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">was broken up</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the middle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05371">Nergal–sharezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05562">Samgar–nebo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08310">Sarsechim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07249">Rab–saris</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05371">Nergal–sharezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07248">Rab–mag</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07611">with all the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And it came to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06667">when Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">them, and all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then they fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">garden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">by the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">betwixt the two walls</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">of the plain</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03778">But the Chaldeans’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">army</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and overtook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when they had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, they brought him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">to Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07247">to Riblah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">where he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> upon him.<note type="study"><catchWord>gave…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">spake with him judgments</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">of Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07247">in Riblah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before his eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">also the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02715">all the nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05786" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Moreover he put out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">him with chains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">him to Babylon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with two brasen chains</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">fetters</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03778">And the Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and brake down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05018">Then Nebuzar–adan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">into Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and those that fell away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">to him, with the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that remained</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>captain…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chief marshal</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">chief of the executioners</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">slaughtermen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05018">But Nebuzar–adan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">of the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03972">which had nothing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">them vineyards</w> <w lemma="strong:H03010">and fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">at the same time</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>captain…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chief marshal</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">chief of the executioners</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">slaughtermen</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>at the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in that day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05019">Now Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">gave charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">concerning Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H05018">Nebuzar–adan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>to</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>captain…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chief marshal</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">chief of the executioners</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">slaughtermen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760 strong:H05869" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">him, and look well</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to him, and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451 strong:H03972">him no harm</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">but do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto him even as he shall say</w> unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>look…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set thine eyes upon him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05018">So Nebuzar–adan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05021">and Nebushasban</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07249">Rab–saris</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05371">and Nergal–sharezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07248">Rab–mag</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and all the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">princes</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>captain…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chief marshal</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">chief of the executioners</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">slaughtermen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Even they sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">out of the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">of the prison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">him unto Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">of Shaphan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that he should carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him home</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so he dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Now the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">came unto Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">while he was shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">of the prison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05663">to Ebed–melech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03569">the Ethiopian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">upon this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">for evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and not for good</w>; and they shall be <transChange type="added">accomplished</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">But I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and thou shalt not be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of whom</w> thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03016" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">afraid</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">For I will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, and thou shalt not fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">but thy life</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">shall be for a prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto thee: because thou hast put thy trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">in me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 39." eID="gen836" osisID="Jer.39"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">that came to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05018">that Nebuzar–adan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">had let him go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">from Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">him being bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H0246">in chains</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01546">all that were carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">which were carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">unto Babylon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chains</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">manicles</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">And the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto him, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath pronounced</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">this evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">upon this place</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Now the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath brought</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">according as he hath said</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because ye have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have not obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">therefore this thing</w> is come upon you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And now, behold, I loose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0246">from the chains</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">upon thine hand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H02896">If it seem good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">with me into Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will look well</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto thee: but if it seem ill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">with me into Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">forbear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the land</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">thee: whither it seemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03477">and convenient</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for thee to go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thither go</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>were…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">are upon thine hand</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>I will…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I will set mine eye upon thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now while he was not yet gone back</w>, <transChange type="added">he said</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go back</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">also to Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">of Shaphan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath made governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">over the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">with him among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">or go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03477">wheresoever it seemeth convenient</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee to go</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07227">So the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0737">him victuals</w> <w lemma="strong:H04864">and a reward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and let him go</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">unto Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04708">to Mizpah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">with him among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that were left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08269">Now when all the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the forces</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the fields</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">they and their men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">had made Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and had committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto him men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01803">and of the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">of them that were not carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">to Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04708">to Mizpah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03458">even Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03110">and Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07143">of Kareah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08304">and Seraiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08576">of Tanhumeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05778">of Ephai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05200">the Netophathite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03153">and Jezaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04602">of a Maachathite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">they and their men</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01436">And Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">of Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto them and to their men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">the Chaldeans</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">dwell in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it shall be well</w> with you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">As for me, behold, I will dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">at Mizpah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which will come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto us: but ye, gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">ye wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07019">and summer fruits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">in your vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in your cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye have taken</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to serve</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to stand before</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03064">Likewise when all the Jews</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04124">in Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05983">and among the Ammonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0123">and in Edom</w>, and that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the countries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had left</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">a remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and that he had set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">over them Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">of Shaphan</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03064">Even all the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of all places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">whither they were driven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01436">to Gedaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04708">unto Mizpah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">and summer fruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">much</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03110">Moreover Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07143">of Kareah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and all the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the forces</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the fields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">to Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04708">to Mizpah</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, Dost thou certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01185">that Baalis</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983 strong:H01121">of the Ammonites</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315 strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">thee? But Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">believed</w> them not.<note type="study"><catchWord>to slay…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to strike thee in soul?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03110">Then Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07143">of Kareah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">to Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">in Mizpah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">secretly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I pray thee, and I will slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall know</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05315 strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">wherefore should he slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">thee, that all the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which are gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">unto thee should be scattered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07611">and the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">perish</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01436">But Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03110">unto Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07143">of Kareah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for thou speakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">of Ishmael</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 40." eID="gen837" osisID="Jer.40"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">Now it came to pass in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03458">Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0476">of Elishama</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">of the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">royal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">even ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him, came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">unto Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">to Mizpah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there they did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04708">in Mizpah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and the ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that were with him, and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">of Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him, whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had made governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over the land</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03458">Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">also slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">all the Jews</w> that were with him, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01436">with Gedaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04709">at Mizpah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03778">and the Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that were found</w> there, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08145">And it came to pass the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">after he had slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">Gedaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">from Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07887">from Shiloh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08111">and from Samaria</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08084">fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02206">having their beards</w> <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">shaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">and their clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">rent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01413" morph="strongMorph:TH8706">and having cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">themselves, with offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">and incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03458">And Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">from Mizpah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them, weeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">all along</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as he went</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06298" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and it came to pass, as he met</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">to Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>weeping…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in going and weeping</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:7
verses.text: And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03458">that Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slew</w> them, <transChange type="added">and cast them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">of the pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">he, and the men</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06235">But ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">among them that said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">unto Ishmael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">us not: for we have</w> <w lemma="strong:H04301">treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02406">of wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08184">and of barley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and of oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01706">and of honey</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he forbare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">them not among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brethren</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0953">Now the pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">wherein Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06297">all the dead bodies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom he had slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">of Gedaliah</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0609">it which Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">of Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03458">Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">filled</w> it with <transChange type="added">them that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>because…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">near Gedaliah</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">by the side of Gedaliah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03458">Then Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">all the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04709">in Mizpah</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">in Mizpah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05018">whom Nebuzar–adan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">to Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03458">and Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">carried them away captive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983 strong:H01121">to the Ammonites</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03110">But when Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07143">of Kareah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and all the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the forces</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">that Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">all the men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">with Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">him by the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01391">in Gibeon</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:13
verses.text: Now it came to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">when all the people</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03458">with Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03110">Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07143">of Kareah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and all the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the forces</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, then they were glad</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">So all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">that Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">from Mizpah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cast about</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03110">unto Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07143">of Kareah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03458">But Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03110">Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">with eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983 strong:H01121">to the Ammonites</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03110">Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07143">of Kareah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and all the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the forces</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07611">with him, all the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom he had recovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">from Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04709">from Mizpah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he had slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01397">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and the women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and the children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05631">and the eunuchs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom he had brought again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">from Gibeon</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01628">the habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03643">of Chimham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0681">which is by</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">Beth–lehem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">Because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they were afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">of them, because Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">made governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 41." eID="gen838" osisID="Jer.41"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Then all the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the forces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03110">and Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07143">of Kareah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03153">and Jezaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01955">of Hoshaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">from the least</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">even unto the greatest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came near</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">unto Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08467">Let, we beseech thee, our supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be accepted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">thee, and pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for us unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07611">for all this remnant</w>; (<w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for we are left</w> <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a few</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">of many</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">as thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">do behold</w> us:)<note type="study"><catchWord>Let…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Let our supplication fall before thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">That the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">may shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">us the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherein we may walk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may do</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03414">Then Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, I have heard</w> <transChange type="added">you</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">behold, I will pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to your words</w>; and it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">whatsoever thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">you, I will declare</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-349">unto you; I will keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-349">back</w> from you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">to Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">be a true</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">between us, if we do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not even according to all things</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall send</w> thee to us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:6
verses.text: Whether <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, or whether <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0580">to whom we</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">send</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee; that it may be well</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with us, when we obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07093">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">that the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">came unto Jeremiah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03110">he Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07143">of Kareah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and all the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the forces</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with him, and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">from the least</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">even to the greatest</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto whom ye sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">me to present</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">your supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him;

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">If ye will still</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then will I build</w> you, and not pull <transChange type="added">you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will plant</w> you, and not pluck <transChange type="added">you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for I repent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">me of the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have done</w> unto you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Be not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">of whom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">ye are afraid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of him, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">with you to save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">you, and to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you from his hand</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">unto you, that he may have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">upon you, and cause you to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">to your own land</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But if ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We will not dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">neither obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">No; but we will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where we shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">no war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor have hunger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there will we dwell</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And now therefore hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07611">ye remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">If ye wholly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">your faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sojourn</w> there;

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:16
verses.text: Then it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03373">which ye feared</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall overtake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you there in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">and the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whereof ye were afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall follow close</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">you there in Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there ye shall die</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall follow…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall cleave after you</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">So shall it be with all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there; they shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">by the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and by the pestilence</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08300">and none of them shall remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06412">or escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that I will bring</w> upon them.<note type="study"><catchWord>So…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">So shall all the men be</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0639">As mine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">and my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath been poured forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02534">so shall my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be poured forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">upon you, when ye shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0423">and ye shall be an execration</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08047">and an astonishment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07045">and a curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02781">and a reproach</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">this place</w> no more.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">concerning you, O ye remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">ye not into Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I have admonished</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">you this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>admonished…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">testified against you</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">For ye dissembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">in your hearts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when ye sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for us unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and according unto all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">so declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto us, and we will do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ye dissembled…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ye have used deceit against your souls</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:21
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">now</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">I have this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">declared</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to you; but ye have not obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, nor any <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for the which he hath sent</w> me unto you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now therefore know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">by the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and by the pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whither ye desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sojourn</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to go…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to go to sojourn</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 42." eID="gen839" osisID="Jer.42"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:1
verses.text: And it came to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03414">when Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">for which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had sent</w> him to them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01955">of Hoshaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03110">and Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07143">of Kareah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02086">and all the proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">unto Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Thou speakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsely</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">not into Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sojourn</w> there:

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01263">But Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05374">of Neriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">setteth thee on</w> <w lemma="strong:H04616">against us, for to</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">us into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that they might put us to death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and carry us away captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">into Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03110">So Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07143">of Kareah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and all the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the forces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03110">But Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07143">of Kareah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and all the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the forces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">all the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that were returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">from all nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">whither they had been driven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01397">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and every person</w> <w lemma="strong:H05018">that Nebuzar–adan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">with Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">of Shaphan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03414">and Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01263">and Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05374">of Neriah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thus came</w> they <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08471">to Tahpanhes</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Then came the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">unto Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08471">in Tahpanhes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04423">them in the clay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04404">in the brickkiln</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the entry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08471">in Tahpanhes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">of Judah</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">these stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have hid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08237">his royal pavilion</w> over them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And when he cometh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <transChange type="added">and deliver</transChange> such <transChange type="added">as are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">for death</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">to death</w>; and such <transChange type="added">as are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07628">for captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">to captivity</w>; and such <transChange type="added">as are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">for the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">to the sword</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:12
