verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and carry them away captives</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall array</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">himself with the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as a shepherd</w> <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">putteth on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his garment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">from thence in peace</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">He shall break</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">also the images</w> <w lemma="strong:H01053">of Beth–shemesh</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">statues</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">standing images</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Beth–shemesh</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">The house of the sun</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 43." eID="gen840" osisID="Jer.43"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">that came to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">concerning all the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04024">at Migdol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08471">and at Tahpanhes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05297">and at Noph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and in the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H06624">of Pathros</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">upon Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and upon all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">and, behold, this day</w> they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02723">a desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and no man dwelleth</w> therein,

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">Because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of their wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they have committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to provoke me to anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in that they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to burn incense</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom they knew</w> not, <transChange type="added">neither</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">they, ye, nor your fathers</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Howbeit I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto you all my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">rising early</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and sending</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Oh, do</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">not this abominable</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I hate</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But they hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">not, nor inclined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">their ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from their wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to burn no incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02534">Wherefore my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">and mine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was poured forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">and in the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02723">and they are wasted</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as at this day</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore now thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Wherefore commit</w> ye <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">against your souls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">from you man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05768">child</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and suckling</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">you none to remain</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>out…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">out of the midst of Judah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">In that ye provoke me unto wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">with the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of your hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">burning incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither ye be gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that ye might cut yourselves off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07045">and that ye might be a curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">and a reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Have ye forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of their wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and your own wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of your wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they have committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02351">and in the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>wickedness…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wickednesses</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">punishments</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">They are not humbled</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither have they feared</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in my law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02708">nor in my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">you and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your fathers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>humbled</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">contrite</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">against you for evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">all Judah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there, and they shall all be consumed</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; they shall <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07458">by the famine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">from the least</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">even unto the greatest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">and by the famine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0423">and they shall be an execration</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08047">an astonishment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07045">and a curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02781">and a reproach</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as I have punished</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">by the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and by the pestilence</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07611">So that none of the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which are gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06412">there, shall escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">or remain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they should return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">to the which they have</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">a desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there: for none shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H06405">but such as shall escape</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>have…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lift up their soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">Then all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">that their wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">had burned incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and all the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that stood by</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">multitude</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">even all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06624">in Pathros</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:16
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that thou hast spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto us in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">we will not hearken</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">But we will certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">whatsoever thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">goeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of our own mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to burn incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H04446">unto the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">drink offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto her, as we have done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">we, and our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">our kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and our princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02351">and in the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>: for <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had we plenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of victuals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and were well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">no evil</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>queen…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">frame of heaven</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>victuals</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bread</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But since we left off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to burn incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H04446">to the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">drink offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto her, we have wanted</w> all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have been consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">and by the famine</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And when we burned incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H04446">to the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">drink offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto her, did we make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03561">her cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">her, and pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">drink offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01107">unto her, without</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">our men</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>men</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">husbands?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03414">Then Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01397">to the men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and to the women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and to all the people</w> which had given him <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06030 strong:H01697" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">answer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07002">The incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that ye burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02351">and in the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">ye, and your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">your kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and your princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">did not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and came</w> it <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">into his mind</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">So that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">could</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">no longer bear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07455">of the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of your doings</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">of the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye have committed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">therefore is your land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">a desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08047">and an astonishment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07045">and a curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">without an inhabitant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as at this day</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0834 strong:H06440">Because</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">ye have burned incense</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and because ye have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have not obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in his law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02708">nor in his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05715">nor in his testimonies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07451">therefore this evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is happened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto you, as at this day</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03414">Moreover Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and to all the women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">all Judah</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802">Ye and your wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">have both spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with your mouths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and fulfilled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with your hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">We will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">our vows</w> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that we have vowed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to burn incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H04446">to the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">drink offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">unto her: ye will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">accomplish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">your vows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">your vows</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">ye the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Behold, I have sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">by my great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">that my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall no more be named</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">The Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08245" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">over them for evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and not for good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">and all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">and by the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until there be an end</w> of them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04962">Yet a small</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">number</w> <w lemma="strong:H06412">that escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07611">and all the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that are gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there, shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">whose words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall stand</w>, mine, or theirs.<note type="study"><catchWord>mine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from me</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">from them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And this <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">you in this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">that my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">against you for evil</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06548">Pharaoh–hophra</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of his enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of them that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and that sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his life</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 44." eID="gen841" osisID="Jer.44"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">that Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01263">unto Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05374">of Neriah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he had written</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in a book</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">at the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07243">in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01263">unto thee, O Baruch</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou didst say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0188">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">is me now! for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath added</w> <w lemma="strong:H03015">grief</w> <w lemma="strong:H04341">to my sorrow</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I fainted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0585">in my sighing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I find</w> <w lemma="strong:H04496">no rest</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shalt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto him, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> thus; Behold, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">will I break down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and that which I have planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I will pluck up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">even this whole land</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And seekest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">thou great things</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">for thyself? seek</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">not: for, behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">upon all flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">but thy life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">unto thee for a prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in all places</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whither thou goest</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 45." eID="gen842" osisID="Jer.45"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">which came to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">against the Gentiles</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">Against Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">against the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H06549">of Pharaoh–necho</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">which was by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">Euphrates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03751">in Carchemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05019">which Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07243">in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Order</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">ye the buckler</w> <w lemma="strong:H06793">and shield</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and draw near</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Harness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">the horses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and get up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">ye horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and stand forth</w> with <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03553">helmets</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04838" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">furbish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07420">the spears</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H05630">the brigandines</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore have I seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02844">them dismayed</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05472" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">away back</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01368">and their mighty ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">are beaten down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and are fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04498">apace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and look not back</w>: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04032">fear</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>beaten…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">broken in pieces</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>fled…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fled a flight</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07031">Let not the swift</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">flee away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">nor the mighty man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">escape</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall stumble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">Euphrates</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:7
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">as a flood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">whose waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01607" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">are moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">as the rivers</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">riseth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">like a flood</w>, and <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01607" morph="strongMorph:TH8704">are moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">like the rivers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go up</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> thereof.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">ye horses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8703">and rage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">ye chariots</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01368">and let the mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come forth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03568">the Ethiopians</w> <w lemma="strong:H06316">and the Libyans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that handle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">the shield</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03866">and the Lydians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that handle</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bend</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">the bow</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the Ethiopians</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Cush</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the Libyans</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Put</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:10
verses.text: For this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">of vengeance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that he may avenge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">him of his adversaries</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02719">and the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall devour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall be satiate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07301" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and made drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with their blood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0136">for the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">hath a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">in the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">Euphrates</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">into Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06875">balm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01330">O virgin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07723">in vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shalt thou use many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07499">medicines</w>; <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08585">thou shalt not be cured</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thou shalt…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">no cure shall be unto thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">The nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07036">of thy shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06682">and thy cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01368">for the mighty man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath stumbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">against the mighty</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05019">how Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">should come</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">ye in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and publish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04024">in Migdol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and publish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05297">in Noph</w> <w lemma="strong:H08471">and in Tahpanhes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">ye, Stand fast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">thee; for the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H047">Why are thy valiant</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05502" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">swept away</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not, because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did drive</w> them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He made many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">yea, one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">upon another</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us go again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to our own people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04138">of our nativity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the oppressing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">multiplied the faller</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They did cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">there, Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <transChange type="added">is but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07588">a noise</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">the time appointed</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the King</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08396">Surely as Tabor</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">among the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03760">and as Carmel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">by the sea</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he come</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01323">O thou daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">furnish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473 strong:H03627">thyself to go into captivity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05297">for Noph</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">shall be waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">without an inhabitant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>furnish…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">make thee instruments of captivity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w> <transChange type="added">is like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03304">a very fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H05697">heifer</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07171">destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cometh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it cometh out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07916">Also her hired men</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04770">of her like fatted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">bullocks</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for they also are turned back</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are fled away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they did not stand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">because the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0343">of their calamity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come</w> upon them, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">of their visitation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fatted…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bullocks of the stall</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">The voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">like a serpent</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they shall march</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">with an army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07134">against her with axes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02404" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as hewers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of wood</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They shall cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">her forest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">though it cannot be searched</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they are more</w> <w lemma="strong:H0697">than the grasshoppers</w>, and <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557 strong:H0369">innumerable</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01323">The daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall be confounded</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">she shall be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0528 strong:H0527" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H04996">of No</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06547">and Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">with their gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and their kings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06547">even Pharaoh</w>, and <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that trust</w> in him:<note type="study"><catchWord>multitude</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">nourisher</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Amon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of those that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their lives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall be inhabited</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">not thou, O my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and be not dismayed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">for, behold, I will save</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">thee from afar off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">of their captivity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be in rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07599" morph="strongMorph:TH8768">and at ease</w>, and none shall make <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">afraid</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">thou not, O Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee; for I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">a full end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whither I have driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee: but I will not make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">a full end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">of thee, but correct</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thee in measure</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">yet will I not leave thee wholly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unpunished</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>not leave…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">not utterly cut thee off</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 46." eID="gen843" osisID="Jer.46"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">that came to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">against the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06547">before that Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05804">Gaza</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Gaza</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Azzah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04325">Behold, waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">out of the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and shall be an overflowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">flood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall overflow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04393">and all that is therein</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and them that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">therein: then the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall howl</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>all that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the fulness thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">At the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08161">of the stamping</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">of the hoofs</w> <w lemma="strong:H047">of his strong</w> <transChange type="added">horses</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07494">at the rushing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of his chariots</w>, <transChange type="added">and at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01995">the rumbling</w> <w lemma="strong:H01534">of his wheels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall not look back</w> to <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07510">for feebleness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of hands</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Because of the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">all the Philistines</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">from Tyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">and Zidon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every helper</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">that remaineth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">will spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07611">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">of the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H03731">of Caphtor</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the country</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the isle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07144">Baldness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05804">upon Gaza</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0831">Ashkelon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is cut off</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07611">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">of their valley</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01413" morph="strongMorph:TH8704">how long wilt thou cut</w> thyself?

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">O</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">thou sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, how long <transChange type="added">will it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03808">ere</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou be quiet</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">put up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08593">thyself into thy scabbard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07280" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be still</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>put…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gather thyself</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How can it be quiet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">seeing the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath given it a charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0831">against Ashkelon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">and against the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H02348">shore</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there hath he appointed</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>How…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">How canst thou</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 47." eID="gen844" osisID="Jer.47"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04124">Against Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05015">unto Nebo</w>! <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">for it is spoiled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07156">Kiriathaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is confounded</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">taken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04869">Misgab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dismayed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Misgab</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the high place</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08416">no more praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02809">in Heshbon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have devised</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">against it; come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and let us cut it off</w> from <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">a nation</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Also thou shalt be cut down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04086">O Madmen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">thee</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be cut…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">be brought to silence</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>pursue…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">go after thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">A voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06818">of crying</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02773">from Horonaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07701">spoiling</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">destruction</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04124">Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is destroyed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06810">her little ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H02201">have caused a cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to be heard</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04608">For in the going up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03872">of Luhith</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">weeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04174">for in the going down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02773">of Horonaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">the enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06818">a cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">of destruction</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>continual…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">weeping with weeping</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Flee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">your lives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be</w> <w lemma="strong:H06176">like the heath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the heath</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a naked tree</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">For because thou hast trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">in thy works</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">and in thy treasures</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thou shalt also be taken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03645">and Chemosh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">into captivity</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">his priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and his princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the spoiler</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">upon every city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and no city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall escape</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06010">the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also shall perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04334">and the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be destroyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath spoken</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06731">wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">unto Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05323" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that it may flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and get away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05892">for the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">thereof shall be desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">without any to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02004">therein</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07423">deceitfully</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that keepeth back</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">his sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">from blood</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>deceitfully</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">negligently</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04124">Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07599" morph="strongMorph:TH8768">hath been at ease</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">from his youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he hath settled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08105">on his lees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">and hath not been emptied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">from vessel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">to vessel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither hath he gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">into captivity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02940">therefore his taste</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">in him, and his scent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04171" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is not changed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>remained</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Therefore, behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06808" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto him wanderers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06808" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that shall cause him to wander</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall empty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">his vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and break</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">their bottles</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04124">And Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03645">of Chemosh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">as the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">of Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H04009">their confidence</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How say</w> ye, We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">and strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">for the war</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04124">Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is spoiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and gone up</w> <transChange type="added">out of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">her cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04005">and his chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are gone down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02874">to the slaughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the King</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the choice of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0343">The calamity</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and his affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hasteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">fast</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05439">All ye that are about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">him, bemoan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him; and all ye that know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05797">How is the strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">broken</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08597">the beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04731">rod</w>!

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01323">Thou daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dost inhabit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01769">Dibon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come down</w> from <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06772">in thirst</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for the spoiler</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> upon thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">thy strong holds</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06177">of Aroer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and espy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">him that fleeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and her that escapeth</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">What is done</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>inhabitant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">inhabitress</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04124">Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is confounded</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for it is broken down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">howl</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and cry</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">ye it in Arnon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04124">that Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is spoiled</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04941">And judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04334">upon the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02473">upon Holon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03096">and upon Jahazah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04158">and upon Mephaath</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01769">And upon Dibon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05015">and upon Nebo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01015">and upon Beth–diblathaim</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07156">And upon Kiriathaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01014">and upon Beth–gamul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01010">and upon Beth–meon</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07152">And upon Kerioth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01224">and upon Bozrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and upon all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07350">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">or near</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07161">The horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is cut off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02220">and his arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Make ye him drunken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for he magnified</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H04124">Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05606" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also shall wallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06892">in his vomit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07814">and he also shall be in derision</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">For was not Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07814">a derision</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">unto thee? was he found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01590">among thieves</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01767">for since</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thou spakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">of him, thou skippedst</w> for joy.<note type="study"><catchWord>skippedst…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">movedst thyself</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O ye that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">in Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">in the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03123">and be like the dove</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07077" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">maketh her nest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">in the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H06354">of the hole’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H03966">he is exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01343">proud</w>) <w lemma="strong:H01363">his loftiness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01346">and his arrogancy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01347">and his pride</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07312">and the haughtiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of his heart</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">his wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; but <transChange type="added">it shall</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0907">so; his lies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall not so effect</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his lies…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">those on whom he stayeth (Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his bars</rdg>) do not right</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Therefore will I howl</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">for Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will cry out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">for all Moab</w>; <transChange type="added">mine heart</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">for the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07025">of Kir–heres</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01612">O vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07643">of Sibmah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">for thee with the weeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H03270">of Jazer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05189">thy plants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are gone over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they reach</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">to the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03270">of Jazer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the spoiler</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">upon thy summer fruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H01210">and upon thy vintage</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08057">And joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01524">and gladness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03759">from the plentiful field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03196">and I have caused wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03342">from the winepresses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">none shall tread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01959">with shouting</w>; <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01959">shouting</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01959">no shouting</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02201">From the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">of Heshbon</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0500">unto Elealeh</w>, <transChange type="added">and even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03096">unto Jahaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have they uttered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06820">from Zoar</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02773">unto Horonaim</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05697">an heifer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">of three years old</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04325">for the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05249">also of Nimrim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04923">shall be desolate</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>desolate</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">desolations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Moreover I will cause to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">in Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">him that offereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">in the high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and him that burneth incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to his gods</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Therefore mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">for Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H02485">like pipes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H02485">like pipes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">for the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07025">of Kir–heres</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03502">because the riches</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath gotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are perished</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07218">For every head</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07144">bald</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02206">and every beard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">clipped</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">upon all the hands</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01417">cuttings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04975">and upon the loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">sackcloth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>clipped</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">diminished</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:38
