verses.text: <transChange type="added">There shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04553">lamentation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">generally upon all the housetops</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07339">and in the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof: for I have broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">like a vessel</w> wherein <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02656">no pleasure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">They shall howl</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">How is it broken down</w>! <w lemma="strong:H04124">how hath Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">the back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with shame</w>! <w lemma="strong:H04124">so shall Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07814">be a derision</w> <w lemma="strong:H04288">and a dismaying</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">to all them about</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>back</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">neck</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01675" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, he shall fly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">as an eagle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">his wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">over Moab</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07152">Kerioth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is taken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04679">and the strong holds</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are surprised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">and the mighty men’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">in Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">at that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">shall be as the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">in her pangs</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Kerioth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">The cities</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04124">And Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be destroyed</w> from <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because he hath magnified</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06343">Fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06354">and the pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06341">and the snare</w>, <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon thee, O inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05211 strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8801">He that fleeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06354">into the pit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he that getteth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06354">out of the pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">in the snare</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for I will bring</w> upon it, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04124">upon Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">of their visitation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">They that fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">under the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">of Heshbon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">because of the force</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0784">but a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">out of Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03852">and a flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">from the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">of Sihon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">the corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06936">and the crown of the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H07588">of the tumultuous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">ones</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>tumultuous…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">children of noise</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0188">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">be unto thee, O Moab</w>! <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03645">of Chemosh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">perisheth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">for thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">are taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and thy daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07633">captives</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>captives, and</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in captivity</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:47
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet will I bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">in the latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H02008">Thus far</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 48." eID="gen845" osisID="Jer.48"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05983 strong:H01121">Concerning the Ammonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">Hath Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">no sons</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hath he no heir</w>? why <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">doth their king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in his cities</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Concerning</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Against</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>their king</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Melcom</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Therefore, behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08643">that I will cause an alarm</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to be heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07237">in Rabbah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983 strong:H01121">of the Ammonites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08077">and it shall be a desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08510">heap</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">then shall Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be heir</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them that were his heirs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02809">O Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05857">for Ai</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is spoiled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">ye daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07237">of Rabbah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">gird</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">you with sackcloth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">lament</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07751" morph="strongMorph:TH8708">and run to and fro</w> <w lemma="strong:H01448">by the hedges</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">for their king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">into captivity</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">his priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and his princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their king</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Melcom</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Wherefore gloriest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">thou in the valleys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy flowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07728">O backsliding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">in her treasures</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who shall come</w> unto me?<note type="study"><catchWord>thy…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thy valley floweth away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">a fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">upon thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05439">from all those that be about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thee; and ye shall be driven out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">right forth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and none shall gather up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him that wandereth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0123">Concerning Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08487">no more in Teman</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06098">is counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">perished</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">from the prudent</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02451">is their wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05628" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">vanished</w>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">ye, turn back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06009" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">deep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01719">of Dedan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0343">the calamity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">upon him, the time</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will visit</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>turn…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they are turned back</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">If grapegatherers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to thee, would they not leave</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05955">gleaning grapes</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01590">if thieves</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">till they have enough</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>till…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their sufficiency</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06215">But I have made Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H02834" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have uncovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04565">his secret places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall not be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H02247" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">himself: his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is spoiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07934">and his neighbours</w>, and he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">thy fatherless children</w>, I will preserve <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">alive</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0490">and let thy widows</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">trust</w> in me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04941">Behold, they whose judgment</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">of the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">have assuredly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drunken</w>; and <transChange type="added">art</transChange> thou he <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall altogether</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">go unpunished</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thou shalt not go unpunished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drink</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">For I have sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">by myself, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01224">that Bozrah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">shall become a desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02781">a reproach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02721">a waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07045">and a curse</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05892">and all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">thereof shall be perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">wastes</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">a rumour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06735">and an ambassador</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">is sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">unto the heathen</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Gather ye together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">against her, and rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to the battle</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For, lo, I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">thee small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">among men</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08606">Thy terribleness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath deceived</w> thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02087">the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O thou that dwellest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02288">in the clefts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that holdest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">of the hill</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07064">though thou shouldest make thy nest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">as high</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">as the eagle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will bring thee down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">from thence, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0123">Also Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">shall be a desolation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one that goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by it shall be astonished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08319" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall hiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">at all the plagues</w> thereof.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04114">As in the overthrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">and Gomorrah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07934">and the neighbour</w> <transChange type="added">cities</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">there, neither shall a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> in it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, he shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">like a lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">from the swelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">against the habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0386">of the strong</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07280" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but I will suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">make him run away</w> from her: and who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">a chosen</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I may appoint</w> over her? for who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">like me? and who will appoint me the time</w>? and who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that shepherd</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that will stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> me?<note type="study"><catchWord>appoint me…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">convent me in judgment?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">against Edom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04284">and his purposes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath purposed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08487">of Teman</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06810">Surely the least</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05498" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall draw them out</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05116">surely he shall make their habitations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">desolate</w> with them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">at the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of their fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06818">at the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thereof was heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">in the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Red sea</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Weedy sea</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, he shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01675" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">as the eagle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">his wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01224">over Bozrah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">and at that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">shall the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">be as the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">in her pangs</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01834">Concerning Damascus</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02574">Hamath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is confounded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0774">and Arpad</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">tidings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they are fainthearted</w>; <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01674">sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">on the sea</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">be quiet</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fainthearted</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">melted</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>on…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">as on the sea</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01834">Damascus</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is waxed feeble</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">herself to flee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07374">and fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath seized</w> on <transChange type="added">her</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06869">anguish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">and sorrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">her, as a woman in travail</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">How is the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">of praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">not left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07151">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04885">of my joy</w>!

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0970">Therefore her young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in her streets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">in the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">the palaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H01130">of Ben–hadad</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06938">Concerning Kedar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">and concerning the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H02674">of Hazor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05019">which Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall smite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06938">to Kedar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of the east</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0168">Their tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">and their flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they take away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">to themselves their curtains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all their vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01581">and their camels</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H04032">unto them, Fear</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">on every side</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Flee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">you far off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06009" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">deep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O ye inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02674">of Hazor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05019">for Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289 strong:H06098" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath taken counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against you, and hath conceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">a purpose</w> against you.<note type="study"><catchWord>get…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">flit greatly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get you up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07961">unto the wealthy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">without care</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01817">which have neither gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">nor bars</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0910">alone</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wealthy</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that is at ease</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01581">And their camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">shall be a booty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">and the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">of their cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">a spoil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and I will scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">into all winds</w> them <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07112" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">in the utmost</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">corners</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0343">their calamity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">from all sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thereof, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cut off into corners</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">that have the corners of their hair polled</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02674">And Hazor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04583">shall be a dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">for dragons</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08077">a desolation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">there shall no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abide</w> there, nor <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> in it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:34
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">that came to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05867">against Elam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">in the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">of Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, I will break</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">the bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05867">of Elam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07225">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">of their might</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05867">And upon Elam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">will I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">winds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">from the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">quarters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and will scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">them toward all those winds</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01471">and there shall be no nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">whither the outcasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769 strong:H05867" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">of Elam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not come</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05867">For I will cause Elam</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to be dismayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">them that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> upon them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02740">my fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">them, till I have consumed</w> them:

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">my throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H05867">in Elam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">from thence the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:39
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0319">But it shall come to pass in the latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">I will bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622 strong:H07622" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05867">of Elam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 49." eID="gen846" osisID="Jer.49"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">against Babylon</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">against the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of Jeremiah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">ye among the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and publish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">a standard</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">publish</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">conceal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">not: say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0894">Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is taken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01078">Bel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is confounded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04781">Merodach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is broken in pieces</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06091">her idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">are confounded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01544">her images</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are broken in pieces</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set up</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lift up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06828">For out of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there cometh up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against her, which shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">her land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and none shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therein: they shall remove</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall depart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">both man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and in that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">they and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">going</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and weeping</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">to Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">with their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H02008">thitherward</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and let us join</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ourselves to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">in a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be forgotten</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">My people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hath been lost</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have caused them to go astray</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07726 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8790">they have turned them away</w> <transChange type="added">on</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">to hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07258">their restingplace</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>restingplace</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">place to lie down in</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">All that found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them have devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">them: and their adversaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We offend</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not, because they have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05116">the habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of justice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">even the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04723">the hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318 strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8798">and go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06260">and be as the he goats</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flocks</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">For, lo, I will raise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and cause to come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">against Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">an assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">from the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall set themselves in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">against her; from thence she shall be taken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02671">their arrows</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">as of a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07921 strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8688">expert man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">none shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">in vain</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>expert…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">destroyer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03778">And Chaldea</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">shall be a spoil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her shall be satisfied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Because ye were glad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">because ye rejoiced</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08154" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O ye destroyers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of mine heritage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06335" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">because ye are grown fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05697">as the heifer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01758 strong:H01877" morph="strongMorph:TH8801 strongMorph:TH8676">at grass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06670" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bellow</w> <w lemma="strong:H047">as bulls</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>fat</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">big</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">corpulent</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>bellow…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">neigh as steeds</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0517">Your mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">shall be sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">confounded</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">she that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you shall be ashamed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0319">behold, the hindermost</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04057">a wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06723">a dry land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06160">and a desert</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07110">Because of the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall not be inhabited</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08077">but it shall be wholly desolate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one that goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">by Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be astonished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08319" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">at all her plagues</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Put yourselves in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">against Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all ye that bend</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">the bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">shoot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">at her, spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">no arrows</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for she hath sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Shout</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">against her round about</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">her hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0803">her foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are fallen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02346">her walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are thrown down</w>: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05360">the vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">take vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon her; as she hath done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">do</w> unto her.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the sower</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">from Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and him that handleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04038">the sickle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">of harvest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06440">for fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the oppressing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to his own land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sickle</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">scythe</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06340" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">a scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">sheep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0738">the lions</w> have driven <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">him; and last</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">this Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath broken his bones</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and his land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as I have punished</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8790" type="x-split-350">And I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8790" type="x-split-350">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">to his habitation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">on Carmel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">and Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">and Gilead</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and in that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be sought for</w>, and <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">none; and the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they shall not be found</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will pardon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them whom I reserve</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">against the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04850">of Merathaim</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against it, and against the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06489">of Pekod</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and utterly destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">according to all that I have commanded</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>of Merathaim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of the rebels</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Pekod</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Visitation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">A sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of battle</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">destruction</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06360">How is the hammer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the whole earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">cut asunder</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and broken</w>! <w lemma="strong:H0894">how is Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">become a desolation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>!

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03369" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have laid a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for thee, and thou art also taken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0894">O Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou wast not aware</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thou art found</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and also caught</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01624" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">because thou hast striven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">his armoury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and hath brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">the weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">of his indignation</w>: for this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">against her from the utmost border</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">open</w> <w lemma="strong:H03965">her storehouses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05549" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">cast her up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06194">as heaps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and destroy her utterly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07611">let nothing of her be left</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from the end</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cast…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">tread her</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">all her bullocks</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02874">to the slaughter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01945">woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto them! for their day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">of their visitation</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">The voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of them that flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06405">and escape out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">the vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05360">the vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of his temple</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Call together</w> <w lemma="strong:H07228">the archers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">against Babylon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all ye that bend</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">the bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">against it round about</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06413">let none thereof escape</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">her according to her work</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">according to all that she hath done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02102" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto her: for she hath been proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">against the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0970">Therefore shall her young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the streets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and all her men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:31
verses.text: Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> against thee, <transChange type="added">O thou</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02087">most proud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for thy day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">the time</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will visit</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>most…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pride</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02087">And the most proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall stumble</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and none shall raise him up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in his cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">all round about</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pride</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all that took them captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">held them fast</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to let them go</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Their Redeemer</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02389">strong</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall throughly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">their cause</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07280" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that he may give rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and disquiet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02719">A sword</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03778">upon the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and upon the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and upon her princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02450">and upon her wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02719">A sword</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0907">upon the liars</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02973" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and they shall dote</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">upon her mighty men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall be dismayed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>liars</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chief stays</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bars</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02719">A sword</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05483">upon their horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">and upon their chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06153">and upon all the mingled people</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of her; and they shall become as women</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0214">upon her treasures</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">and they shall be robbed</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02721">A drought</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">upon her waters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall be dried up</w>: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">of graven images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8704">and they are mad</w> upon <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0367">idols</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06728">Therefore the wild beasts of the desert</w> <w lemma="strong:H0338">with the wild beasts of the islands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> <transChange type="added">there</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03284 strong:H01323">and the owls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein: and it shall be no more inhabited</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall it be dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in from generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to generation</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">As God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04114">overthrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">and Gomorrah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07934">and the neighbour</w> <transChange type="added">cities</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thereof, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">shall no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">there, neither shall any son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> therein.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Behold, a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">from the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be raised up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">from the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They shall hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">the bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03591">and the lance</w>: they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0394">cruel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and will not shew mercy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall roar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">like the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">upon horses</w>, <transChange type="added">every one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">put in array</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">like a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to the battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">against thee, O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">the report</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of them, and his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">waxed feeble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06869">anguish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">took hold</w> of him, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02427">pangs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as of a woman in travail</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, he shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">like a lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">from the swelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">unto the habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0386">of the strong</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07323" type="x-split-351">but I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07280" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323 strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">run away</w> from her: and who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">a chosen</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I may appoint</w> over her? for who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">like me? and who will appoint me the time</w>? and who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that shepherd</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that will stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> me?<note type="study"><catchWord>appoint me…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">convent me to plead?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">ye the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">against Babylon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04284">and his purposes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath purposed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">against the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06810">Surely the least</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05498" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall draw them out</w>: surely he shall make <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05116">habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">desolate</w> with them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">At the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">of the taking</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is moved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02201">and the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 50." eID="gen847" osisID="Jer.50"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">against Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and against them that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of them that rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">against me, a destroying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>midst</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">unto Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">fanners</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that shall fan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01238" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">her, and shall empty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">her land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">they shall be against her round about</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0413">Against</w> <transChange type="added">him that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bendeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let the archer bend</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">his bow</w>, and against <transChange type="added">him that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">lifteth himself up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05630">in his brigandine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">ye not her young men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">destroy ye utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">all her host</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02491">Thus the slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>, and <transChange type="added">they that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01856" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">thrust through</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">in her streets</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">For Israel</w> <transChange type="added">hath</transChange> not <transChange type="added">been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0488">forsaken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">nor Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">though their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">with sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">against the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Flee out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be not cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">in her iniquity</w>; for this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">vengeance</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">he will render</w> <w lemma="strong:H01576">unto her a recompence</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0894">Babylon</w> <transChange type="added">hath been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">a golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">that made all the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">drunken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have drunken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of her wine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01471">therefore the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8704">are mad</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0894">Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">is suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and destroyed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">howl</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">for her; take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06875">balm</w> <w lemma="strong:H04341">for her pain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">if so be she may be healed</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">We would have healed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">but she is not healed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her, and let us go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into his own country</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04941">for her judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">unto heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and is lifted up</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07834">to the skies</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">our righteousness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and let us declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Make bright</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">the arrows</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H07982">the shields</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath raised up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04074">of the Medes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04209">for his device</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0894">against Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> it; because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05360">the vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05360">the vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of his temple</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bright</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pure</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">the standard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04929">make the watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the watchmen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the ambushes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02161" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath both devised</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ambushes</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">liers in wait</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07931 strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8802">O thou that dwellest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">upon many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">abundant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">in treasures</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07093">thine end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is come</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0520">the measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">of thy covetousness</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">by himself</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Surely I will fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">thee with men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03218">as with caterpillers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01959">a shout</w> against thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>by himself</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by his soul</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>lift up</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">utter</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">by his power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he hath established</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">by his wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">by his understanding</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:16
