verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When he uttereth</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01995">a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the heavens</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05387">and he causeth the vapours</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to ascend</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">from the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">lightnings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">with rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and bringeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">out of his treasures</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>multitude</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">noise</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is brutish</w> by <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every founder</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">by the graven image</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05262">for his molten image</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsehood</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">no breath</w> in them.<note type="study"><catchWord>is brutish…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">is more brutish than to know</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:18
verses.text: They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H08595">of errors</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">of their visitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall perish</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02506">The portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not like them; for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the former</w> of all things: and <transChange type="added">Israel is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of his inheritance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:20
verses.text: Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04661">my battle axe</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for with thee will I break in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and with thee will I destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">kingdoms</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>with thee</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in thee</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">by thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And with thee will I break in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">the horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his rider</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and with thee will I break in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">the chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his rider</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">With thee also will I break in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and woman</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and with thee will I break in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">and young</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and with thee will I break in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">and the maid</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I will also break in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with thee the shepherd</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">and his flock</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and with thee will I break in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0406">the husbandman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06776">and his yoke of oxen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and with thee will I break in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H06346">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05461">and rulers</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will render</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">unto Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and to all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of Chaldea</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all their evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in your sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:25
verses.text: Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04889">against thee, O destroying</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which destroyest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">upon thee, and roll thee down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">from the rocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08316">thee a burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they shall not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of thee a stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">for a corner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068">nor a stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H04146">for foundations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08077">but thou shalt be desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>desolate…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">everlasting desolations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Set ye up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">a standard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">the trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">against her, call together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">against her the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0780">of Ararat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04508">Minni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0813">and Ashchenaz</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H02951">a captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">against her; cause the horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05569">as the rough</w> <w lemma="strong:H03218">caterpillers</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">against her the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04074">of the Medes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06346">the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05461">thereof, and all the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thereof, and all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04475">of his dominion</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall tremble</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sorrow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04284">for every purpose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be performed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">against Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">a desolation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">without an inhabitant</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01368">The mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have forborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have remained</w> in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04679">holds</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01369">their might</w> <w lemma="strong:H05405" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath failed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802">they became as women</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they have burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">her dwellingplaces</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01280">her bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are broken</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">One post</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall run</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and one messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">that his city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is taken</w> at <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">end</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04569">And that the passages</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are stopped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H098">and the reeds</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are affrighted</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01323">The daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01637">like a threshingfloor</w>, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to thresh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">her: yet a little while</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">of her harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it is…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in the time that he thresheth her</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H02000" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, he hath crushed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">me, he hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07385">me an empty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath swallowed me up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">like a dragon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03770">his belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05730">with my delicates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01740" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath cast me out</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02555">The violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H07607">done to me and to my flesh</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0894">upon Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall the inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">and my blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of Chaldea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">shall Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The violence…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">My violence</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>flesh</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">remainder</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>inhabitant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">inhabitress</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Behold, I will plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">thy cause</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and take vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">for thee</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will dry up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">her sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04726">and make her springs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">dry</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0894">And Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">shall become heaps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04583">a dwellingplace</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">for dragons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08047">an astonishment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08322">and an hissing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">without an inhabitant</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall roar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">like lions</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05286" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall yell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">as lions’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01484">whelps</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>yell</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shake themselves</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02527">In their heat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">their feasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will make them drunken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H08142">sleep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and not wake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will bring them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03733">like lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H02873" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to the slaughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">like rams</w> <w lemma="strong:H06260">with he goats</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08347">How is Sheshach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">taken</w>! <w lemma="strong:H08416">and how is the praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the whole earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">surprised</w>! <w lemma="strong:H0894">how is Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">become an astonishment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>!

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03220">The sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">upon Babylon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">she is covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">with the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">of the waves</w> thereof.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">Her cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">are a desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06723">a dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06160">and a wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">wherein no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelleth</w>, neither doth <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H02004">thereby</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01078">Bel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">in Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01105">that which he hath swallowed up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01471">and the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05102" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not flow together</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">any more unto him: yea, the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fall</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">My people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go ye out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">of her, and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">from the fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03824">And lest your heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07401" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">faint</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">for the rumour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that shall be heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08052">a rumour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall both come</w> <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> that in <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <transChange type="added">shall come</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08052">a rumour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02555">and violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against ruler</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lest</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">let not</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Therefore, behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I will do judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">upon the graven images</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">and her whole land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be confounded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02491">and all her slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> of her.<note type="study"><catchWord>do…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visit upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">Then the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w>, and all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">therein, shall sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">for Babylon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for the spoilers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">unto her from the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01571">As</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">Babylon</w> <transChange type="added">hath caused</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">the slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0894">so at Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">the slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>As…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Both Babylon is to fall, O ye slain of Israel, and with Babylon</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>the earth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the country</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06405">Ye that have escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stand not still</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and let Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">into your mind</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We are confounded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because we have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">reproach</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03639">shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">our faces</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">for strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">into the sanctuaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Wherefore, behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I will do judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">upon her graven images</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">and through all her land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">the wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0602" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall groan</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0894">Though Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should mount up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">to heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and though she should fortify</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of her strength</w>, <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H0227">yet</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from me shall spoilers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto her, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">A sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H02201">of a cry</w> <transChange type="added">cometh</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0894">from Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hath spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">out of her the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01530">when her waves</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do roar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">like great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07588">a noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">of their voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is uttered</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Because the spoiler</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> upon her, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0894">upon Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">and her mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are taken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198">every one of their bows</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">is broken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01578">of recompences</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">requite</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:57
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will make drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">her princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02450">and her wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06346">her captains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05461">and her rulers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">and her mighty men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H08142">sleep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and not wake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the King</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:58
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07342">The broad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06209" morph="strongMorph:TH8771">shall be utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06209" morph="strongMorph:TH8698">broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01364">and her high</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07385">in vain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03816">and the folk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03286" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall be weary</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The broad…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">The walls of broad Babylon</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>broken</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">made naked</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:59
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">which Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08304">Seraiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05374">of Neriah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04271">of Maaseiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">with Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">into Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07243">in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of his reign</w>. And <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08304">Seraiah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04496">a quiet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">prince</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">on the behalf of</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>quiet…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prince of Menucha</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">chief chamberlain</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:60
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03414">So Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in a</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">book</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that should come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">upon Babylon</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that are written</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">against Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:61
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03414">And Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08304">to Seraiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When thou comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt read</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:62
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shalt thou say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">against this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cut it off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that none shall remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">in it, neither man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">nor beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08077">but that it shall be desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>desolate</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">desolations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:63
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And it shall be, when thou hast made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of reading</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">this book</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">a stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to it, and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">it into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">of Euphrates</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:64
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0894">Thus shall Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08257" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03286" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon her: and they shall be weary</w>. Thus far <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 51." eID="gen848" osisID="Jer.51"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0259">eleven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02537">Hamutal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03841">of Libnah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>began…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">reigned</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03079">according to all that Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05921">For through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">it came to pass in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">till he had cast them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from his presence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06667">that Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08671">And it came to pass in the ninth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of his reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06224">in the tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06218">in the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">he and all his army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against it, and built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01785">forts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">against it round about</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">was besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H06249">unto the eleventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07243">And in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08672">in the ninth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">the famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">so that there was no bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">Then the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was broken up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">between the two walls</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">by the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">garden</w>; (<w lemma="strong:H03778">now the Chaldeans</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">by the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>:) <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">of the plain</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02428">But the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and overtook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02428">and all his army</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was scattered</w> from him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and carried him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07247">to Riblah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">where he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> upon him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">of Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before his eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">also all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07247">in Riblah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05786" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Then he put out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">of Zedekiah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">him in chains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">him to Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486 strong:H01004">him in prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">till the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of his death</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>put out</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">blinded</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>chains</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fetters</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>prison</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">house of the wards</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02549">Now in the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06218">in the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H06240 strong:H08672">the nineteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05018">Nebuzar–adan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">served</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">into Jerusalem</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>captain…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chief marshal</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">chief of the executioners</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">slaughtermen</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>served</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stood before</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of the great</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">he with fire</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02428">And all the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>, that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">with the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">brake down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">all the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05018">Then Nebuzar–adan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">carried away captive</w> <transChange type="added">certain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01803">of the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">and the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and those that fell away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">and the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0527">of the multitude</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05018">But Nebuzar–adan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">left</w> <transChange type="added">certain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01803">of the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03755">for vinedressers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03009" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and for husbandmen</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05982">Also the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04350">and the bases</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">and the brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03778">the Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">brake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">all the brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of them to Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05518">The caldrons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03257">also, and the shovels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04212">and the snuffers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04219">and the bowls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and the spoons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wherewith they ministered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took they away</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shovels</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">instruments to remove the ashes</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>bowls</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">basons</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05592">And the basons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04289">and the firepans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04219">and the bowls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05518">and the caldrons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04501">and the candlesticks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and the spoons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04518">and the cups</w>; <transChange type="added">that</transChange> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-352">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-352">away</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>firepans</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">censers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">The two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">and twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">bulls</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04350">under the bases</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">which king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05178">the brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">of all these vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">was without weight</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the brass</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their brass</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:21
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05982">the pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06967">the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillar</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">eighteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02339">and a fillet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">of twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05672">it; and the thickness</w> thereof <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">fingers</w>: <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05014" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hollow</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fillet</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thread</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03805">And a chapiter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06967">upon it; and the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">chapiter</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07639">with network</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">and pomegranates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">upon the chapiters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08145">The second</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">also and the pomegranates</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> like unto these.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08673">And there were ninety</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">pomegranates</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">on a side</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07416">all the pomegranates</w> <w lemma="strong:H07639">upon the network</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07227">And the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08304">Seraiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06846">and Zephaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">of the door</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>door</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">threshold</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">also out of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">an</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">eunuch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06496">which had the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that were near</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">person</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which were found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the principal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06633" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">who mustered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08346">and threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that were found</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>were near…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">saw the face of the king</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>principal…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">scribe of the captain of the host</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05018">So Nebuzar–adan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">them to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07247">to Riblah</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and put them to death</w> <w lemma="strong:H07247">in Riblah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03063">Thus Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of his own land</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:28
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">whom Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">carried away captive</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07651">in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w>:

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">In the eighteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">persons</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>persons</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">souls</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">In the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05018">Nebuzar–adan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">of the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">persons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">all the persons</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07651">And it came to pass in the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirtieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01546">of the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03078">of Jehoiachin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">in the twelfth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">in the five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0192">Evil–merodach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> in the <transChange type="added">first</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of his reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03078">of Jehoiachin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought him forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03628 strong:H01004">out of prison</w>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">kindly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0894">with him in Babylon</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>kindly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">good things with him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03608">his prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08548">and he did continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:34
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0737">his diet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08548">there was a continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H0737">diet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">every</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">until the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of his death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>every…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the matter of the day in his day</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 52." eID="gen849" osisID="Jer.52"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen797" osisID="Jer" type="book"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">How doth the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0910">solitary</w>, <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of people</w>! <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0490">is she become as a widow</w>! she <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08282">princess</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">among the provinces</w>, <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04522">is she become tributary</w>!

verses.name: Lamentations 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">She weepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01832">and her tears</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03895">on her cheeks</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">among all her lovers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">she hath none to comfort</w> <transChange type="added">her</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07453">all her friends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have dealt treacherously</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with her, they are become her enemies</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is gone into captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">because of affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">and because of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">servitude</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she findeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04494">no rest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all her persecutors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">overtook</w> <w lemma="strong:H04712">her between the straits</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>because of great…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for the greatness of servitude</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">The ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H057">do mourn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because none come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">to the solemn feasts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08179">all her gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">are desolate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">her priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H0584" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">sigh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01330">her virgins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03013" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">are afflicted</w>, and she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in bitterness</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06862">Her adversaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">are the chief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">her enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H07951" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">prosper</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03013" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">her for the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">of her transgressions</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05768">her children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">into captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">the enemy</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01323">And from the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">all her beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is departed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08269">her princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0354">are become like harts</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">find</w> <w lemma="strong:H04829">no pasture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they are gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">without strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the pursuer</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">of her affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H04788">and of her miseries</w> <w lemma="strong:H04262">all her pleasant things</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that she had in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">when her people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">of the enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and none did help</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">her: the adversaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> her, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did mock</w> <w lemma="strong:H04868">at her sabbaths</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">desirable</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">hath grievously</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sinned</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05206">therefore she is removed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">all that honoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H02107" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">her despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">her, because they have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">her nakedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0584" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">yea, she sigheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">backward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>is…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is become a removing</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">wandering</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02932">Her filthiness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07757">in her skirts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she remembereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">not her last end</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore she came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06382">wonderfully</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">she had no comforter</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">my affliction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath magnified</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange>.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06862">The adversary</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath spread out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04261">upon all her pleasant things</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for she hath seen</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">into her sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whom thou didst command</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they should not enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">into thy congregation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">desirable</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">All her people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0584" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">sigh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">they seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04262 strong:H04261" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">their pleasant things</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">for meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to relieve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and consider</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02151" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for I am become vile</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to make the soul to come again</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nothing to you, all ye that pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">if there be</w> <w lemma="strong:H04341">any sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04341">like unto my sorrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8776">which is done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto me, wherewith the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03013" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath afflicted</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">of his fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Is it…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">It is nothing</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>pass by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pass by the way?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04791">From above</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">into my bones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it prevaileth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against them: he hath spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07568">a net</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">for my feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">me back</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me desolate</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01739">faint</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05923">The yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">of my transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H08244" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08276" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">they are wreathed</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">upon my neck</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03581">he hath made my strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath delivered</w> me into <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>, <transChange type="added">from whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I am not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to rise up</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">The Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H05541" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath trodden under foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H047">all my mighty</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of me: he hath called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">an assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against me to crush</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">my young men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath trodden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">the virgin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01660">in a winepress</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the virgin…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the winepress of the virgin</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:16
verses.text: For these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I weep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eye</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">runneth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">because the comforter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that should relieve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is far</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from me: my children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">are desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">prevailed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>relieve</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bring back</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spreadeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">her hands</w>, <transChange type="added">and there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">none to comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">her: the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">concerning Jacob</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06862">his adversaries</w> <transChange type="added">should be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">him: Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">is as a menstruous woman</w> among them.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">is righteous</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">against his commandment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">I pray you, all people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04341">my sorrow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01330">my virgins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">and my young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">into captivity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>commandment</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">for my lovers</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07411" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they deceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">me: my priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">and mine elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave up the ghost</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">while they sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">their meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to relieve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their souls</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in distress</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04578">my bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02560" morph="strongMorph:TH8777">are troubled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03820">mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me; for I have grievously</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rebelled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">bereaveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">at home</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">as death</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0584" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that I sigh</w>: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">none to comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me: all mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of my trouble</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast done</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou wilt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03644">and they shall be like</w> unto me.<note type="study"><catchWord>called</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">proclaimed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">Let all their wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8778">thee; and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8782">unto them, as thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">unto me for all my transgressions</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0585">for my sighs</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and my heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01742">faint</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen851" osisID="Lam.1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">How hath the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H05743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-353">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-353">with a cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in his anger</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">the beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272 strong:H01916">not his footstool</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of his anger</w>!

verses.name: Lamentations 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">The Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath swallowed up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04999">all the habitations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath not pitied</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath thrown down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">in his wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">the strong holds</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; he hath brought <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>brought…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made to touch</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:3
