verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath cut off</w> in <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02750">fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">all the horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath drawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">back</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">his right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">against Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03852">like a flaming</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">devoureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath bent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">his bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like an enemy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">with his right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">as an adversary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> all <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04261">pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">to the eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">his fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">like fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all the desirable of the eye</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">The Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was as an enemy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath swallowed up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath swallowed up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">all her palaces</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">his strong holds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and hath increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">in the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08386">mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0592">and lamentation</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02554" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he hath violently taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07900">his tabernacle</w>, as <transChange type="added">if it were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01588">a garden</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">his places of the assembly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">hath caused the solemn feasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">and sabbaths</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">to be forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hath despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">in the indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>tabernacle</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hedge</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">The Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath cast off</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">his altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05010" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath abhorred</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">his sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath given up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">of her palaces</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">a noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of a solemn feast</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>given up</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shut up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath purposed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06957">a line</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath not withdrawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">from destroying</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02426">therefore he made the rampart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">and the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to lament</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">they languished</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroying</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">swallowing up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08179">Her gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H02883" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are sunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the ground</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">her bars</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">her king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and her princes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the Gentiles</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> no <transChange type="added">more</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05030">her prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">no vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">The elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the ground</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">keep silence</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they have cast up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon their heads</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">themselves with sackcloth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01330">the virgins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hang down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">their heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">with tears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04578">my bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02560" morph="strongMorph:TH8777">are troubled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03516">my liver</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07667">for the destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05768">because the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the sucklings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">swoon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">of the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>swoon</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">faint</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">to their mothers</w>, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01715">corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">and wine</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">when they swooned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">as the wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">when their soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">was poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">into their mothers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">bosom</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05749 strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">What thing shall I take to witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04100">for thee? what thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall I liken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">to thee, O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">what shall I equal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to thee, that I may comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">thee, O virgin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07667">for thy breach</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">like the sea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who can heal</w> thee?

verses.name: Lamentations 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">Thy prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08602">and foolish things</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for thee: and they have not discovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">thine iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622 strong:H07622" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">thy captivity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">for thee false</w> <w lemma="strong:H04864">burdens</w> <w lemma="strong:H04065">and causes of banishment</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">All that pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05606" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">by clap</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">at thee</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08319" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they hiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and wag</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">their head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">at the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this the city</w> that <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H03632">The perfection</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">of beauty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04885">The joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the whole earth</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the way</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">All thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06475" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">their mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08319" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against thee: they hiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H02786" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gnash</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">the teeth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they say</w>, We have swallowed <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0389">certainly</w> this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that we looked for</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we have found</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we have seen</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath done</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02161" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had devised</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01214" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath fulfilled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">his word</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of old</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath thrown down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath not pitied</w>: and he hath caused <transChange type="added">thine</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">over thee, he hath set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">the horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">of thine adversaries</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">unto the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02346">O wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01832">let tears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">run down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">like a river</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06314">thyself no rest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01323">let not the apple</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of thine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cease</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">cry out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0821">of the watches</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">like water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05227">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">thy hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">toward him for the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05768">of thy young children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that faint</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">for hunger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">of every street</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8782">to whom thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03541">this</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0802">Shall the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">their fruit</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05768">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02949">of a span long</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03548">shall the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">and the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">in the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>of a span…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">swaddled with their hands?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">The young</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">in the streets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01330">my virgins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">and my young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast slain</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of thine anger</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02873" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast killed</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not pitied</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou hast called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">as in a solemn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04032">my terrors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">so that in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H06412">none escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">nor remained</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02946" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">those that I have swaddled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hath mine enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">consumed</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen852" osisID="Lam.2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:1
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01397">the man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">by the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">of his wrath</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath led</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, and brought</w> <transChange type="added">me into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w>, but not <transChange type="added">into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Surely against me is he turned</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <transChange type="added">against me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">My flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">and my skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01086" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath he made old</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">my bones</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath builded against</w> <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, and compassed</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07219">with gall</w> <w lemma="strong:H08513">and travail</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He hath set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04285">me in dark places</w>, as <transChange type="added">they that be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01443" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath hedged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me about, that I cannot get out</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05178">he hath made my chain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">heavy</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Also when I cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and shout</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05640" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shutteth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">my prayer</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01443" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath inclosed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H01496">with hewn stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05410">he hath made my paths</w> <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">crooked</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:10
verses.text: He <transChange type="added">was</transChange> unto me <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01677">a bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lying in wait</w>, <transChange type="added">and as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0738">a lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04565">in secret places</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">He hath turned aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06582" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and pulled me in pieces</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me desolate</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath bent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">his bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">me as a mark</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">for the arrow</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">He hath caused the arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H0827">of his quiver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">into my reins</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>arrows</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sons</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07814">I was a derision</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to all my people</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05058">their song</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He hath filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04844">me with bitterness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07301" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath made me drunken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03939">with wormwood</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bitterness</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bitternesses</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01638" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He hath also broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">my teeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02687">with gravel stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03728" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">me with ashes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>covered…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">rolled me in the ashes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-354">And thou hast removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-354">far off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">from peace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05382" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I forgat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">prosperity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prosperity</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">good</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05331">My strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H08431">and my hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is perished</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Lamentations 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remembering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">mine affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H04788">and my misery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03939">the wormwood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07219">and the gall</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Remembering</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Remember</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> hath <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">still</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in remembrance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and is humbled</w> in me.<note type="study"><catchWord>humbled</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bowed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">This I recall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">to my mind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore have I hope</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>recall…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">make to return to my heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">It is of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that we are not consumed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07356">because his compassions</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fail</w> not.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:23
verses.text: <transChange type="added">They are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02319">new</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">every morning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0530">thy faithfulness</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">my portion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore will I hope</w> in him.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them that wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for him, to the soul</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">seeketh</w> him.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:26
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> that <transChange type="added">a man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02342 strong:H03175" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675">should both hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H01748">and quietly wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">for the salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:27
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">for a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">the yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">in his youth</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0910">alone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and keepeth silence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05190" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he hath borne</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> upon him.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He putteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">in the dust</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03426">if so be there may be</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">hope</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He giveth</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03895">cheek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to him that smiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: he is filled full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">with reproach</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">For the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not cast off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Lamentations 3:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03013" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">But though he cause grief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">yet will he have compassion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">according to the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of his mercies</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">For he doth not afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">willingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03013" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">nor grieve</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>willingly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from his heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">To crush</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">under his feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0615">all the prisoners</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>,

verses.name: Lamentations 3:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To turn aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">of a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">of the most High</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>the most High</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a superior</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05791" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">To subvert</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">in his cause</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">approveth</w> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>approveth not</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">seeth not</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:37
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w>, and it cometh to pass, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commandeth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> not?

verses.name: Lamentations 3:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">Out of the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">of the most High</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">proceedeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">not evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and good</w>?

verses.name: Lamentations 3:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">Wherefore doth a living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0596" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">complain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01397">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">for the punishment of his sins</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>complain</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">murmur</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us search</w> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and try</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">our ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">our heart</w> with <transChange type="added">our</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the heavens</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05168">We</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have rebelled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast not pardoned</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">with anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and persecuted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us: thou hast slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast not pitied</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">thyself with a cloud</w>, that <transChange type="added">our</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08605">prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">should not pass through</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou hast made</w> us <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05501">the offscouring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03973">and refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">All our enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06475" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">their mouths</w> against us.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06343">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06354">and a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07612">is come upon us, desolation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">and destruction</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">runneth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06388">with rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">for the destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H05064" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">trickleth down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ceaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02014">not, without any intermission</w>,

verses.name: Lamentations 3:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Till the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">look down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8782">affecteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">because of all the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of my city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mine heart</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my soul</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>because…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">more than all</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">chased</w> <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me sore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06833">like a bird</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02600">without cause</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">in the dungeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">a stone</w> upon me.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">Waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06687" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">flowed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">mine head</w>; <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01504" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am cut off</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:55
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">upon thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08482">out of the low</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">dungeon</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">not thine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07309">at my breathing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07775">at my cry</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:57
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou drewest near</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon thee: thou saidst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> not.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:58
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast pleaded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">the causes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of my soul</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">my life</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:59
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05792">my wrong</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thou my cause</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:60
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">all their vengeance</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04284">all their imaginations</w> against me.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:61
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">their reproach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04284">all their imaginations</w> against me;

verses.name: Lamentations 3:62
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08193">The lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of those that rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01902">against me, and their device</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">against me all the day</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:63
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">their sitting down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07012">and their rising up</w>; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04485">their musick</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:64
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Render</w> <w lemma="strong:H01576">unto them a recompence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">according to the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their hands</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:65
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04044">them sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08381">thy curse</w> unto them.<note type="study"><catchWord>sorrow…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">obstinacy of heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:66
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Persecute</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">them in anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from under the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen853" osisID="Lam.3"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02091">How is the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06004" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">become dim</w>! <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">is the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H03800">fine gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08132" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">changed</w>! <w lemma="strong:H068">the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">are poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">of every street</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03368">The precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05537" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">comparable</w> <w lemma="strong:H06337">to fine gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">how are they esteemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02789">as earthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">pitchers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the potter</w>!

verses.name: Lamentations 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08577">Even the sea monsters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">draw out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">the breast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they give suck</w> <w lemma="strong:H01482">to their young ones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <transChange type="added">is become</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0393">cruel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03283">like the ostriches</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sea…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sea calves</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03956">The tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the sucking child</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cleaveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02441">to the roof of his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06772">for thirst</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05768">the young children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">no man breaketh</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> unto them.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They that did feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04574">delicately</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">in the streets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they that were brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08438">in scarlet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02263" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">embrace</w> <w lemma="strong:H0830">dunghills</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05771">For the punishment of the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">than the punishment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of the sin of Sodom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that was overthrown</w> <w lemma="strong:H07281">as in a moment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and no hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stayed</w> on her.<note type="study"><catchWord>punishment of the iniquity</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">iniquity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05139">Her Nazarites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02141" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were purer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07950">than snow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06705" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they were whiter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">than milk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0119" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they were more ruddy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">in body</w> <w lemma="strong:H06443">than rubies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01508">their polishing</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05601">of sapphire</w>:

verses.name: Lamentations 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08389">Their visage</w> <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is blacker</w> <w lemma="strong:H07815">than a coal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they are not known</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">in the streets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05785">their skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06821" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cleaveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">to their bones</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it is withered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">it is become like a stick</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blacker…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">darker than blackness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">They that be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">are better</w> than <transChange type="added">they that be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">with hunger</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01992">for these</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pine away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01856" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">stricken</w> through for <transChange type="added">want of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08570">the fruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">flow out</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">The hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07362">of the pitiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w> <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have sodden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">their own children</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01262" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">they were their meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">in the destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath accomplished</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">his fury</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">his fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and hath kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it hath devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H03247">the foundations</w> thereof.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">of the world</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">would not have believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">that the adversary</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should have entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">into the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02403">For the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of her prophets</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of her priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that have shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the just</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> of her,

verses.name: Lamentations 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have wandered</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05787">blind</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02351">in the streets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01351" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they have polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">themselves with blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that men could</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">their garments</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>so…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in that they could not but touch</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Depart</w> ye; <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">depart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">depart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05132" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not: when they fled away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wandered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They shall no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sojourn</w> <transChange type="added">there</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ye polluted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">The anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them; he will no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: they respected</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">not the persons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they favoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">not the elders</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>anger</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">face</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">As for us, our eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">as yet failed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">for our vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">help</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06836">in our watching</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">we have watched</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">for a nation</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">could not save</w> <transChange type="added">us</transChange>.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They hunt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06806">our steps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that we cannot go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in our streets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07093">our end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">our days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are fulfilled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07093">for our end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Our persecutors</w> <w lemma="strong:H07031">are swifter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">than the eagles</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01814" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">us upon the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they laid wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">for us in the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">The breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of our nostrils</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04899">the anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07825">in their pits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of whom we said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06738">Under his shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we shall live</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be glad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwellest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05780">of Uz</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03563">the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also shall pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and shalt make thyself naked</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05771">The punishment of thine iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is accomplished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he will no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">carry thee away into captivity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he will visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">thine iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he will discover</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">thy sins</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Thine iniquity</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>discover…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">carry thee captive for thy sins</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen854" osisID="Lam.4"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">what is come upon us: consider</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">our reproach</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05159">Our inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">to strangers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">our houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">to aliens</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03490">We are orphans</w> <w lemma="strong:H01 strong:H0369">and fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">our mothers</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0490">as widows</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have drunken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">our water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for money</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06086">our wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04242 strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is sold</w> unto us.<note type="study"><catchWord>is…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cometh for price</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06677">Our necks</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">under persecution</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we labour</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">have no rest</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Our…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">On our necks are we persecuted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hand</w> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w>, <transChange type="added">and to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0804">the Assyrians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">with bread</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have sinned</w>, <transChange type="added">and are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0369">not</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05445" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and we have borne</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">their iniquities</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">Servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have ruled</w> over us: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06561" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none that doth deliver</w> <transChange type="added">us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of their hand</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">We gat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">our bread</w> with <transChange type="added">the peril of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">our lives</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05785">Our skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03648" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was black</w> <w lemma="strong:H08574">like an oven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02152">of the terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">famine</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>terrible</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">terrors</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">storms</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">They ravished</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01330">the maids</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are hanged up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by their hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06440">the faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01921" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were not honoured</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02911">to grind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">under the wood</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">The elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have ceased</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">from the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0970">the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05058">from their musick</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04885">The joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of our heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is ceased</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04234">our dance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">into mourning</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05850">The crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fallen</w> <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">our head</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0188">woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto us, that we have sinned</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>The…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">The crown of our head is fallen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">For this our heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01739">is faint</w>; for these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">our eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are dim</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">Because of the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which is desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07776">the foxes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">walk</w> upon it.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remainest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03678">thy throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">from generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to generation</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore dost thou forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">us for ever</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">us so long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">time</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>so…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for length of days?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thou us unto thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we shall be turned</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02318" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">renew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">our days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">as of old</w>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">But thou hast utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">us; thou art very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wroth</w> against us.<note type="study"><catchWord>But…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">For wilt thou utterly reject us?</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen855" osisID="Lam.5"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen850" osisID="Lam" type="book"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07970">Now it came to pass in the thirtieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07243">in the fourth</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">in the fifth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, as I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">the captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H03529">of Chebar</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were opened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04759">visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>captives</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">captivity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568">In the fifth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02549">the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03112">Jehoiachin’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01546">captivity</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03168">came expressly unto Ezekiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0941">of Buzi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H03529">Chebar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">and the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> was there upon him.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ezekiel</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Jehezkel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05591 strong:H07307">and, behold, a whirlwind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">out of the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">and a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">infolding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05051">itself, and a brightness</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">it, and out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thereof as the colour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02830">of amber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of the fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>infolding…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">catching itself</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08432">Also out of the midst</w> thereof <transChange type="added">came</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01823">the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">of four</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">living creatures</w>. And this <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">their appearance</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02007">they</w> <w lemma="strong:H01823">had the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">had four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">faces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">had four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wings</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07272">And their feet</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">straight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">feet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03709">and the sole</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of their feet</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">like the sole</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">of a calf’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">foot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05340" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they sparkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">like the colour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07044">of burnished</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>straight…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a straight foot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:8
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">they had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">under their wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">on their four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07253">sides</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0702">and they four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">had their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">and their wings</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03671">Their wings</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">to another</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not when they went</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">straight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">forward</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01823">As for the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of their faces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">they four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">had the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">of a lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right side</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0702">and they four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">had the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">of an ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">on the left side</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0702">they four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">also had the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">of an eagle</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:11
verses.text: Thus <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">their faces</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03671">and their wings</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">stretched</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">upward</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <transChange type="added">wings</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of every one</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01472">their bodies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stretched…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">divided above</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">straight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">forward</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07307">whither the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was to go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they went</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not when they went</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01823">As for the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living creatures</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">their appearance</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01513">coals</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">like the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03940">of lamps</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">it went up and down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">among the living creatures</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0784">and the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05051">was bright</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">and out of the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">lightning</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">And the living creatures</w> <w lemma="strong:H07519" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">as the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0965">of a flash of lightning</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now as I beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the living creatures</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">behold one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">wheel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the living creatures</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">with his four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">faces</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04758">The appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">of the wheels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">and their work</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">like unto the colour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08658">of a beryl</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0702">and they four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">had one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01823">likeness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04758">and their appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">and their work</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0212">as it were a wheel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the middle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">of a wheel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When they went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">upon their four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07253">sides</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not when they went</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01354">As for their rings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01363">they were so high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">that they were dreadful</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01354">and their rings</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">them four</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and their rings</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and their strakes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">And when the living creatures</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0212">the wheels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by them</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02416">and when the living creatures</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">were lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0212">the wheels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were lifted up</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">Whithersoever the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was to go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they went</w>, thither <transChange type="added">was their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0212">and the wheels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05980">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">them: for the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living creature</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0212">in the wheels</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When those went</w>, <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when those stood</w>, <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">and when those were lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0212">the wheels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05980">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">them: for the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living creature</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0212">in the wheels</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01823">And the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07549">of the firmament</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living creature</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">as the colour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of the terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H07140">crystal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">stretched forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">over their heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07549">And under the firmament</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03671">their wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">straight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">toward the other</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">had two</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">on this side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">had two</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">on that side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01472">their bodies</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And when they went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of their wings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">like the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">as the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">of the Almighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01999">of speech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">as the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of an host</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they stood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they let down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">their wings</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:25
