verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">And there was a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07549">from the firmament</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">over their heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they stood</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">had let down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">their wings</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04605">And above</w> <w lemma="strong:H07549">the firmament</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">over their heads</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01823">the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">of a throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">as the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05601">of a sapphire</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01823">and upon the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">of the throne</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01823">the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">as the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> upon it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">as the colour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02830">of amber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">as the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">it, from the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">of his loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">even upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">and from the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">of his loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">even downward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">as it were the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05051">and it had brightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04758">As the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">of the bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">that is in the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">of rain</w>, so <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05051">of the brightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>. This <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01823">of the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when I saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon my face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of one that spake</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen857" osisID="Ezek.1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">upon thy feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will speak</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">And the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">into me when he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto me, and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">me upon my feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">him that spake</w> unto me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I send</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thee to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to a rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that hath rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">against me: they and their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have transgressed</w> against me, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06106">unto this very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>nation</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">nations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:4
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H07186">impudent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H02389">and stiffhearted</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I do send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee unto them; and thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>impudent</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hard of face</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they, whether they will hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or whether they will forbear</w>, (for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04805">a rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">that there hath been a prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And thou, son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them, neither be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of their words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05621">though briers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05544">and thorns</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with thee, and thou dost dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06137">among scorpions</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of their words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor be dismayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at their looks</w>, though they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04805">a rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>briers…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">rebels</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And thou shalt speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, whether they will hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or whether they will forbear</w>: for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04805">most rebellious</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>most…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rebellion</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">But thou, son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">what I say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee; Be not</w> <w lemma="strong:H04805">thou rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H04805">like that rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06475" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I give</w> thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when I looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">behold, an hand</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">unto me; and, lo, a roll</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of a book</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> therein;

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it before</w> me; and it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">and without</w>: and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H07015">therein lamentations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01899">and mourning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01958">and woe</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen858" osisID="Ezek.2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou findest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">this roll</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So I opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he caused me to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">that roll</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0990">cause thy belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">thy bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04039">with this roll</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee. Then did I eat</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H06310">and it was in my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">as honey</w> <w lemma="strong:H04966">for sweetness</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thee unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">with my words</w> unto them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:5

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Not to many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06012">of a strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">and of an hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">language</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">whose words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou canst not understand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Surely, had I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee to them, they would have hearkened</w> unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>of a…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">deep of lip, and heavy of language</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Surely…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">If I had sent thee, etc. would they not have hearkened unto thee?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">But the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto thee; for they will</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto me: for all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04696 strong:H02389">impudent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H07186">and hardhearted</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>impudent…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stiff of forehead, and hard of heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H05980">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">their faces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04696">and thy forehead</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H05980">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04696">their foreheads</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08068">As an adamant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">harder</w> <w lemma="strong:H06864">than flint</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04696">thy forehead</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">them not, neither be dismayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at their looks</w>, though they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04805">a rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">all my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that I shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto thee receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">with thine ears</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">thee to them of the captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whether they will hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or whether they will forbear</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">Then the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took me up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">me a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07494">rushing</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">from his place</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">I heard</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">also the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of the wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living creatures</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">of the wheels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05980">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">them, and a noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07494">rushing</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>touched</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">kissed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">So the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lifted me up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took me away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">in bitterness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">in the heat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of my spirit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">but the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was strong</w> upon me.<note type="study"><catchWord>in bitterness</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bitter</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>heat</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hot anger</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">to them of the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H08512">at Tel–abib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H03529">of Chebar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where they sat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">there astonished</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">them seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07097">And it came to pass at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">of seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">that the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee a watchman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">at my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and give them warning</w> from me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When I say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">unto the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and thou givest him not warning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">nor speakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to warn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">from his wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to save his life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07563">the same wicked</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">in his iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">but his blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I require</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at thine hand</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Yet if thou warn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">not from his wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">nor from his wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">in his iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but thou hast delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-355">Again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06662">When a righteous</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-355">doth turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">from his righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04383">a stumblingblock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, he shall die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because thou hast not given him warning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">in his sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and his righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be remembered</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">but his blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I require</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at thine hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>righteousness which</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">righteousnesses</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Nevertheless if thou warn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06662">that the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not, and he doth not sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">because he is warned</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">also thou hast delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03027">And the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was there upon me; and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">into the plain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will there talk</w> with thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">into the plain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03519">and, behold, the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">there, as the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H03529">of Chebar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on my face</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">Then the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">into me, and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">me upon my feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with me, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">thyself within</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thine house</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">But thou, O son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">behold, they shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon thee, and shall bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee with them, and thou shalt not go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> them:

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03956">And I will make thy tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02441">to the roof of thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0481" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that thou shalt be dumb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198 strong:H0376" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and shalt not be to them a reprover</w>: for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04805">a rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a reprover</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man reproving</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">But when I speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, I will open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that heareth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him hear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02310">and he that forbeareth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him forbear</w>: for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04805">a rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen859" osisID="Ezek.3"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Thou also, son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03843">thee a tile</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and pourtray</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">upon it the city</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">siege</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against it, and build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01785">a fort</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against it, and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05550">a mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against it; set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">also against it, and set</w> <transChange type="added">battering</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03733">rams</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">against it round about</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>battering…</catchWord>: <rdg>chief leaders</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Moreover take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">thou unto thee an iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04227">pan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and set</w> it <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07023">a wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">between thee and the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">against it, and it shall be besieged</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt lay siege</w> against it. This <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a flat plate</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">slice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H08042">thou also upon thy left</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> upon it: <transChange type="added">according</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou shalt lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon it thou shalt bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">their iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I have laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">upon thee the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">of their iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">according to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of the days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08673">and ninety</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so shalt thou bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And when thou hast accomplished</w> <w lemma="strong:H0428">them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03227 strong:H03233" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">on thy right</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">thee each day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H08141">for a year</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>each…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a day for a year, a day for a year</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Therefore thou shalt set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">toward the siege</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02220">and thine arm</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02834" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">uncovered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and thou shalt prophesy</w> against it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And, behold, I will lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">upon thee, and thou shalt not turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">thee from one side</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">till thou hast ended</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">of thy siege</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from one…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from thy side to thy side</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">thou also unto thee wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08184">and barley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06321">and beans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05742">and lentiles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01764">and millet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03698">and fitches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">them in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">thee bread</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">according</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that thou shalt lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">upon thy side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08673">and ninety</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou eat</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>fitches</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spelt</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03978">And thy meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou shalt eat</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04946">by weight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">from time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">to time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou eat</w> it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">also water</w> <w lemma="strong:H04884">by measure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08345">the sixth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H01969">of an hin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">from time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">to time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou drink</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt eat</w> it <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08184">barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H05692">cakes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05746" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt bake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01561">it with dung</w> <w lemma="strong:H06627">that cometh out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">in their sight</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">Even thus shall the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">their defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the Gentiles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">whither I will drive</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0162">I, Ah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>! <w lemma="strong:H05315">behold, my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">hath not been polluted</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05271">for from my youth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">up even till now have I not eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">of that which dieth of itself</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02966">or is torn in pieces</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06292">there abominable</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">into my mouth</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Lo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">thee cow’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06832 strong:H06832" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">dung</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">for man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01561">dung</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">thy bread</w> therewith.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">behold, I will break</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">by weight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01674">and with care</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H04884">by measure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08078">and with astonishment</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That they may want</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">and water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and be astonied</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04743" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and consume away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for their iniquity</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen860" osisID="Ezek.4"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And thou, son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02299">thee a sharp</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">knife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01532">thee a barber’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08593">razor</w>, and cause <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon thine head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02206">and upon thy beard</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03976">thee balances</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">to weigh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and divide</w> the <transChange type="added">hair</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0217">with fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">a third part</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">when the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">of the siege</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">are fulfilled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">a third part</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">it with a knife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07992">and a third part</w> <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">in the wind</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will draw out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou shalt also take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">thereof a few</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">in number</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">them in thy skirts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>skirts</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then take of them again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">them into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">them in the fire</w>; <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">thereof shall a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">it in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and countries</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> her.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And she hath changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H07564">into wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">more than the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02708">and my statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">more than the countries</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">her: for they have refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">and my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have not walked</w> in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01995" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Because ye multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">more than the nations</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> you, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have not walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">in my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither have kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">according to the judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> you;

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; Behold, I, even I, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against thee, and will execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of thee in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in thee that which I have not done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and whereunto I will not do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03282">any more the like, because</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">of all thine abominations</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Therefore the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of thee, and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H08201">judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">in thee, and the whole remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">of thee will I scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">into all the winds</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:11
verses.text: Wherefore, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Surely, because thou hast defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">my sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">with all thy detestable things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08441">and with all thine abominations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore will I also diminish</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">neither shall mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither will I have any pity</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07992">A third part</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of thee shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">with the pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">and with famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they be consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">of thee: and a third part</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee; and I will scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">a third part</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">into all the winds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will draw out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">Thus shall mine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be accomplished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">and I will cause my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">upon them, and I will be comforted</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07068">in my zeal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when I have accomplished</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">my fury</w> in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">thee waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02781">and a reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thee, in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all that pass by</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02781">So it shall be a reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01422">and a taunt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04148">an instruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H04923">and an astonishment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">unto the nations</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, when I shall execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H08201">judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in thee in anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">and in fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">and in furious</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">rebukes</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">When I shall send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">upon them the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">of famine</w>, which shall be for <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04889">destruction</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">which I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">you: and I will increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">the famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon you, and will break</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">your staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">So will I send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">upon you famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and they shall bereave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">thee; and pestilence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">and blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee; and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon thee. I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen861" osisID="Ezek.5"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">toward the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and prophesy</w> against them,

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">Ye mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and to the hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0650">to the rivers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01516">and to the valleys</w>; Behold, I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">I, will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon you, and I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">your high places</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04196">And your altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02553">and your images</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be broken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">your slain</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">your idols</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sun images</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06297">the dead carcases</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">their idols</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and I will scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">your bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">your altars</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lay</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">give</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04186">In all your dwellingplaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be laid waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01116">and the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H03456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be desolate</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04196">that your altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may be laid waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01544">and your idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">may be broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and cease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02553">and your images</w> <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">may be cut down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">and your works</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">may be abolished</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sun images</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02491">And the slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of you, and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Yet will I leave a remnant</w>, that ye may have <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06412">that shall escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when ye shall be scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through the countries</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06412">And they that escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of you shall remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">me among the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">whither they shall be carried captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">because I am broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with their whorish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which hath departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">from me, and with their eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which go a whoring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">their idols</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06962" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and they shall lothe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">themselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">for the evils</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they have committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">in all their abominations</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">and that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have not said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">in vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I would do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">this evil</w> unto them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">with thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07554" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and stamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">with thy foot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0253">Alas</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">for all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>! <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">by the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and by the pestilence</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07350">He that is far off</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">of the pestilence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07138">and he that is near</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and he that remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and is besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">by the famine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thus will I accomplish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">my fury</w> upon them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shall ye know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02491">when their slain</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">shall be among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">their idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">their altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon every high</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">in all the tops</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07488">and under every green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05687">and under every thick</w> <w lemma="strong:H0424">oak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">where they did offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">to all their idols</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">So will I stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon them, and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04923">yea, more desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">than the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01689">toward Diblath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04186">in all their habitations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>more…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">desolate from the wilderness</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen862" osisID="Ezek.6"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Moreover the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Also, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07093">An end</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07093">the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">upon the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:3
verses.text: Now <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07093">the end</w> <transChange type="added">come</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon thee, and I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">mine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon thee, and will judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee according to thy ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">upon thee all thine abominations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>recompense</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">give</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">And mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, neither will I have pity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but I will recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thy ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">upon thee, and thine abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">shall be in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of thee: and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07451">An evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">an only</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, is come</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07093">An end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07093">the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">it watcheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for thee; behold, it is come</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>watcheth for</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">awaketh against</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06843">The morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto thee, O thou that dwellest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935 strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04103">of trouble</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01906">and not the sounding again</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sounding…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">echo</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07138">Now will I shortly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon thee, and accomplish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">mine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon thee: and I will judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee according to thy ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">thee for all thine abominations</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">And mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not spare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither will I have pity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee according to thy ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">and thine abominations</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">are in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of thee; and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that smiteth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thee according</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon thee</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold the day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, it is come</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06843">the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is gone forth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04294">the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H06692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath blossomed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02087">pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath budded</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02555">Violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is risen up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">into a rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">of wickedness</w>: none of them <transChange type="added">shall remain</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">nor of their multitude</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01991">nor of any</w> of theirs: neither <transChange type="added">shall there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05089">wailing</w> for them.<note type="study"><catchWord>theirs</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">their tumultuous persons</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tumult</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">The time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">draweth near</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">let not the buyer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor the seller</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">mourn</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02740">for wrath</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01995">upon all the multitude</w> thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For the seller</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04465">to that which is sold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">although they were yet alive</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02377">for the vision</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01995">touching the whole multitude</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not return</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">neither shall any</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">himself in the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>although they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">though their life were yet among the living</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">whose life is in his iniquity</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the iniquity</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his iniquity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have blown</w> <w lemma="strong:H08619">the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">even to make all ready</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but none goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to the battle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02740">for my wrath</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01995">upon all the multitude</w> thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02719">The sword</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and the pestilence</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">and the famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">within</w>: he that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>; and he that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">and pestilence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall devour</w> him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But they that escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H06412">of them shall escape</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and shall be on the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">like doves</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">of the valleys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all of them mourning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for his iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">All hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be feeble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01290">and all knees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be weak</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be weak…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">go into water</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They shall also gird</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08242">with sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06427">and horror</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H0955">them; and shame</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon all faces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07144">and baldness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon all their heads</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They shall cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">their silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">in the streets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and their gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">shall be removed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03701">their silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and their gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">them in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">of the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they shall not satisfy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their souls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">their bowels</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04383">because it is the stumblingblock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">of their iniquity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>removed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for a separation</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">uncleanness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>it is…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">their iniquity is their stumblingblock</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06643">As for the beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05716">of his ornament</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">it in majesty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06754">the images</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">of their abominations</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08251">of their detestable things</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therein: therefore have I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">it far</w> from them.<note type="study"><catchWord>set it far…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">made it unto them an unclean thing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it into the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">for a prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">and to the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">for a spoil</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and they shall pollute</w> it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">My face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">will I turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">also from them, and they shall pollute</w> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">my secret</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06530">for the robbers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">into it, and defile</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>robbers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">burglers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07569">a chain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">for the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of bloody</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">crimes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">of violence</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Wherefore I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the worst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">their houses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01347">I will also make the pomp</w> <w lemma="strong:H05794">of the strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to cease</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and their holy places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157 strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8738">shall be defiled</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their holy…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they shall inherit their holy places</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07089">Destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cometh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and they shall seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>, and <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> none.<note type="study"><catchWord>Destruction</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Cutting off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01943">Mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01943">upon mischief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08052">and rumour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">shall be upon rumour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">then shall they seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">a vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08451">but the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">from the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06098">and counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">from the ancients</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall mourn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">and the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">with desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be troubled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">unto them after their way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and according to their deserts</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them; and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>according…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with their judgments</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen863" osisID="Ezek.7"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:1
