verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08345">And it came to pass in the sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08345">in the sixth</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">in the fifth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in mine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">me, that the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> there upon me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I beheld</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01823">and lo a likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">as the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04758">from the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">of his loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">even downward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04975">and from his loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">even upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">as the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02096">of brightness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">as the colour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02830">of amber</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08403">the form</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of an hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06734">me by a lock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of mine head</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07307">and the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted me up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">between the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">and the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04759">me in the visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06607">to the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">of the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w>; where <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04186">the seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05566">of the image</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">of jealousy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which provoketh to jealousy</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03519">And, behold, the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">there, according to the vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">in the plain</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">he unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">now the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So I lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">and behold northward</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05566">this image</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">of jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0872">in the entry</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">furthermore unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou what they do</w>? <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">that the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">committeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">here, that I should go far off</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">from my sanctuary</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but turn</w> thee yet again, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abominations</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">me to the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when I looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">behold a</w> <w lemma="strong:H02356">hole</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">in the wall</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">he unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02864" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">dig</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">now in the wall</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02864" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when I had digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">in the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">behold a</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">door</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Go in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that they do</w> here.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So I went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08403">and behold every form</w> <w lemma="strong:H07431">of creeping things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08263">and abominable</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01544">and all the idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02707" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">pourtrayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">upon the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And there stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">them seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the ancients</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">and in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02970">Jaazaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">of Shaphan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">with every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04730">his censer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06282">and a thick</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">of incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went up</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">he unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">what the ancients</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">in the dark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">in the chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04906">of his imagery</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for they say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">us not; the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also unto me, Turn</w> thee yet again, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that they do</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">me to the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, there sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">weeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H08542">for Tammuz</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he unto me, Hast thou seen</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">O son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turn</w> thee yet again, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abominations</w> than these.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">me into the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06607">and, behold, at the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0197">between the porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altar</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">about five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0268">with their backs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">toward the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">toward the east</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and they worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">toward the east</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, Hast thou seen</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">O son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Is it a light thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">here? for they have filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">with violence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to provoke me to anger</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, lo, they put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02156">the branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">to their nose</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Is it…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Is there any thing lighter than to commit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore will I also deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">in fury</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not spare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither will I have pity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and though they cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in mine ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I not hear</w> them. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen864" osisID="Ezek.8"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">also in mine ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06486">Cause them that have charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">over the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to draw near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">even every man</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04892">his destroying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">weapon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">And, behold, six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">from the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">of the higher</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">which lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04660">a slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">weapon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> them <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">with linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with a writer’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07083">inkhorn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">by his side</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">the brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>which lieth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">which is turned</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a slaughter…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a weapon of his breaking in pieces</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>by his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon his loins</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03519">And the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was gone up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">from the cherub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04670">whereupon he was, to the threshold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">with linen</w>, which <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the writer’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07083">inkhorn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">by his side</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Go through</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">through the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08420">a mark</w> <w lemma="strong:H04696">upon the foreheads</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0584" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that sigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0602" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and that cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">for all the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>set a mark</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mark a mark</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0428">And to the others</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in mine hearing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">ye after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">him through the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and smite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">let not your eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither have ye pity</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>mine hearing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mine ears</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04889">utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">old</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0970">young</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01330">both maids</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and little children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but come not near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">any man</w> upon whom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08420">the mark</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">at my sanctuary</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then they began</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">at the ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>utterly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to destruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">unto them, Defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">the courts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">with the slain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go ye forth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they went forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">And it came to pass, while they were slaying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">them, and I was left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon my face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0162">Ah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>! <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">wilt thou destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">all the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in thy pouring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">of thy fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">upon Jerusalem</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">he unto me, The iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966 strong:H03966">exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H04297">of perverseness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">seeth</w> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>full of blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">filled with</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>perverseness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wresting of judgment</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">And as for me also, mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not spare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither will I have pity</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">their way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon their head</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And, behold, the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">with linen</w>, which <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07083">the inkhorn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">by his side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">reported</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the matter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as thou hast commanded</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>reported…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">returned the word</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen865" osisID="Ezek.9"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07549">and, behold, in the firmament</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">that was above the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">of the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">there appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H05601">over them as it were a sapphire</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">as the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01823">of the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">of a throne</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">with linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">between</w> <w lemma="strong:H01534">the wheels</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03742">under the cherub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02651">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01513">with coals</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">from between</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">the cherubims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and scatter</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">over the city</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thine hand</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the hollow of thine hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03742">Now the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">when the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">went in</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06051">and the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03519">Then the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">from the cherub</w>, <transChange type="added">and stood</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04670">over the threshold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">with the cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">and the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was full</w> <w lemma="strong:H05051">of the brightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>went up</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was lifted up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">And the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">of the cherubims’</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was heard</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02435">to the outer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">as the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">of the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when he speaketh</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:6
verses.text: And it came to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when he had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">with linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01534">from between the wheels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03742">from between the cherubims</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then he went in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">the wheels</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:7
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stretched forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">from between the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">unto the fire</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03742">between the cherubims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02651">into the hands</w> of <transChange type="added">him that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">with linen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who took</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went out</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stretched forth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sent forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And there appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">in the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H08403">the form</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">under their wings</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when I looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">behold the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">wheels</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">the cherubims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">wheel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">wheel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04758">and the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">of the wheels</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">as the colour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08658">of a beryl</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:10
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">their appearances</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">they four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">had one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01823">likeness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0212">as if a wheel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">had been in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">of a wheel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When they went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">upon their four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07253">sides</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not as they went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">but to the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">whither the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it; they turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not as they went</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">And their whole body</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01354">and their backs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and their hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03671">and their wings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0212">and the wheels</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0212">the wheels</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">that they four</w> had.<note type="study"><catchWord>body</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">flesh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0212">As for the wheels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">it was cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">unto them in my hearing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01534">O wheel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it was…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they were called in my hearing, wheel</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">galgal</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">had four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">faces</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">of a cherub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08145">and the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07992">and the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">of a lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07243">and the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">of an eagle</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03742">And the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H07426" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were lifted up</w>. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the living creature</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H03529">of Chebar</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03742">And when the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0212">the wheels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by them</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03742">and when the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">their wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to mount up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0212">the same wheels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01992">also</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">not from beside</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When they stood</w>, <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when they were lifted up</w>, <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07426" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">lifted up</w> themselves <transChange type="added">also</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07307">for the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living creature</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in them.<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03519">Then the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04670">from off the threshold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">over the cherubims</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03742">And the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">their wings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07426" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and mounted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0212">the wheels</w> also <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05980">beside</w> them, and <transChange type="added">every one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H06931">of the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03519">and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">over them above</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:20
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the living creature</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">under the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H03529">of Chebar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I knew</w> that they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03742">the cherubims</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">Every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">had four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">apiece</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01823">and the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03671">under their wings</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01823">And the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of their faces</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01992">the same</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H03529">of Chebar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">their appearances</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and themselves: they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">straight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">forward</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen866" osisID="Ezek.10"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">Moreover the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted me up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06931">me unto the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">eastward</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06607">and behold at the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02970">Jaazaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05809">of Azur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06410">and Pelatiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01141">of Benaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">he unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">mischief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in this city</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Which say</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">not near</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">let us build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>: this <transChange type="added">city is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05518">the caldron</w>, and we <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>It is…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">It is not for us to build houses near</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Therefore prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">against them, prophesy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">O son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">And the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon me, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Speak</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus have ye said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">the things that come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">into your mind</w>, <transChange type="added">every one of</transChange> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Ye have multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">your slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and ye have filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">thereof with the slain</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02491">Your slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom ye have laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> of it, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w>, and this <transChange type="added">city is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05518">the caldron</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but I will bring you forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> of it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">upon you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will bring you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you into the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of strangers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H08201">judgments</w> among you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">you in the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:11
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">city</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05518">shall not be your caldron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">neither shall ye be the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> thereof; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">you in the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for ye have not walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">in my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither executed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">after the manners</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> you.<note type="study"><catchWord>for ye…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">which have not walked</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">And it came to pass, when I prophesied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06410">that Pelatiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01141">of Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">died</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then fell I down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon my face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0162">Ah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>! <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wilt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">a full end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">of the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Again the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brethren</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01353">of thy kindred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> wholly, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they unto whom the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get you far</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto us is this land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04181">in possession</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Although I have cast them far off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and although I have scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them among the countries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04592">yet will I be to them as a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the countries</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">where they shall come</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I will even gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">you from the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you out of the countries</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">where ye have been scattered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">you the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thither, and they shall take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">all the detestable things</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">thereof and all the abominations</w> thereof from thence.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">them one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">you; and I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">the stony</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">out of their flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">them an heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of flesh</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That they may walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">in my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">mine ordinances</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">them: and they shall be my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and I will be their God</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:21
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">as for them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">whose heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">after the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">of their detestable things</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">and their abominations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">their way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon their own heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03742">Then did the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">their wings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0212">and the wheels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05980">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">them; and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">over them above</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03519">And the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountain</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06924">on the east side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07307">Afterwards the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took me up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">me in a vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">by the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">into Chaldea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01473">to them of the captivity</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04758">So the vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I had seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> from me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Then I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">unto them of the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the things</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had shewed</w> me. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen867" osisID="Ezek.11"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">also came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou dwellest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04805">of a rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">which have eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">not; they have ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hear</w> not: for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04805">a rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Therefore, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">thee stuff</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">for removing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">by day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in their sight</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">from thy place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">to another</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in their sight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it may be they will consider</w>, though they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04805">a rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stuff</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">instruments</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Then shalt thou bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">thy stuff</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">by day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in their sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">as stuff</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">for removing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in their sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04161">as they that go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">into captivity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as the goings forth of captivity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02864" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Dig</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">thou through the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in their sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and carry out</w> thereby.<note type="study"><catchWord>Dig…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Dig for thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">In their sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou bear</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> upon <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03802">shoulders</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> carry <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05939">in the twilight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">not the ground</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have set</w> thee <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04159">a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I did</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">so as I was commanded</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">my stuff</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">by day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">as stuff</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">for captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06153">and in the even</w> <w lemma="strong:H02864" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">through the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with mine hand</w>; I brought <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05939">in the twilight</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I bare</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> upon <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03802">shoulder</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in their sight</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>digged</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">digged for me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01242">And in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">came the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">hath not the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04805">the rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto thee, What doest</w> thou?

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04853">This burden</w> <transChange type="added">concerneth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05387">the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04159">your sign</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">like as I have done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">so shall it be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">unto them: they shall remove</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">into captivity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by removing go into captivity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And the prince</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them shall bear</w> upon <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03802">shoulder</w> <w lemma="strong:H05939">in the twilight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall go forth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02864" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall dig</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">through the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to carry out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thereby: he shall cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03282">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">not the ground</w> with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eyes</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07568">My net</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also will I spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">upon him, and he shall be taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">in my snare</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">him to Babylon</w> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet shall he not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, though he shall die</w> there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I will scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">toward every wind</w> all that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05828">him to help</w> <w lemma="strong:H0102">him, and all his bands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will draw out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when I shall scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">them among the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and disperse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them in the countries</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">But I will leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">a few</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of them from the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">from the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and from the pestilence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that they may declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">all their abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whither they come</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a few…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">men of number</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Moreover the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came to me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">thy bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07494">with quaking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">thy water</w> <w lemma="strong:H07269">with trembling</w> <w lemma="strong:H01674">and with carefulness</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">their bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01674">with carefulness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">their water</w> <w lemma="strong:H08078">with astonishment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">that her land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may be desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">from all that is therein</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02555">because of the violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all them that dwell</w> therein.<note type="study"><catchWord>all that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the fulness thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">And the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that are inhabited</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be laid waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">shall be desolate</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04912">that proverb</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0127">ye have in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">The days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are prolonged</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02377">and every vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">faileth</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them therefore, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04912">I will make this proverb</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to cease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall no more use it as a proverb</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">but say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto them, The days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are at hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and the effect</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">of every vision</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07723">For there shall be no more any vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H02509">nor flattering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04738">divination</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:25
verses.text: For I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that I shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall come to pass</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be no more prolonged</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for in your days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04805">O rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">it, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Again the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came to me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, behold, <transChange type="added">they of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02377">The vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that he seeth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">for many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <transChange type="added">to come</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and he prophesieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">of the times</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far</w> off.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01697">There shall none of my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be prolonged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">any more, but the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">which I have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen868" osisID="Ezek.12"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">against the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that prophesy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">thou unto them that prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">out of their own hearts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">ye the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>that prophesy out…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that are prophets out of their own hearts</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05036">unto the foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">their own spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have seen</w> nothing!<note type="study"><catchWord>follow</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">walk after</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>and…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and things which they have not seen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">thy prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07776">are like the foxes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">in the deserts</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have not gone up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">into the gaps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01443" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither made up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01447">the hedge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gaps</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">breaches</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hedged the hedge</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">and lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07081">divination</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not sent</w> them: and they have made <transChange type="added">others</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">to hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that they would confirm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Have ye not seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">a vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04236">vision</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and have ye not spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">a lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H04738">divination</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whereas ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">albeit I have not spoken</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">Because ye have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">lies</w>, therefore, behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">against you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">shall be upon the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H02374">that see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and that divine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">lies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05475">they shall not be in the assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">neither shall they be written</w> <w lemma="strong:H03791">in the writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall they enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>assembly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">secret</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">counsel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02937" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Because, even because they have seduced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">Peace</w>; and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">no peace</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and one built up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02434">a wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02009">and, lo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02902" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">others daubed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08602">it with untempered</w> <transChange type="added">morter</transChange>:<note type="study"><catchWord>a wall</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a slight wall</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:11
