verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02902" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them which daub</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08602">with untempered</w> <transChange type="added">morter</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that it shall fall</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">there shall be an overflowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">shower</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0859">and ye</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068 strong:H0417">O great hailstones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05591">and a stormy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall rend</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07023">Lo, when the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fallen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall it not be said</w> unto you, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02915">the daubing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02902" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherewith ye have daubed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I will even rend</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05591">with a stormy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">in my fury</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and there shall be an overflowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">shower</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in mine anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068 strong:H0417">and great hailstones</w> in <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02534">fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">to consume</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">So will I break down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02902" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye have daubed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08602">with untempered</w> <transChange type="added">morter</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">it down to the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03247">so that the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thereof shall be discovered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall be consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof: and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thus will I accomplish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">my wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">upon the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02902" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and upon them that have daubed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08602">it with untempered</w> <transChange type="added">morter</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">unto you, The wall</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> no <transChange type="added">more</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02902" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">neither they that daubed</w> it;

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:16
verses.text: <transChange type="added">To wit</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">concerning Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02374">and which see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w> for her, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">no peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">Likewise, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">against the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">which prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">out of their own heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and prophesy</w> thou against them,

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> to the <transChange type="added">women</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08609" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that sew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03704">pillows</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H0679">to all armholes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04555">kerchiefs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">of every stature</w> <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8780">to hunt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">souls</w>! <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">Will ye hunt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-356">and will ye save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-356">alive</w> <transChange type="added">that come</transChange> unto you?<note type="study"><catchWord>armholes</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">elbows</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And will ye pollute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">me among my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08168">for handfuls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H06595">and for pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that should not die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8763" type="x-split-357">and to save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8763" type="x-split-357">alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that should not live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03576" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">by your lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that hear</w> <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03577">lies</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03704">against your pillows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0859">wherewith ye</w> <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">there hunt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the souls</w> to make <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will tear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">them from your arms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and will let the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">go</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">that ye hunt</w> to make <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to make…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">into gardens</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04555">Your kerchiefs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also will I tear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of your hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and they shall be no more in your hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">to be hunted</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08267">Because with lies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">ye have made the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03512" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">sad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03510" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom I have not made sad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he should not return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">from his wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">by promising him life</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that I should save his life</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by quickening him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore ye shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">no more vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor divine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07081">divinations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of your hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen869" osisID="Ezek.13"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">these men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">their idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in their heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04383">the stumblingblock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">of their iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05227">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">their face</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">should I be enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">of at all</w> by them?

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Therefore speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">Every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that setteth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">his idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and putteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04383">the stumblingblock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">of his iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05227">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">to the prophet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">will answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him that cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">according to the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">of his idols</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">That I may take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in their own heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">because they are all estranged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">from me through their idols</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Repent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and turn</w> <transChange type="added">yourselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01544">from your idols</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">your faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">from all your abominations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>yourselves</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">others</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">For every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">or of the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that sojourneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05144" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which separateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">himself from me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and setteth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">his idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and putteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04383">the stumblingblock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">of his iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05227">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">to a prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of him concerning me; I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">will answer</w> him by myself:

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">against that man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">him a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">and a proverb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cut him off</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">And if the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">be deceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">when he hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have deceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">that prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">upon him, and will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">him from the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the punishment of their iniquity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05771">the punishment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">shall be even as the punishment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that seeketh</w> <transChange type="added">unto him</transChange>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">That the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may go no more astray</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">neither be polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">any more with all their transgressions</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">but that they may be my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and I may be their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came again to me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">when the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sinneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against me by trespassing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">grievously</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then will I stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon it, and will break</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof, and will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">upon it, and will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w> from it:

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">Though these three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05146">Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01840">Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0347">and Job</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">were in it</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they should deliver</w> <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their own souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">by their righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03863">If</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">I cause noisome</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and they spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">it, so that it be desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that no man may pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the beasts</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>spoil</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bereave</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:16
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">these three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in it</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">neither sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">nor daughters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they only shall be delivered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">but the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">shall be desolate</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in it</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the midst of it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>Or <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon that land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">Sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">so that I cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w> from it:

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">Though these three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in it</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">neither sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">nor daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">but they only shall be delivered</w> themselves.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>Or <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I send</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">a pestilence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into that land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">upon it in blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">from it man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05146">Though Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01840">Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0347">and Job</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in it</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">neither son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0518">nor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>; they shall <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their own souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">by their righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">How much more when I send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">my four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08201">judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">upon Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">and the famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and the noisome</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">and the pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">from it man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>How…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Also when</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Yet, behold, therein shall be left</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">a remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">that shall be brought forth</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, they shall come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto you, and ye shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">their way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">and their doings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and ye shall be comforted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">concerning the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">upon Jerusalem</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">concerning all that I have brought</w> upon it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And they shall comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, when ye see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">their ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">and their doings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have not done</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">without cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">all that I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">in it, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen870" osisID="Ezek.14"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01612">What is the vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">more than any tree</w>, <transChange type="added">or than</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02156">a branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">which is among the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the forest</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06086">Shall wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">any work</w>? or will <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03489">a pin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of it to hang</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">any vessel</w> thereon?

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Behold, it is cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">into the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0402">for fuel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">devoureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">of it, and the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02787" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of it is burned</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Is it meet</w> for <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Is it…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Will it prosper?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08549">Behold, when it was whole</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it was meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">for no work</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">how much less shall it be meet</w> yet for <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">when the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H02787" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it, and it is burned</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>meet</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made fit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01612">As the vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">among the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the forest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">to the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0402">for fuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against them; they shall go out</w> from <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>, and <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them; and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> against them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they have committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">a trespass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>committed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">trespassed a trespass</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen871" osisID="Ezek.15"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Again the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">cause Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">her abominations</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04351">Thy birth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04138">and thy nativity</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of Canaan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0567">an Amorite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">and thy mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">an Hittite</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>birth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cutting out</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">habitation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:4
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04138">thy nativity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8715">thou wast born</w> <w lemma="strong:H08270">thy navel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was not cut</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">neither wast thou washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w> <w lemma="strong:H04935">to supple</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H04414" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">thou wast not salted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04414" morph="strongMorph:TH8715">at all</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02853" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">nor swaddled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02853" morph="strongMorph:TH8715">at all</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to supple…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when I looked upon thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">None eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pitied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of these unto thee, to have compassion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">upon thee; but thou wast cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the open</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01604">to the lothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of thy person</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8715">that thou wast born</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when I passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by thee, and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0947" morph="strongMorph:TH8711">thee polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in thine own blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I said</w> unto thee <transChange type="added">when thou wast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in thy blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Live</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, I said</w> unto thee <transChange type="added">when thou wast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in thy blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Live</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>polluted</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">trodden under foot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have caused</w> <w lemma="strong:H07233">thee to multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H06780">as the bud</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou hast increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and waxen great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou art come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05716">to excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05716">ornaments</w>: <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07699">breasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are fashioned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08181">and thine hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">is grown</w>, whereas thou <transChange type="added">wast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05903">naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06181">and bare</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>caused…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made thee a million</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>excellent…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ornament of ornaments</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now when I passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by thee, and looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">upon thee, behold, thy time</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">of love</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">my skirt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">over thee, and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">thy nakedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">yea, I sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, and entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">into a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">with thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, and thou becamest mine.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">I thee with water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, I throughly washed away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">thy blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05480" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from thee, and I anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">thee with oil</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07553">thee also with broidered work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05274" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shod</w> <w lemma="strong:H08476">thee with badgers’ skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">thee about with fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04897">thee with silk</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05710" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I decked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05716">thee also with ornaments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06781">bracelets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">upon thy hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07242">and a chain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01627">on thy neck</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05141">a jewel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">on thy forehead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05694">and earrings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in thine ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08597">and a beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05850">crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon thine head</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>forehead</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">nose</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05710" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus wast thou decked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04403">and thy raiment</w> <transChange type="added">was of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08336 strong:H08336" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04897">and silk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07553">and broidered work</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou didst eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">fine flour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and oil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03966">and thou wast exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03302" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">beautiful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou didst prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">into a kingdom</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And thy renown</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">for thy beauty</w>: for it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03632">perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">through my comeliness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I had put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">upon thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But thou didst trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">in thine own beauty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and playedst the harlot</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">because of thy renown</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pouredst out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">thy fornications</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">on every one that passed by</w>; his it was.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0899">And of thy garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou didst take</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and deckedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">thy high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H02921" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">with divers colours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and playedst the harlot</w> thereupon: <transChange type="added">the like things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall not come</w>, neither shall it be <transChange type="added">so</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou hast also taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">thy fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">jewels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of my gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">and of my silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I had given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, and madest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06754">to thyself images</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and didst commit whoredom</w> with them,<note type="study"><catchWord>of men</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of a male</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And tookest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07553">thy broidered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and coveredst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: and thou hast set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">mine oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">and mine incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03899">My meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also which I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">thee, fine flour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>, <transChange type="added">wherewith</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, thou hast even set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">them for a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w>: and <transChange type="added">thus</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">it was, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a sweet…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a savour of rest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover thou hast taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and thy daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom thou hast borne</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto them to be devoured</w>. <transChange type="added">Is this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08457">of thy whoredoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a small matter</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>to be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to devour</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That thou hast slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">them to cause them to pass through</w> <transChange type="added">the fire</transChange> for them?

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08441">And in all thine abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">and thy whoredoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast not remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of thy youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05903">when thou wast naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06181">and bare</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0947" morph="strongMorph:TH8711">wast polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in thy blood</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all thy wickedness</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H0188">woe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0188">woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto thee! saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>;)

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:24
verses.text: <transChange type="added">That</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou hast also built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01354">unto thee an eminent place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07413">thee an high place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in every street</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>eminent…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">brothel house</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast built</w> <w lemma="strong:H07413">thy high place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">at every head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03308">and hast made thy beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to be abhorred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06589" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and hast opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">thy feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to every one that passed by</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">thy whoredoms</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou hast also committed fornication</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714 strong:H01121">with the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07934">thy neighbours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01432">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of flesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and hast increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">thy whoredoms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to provoke me to anger</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, therefore I have stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">over thee, and have diminished</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">thine ordinary</w> <transChange type="added">food</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thee unto the will</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">thee, the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which are ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">of thy lewd</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>daughters</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cities</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou hast played the whore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804 strong:H01121">also with the Assyrians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01115">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou wast unsatiable</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, thou hast played the harlot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07654">with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou hast moreover multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">thy fornication</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">unto Chaldea</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and yet thou wast not satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">herewith</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">How weak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03826">is thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">seeing thou doest</w> all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07986">of an imperious</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">whorish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">In that thou buildest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01354">thine eminent place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of every way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and makest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07413">thine high place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in every street</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and hast not been as an harlot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07046" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in that thou scornest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0868">hire</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>In that thou buildest…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">In thy daughters is thine</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:32
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that committeth adultery</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">instead of her husband</w>!

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05078">gifts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to all whores</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but thou givest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05083">thy gifts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">to all thy lovers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07809" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hirest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, that they may come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">unto thee on every side</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">for thy whoredom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hirest</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bribest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02016">And the contrary</w> is in thee from <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">in thy whoredoms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">whereas none followeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">thee to commit whoredoms</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and in that thou givest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0868">a reward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0868">and no reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, therefore thou art</w> <w lemma="strong:H02016">contrary</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Wherefore, O harlot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05178">Because thy filthiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was poured out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06172">and thy nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">discovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">through thy whoredoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">with thy lovers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01544">and with all the idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">of thy abominations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">and by the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of thy children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou didst give</w> unto them;

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Behold, therefore I will gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">all thy lovers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06149" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with whom thou hast taken pleasure</w>, and all <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast loved</w>, with all <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast hated</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I will even gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">them round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">against thee, and will discover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">thy nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, that they may see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">all thy nakedness</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee, as women that break wedlock</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">are judged</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">thee blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">in fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">and jealousy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with judgments of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will also give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thee into their hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall throw down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01354">thine eminent place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shall break down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07413">thy high places</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they shall strip</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">thee also of thy clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">thy fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">jewels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05903">thee naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06181">and bare</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thy fair…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">instruments of thine ornament</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">They shall also bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">a company</w> <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against thee, and they shall stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">thee with stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01333" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and thrust thee through</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with their swords</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thine houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H08201">judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">upon thee in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cause thee to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from playing the harlot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou also shalt give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0868">no hire</w> any more.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02534">So will I make my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">toward thee to rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07068">and my jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from thee, and I will be quiet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will be no more angry</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because thou hast not remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of thy youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but hast fretted</w> me in all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H01887">behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore I also will recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thy way</w> upon <transChange type="added">thine</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt not commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">this lewdness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">above all thine abominations</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:44
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, every one that useth proverbs</w> shall use <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">proverb</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against thee, saying</w>, As <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">the mother</w>, <transChange type="added">so is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">her daughter</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:45
verses.text: Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">thy mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01602" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that lotheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and her children</w>; and thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0269">the sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">of thy sisters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01602" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which lothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">their husbands</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and their children</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0517">your mother</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02850">an Hittite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and your father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">an Amorite</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">And thine elder</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">she and her daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">at thy left hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06996">and thy younger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">at thy right hand</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05467">Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her daughters</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thy younger</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lesser than thou</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet hast thou not walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">after their ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">after their abominations</w>: but, as <transChange type="added">if that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06985">a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H06962 strong:H04592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">little</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou wast corrupted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02004">more than they</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in all thy ways</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as if…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that was lothed as a small thing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:48
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05467">Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">thy sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">she nor her daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as thou hast done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">thou and thy daughters</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05771">Behold, this was the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">of thy sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">Sodom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01347">pride</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07653">fulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07962">and abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">of idleness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">was in her and in her daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">neither did she strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">of the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they were haughty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me: therefore I took them away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as I saw</w> <transChange type="added">good</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08111">Neither hath Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of thy sins</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but thou hast multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">thine abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">more than they</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and hast justified</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">thy sisters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">in all thine abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast done</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou also, which hast judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">thy sisters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">thine own shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for thy sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that thou hast committed more abominable</w> <w lemma="strong:H02004">than they</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they are more righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">than thou: yea, be thou confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">also, and bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">thy shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in that thou hast justified</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">thy sisters</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When I shall bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622 strong:H07622" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">their captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07622 strong:H07622" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07622 strong:H07622" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">and the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her daughters</w>, then <transChange type="added">will I bring again</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07622 strong:H07622" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">of thy captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> of them:

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That thou mayest bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">thine own shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and mayest be confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in all that thou hast done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in that thou art a comfort</w> unto them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0269">When thy sisters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05467">Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H06927">to their former estate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08111">and Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H06927">to their former estate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">then thou and thy daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H06927">to your former estate</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0269">For thy sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">was not mentioned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">by thy mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">of thy pride</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>mentioned</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for a report</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">hearing</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>pride</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">prides</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">excellencies</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:57
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">Before thy wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was discovered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">as at the time</w> of <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02781">reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>, and all <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">her, the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07590" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">which despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thee round about</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Syria</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Aram</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>despise</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spoil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:58
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast borne</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">thy lewdness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">and thine abominations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>borne</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">borne them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:59
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will even deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee as thou hast done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which hast despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">the oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">in breaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:60
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Nevertheless I will remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">with thee in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of thy youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">unto thee an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:61
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then thou shalt remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thy ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and be ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou shalt receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">thy sisters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">thine elder</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">and thy younger</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">them unto thee for daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01285">but not by thy covenant</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:62
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee; and thou shalt know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:63
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That thou mayest remember</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be confounded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06610">and never open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">thy mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">any more because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">of thy shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when I am pacified</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">toward thee for all that thou hast done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen872" osisID="Ezek.16"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02330" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02420">a riddle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">a parable</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01419">A great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">eagle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0750 strong:H083">longwinged</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H05133">of feathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07553">which had divers colours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">unto Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06788">the highest branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of the cedar</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>divers…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">embroidering</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06998" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He cropped off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H03242">of his young twigs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">it into a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of traffick</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">it in a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of merchants</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">also of the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">it in a fruitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he placed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">by great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">set</w> it <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06851">a willow tree</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>planted…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">put it in a field of seed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it grew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05628" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and became a spreading</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08217">of low</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">stature</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01808">whose branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">toward him, and the roots</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">thereof were under him: so it became a vine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">branches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and shot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06288">forth sprigs</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">There was also another</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">eagle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">and many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05133">feathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01612">and, behold, this vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03719" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did bend</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">her roots</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">toward him, and shot forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01808">her branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">toward him, that he might water</w> <w lemma="strong:H06170">it by the furrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H04302">of her plantation</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08362" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">It was planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">in a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">soil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">by great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that it might bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06057">branches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and that it might bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">fruit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0155">that it might be a goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">vine</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>soil</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">field</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall it prosper</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall he not pull up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">the roots</w> <w lemma="strong:H07082" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">thereof, and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, that it wither</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall wither</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">in all the leaves</w> <w lemma="strong:H06780">of her spring</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">even without great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">power</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">or many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to pluck it up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">by the roots</w> thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:10
verses.text: Yea, behold, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08362" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">planted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall it prosper</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall it not utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wither</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06921">when the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it? it shall wither</w> <w lemma="strong:H06170">in the furrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H06780">where it grew</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Moreover the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:12
