verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H04805">now to the rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Know</w> ye not what these <transChange type="added">things mean</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">tell</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">Behold, the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hath taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">thereof, and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof, and led</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">them with him to Babylon</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And hath taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">with him, and hath taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">an oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of him: he hath also taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>taken an…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">brought him to an oath</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04467">That the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08217">might be base</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">that it might not lift itself up</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that by keeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of his covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it might stand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>but…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to keep his covenant, to stand to it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But he rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against him in sending</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">his ambassadors</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they might give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">him horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">and much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall he prosper</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall he escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that doeth</w> such <transChange type="added">things</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">or shall he break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and be delivered</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:16
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">surely in the place</w> <transChange type="added">where</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <transChange type="added">dwelleth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that made him king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0423">whose oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he despised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01285">and whose covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he brake</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">with him in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall die</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">Neither shall Pharaoh</w> with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">army</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">and great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">company</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">for him in the war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by casting up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05550">mounts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and building</w> <w lemma="strong:H01785">forts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">persons</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Seeing he despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">the oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">by breaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when, lo, he had given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath done</w> all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">he shall not escape</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0423">surely mine oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath despised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01285">and my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06331" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that he hath broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">even it will I recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his own head</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07568">my net</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">upon him, and he shall be taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">in my snare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">him to Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and will plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him there for his trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">that he hath trespassed</w> against me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04015">And all his fugitives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0102">with all his bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and they that remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">toward all winds</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will also take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06788">of the highest branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will set</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H06998" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will crop off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">from the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H03127">of his young twigs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07390">a tender one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08362" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will plant</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01364">upon an high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08524" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and eminent</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">In the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">of the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08362" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it: and it shall bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06057">boughs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">fruit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0117">and be a goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and under it shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">all fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of every wing</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06738">in the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01808">of the branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof shall they dwell</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06086">And all the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have brought down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01364">the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08217">the low</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have dried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03892">up the green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03002">and have made the dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to flourish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have done</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen873" osisID="Ezek.17"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me again, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">What mean ye, that ye use</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">this proverb</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">concerning the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">The fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01155">sour grapes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">teeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06949" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are set on edge</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, ye shall not have <transChange type="added">occasion</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">any more to use</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">this proverb</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">Behold, all souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">are mine; as the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">so also the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">is mine: the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sinneth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall die</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">But if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">be just</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">that which is lawful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and right</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">judgment and justice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither hath lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">to the idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">neither hath defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither hath come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">to a menstruous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And hath not oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">any</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath restored</w> <w lemma="strong:H02326">to the debtor</w> <w lemma="strong:H02258">his pledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01500">none by violence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">his bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07457">to the hungry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and hath covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05903">the naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">with a garment</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:8
verses.text: He <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath not given forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05392">upon usury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither hath taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08636">any increase</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath withdrawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">from iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath executed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">true</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">between man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">and man</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Hath walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">in my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">truly</w>; he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">just</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">If he beget</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06530">a robber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a shedder</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">the like</w> to <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> of these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>,<note type="study"><catchWord>robber</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">breaker up of an house</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>that doeth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that doeth to his brother besides any of these</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And that doeth</w> not any of those <transChange type="added">duties</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but even hath eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Hath oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01500">by violence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath not restored</w> <w lemma="strong:H02258">the pledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">to the idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hath given forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05392">upon usury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08636">increase</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall he then live</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not live</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">all these abominations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w> shall be upon him.<note type="study"><catchWord>blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>Now, lo, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he beget</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">all his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and considereth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02004">not such like</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">That</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither hath lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">to the idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath not defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Neither hath oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">any</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not withholden</w> <w lemma="strong:H02258">the pledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither hath spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01500">by violence</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">his bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07457">to the hungry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and hath covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05903">the naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">with a garment</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>hath not…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hath not pledged the pledge</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">taken to pledge</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">That</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath taken off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">from the poor</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not received</w> <w lemma="strong:H05392">usury</w> <w lemma="strong:H08636">nor increase</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath executed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">in my statutes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not die</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06233">because he cruelly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">oppressed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01499">by violence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and did</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">lo, even he shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">in his iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">ye, Why? doth not the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the father</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01121">When the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">that which is lawful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and right</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">all my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">The soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sinneth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall die</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">neither shall the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06666">the righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07564">shall be upon him, and the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> shall be upon him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">But if the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">from all his sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath committed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">all my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">that which is lawful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and right</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not die</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06588">All his transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath committed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall not be mentioned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">unto him: in his righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall live</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Have I any pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">that the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">should die</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not that he should return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">from his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and live</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06662">But when the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">turneth away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">from his righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and committeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">according to all the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">that the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">doeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall he live</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06666">All his righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be mentioned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in his trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">that he hath trespassed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and in his sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in them shall he die</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is not equal</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">now, O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01870">Is not my way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">equal</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01870">are not your ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">unequal</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">When a righteous</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">turneth away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">from his righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and committeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">in them; for his iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he die</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">Again, when the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">turneth away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07564">from his wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath committed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">that which is lawful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and right</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-358">he shall save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-358">alive</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Because he considereth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and turneth away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">from all his transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath committed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not die</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is not equal</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">are not my ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">equal</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01870">are not your ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">unequal</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore I will judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">you, O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">according to his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Repent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and turn</w> <transChange type="added">yourselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06588">from all your transgressions</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05771">so iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H04383">shall not be your ruin</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>yourselves</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">others</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Cast away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">from you all your transgressions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whereby ye have transgressed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">you a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">and a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for why will ye die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For I have no pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">in the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of him that dieth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">wherefore turn</w> <transChange type="added">yourselves</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and live</w> ye.<note type="study"><catchWord>yourselves</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">others</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen874" osisID="Ezek.18"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Moreover take thou up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07015">a lamentation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">for the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">thy mother</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03833">A lioness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she lay down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">among lions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">she nourished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01482">her whelps</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">young lions</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And she brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01482">of her whelps</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03715">it became a young lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it learned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to catch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">the prey</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">The nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">of him; he was taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">in their pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02397">him with chains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now when she saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that she had waited</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08615">her hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was lost</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then she took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H01482">of her whelps</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">him a young lion</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">And he went up and down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">the lions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03715">he became a young lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and learned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to catch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">the prey</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">their desolate palaces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he laid waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">their cities</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04393">and the fulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thereof, by the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07581">of his roaring</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their desolate…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">their widows</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the fulness…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">all it containeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">Then the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">against him on every side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">from the provinces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07568">their net</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">over him: he was taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">in their pit</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05474">him in ward</w> <w lemma="strong:H02397">in chains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04685">him into holds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">that his voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">should no more be heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in chains</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in hooks</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0517">Thy mother</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01612">like a vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818 strong:H01818" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">in thy blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08362" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">by the waters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">she was fruitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06058">and full of branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">by reason of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in thy quietness</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">in thy likeness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05797">And she had strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">rods</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">for the sceptres</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that bare rule</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06967">and her stature</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">among the thick branches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and she appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01363">in her height</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">with the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01808">of her branches</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">But she was plucked up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">in fury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">she was cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06921">and the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">dried up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">her fruit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05797">her strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">rods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06561" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">were broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and withered</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">consumed</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:13
verses.text: And now she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08362" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06723">in a dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06772">and thirsty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">ground</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">And fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of a rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">of her branches</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">her fruit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05797">so that she hath no strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">rod</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">a sceptre</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to rule</w>. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07015">a lamentation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07015">and shall be for a lamentation</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen875" osisID="Ezek.19"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">And it came to pass in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02549">in the fifth</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06218">the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Then came the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Are ye come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enquire</w> of me? <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">I will not be enquired</w> of by you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wilt thou judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">them, son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou judge</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">cause them to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Wilt…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Wilt thou plead for them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">unto the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and made myself known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto them in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when I lifted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">up mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto them, saying</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>lifted…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sware</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the day</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">unto them, to bring them forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I had espied</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for them, flowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06643">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all lands</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">I unto them, Cast ye away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">not yourselves with the idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">But they rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against me, and would</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto me: they did not every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">cast away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of their eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither did they forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">the idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I will pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">upon them, to accomplish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">my anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">against them in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But I wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for my name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">sake, that it should not be polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> whom they <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">in whose sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I made myself known</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">unto them, in bringing them forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Wherefore I caused them to go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">them into the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">them my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">them my judgments</w>, which <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall even live</w> in them.<note type="study"><catchWord>shewed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made them to know</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Moreover also I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">them my sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0226">to be a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">between me and them, that they might know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that sanctify</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">But the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">against me in the wilderness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">not in my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w>, which <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall even live</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">in them; and my sabbaths</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">they greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">polluted</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I would pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">upon them in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to consume</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But I wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for my name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">sake, that it should not be polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">in whose sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I brought them out</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet also I lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">unto them in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I would not bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I had given</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">flowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06643">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all lands</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because they despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">not in my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">but polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">my sabbaths</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">for their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">their idols</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Nevertheless mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spared</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">them from destroying</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, neither did I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of them in the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">ye not in the statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">their judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">nor defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">yourselves with their idols</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:19
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">in my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> them;

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">And hallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">my sabbaths</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0226">and they shall be a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">between me and you, that ye may know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Notwithstanding the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against me: they walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">not in my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> them, which <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall even live</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">in them; they polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">my sabbaths</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I would pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">upon them, to accomplish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">my anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">against them in the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Nevertheless I withdrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for my name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">sake, that it should not be polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">in whose sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I brought them forth</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">unto them also in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I would scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">them among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and disperse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them through the countries</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because they had not executed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but had despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and had polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">my sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and their eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">were after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their fathers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">idols</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">them also statutes</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whereby they should not live</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04979">them in their own gifts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">in that they caused to pass through</w> <transChange type="added">the fire</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06363">all that openeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">the womb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that I might make them desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to the end that they might know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">Therefore, son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01">Yet in this your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01442" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have blasphemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me, in that they have committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">a trespass</w> against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>committed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">trespassed a trespass</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:28
verses.text: <transChange type="added">For</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when I had brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them into the land</w>, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">the which I lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it to them, then they saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every high</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05687">and all the thick</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">there their sacrifices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there they presented</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">the provocation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">of their offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there also they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">their sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">there their drink offerings</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I said</w> unto them, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01116">the high place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whereunto ye go</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08034">And the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thereof is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01117">Bamah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I said…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">I told them what the high place was</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Bamah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Wherefore say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Are ye polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">after the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and commit ye whoredom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">their abominations</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">For when ye offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04979">your gifts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">when ye make your sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">ye pollute</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">yourselves with all your idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">even unto this day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and shall I be enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of by you, O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>? <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">I will not be enquired</w> of by you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And that which cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">into your mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall not be at all, that ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We will be</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">as the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">as the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the countries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">and stone</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">surely with a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and with a stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">and with fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">poured out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I rule</w> over you:

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will bring you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and will gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you out of the countries</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">wherein ye are scattered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">with a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and with a stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">and with fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">poured out</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">you into the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and there will I plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">with you face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to face</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Like as I pleaded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">so will I plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">with you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will cause you to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">under the rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04562">you into the bond</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>bond</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">delivering</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will purge out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from among you the rebels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and them that transgress</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against me: I will bring them forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H04033">where they sojourn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall not enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">As for you, O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">his idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and hereafter</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">if ye will not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto me: but pollute</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">ye my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04979">no more with your gifts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01544">and with your idols</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06944">For in mine holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">of the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">there shall all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">all of them in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me: there will I accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and there will I require</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">your offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07225">and the firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H04864">of your oblations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">with all your holy things</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>firstfruits</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chief</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">you with your sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when I bring you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you out of the countries</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">wherein ye have been scattered</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and I will be sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in you before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sweet…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">savour of rest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when I shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">you into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the country</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">the which I lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">it to your fathers</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And there shall ye remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">your ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05949">and all your doings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">wherein ye have been defiled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06962" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and ye shall lothe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">yourselves in your own sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">for all your evils</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye have committed</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I have wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">with you for my name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">sake, not according to your wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">nor according to your corrupt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">doings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O ye house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:45
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Moreover the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H08486">the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and drop</w> <transChange type="added">thy word</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01864">toward the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">against the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">to the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in thee, and it shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03892">every green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H03002">in thee, and every dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03852">the flaming</w> <w lemma="strong:H07957">flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not be quenched</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and all faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">from the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">to the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06866" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be burned</w> therein.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">And all flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it: it shall not be quenched</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0162">I, Ah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>! <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they say</w> <w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of me, Doth he not speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">parables</w>? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen876" osisID="Ezek.20"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">toward Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and drop</w> <transChange type="added">thy word</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04720">toward the holy places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">against the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">against thee, and will draw forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">my sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H08593">out of his sheath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">from thee the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">and the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03282">Seeing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then that I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">from thee the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">and the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">therefore shall my sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08593">out of his sheath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">against all flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">from the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">to the north</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">That all flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have drawn forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">my sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H08593">out of his sheath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall not return</w> any more.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0584" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Sigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">therefore, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07670">with the breaking</w> of <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04975">loins</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04814">and with bitterness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0584" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before their eyes</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it shall be, when they say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0584" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">unto thee, Wherefore sighest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou? that thou shalt answer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08052">For the tidings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because it cometh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">and every heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall melt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and all hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be feeble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and every spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03543" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall faint</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01290">and all knees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be weak</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, it cometh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and shall be brought to pass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall be weak…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall go into water</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Again the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:9
