verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">prophesy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">A sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H02300" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">is sharpened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04803" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and also furbished</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02300" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">It is sharpened</w> <w lemma="strong:H02874">to make a sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02873" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">slaughter</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04178" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">it is furbished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">that it may glitter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0176">should</w> <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we then make mirth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it contemneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of my son</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">every tree</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it contemneth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">it is the rod of my son, it despiseth every tree</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04803" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it to be furbished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610 strong:H03709" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that it may be handled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02719">this sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H02300" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">is sharpened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04178" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and it is furbished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the slayer</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">for it shall be upon my people</w>, it <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05387">upon all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04048" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">terrors</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">by reason of</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">shall be upon my people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05606" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">smite</w> therefore upon <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03409">thigh</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>terrors…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they are thrust down to the sword with my people</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:13
verses.text: Because <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">a trial</w>, and what if <transChange type="added">the sword</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">contemn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">even the rod</w>? it shall be no <transChange type="added">more</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Because…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">When the trial hath been, what then? shall they not also belong to the despising rod?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Thou therefore, son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">prophesy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-359">and smite</w> <transChange type="added">thine</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709 strong:H03709">hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-359">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">and let the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03717" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be doubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">time, the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">of the slain</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of the great</w> <transChange type="added">men that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02314" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which entereth into their privy chambers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hands…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand to hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H019">the point</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">against all their gates</w>, that <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may faint</w>, and <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04383">ruins</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">be multiplied</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0253">ah</w>! <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">bright</w>, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04593">wrapped up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02874">for the slaughter</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>point</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">glittering</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">fear</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>wrapped up</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sharpened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0258" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Go thee one way or other</w>, <transChange type="added">either</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">on</w> <w lemma="strong:H03231" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">the right hand</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08041" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">on the left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0575">whithersoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">set</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>or on…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set thyself, take the left hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will also smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">mine hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">and I will cause my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to rest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have said</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me again, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Also, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">thee two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">that the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may come</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08147">both twain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">out of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thou a place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">choose</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">at the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to the city</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">a way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">that the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07237">to Rabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983 strong:H01121">of the Ammonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and to Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the defenced</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">For the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">at the parting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">at the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to use</w> <w lemma="strong:H07081">divination</w>: he made <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02671">arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">bright</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he consulted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08655">with images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03516">in the liver</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>parting of</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mother of</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>arrows</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">knives</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">teraphim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03225">At his right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07081">was the divination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">for Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H03733">captains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07524">in the slaughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">with shouting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to appoint</w> <transChange type="added">battering</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03733">rams</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">against the gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05550">a mount</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01785">a fort</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>captains</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">battering rams</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rams</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07723">And it shall be unto them as a false</w> <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">divination</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in their sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">to them that have sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">oaths</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">but he will call to remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that they may be taken</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to them…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for the oaths made unto them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05771">Because ye have made your iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to be remembered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06588">in that your transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">are discovered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05949">so that in all your doings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">your sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">do appear</w>; because, <transChange type="added">I say</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that ye are come to remembrance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">ye shall be taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">with the hand</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02491">And thou, profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">whose day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">when</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w> <transChange type="added">shall have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07093">an end</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H04701">the diadem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and take off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05850">the crown</w>: this <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02063">the same</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">exalt</w> <transChange type="added">him that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08217">low</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and abase</w> <transChange type="added">him that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01364">high</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05754">I will overturn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05754">overturn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05754">overturn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it: and it shall be</w> no <transChange type="added">more</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until he come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">whose right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it is; and I will give</w> it <transChange type="added">him</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I will overturn…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Perverted, perverted, perverted, will I make it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And thou, son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05983 strong:H01121">concerning the Ammonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02781">and concerning their reproach</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">even say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">thou, The sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">drawn</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02874">for the slaughter</w> <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04803" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">furbished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">because of the glittering</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Whiles they see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, whiles they divine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">a lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">thee upon the necks</w> of <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">whose day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">when</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">their iniquity</w> <transChange type="added">shall have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07093">an end</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:30
verses.text: Shall I cause <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H08593">into his sheath</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">thee in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">where thou wast created</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04351">of thy nativity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Shall…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Cause it to return</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">mine indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06315" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">upon thee, I will blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">against thee in the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">of my wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thee into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of brutish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02796">skilful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04889">to destroy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brutish</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">burning</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0402">Thou shalt be for fuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">to the fire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">thy blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">shall be in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>; thou shalt be no <transChange type="added">more</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">remembered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen877" osisID="Ezek.21"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Moreover the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Now, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou judge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the bloody</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">yea, thou shalt shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">her all her abominations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>judge</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">plead for</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>bloody…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">city of bloods?</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>shew her</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">make her know</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">The city</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sheddeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">of it, that her time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against herself to defile</w> herself.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou art become guilty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in thy blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast shed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">thyself in thine idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast made</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">and thou hast caused thy days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to draw near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and art come</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">unto thy years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore have I made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">thee a reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">unto the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07048">and a mocking</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to all countries</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Those that be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w>, and <transChange type="added">those that be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H07046" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">from thee, shall mock</w> thee, <transChange type="added">which art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034 strong:H02931">infamous</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H04103">vexed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>infamous…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">polluted of name, much in vexation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">Behold, the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">were in thee to their power</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>power</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">arm</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">In thee have they set light</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">by father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and mother</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of thee have they dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06233">by oppression</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">with the stranger</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">in thee have they vexed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">the fatherless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">and the widow</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>oppression</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">deceit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">mine holy things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and hast profaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">my sabbaths</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">In thee are men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07400">that carry tales</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and in thee they eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of thee they commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">lewdness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of slanders</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">In thee have they discovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their fathers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">nakedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">in thee have they humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">her that was set apart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">for pollution</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">with his neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">hath lewdly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">his daughter in law</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">in thee hath humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">his sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>one</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">every one</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>another</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">every one</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>lewdly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">by lewdness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">In thee have they taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">gifts</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05392">usury</w> <w lemma="strong:H08636">and increase</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01214" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and thou hast greedily gained</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of thy neighbours</w> <w lemma="strong:H06233">by extortion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Behold, therefore I have smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">at thy dishonest gain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">and at thy blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">which hath been in the midst</w> of thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Can thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">endure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">or can thine hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I shall deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with thee? I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">thee among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and disperse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee in the countries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">thy filthiness</w> out of thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05157 strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8738">And thou shalt take thine inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thyself in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shalt take…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shalt be profaned</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05509">is to me become dross</w>: all they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0913">and tin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01270">and iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05777">and lead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03564">of the furnace</w>; they are <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05509">the dross</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dross of silver</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">drosses</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05509">Because ye are all become dross</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, therefore I will gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">you into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06910">they gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">and brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01270">and iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05777">and lead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0913">and tin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03564">of the furnace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05301" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">upon it, to melt</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so will I gather</w> <transChange type="added">you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in mine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">and in my fury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will leave</w> <transChange type="added">you there</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and melt</w> you.<note type="study"><catchWord>As…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">According to the gathering</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03664" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Yea, I will gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05301" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you, and blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">upon you in the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">of my wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and ye shall be melted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03701">As silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02046">is melted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03564">of the furnace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">so shall ye be melted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof; and ye shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">my fury</w> upon you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">say</w> unto her, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">that is not cleansed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01656">nor rained</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">upon in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">of indignation</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:25
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07195">a conspiracy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of her prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thereof, like a roaring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ravening</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">the prey</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">souls</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02633">the treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03366">and precious things</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they have made her many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">widows</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Her priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H02554" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have violated</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">my law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and have profaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">mine holy things</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they have put no difference</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">between the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02455">and profane</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">neither have they shewed</w> <transChange type="added">difference</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">between the unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">and the clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and have hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">their eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">from my sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and I am profaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>violated</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">offered violence to</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Her princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> thereof <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02061">like wolves</w> <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ravening</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">the prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">souls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01214" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to get</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">dishonest gain</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">And her prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H02902" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have daubed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08602">them with untempered</w> <transChange type="added">morter</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02374">seeing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and divining</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">lies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath not spoken</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">The people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06233 strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have used oppression</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and exercised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01498">robbery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and have vexed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, they have oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">wrongfully</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>oppression</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">deceit</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>wrongfully</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">without right</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">for a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01443" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">among them, that should make up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01447">the hedge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">in the gap</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">me for the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that I should not destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it: but I found</w> none.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore have I poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">mine indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon them; I have consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">them with the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">of my wrath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01870">their own way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I recompensed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon their heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen878" osisID="Ezek.22"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came again unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">there were two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">mother</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they committed whoredoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they committed whoredoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">in their youth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07699">there were their breasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04600" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">pressed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and there they bruised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01717">the teats</w> <w lemma="strong:H01331">of their virginity</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And the names</w> of them <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0170">Aholah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the elder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0172">and Aholibah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">her sister</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they were mine, and they bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>. Thus <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">their names</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0170">Aholah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0172">Aholibah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Aholah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">His tent</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">tabernacle</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Aholibah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">My tabernacle in her</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0170">And Aholah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">played the harlot</w> <w lemma="strong:H08478">when she was mine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05689" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she doted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">on her lovers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0804">on the Assyrians</w> <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">neighbours</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08504">with blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06346">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05461">and rulers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02531">all of them desirable</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">horsemen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">riding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">upon horses</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus she committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">her whoredoms</w> with them, with all them <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04005">the chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05689" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and with all on whom she doted</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01544">with all their idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">she defiled</w> herself.<note type="study"><catchWord>committed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bestowed her whoredoms upon them</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the chosen…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the choice of the children of Asshur</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Neither left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">she her whoredoms</w> <transChange type="added">brought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04714">from Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05271">for in her youth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">with her, and they bruised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01717">the breasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01331">of her virginity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">their whoredom</w> upon her.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore I have delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">her into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of her lovers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804 strong:H01121">of the Assyrians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05689" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon whom she doted</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">These discovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">her nakedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">her sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">her with the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and she became famous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">among women</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they had executed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08196">judgment</w> upon her.<note type="study"><catchWord>famous</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a name</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0269">And when her sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H0172">Aholibah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">she was more corrupt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05691">in her inordinate love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">than she, and in her whoredoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">more than her sister</w> in <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02183">whoredoms</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>she was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">she corrupted her inordinate love more than</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>more than…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">more than the whoredoms of her sister</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05689" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">She doted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804 strong:H01121">upon the Assyrians</w> <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">neighbours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06346">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05461">and rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04358">most gorgeously</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">horsemen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">riding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">upon horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02531">all of them desirable</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">young men</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that she was defiled</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> they <transChange type="added">took</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:14
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">she increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">her whoredoms</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for when she saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02707" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">pourtrayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">upon the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06754">the images</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">pourtrayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08350">with vermilion</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02289">Girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0232">with girdles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">upon their loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05628" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02871">in dyed attire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon their heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07991">all of them princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">to look to</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01823">after the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894 strong:H01121">of the Babylonians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of Chaldea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04138">of their nativity</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04758">And as soon as she saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">them with her eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05689" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she doted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon them, and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">unto them into Chaldea</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as soon…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at the sight of her eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0894 strong:H01121">And the Babylonians</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">to her into the bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">of love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">her with their whoredom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she was polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">with them, and her mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03363" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was alienated</w> from them.<note type="study"><catchWord>Babylonians</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">children of Babel</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>alienated</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">loosed</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">disjointed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">So she discovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">her whoredoms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and discovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">her nakedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">then my mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03363" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was alienated</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">from her, like as my mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05361" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was alienated</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">from her sister</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Yet she multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">her whoredoms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in calling to remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of her youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein she had played the harlot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05689" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For she doted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">upon their paramours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">whose flesh</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">of asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02231">and whose issue</w> <transChange type="added">is like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02231">the issue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">of horses</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus thou calledst to remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">the lewdness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of thy youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in bruising</w> <w lemma="strong:H01717">thy teats</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">by the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">for the paps</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of thy youth</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0172">Therefore, O Aholibah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">thy lovers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">against thee, from whom thy mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05361" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is alienated</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">them against thee on every side</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0894 strong:H01121">The Babylonians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03778">and all the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06489">Pekod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07772">and Shoa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06970">and Koa</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0804 strong:H01121">all the Assyrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H02531">with them: all of them desirable</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06346">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05461">and rulers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07991">great lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and renowned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all of them riding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">upon horses</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02021">against thee with chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">wagons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01534">and wheels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06951">and with an assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of people</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06793">against thee buckler</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">and shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H06959">and helmet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and they shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thee according to their judgments</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">my jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against thee, and they shall deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">furiously</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">with thee: they shall take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">thy nose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">and thine ears</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0319">and thy remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and thy daughters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0319">and thy residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">by the fire</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">They shall also strip</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">thee out of thy clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">thy fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">jewels</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fair…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">instruments of thy decking</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02154">Thus will I make thy lewdness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H02184">from thee, and thy whoredom</w> <transChange type="added">brought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that thou shalt not lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, nor remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w> any more.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thee into the hand</w> <transChange type="added">of them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom thou hatest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <transChange type="added">of them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">from whom thy mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05361" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is alienated</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H08135">with thee hatefully</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03018">all thy labour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05903">thee naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06181">and bare</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06172">and the nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02183">of thy whoredoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be discovered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02154">both thy lewdness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">and thy whoredoms</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I will do</w> these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">because thou art polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">with their idols</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">of thy sister</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">her cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into thine hand</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">of thy sister’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H06013">deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07342">and large</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06712">thou shalt be laughed to scorn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03933">and had in derision</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">it containeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04767">much</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Thou shalt be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07943">with drunkenness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03015">and sorrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03563">with the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">of astonishment</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">and desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03563">with the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">of thy sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou shalt even drink</w> it and suck <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04680" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01633" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and thou shalt break</w> <w lemma="strong:H02789">the sherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thereof, and pluck off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">thine own breasts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for I have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because thou hast forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">me behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01458">thy back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">therefore bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">thou also thy lewdness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">and thy whoredoms</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:36
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">moreover unto me; Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0170">Aholah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0172">and Aholibah</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">yea, declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">unto them their abominations</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>judge</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">plead for</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">That they have committed adultery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">and blood</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01544">and with their idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have they committed adultery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and have also caused their sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom they bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto me, to pass for them through</w> <transChange type="added">the fire</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0402">to devour</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Moreover this they have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">unto me: they have defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">my sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the same day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and have profaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">my sabbaths</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">For when they had slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">to their idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">into my sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it; and, lo, thus have they done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of mine house</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0637">And furthermore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">for men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">from far</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">unto whom a messenger</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">sent</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and, lo, they came</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for whom thou didst wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H03583" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thyself, paintedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thy eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05710" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and deckedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05716">thyself with ornaments</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>to come</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">coming</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And satest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03520">upon a stately</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07979">and a table</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, whereupon thou hast set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">mine incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">and mine oil</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stately</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">honourable</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">And a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">of a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H07961">being at ease</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">with her: and with the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120 strong:H07230">of the common sort</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05433 strong:H05436" morph="strongMorph:TH8802 strongMorph:TH8675">Sabeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">from the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06781">bracelets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">upon their hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08597">and beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05850">crowns</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon their heads</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of the multitude of men</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Sabeans</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">drunkards</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> I unto <transChange type="added">her that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01087">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H05004">in adulteries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Will they now commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08457">whoredoms</w> with her, and she <transChange type="added">with them</transChange>?<note type="study"><catchWord>whoredoms…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">her whoredoms</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yet they went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto her, as they go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that playeth the harlot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so went they in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0170">unto Aholah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0172">and unto Aholibah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02154">the lewd</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:45
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06662">And the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">them after the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of adulteresses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and after the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of women that shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>; because they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">adulteresses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">and blood</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hands</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">I will bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">a company</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">upon them, and will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02189">them to be removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">and spoiled</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for a removing and spoil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06951">And the company</w> <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">them with stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and dispatch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">them with their swords</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">their sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and their daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burn up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">their houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dispatch…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">single them out</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02154">Thus will I cause lewdness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">that all women</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8739">may be taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">after your lewdness</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">your lewdness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon you, and ye shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">of your idols</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen879" osisID="Ezek.23"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08671">Again in the ninth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06224">in the tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06218">in the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">write</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thee the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of the day</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06106">of this same</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">himself against Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">this same</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">a parable</w> <w lemma="strong:H04805">unto the rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08239" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Set on</w> <w lemma="strong:H05518">a pot</w>, set <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08239" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and also pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> into it:

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05409">the pieces</w> thereof into it, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">every good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05409">piece</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03409">the thigh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03802">and the shoulder</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">fill</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04005">with the choice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">bones</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04005">the choice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01754">and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">also the bones</w> under it, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07570" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">make it boil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07571">well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and let them seethe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">of it therein</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>burn</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">heap</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0188">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">to the bloody</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05518">to the pot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02457">whose scum</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02457">therein, and whose scum</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is not gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">of it! bring it out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05409">piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H05409">by piece</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01486">let no lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fall</w> upon it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01818">For her blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">is in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of her; she set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06706">it upon the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of a rock</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">it not upon the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">it with dust</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02534">That it might cause fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05359">vengeance</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">her blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06706">upon the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of a rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that it should not be covered</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0188">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">to the bloody</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>! <w lemma="strong:H04071">I will even make the pile</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for fire great</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">on wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01814" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07543" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and spice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04841">it well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">and let the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H02787" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be burned</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">Then set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07386">it empty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01513">upon the coals</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">thereof, that the brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03179" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of it may be hot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02787" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and may burn</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02932">the filthiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">of it may be molten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in it</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02457">the scum</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of it may be consumed</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">She hath wearied</w> <transChange type="added">herself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08383">with lies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and her great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02457">scum</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went not forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02457">out of her: her scum</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02932">In thy filthiness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02154">lewdness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because I have purged</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and thou wast not purged</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not be purged</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">from thy filthiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">any more, till I have caused my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to rest</w> upon thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it shall come to pass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not go back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither will I spare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">neither will I repent</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01870">according to thy ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05949">and according to thy doings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall they judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Also the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, I take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04261">from thee the desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04046">with a stroke</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet neither shalt thou mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor weep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01832">neither shall thy tears</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">run down</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>run down</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">go</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:17
