verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Forbear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0602" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">no mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">for the dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06287">the tire of thine head</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon thee, and put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">thy shoes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">upon thy feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cover</w> not <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08222">lips</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">not the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Forbear</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Be silent</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>lips</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upper lip</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">So I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06153">and at even</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">my wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">as I was commanded</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto me, Wilt thou not tell</w> us what these <transChange type="added">things are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to us, that thou doest</w> <transChange type="added">so</transChange>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">them, The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Behold, I will profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">my sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01347">the excellency</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of your strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04261">the desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of your eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and that which your soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04263">pitieth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and your sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and your daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom ye have left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the pity of your soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as I have done</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall not cover</w> <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08222">lips</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of men</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06287">And your tires</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon your heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05275">and your shoes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">upon your feet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall not mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor weep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04743" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">but ye shall pine away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for your iniquities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05098" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">toward another</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03168">Thus Ezekiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">is unto you a sign</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">according to all that he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye do</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when this cometh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Also, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <transChange type="added">shall it</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">from them their strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04885">the joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">of their glory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04261">the desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of their eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04853">and that whereupon they set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their minds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">their sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and their daughters</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the lifting up of their soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:26
verses.text: <transChange type="added">That</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06412">he that escapeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> unto thee, to cause <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02045">to hear</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> with <transChange type="added">thine</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0241">ears</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">shall thy mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06412">to him which is escaped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and thou shalt speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0481" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and be no more dumb</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04159">and thou shalt be a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them; and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 24." eID="gen880" osisID="Ezek.24"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came again unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983 strong:H01121">against the Ammonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and prophesy</w> against them;

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983 strong:H01121">unto the Ammonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Because thou saidst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01889">Aha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04720">against my sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">when it was profaned</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0127">and against the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">when it was desolate</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">and against the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">into captivity</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, therefore I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thee to the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H04181">for a possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and they shall set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02918">their palaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in thee, and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">their dwellings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in thee: they shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">thy fruit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">thy milk</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>men</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">children</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07237">Rabbah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">a stable</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">for camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05983 strong:H01121">and the Ammonites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04769">a couchingplace</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">for flocks</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04222" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">Because thou hast clapped</w> <transChange type="added">thine</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07554" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and stamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">with the feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">in heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07589">with all thy despite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">against the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>hands</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>feet</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">foot</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>heart</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, therefore I will stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon thee, and will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0897 strong:H0957" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">thee for a spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">to the heathen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cut thee off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cause thee to perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the countries</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee; and thou shalt know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a spoil</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">meat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03282">Because</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">that Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">and Seir</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">do say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">Behold, the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">like unto all the heathen</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Therefore, behold, I will open</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from the cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">from his cities</w> <transChange type="added">which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">on his frontiers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06643">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01020">Beth–jeshimoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01186">Baal–meon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07156">and Kiriathaim</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>side…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shoulder of Moab</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Unto the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983 strong:H01121">with the Ammonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04181">them in possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05983 strong:H01121">that the Ammonites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">may not be remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">against the children of Ammon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H08201">judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">upon Moab</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0123">Because that Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">hath dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">against the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by taking</w> <w lemma="strong:H05359">vengeance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and hath greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">offended</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and revenged</w> himself upon them;<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by revenging revengement</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will also stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">upon Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from it; and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">it desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08487">from Teman</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01719">and they of Dedan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they shall fall by the sword unto Dedan</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">my vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">upon Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">in Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">according to mine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">and according to my fury</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">my vengeance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06430">Because the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">have dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">by revenge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05359">vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07589">with a despiteful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04889">to destroy</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H0342">hatred</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>for the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">with perpetual hatred</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">upon the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03774">the Cherethims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H02348">coast</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sea coast</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">haven of the sea</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">upon them with furious</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">rebukes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">my vengeance</w> upon them.<note type="study"><catchWord>great vengeance</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">great vengeances</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 25." eID="gen881" osisID="Ezek.25"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H06249">And it came to pass in the eleventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">in the first</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06865">because that Tyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01889">Aha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">she is broken</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">she is turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">unto me: I shall be replenished</w>, <transChange type="added">now</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">she is laid waste</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06865">against thee, O Tyrus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and will cause many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">against thee, as the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">causeth his waves</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to come up</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And they shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyrus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and break down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">her towers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05500" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I will also scrape</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">her dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from her, and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06706">her like the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of a rock</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:5
verses.text: It shall be <transChange type="added">a place for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04894">the spreading</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">of nets</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for I have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0957">and it shall become a spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">to the nations</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01323">And her daughters</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">upon Tyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">from the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">with horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">and with chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">and with horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06951">and companies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">thy daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01785">a fort</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against thee, and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05550">a mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">against thee, and lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06793">the buckler</w> against thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>cast…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pour out the engine of shot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04239">engines</w> <w lemma="strong:H06904">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">against thy walls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">and with his axes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall break down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">thy towers</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08229">By reason of the abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">of his horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H080">their dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">thee: thy walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">at the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">of the horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01534">and of the wheels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">and of the chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">into thy gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03996">as men enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">wherein is made a breach</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as men…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to the enterings of a city broken up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06541">With the hoofs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">of his horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he tread down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">all thy streets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05797">and thy strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">garrisons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall make a spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of thy riches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and make a prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H07404">of thy merchandise</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall break down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">thy walls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02532">thy pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">thy stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">and thy timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">and thy dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the water</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thy pleasant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">houses of thy desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01995">And I will cause the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of thy songs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to cease</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">of thy harps</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be no more heard</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06706">thee like the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of a rock</w>: thou shalt be <transChange type="added">a place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04894" type="x-split-360">to spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">nets</w> <w lemma="strong:H04894" type="x-split-360">upon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thou shalt be built</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">no more: for I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">to Tyrus</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0339">Shall not the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">at the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H04658">of thy fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02491">when the wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0602" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02027">when the slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">is made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> of thee?

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">Then all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">from their thrones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and lay away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">their robes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07553">their broidered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall clothe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02731">themselves with trembling</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall tremble</w> at <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07281">moment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be astonished</w> at thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>trembling</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tremblings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07015">a lamentation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thee, and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to thee, How art thou destroyed</w>, <transChange type="added">that wast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">inhabited</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of seafaring men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">the renowned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">which wast strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">in the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">she and her inhabitants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H02851">their terror</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">on all that haunt</w> it!<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of the seas</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0339">Now shall the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">tremble</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04658">of thy fall</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0339">yea, the isles</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">in the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at thy departure</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When I shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thee a desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">like the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that are not inhabited</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when I shall bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">the deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">upon thee, and great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall cover</w> thee;

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">When I shall bring thee down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them that descend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">into the pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">with the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08482">thee in the low parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02723">in places desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">to the pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou be not inhabited</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I shall set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06643">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01091">thee a terror</w>, and thou <transChange type="added">shalt be</transChange> no <transChange type="added">more</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">though thou be sought for</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">yet shalt thou never</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">again, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a terror</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">terrors</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 26." eID="gen882" osisID="Ezek.26"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came again unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Now, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07015">a lamentation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">for Tyrus</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">unto Tyrus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O thou that art situate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03997">at the entry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <transChange type="added">which art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a merchant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">for many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">isles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06865">O Tyrus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03632">of perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">beauty</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of perfect…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">perfect of beauty</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">Thy borders</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the seas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy builders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03634" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have perfected</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">thy beauty</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>midst</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have made</w> all thy <transChange type="added">ship</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03871">boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H01265">of fir trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H08149">of Senir</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedars</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">from Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08650">masts</w> for thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>made</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">built</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0437">the oaks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04880">thine oars</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01323">the company</w> <w lemma="strong:H0839">of the Ashurites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">thy benches</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08127">ivory</w>, <transChange type="added">brought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0339">out of the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03794">of Chittim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the company…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they have made thy hatches of ivory well trodden</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>company</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">daughter</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08336">Fine linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07553">with broidered work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">from Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04666">was that which thou spreadest forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">to be thy sail</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">from the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H0473">of Elishah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04374">was that which covered</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>blue…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">purple and scarlet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">of Zidon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0719">and Arvad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07751" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">were thy mariners</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02450">thy wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06865">O Tyrus</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02259">were in thee, were thy pilots</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">The ancients</w> <w lemma="strong:H01380">of Gebal</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">and the wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02388 strong:H0919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">thereof were in thee thy calkers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0591">all the ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H04419">with their mariners</w> <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were in thee to occupy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04627">thy merchandise</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>calkers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stoppers of chinks</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strengtheners</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06539">They of Persia</w> <w lemma="strong:H03865">and of Lud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06316">and of Phut</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">were in thine army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">thy men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">the shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H03553">and helmet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in thee; they set forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">thy comeliness</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0719">of Arvad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">with thine army</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon thy walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01575">and the Gammadims</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">were in thy towers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07982">their shields</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon thy walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03634" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-361">they have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">thy beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03634" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-361">perfect</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08659">Tarshish</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy merchant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">by reason of the multitude</w> of all <transChange type="added">kind of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01952">riches</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03701">with silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01270">iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0913">tin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05777">and lead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they traded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05801">in thy fairs</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03120">Javan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08422">Tubal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04902">and Meshech</w>, they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy merchants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they traded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the persons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">and vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H04627">in thy market</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>market</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">merchandise</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">They of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08425">of Togarmah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">traded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05801">in thy fairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">with horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">and horsemen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06505">and mules</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01719">of Dedan</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy merchants</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">isles</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05506">the merchandise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they brought</w> thee <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0814">a present</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">of ivory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01894">and ebony</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0758">Syria</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy merchant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">by reason of the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">of the wares of thy making</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they occupied</w> <w lemma="strong:H05801">in thy fairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05306">with emeralds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07553">and broidered work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0948">and fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07215">and coral</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03539">and agate</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the wares…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thy works</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>agate</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chrysoprase</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy merchants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they traded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04627">in thy market</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">wheat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04511">of Minnith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06436">and Pannag</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06875">and balm</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>balm</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">rosin</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01834">Damascus</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy merchant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">of the wares of thy making</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">for the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">of all riches</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03196">in the wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02463">of Helbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06713">and white</w> <w lemma="strong:H06785">wool</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01835 strong:H02051" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03120">also and Javan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0235" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">going to and fro</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">occupied</w> <w lemma="strong:H05801">in thy fairs</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06219">bright</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06916">cassia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07070">and calamus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04627">were in thy market</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>going…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Meuzal</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01719">Dedan</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy merchant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02667">in precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07396">for chariots</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>precious…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">clothes of freedom</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06152">Arabia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">and all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06938">of Kedar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-362">they occupied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H03733">in lambs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">and rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06260">and goats</w>: in these <transChange type="added">were they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-362">thy merchants</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they occupied…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they were the merchants of thy hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The merchants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07614">of Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H07484">and Raamah</w>, they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy merchants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they occupied</w> <w lemma="strong:H05801">in thy fairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">with chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01314">of all spices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03368">and with all precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02771">Haran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03656">and Canneh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05729">and Eden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the merchants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07614">of Sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0804">Asshur</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03638">Chilmad</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy merchants</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:24
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy merchants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04360">in all sorts</w> <transChange type="added">of things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08504">in blue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01545">clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07553">and broidered work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01595">and in chests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01264">of rich apparel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">with cords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0729">and made of cedar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04819">among thy merchandise</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>all…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">excellent things</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>clothes</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">foldings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0591">The ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">of Tarshish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07788" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">did sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04627">of thee in thy market</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and thou wast replenished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and made very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the seas</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07751" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Thy rowers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">thee into great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06921">the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thee in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the seas</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>midst</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01952">Thy riches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05801">and thy fairs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04627">thy merchandise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04419">thy mariners</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02259">and thy pilots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388 strong:H0919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">thy calkers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the occupiers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04627">of thy merchandise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and all thy men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06951">in thee, and in all thy company</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of thee, shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the seas</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04658">of thy ruin</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and in…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">even with all</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>midst of the seas</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heart</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04054">The suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">at the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H02201">of the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02259">of thy pilots</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>suburbs</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">waves</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And all that handle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04880">the oar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04419">the mariners</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02259">all the pilots</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">from their ships</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the land</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">And shall cause their voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to be heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against thee, and shall cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">bitterly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall cast up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon their heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06428" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">they shall wallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">themselves in the ashes</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07144">And they shall make themselves utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07139" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">bald</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thee, and gird</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">them with sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">for thee with bitterness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of heart</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04751">bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04553">wailing</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05204">And in their wailing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07015">a lamentation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06969" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">for thee, and lament</w> over thee, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, What <transChange type="added">city is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06865">like Tyrus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01822">like the destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05801">When thy wares</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">out of the seas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou filledst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou didst enrich</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">with the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">of thy riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H04627">and of thy merchandise</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">In the time</w> <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thou shalt be broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">by the seas</w> <w lemma="strong:H04615">in the depths</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04627">thy merchandise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">and all thy company</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of thee shall fall</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">All the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">of the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be astonished</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">at thee, and their kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08178">shall be sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08175" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07481" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall be troubled</w> in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">countenance</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The merchants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08319" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall hiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H01091">at thee; thou shalt be a terror</w>, and never <transChange type="added">shalt be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769 strong:H05704">any more</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a terror</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">terrors</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>never…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shalt not be for ever</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 27." eID="gen883" osisID="Ezek.27"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came again unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">unto the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyrus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03820">Because thine heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lifted up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou hast said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">a God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I sit</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04186">the seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the seas</w>; yet thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">and not God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">though thou set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">as the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>midst</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:3
verses.text: Behold, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wiser</w> <w lemma="strong:H01840">than Daniel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05640" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">there is no secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H06004" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they can hide</w> from thee:

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02451">With thy wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">and with thine understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast gotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">thee riches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hast gotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">into thy treasures</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">By thy great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07404">by thy traffick</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hast thou increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">thy riches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">and thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">because of thy riches</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>thy great…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the greatness of thy wisdom</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Because thou hast set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">as the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, therefore I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">upon thee, the terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and they shall draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">their swords</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">against the beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of thy wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and they shall defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H03314">thy brightness</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They shall bring thee down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">to the pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt die</w> <w lemma="strong:H04463">the deaths</w> of <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the seas</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Wilt thou yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him that slayeth</w> thee, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>? but thou <transChange type="added">shalt be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">and no God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of him that slayeth</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>of him that slayeth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of him that woundeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt die</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the deaths</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">of the uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of strangers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for I have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Moreover the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07015">a lamentation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">upon the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyrus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Thou sealest up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08508">the sum</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03632">and perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">in beauty</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05731">Thou hast been in Eden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03368">every precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04540">thy covering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0124">the sardius</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06357">topaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03095">and the diamond</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08658">the beryl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07718">the onyx</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03471">and the jasper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05601">the sapphire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05306">the emerald</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01304">and the carbuncle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04399">the workmanship</w> <w lemma="strong:H08596">of thy tabrets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05345">and of thy pipes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">was prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in thee in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that thou wast created</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sardius</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ruby</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>beryl</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chrysolite</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>emerald</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chrysoprase</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:14
verses.text: Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04473">the anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w> <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that covereth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I have set</w> thee <transChange type="added">so</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06944">thou wast upon the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">thou hast walked up and down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:15
verses.text: Thou <transChange type="added">wast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08549">perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in thy ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that thou wast created</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05766">till iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was found</w> in thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">By the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H07404">of thy merchandise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">of thee with violence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou hast sinned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">therefore I will cast thee as profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">out of the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee, O covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">from the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">because of thy beauty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast corrupted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">thy wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">by reason of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03314">thy brightness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I will cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee to the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thee before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they may behold</w> thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou hast defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">thy sanctuaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">by the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">of thine iniquities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05766">by the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07404">of thy traffick</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore will I bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of thee, it shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">thee to ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all them that behold</w> thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">All they that know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thee among the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be astonished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01091">at thee: thou shalt be a terror</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0369">and never</w> <transChange type="added">shalt</transChange> thou <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769 strong:H05704">any more</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a terror</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">terrors</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Again the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">against Zidon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and prophesy</w> against it,

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06721">against thee, O Zidon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and I will be glorified</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of thee: and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I shall have executed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08201">judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">in her, and shall be sanctified</w> in her.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">For I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">into her pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">and blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">into her streets</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02491">and the wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8768">shall be judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of her by the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">upon her on every side</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03992" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And there shall be no more a pricking</w> <w lemma="strong:H05544">brier</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, nor <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03510" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">grieving</w> <w lemma="strong:H06975">thorn</w> of all <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H07590" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">them, that despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them; and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">When I shall have gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">among whom they are scattered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and shall be sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in them in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shall they dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safely</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therein, and shall build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">vineyards</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, they shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">with confidence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I have executed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08201">judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H07590" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">upon all those that despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">them round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them; and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>safely</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">with confidence</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>despise</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spoil</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 28." eID="gen884" osisID="Ezek.28"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06224">In the tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06224">in the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">in the twelfth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">against Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">against him, and against all Egypt</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">against thee, Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">dragon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of his rivers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which hath said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02975">My river</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">mine own, and I have made</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> for myself.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But I will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02397 strong:H02397" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">hooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03895">in thy jaws</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01710">and I will cause the fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of thy rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to stick</w> <w lemma="strong:H07193">unto thy scales</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of thy rivers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01710">and all the fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of thy rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall stick</w> <w lemma="strong:H07193">unto thy scales</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will leave</w> thee <transChange type="added">thrown</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01710">thee and all the fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of thy rivers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the open</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">fields</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thou shalt not be brought together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor gathered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0402">thee for meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">to the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">and to the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>open…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">face of the field</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04938">because they have been a staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">of reed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:7
