verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When they took hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">of thee by thy hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thou didst break</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and rend</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">all their shoulder</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">and when they leaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">upon thee, thou brakest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04975">and madest all their loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H05976" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to be at a stand</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">upon thee, and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w> out of thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">shall be desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">and waste</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he hath said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02975">The river</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">mine, and I have made</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:10
verses.text: Behold, therefore I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02975">against thee, and against thy rivers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02721">utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">waste</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04024">from the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H05482">of Syene</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">even unto the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">of Ethiopia</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>utterly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wastes of waste</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from Migdol to Syene</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Syene</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Seveneh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07272">No foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">it, nor foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, neither shall it be inhabited</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the countries</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and her cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">laid waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">shall be desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and will disperse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them through the countries</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07093">At the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">of forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">whither they were scattered</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will cause them to return</w> <transChange type="added">into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06624">of Pathros</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04351">of their habitation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08217">and they shall be there a base</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">kingdom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>habitation</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">birth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>base</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">low</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08217">It shall be the basest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of the kingdoms</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">neither shall it exalt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">itself any more above the nations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for I will diminish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, that they shall no more rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">over the nations</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04009">And it shall be no more the confidence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688" type="x-split-363">which bringeth</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688" type="x-split-363">to remembrance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: but they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07651">And it came to pass in the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">in the first</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">in the first</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-364">caused</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">his army</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-364">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">service</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">against Tyrus</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07218">every head</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07139" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">made bald</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03802">and every shoulder</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04803" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">peeled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07939">yet had he no wages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">nor his army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06865">for Tyrus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05656">for the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had served</w> against it:

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">unto Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">her multitude</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">her spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">her prey</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07939">and it shall be the wages</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">for his army</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>take her spoil…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">spoil her spoil, and prey her prey</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">him the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06468">his labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherewith he served</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against it, because they wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">for me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for his…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for his hire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-365">will I cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">the horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-365">to bud forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06610">thee the opening</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of them; and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 29." eID="gen885" osisID="Ezek.29"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came again unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Howl</w> <w lemma="strong:H01929">ye, Woe worth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w>!

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For the day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">even the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">a cloudy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06256">it shall be the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02719">And the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">upon Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02479">and great pain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">shall be in Ethiopia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02491">when the slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">her multitude</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03247">and her foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be broken down</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pain</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fear</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03568">Ethiopia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06316">and Libya</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03865">and Lydia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06153">and all the mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03552">people, and Chub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">that is in league</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with them by the sword</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Libya</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Phut</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>men</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">children</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They also that uphold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fall</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01347">and the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of her power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04024">from the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H05482">of Syene</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">in it by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from Migdol to Syene</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And they shall be desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the countries</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and her cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">shall be in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the cities</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">wasted</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, and <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all her helpers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be destroyed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroyed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">broken</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">shall messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from me</w> <w lemma="strong:H06716">in ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">to make the careless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">Ethiopians</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02479">and great pain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">shall come upon them, as in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for, lo, it cometh</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01995">I will also make the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadrezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">He and his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">with him, the terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">shall be brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and they shall draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">their swords</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">against Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">with the slain</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02724">dry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of the wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">and I will make the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04393">and all that is therein</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of strangers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dry</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">drought</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the fulness thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I will also destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">the idols</w>, and I will cause <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0457">images</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H05297">out of Noph</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05387">and there shall be no more a prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">a fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06624">And I will make Pathros</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06814">in Zoan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H08201">judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H04996">in No</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Zoan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Tanis</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H05512">upon Sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04581">the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H04996">of No</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Sin</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Pelusium</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05512">Sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall have great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04996">and No</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">shall be rent asunder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05297">and Noph</w> <transChange type="added">shall have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06862">distresses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">daily</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0970">The young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0206">of Aven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06364">and of Pi–beseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>: and these <transChange type="added">cities</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">into captivity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Aven</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Heliopolis</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Pi–beseth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Pubastum</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08471">At Tehaphnehes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">also the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02820 strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8804">shall be darkened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I shall break</w> <w lemma="strong:H04133">there the yokes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01347">and the pomp</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of her strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H01931">in her</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06051">as for her, a cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">her, and her daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">into captivity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>darkened</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">restrained</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus will I execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H08201">judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0259">And it came to pass in the eleventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">in the first</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">in the seventh</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">the arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">and, lo, it shall not be bound up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414 strong:H07499" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be healed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02848">a roller</w> <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it, to make it strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">against Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will break</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">his arms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">the strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and that which was broken</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02719">and I will cause the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of his hand</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and will disperse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them through the countries</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">the arms</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">my sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but I will break</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05008" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall groan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05009">him with the groanings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">of a deadly wounded</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">But I will strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">the arms</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02220">and the arms</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall down</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">my sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall stretch it out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and disperse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them among the countries</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 30." eID="gen886" osisID="Ezek.30"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0259">And it came to pass in the eleventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07992">in the third</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">in the first</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">and to his multitude</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Whom art thou like</w> <w lemma="strong:H01433">in thy greatness</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0804">Behold, the Assyrian</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0730">a cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">in Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">with fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H06057">branches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06751" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and with a shadowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02793">shroud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01362">and of an high</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">stature</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06788">and his top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">was among the thick boughs</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with fair branches</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fair of branches</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">The waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">made him great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08415">the deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">set him up on high</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">with her rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">running</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04302">his plants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and sent out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08585">her little rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">unto all the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">nourished him</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">brought him up</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>little rivers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">conduits</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06967">Therefore his height</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">above all the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05634">and his boughs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were multiplied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06288">and his branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">became long</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">because of the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when he shot forth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when it sent them forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05775">All the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07077" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">made their nests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05589">in his boughs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06288">and under his branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">did all the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bring forth their young</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06738">and under his shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">all great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03302" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus was he fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01433">in his greatness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0753">in the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H01808">of his branches</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08328">for his root</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">was by great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0730">The cedars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">in the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06004" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">could not hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01265">him: the fir trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were not like</w> <w lemma="strong:H05589">his boughs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06196">and the chesnut trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H06288">were not like his branches</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06086">nor any tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">in the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was like</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">unto him in his beauty</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">him fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">by the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01808">of his branches</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06086">so that all the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H05731">of Eden</w>, that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01588">in the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">envied</w> him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because thou hast lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">thyself in height</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he hath shot up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06788">his top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">among the thick boughs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">and his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01363">in his height</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I have therefore delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of the mighty one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">with him: I have driven him out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">for his wickedness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in doing he shall do unto him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">And strangers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06184">the terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have cut him off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have left</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">him: upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">and in all the valleys</w> <w lemma="strong:H01808">his branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are fallen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06288">and his boughs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">are broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0650">by all the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are gone down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">from his shadow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have left</w> him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04658">Upon his ruin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">shall all the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and all the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06288">shall be upon his branches</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06086">To the end that none of all the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">by the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">exalt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">themselves for their height</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shoot up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06788">their top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">among the thick boughs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">neither their trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stand up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01363">in their height</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for they are all delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">unto death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08482">to the nether parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">to the pit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their trees…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stand upon themselves for their height</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">to the grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I caused a mourning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">the deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for him, and I restrained</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the floods</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">thereof, and the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were stayed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03844">and I caused Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">for him, and all the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H05969">fainted</w> for him.<note type="study"><catchWord>to mourn</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to be black</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">I made the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">at the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H04658">of his fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when I cast him down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">to hell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them that descend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">into the pit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06086">and all the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H05731">of Eden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04005">the choice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and best</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be comforted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08482">in the nether parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They also went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">into hell</w> with him unto <transChange type="added">them that be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>; and <transChange type="added">they that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02220">his arm</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">under his shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">To whom art thou thus like</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">in glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01433">and in greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">among the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H05731">of Eden</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">yet shalt thou be brought down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">with the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H05731">of Eden</w> <w lemma="strong:H08482">unto the nether parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">of the uncircumcised</w> with <transChange type="added">them that be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">and all his multitude</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 31." eID="gen887" osisID="Ezek.31"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">And it came to pass in the twelfth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">in the twelfth month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">in the first</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07015">a lamentation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">for Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">unto him, Thou art like</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">a young lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>, and thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08565 strong:H08577" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">as a whale</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">in the seas</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou camest forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">with thy rivers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01804" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and troubledst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">with thy feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07515" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fouledst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">their rivers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>whale</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dragon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will therefore spread out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07568">my net</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">over thee with a company</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and they shall bring thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">in my net</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then will I leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee upon the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02904" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will cast thee forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the open</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and will cause all the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">upon thee, and I will fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the whole earth</w> with thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">thy flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">the valleys</w> <w lemma="strong:H07419">with thy height</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I will also water</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with thy blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06824">wherein thou swimmest</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to the mountains</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0650">and the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be full</w> of thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>the land wherein…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the land of thy swimming</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And when I shall put thee out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I will cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-366">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-366">thereof dark</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">with a cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03394">and the moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">her light</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>put…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">extinguish thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03974">All the bright</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">lights</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I make dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">over thee, and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bright…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lights of the light in heaven</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>dark</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">them dark</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I will also vex</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when I shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">thy destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the countries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast not known</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>vex</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">provoke to anger</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">grief</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Yea, I will make many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">amazed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">at thee, and their kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08178">shall be horribly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08175" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8788">for thee, when I shall brandish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">my sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before them</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall tremble</w> at <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07281">moment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for his own life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04658">of thy fall</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02719">The sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> upon thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02719">By the swords</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">will I cause thy multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06184">the terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">all of them: and they shall spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">the pomp</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">and all the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thereof shall be destroyed</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">also all the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">thereof from</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">beside the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07272">neither shall the foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01804" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">them any more, nor the hoofs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01804" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">trouble</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">Then will I make their waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08257" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">and cause their rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to run</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">like oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When I shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall be destitute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">of that whereof it was full</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when I shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all them that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therein, then shall they know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destitute…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">desolate from the fulness thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:16
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07015">the lamentation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06969" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">wherewith they shall lament</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">her: the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06969" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">shall lament</w> <w lemma="strong:H06969" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">her: they shall lament</w> for her, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04714">for Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">and for all her multitude</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">It came to pass also in the twelfth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">in the fifteenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05091" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">wail</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">for the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and cast them down</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">her, and the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0117">of the famous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08482">unto the nether parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">into the pit</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05276" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Whom dost thou pass in beauty</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8713">and be thou laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">with the uncircumcised</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> of <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">she is delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">to the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">her and all her multitudes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>she…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the sword is laid</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">The strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">among the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">to him out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">of hell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them that help</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him: they are gone down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">uncircumcised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0804">Asshur</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06951">there and all her company</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06913">his graves</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">him: all of them slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06913">Whose graves</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">in the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">of the pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06951">and her company</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">is round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06900">her grave</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02491">all of them slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which caused</w> <w lemma="strong:H02851">terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>terror</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dismaying</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:24
verses.text: There <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05867">Elam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">and all her multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06900">her grave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02491">all of them slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which are gone down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H08482">into the nether parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which caused</w> <w lemma="strong:H02851">their terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet have they borne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">their shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">to the pit</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">her a bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">of the slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">with all her multitude</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06913">her graves</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">him: all of them uncircumcised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02851">though their terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">was caused</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet have they borne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">their shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">to the pit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">he is put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> of <transChange type="added">them that be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:26
verses.text: There <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04902">Meshech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08422">Tubal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">and all her multitude</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06913">her graves</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">him: all of them uncircumcised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">though they caused</w> <w lemma="strong:H02851">their terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they shall not lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">with the mighty</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">of the uncircumcised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which are gone down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">to hell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with their weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they have laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">their swords</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">under their heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">but their iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">shall be upon their bones</w>, though <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02851">the terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with their…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with weapons of their war</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Yea, thou shalt be broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">of the uncircumcised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shalt lie</w> with <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:29
verses.text: There <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0123">Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">her kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">and all her princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">which with their might</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are laid</w> by <transChange type="added">them that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">with the uncircumcised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and with them that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">to the pit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>laid</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">given</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">put</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:30
verses.text: There <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05257">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06722">all of them, and all the Zidonians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which are gone down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">with the slain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02851">with their terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they are ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">of their might</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">uncircumcised</w> with <transChange type="added">them that be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">their shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">to the pit</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">them, and shall be comforted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">over all his multitude</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">and all his army</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I have caused</w> <w lemma="strong:H02851">my terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">and he shall be laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">of the uncircumcised</w> with <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">and all his multitude</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 32." eID="gen888" osisID="Ezek.32"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Again the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto them, When I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon a land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">if the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">of their coasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him for their watchman</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>When…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">A land when I bring a sword upon her</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If when he seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and warn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Then whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and taketh not warning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02719">if the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and take him away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">shall be upon his own head</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>whosoever…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">he that hearing heareth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and took not warning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall be upon him. But he that taketh warning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But if the watchman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">not the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">be not warned</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02719">if the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and take</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">person</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">from among them, he is taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">in his iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">but his blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I require</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">at the watchman’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">So thou, O son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee a watchman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore thou shalt hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">at my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and warn</w> them from me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When I say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">unto the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">O wicked</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">if thou dost not speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to warn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">from his way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">that wicked</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">in his iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">but his blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I require</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at thine hand</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Nevertheless, if thou warn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of his way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from it; if he do not turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">from his way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">in his iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but thou hast delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Therefore, O thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus ye speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06588">If our transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">and our sins</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04743" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">upon us, and we pine away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in them, how should we then live</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> unto them, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I have no pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">in the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07563">but that the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">from his way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and live</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">ye from your evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for why will ye die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Therefore, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">The righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">of his transgression</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07564">as for the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">he shall not fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thereby in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">from his wickedness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06662">neither shall the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to live</w> for his <transChange type="added">righteousness</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he sinneth</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When I shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">to the righteous</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">if he trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">to his own righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">all his righteousnesses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be remembered</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05766">but for his iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath committed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall die</w> for it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Again, when I say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">unto the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">if he turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">from his sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">that which is lawful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and right</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">judgment and justice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">If</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02258">the pledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">give again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01500">that he had robbed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">in the statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">without committing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not die</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02403">None of his sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be mentioned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him: he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">that which is lawful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and right</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">Yet the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is not equal</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01870">but as for them, their way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is not equal</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">When the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">from his righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and committeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall even die</w> thereby.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">But if the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07564">from his wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">that which is lawful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and right</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall live</w> thereby.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is not equal</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01004">O ye house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">you every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">after his ways</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:21
