verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">And it came to pass in the twelfth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01546">of our captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06224">in the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">in the fifth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06412">one that had escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">out of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">The city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">is smitten</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Now the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">was upon me in the evening</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">afore</w> <w lemma="strong:H06412">he that was escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and had opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">to me in the morning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06310">and my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was opened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0481" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and I was no more dumb</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Then the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that inhabit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">those wastes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">was one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he inherited</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>: but we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04181">us for inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Wherefore say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">your eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">toward your idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall ye possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">upon your sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye work</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and ye defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall ye possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou thus unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, surely they that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02723">in the wastes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, and him that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the open</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">to the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be devoured</w>, and they that <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04679">in the forts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">and in the caves</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">of the pestilence</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to devour him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I will lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04923">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01347">and the pomp</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of her strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall cease</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02022">and the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that none shall pass through</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>most…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">desolation and desolation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shall they know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I have laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04923">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">because of all their abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they have committed</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">Also, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">still are talking</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">thee by the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">and in the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02297">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I pray you, and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">what is the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that cometh forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>against thee</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto thee as the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">cometh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but they will not do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">them: for with their mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05690">much love</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">their covetousness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to the coming of the people</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>they sit…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">my people sit before thee</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>they shew…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they make loves</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">jests</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:32
verses.text: And, lo, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05690">unto them as a very lovely</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">song</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">of one that hath a pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and can play well</w> <w lemma="strong:H05059" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">on an instrument</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but they do</w> them not.<note type="study"><catchWord>a very…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a song of loves</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And when this cometh to pass</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lo, it will come</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shall they know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">that a prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">hath been among</w> them. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 33." eID="gen889" osisID="Ezek.33"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against the shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">prophesy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto the shepherds</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that do feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">themselves! should not the shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flocks</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye clothe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06785">you with the wool</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01277">them that are fed</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">not the flock</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">The diseased</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have ye not strengthened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">neither have ye healed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that which was sick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither have ye bound up</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">neither have ye brought again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that which was driven away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">neither have ye sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that which was lost</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02394">but with force</w> <w lemma="strong:H06531">and with cruelty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have ye ruled</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they were scattered</w>, because <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">no shepherd</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0402">and they became meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">to all the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when they were scattered</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>because…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">without a shepherd</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06629">My sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wandered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">through all the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and upon every high</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">hill</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06629">yea, my flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon all the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and none did search</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">or seek</w> <transChange type="added">after them</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Therefore, ye shepherds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">surely because my flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">became a prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and my flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0402">became meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">to every beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, because <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">no shepherd</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">neither did my shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">search</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">for my flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but the shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">themselves, and fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">not my flock</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>because…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">without a shepherd</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Therefore, O ye shepherds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against the shepherds</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will require</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">my flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at their hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and cause them to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from feeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flock</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">neither shall the shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">themselves any more; for I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">my flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">from their mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0402">that they may not be meat</w> for them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; Behold, I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I, will both search</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">my sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01239" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and seek them out</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">As a shepherd</w> <w lemma="strong:H01243">seeketh out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">his flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">that he is among</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">his sheep</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06567" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">scattered</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01239" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">so will I seek out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">my sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">them out of all places</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">where they have been scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">in the cloudy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06205">and dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>As…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">According to the seeking</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will bring them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them from the countries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">them to their own land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">them upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0650">by the rivers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04186">and in all the inhabited places</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the country</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">them in a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H04829">pasture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04791">and upon the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">shall their fold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be: there shall they lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">in a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">fold</w>, and <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08082">a fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04829">pasture</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">my flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will cause them to lie down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that which was lost</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that which was driven away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will bind up</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and will strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that which was sick</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08082">the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">and the strong</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">them with judgment</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:17
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0859">you</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">O my flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">between cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">and cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">between the rams</w> <w lemma="strong:H06260">and the he goats</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cattle</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">small cattle of lambs and kids</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>he goats</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">great he goats</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Seemeth it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a small thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto you to have eaten up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H04829">pasture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but ye must tread down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">with your feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H04829">of your pastures</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and to have drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H04950">of the deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07515" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but ye must foul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">with your feet</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:19
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06629">my flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04823">that which ye have trodden</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">with your feet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04833">that which ye have fouled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">with your feet</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> unto them; Behold, I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I, will judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01274">between the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07330">and between the lean</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">cattle</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Because ye have thrust</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">with side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">and with shoulder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and pushed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">all the diseased</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">with your horns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">till ye have scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">them abroad</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Therefore will I save</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">my flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0957">and they shall no more be a prey</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">between cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">and cattle</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shepherd</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">over them, and he shall feed</w> them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them, and he shall be their shepherd</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">will be their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">a prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them; I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">with them a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and will cause the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03264 strong:H03293" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">in the woods</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">them and the places round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">my hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">a blessing</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01653">and I will cause the shower</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in his season</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01653">there shall be showers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">of blessing</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06086">And the tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">her fruit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H02981">her increase</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0983">and they shall be safe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in their land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I have broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04133">the bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">of their yoke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of those that served</w> themselves of them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0957">And they shall no more be a prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">to the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">neither shall the beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them; but they shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safely</w>, and none shall make <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">afraid</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04302">for them a plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of renown</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and they shall be no more consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">with hunger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">the shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w> any more.<note type="study"><catchWord>of renown</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for renown</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>consumed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">taken away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus shall they know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w> <transChange type="added">am</transChange> with them, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> they, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0859">And ye</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">my flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H04830">of my pasture</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 34." eID="gen890" osisID="Ezek.34"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Moreover the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">against mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and prophesy</w> against it,

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto it, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02022">Behold, O mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against thee, and I will stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against thee, and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04923">thee most</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>most…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">desolation and desolation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">thy cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08077">and thou shalt be desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05769">Because thou hast had a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H0342">hatred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05064" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and hast shed</w> <transChange type="added">the blood of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the force</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0343">of their calamity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">in the time</w> <transChange type="added">that their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w> <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07093">an end</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>perpetual…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hatred of old</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>shed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">poured out the children</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>force</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hands</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:6
verses.text: Therefore, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">thee unto blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">and blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0518">thee: sith</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast not hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">even blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pursue</w> thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus will I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from it him that passeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and him that returneth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>most…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">desolation and desolation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">his mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">with his slain</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H01389">in thy hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01516">and in thy valleys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0650">and in all thy rivers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">that are slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">thee perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and thy cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">shall not return</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Because thou hast said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">These two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and these two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">countries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be mine, and we will possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it; whereas the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> was there:<note type="study"><catchWord>whereas…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">though the <divineName>Lord</divineName> was there</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:11
verses.text: Therefore, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will even do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">according to thine anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07068">and according to thine envy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast used</w> <w lemma="strong:H08135">out of thy hatred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">against them; and I will make myself known</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">among them, when I have judged</w> thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">and that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05007">all thy blasphemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">against the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08077 strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">They are laid desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they are given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0402">us to consume</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to consume</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to devour</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">Thus with your mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye have boasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06280" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">against me, and have multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">your words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against me: I have heard</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>boasted</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">magnified</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">When the whole earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">rejoiceth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">thee desolate</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08057">As thou didst rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">at the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because it was desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so will I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">unto thee: thou shalt be desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">O mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0123">and all Idumea</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">all of it: and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 35." eID="gen891" osisID="Ezek.35"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Also, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">Ye mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Because the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01889">against you, Aha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">even the ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H04181">are ours in possession</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Therefore prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; Because they have made <transChange type="added">you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07602" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and swallowed you up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">on every side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04181">that ye might be a possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">unto the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and ye are taken up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">in the lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">of talkers</w>, and <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01681">an infamy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Because</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Because for because</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>are…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ye are made to come up on the lip of the tongue</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">Therefore, ye mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and to the hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0650">to the rivers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01516">and to the valleys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">wastes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and to the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that are forsaken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0957">which became a prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H03933">and derision</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">to the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>rivers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bottoms</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">dales</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0784">Surely in the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">of my jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have I spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">against the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0123">and against all Idumea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which have appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">my land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04181">into their possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with the joy</w> of all <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07589">with despiteful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">minds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04054">to cast it out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">for a prey</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">therefore concerning the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and to the hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0650">to the rivers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01516">and to the valleys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Behold, I have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">in my jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">and in my fury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because ye have borne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">the shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">Surely the heathen</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, they shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">their shame</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02022">But ye, O mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall shoot forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06057">your branches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">your fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for they are at hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:9
verses.text: For, behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for you, and I will turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">unto you, and ye shall be tilled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and sown</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon you, all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">all of it: and the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be inhabited</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02723">and the wastes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be builded</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">upon you man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bring fruit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will settle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06927">you after your old estates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will do better</w> <transChange type="added">unto you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07221">than at your beginnings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Yea, I will cause men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to walk</w> upon you, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thou shalt no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">henceforth bereave</w> them <transChange type="added">of men</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Because they say</w> unto you, Thou <transChange type="added">land</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">devourest up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and hast bereaved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">thy nations</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore thou shalt devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782 strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8762 strongMorph:TH8762">no more, neither bereave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">thy nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">any more, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bereave</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cause to fall</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:15
verses.text: Neither will I cause <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">in thee the shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">any more, neither shalt thou bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">the reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">any more, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Moreover the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">when the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in their own land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">it by their own way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">and by their doings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01870">their way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">was before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">me as the uncleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">of a removed woman</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore I poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">upon them for the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they had shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01544">and for their idols</w> <transChange type="added">wherewith</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they had polluted</w> it:

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">them among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they were dispersed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through the countries</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01870">according to their way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">and according to their doings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I judged</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">unto the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whither they went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they profaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they said</w> to them, These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and are gone forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of his land</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But I had pity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">for mine holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">which the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had profaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whither they went</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I do</w> not <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for your sakes, O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">but for mine holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">sake, which ye have profaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whither ye went</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">my great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">which was profaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which ye have profaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of them; and the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when I shall be sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in you before their eyes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">your</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04480">you from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you out of all countries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">you into your own land</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then will I sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon you, and ye shall be clean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02932">from all your filthiness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01544">and from all your idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I cleanse</w> you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02319">A new</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">you, and a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">you: and I will take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">the stony</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">out of your flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">you an heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of flesh</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you, and cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">in my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to your fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and ye shall be my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and I will be your God</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I will also save</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">you from all your uncleannesses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will call</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">for the corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">no famine</w> upon you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of the tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08570">and the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye shall receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">no more reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">of famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shall ye remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">your own evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04611">and your doings</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06962" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and shall lothe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">yourselves in your own sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for your iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">and for your abominations</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Not for your sakes do</w> I <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be it known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto you: be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">for your own ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that I shall have cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">you from all your iniquities</w> I will also cause <transChange type="added">you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02723">and the wastes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be builded</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And the desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be tilled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08077">whereas it lay desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all that passed by</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01977">This</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that was desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">is become like the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05731">of Eden</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02720">and the waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and ruined</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <transChange type="added">are become</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">fenced</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are inhabited</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">Then the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that are left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">build</w> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the ruined</w> <transChange type="added">places</transChange>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that that was desolate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; I will yet <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">this be enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of by the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for them; I will increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">them with men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">like a flock</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06944">As the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">as the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">in her solemn feasts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02720">so shall the waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">with flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>holy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">flock of holy things</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 36." eID="gen892" osisID="Ezek.36"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">The hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">was upon me, and carried me out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">in the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set me down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">of the valley</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">of bones</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And caused me to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">by them round about</w>: and, behold, <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the open</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">valley</w>; and, lo, <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03002">dry</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>valley</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">champaign</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">can these bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou knowest</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Again he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">unto me, Prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">upon these bones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03002">unto them, O ye dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">bones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">unto these bones</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07307">Behold, I will cause breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">into you, and ye shall live</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01517">sinews</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">upon you, and will bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07159" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon you, and cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">you with skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in you, and ye shall live</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">So I prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">as I was commanded</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">and as I prophesied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">there was a noise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07494">and behold a shaking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">and the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">bone</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">to his bone</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And when I beheld</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01517">lo, the sinews</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">and the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">upon them, and the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07159" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">them above</w>: but <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">no breath</w> in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">he unto me, Prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">unto the wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">prophesy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">to the wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">from the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">winds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">O breath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05301" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and breathe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">upon these slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may live</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wind</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">breath</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">So I prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">me, and the breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">into them, and they lived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">upon their feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966 strong:H03966">an exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">army</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">these bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">are the whole house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, they say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">Our bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are dried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08615">and our hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is lost</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01504" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">we are cut off</w> for our parts.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Therefore prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">Behold, O my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I will open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">your graves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and cause you to come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">out of your graves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">you into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I have opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">your graves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">O my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and brought you up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">out of your graves</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in you, and ye shall live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I shall place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">you in your own land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shall ye know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and performed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came again unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Moreover, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">thee one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">stick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and write</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">upon it, For Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02270">his companions</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">then take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">stick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and write</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">upon it, For Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">the stick</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, and <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02270">his companions</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">And join</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">them one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">into one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">stick</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">and they shall become one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Wilt thou not shew</w> us what thou <transChange type="added">meanest</transChange> by these?

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">the stick</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">and the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02270">his fellows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will put</w> them with him, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">with the stick</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">them one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">stick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and they shall be one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in mine hand</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06086">And the sticks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whereon thou writest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">shall be in thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before their eyes</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">And say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whither they be gone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and will gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">them on every side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">them into their own land</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:22
