verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">them one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">shall be king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">to them all: and they shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">no more two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02673" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">neither shall they be divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">into two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">kingdoms</w> any more at all:

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Neither shall they defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">themselves any more with their idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08251">nor with their detestable things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06588">nor with any of their transgressions</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but I will save</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">them out of all their dwellingplaces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein they have sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and will cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">them: so shall they be my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and I will be their God</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">over them; and they all shall have one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shepherd</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall also walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">wherein your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have dwelt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall dwell</w> therein, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">they, and their children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and their children’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05650">and my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05387">their prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Moreover I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">with them; it shall be an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with them: and I will place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, and multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">my sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of them for evermore</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04908">My tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and they shall be my people</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">And the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">do sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04720">when my sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">shall be in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of them for evermore</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 37." eID="gen893" osisID="Ezek.37"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H01463">against Gog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04031">of Magog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H04902">of Meshech</w> <w lemma="strong:H08422">and Tubal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and prophesy</w> against him,<note type="study"><catchWord>the chief…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prince of the chief</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01463">against thee, O Gog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H04902">of Meshech</w> <w lemma="strong:H08422">and Tubal</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">And I will turn thee back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02397">hooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03895">into thy jaws</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring thee forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">and all thine army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">and horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">all of them clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04358">with all sorts</w> <transChange type="added">of armour</transChange>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">company</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06793">bucklers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">and shields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all of them handling</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">swords</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06539">Persia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03568">Ethiopia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06316">and Libya</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">with them; all of them with shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H03553">and helmet</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Libya</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Phut</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01586">Gomer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0102">and all his bands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08425">of Togarmah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">quarters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0102">and all his bands</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> with thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Be thou prepared</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">for thyself, thou, and all thy company</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that are assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04929">unto thee, and be thou a guard</w> unto them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07227">After many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thou shalt be visited</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0319">in the latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8796">brought back</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">from the sword</w>, <transChange type="added">and is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">out of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">against the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08548">which have been always</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">waste</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">but it is brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">out of the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safely</w> all of them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou shalt ascend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07722">like a storm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">thou shalt be like a cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0102">thou, and all thy bands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> with thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; It shall also come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">at the same time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">shall things</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">into thy mind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt think</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">thought</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>think…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">conceive a mischievous purpose</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06519">of unwalled villages</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that are at rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all of them dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">without walls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01280">and having neither bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">nor gates</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>safely</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">confidently</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">a spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">a prey</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">upon the desolate places</w> <transChange type="added">that are now</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">inhabited</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and upon the people</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">out of the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which have gotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07075">and goods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02872">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>To take…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">To spoil the spoil, and to prey the prey</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>midst</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">navel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07614">Sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01719">and Dedan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the merchants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">of Tarshish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03715">with all the young lions</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto thee, Art thou come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">a spoil</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hast thou gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">thy company</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">a prey</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to carry away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07075">and goods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">spoil</w>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">Therefore, son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01463">unto Gog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">when my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou not know</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">from thy place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">out of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">parts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">thou, and many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with thee, all of them riding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">upon horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">company</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">army</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">against my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">as a cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0319">it shall be in the latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee against my land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">that the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">me, when I shall be sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H01463">in thee, O Gog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">before their eyes</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou he of whom I have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06931">in old</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in those days</w> <transChange type="added">many</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I would bring</w> thee against them?<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass at the same time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">when</w> <w lemma="strong:H01463">Gog</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">against the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02534">my fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in my face</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07068">For in my jealousy</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">of my wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have I spoken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">Surely in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">there shall be a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07494">shaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01709">So that the fishes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07431">and all creeping things</w> <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that creep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">upon the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">and all the men</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at my presence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be thrown down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04095">and the steep places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02346">and every wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>steep…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">towers</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">stairs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will call</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">for a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">against him throughout all my mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">shall be against his brother</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And I will plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">against him with pestilence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">and with blood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0102">upon him, and upon his bands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and upon the many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with him, an overflowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068 strong:H0417">and great hailstones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01614">and brimstone</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">Thus will I magnify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">myself, and sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">myself; and I will be known</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 38." eID="gen894" osisID="Ezek.38"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Therefore, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01463">against Gog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01463">against thee, O Gog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H04902">of Meshech</w> <w lemma="strong:H08422">and Tubal</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">And I will turn thee back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08338" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and leave but the sixth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">of thee, and will cause thee to come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">from the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">parts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">thee upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>leave…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">strike thee with six plagues</rdg>: or, <rdg type="alternate">draw thee back with an hook of six teeth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the north…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the sides of the north</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">thy bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">out of thy left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02671">and will cause thine arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">out of thy right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0102">thou, and all thy bands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee: I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05861">thee unto the ravenous</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">birds</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of every sort</w>, and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H0402">to be devoured</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sort</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wing</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to devour</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the open</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for I have spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the open…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the face of the field</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04031">on Magog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and among them that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">carelessly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">in the isles</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>carelessly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">confidently</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06944">So will I make my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">known</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>; and I will not <transChange type="added">let them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">pollute</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">any more: and the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, it is come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it is done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whereof I have spoken</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And they that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shall set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">on fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05400" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05402">the weapons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04043">both the shields</w> <w lemma="strong:H06793">and the bucklers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198">the bows</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">and the arrows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04731 strong:H03027">and the handstaves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07420">and the spears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and they shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">them with fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>handstaves</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">javelins</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>burn them…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">make a fire of them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So that they shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">no wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">out of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02404" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither cut down</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03293">out of the forests</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">for they shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05402">the weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">those that spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and rob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">those that robbed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01463">unto Gog</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">there of graves</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01516">the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the passengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06926">on the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02629" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and it shall stop</w> the <transChange type="added">noses</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the passengers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and there shall they bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H01463">Gog</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">and all his multitude</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall call</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01516">The valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01996">of Hamon–gog</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>noses</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mouths</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Hamon–gog</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The multitude of Gog</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">And seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">shall the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be burying</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of them, that they may cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Yea, all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall bury</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">and it shall be to them a renown</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that I shall be glorified</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they shall sever out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">of continual employment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passing through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">to bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with the passengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">those that remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">it: after the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">of seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they search</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>men…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">men of continuance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the passengers</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, when <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">bone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shall he set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06725">a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">it, till the buriers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">it in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01996">of Hamon–gog</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set up</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">build</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And also the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01997">Hamonah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thus shall they cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hamonah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The multitude</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">unto every feathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">fowl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and to every beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yourselves, and come</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">yourselves on every side</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">to my sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I do sacrifice</w> for you, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unto…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to the fowl of every wing</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>my sacrifice</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">my slaughter</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">of the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">of rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03733">of lambs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06260">and of goats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06499">of bullocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04806">all of them fatlings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>goats</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">great goats</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07654">till ye be full</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07943">till ye be drunken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">of my sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have sacrificed</w> for you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus ye shall be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">at my table</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">with horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">and chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">with mighty men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and with all men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">my glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">and all the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have executed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have laid</w> upon them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">So the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01973">and forward</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01471">And the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">that the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went into captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for their iniquity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they trespassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against me, therefore hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">I my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from them, and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">of their enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">they all by the sword</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02932">According to their uncleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">and according to their transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I done</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto them, and hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> from them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Now will I bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622 strong:H07622" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon the whole house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and will be jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">for my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">After that they have borne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">their shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04604">and all their trespasses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whereby they have trespassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against me, when they dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safely</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in their land</w>, and none made <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">afraid</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8788">When I have brought them again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them out of their enemies’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">lands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and am sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in them in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shall they know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">which caused them to be led into captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03664" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">but I have gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">them unto their own land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and have left</w> none of them any more there.<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by my causing of them</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Neither will I hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">any more from them: for I have poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 39." eID="gen895" osisID="Ezek.39"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568">In the five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01546">of our captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06218">in the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">in the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">that the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">was smitten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">in the selfsame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">was upon me, and brought</w> me thither.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04759">In the visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">he me into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">me upon a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01364">high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>, by which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04011">as the frame</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">on the south</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by which</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">upon which</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> me thither, and, behold, <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">whose appearance</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">like the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06616">with a line</w> <w lemma="strong:H06593">of flax</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04060">and a measuring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">with thine ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">upon all that I shall shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04616">thee; for to the intent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I might shew</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> unto thee <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">thou brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">hither: declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that thou seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02346">And behold a wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">on the outside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and in the man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">a measuring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">of six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <transChange type="added">long</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0520">by the cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02948">and an hand breadth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so he measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01146">of the building</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06967">and the height</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">he unto the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">which looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">the stairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, and measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">the threshold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>, <transChange type="added">which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">threshold</w> <transChange type="added">of the gate</transChange>, <transChange type="added">which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>which looketh…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">whose face was the way toward the east</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:7
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08372">little chamber</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08372">and between the little chambers</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05592">and the threshold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">the porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">within</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">also the porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">within</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">he the porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0352">and the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">thereof, two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0197">and the porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">inward</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08372">And the little chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921 strong:H01870">eastward</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06311">on this side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06311">on that side</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">they three</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">measure</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0352">and the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">had one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">measure</w> on this side and on that side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">of the entry</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">thirteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">The space</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">also before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08372">the little chambers</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubit</w> <transChange type="added">on this side</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the space</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0520">one cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08372">on that side: and the little chambers</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">on this side, and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> on that side.<note type="study"><catchWord>space</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">limit</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">bound</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:13

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:15

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:17

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:18

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the forefront</w> <w lemma="strong:H08481">of the lower</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto the forefront</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">of the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">eastward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">and northward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>without</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from without</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:20

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08372">And the little chambers</w> thereof <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">on this side and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">on that side; and the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0361">thereof and the arches</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">thereof were after the measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> thereof <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>arches</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">galleries</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">porches</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02474">And their windows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0361">and their arches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08561">and their palm trees</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04060">after the measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">that looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">the east</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">unto it by seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">steps</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0361">and the arches</w> thereof <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08179">And the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">of the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">over against the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06921">and toward the east</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">from gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">to gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">After that he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">me toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01864">the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and behold a gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01864">the south</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0361">thereof and the arches</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">thereof according to these measures</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:25
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02474">windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H0361">in it and in the arches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02474">like those windows</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:26
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">steps</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">to go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0361">to it, and the arches</w> thereof <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08561">them: and it had palm trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">on this side, and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">on that side, upon the posts</w> thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:27

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">me to the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w> <w lemma="strong:H01864">by the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H01864">the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">according to these measures</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08372">And the little chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">thereof, and the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0361">thereof, and the arches</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">thereof, according to these measures</w>: and <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02474">windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H0361">in it and in the arches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w>: <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0361">And the arches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>broad</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">breadth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0361">And the arches</w> thereof <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02435">toward the utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08561">and palm trees</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0352">upon the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04608">thereof: and the going up</w> to it <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">steps</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">me into the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">the east</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">according to these measures</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08372">And the little chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">thereof, and the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0361">thereof, and the arches</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04060">according to these measures</w>: and <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02474">windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H0361">therein and in the arches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w>: <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0361">And the arches</w> thereof <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02435">toward the outward</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08561">and palm trees</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0352">upon the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04608">thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up</w> to it <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">steps</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">me to the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and measured</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04060">according to these measures</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08372">The little chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">thereof, the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0361">thereof, and the arches</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">thereof, and the windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">to it round about</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0352">And the posts</w> thereof <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02435">toward the utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08561">and palm trees</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0352">upon the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04608">thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up</w> to it <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">steps</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03957">And the chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">and the entries</w> thereof <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0352">by the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01740" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">where they washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:39
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0197">And in the porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">on this side, and two tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">on that side, to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">thereon the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">and the sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">and the trespass offering</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03802">And at the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as one goeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">to the entry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">tables</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0312">and on the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">side</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0197">at the porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">tables</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as one…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">at the step</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0702">Four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">tables</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">on this side, and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">on that side, by the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">tables</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whereupon they slew</w> <transChange type="added">their sacrifices</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0702">And the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">tables</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01496">of hewn</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0520">of a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and an half</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0520">and a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and an half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01363">high</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">whereupon also they laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">the instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherewith they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">and the sacrifice</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:43

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:44
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02351">And without</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03957">the chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the singers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">in the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03802">at the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">and their prospect</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01864">the south</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">at the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">of the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <transChange type="added">having</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the prospect</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">the north</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02090">unto me, This</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">chamber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">whose prospect</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01864">the south</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">for the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the keepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">of the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>charge</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ward</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">ordinance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:46

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07341">And the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">of the door</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03802">and the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">of the door</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">on the one side, and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">on the other side: and he measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">thereof, forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>door</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">entrance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:4

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">After he measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> of <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06763">side chamber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">on every side</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:7
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">an enlarging</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and a winding about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">still upward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">to the side chambers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04141">for the winding about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">went still upward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07341">therefore the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <transChange type="added">was still</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and so increased</w> <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08481">the lowest</w> <transChange type="added">chamber</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05945">to the highest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08484">by the midst</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>there…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">it was made broader, and went round</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:10

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:11

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:12

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">So he measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01508">and the separate place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01140">and the building</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07023">with the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">thereof, an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05592">The door posts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0331" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and the narrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">windows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0862">and the galleries</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">on their three stories</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05048">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">the door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07824">cieled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">with wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and from the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">up to the windows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02474">and the windows</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">covered</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>cieled…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cieling of wood</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>and from…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and the ground unto the windows</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">So that the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08561">toward the palm tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on the one side, and the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">of a young lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H08561">toward the palm tree</w> on the other side: <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">through all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04201">The posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of the temple</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07251" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">squared</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04758">the appearance</w> <transChange type="added">of the one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">as the appearance</w> <transChange type="added">of the other</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>posts</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">post</rdg></note>

verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0331" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">narrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H08561">and palm trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">on the one side and on the other side, on the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">of the porch</w>, and <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06763">the side chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05646">and thick planks</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 41." eID="gen897" osisID="Ezek.41"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then he brought me forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02435">into the utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">the north</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">me into the chamber</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01508">over against the separate place</w>, and which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01146">before the building</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">Before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06828">the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06242">Over against the twenty</w> <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06442">for the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07531">and over against the pavement</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02435">for the utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0862">gallery</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H0862">gallery</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">in three</w> <transChange type="added">stories</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">And before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">the chambers</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04109">a walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">of ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">inward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">a way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06607">and their doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05945">Now the upper</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">chambers</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shorter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0862">for the galleries</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were higher</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">than these</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08481">than the lower</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08484">and than the middlemost</w> <w lemma="strong:H01146">of the building</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>were higher…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">did eat of these</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>than the lower…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and the building consisted of the lower and the middlemost</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:6
verses.text: For they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08027" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">in three</w> <transChange type="added">stories</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05982">but had not pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">as the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the courts</w>: therefore <transChange type="added">the building</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0680" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was straitened</w> <w lemma="strong:H08481">more than the lowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08484">and the middlemost</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the ground</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01447">And the wall</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H05980">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">the chambers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H02435">the utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on the forepart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">of the chambers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> thereof <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0753">For the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">of the chambers</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02435">in the utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06440">and, lo, before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">the temple</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03957">And from under these chambers</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935 strong:H03996" morph="strongMorph:TH8688 strongMorph:TH8675">the entry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">on the east side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as one goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">into them</w> <w lemma="strong:H02435">from the utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from under</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from the place</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the entry</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he that brought me</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>as…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">as he came</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:10
