verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03957">The chambers</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07341">in the thickness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01444">of the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01508">the separate place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01146">the building</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">And the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">like the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">of the chambers</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0753">as long as</w> they, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07341 strong:H03651">as broad as</w> <w lemma="strong:H04161">they: and all their goings out</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">both according to their fashions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06607">and according to their doors</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06607">And according to the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">of the chambers</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01864">the south</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">a door</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of the way</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01903">directly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01448">the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as one entereth</w> into them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">he unto me, The north</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">chambers</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01864">the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">chambers</w>, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01508">the separate place</w>, they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">chambers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">where the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">that approach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy things</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">there shall they lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and the meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0817">and the trespass offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04725">for the place</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">When the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein, then shall they not go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02435">into the utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but there they shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">their garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wherein they minister</w>; for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03847 strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">and shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">on other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall approach</w> to <transChange type="added">those things</transChange> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Now when he had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">of measuring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he brought me forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">whose prospect</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">it round about</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">with the measuring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0520 strong:H02568" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reeds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04060">with the measuring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>side</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wind</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reeds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04060">with the measuring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H01864">the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reeds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04060">with the measuring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He turned about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">to the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">side</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reeds</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">with the measuring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">it by the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">sides</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02346">it had a wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <transChange type="added">reeds</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to make a separation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">between the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H02455">and the profane place</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 42." eID="gen898" osisID="Ezek.42"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Afterward he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">me to the gate</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">the east</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03519">And, behold, the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">from the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">of the east</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06963">and his voice</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">like a noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shined</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">with his glory</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:3
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">according to the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">of the vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I saw</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">according to the vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04759">and the visions</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">like the vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H03529">Chebar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon my face</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when I came to prophesy that the city should be destroyed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03519">And the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">whose prospect</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">the east</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">So the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took me up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">me into the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03519">and, behold, the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I heard</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto me out of the house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by me</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">of my throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">and the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">of the soles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of my feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where I will dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">and my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">shall the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">no more defile</w>, <transChange type="added">neither</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">they, nor their kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02184">by their whoredom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06297">nor by the carcases</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of their kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">in their high places</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">In their setting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">of their threshold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">by my thresholds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04201">and their post</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H04201">my posts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07023">and the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">between me and them, they have even defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">by their abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they have committed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wherefore I have consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">them in mine anger</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for there was but a wall between me and them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-367">Now let them put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02184">their whoredom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06297">and the carcases</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of their kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-367">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from me, and I will dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of them for ever</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">Thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that they may be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">of their iniquities</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and let them measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H08508">the pattern</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pattern</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sum</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">number</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And if they be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of all that they have done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06699">them the form</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08498">and the fashion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04161">thereof, and the goings out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04126">thereof, and the comings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06699">in thereof, and all the forms</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">thereof, and all the ordinances</w> <w lemma="strong:H06699">thereof, and all the forms</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thereof, and all the laws</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thereof: and write</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in their sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06699">the whole form</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">thereof, and all the ordinances</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, and do</w> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:12
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07218">Upon the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the whole limit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>. Behold, this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04060">the measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">after the cubits</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0520">The cubit</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0520">a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02948">and an hand breadth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02436">even the bottom</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0520">a cubit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">a cubit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">thereof by the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H02239">span</w>: and this <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01354">the higher place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bottom</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bosom</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>edge</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lip</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02436">And from the bottom</w> <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the ground</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08481">to the lower</w> <w lemma="strong:H05835">settle</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06996">and from the lesser</w> <w lemma="strong:H05835">settle</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">to the greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H05835">settle</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubit</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02025 strong:H0741">So the altar</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0741">and from the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">horns</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the altar shall</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Harel</rdg>, that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">the mountain of God</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the altar and</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Ariel</rdg>, that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">the lion of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0741">And the altar</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07251" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">square</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">in the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07253">squares</w> thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05835">And the settle</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">fourteen</w> <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">and fourteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">in the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07253">squares</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">thereof; and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about</w> it <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02677">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">a cubit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02436">and the bottom</w> thereof <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0520">a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04609">and his stairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">toward the east</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">the ordinances</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when they shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">it, to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereon, and to sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> thereon.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">to the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">that be of the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">of Zadok</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07138">which approach</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto me, to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241 strong:H01121">a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">on the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">of it, and on the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H05835">of the settle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and upon the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thus shalt thou cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and purge</w> it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">also of the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04662">it in the appointed place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">the sanctuary</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08145">And on the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">a kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of the goats</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and they shall cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as they did cleanse</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06499">with the bullock</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">When thou hast made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of cleansing</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241 strong:H01121">a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">and a ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">out of the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">upon them, and they shall offer them up</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">Seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">every day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">a goat</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall also prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241 strong:H01121">a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">and a ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">out of the flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">Seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall they purge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and purify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">it; and they shall consecrate themselves</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>consecrate…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fill their hands</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And when these days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">are expired</w>, it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08066">upon the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01973">forward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">your burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08002">and your peace offerings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>peace…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thank offerings</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 43." eID="gen899" osisID="Ezek.43"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then he brought me back</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02435">of the outward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">toward the east</w>; and it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shut</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">unto me; This gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shall be shut</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall not be opened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in by it; because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">in by it, therefore it shall be shut</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05387">for the prince</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05387">the prince</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in it to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">of the porch</w> of <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> of the same.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">he me the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and, behold, the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon my face</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">mark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">with thine ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">all that I say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">unto thee concerning all the ordinances</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">and all the laws</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof; and mark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">well</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">the entering in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04161">with every going forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">of the sanctuary</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mark well</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set thine heart</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>mark well</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set thine heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H04805">to the rebellious</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">O ye house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">let it suffice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">you of all your abominations</w>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">In that ye have brought</w> <transChange type="added">into my sanctuary</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05236 strong:H01121">strangers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06189">uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06189">and uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">in flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04720">to be in my sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to pollute</w> it, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">my house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when ye offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">my bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">and the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they have broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">of all your abominations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strangers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">children of a stranger</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye have not kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of mine holy things</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but ye have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">of my charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">in my sanctuary</w> for yourselves.<note type="study"><catchWord>my charge</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">my ward</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">ordinance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05236 strong:H01121">No stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06189">uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06189">nor uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">in flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">into my sanctuary</w>, of any stranger that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">And the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that are gone away far</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">from me, when Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">went astray</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which went astray away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from me after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">their idols</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall even bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">their iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Yet they shall be ministers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">in my sanctuary</w>, <transChange type="added">having</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06486">charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and ministering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">and the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">them to minister</w> unto them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Because they ministered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto them before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">their idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and caused the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04383">to fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">into iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore have I lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">against them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">their iniquity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>caused…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were for a stumblingblock of iniquity unto</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they shall not come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto me, to do the office of a priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, nor to come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">to any of my holy things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the most holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">their shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08441">and their abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they have committed</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them keepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">of the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05656">for all the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thereof, and for all that shall be done</w> therein.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03548">But the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">of Zadok</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">of my sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">went astray</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from me, they shall come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to me to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, and they shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">me to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">unto me the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">and the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">into my sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">to my table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, and they shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">my charge</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in at the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">of the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall be clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06593">with linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06785">and no wool</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">upon them, whiles they minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">of the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and within</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06593">They shall have linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06287">bonnets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon their heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06593">and shall have linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04370">breeches</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">upon their loins</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall not gird</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03154">with any thing that causeth sweat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in sweating places</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">with sweat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And when they go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02435">into the utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02435">into the utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall put off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">their garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">wherein they ministered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">them in the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">chambers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">on other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they shall not sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">with their garments</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Neither shall they shave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">their heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06545">nor suffer their locks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to grow long</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03697" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they shall only</w> <w lemma="strong:H03697" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">poll</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">their heads</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Neither shall any priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">into the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither shall they take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">for their wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">a widow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">nor her that is put away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but they shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">maidens</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">or a widow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">that had a priest</w> before.<note type="study"><catchWord>put…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thrust forth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>that had…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from a priest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they shall teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <transChange type="added">the difference</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">between the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02455">and profane</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cause them to discern</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">between the unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">and the clean</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07379">And in controversy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in judgment</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">it according to my judgments</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">my laws</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">and my statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">in all mine assemblies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they shall hallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">my sabbaths</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">at no dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">person</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">themselves: but for father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">or for mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">or for son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">or for daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">for brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">or for sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">that hath had no husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">they may defile</w> themselves.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02893">he is cleansed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall reckon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">unto him seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">into the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06442">unto the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">his sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05159">And it shall be unto them for an inheritance</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">their inheritance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">them no possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0272">their possession</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">the meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0817">and the trespass offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02764">and every dedicated thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w> shall be theirs.<note type="study"><catchWord>dedicated</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">devoted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07225">And the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H01061">of all the firstfruits</w> of all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08641">and every oblation</w> of all, of every <transChange type="added">sort</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08641">of your oblations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">shall be the priest’s</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall also give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H06182">of your dough</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01293">that he may cause the blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thine house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>And the first</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">And the chief</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">The priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">of any thing that is dead of itself</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02966">or torn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">whether it be fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">or beast</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 44." eID="gen900" osisID="Ezek.44"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">Moreover, when ye shall divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">by lot the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">for inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">an oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">an holy portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">of five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">reeds</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>. This <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">in all the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">when ye cause the land to fall</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>an holy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">holiness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06944">Of this there shall be for the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <transChange type="added">in length</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">with five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <transChange type="added">in breadth</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07251" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">square</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">for the suburbs</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>suburbs</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">void places</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04060">And of this measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">of five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">of ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04720">and in it shall be the sanctuary</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06944">The holy</w> <transChange type="added">portion</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">shall be for the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">the ministers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">of the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07131">which shall come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H04725">and it shall be a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for their houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04720">and an holy place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">for the sanctuary</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568">And the five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">of length</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and the ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">of breadth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">shall also the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">the ministers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0272">have for themselves, for a possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">for twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">chambers</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye shall appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">the possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05980">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">the oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy</w> <transChange type="added">portion</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">it shall be for the whole house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And a <transChange type="added">portion shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05387">for the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">on the one side and on the other side of the oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy</w> <transChange type="added">portion</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0272">and of the possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">the oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy</w> <transChange type="added">portion</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">the possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">from the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06924">and from the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">eastward</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0753">and the length</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05980">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">of the portions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">from the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">border</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">unto the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">border</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">In the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">shall be his possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05387">and my princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall no more oppress</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>; and <transChange type="added">the rest of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">according to their tribes</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">Let it suffice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">you, O princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H07701">and spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and justice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01646">your exactions</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>exactions</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">expulsions</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06664">Ye shall have just</w> <w lemma="strong:H03976">balances</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06664">and a just</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">ephah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06664">and a just</w> <w lemma="strong:H01324">bath</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0374">The ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01324">and the bath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">shall be of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08506">measure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01324">that the bath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may contain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">the tenth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">of an homer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0374">and the ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06224">the tenth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">of an homer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04971">the measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">thereof shall be after the homer</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08255">And the shekel</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01626">gerahs</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235 strong:H02568">fifteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04488">shall be your maneh</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:13
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08641">the oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that ye shall offer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08345">the sixth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">of an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">of an homer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">of wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08341" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and ye shall give the sixth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">of an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">of an homer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02706">Concerning the ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01324">the bath</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>, <transChange type="added">ye shall offer</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04643">the tenth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H01324">of a bath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03734">out of the cor</w>, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02563">an homer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">of ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01324">baths</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06235">for ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01324">baths</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02563">an homer</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">out of the flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">out of two hundred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04945">out of the fat pastures</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04503">for a meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">and for a burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08002">and for peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make reconciliation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">for them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lamb</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">kid</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>peace…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thank offerings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">All the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">shall give this oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">for the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall be for</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>for</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">with</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And it shall be the prince’s part</w> <transChange type="added">to give</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and meat offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and drink offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02282">in the feasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">and in the new moons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07676">and in the sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">in all solemnities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and the meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">and the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08002">and the peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make reconciliation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>peace…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thank offerings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07223">In the first</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">in the first</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241 strong:H01121">a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">the sanctuary</w>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04201">upon the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and upon the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H05835">of the settle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04201">and upon the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">of the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And so thou shalt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">the seventh</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">for every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that erreth</w>, and for <transChange type="added">him that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06612">simple</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">so shall ye reconcile</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">In the first</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">in the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06453">ye shall have the passover</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02282">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">of seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be eaten</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And upon that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">shall the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for himself and for all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">a bullock</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">And seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">of the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08163">and a kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of the goats</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">daily</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">of an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">for a bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0374">and an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">for a ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01969">and an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">for an ephah</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">In the seventh</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">in the fifteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the like in the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">of the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">according to the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">according to the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and according to the meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and according to the oil</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 45." eID="gen901" osisID="Ezek.45"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08179">The gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">of the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">toward the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shall be shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">the six</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">working</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H07676">but on the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be opened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the new moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be opened</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">of the porch</w> of <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04201">by the post</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">his burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">and his peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and he shall worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H04670">at the threshold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he shall go forth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08179">but the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the evening</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Likewise the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">shall worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of this gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">in the sabbaths</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">and in the new moons</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05930">And the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">that the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">in the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">and a ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04503">And the meat offering</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0374">an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">for a ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and the meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">for the lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">as he shall be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H04991">to give</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01969">and an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">to an ephah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the gift of his hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the new moon</w> <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01241 strong:H01121">a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">and a ram</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08549">they shall be without blemish</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0374">an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">for a bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0374">and an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">for a ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03532">and for the lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">according as his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall attain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01969">unto, and an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">to an ephah</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And when the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall enter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">of the porch</w> of <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">But when the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">in the solemn feasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that entereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he that entereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whereby he came in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but shall go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05226">over against</w> it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of them, when they go in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go in</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when they go forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go forth</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02282">And in the feasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">and in the solemnities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">the meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">shall be an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">to a bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0374">and an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">to a ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03532">and to the lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">as he is able</w> <w lemma="strong:H04991">to give</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01969">and an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">to an ephah</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">Now when the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05071">a voluntary</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">or peace offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05071">voluntarily</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall then open</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">him the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">toward the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">his burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">and his peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">as he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he shall go forth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">his going forth</w> <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gate</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Thou shalt daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03532">a lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">it every</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">morning</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a son of his year</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>every…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">morning by morning</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">for it every morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08345">the sixth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">of an ephah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07992">and the third part</w> <w lemma="strong:H01969">of an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07450" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to temper with</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">the fine flour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">by a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shall they prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">the lamb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and the meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and the oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">every morning</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">a continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:16
