verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05387">If the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04979">a gift</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto any</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thereof shall be his sons’</w>; it <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0272">their possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">by inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if he give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04979">a gift</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of his inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">then it shall be his to the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01865">of liberty</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">after it shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">to the prince</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05159">but his inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">shall be his sons’</w> for them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">Moreover the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">by oppression</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to thrust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">them out of their possession</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">he shall give his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">out of his own possession</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">that my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">from his possession</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">After he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">me through the entry</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03802">at the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">into the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w>: and, behold, there <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">on the two sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> he unto me, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">where the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall boil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">the trespass offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">and the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where they shall bake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">the meat offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that they bear</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02435">not out into the utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then he brought me forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02435">into the utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and caused me to pass by</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H04740">corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04740">and, behold, in every</w> <w lemma="strong:H04740">corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691 strong:H02691">of the court</w> <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02691">a court</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in every…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a court in a corner of a court, and a court in a corner of a court</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0702">In the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H04740">corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w> <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02691">courts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07000" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">of forty</w> <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0702">these four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07106" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">corners</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">measure</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>joined</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">made with chimneys</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>corners were…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cornered</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:23
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02905">a row</w> <transChange type="added">of building</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">in them, round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">them four</w>, and <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04018">with boiling places</w> <w lemma="strong:H02918">under the rows</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> he unto me, These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the places</w> <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of them that boil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">where the ministers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall boil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 46." eID="gen902" osisID="Ezek.46"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Afterward he brought me again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04325">and, behold, waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">issued out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04670">from under the threshold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">eastward</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06440">for the forefront</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <transChange type="added">stood toward</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06921">the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">and the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">from under from the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">at the south</w> <transChange type="added">side</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then brought he me out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">northward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and led me about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without unto the utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">eastward</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06379" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and, behold, there ran out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">on the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">side</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And when the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06957">that had the line</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">eastward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he brought me through</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0657">to the ankles</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the waters were…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">waters of the ankles</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Again he measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought me through</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01290">to the knees</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Again he measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought me through</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04975">to the loins</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Afterward he measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w>; <transChange type="added">and it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05158">a river</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I could</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not pass over</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04325">for the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were risen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07813">to swim in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">a river</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that could not be passed over</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>waters to…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">waters of swimming</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou seen</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, and caused me to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">to the brink</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Now when I had returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08193">behold, at the bank</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w> on the one side and on the other.<note type="study"><catchWord>bank</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lip</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">he unto me, These waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">issue out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06930">toward the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H01552">country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">into the desert</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">into the sea</w>: <transChange type="added">which being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">into the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be healed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>desert</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">plain</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:9
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">every thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">that liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which moveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">whithersoever the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall live</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03966">and there shall be a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01710">multitude of fish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">because these waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thither: for they shall be healed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and every thing shall live</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">whither the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rivers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">two rivers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:10
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01728">the fishers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975 strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05872">upon it from En–gedi</w> <w lemma="strong:H05882">even unto En–eglaim</w>; they shall be a <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04894">to spread forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">nets</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01710">their fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">shall be according to their kinds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01710">as the fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01207">But the miry places</w> <w lemma="strong:H01360">thereof and the marishes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thereof shall not be healed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they shall be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">to salt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall not…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and that which shall not be healed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05158">And by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">upon the bank</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">all trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">for meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05929">whose leaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not fade</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">neither shall the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof be consumed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01069" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">it shall bring forth new fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">according to his months</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">because their waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they issued out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">of the sanctuary</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06529">and the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">thereof shall be for meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05929">and the leaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H08644">thereof for medicine</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall grow</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall come up</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>new</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">principal</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>for medicine</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for bruises and sores</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01454">This</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the border</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">whereby ye shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">according to the twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <transChange type="added">shall have two</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02256">portions</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">it, one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">as well as another</w>: <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">the which I lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">it unto your fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">and this land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">unto you for inheritance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lifted…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">swore</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:15
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">from the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02855">of Hethlon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as men go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06657">to Zedad</w>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02574">Hamath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01268">Berothah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05453">Sibraim</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">between the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02694">Hazar–hatticon</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">by the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02362">of Hauran</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hazar–hatticon</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the middle village</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">from the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H02703">shall be Hazar–enan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">and the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">northward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w>. And <transChange type="added">this is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06828">the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:18

verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And by the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06921">from the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">unto the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03485">Issachar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <transChange type="added">portion</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And by the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06921">from the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">unto the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02074">Zebulun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <transChange type="added">portion</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And by the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06921">from the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">unto the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01410">Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <transChange type="added">portion</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And by the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">at the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H08486">southward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H08559">shall be even from Tamar</w> <transChange type="added">unto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04809 strong:H04808" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of strife</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06946">Kadesh</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05158">to the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">toward the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strife…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Meribah–kadesh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:29
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which ye shall divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">by lot unto the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">for inheritance</w>, and these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04256">their portions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08444">the goings out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">measures</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08179">And the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">after the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">northward</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06921">And at the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gates</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05045">And at the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">measures</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gates</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03220">At the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">their three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gates</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:35
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">eighteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">measures</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> from <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange>, The <divineName>Lord</divineName> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03074">there</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The <divineName>Lord</divineName>…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Jehovah–shammah</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 48." eID="gen904" osisID="Ezek.48"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen856" osisID="Ezek" type="book"/>

verses.name: Daniel 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">In the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and besieged</w> it.

verses.name: Daniel 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">And the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07117">with part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">of the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which he carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08152">of Shinar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his god</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">into the treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his god</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 1:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0828">unto Ashpenaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the master</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">of his eunuchs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that he should bring</w> <transChange type="added">certain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04410">and of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06579">and of the princes</w>;

verses.name: Daniel 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03206">Children</w> in whom <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03971 strong:H03971" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">no blemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">but well</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">favoured</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and skilful</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">in all wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">in knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H04093">science</w>, and such as <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">ability</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in them to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">palace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and whom they might teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the learning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">and the tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">them a daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">provision</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06598">meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">and of the wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">which he drank</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">so nourishing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">them three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07117">that at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof they might stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the wine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the wine of his drink</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Now among these were of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01840">Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02608">Hananiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04332">Mishael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05838">and Azariah</w>:

verses.name: Daniel 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Unto whom the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">of the eunuchs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">names</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01840">unto Daniel</w> <transChange type="added">the name</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01095">of Belteshazzar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02608">and to Hananiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07714">of Shadrach</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04332">and to Mishael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04335">of Meshach</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05838">and to Azariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05664">of Abed–nego</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 1:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01840">But Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">purposed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01351" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">that he would not defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H06598" type="x-split-368">himself with the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06598" type="x-split-368">meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">nor with the wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">which he drank</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">therefore he requested</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">of the eunuchs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01351" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">that he might not defile</w> himself.

verses.name: Daniel 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Now God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01840">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">into favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">and tender love</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">of the eunuchs</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">of the eunuchs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01840">unto Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03373">I fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">who hath appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">your meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">and your drink</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for why should he see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">your faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H02196" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">worse liking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">than the children</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01524">of your sort</w>? then shall ye make <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02325" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">endanger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">my head</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>worse…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sadder</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>sort</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">term</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">continuance?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01840">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04453">to Melzar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">whom the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">of the eunuchs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01840">over Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02608">Hananiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04332">Mishael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05838">and Azariah</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Melzar</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the steward</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Prove</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">I beseech thee, ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let them give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02235">us pulse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">and water</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to drink</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pulse</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of pulse</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to eat…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that we may eat</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Daniel 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04758">Then let our countenances</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be looked upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">thee, and the countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06598" type="x-split-369">of the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06598" type="x-split-369">meat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and as thou seest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servants</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he consented</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">to them in this matter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and proved</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">them ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07117">And at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">of ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">their countenances</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">fairer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01277">and fatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">in flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">than all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06598" type="x-split-370">the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06598" type="x-split-370">meat</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04453">Thus Melzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06598">the portion of their meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">and the wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">that they should drink</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02235">them pulse</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 1:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0702">As for these four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04093">them knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and skill</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in all learning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">and wisdom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01840">and Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">in all visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">and dreams</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Daniel…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he made Daniel understand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07117">Now at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he should bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">them in, then the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">of the eunuchs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them in before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadnezzar</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 1:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">communed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">with them; and among them all was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01840">none like Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02608">Hananiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04332">Mishael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05838">and Azariah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">they before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And in all matters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0998">understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them, he found</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">them ten times</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H02748">than all the magicians</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0825">astrologers</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04438">in all his realm</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wisdom…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wisdom of understanding</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01840">And Daniel</w> continued <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">unto the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03566">Cyrus</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen906" osisID="Dan.1"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dreamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">dreams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">wherewith his spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06470" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">was troubled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08142">and his sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">brake</w> from him.

verses.name: Daniel 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to call</w> <w lemma="strong:H02748">the magicians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0825">and the astrologers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03784" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and the sorcerers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03778">and the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">for to shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">his dreams</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, I have dreamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">a dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06470" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">the dream</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Then spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">the Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0762">in Syriack</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02418" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">live</w> <w lemma="strong:H05957">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05649">thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">the dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02324" morph="strongMorph:TH8741">and we will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">the interpretation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>O king…</catchWord>: (Chaldee, to the end of chapter seven)</note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04430">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03779">to the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04406">The thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0230" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">is gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from me</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02006">if</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">ye will not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">unto me the dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06591">with the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8725">thereof, ye shall be cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01917">in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01005">and your houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8725">shall be made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05122">a dunghill</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cut…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">made pieces</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02006">But if</w> <w lemma="strong:H02324" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">ye shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">the dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06591">and the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06902" morph="strongMorph:TH8741">thereof, ye shall receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">me</w> <w lemma="strong:H04978">gifts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05023">and rewards</w> <w lemma="strong:H07690">and great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03367">honour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03861">therefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02324" morph="strongMorph:TH8680">shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">me the dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06591">and the interpretation</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>rewards</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">They answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08579">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">Let the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05649">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">the dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02324" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">and we will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">the interpretation</w> of it.

verses.name: Daniel 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04430">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0576">I</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03330">certainty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0608">that ye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02084" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">would gain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05732">the time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606 strong:H06903">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">ye see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0230" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">is gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>gain</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">buy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02006">But if</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">ye will not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">unto me the dream</w>, <transChange type="added">there is but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02298 strong:H01932">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01882">decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H02164" morph="strongMorph:TH8724">for you: for ye have prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03538">lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07844" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">and corrupt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">me, till</w> <w lemma="strong:H05732">the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8721">be changed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03861">therefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">me the dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and I shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01768">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H02324" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">ye can shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">me the interpretation</w> thereof.

verses.name: Daniel 2:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03779">The Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0383">There is</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03007">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03202" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">that can</w> <w lemma="strong:H02324" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">matter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01768 strong:H06903">therefore</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03809">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07229">lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07990">nor ruler</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07593" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">such</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">things</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">at any</w> <w lemma="strong:H02749">magician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0826">or astrologer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03779">or Chaldean</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:11
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03358">a rare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07593" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">requireth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0383">and there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">none</w> <w lemma="strong:H0321">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H02324" morph="strongMorph:TH8741">that can shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03861">except</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">the gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04070">whose dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H0383">is</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H05974">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H01321">flesh</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06903">For</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01149" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">was angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07690">and very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07108" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">furious</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H02445">the wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01882">And the decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05312" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02445">that the wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06992" morph="strongMorph:TH8726">should be slain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01156" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and they sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02269">and his fellows</w> <w lemma="strong:H06992" morph="strongMorph:TH8723">to be slain</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08421" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05843">with counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942">and wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0746">to Arioch</w> <w lemma="strong:H07229">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01768">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02877">guard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05312" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">which was gone forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06992" morph="strongMorph:TH8742">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02445">the wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>answered…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">returned</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>captain…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chief marshal</rdg>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">chief of the executioners</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">slaughtermen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">He answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0746">to Arioch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07990">captain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05922 strong:H04101">Why</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01882">the decree</w> <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02685" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">hasty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925 strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0746">Arioch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">made the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">known</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">to Daniel</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01841">Then Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05954" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">went in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01156" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and desired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05415" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">that he would give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02166">him time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02324" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">and that he would shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">the interpretation</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0236" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">to his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04406">and made the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">known</w> <w lemma="strong:H02608">to Hananiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04333">Mishael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05839">and Azariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02269">his companions</w>:

verses.name: Daniel 2:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01156" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">That they would desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07359">mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925 strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">concerning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H07328">secret</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01841">that Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02269">and his fellows</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">should not</w> <w lemma="strong:H07" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05974">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H07606">the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02445">of the wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of the God</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">from before God</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>that Daniel…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that they should not destroy Daniel</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H07328">was the secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H01541" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">revealed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">unto Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03916">in a night</w> <w lemma="strong:H02376">vision</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01289" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01289" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">Blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">be</w> <w lemma="strong:H08036">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05957">ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05957 strong:H05705">and ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02452">for wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01370">and might</w> <w lemma="strong:H01932">are</w> his:

verses.name: Daniel 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">And he changeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05732">the times</w> <w lemma="strong:H02166">and the seasons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05709" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">he removeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">and setteth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">kings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">he giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02452">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02445">unto the wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04486">and knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">to them that know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0999">understanding</w>:

verses.name: Daniel 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01541" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">He revealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05994">the deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05642" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">and secret things</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">he knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04101">what</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02816">in the darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05094">and the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H08271" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05974">with him</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0576">I</w> <w lemma="strong:H03029" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">thank</w> <w lemma="strong:H07624" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">thee, and praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">thee, O thou God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02">of my fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">who hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H02452">me wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01370">and might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and hast made known</w> <w lemma="strong:H03705">unto me now</w> <w lemma="strong:H01156" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">what we desired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of thee</w>: for thou hast <transChange type="added">now</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">made known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">unto us the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">matter</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01836 strong:H06903 strong:H03606">Therefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05954" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H0746">Arioch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04483" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">had ordained</w> <w lemma="strong:H07" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02445">the wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0236" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03652">thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H07" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">unto him; Destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0409">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H02445">the wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05954" morph="strongMorph:TH8680">bring me in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02324" morph="strongMorph:TH8741">and I will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">the interpretation</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0746">Arioch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05954" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0927" morph="strongMorph:TH8726">in haste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03652">thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">unto him, I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01547 strong:H01123">of the captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03061">Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">that will make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">the interpretation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I have…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">That I have found</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>captives…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">children of the captivity of Judah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04430">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">to Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08036">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01096">Belteshazzar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0383">Art</w> <w lemma="strong:H03546" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">thou able</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">unto me the dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">which I have seen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06591">and the interpretation</w> thereof?

verses.name: Daniel 2:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07328">The secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">which the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07593" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">hath demanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809 strong:H03202" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02445">the wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0826">the astrologers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02749">the magicians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01505" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">the soothsayers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02324" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">unto the king</w>;

verses.name: Daniel 2:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01297">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H0383">there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">in heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01541" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">that revealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07328">secrets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and maketh known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04101">what</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H0320">in the latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03118">days</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02493">Thy dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02376">and the visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07217">of thy head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04903">thy bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01836">are these</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>maketh…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">hath made known</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0607">As for thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07476">thy thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05559" morph="strongMorph:TH8760">came</w> <transChange type="added">into thy mind</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04903">thy bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04101">what</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">should come to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836 strong:H0311">hereafter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01541" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">and he that revealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07328">secrets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">maketh known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04101">to thee what</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall come to pass</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>came</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">came up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0576">But as for me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H07328">secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">is not</w> <w lemma="strong:H01541" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">revealed</w> to me for <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02452">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0383">that I have</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">more than</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H02417">living</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03861">but</w> for <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01701">sakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">shall make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and that thou mightest know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07476">the thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03825">of thy heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>but for…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">but for the intent that the interpretation may be made known to the king</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0607">Thou</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02370 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8751 strongMorph:TH8754">sawest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0431">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07690 strong:H02298">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06755">image</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01797">This</w> <w lemma="strong:H07229">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06755">image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02122">whose brightness</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03493">excellent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06903">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07299">thee; and the form</w> thereof <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01763" morph="strongMorph:TH8753">terrible</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sawest</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">wast seeing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06755">This image’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07217">head</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02869">of fine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02306">his breast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01872">and his arms</w> <w lemma="strong:H03702">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04577">his belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03410">and his thighs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05174">of brass</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>thighs</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sides</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08243">His legs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06523">of iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07271">his feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">part</w> <w lemma="strong:H06523">of iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">and part</w> <w lemma="strong:H02635">of clay</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01934 strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8754 strongMorph:TH8751">Thou sawest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">till</w> <w lemma="strong:H069">that a stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01505" morph="strongMorph:TH8728">was cut out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H03028">hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04223" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">which smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06755">the image</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07271">his feet</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06523">of iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H02635">and clay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01855" morph="strongMorph:TH8684" type="x-split-371">and brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01994">them</w> <w lemma="strong:H01855" morph="strongMorph:TH8684" type="x-split-371">to pieces</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>without…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">which was not in hands</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H06523">was the iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02635">the clay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05174">the brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03702">the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01722">and the gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01751 strong:H01855" morph="strongMorph:TH8754 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8754">broken to pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H02298">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and became</w> <w lemma="strong:H05784">like the chaff</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H07007">the summer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0147">threshingfloors</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07308">and the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05376" morph="strongMorph:TH8754" type="x-split-372">carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01994">them</w> <w lemma="strong:H05376" morph="strongMorph:TH8754" type="x-split-372">away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H0870">place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8728">was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H069">for them: and the stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H04223" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">that smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06755">the image</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">became</w> <w lemma="strong:H07229">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02906">mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04391" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">the whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">earth</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:36
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01836">This</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02493">the dream</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and we will tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">thereof before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0607">Thou</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04430">a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">of kings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0426">for the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">thee a kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02632">power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08632">and strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03367">and glory</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03606">And wheresoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01123">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01753" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">dwell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02423">the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01251">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H05776">and the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">hath he given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03028">into thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07981" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and hath made thee ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">over them all</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0607">Thou</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07217">this head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">of gold</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0870">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">thee shall arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0317">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">inferior</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">to thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0317">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H08523">third</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05174">of brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07981" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">which shall bear rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">over all</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">the earth</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07244">And the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H08624">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H06523">as iron</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06523">forasmuch as iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01855" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">breaketh in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H02827" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">and subdueth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06903">and as</w> <w lemma="strong:H06523">iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07490" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">that breaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H0459">these</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01855" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">shall it break in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H07490" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and bruise</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">And whereas thou sawest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07271">the feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0677">and toes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04481" type="x-split-373">part</w> <w lemma="strong:H06353">of potters’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02635">clay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04481">and part</w> <w lemma="strong:H06523">of iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04437">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H06386" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">divided</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04481" type="x-split-373">but</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">there shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">in it of</w> <w lemma="strong:H05326">the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H06523">of the iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06903 strong:H03606">forasmuch as</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">thou sawest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06523">the iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06151" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">mixed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02917">with miry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02635">clay</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:42
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0677">the toes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07271">of the feet</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04481">part</w> <w lemma="strong:H06523">of iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04481">and part</w> <w lemma="strong:H02635">of clay</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04437">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H07118 strong:H04481">partly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08624">strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07118 strong:H04481">and partly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08406" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">broken</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>broken</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">brittle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01768">And whereas</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">thou sawest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06523">iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06151" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">mixed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02917">with miry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02635">clay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06151 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8723 strongMorph:TH8748">they shall mingle themselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H02234">with the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">of men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">but they shall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H01693" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05974">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01888">even</w> <w lemma="strong:H06523">as iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">is not</w> <w lemma="strong:H06151" morph="strongMorph:TH8723">mixed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02635">with clay</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>one…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">this with this</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03118">And in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0581">of these</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">shall the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">a kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809 strong:H05957">which shall never</w> <w lemma="strong:H02255" morph="strongMorph:TH8721">be destroyed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04437">and the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">shall not</w> <w lemma="strong:H07662" morph="strongMorph:TH8721">be left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0321">to other</w> <w lemma="strong:H05972">people</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01855" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">it shall break in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H05487" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">and consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H0459">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">kingdoms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01932">and it</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05957">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the days</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">their days</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the kingdom</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">the kingdom thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06903 strong:H03606">Forasmuch as</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">thou sawest</w> <w lemma="strong:H069">that the stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01505" morph="strongMorph:TH8728">was cut out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02906">of the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H03028">hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01855" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and that it brake in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H06523">the iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05174">the brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02635">the clay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03702">the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01722">and the gold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07229">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">hath made known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04101">what</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall come to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836 strong:H0311">hereafter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02493">and the dream</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03330">certain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06591">and the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0540" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">thereof sure</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>without…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">which was not in hands</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>hereafter</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">after this</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:46
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05308" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0600">his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05457" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05260" morph="strongMorph:TH8742">that they should offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04504">an oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05208">and sweet odours</w> unto him.

verses.name: Daniel 2:47
