verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04430">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">unto Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04481">Of</w> <w lemma="strong:H07187">a truth</w> <transChange type="added">it is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01768">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">your God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0426">a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04756">and a Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">of kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01541" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">and a revealer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07328">of secrets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03202" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">seeing thou couldest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01541" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">reveal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H07328">secret</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07236" morph="strongMorph:TH8745" type="x-split-374">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07236" morph="strongMorph:TH8745" type="x-split-374">a great man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07690">him many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07260">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04978">gifts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07981" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and made him ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">the whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H04083">province</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07229">and chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H05460">of the governors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H02445">the wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01841">Then Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01156" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">requested</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04483" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">and he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07715">Shadrach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04336">Meshach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05665">and Abed–nego</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05922">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05673">the affairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04083">of the province</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01841">but Daniel</w> <transChange type="added">sat</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08651">in the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">of the king</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen907" osisID="Dan.2"/>

verses.name: Daniel 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06755">an image</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07314">whose height</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08361">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0521">cubits</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06613">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08353">thereof six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0521">cubits</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">he set it up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01236">in the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01757">of Dura</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04083">in the province</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05020">Then Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07972" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03673" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">to gather together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0324">the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05460">the governors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06347">and the captains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0148">the judges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01411">the treasurers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01884">the counsellors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08614">the sheriffs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">and all</w> <w lemma="strong:H07984">the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04083">of the provinces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02597">to the dedication</w> <w lemma="strong:H06755">of the image</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">which Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">had set up</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0324">the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05460">the governors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06347">and captains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0148">the judges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01411">the treasurers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01884">the counsellors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08614">the sheriffs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">and all</w> <w lemma="strong:H07984">the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04083">of the provinces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03673" morph="strongMorph:TH8723">were gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H02597">unto the dedication</w> <w lemma="strong:H06755">of the image</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">that Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">had set up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and they stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06903">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06755">the image</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">that Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">had set up</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03744">Then an herald</w> <w lemma="strong:H07123" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H02429">aloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">To you it is commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05972">O people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0524">nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03961">and languages</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>aloud</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">with might</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>it…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">they command</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">That</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05732">at what time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08086" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">ye hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07032">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07162">of the cornet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04953">flute</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07030 strong:H07030" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">harp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05443">sackbut</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06460">psaltery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05481">dulcimer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">and all</w> <w lemma="strong:H02178">kinds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02170">of musick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05308" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">ye fall down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05457" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06755">image</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">that Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">hath set up</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>dulcimer</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">singing</rdg>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">symphony</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04479">And whoso</w> <w lemma="strong:H05308" morph="strongMorph:TH8748" type="x-split-375">falleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H05308" morph="strongMorph:TH8748" type="x-split-375">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05457" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and worshippeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08160">shall the same hour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07412" morph="strongMorph:TH8729">be cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01459">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03345" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">of a burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05135">fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H0861">furnace</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01836 strong:H06903">Therefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02166">at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01768">when</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H05972">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08086" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07032">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07162">of the cornet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04953">flute</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07030 strong:H07030" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">harp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05443">sackbut</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06460">psaltery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">and all</w> <w lemma="strong:H02178">kinds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02170">of musick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H05972">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0524">the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03961">and the languages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05308" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">fell down</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05457" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06755">image</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">that Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">had set up</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 3:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03606 strong:H06903">Wherefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">at that</w> <w lemma="strong:H02166">time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03779">Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H07127" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">came near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0399 strong:H07170" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and accused</w> <w lemma="strong:H03062">the Jews</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">They spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02418" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">live</w> <w lemma="strong:H05957">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0607">Thou</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942">a decree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">that every</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08086" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">that shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07032">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07162">of the cornet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04953">flute</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07030 strong:H07030" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">harp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05443">sackbut</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06460">psaltery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05481 strong:H05481" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and dulcimer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">and all</w> <w lemma="strong:H02178">kinds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02170">of musick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05308" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall fall down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05457" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06755">image</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>dulcimer</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">singing</rdg>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">symphony</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04479">And whoso</w> <w lemma="strong:H05308" morph="strongMorph:TH8748" type="x-split-376">falleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H05308" morph="strongMorph:TH8748" type="x-split-376">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05457" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and worshippeth</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07412" morph="strongMorph:TH8729">he should be cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01459">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03345" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">of a burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05135">fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H0861">furnace</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0383">There are</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03062">Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H03487">whom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04483" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">thou hast set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05673">the affairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04083">of the province</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07715">Shadrach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04336">Meshach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05665">and Abed–nego</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0479">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">have</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942">regarded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">thee</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06399" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">they serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">thy gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">nor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05457" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06755">image</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">which thou hast set up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>have…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">have set no regard upon thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> in <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07266">rage</w> <w lemma="strong:H02528">and fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07715">Shadrach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04336">Meshach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05665">and Abed–nego</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0479">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> unto them, <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06656">true</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07715">O Shadrach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04336">Meshach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05665">and Abed–nego</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">do not</w> <w lemma="strong:H0383">ye</w> <w lemma="strong:H06399" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">my gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">nor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05457" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06755">image</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">which I have set</w> up?<note type="study"><catchWord>true</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of purpose</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03705">Now</w> <w lemma="strong:H02006">if</w> <w lemma="strong:H0383">ye be</w> <w lemma="strong:H06263">ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H05732">that at what time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08086" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">ye hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07032">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07162">of the cornet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04953">flute</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07030 strong:H07030" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">harp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05443">sackbut</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06460">psaltery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05481">and dulcimer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">and all</w> <w lemma="strong:H02178">kinds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02170">of musick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05308" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">ye fall down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05457" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H06755">the image</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">which I have made</w>; <transChange type="added">well</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H02006">but if</w> <w lemma="strong:H05457" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">ye worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07412" morph="strongMorph:TH8729">ye shall be cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08160">the same hour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01459">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03345" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">of a burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05135">fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H0861">furnace</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04479">and who</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0426">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07804" morph="strongMorph:TH8755">that shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">you out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03028">my hands</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>dulcimer</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">singing</rdg>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">symphony</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07715">Shadrach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04336">Meshach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05665">and Abed–nego</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05020">O Nebuchadnezzar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0586">we</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H02818" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">careful</w> <w lemma="strong:H08421" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">thee in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H06600">matter</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02006">If</w> it be <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0426">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0586">whom we</w> <w lemma="strong:H06399" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0383">is</w> <w lemma="strong:H03202" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">able</w> <w lemma="strong:H07804" morph="strongMorph:TH8756">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481" type="x-split-377">us from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03345" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">the burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05135">fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H0861">furnace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04481" type="x-split-377">and</w> <w lemma="strong:H07804" morph="strongMorph:TH8755">he will deliver</w> <transChange type="added">us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04481">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03028">thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02006">But if</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">be it</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">unto thee, O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0383">that we will</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H06399" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">thy gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">nor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05457" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06755">image</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">which thou hast set up</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 3:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">was Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04391" morph="strongMorph:TH8728">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02528">of fury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06755">and the form</w> <w lemma="strong:H0600">of his visage</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8724">was changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H07715">Shadrach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04336">Meshach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05665">and Abed–nego</w>: <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">he spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0228" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">that they should heat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0861">the furnace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02298">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07655">seven times</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H01768">than</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">it was wont</w> <w lemma="strong:H0228" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">to be heated</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>full</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">filled</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">And he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02429">the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H01401">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">men</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02429">in his army</w> <w lemma="strong:H03729" morph="strongMorph:TH8742">to bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07715">Shadrach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04336">Meshach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05665">and Abed–nego</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07412" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">to cast</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03345" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">into the burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05135">fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H0861">furnace</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>most…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">mighty of strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0479">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03729" morph="strongMorph:TH8760">were bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05622">in their coats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06361 strong:H06361" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">their hosen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03737">and their hats</w>, and their <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03831">garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07412" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">and were cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01459">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03345" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">of the burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05135">fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H0861">furnace</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>coats</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mantles</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>hats</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">turbans</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06903 strong:H03606">Therefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836 strong:H04481">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H02685" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">was urgent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0861">and the furnace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03493">exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H0228" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">hot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07631">the flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H05135">of the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06992" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0479">those</w> <w lemma="strong:H01994 strong:H01400">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05267" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">that took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07715">Shadrach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04336">Meshach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05665">and Abed–nego</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>commandment</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">word</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>flame</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spark</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0479">And these</w> <w lemma="strong:H08532">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07715">Shadrach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04336">Meshach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05665">and Abed–nego</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05308" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03729" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H01459">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03345" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">of the burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05135">fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H0861">furnace</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 3:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08429" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">was astonied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0927" morph="strongMorph:TH8726">in haste</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01907">unto his counsellors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">Did not</w> <w lemma="strong:H07412" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">we cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08532">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03729" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H01459">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05135">of the fire</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">They answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03330">True</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>counsellors</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">governors</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">He answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01888">Lo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0576">I</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0703">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08271" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">loose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01981" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">walking</w> <w lemma="strong:H01459">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05135">of the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0383">and they have</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H02257">hurt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07299">and the form</w> <w lemma="strong:H07244">of the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01821" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">is like</w> <w lemma="strong:H01247">the Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">there is no hurt in them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07127" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H08651">to the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03345" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">of the burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05135">fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H0861">furnace</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07715">Shadrach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04336">Meshach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05665">and Abed–nego</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05649">ye servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05943">of the most high</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05312" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">come forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">and come</w> <transChange type="added">hither</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H07715">Shadrach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04336">Meshach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05665">and Abed–nego</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05312" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01459">the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05135">of the fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mouth</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">door</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0324">And the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05460">governors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06347">and captains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">and the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01907">counsellors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03673" morph="strongMorph:TH8723">being gathered together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0479">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01655">upon whose bodies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05135">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">had no</w> <w lemma="strong:H07981" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">nor</w> <w lemma="strong:H08177">was an hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H07217">of their head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02761" morph="strongMorph:TH8724">singed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">neither</w> <w lemma="strong:H05622">were their coats</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">changed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">nor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07382">the smell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05135">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05709" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">had passed</w> on them.

verses.name: Daniel 3:28
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01289" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0426">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07715">of Shadrach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04336">Meshach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05665">and Abed–nego</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07972" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">who hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04398">his angel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07804" morph="strongMorph:TH8758">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05649">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07365" morph="strongMorph:TH8702">that trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">in him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">and have changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and yielded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01655">their bodies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">that they might not</w> <w lemma="strong:H06399" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">nor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05457" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03861">except</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">their own God</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 3:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04481">Therefore I</w> <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942">a decree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">That every</w> <w lemma="strong:H05972">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0524">nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03961">and language</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">which speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07955 strong:H07960" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">any thing amiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07715">of Shadrach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04336">Meshach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05665">and Abed–nego</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8725">shall be cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01917">in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01005">and their houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07739" morph="strongMorph:TH8721">shall be made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05122">a dunghill</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03606 strong:H06903">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H0383">there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H0321">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03202" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">that can</w> <w lemma="strong:H05338" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">after this</w> sort.<note type="study"><catchWord>I make…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">a decree is made by me</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>any…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">error</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cut…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">made pieces</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06744" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">promoted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07715">Shadrach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04336">Meshach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05665">and Abed–nego</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04083">in the province</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>promoted</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">made to prosper</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen908" osisID="Dan.3"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">unto all</w> <w lemma="strong:H05972">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0524">nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03961">and languages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01753" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">in all</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08001">Peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H07680" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">be multiplied</w> unto you.

verses.name: Daniel 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06925">I thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08232" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">it good</w> <w lemma="strong:H02324" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0852">the signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08540">and wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05943">that the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">hath wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05974">toward</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>I thought…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">It was seemly before me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04101">How</w> <w lemma="strong:H07260">great</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0852">his signs</w>! <w lemma="strong:H04101">and how</w> <w lemma="strong:H08624">mighty</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08540">his wonders</w>! <w lemma="strong:H04437">his kingdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05957">an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07985">and his dominion</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05974">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H01859">generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01859">to generation</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 4:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0576">I</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">was</w> <w lemma="strong:H07954" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">at rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">in mine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07487">and flourishing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01965">in my palace</w>:

verses.name: Daniel 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">a dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H01763" morph="strongMorph:TH8741">which made me afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02031">and the thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04903">my bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02376">and the visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07217">of my head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0927" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">troubled</w> me.

verses.name: Daniel 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04481" type="x-split-378">Therefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481" type="x-split-378">I</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942">a decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05954" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">in all</w> <w lemma="strong:H02445">the wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">me, that they might make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">unto me the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">of the dream</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H05954" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02749">in the magicians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0826">the astrologers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03779">the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01505" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and the soothsayers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0576">and I</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">the dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">them; but they did not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">unto me the interpretation</w> thereof.

verses.name: Daniel 4:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05705">But at</w> <w lemma="strong:H0318">the last</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08036">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01096">Belteshazzar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08036">according to the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of my god</w>, and in whom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07308">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06922">of the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">gods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06925">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">him I told</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">the dream</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>,

verses.name: Daniel 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01096">O Belteshazzar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07229">master</w> <w lemma="strong:H02749">of the magicians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0576">because I</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07308">that the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06922">of the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">gods</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03809 strong:H03606">in thee, and no</w> <w lemma="strong:H07328">secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H0598" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">troubleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">thee, tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02376">me the visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">of my dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">that I have seen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06591">and the interpretation</w> thereof.

verses.name: Daniel 4:10
verses.text: Thus <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02376">the visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07217">of mine head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04903">my bed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02370 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8751 strongMorph:TH8754">I saw</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0431">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0363">a tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H01459">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07314">and the height</w> thereof <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07690">great</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I saw</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">I was seeing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0363">The tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H07236" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">grew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08631" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and was strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07314">and the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H04291" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">thereof reached</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">unto heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02379">and the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05491">thereof to the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">of all</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">the earth</w>:

verses.name: Daniel 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06074">The leaves</w> thereof <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08209">fair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04">and the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07690">thereof much</w>, and in it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04203">meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">for all</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02423">the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01251">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H02927" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">had shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08460">under</w> <w lemma="strong:H06853">it, and the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01753" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06056">in the boughs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">thereof, and all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01321">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02110" morph="strongMorph:TH8729">was fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of it</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02370 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8751 strongMorph:TH8754">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02376">in the visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07217">of my head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04903">my bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0431">and, behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05894">a watcher</w> <w lemma="strong:H06922">and an holy one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05182" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">heaven</w>;

verses.name: Daniel 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07123" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">He cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H02429">aloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03652">thus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01414">Hew down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0363">the tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07113" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06056">his branches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05426" morph="strongMorph:TH8680">shake off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06074">his leaves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0921" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">and scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04">his fruit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02423">let the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05111" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">get away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H08479">under it</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06853">and the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H06056">his branches</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>aloud</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">with might</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01297">Nevertheless</w> <w lemma="strong:H07662" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06136">the stump</w> <w lemma="strong:H08330">of his roots</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0613">even with a band</w> <w lemma="strong:H06523">of iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05174">and brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01883">in the tender grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01251">of the field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06647" morph="strongMorph:TH8721">and let it be wet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02920">with the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>, and <transChange type="added">let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02508">his portion</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05974">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H02423">the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06211">in the grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">of the earth</w>:

verses.name: Daniel 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03825">Let his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8741">be changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">man’s</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02423">and let a beast’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03825">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8725">be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07655">unto him; and let seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05732">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H02499">pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">over</w> him.

verses.name: Daniel 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06600">This matter</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01510">by the decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05894">of the watchers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07595">and the demand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03983">by the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H06922">of the holy ones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05705">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H01701">the intent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02417">that the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05943">that the most High</w> <w lemma="strong:H07990">ruleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">in the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05415" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04479">it to whomsoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H06634" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">he will</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">and setteth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H08215">it the basest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">of men</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 4:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01836">This</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H0576">I</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">have seen</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0607">Now thou</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01096">O Belteshazzar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06903">thereof, forasmuch as</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H02445">the wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04437">of my kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">are not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03202" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">able</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">unto me the interpretation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0607">but thou</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03546" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">able</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07308">for the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06922">of the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">gods</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in thee.

verses.name: Daniel 4:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08036">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01096">Belteshazzar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08075" morph="strongMorph:TH8733">was astonied</w> <w lemma="strong:H02298">for one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08160">hour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07476">and his thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0927" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">him. The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01096">Belteshazzar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0409">let not</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">the dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06591">or the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0927" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">thereof, trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H01096">thee. Belteshazzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04756">My lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02493">the dream</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08131" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">to them that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">thee, and the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06146">thereof to thine enemies</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 4:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0363">The tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">that thou sawest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07236" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">which grew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08631" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and was strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07314">whose height</w> <w lemma="strong:H04291" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">reached</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">unto the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02379">and the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">thereof to all</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">the earth</w>;

verses.name: Daniel 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06074">Whose leaves</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08209">fair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04">and the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07690">thereof much</w>, and in it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04203">meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">for all</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08460">under</w> <w lemma="strong:H02423">which the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01251">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H01753" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">dwelt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06056">and upon whose branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H06853">the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07932" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">had their habitation</w>:

verses.name: Daniel 4:22
verses.text: It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0607">thou</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07236" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">that art grown</w> <w lemma="strong:H08631" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and become strong</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07238">for thy greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07236" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">is grown</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04291" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and reacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">unto heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07985">and thy dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05491">to the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 4:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04430">And whereas the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05894">a watcher</w> <w lemma="strong:H06922">and an holy one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05182" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">coming down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01414" type="x-split-379">Hew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0363">the tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H01414" type="x-split-379">down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02255" morph="strongMorph:TH8740">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01297">it; yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07662" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06136">the stump</w> <w lemma="strong:H08330">of the roots</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">thereof in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0613">even with a band</w> <w lemma="strong:H06523">of iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05174">and brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01883">in the tender grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01251">of the field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06647" morph="strongMorph:TH8721">and let it be wet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02920">with the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>, and <transChange type="added">let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02508">his portion</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05974">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H02423">the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01251">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05705">till</w> <w lemma="strong:H07655">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05732">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H02499">pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">over</w> him;

verses.name: Daniel 4:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01836">This</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06591">the interpretation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01932">and this</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01510">the decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05943">of the most High</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04291" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">which is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04756">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>:

verses.name: Daniel 4:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02957" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">That they shall drive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">thee from</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04070">and thy dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H05974">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H02423">the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01251">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02939" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and they shall make thee to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06211">grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H08450">as oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06647" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">and they shall wet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02920">thee with the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07655">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05732">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H02499">shall pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">thee, till</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">thou know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05943">that the most High</w> <w lemma="strong:H07990">ruleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">in the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05415" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04479">it to whomsoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H06634" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">he will</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 4:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">And whereas they commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07662" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">to leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06136">the stump</w> <w lemma="strong:H0363">of the tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H08330">roots</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04437">thy kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07011">shall be sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">unto thee, after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">that thou shalt have known</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">that the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H07990">do rule</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 4:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03861">Wherefore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04431">let my counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08232" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">be acceptable</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06562" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">and break off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02408">thy sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H06665">by righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05758">and thine iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02604" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">by shewing mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06033" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">to the poor</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02006">if</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">it may be</w> <w lemma="strong:H0754">a lengthening</w> <w lemma="strong:H07963">of thy tranquillity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a lengthening…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">an healing of thine error</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 4:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03606">All</w> <w lemma="strong:H04291" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">this came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 4:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07118">At the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06236 strong:H08648">of twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03393">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H01981 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8750 strongMorph:TH8754">he walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01965">the palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">of the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 4:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04430">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">Is not</w> <w lemma="strong:H01668 strong:H01932">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H07229">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0576">that I</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">of the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08632">by the might</w> <w lemma="strong:H02632">of my power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03367">and for the honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01923">of my majesty</w>?

verses.name: Daniel 4:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05751">While</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">the word</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04430">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06433">mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05308" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">there fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07032">a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">heaven</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">to thee it is spoken</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04437">The kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05709" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">is departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> thee.

verses.name: Daniel 4:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02957" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">And they shall drive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">thee from</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04070">and thy dwelling</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05974">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H02423">the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01251">of the field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02939" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">they shall make thee to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06211">grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H08450">as oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07655">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05732">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H02499">shall pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">thee, until</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">thou know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05943">that the most High</w> <w lemma="strong:H07990">ruleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">in the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05415" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04479">it to whomsoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H06634" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">he will</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 4:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08160">The same hour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">was the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05487" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">fulfilled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02957" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">and he was driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0399" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06211">grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H08450">as oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01655">and his body</w> <w lemma="strong:H06647" morph="strongMorph:TH8721">was wet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02920">with the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05705">till</w> <w lemma="strong:H08177">his hairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07236" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">were grown</w> <w lemma="strong:H05403">like eagles’</w> <transChange type="added">feathers</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02953">and his nails</w> <w lemma="strong:H06853">like birds’</w> <transChange type="added">claws</transChange>.

verses.name: Daniel 4:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07118">And at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03118">of the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0576">I</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05191" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05870">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">unto heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04486">and mine understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H08421" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01289" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">and I blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05943">the most High</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07624" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">and I praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01922" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">and honoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H02417">him that liveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05957">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07985">whose dominion</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05957">an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H07985">dominion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04437">and his kingdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05974">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H01859">generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01859">to generation</w>:

verses.name: Daniel 4:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03606">And all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01753" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">of the earth</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02804" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">reputed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">as nothing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">and he doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06634" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">according to his will</w> <w lemma="strong:H02429">in the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>, and <transChange type="added">among</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01753" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03809">and none</w> <w lemma="strong:H0383">can</w> <w lemma="strong:H04223" morph="strongMorph:TH8741">stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03028">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">or say</w> <w lemma="strong:H04101">unto him, What</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">doest</w> thou?

verses.name: Daniel 4:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02166">At the same time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04486">my reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H08421" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto me</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03367">and for the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">of my kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01923">mine honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02122">and brightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08421" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto me</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01907">and my counsellors</w> <w lemma="strong:H07261">and my lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H01156" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto me</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08627" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">and I was established</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">in my kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03493">and excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07238">majesty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03255" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">was added</w> unto me.

verses.name: Daniel 4:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03705">Now</w> <w lemma="strong:H0576">I</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07624" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07313" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">and extol</w> <w lemma="strong:H01922" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">and honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the King</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H04567">whose works</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07187">truth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0735">and his ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H01780">judgment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01981" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">and those that walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01467">in pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H03202" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">he is able</w> <w lemma="strong:H08214" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to abase</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen909" osisID="Dan.4"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01113">Belshazzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07229">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03900">feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0506">to a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07261">of his lords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08355" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and drank</w> <w lemma="strong:H02562">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06903">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0506">the thousand</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01113">Belshazzar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02942">whiles he tasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02562">the wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03702">and silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03984">vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02">which his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05312" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01965">the temple</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03390">in Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04430">that the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07261">and his princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07695">his wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03904">and his concubines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08355" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">might drink</w> therein.<note type="study"><catchWord>father</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">grandfather</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>taken</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">brought forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03984">vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05312" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">that were taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01965">the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03390">at Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04430">and the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07261">and his princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07695">his wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03904">and his concubines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08355" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">drank</w> in them.

verses.name: Daniel 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08355" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">They drank</w> <w lemma="strong:H02562">wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07624" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">and praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03702">and of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05174">of brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06523">of iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0636">of wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H069">and of stone</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 5:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08160">In the same hour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05312" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0677">fingers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">of a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03028">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03790" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">and wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06903">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H05043">the candlestick</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01528">the plaister</w> <w lemma="strong:H03797">of the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01965">palace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04430">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06447">the part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03028">of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03790" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">that wrote</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02122">countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">was changed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07476">and his thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0927" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07001">him, so that the joints</w> <w lemma="strong:H02783">of his loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H08271" morph="strongMorph:TH8723">were loosed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0755">and his knees</w> <w lemma="strong:H05368" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01668">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01668">against another</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>countenance</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">brightnesses</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>was changed</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">changed it</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>joints</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">girdles</rdg>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">bindings</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">knots</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04430">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07123" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H02429">aloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05954" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0826">in the astrologers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03779">the Chaldeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01505" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and the soothsayers</w>. <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02445">to the wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606 strong:H0606">Whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H07123" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">shall read</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H03792">writing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02324" morph="strongMorph:TH8741">and shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">me the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03848" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">thereof, shall be clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0711">with scarlet</w>, and <transChange type="added">have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02002">a chain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06676">his neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08523">and shall be the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H07981" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">in the kingdom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>aloud</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">with might</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>scarlet</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">purple</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H05954" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">in all</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02445">wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03546" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">but they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H07123" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">read</w> <w lemma="strong:H03792">the writing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">nor make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">the interpretation</w> thereof.

verses.name: Daniel 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">was king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01113">Belshazzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07690">greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0927" morph="strongMorph:TH8727">troubled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02122">and his countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">was changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">in him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07261">and his lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H07672" morph="strongMorph:TH8723">were astonied</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>countenance</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">brightnesses</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">Now</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04433">the queen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06903">by reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">of the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07261">and his lords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05954" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04961">into the banquet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04433">the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02418" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">live</w> <w lemma="strong:H05957">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0409">let not</w> <w lemma="strong:H07476">thy thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0927" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H02122">thee, nor let thy countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8721">be changed</w>:

verses.name: Daniel 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0383">There is</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">in thy kingdom</w>, in whom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07308">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06922">of the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">gods</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03118">and in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02">of thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05094">light</w> <w lemma="strong:H07924">and understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02452">and wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02452">like the wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of the gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8728">was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">in him; whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H02">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>, <transChange type="added">I say</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07229">master</w> <w lemma="strong:H02749">of the magicians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0826">astrologers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03779">Chaldeans</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01505" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">soothsayers</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>father</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">grandfather</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03606 strong:H06903">Forasmuch as</w> <w lemma="strong:H03493">an excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07308">spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04486">and knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07924">and understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06590" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">interpreting</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">of dreams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0263">and shewing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0280">of hard sentences</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08271" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">and dissolving</w> <w lemma="strong:H07001">of doubts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8728">were found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">in the same Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08036 strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">named</w> <w lemma="strong:H01096">Belteshazzar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03705">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">let Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07123" morph="strongMorph:TH8729">be called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02324" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">and he will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">the interpretation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>interpreting</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of an interpreter</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>dissolving</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of a dissolver</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>doubts</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">knots</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">was Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05954" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>. <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">unto Daniel</w>, <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0607">thou</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">that Daniel</w>, which <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01123">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01547">of the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03061">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03061">Jewry</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>father</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">grandfather</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08086" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">I have even heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07308">of thee, that the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of the gods</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05922">in thee</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05094">light</w> <w lemma="strong:H07924">and understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03493">and excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02452">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8728">is found</w> in thee.

verses.name: Daniel 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03705">And now</w> <w lemma="strong:H02445">the wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0826">the astrologers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05954" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">have been brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">in before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07123" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">me, that they should read</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H03792">writing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">and make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">unto me the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03546" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">thereof: but they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H02324" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">of the thing</w>:

verses.name: Daniel 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0576">And I</w> <w lemma="strong:H08086" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">of thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03202" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">that thou canst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06590" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">interpretations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08271" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">and dissolve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07001">doubts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03705">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H02006">if</w> <w lemma="strong:H03202" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">thou canst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07123" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">read</w> <w lemma="strong:H03792">the writing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">and make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">to me the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03848" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">thereof, thou shalt be clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0711">with scarlet</w>, and <transChange type="added">have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02002">a chain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06676">thy neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08531">and shalt be the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H07981" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">in the kingdom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>make interpretations</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">interpret</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04978">Let thy gifts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">be</w> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">to thyself, and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05023">thy rewards</w> <w lemma="strong:H0321">to another</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01297">yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07123" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">I will read</w> <w lemma="strong:H03792">the writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">and make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">to him the interpretation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rewards</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:18
