verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0607">O thou</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05943">the most high</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H02">thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">a kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07238">and majesty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03367">and glory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01923">and honour</w>:

verses.name: Daniel 5:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04481">And for</w> <w lemma="strong:H07238">the majesty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">that he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">him, all</w> <w lemma="strong:H05972">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0524">nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03961">and languages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02112 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">trembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01763" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">and feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">him</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06634 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8750 strongMorph:TH8754">whom he would</w> <w lemma="strong:H06992 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8751 strongMorph:TH8754">he slew</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06634 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8750 strongMorph:TH8754">and whom he would</w> <w lemma="strong:H02418 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8683 strongMorph:TH8754">he kept alive</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06634 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8750 strongMorph:TH8754">and whom he would</w> <w lemma="strong:H07313 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8683 strongMorph:TH8754">he set up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06634 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8750 strongMorph:TH8754">and whom he would</w> <w lemma="strong:H08214 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8683 strongMorph:TH8754">he put down</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 5:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03825">But when his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07313" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">was lifted up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07308">and his mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H08631" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H02103" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">in pride</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05182" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">he was deposed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">his kingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03764">throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05709" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03367">his glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from him</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>in pride</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to deal proudly</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>deposed</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">made to come down</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02957" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">And he was driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H01123">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">of men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03825">and his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07739" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">was made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05974">like</w> <w lemma="strong:H02423">the beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04070">and his dwelling</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06167">with the wild asses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02939" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">they fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06211">him with grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H08450">like oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01655">and his body</w> <w lemma="strong:H06647" morph="strongMorph:TH8721">was wet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02920">with the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05705">till</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">he knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05943">that the most high</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07990">ruled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">in the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">of men</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">he appointeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04479">it whomsoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H06634" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">he will</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his heart…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he made his heart equal</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0607">And thou</w> <w lemma="strong:H01247">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01113">O Belshazzar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">hast not</w> <w lemma="strong:H08214" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03825">thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06903">though</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">thou knewest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w>;

verses.name: Daniel 5:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07313" morph="strongMorph:TH8712">But hast lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">thyself against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04756">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and they have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03984">the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">of his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0607">thee, and thou</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07261">and thy lords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07695">thy wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03904">and thy concubines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08355" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">have drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02562">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07624" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">in them; and thou hast praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H03702">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01722">and gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05174">of brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06523">iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0636">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H069">and stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">which see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">nor</w> <w lemma="strong:H08086" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">nor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">know</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0426">and the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03028">in whose hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05396">thy breath</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, and whose <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H0735">thy ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">hast thou not</w> <w lemma="strong:H01922" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">glorified</w>:

verses.name: Daniel 5:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H06447">was the part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03028">of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07972" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">him</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01836">and this</w> <w lemma="strong:H03792">writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07560" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">was written</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 5:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01836">And this</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03792">the writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07560" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">that was written</w>, <inscription><w lemma="strong:H04484" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">MENE</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04484" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">MENE</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08625" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">TEKEL</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06537" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">UPHARSIN</w></inscription>.

verses.name: Daniel 5:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01836">This</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06591">the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">of the thing</w>: <inscription><w lemma="strong:H04484" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">MENE</w></inscription>; <w lemma="strong:H0426">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04483" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">hath numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">thy kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08000" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and finished</w> it.

verses.name: Daniel 5:27
verses.text: <inscription><w lemma="strong:H08625" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">TEKEL</w></inscription>; <w lemma="strong:H08625" morph="strongMorph:TH8760">Thou art weighed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03977">in the balances</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8728">and art found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02627">wanting</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 5:28
verses.text: <inscription><w lemma="strong:H06537" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">PERES</w></inscription>; <w lemma="strong:H04437">Thy kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06537" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">is divided</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8753">and given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04076">to the Medes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06540">and Persians</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 5:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01113">Belshazzar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03848" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and they clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0711">with scarlet</w>, and <transChange type="added">put</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02002">a chain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06676">his neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03745" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and made a proclamation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">concerning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">him, that he should be</w> <w lemma="strong:H08531">the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H07990">ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">in the kingdom</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 5:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03916">In that night</w> <w lemma="strong:H01113">was Belshazzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03779">of the Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H06992" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">slain</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 5:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01868">And Darius</w> <w lemma="strong:H04077">the Median</w> <w lemma="strong:H06902" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">the kingdom</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08361">about threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08648">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08140">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01247">old</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>being…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">he as the son of</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>about</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">now</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen910" osisID="Dan.5"/>

verses.name: Daniel 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08232 strong:H06925" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">It pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01868">Darius</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">to set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03969">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06243">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0324">princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">which should be</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">over the whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">kingdom</w>;

verses.name: Daniel 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05924">And over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H08532">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05632">presidents</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04481">of whom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02298">first</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0459">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H0324">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">might</w> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02941">accounts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">unto them, and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">should have</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H05142" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">damage</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">was</w> <w lemma="strong:H05330" morph="strongMorph:TH8723">preferred</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H05632">the presidents</w> <w lemma="strong:H0324">and princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06903 strong:H03606">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03493">an excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07308">spirit</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04430">in him; and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06246" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">him over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">the whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">realm</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H05632">the presidents</w> <w lemma="strong:H0324">and princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01156 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8750 strongMorph:TH8754">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to find</w> <w lemma="strong:H05931">occasion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">against Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06655">concerning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">the kingdom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03606">but</w> <w lemma="strong:H03202" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">find</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">none</w> <w lemma="strong:H05931">occasion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">nor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07844" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">fault</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06903">forasmuch</w> as he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0540" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">faithful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">neither</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">was there any</w> <w lemma="strong:H07960">error</w> <w lemma="strong:H07844" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">or fault</w> <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8728">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">in him</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0479">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">We shall not</w> <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">find</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H05931">occasion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03861">except</w> <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">we find</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01882">against him concerning the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of his God</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0459">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H05632">presidents</w> <w lemma="strong:H0324">and princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07284" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">assembled together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03652">thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">King</w> <w lemma="strong:H01868">Darius</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02418" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">live</w> <w lemma="strong:H05957">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>assembled…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">came tumultuously</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03606">All</w> <w lemma="strong:H05632">the presidents</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">of the kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05460">the governors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0324">and the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01907">the counsellors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06347">and the captains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03272" morph="strongMorph:TH8724">have consulted together</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8742">to establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">a royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H07010">statute</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08631" morph="strongMorph:TH8742">and to make a firm</w> <w lemma="strong:H0633">decree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01156" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">that whosoever shall ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H01159">a petition</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">or man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H08533">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03118">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03861">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07412" morph="strongMorph:TH8729">he shall be cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01358">into the den</w> <w lemma="strong:H0744">of lions</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>decree</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">interdict</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03705">Now</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0633">the decree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07560" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03792">the writing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">that it be not</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">changed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01882">according to the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04076">of the Medes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06540">and Persians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05709" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">which altereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>altereth not</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">passeth not</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06903 strong:H01836 strong:H03606">Wherefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01868">Darius</w> <w lemma="strong:H07560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">signed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03792">the writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0633">and the decree</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01841">Now when Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03792">that the writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07560" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">was signed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05954" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">into his house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03551">and his windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H06606" morph="strongMorph:TH8759">being open</w> <w lemma="strong:H05952">in his chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H05049">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03390">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01289" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">he kneeled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01291">his knees</w> <w lemma="strong:H08532">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02166">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H03118">a day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06739" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">and prayed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03029" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">and gave thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">his God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606 strong:H06903">as</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8751 strongMorph:TH8754">he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H06928 strong:H01836 strong:H04481">aforetime</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0479">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07284" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">assembled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01156" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">praying</w> <w lemma="strong:H02604" morph="strongMorph:TH8723">and making supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">his God</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H07127" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">they came near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">concerning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0633">decree</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03809">Hast thou not</w> <w lemma="strong:H07560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">signed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0633">a decree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">that every</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01156" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">that shall ask</w> <transChange type="added">a petition</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">or man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H08533">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03118">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03861">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07412" morph="strongMorph:TH8729">shall be cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01358">into the den</w> <w lemma="strong:H0744">of lions</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04430">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04406">The thing</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03330">true</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01882">according to the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04076">of the Medes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06540">and Persians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05709" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">which altereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">they and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01841">That Daniel</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01123">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01547">of the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03061">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02942 strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">regardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0633">nor the decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H07560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">that thou hast signed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01156" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">but maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01159">his petition</w> <w lemma="strong:H08532">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02166">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H03118">a day</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08086" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">when he heard</w> <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04406">words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07690">was sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0888" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">displeased</w> <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">with himself, and set</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01079">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">on</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07804" morph="strongMorph:TH8756">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07712 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8723 strongMorph:TH8754">him: and he laboured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">till</w> <w lemma="strong:H04606">the going down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08122">of the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H05338" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to deliver</w> him.

verses.name: Daniel 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0479">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07284" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">Know</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01882">that the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04076">of the Medes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06540">and Persians</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">That no</w> <w lemma="strong:H0633">decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H07010">nor statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">which the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">establisheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">may be changed</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07412" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and cast</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01358">into the den</w> <w lemma="strong:H0744">of lions</w>. <transChange type="added">Now</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">unto Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0426">Thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0607">whom thou</w> <w lemma="strong:H06399" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">servest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08411">continually</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07804" morph="strongMorph:TH8755">he will deliver</w> thee.

verses.name: Daniel 6:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02298">And a</w> <w lemma="strong:H069">stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">was brought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06433">the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01358">of the den</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04430">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02857" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">sealed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05824">it with his own signet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05824">and with the signet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07261">of his lords</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06640">that the purpose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">might not</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">be changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">concerning Daniel</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0236" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01965">to his palace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0956" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and passed the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H02908">fasting</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03809">neither</w> <w lemma="strong:H01761">were instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05954" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">of musick brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08139">him: and his sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05075" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">from him</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>instruments…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">table</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 6:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H08238">very early</w> <w lemma="strong:H05053">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0236" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0927" morph="strongMorph:TH8726">in haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H01358">unto the den</w> <w lemma="strong:H0744">of lions</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07127" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">And when he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01358">to the den</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02200" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">he cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06088" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">with a lamentable</w> <w lemma="strong:H07032">voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">unto Daniel</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">to Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01841">O Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05649">servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02417">of the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0426">is thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06399" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">whom thou servest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08411">continually</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03202" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">able</w> <w lemma="strong:H07804" morph="strongMorph:TH8756">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">thee from</w> <w lemma="strong:H0744">the lions</w>?

verses.name: Daniel 6:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H04449" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05974">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02418" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">live</w> <w lemma="strong:H05957">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0426">My God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07972" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04398">his angel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05463" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and hath shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H0744">the lions’</w> <w lemma="strong:H06433">mouths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">that they have not</w> <w lemma="strong:H02255" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">hurt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06903 strong:H03606">me: forasmuch as</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02136">him innocency</w> <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8728">was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0638">in me; and also</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">thee, O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">have I done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H02248">hurt</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">was the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07690">exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02868" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">for him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05267" morph="strongMorph:TH8682" type="x-split-380">that they should take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05267" morph="strongMorph:TH8682" type="x-split-380">up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01358">the den</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01841">So Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05267" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">was taken up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01358">the den</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">and no</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02257">of hurt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8728">was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0540" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">upon him, because he believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">in his God</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04430">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0479">those</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07170 strong:H0399" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">which had accused</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07412" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and they cast</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01358">into the den</w> <w lemma="strong:H0744">of lions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0581">them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01123">their children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05389">and their wives</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0744">and the lions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07981 strong:H05705" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">had the mastery</w> <w lemma="strong:H01855" morph="strongMorph:TH8684" type="x-split-381">of them, and brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01635">their bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01855" morph="strongMorph:TH8684" type="x-split-381">in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">or ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H04291" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0773">at the bottom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01358">of the den</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01868">Darius</w> <w lemma="strong:H03790" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">unto all</w> <w lemma="strong:H05972">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0524">nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03961">and languages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01753" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">in all</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08001">Peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H07680" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">be multiplied</w> unto you.

verses.name: Daniel 6:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06925 strong:H04481">I</w> <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942">a decree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">That in every</w> <w lemma="strong:H07985">dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">of my kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02112 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">men tremble</w> <w lemma="strong:H01763" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">and fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925 strong:H04481">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">of Daniel</w>: for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02417">the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07011">and stedfast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05957">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04437">and his kingdom</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03809">which shall not</w> <w lemma="strong:H02255" morph="strongMorph:TH8721">be destroyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07985">and his dominion</w> <transChange type="added">shall be even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05705">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H05491">the end</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 6:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07804" morph="strongMorph:TH8757">He delivereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05338" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">and rescueth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">and he worketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0852">signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08540">and wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">in heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">and in earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07804" morph="strongMorph:TH8758">who hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03028">the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H0744">of the lions</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>power</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 6:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01836">So this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06744" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">prospered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">in the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01868">of Darius</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04437">and in the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03567">of Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H06543">the Persian</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen911" osisID="Dan.6"/>

verses.name: Daniel 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02298">In the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08140">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01113">of Belshazzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">had</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">a dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H02376">and visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07217">of his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04903">his bed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0116">then</w> <w lemma="strong:H03790" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">he wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H02493">the dream</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07217">the sum</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">of the matters</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>had</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">saw</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>matters</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">words</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06032" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01934 strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8754 strongMorph:TH8751">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02376">in my vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H05974">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H03916">night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0718">and, behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0703">the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07308">winds</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01519" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">strove</w> <w lemma="strong:H07229">upon the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03221">sea</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0703">And four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07260">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02423">beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05559" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03221">the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">diverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01668">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H01668">another</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06933">The first</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0744">like a lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05403">and had eagle’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01611">wings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02370 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8751 strongMorph:TH8754">I beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">till</w> <w lemma="strong:H01611">the wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04804" morph="strongMorph:TH8760">thereof were plucked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05191" morph="strongMorph:TH8760">and it was lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">and made stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07271">the feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">as a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0606">and a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03825">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8753">was given</w> to it.<note type="study"><catchWord>and it</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wherewith it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0718">And behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0317">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H02423">beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08578">a second</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01821" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">like</w> <w lemma="strong:H01678">to a bear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and it raised up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02298">itself on one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07859">side</w>, and <transChange type="added">it had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08532">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05967">ribs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06433">in the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0997">of it between</w> <w lemma="strong:H08128">the teeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">of it: and they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03652">thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">unto it, Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0399" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07690">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H01321">flesh</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it raised…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">it raised up one dominion</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0870">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8751 strongMorph:TH8754">I beheld</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0718">and lo</w> <w lemma="strong:H0317">another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05245">like a leopard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05922">which had upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01355">the back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0703">of it four</w> <w lemma="strong:H01611">wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05776">of a fowl</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02423">the beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0703">had also four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07217">heads</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07985">and dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8753">was given</w> to it.

verses.name: Daniel 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0870">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8751 strongMorph:TH8754">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03916">in the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H02376">visions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0718">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07244">a fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02423">beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01763" morph="strongMorph:TH8753">dreadful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0574">and terrible</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08624">and strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03493">exceedingly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07260">and it had great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06523">iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H08128">teeth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0399" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">it devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H01855" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">and brake in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07512" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">and stamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H07606">the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07271">with the feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01932">of it: and it</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">diverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H02423">the beasts</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06236">it; and it had ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07162">horns</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07920 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8723 strongMorph:TH8754">I considered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07162">the horns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0431">and, behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05559" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">there came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0997">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0317">them another</w> <w lemma="strong:H02192">little</w> <w lemma="strong:H07162">horn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04481 strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08532">whom there were three</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H06933">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H07162">horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H06132" morph="strongMorph:TH8725">plucked up by the roots</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0431">and, behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01668">in this</w> <w lemma="strong:H07162">horn</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05870">eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05870">like the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06433">and a mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04449" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H07260">great things</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02370 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8751 strongMorph:TH8754">I beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">till</w> <w lemma="strong:H03764">the thrones</w> <w lemma="strong:H07412" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">were cast down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06268">and the Ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H03118">of days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03488" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">did sit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03831">whose garment</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02358">white</w> <w lemma="strong:H08517">as snow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08177">and the hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H07217">of his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05343">like the pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H06015">wool</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03764">his throne</w> <transChange type="added">was like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05135">the fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H07631">flame</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01535">his wheels</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01815" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05135">fire</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05135">A fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H05103">stream</w> <w lemma="strong:H05047" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">issued</w> <w lemma="strong:H05312" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0506">him: thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0506">thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08120" morph="strongMorph:TH8741">ministered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07240">unto him, and ten thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07240">times ten thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01780">him: the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03488" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">was set</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05609">and the books</w> <w lemma="strong:H06606" morph="strongMorph:TH8760">were opened</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02370 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8751 strongMorph:TH8754">I beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H0116">then</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07032">of the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07260">of the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07162">which the horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04449" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">spake</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02370 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8751 strongMorph:TH8754">I beheld</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05705">till</w> <w lemma="strong:H02423">the beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06992" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">was slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01655">and his body</w> <w lemma="strong:H07" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">destroyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8753">and given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03346">to the burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0785">flame</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07606">As concerning the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02423">of the beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07985">they had their dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05709" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">taken away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02417">yet their lives</w> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8753">were prolonged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H02166">a season</w> <w lemma="strong:H05732">and time</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their lives…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">a prolonging in life was given them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02370 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8751 strongMorph:TH8754">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03916">in the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H02376">visions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0718">and, behold</w>, <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01247">like the Son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05974">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H06050">the clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04291" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H06268">the Ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H03118">of days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07127" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and they brought him near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> him.

verses.name: Daniel 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8753">And there was given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07985">him dominion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03367">and glory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04437">and a kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">that all</w> <w lemma="strong:H05972">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0524">nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03961">and languages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06399" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">should serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07985">him: his dominion</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05957">an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H07985">dominion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">which shall not</w> <w lemma="strong:H05709" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">pass away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04437">and his kingdom</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03809">which shall not</w> <w lemma="strong:H02255" morph="strongMorph:TH8721">be destroyed</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0576">I</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03735" morph="strongMorph:TH8730">was grieved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07308">in my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01459">in the midst</w> of <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05085">body</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02376">and the visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07217">of my head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0927" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">troubled</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>body</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">sheath</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07127" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">I came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H02298">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">them that stood by</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01156" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">him</w> <w lemma="strong:H03330">the truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">of all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">So he told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">me, and made me know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06591">the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">of the things</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0459">These</w> <w lemma="strong:H07260">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02423">beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0581">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H0703">are four</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0703">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">kings</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">the earth</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06922">But the saints</w> <w lemma="strong:H05946">of the most High</w> <w lemma="strong:H06902" morph="strongMorph:TH8741">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">the kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02631" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">and possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05957">ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05705">even for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05957">ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05957">and ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>most…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">high ones</rdg>, that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">things</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">places</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H06634" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">I would</w> <w lemma="strong:H03321" morph="strongMorph:TH8742">know the truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H07244">the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02423">beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">which was</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">diverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H03493">the others, exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01763" morph="strongMorph:TH8753">dreadful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08128">whose teeth</w> <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06523">iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02953">and his nails</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05174">brass</w>; <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0399" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">devoured</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01855" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">brake in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07512" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">and stamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H07606">the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07271">with his feet</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">from all those</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05922">And of</w> <w lemma="strong:H06236">the ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07162">horns</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07217">in his head</w>, and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0317">the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H05559" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">which came up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06925 strong:H04481">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08532">whom three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05308" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">fell</w>; even <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07162">that horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01797">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H05870">had eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06433">and a mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04449" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">that spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07260">very great things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02376">whose look</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04481" type="x-split-382">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H07229">stout</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481" type="x-split-382">than</w> <w lemma="strong:H02273">his fellows</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02370 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8751 strongMorph:TH8754">I beheld</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01797">and the same</w> <w lemma="strong:H07162">horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07129">war</w> <w lemma="strong:H05974">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H06922">the saints</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03202" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and prevailed</w> against them;

verses.name: Daniel 7:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05705">Until</w> <w lemma="strong:H06268">the Ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H03118">of days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01768 strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01780">and judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8753">was given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06922">to the saints</w> <w lemma="strong:H05946">of the most High</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02166">and the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04291" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06922">that the saints</w> <w lemma="strong:H02631" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">the kingdom</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03652">Thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07244">The fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02423">beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H07244">the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">upon earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">which shall be diverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">kingdoms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0399" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">the whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01759" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and shall tread it down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01855" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">and break it in pieces</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06236">And the ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07162">horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">this kingdom</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06236">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">kings</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall arise</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0321">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0311">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">them; and he shall be diverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H06933">the first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08214" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">and he shall subdue</w> <w lemma="strong:H08532">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">kings</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04449" morph="strongMorph:TH8741">And he shall speak</w> <transChange type="added">great</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04406">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06655">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H05943">the most High</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01080" morph="strongMorph:TH8741">and shall wear out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06922">the saints</w> <w lemma="strong:H05946">of the most High</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05452" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and think</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to change</w> <w lemma="strong:H02166">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H01882">and laws</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8725">and they shall be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03028">into his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">until</w> <w lemma="strong:H05732">a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05732">and times</w> <w lemma="strong:H06387">and the dividing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05732">of time</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01780">But the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03488" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">shall sit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05709" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">and they shall take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07985">his dominion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08046" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H07" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">and to destroy</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05705">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H05491">the end</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 7:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04437">And the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07985">and dominion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07238">and the greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">of the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08460">under</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">the whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8753">shall be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05972">to the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06922">of the saints</w> <w lemma="strong:H05946">of the most High</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04437">whose kingdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05957">an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">and all</w> <w lemma="strong:H07985">dominions</w> <w lemma="strong:H06399" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08086" morph="strongMorph:TH8721">and obey</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>dominions</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">rulers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 7:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03542 strong:H05705">Hitherto</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05491">the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">of the matter</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0576">As for me</w> <w lemma="strong:H01841">Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07476">my cogitations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07690">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H0927" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02122">me, and my countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8721">changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">in me</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05202" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">but I kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04406">the matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03821">in my heart</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen912" osisID="Dan.7"/>

verses.name: Daniel 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">In the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01112">Belshazzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">a vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">appeared</w> unto me, <transChange type="added">even unto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01840">me Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that which appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H08462">unto me at the first</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">in a vision</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and it came to pass, when I saw</w>, that I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07800">at Shushan</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01002">the palace</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04082">in the province</w> <w lemma="strong:H05867">of Elam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">in a vision</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0180">and I was by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0195">of Ulai</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, there stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0180">the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">ram</w> which had <transChange type="added">two</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">horns</w>: and the <transChange type="added">two</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">horns</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01364">high</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">but one</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01364">higher</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">than the other</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01364">and the higher</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">last</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the other</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the second</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05055" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">pushing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">and northward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and southward</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02416">so that no beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">might stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him, neither <transChange type="added">was there any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that could deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of his hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">according to his will</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and became great</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And as I was considering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05795">behold, an he</w> <w lemma="strong:H06842">goat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04628">from the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the whole earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">not the ground</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06842">and the goat</w> <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02380">a notable</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">between his eyes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>touched…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">none touched him in the earth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a notable…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a horn of sight</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">to the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">that had</w> <transChange type="added">two</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">horns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I had seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">standing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0180">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">unto him in the fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">of his power</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">him come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">close unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8698">and he was moved with choler</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against him, and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">horns</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03581">and there was no power</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">in the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, but he cast him down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">upon him: and there was none that could deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of his hand</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06842">Therefore the he</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">goat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">waxed very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">great</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when he was strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was broken</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and for it came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H02380">notable ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">toward the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">winds</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And out of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of them came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04704">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">horn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">which waxed exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">toward the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04217">and toward the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06643">and toward the pleasant</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it waxed great</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06635">to the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and it cast down</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">and of the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stamped</w> upon them.<note type="study"><catchWord>to the host</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">against the host</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Yea, he magnified</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">even to the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08548">and by him the daily</w> <transChange type="added">sacrifice</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311 strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8717">was taken away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04349">and the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">of his sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">was cast down</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">against</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>by him</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And an host</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was given</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">against the daily</w> <transChange type="added">sacrifice</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06588">by reason of transgression</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and it cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">the truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it practised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and prospered</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an host…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the host was given over for the transgression against the daily sacrifice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 8:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">saint</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">speaking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">saint</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06422">unto that certain</w> <transChange type="added">saint</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which spake</w>, How long <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02377">the vision</w> <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">the daily</w> <transChange type="added">sacrifice</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06588">and the transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">both the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">and the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04823">to be trodden under foot</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the numberer of secrets</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">the wonderful numberer</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Palmoni</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">making desolate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">unto me, Unto two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242 strong:H06153">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06944">then shall the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be cleansed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>days</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">evening morning</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cleansed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">justified</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 8:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And it came to pass, when I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01840">I Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">the vision</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">for the meaning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">then, behold, there stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">before me as the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">of a man</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w> between <transChange type="added">the banks of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0195">Ulai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01403">Gabriel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01975">make this</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">the vision</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H05977">where I stood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when he came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I was afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon my face</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto me, Understand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">O son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">for at the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">of the end</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02377">the vision</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">Now as he was speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H07290" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">with me, I was in a deep sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">toward the ground</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05977">me upright</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made me stand upon my standing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 8:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will make thee know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">what shall be in the last end</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">of the indignation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04150">for at the time appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">the end</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0352">The ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou sawest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">having</w> <transChange type="added">two</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">horns</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04074">of Media</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">and Persia</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08163">And the rough</w> <w lemma="strong:H06842">goat</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03120">of Grecia</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01419">and the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">horn</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">between his eyes</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Now that being broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">whereas four</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">for it, four</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall stand up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">out of the nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03581">but not in his power</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0319">And in the latter time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of their kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when the transgressors</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">are come to the full</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05794">of fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">countenance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02420">dark sentences</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall stand up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>are…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">are accomplished</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 8:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03581">And his power</w> <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be mighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03581">but not by his own power</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">wonderfully</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall prosper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and practise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">and the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>holy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">people of the holy ones</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 8:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07922">And through his policy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">also he shall cause craft</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he shall magnify</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07962">and by peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall also stand up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">against the Prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of princes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">but he shall be broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>peace</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prosperity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 8:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04758">And the vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">of the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">and the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which was told</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">true</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05640" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">wherefore shut thou up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">the vision</w>; for it <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">for many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01840">And I Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">fainted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and was sick</w> <transChange type="added">certain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">afterward I rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">business</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">and I was astonished</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">at the vision</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">but none understood</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen913" osisID="Dan.8"/>

verses.name: Daniel 9:1
