verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">In the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01867">of Darius</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">of Ahasuerus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">of the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04074">of the Medes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">which was made king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">over the realm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldeans</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>which</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in which he</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">In the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of his reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01840">I Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">understood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">by books</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">whereof the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">came to Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that he would accomplish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">in the desolations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 9:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">unto the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">by prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08469">and supplications</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06685">with fasting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08242">and sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0665">and ashes</w>:

verses.name: Daniel 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">And I prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and made my confession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0577">O</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and dreadful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">and mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him, and to them that keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w>;

verses.name: Daniel 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have committed iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and have done wickedly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have rebelled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">even by departing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">from thy precepts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and from thy judgments</w>:

verses.name: Daniel 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Neither have we hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to our kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">our princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and to all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">righteousness</w> <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01322">unto thee, but unto us confusion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of faces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as at this day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and to the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and unto all Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w>, and <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">through all the countries</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whither thou hast driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">them, because of their trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they have trespassed</w> against thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>belongeth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thou hast</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, to us <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01322">confusion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">to our kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">to our princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and to our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because we have sinned</w> against thee.

verses.name: Daniel 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">To the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <transChange type="added">belong</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07356">mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05547">and forgivenesses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">though we have rebelled</w> against him;

verses.name: Daniel 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Neither have we obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in his laws</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">us by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Yea, all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">even by departing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they might not obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thy voice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0423">therefore the curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">upon us, and the oath</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because we have sinned</w> against him.

verses.name: Daniel 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he hath confirmed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against us, and against our judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">us, by bringing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">upon us a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08064">for under the whole heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath not been done</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">as hath been done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">upon Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 9:13
verses.text: As <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">all this evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon us: yet made we not our prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that we might turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">from our iniquities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">thy truth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">intreated we not the face of the</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Daniel 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08245" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">watched</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">upon the evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it upon us: for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">in all his works</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he doeth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for we obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not his voice</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">And now, O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-383">that hast brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-383">forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">with a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hast gotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thee renown</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as at this day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we have sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we have done wickedly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gotten…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made thee a name</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 9:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">according to all thy righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">I beseech thee, let thine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">and thy fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be turned away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from thy city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02399">because for our sins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">and for the iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and thy people</w> <transChange type="added">are become</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02781">a reproach</w> to all <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about</w> us.

verses.name: Daniel 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Now therefore, O our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">the prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08469">and his supplications</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and cause thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to shine</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">upon thy sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H08076">that is desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">for the Lord’s</w> sake.

verses.name: Daniel 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">open</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">our desolations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by thy name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">for we do not present</w> <w lemma="strong:H08469">our supplications</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">thee for our righteousnesses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">but for thy great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">mercies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">whereupon thy name is called</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cause to fall</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">forgive</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">defer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0408">not</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">for thine own sake, O my God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05892">for thy city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by thy name</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 9:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And whiles I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">speaking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and praying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and confessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">my sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">and the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and presenting</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">my supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">for the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of my God</w>;

verses.name: Daniel 9:21
verses.text: Yea, whiles I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">in prayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">even the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01403">Gabriel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom I had seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">in the vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H08462">at the beginning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03286" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">being caused to fly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03288">swiftly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">me about the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">of the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">oblation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>swiftly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with weariness</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">flight</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 9:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he informed</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with me, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01840">O Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am now come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to give thee skill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">and understanding</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to make thee skilful of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 9:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08462">At the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H08469">of thy supplications</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I am come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to shew</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange>; for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02532">greatly beloved</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">therefore understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the matter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">the vision</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>commandment</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">word</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>greatly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man of desires</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 9:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07657">Seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">weeks</w> <w lemma="strong:H02852" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are determined</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">upon thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">and upon thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to finish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">the transgression</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02856 strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8687">and to make an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of sins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to make reconciliation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to bring in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to seal up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">the vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">and prophecy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">Holy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>finish</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">restrain</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>make an…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">seal up</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>prophecy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">prophet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 9:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore and understand</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04161">from the going forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">unto the Messiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">the Prince</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">weeks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08346">and threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">weeks</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07339">the street</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be built</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02742">and the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06695">even in troublous</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">times</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be built…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">return and be built</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>wall</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">breach</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">ditch</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>troublous</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strait of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 9:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">weeks</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">shall Messiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be cut off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">but not for himself: and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">of the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">and the sanctuary</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07093">and the end</w> thereof <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07858">with a flood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07093">and unto the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of the war</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">desolations</w> <w lemma="strong:H02782" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">are determined</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>but…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and shall have nothing</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>desolations…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">it shall be cut off by desolations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 9:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall confirm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">with many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">for one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">week</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02677">and in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">of the week</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">he shall cause the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">and the oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to cease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03671">and for the overspreading</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">of abominations</w> he shall make <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03617">even until the consummation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02782" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and that determined</w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon the desolate</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the covenant</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a covenant</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>for the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">with the abominable armies</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the desolate</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the desolator</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen914" osisID="Dan.9"/>

verses.name: Daniel 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">In the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03566">of Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was revealed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01840">unto Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01095">Belteshazzar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01697">and the thing</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">true</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">but the time appointed</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">long</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he understood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0998">and had understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">of the vision</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>long</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">great</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01840">I Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">was mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">weeks</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>full…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">weeks of days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I ate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02532">no pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">nor wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05480" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither did I anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H05480" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">myself at all</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">till three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">weeks</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were fulfilled</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bread of desires</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0702">And in the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">as I was by the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">river</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02313">Hiddekel</w>;

verses.name: Daniel 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and behold a certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">in linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04975">whose loins</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03800">with fine gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0210">of Uphaz</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>a…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">one man</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 10:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01472">His body</w> also <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08658">like the beryl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">as the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">of lightning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03940">as lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02220">and his arms</w> <w lemma="strong:H04772">and his feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">like in colour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07044">to polished</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of his words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">like the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">of a multitude</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01840">And I Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">alone saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04759">the vision</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">for the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that were with me saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04759">not the vision</w>; <w lemma="strong:H061">but</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02731">quaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon them, so that they fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to hide</w> themselves.

verses.name: Daniel 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Therefore I was left alone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04759">vision</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and there remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">no strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H01935">in me: for my comeliness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04889">in me into corruption</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I retained</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">no strength</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>comeliness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">vigour</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yet heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">I the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of his words</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of his words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07290" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">then was I in a deep sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on my face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">toward the ground</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 10:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03027">And, behold, an hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, which set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">me upon my knees</w> and <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">the palms</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of my hands</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">moved</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01840">unto me, O Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02532">greatly beloved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto thee, and stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05977">upright</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">for unto thee am I now sent</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And when he had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, I stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07460" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">trembling</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>greatly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of desires</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>upright</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon thy standing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he unto me, Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01840">not, Daniel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07223">for from the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou didst set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to understand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">and to chasten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thyself before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were heard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I am come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">for thy words</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">But the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">withstood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">me one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04317">but, lo, Michael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to help</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">me; and I remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">there with</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chief</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">first</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Now I am come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to make thee understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what shall befall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">in the latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02377">for yet the vision</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for <transChange type="added">many</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 10:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And when he had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">such words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">toward the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0481" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and I became dumb</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 10:16
verses.text: And, behold, <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01823">like the similitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">my lips</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then I opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto him that stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">before me, O my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04759">by the vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H06735">my sorrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon me, and I have retained</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">no strength</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01963">For how</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of this my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">with this my lord</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06258">for as for me, straightway</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">no strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H05397">in me, neither is there breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">left</w> in me.<note type="study"><catchWord>the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">this servant of my lord</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then there came again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and touched</w> me <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">like the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he strengthened</w> me,

verses.name: Daniel 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">O man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02532">greatly beloved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">not: peace</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto thee, be strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yea, be strong</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And when he had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">unto me, I was strengthened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">Let my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">speak</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for thou hast strengthened</w> me.

verses.name: Daniel 10:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he, Knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou wherefore I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee? and now will I return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">with the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and when I am gone forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">lo, the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H03120">of Grecia</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 10:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H061">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07559" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thee that which is noted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03791">in the scripture</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">of truth</w>: and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">none</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">that holdeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04317">with me in these things, but Michael</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">your prince</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>holdeth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strengtheneth himself</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen915" osisID="Dan.10"/>

verses.name: Daniel 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">Also I in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01867">of Darius</w> <w lemma="strong:H04075">the Mede</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05977">I, stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to confirm</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">and to strengthen</w> him.

verses.name: Daniel 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And now will I shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">thee the truth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, there shall stand up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">yet three</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">in Persia</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07243">and the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">shall be far</w> <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">richer</w> than <transChange type="added">they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">all</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02393">and by his strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">through his riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall stir up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">all against the realm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03120">of Grecia</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01368">And a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall stand up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that shall rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04474">dominion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">according to his will</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And when he shall stand up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04438">his kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02673" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and shall be divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">toward the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">winds</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0319">and not to his posterity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04915">nor according to his dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he ruled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04438">for his kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be plucked up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0312">even for others</w> beside those.

verses.name: Daniel 11:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be strong</w>, and <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of his princes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall be strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">above him, and have dominion</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04475">his dominion</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04474">dominion</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07093">And in the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">they shall join themselves together</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04339">an agreement</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but she shall not retain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">of the arm</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall he stand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02220">nor his arm</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">but she shall be given up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and they that brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">her, and he that begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">her, and he that strengthened</w> her in <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">times</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>join…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">associate themselves</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rights</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>he that begat…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">whom she brought forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05342">But out of a branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">of her roots</w> shall <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stand up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03653">in his estate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">with an army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">into the fortress</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">against them, and shall prevail</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in his place</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">office</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And shall also carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05257">with their princes</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02532">with their precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and of gold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall continue</w> <transChange type="added">more</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">than the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their precious…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vessels of their desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> into <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04438">kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">into his own land</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">But his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01624" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall be stirred up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">forces</w>: and <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and overflow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and pass through</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then shall he return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01624" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and be stirred up</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04581">to his fortress</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall be…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shall war</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>return…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">be stirred up again</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8698">shall be moved with choler</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and fight</w> with him, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he shall set forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">multitude</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01995">but the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into his hand</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">when he hath taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">the multitude</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311 strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">shall be lifted up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he shall cast down</w> <transChange type="added">many</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07239">ten thousands</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05810" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he shall not be strengthened</w> <transChange type="added">by it</transChange>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">For the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall set forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">than the former</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and shall certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">army</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">and with much</w> <w lemma="strong:H07399">riches</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>after…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at the end of times, even years</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">And in those times</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">there shall many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stand up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06530 strong:H01121">also the robbers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall exalt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">themselves to establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">the vision</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">but they shall fall</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the robbers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the children of robbers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cast up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05550">a mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">the most fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02220">and the arms</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not withstand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04005">neither his chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, neither <transChange type="added">shall there be any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to withstand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the most…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the city of munitions</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the people of his choices</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But he that cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against him shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">according to his own will</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and none shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: and he shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06643">in the glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">which by his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">shall be consumed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>glorious…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">goodly</rdg>, etc.: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">land of ornament</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall also set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08633">with the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of his whole kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03477">and upright ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him; thus shall he do</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">him the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">corrupting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her: but she shall not stand</w> <transChange type="added">on his side</transChange>, neither be for him.<note type="study"><catchWord>upright…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">much uprightness</rdg>: or, <rdg type="alternate">equal conditions</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>corrupting</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to corrupt</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">After this shall he turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">unto the isles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07101">but a prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">for his own behalf shall cause the reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">offered by him to cease</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01115">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">his own reproach</w> he shall cause <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to turn</w> upon him.<note type="study"><catchWord>for…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for him</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the reproach…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his reproach</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then he shall turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">toward the fort</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of his own land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">but he shall stumble</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and not be found</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shall stand up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03653">in his estate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">a raiser</w> <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of taxes</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01925">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the kingdom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">but within few</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">he shall be destroyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">neither in anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">nor in battle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>estate</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">place</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">one that causeth an exacter to pass over</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>anger</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">angers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03653">And in his estate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall stand up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a vile person</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to whom they shall not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01935">the honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the kingdom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07962">in peaceably</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and obtain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02519">by flatteries</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>estate</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">place</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02220">And with the arms</w> <w lemma="strong:H07858">of a flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall they be overflown</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">him, and shall be broken</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05057">yea, also the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">And after the league</w> <transChange type="added">made</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him he shall work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">deceitfully</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he shall come up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall become strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">with a small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">people</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07962">peaceably</w> <w lemma="strong:H04924">even upon the fattest places</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">of the province</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall do</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">which his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have not done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">nor his fathers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0967" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0961">among them the prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07998">and spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07399">and riches</w>: <transChange type="added">yea</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he shall forecast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">his devices</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">against the strong holds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">even for a time</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>peaceably…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">into the peaceable and fat</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>forecast…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">think his thoughts</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he shall stir up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">his power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">and his courage</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">army</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H01624" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall be stirred up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">with a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">and mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">army</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he shall not stand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they shall forecast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">devices</w> against him.

verses.name: Daniel 11:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Yea, they that feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06598">of the portion of his meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">him, and his army</w> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall overflow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07227">and many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">down slain</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And both</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">these kings’</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">hearts</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451 strong:H04827" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to do mischief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">lies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">at one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">table</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but it shall not prosper</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07093">for yet the end</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04150">at the time appointed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hearts</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their hearts</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shall he return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into his land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07399">riches</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03824">and his heart</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">against the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall do</w> <transChange type="added">exploits</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to his own land</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04150">At the time appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">toward the south</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07223">but it shall not be as the former</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0314">or as the latter</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06716">For the ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H03794">of Chittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03512" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">against him: therefore he shall be grieved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02194" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">against the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so shall he do</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall even return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have intelligence</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them that forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02220">And arms</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">on his part, and they shall pollute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">of strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">the daily</w> <transChange type="added">sacrifice</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall place</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">the abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">that maketh desolate</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>maketh…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">astonisheth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And such as do wickedly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">against the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02610" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall he corrupt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02514">by flatteries</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">but the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that do know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall be strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <transChange type="added">exploits</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>corrupt</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cause to dissemble</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And they that understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall instruct</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">yet they shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03852">and by flame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07628">by captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0961">and by spoil</w>, <transChange type="added">many</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">Now when they shall fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall be holpen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">with a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05828">help</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07227">but many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02519">to them with flatteries</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:35
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of them of understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to try</w> <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">them, and to purge</w>, and to make <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03835" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">white</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">to the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">of the end</w>: because <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04150">yet for a time appointed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>try them</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">try by them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">according to his will</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">and he shall exalt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">himself, and magnify</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">himself above every god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">marvellous things</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">against the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">till the indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be accomplished</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02782" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">for that that is determined</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be done</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither shall he regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02532">nor the desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">any god</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">for he shall magnify</w> himself above all.

verses.name: Daniel 11:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03653">But in his estate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall he honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">of forces</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0433">and a god</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">whom his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">not shall he honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03368">and with precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02532">and pleasant things</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">as for the Almighty God, in his seat he shall honour yea, he shall honour a god, whom</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>estate</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stead</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>forces</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">munitions</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Mauzzim</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">God’s protectors</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">things desired</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus shall he do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">in the most strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">holds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">with a strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05234 strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8689 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">whom he shall acknowledge</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">with glory</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he shall cause them to rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">over many</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and shall divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04242">for gain</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>most…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fortresses of munitions</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>gain</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a price</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">And at the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">of the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">shall the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H05055" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">push</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">at him: and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H08175" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall come against him like a whirlwind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">with chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">and with horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and with many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">ships</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the countries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall overflow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and pass over</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06643">also into the glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and many</w> <transChange type="added">countries</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be overthrown</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">but these shall escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of his hand</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0123">Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04124">and Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07225">and the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>glorious…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">goodly</rdg>, etc.: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">land of delight</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">ornament</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall stretch forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">also upon the countries</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">shall not escape</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stretch…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">send forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But he shall have power</w> <w lemma="strong:H04362">over the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">and of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02532">and over all the precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">things of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03864">and the Libyans</w> <w lemma="strong:H03569">and the Ethiopians</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04703">at his steps</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08052">But tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">out of the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">and out of the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him: therefore he shall go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and utterly to make away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacles</w> <w lemma="strong:H0643">of his palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">between the seas</w> <w lemma="strong:H06643">in the glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet he shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">to his end</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and none shall help</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>glorious…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">goodly</rdg>, etc.: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mountain of delight of holiness</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen916" osisID="Dan.11"/>

verses.name: Daniel 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">And at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04317">shall Michael</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stand up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which standeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and there shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">such as never was since there was a nation</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">to that same time</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">and at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be delivered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">every one that shall be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">And many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03463">of them that sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">in the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">some to everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02781">and some to shame</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01860">contempt</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And they that be wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall shine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02096">as the brightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07549">of the firmament</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">and they that turn many</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">as the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">and ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wise</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">teachers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01840">But thou, O Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05640" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and seal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the book</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">to the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">of the end</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07751" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">shall run to and fro</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01847">and knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be increased</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 12:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01840">Then I Daniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, there stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02008">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of the bank</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">on that side of the bank</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of the river</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bank</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lip</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>bank</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lip</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 12:6
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">in linen</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of the river</w>, How long <transChange type="added">shall it be to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07093">the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06382">of these wonders</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>upon…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from above</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">in linen</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when he held up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">his right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">and his left hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">unto heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">by him that liveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> that <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04150">for a time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and an half</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and when he shall have accomplished</w> <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be finished</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a time…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">part</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I heard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but I understood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not: then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">I, O my Lord</w>, what <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0319">the end</w> of these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>?

verses.name: Daniel 12:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go thy way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01840">Daniel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">for the words</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05640" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">closed up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and sealed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">till the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">of the end</w>.
