verses.name: Daniel 12:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall be purified</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03835" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and made white</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and tried</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07563">but the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall do wickedly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">and none of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall understand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">but the wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall understand</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">And from the time</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">the daily</w> <transChange type="added">sacrifice</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">shall be taken away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08251">and the abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that maketh desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">set up</w>, <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08673">and ninety</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the abomination</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to set up the abomination</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>maketh…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">astonisheth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Daniel 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02442" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">he that waiteth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">to the thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Daniel 12:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">But go thou thy way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">till the end</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thou shalt rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">in thy lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of the days</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for thou</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and thou</rdg>, etc</note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen917" osisID="Dan.12"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen905" osisID="Dan" type="book"/>

verses.name: Hosea 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01954">that came unto Hosea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0882">of Beeri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">of Uzziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03147">Jotham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03169">Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08462">The beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01954">by Hosea</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01954">to Hosea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto thee a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H02183">of whoredoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">and children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02183">of whoredoms</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">for the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">hath committed great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whoredom</w>, <transChange type="added">departing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Hosea 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01586">Gomer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01691">of Diblaim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">him a son</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">Jezreel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04592">for yet a little</w> <transChange type="added">while</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will avenge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">of Jezreel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">of Jehu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will cause to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H04468">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>avenge</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass at that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I will break</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">the bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">of Jezreel</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 1:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she conceived again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">a daughter</w>. And <transChange type="added">God</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">her name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03819" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">Lo–ruhamah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for I will no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but I will utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take them away</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Lo–ruhamah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Not having obtained mercy</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>no…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">not add any more to</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>but…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that I should altogether pardon them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">But I will have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and will not save</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">them by bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">nor by sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">nor by battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">by horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">nor by horsemen</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 1:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now when she had weaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03819" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">Lo–ruhamah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <transChange type="added">God</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03818">Lo–ammi</w>: for ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">not my people</w>, and I will not be your <transChange type="added">God</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Lo–ammi</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Not my people</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 1:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04557">Yet the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02344">shall be as the sand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which cannot be measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor numbered</w>; and it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">where it was said</w> unto them, Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">not my people</w>, <transChange type="added">there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be said</w> unto them, <transChange type="added">Ye are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">instead of that</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Then shall the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">themselves one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01419">for great</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">of Jezreel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen919" osisID="Hos.1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">ye unto your brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">Ammi</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0269">and to your sisters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">Ru–hamah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ammi</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">My people</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Ru–hamah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Having obtained mercy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">with your mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">plead</w>: for she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">not my wife</w>, neither <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">I her husband</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">let her therefore put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02183">her whoredoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">out of her sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05005">and her adulteries</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">from between her breasts</w>;

verses.name: Hosea 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Lest I strip</w> <w lemma="strong:H06174">her naked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">her as in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that she was born</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">her as a wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06723">her like a dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06772">her with thirst</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I will not have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon her children</w>; for they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02183">of whoredoms</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0517">For their mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath played the harlot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">she that conceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them hath done shamefully</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">my lovers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that give</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">my bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">and my water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06785">my wool</w> <w lemma="strong:H06593">and my flax</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">mine oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08250">and my drink</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>drink</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">drinks</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 2:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07753" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Therefore, behold, I will hedge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">up thy way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05518">with thorns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01443" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01447">a wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that she shall not find</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">her paths</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>make…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wall a wall</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And she shall follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">after her lovers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but she shall not overtake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them; and she shall seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, but shall not find</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shall she say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">to my first</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">husband</w>; for then <transChange type="added">was it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H06258">with me than now</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For she did not know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">her corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">and wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">and oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">her silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">for Baal</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wine</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">new wine</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wherewith they made Baal</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore will I return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">my corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">thereof, and my wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">in the season</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof, and will recover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06785">my wool</w> <w lemma="strong:H06593">and my flax</w> <transChange type="added">given</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">her nakedness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>recover</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">take away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And now will I discover</w> <w lemma="strong:H05040">her lewdness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of her lovers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and none</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">her out of mine hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lewdness</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">folly</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">villany</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04885">I will also cause all her mirth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to cease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02282">her feast days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">her new moons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07676">and her sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">and all her solemn feasts</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">her vines</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">and her fig trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whereof she hath said</w>, These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0866">my rewards</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that my lovers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me: and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">them a forest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall eat</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">make desolate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">upon her the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baalim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">wherein she burned incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H05710" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to them, and she decked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05141">herself with her earrings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02484">and her jewels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">her lovers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and forgat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Hosea 2:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Therefore, behold, I will allure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">her, and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">her into the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">comfortably</w> unto her.<note type="study"><catchWord>comfortably</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">friendly</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to her heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">her her vineyards</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">from thence, and the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H05911">of Achor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">for a door</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">of hope</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and she shall sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">there, as in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of her youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and as in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when she came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall be at that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt call</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">me Ishi</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shalt call</w> <w lemma="strong:H01180">me no more Baali</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ishi</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">My husband</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Baali</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">My lord</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">For I will take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baalim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of her mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they shall no more be remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by their name</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 2:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">for them with the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and with the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07431">the creeping things</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the ground</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will break</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">the bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">and the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">and the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will make them to lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safely</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0781" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will betroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">thee unto me for ever</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0781" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">yea, I will betroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">thee unto me in righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and in judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02617">and in lovingkindness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07356">and in mercies</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0781" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I will even betroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">thee unto me in faithfulness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Hosea 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>;

verses.name: Hosea 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">the corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">and the wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">and the oil</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">Jezreel</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">her unto me in the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and I will have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03818 strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8677 strongMorph:TH8795">upon her that had not obtained mercy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will say</w> to <transChange type="added">them which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">not my people</w>, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall say</w>, <transChange type="added">Thou art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen920" osisID="Hos.2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yet, love</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">beloved</w> of <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">friend</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">yet an adulteress</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0160">according to the love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">toward the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who look</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">to other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and love</w> <w lemma="strong:H0809">flagons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06025">of wine</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of wine</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of grapes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03739" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So I bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568 strong:H06240">her to me for fifteen</w> <transChange type="added">pieces</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, and <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02563">an homer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03963">and an half homer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>half…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lethech</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, Thou shalt abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">for me many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not play the harlot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt not be</w> for <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>: so <transChange type="added">will</transChange> I also <transChange type="added">be</transChange> for thee.

verses.name: Hosea 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">For the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">without a king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and without a prince</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">and without a sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04676">and without an image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0646">and without an ephod</w>, and <transChange type="added">without</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08655">teraphim</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>image</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a standing</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">statue</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">pillar</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">Afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">shall the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">their king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">and his goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">in the latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen921" osisID="Hos.3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">ye children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">hath a controversy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, because <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">no truth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02617">nor mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01847">nor knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0422" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">By swearing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and lying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and killing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and stealing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and committing adultery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they break out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">and blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Therefore shall the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">mourn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and every one that dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">therein shall languish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">with the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and with the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01709">yea, the fishes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">also shall be taken away</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Yet let no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">strive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">nor reprove</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">another</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">for thy people</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">as they that strive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">with the priest</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore shalt thou fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">with thee in the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">thy mother</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cut off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 4:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">My people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">for lack of knowledge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because thou hast rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will also reject</w> <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thee, that thou shalt be no priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to me: seeing thou hast forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will also forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy children</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroyed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cut off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">As they were increased</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so they sinned</w> against me: <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04171" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I change</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">their glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H07036">into shame</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They eat up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">on their iniquity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lift up their soul to</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And there shall be, like people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">like priest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">them for their ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">them their doings</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>punish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visit upon</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>reward</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cause to return</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For they shall eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not have enough</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they shall commit whoredom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not increase</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they have left off</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Hosea 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02184">Whoredom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">and wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">and new wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 4:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">My people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">counsel at their stocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04731">and their staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">declareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">unto them: for the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02183">of whoredoms</w> hath caused <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to err</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they have gone a whoring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">from under their God</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">They sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the tops</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and burn incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">upon the hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0437">under oaks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03839">and poplars</w> <w lemma="strong:H0424">and elms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06738">because the shadow</w> thereof <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01323">therefore your daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall commit whoredom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03618">and your spouses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall commit adultery</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">your daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when they commit whoredom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03618">nor your spouses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">when they commit adultery</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">for themselves are separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with whores</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06948">with harlots</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">therefore the people</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doth not understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03832" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall fall</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I will not</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Shall I not</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>fall</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">be punished</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 4:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03478">Though thou, Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">play the harlot</w>, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">let not Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">offend</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">not ye unto Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither go ye up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01007">to Beth–aven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor swear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">For Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05637" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">slideth back</w> <w lemma="strong:H05637" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as a backsliding</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">heifer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">now the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">them as a lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H04800">in a large place</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H06091">to idols</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">let him alone</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 4:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05435">Their drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is sour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they have committed whoredom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">continually</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04043">her rulers</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07036">shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> ye.<note type="study"><catchWord>sour</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gone</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>rulers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shields</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 4:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">The wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath bound her up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">in her wings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">because of their sacrifices</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen922" osisID="Hos.4"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">ye this, O priests</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and hearken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">ye house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and give ye ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04941">for judgment</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06341">toward you, because ye have been a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">on Mizpah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07568">and a net</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08396">upon Tabor</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07846">And the revolters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06009" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">are profound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make slaughter</w>, though I <transChange type="added">have been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04148">a rebuker</w> of them all.<note type="study"><catchWord>though</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a rebuker</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a correction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is not hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">from me: for now, O Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou committest whoredom</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is defiled</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They will not frame</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">their doings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto their God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07307">for the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02183">of whoredoms</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of them, and they have not known</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>They will…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Their doings will not suffer them</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>frame</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">give</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01347">And the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">doth testify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to his face</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">therefore shall Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">and Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">in their iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also shall fall</w> with them.

verses.name: Hosea 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">with their flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and with their herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but they shall not find</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath withdrawn</w> himself from them.

verses.name: Hosea 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have dealt treacherously</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they have begotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02320">now shall a month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">them with their portions</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">ye the cornet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">in Gibeah</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02689">the trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">in Ramah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">cry aloud</w> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01007">Beth–aven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">thee, O Benjamin</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">shall be desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">of rebuke</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07626">among the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have I made known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that which shall surely be</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">The princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05253" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">were like them that remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the bound</w>: <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">my wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">upon them like water</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">oppressed</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because he willingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06673">the commandment</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 5:12
verses.text: Therefore <transChange type="added">will</transChange> I <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0669">unto Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06211">as a moth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07538">as rottenness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rottenness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a worm</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">When Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">his sickness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w> <transChange type="added">saw</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04205">his wound</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">to the Assyrian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378 strong:H03377" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8677">Jareb</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet could</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he not heal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01455" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, nor cure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04205">you of your wound</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>king Jareb</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the king of Jareb</rdg>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the king that should plead</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 5:14
verses.text: For I <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0669">unto Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H07826">as a lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03715">and as a young lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>: I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I, will tear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and go away</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will take away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and none shall rescue</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>.

verses.name: Hosea 5:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to my place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">till they acknowledge their offence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06862">in their affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H07836" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they will seek me early</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>acknowledge…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be guilty</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen923" osisID="Hos.5"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he hath torn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he will heal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">us; he hath smitten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he will bind us up</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">After two days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will he revive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">us: in the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he will raise us up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we shall live</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in his sight</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then shall we know</w>, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">on to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H04161">his going forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">as the morning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">unto us as the rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04456">as the latter</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">former rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the earth</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 6:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0669">O Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what shall I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">unto thee? O Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what shall I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">unto thee? for your goodness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01242">as a morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and as the early</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it goeth away</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>goodness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mercy</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">kindness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore have I hewed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">by the prophets</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">them by the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of my mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04941">and thy judgments</w> <transChange type="added">are as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0216">the light</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">goeth forth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that thy judgments might be</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Hosea 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I desired</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">and not sacrifice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01847">and the knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">more than burnt offerings</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">But they like men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there have they dealt treacherously</w> against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>men</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Adam</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07151">a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w>, <transChange type="added">and is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06121">polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with blood</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>polluted</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cunning for</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01416">And as troops</w> <w lemma="strong:H02442" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of robbers wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">for a man</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02267">the company</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">murder</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927 strong:H07926" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">by consent</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">lewdness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with one shoulder</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">to Shechem</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>lewdness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">enormity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08186">an horrible thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: there <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02184">the whoredom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is defiled</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">Also, O Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">an harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for thee, when I returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen924" osisID="Hos.6"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When I would have healed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">then the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was discovered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsehood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01590">and the thief</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh in</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01416">the troop</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of robbers spoileth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wickedness</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">evils</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>spoileth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strippeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">not in their hearts</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all their wickedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04611">now their own doings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have beset them about</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">they are before my face</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>consider…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">say not to</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">They make the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">with their wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03585">with their lies</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 7:4
verses.text: They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">all adulterers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08574">as an oven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">heated</w> <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">by the baker</w>, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ceaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from raising</w> <w lemma="strong:H03888" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">after he hath kneaded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01217">the dough</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02556" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until it be leavened</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>who…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the raiser will cease</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>raising</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">waking</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of our king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> have made <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">sick</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">with bottles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03945" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with scorners</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bottles…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">heat through wine</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">For they have made ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08574">like an oven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">whiles they lie in wait</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their baker</w> <w lemma="strong:H03463">sleepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">all the night</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it burneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03852">as a flaming</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">applied</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02552" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">They are all hot</w> <w lemma="strong:H08574">as an oven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their judges</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">all their kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are fallen</w>: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none among them that calleth</w> unto me.

verses.name: Hosea 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8704">he hath mixed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">himself among the people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05692">is a cake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">not turned</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">his strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he knoweth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07872">not: yea, gray hairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are here and there</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon him, yet he knoweth</w> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>here…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sprinkled</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01347">And the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">testifieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to his face</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they do not return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">nor seek</w> him for all this.

verses.name: Hosea 7:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">also is like a silly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">dove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">without heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they call</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">to Assyria</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When they shall go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07568">my net</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">upon them; I will bring them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">as the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will chastise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">them, as their congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">hath heard</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0188">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them! for they have fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07701">from me: destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them! because they have transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against me: though I have redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them, yet they have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">lies</w> against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>destruction</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">spoil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they have not cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">unto me with their heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when they howled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">upon their beds</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">they assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">themselves for corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">and wine</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they rebel</w> against me.

verses.name: Hosea 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Though I have bound</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">their arms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">yet do they imagine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">mischief</w> against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>have…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chastened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They return</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05920">not to the most High</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07423">they are like a deceitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">bow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08269">their princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">for the rage</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">of their tongue</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02097">this</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03933">their derision</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen925" osisID="Hos.7"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:1
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Set</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07782">the trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02441">to thy mouth</w>. <transChange type="added">He shall come</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05404">as an eagle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">against the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they have transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and trespassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">against my law</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the roof of thy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto me, My God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we know</w> thee.

verses.name: Hosea 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath cast off</w> <transChange type="added">the thing that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pursue</w> him.

verses.name: Hosea 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">They have set up kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07786" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but not by me: they have made princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I knew</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">not: of their silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and their gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06091">them idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that they may be cut off</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 8:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05695">Thy calf</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08111">O Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath cast</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">off; mine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is kindled</w> against them: how long <transChange type="added">will it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03808">ere</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they attain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05356">to innocency</w>?

verses.name: Hosea 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">For from Israel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02796">it also: the workman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> it; therefore it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05695">but the calf</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H07616">shall be broken in pieces</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For they have sown</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall reap</w> <w lemma="strong:H05492">the whirlwind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07054">it hath no stalk</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06780">the bud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H07058">no meal</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0194">if</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so be it yield</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall swallow it up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stalk</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">standing corn</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is swallowed up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01471">now shall they be among the Gentiles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">as a vessel</w> wherein <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02656">no pleasure</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For they are gone up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">to Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06501">a wild ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0909" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">alone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">by himself: Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08566" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath hired</w> <w lemma="strong:H0158">lovers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lovers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">loves</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yea, though they have hired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">now will I gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and they shall sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">for the burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of princes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sorrow</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">begin</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in a little while</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">Because Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath made many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall be unto him to sin</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I have written</w> <w lemma="strong:H07239 strong:H07230" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">to him the great things</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of my law</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they were counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">as a strange thing</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02077">the sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H01890">of mine offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and eat</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">accepteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them not; now will he remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">their iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">their sins</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>They sacrifice…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">In the sacrifices of mine offerings they</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Hosea 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">For Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his Maker</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and buildeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">temples</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">but I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">upon his cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">the palaces</w> thereof. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen926" osisID="Hos.8"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">not, O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01524">for joy</w>, as <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou hast gone a whoring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">from thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0868">a reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715 strong:H01637">upon every cornfloor</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>upon</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Hosea 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01637">The floor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03342">and the winepress</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">them, and the new wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall fail</w> in her.<note type="study"><catchWord>winepress</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">winefat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall not dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0669">but Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0804">in Assyria</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall not offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <transChange type="added">offerings</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06149" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall they be pleasing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">unto him: their sacrifices</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">unto them as the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of mourners</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thereof shall be polluted</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03899">for their bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for their soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Hosea 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What will ye do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">in the solemn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">of the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>?

verses.name: Hosea 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For, lo, they are gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07701">because of destruction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall gather them up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04644">Memphis</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H04261">them: the pleasant</w> <transChange type="added">places</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for their silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07057">nettles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H02336">them: thorns</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in their tabernacles</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destruction</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">spoil</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">their silver shall be desired, the nettle</rdg>, etc.: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">The days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">of visitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07966">of recompence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are come</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall know</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0191">a fool</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spiritual</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07696" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">mad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">for the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">of thine iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04895">hatred</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>spiritual…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">man of the spirit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 9:8
