verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The watchman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">with my God</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06341">a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03352">of a fowler</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in all his ways</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04895">hatred</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in the</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">against the</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06009" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">They have deeply</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">corrupted</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">of Gibeah</w>: <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he will remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">their iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he will visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">their sins</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06025">like grapes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01063">as the firstripe</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">in the fig tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">at her first time</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01187">to Baal–peor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05144" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and separated</w> themselves unto <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01322">shame</w>; and <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08251">abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were according as they loved</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 9:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">their glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">shall fly away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">like a bird</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from the birth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0990">and from the womb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02032">and from the conception</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Though they bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">their children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">yet will I bereave</w> them, <transChange type="added">that there shall</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w> <transChange type="added">left</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0188">yea, woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">also to them when I depart</w> from them!

verses.name: Hosea 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">Tyrus</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08362" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">in a pleasant place</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0669">but Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">shall bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the murderer</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what wilt thou give</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">them a miscarrying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">womb</w> <w lemma="strong:H06784" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">breasts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>miscarrying</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that casteth the fruit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">All their wickedness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01537">in Gilgal</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for there I hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H07455">them: for the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of their doings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will drive them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of mine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0160">I will love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them no more</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08269">all their princes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05637" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">revolters</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">is smitten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08328">their root</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is dried up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">no fruit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, though they bring forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">yet will I slay</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04261">the beloved</w> <transChange type="added">fruit</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of their womb</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the desires</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">My God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will cast them away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they did not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto him: and they shall be wanderers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen927" osisID="Hos.9"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01238" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">an empty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">vine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he bringeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">unto himself: according to the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">of his fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altars</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02896">according to the goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of his land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they have made goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">images</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a vine emptying the fruit which it giveth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">statues</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">standing images</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is divided</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">now shall they be found faulty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06202" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall break down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">their altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">he shall spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">their images</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Their heart…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">He hath divided their heart</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>break…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">behead</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">statues</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">standing images</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For now they shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">We have no king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because we feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">what then should a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> to us?

verses.name: Hosea 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">They have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0422" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">swearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">falsely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in making</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04941">thus judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">springeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07219">as hemlock</w> <w lemma="strong:H08525">in the furrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07934">The inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05697">because of the calves</w> <w lemma="strong:H01007">of Beth–aven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof shall mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03649">over it, and the priests</w> thereof <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">on it, for the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, because it is departed</w> from it.<note type="study"><catchWord>the priests…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Chemarim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 10:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">It shall be also carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">unto Assyria</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a present</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03377">Jareb</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H01317">shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">of his own counsel</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 10:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">her king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07110">as the foam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the water</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the face of the water</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01116">The high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H0206">also of Aven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be destroyed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06975">the thorn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01863">and the thistle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">on their altars</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">us; and to the hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Fall</w> on us.

verses.name: Hosea 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">of Gibeah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there they stood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04421">the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">in Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05932">of iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">did not overtake</w> them.

verses.name: Hosea 10:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0185">in my desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I should chastise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">them; and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">shall be gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against them, when they shall bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">themselves in their two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">furrows</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when I shall bind them for their two transgressions</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">in their two habitations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">And Ephraim</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05697">an heifer</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">taught</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01758" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to tread out</w> <transChange type="added">the corn</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but I passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">upon her fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">neck</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0669">I will make Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to ride</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall plow</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07702" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall break his clods</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>her…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the beauty of her neck</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">to yourselves in righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">reap</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05214" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">break up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05215">your fallow ground</w>: for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">till he come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w> upon you.

verses.name: Hosea 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have plowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye have reaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye have eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03585">of lies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because thou didst trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in thy way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">in the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of thy mighty men</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07588">Therefore shall a tumult</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04013">and all thy fortresses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall be spoiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08020">as Shalman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07701">spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01009">Beth–arbel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of battle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0517">the mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H07376" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was dashed in pieces</w> upon <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 10:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03602">So</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">shall Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto you because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of your great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">wickedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07837">in a morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">shall the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be cut off</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>your…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the evil of your evil</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen928" osisID="Hos.10"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">When Israel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">a child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then I loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 11:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, so they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from them</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">unto Baalim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and burned incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">to graven images</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08637" morph="strongMorph:TH8809" type="x-split-384">I taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08637" morph="strongMorph:TH8809" type="x-split-384">also to go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">taking</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">them by their arms</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not that I healed</w> them.

verses.name: Hosea 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">them with cords</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05688">with bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">of love</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and I was to them as they that take off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">the yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03895">on their jaws</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">meat</w> unto them.<note type="study"><catchWord>take off</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lift up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 11:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall not return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0804">but the Assyrian</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">shall be his king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because they refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to return</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02719">And the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">on his cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shall consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">his branches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and devour</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04156">because of their own counsels</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08511" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">are bent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04878">to backsliding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from me: though they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05920">them to the most High</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03162">none at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">would exalt</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>none…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">together they exalted not</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How shall I give thee up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>? <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04042" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall I deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">thee, Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">how shall I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0126">thee as Admah</w>? <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06636">thee as Zeboim</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03820">mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05150">within me, my repentings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03648" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">the fierceness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of mine anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and not man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of thee: and I will not enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall roar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">like a lion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when he shall roar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">then the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall tremble</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">from the west</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall tremble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">as a bird</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03123">and as a dove</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">them in their houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Hosea 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">compasseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03585">me about with lies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">with deceit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03063">but Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07300" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet ruleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">with God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and is faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">with the saints</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>saints</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">most holy</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen929" osisID="Hos.11"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">feedeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">on wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and followeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">after the east wind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">he daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">increaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">lies</w> <w lemma="strong:H07701">and desolation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they do make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">with the Assyrians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">is carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">hath also a controversy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">with Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">according to his ways</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04611">according to his doings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will he recompense</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>punish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visit upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 12:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0251">He took his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H06117" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">by the heel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">in the womb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0202">and by his strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H08280" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he had power</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">with God</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>had…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was a prince</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">behaved himself princely</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07786" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yea, he had power</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">over the angel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and prevailed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he wept</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and made supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him: he found</w> him <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01008">Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and there he spake</w> with us;

verses.name: Hosea 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Even the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02143">his memorial</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thou to thy God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">on thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 12:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">He is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03667">a merchant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03976">the balances</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">of deceit</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to oppress</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a merchant</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Canaan</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>oppress</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">deceive</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">And Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet I am become rich</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have found me out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0202">substance</w>: <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03018">all my labours</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall find</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">none iniquity</w> in me that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02399">sin</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in all…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">all my labours suffice me not: he shall have punishment of iniquity in whom is sin</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>that</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">which</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 12:9
verses.text: And I <transChange type="added">that am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will yet make thee to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in tabernacles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the solemn feast</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 12:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have also spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">by the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I have multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">visions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and used similitudes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the ministry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ministry</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 12:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07723">surely they are vanity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">bullocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">in Gilgal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04196">yea, their altars</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01530">as heaps</w> <w lemma="strong:H08525">in the furrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the fields</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">served</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">for a wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and for a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he kept</w> <transChange type="added">sheep</transChange>.

verses.name: Hosea 12:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">And by a prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and by a prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was he preserved</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 12:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> provoked <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H08563">most bitterly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore shall he leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">upon him, and his reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">shall his Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">return</w> unto him.<note type="study"><catchWord>most…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with bitternesses</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen930" osisID="Hos.12"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">When Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07578">trembling</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">himself in Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but when he offended</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">in Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he died</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And now they sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">more and more</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">them molten images</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of their silver</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06091">idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">according to their own understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">all of it the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H02796">of the craftsmen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of them, Let the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">the calves</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they sin…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they add to sin</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the men…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the sacrificers of men</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">Therefore they shall be as the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and as the early</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that passeth away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04671">as the chaff</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05590" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">is driven with the whirlwind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">out of the floor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06227">and as the smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0699">out of the chimney</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 13:4
verses.text: Yet I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">no god</w> <w lemma="strong:H02108">but me</w>: for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">no saviour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01115">beside me</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 13:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I did know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">thee in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08514">of great drought</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>great…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">droughts</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04830">According to their pasture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so were they filled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they were filled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was exalted</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore have they forgotten</w> me.

verses.name: Hosea 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07826">Therefore I will be unto them as a lion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05246">as a leopard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I observe</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>:

verses.name: Hosea 13:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06298" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01677">them as a bear</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07909">bereaved</w> <transChange type="added">of her whelps</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will rend</w> <w lemma="strong:H05458">the caul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of their heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there will I devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03833">them like a lion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07704">the wild</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall tear</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>wild…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">beast of the field</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 13:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast destroyed</w> thyself; but in me <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05828">thine help</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>is…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in thy help</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0165">I will</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">be thy king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0645">where</w> <transChange type="added">is any other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that may save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">thee in all thy cities</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and thy judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of whom thou saidst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">me a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and princes</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>I will…</catchWord>: <rdg>rather, Where is thy king?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 13:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">thee a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in mine anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05678">away in my wrath</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05771">The iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">bound up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02403">his sin</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hid</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02256">The sorrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of a travailing woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> upon him: he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">an unwise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he should not stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">long</w> in <transChange type="added">the place of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04866">the breaking forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of children</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>long</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a time</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will ransom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them from the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">of the grave</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">them from death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04194">O death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0165">I will</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">be thy plagues</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07585">O grave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0165">I will</w> <w lemma="strong:H06987">be thy destruction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05164">repentance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">from mine eyes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>power</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 13:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06500" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Though he be fruitful</w> among <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06921">an east wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">from the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04726">and his spring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall become dry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04599">and his fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be dried up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08154" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">the treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02532">of all pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vessels of desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 13:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall become desolate</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for she hath rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">against her God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05768">their infants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07376" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be dashed in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02030">and their women with child</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be ripped up</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen931" osisID="Hos.13"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou hast fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">by thine iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">with you words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, Take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">all iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and receive</w> <transChange type="added">us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">graciously</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">so will we render</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">the calves</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of our lips</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>receive…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">give good</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0804">Asshur</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not save</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us; we will not ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">upon horses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither will we say</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">any more to the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of our hands</w>, <transChange type="added">Ye are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our gods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03490">for in thee the fatherless</w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">findeth mercy</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 14:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will heal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04878">their backsliding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will love</w> <w lemma="strong:H05071">them freely</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0639">for mine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is turned away</w> from him.

verses.name: Hosea 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02919">I will be as the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall grow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07799">as the lily</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">his roots</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">as Lebanon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>grow</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">blossom</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cast…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strike</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03127">His branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall spread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01935">and his beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">shall be as the olive tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07381">and his smell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">as Lebanon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>spread</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">go</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">under his shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they shall revive</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01715">the corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and grow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">as the vine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02143">the scent</w> thereof <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03196">as the wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>grow</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">blossom</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>scent</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">memorial</rdg></note>

verses.name: Hosea 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <transChange type="added">shall say</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06091">What have I to do any more with idols</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have heard</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and observed</w> him: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07488">like a green</w> <w lemma="strong:H01265">fir tree</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06529">From me is thy fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">found</w>.

verses.name: Hosea 14:9
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall understand</w> these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">prudent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">them? for the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06662">and the just</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in them: but the transgressors</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall fall</w> therein. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen932" osisID="Hos.14"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen918" osisID="Hos" type="book"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03100">that came to Joel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06602">of Pethuel</w>.

verses.name: Joel 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">this, ye old men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and give ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all ye inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03117">Hath this been in your days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0518">or even</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w>?

verses.name: Joel 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">ye your children</w> of it, and <transChange type="added">let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">your children</w> <transChange type="added">tell</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">their children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w>.

verses.name: Joel 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01501">That which the palmerworm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">hath left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0697">hath the locust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">eaten</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0697">and that which the locust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">hath left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03218">hath the cankerworm</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">eaten</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03218">and that which the cankerworm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">hath left</w> <w lemma="strong:H02625">hath the caterpiller</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">eaten</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>That which the palmerworm…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">The residue of the palmerworm</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07910">ye drunkards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and weep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all ye drinkers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06071">because of the new wine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for it is cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">from your mouth</w>.

verses.name: Joel 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">For a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon my land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06099">strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">and without number</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08127">whose teeth</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08127">the teeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">of a lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04973">and he hath the cheek teeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03833">of a great lion</w>.

verses.name: Joel 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">my vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07111">and barked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">my fig tree</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02834" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he hath made it clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H02834" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w>, and cast <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">away</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08299">the branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03835" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof are made white</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>barked…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">laid my fig tree for a barking</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 1:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0421" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lament</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">like a virgin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">with sackcloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">for the husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of her youth</w>.

verses.name: Joel 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04503">The meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">and the drink offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">is cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">ministers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">mourn</w>.

verses.name: Joel 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07704">The field</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is wasted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">mourneth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01715">for the corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is wasted</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08492">the new wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is dried up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">the oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">languisheth</w>.

verses.name: Joel 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Be ye ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0406">O ye husbandmen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03755">O ye vinedressers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02406">for the wheat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">and for the barley</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07105">because the harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is perished</w>.

verses.name: Joel 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01612">The vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is dried up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08384">and the fig tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">languisheth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07416">the pomegranate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08558">tree, the palm tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H08598">also, and the apple tree</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">all the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are withered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08342">because joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is withered away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>.

verses.name: Joel 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Gird</w> <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yourselves, and lament</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">ye priests</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">ye ministers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">lie all night</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">in sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">ye ministers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of my God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04503">for the meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">and the drink offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is withholden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of your God</w>.

verses.name: Joel 1:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">ye a fast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H06116">a solemn assembly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">the elders</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <transChange type="added">into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>solemn…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">day of restraint</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0162">Alas</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for the day</w>! <w lemma="strong:H03117">for the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">at hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07701">and as a destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">from the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall it come</w>.

verses.name: Joel 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0400">Is not the meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before our eyes</w>, <transChange type="added">yea</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08057">joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01524">and gladness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>?

verses.name: Joel 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06507">The seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05685" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is rotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04053">under their clods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">the garners</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are laid desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04460">the barns</w> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are broken down</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01715">for the corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is withered</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>seed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">grains</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0929">How do the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0584" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">groan</w>! <w lemma="strong:H05739">the herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0943" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are perplexed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04829">because they have no pasture</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05739">yea, the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are made desolate</w>.

verses.name: Joel 1:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thee will I cry</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0784">for the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H04999">the pastures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03852">and the flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03857" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">all the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pastures</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">habitations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0929">The beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06165" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0650">also unto thee: for the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are dried up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">and the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H04999">the pastures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen934" osisID="Joel.1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">ye the trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and sound an alarm</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">let all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">tremble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cometh</w>, for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">nigh at hand</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>trumpet</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cornet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">A day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">of darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0653">and of gloominess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">of clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H06205">and of thick darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07837">as the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">and a strong</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">there hath not been</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">the like, neither shall be any more</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> it, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">to the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of many…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of generation and generation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">A fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">devoureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">them; and behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03852">them a flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03857" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">burneth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01588">as the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05731">of Eden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">them, and behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">them a desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">wilderness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06413">yea, and nothing shall escape</w> them.

verses.name: Joel 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04758">The appearance</w> of them <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">as the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">of horses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06571">and as horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so shall they run</w>.

verses.name: Joel 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">Like the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">of chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the tops</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall they leap</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">like the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03851">of a flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that devoureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07179">the stubble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06099">as a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">set in battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">array</w>.

verses.name: Joel 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">Before their face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be much pained</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06440">all faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H06289">blackness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blackness</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall run</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">like mighty men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall climb</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">like men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall march</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">on his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05670" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they shall not break</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">their ranks</w>:

verses.name: Joel 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Neither shall one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01766" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thrust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">another</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">in his path</w>: and <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07973">upon the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01214" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall not be wounded</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sword</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall run to and fro</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall run</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall climb up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon the houses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall enter in</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">at the windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01590">like a thief</w>.

verses.name: Joel 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall quake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">them; the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall tremble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03394">and the moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be dark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03556">and the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall withdraw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05051">their shining</w>:

verses.name: Joel 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">his army</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04264">for his camp</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w>: for <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06099">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that executeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his word</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">and very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">terrible</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and who can abide</w> it?

verses.name: Joel 2:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Therefore also now, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn</w> ye <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">to me with all your heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06685">and with fasting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01065">and with weeping</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04553">and with mourning</w>:

verses.name: Joel 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And rend</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">your heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">and not your garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>: for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02587">gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H07349">and merciful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0750">slow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">to anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and repenteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">him of the evil</w>.

verses.name: Joel 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who knoweth</w> <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he will return</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and repent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">a blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> him; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">and a drink offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>?

verses.name: Joel 2:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">the trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">a fast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H06116">a solemn assembly</w>:

verses.name: Joel 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">the elders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05768">the children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and those that suck</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">the breasts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02860">let the bridegroom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">of his chamber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03618">and the bride</w> <w lemma="strong:H02646">out of her closet</w>.

verses.name: Joel 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Let the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">the ministers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">between the porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let them say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">not thine heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">to reproach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">that the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">should rule over</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them: wherefore should they say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w>, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>rule over</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">use a byword against</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 2:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">Then will the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">be jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">for his land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>.

verses.name: Joel 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Yea, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">you corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">and wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">and oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall be satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therewith: and I will no more make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">you a reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>:

verses.name: Joel 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">But I will remove far off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06830">from you the northern</w> <transChange type="added">army</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will drive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">him into a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06723">barren</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">and desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">with his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06931">toward the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05490">and his hinder part</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">toward the utmost</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0889">and his stink</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06709">and his ill savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">because he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">great things</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hath…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hath magnified to do</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 2:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">not, O land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and rejoice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">great things</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>will…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hath magnified to do</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Be not afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">ye beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04999">for the pastures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01876" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do spring</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">for the tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">beareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">her fruit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08384">the fig tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">and the vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">their strength</w>.

verses.name: Joel 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">then, ye children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04175">you the former rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">moderately</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he will cause to come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">for you the rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04175">the former rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04456">and the latter rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">in the first</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the former rain moderately</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a teacher of righteousness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>moderately</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to righteousness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 2:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01637">And the floors</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be full</w> <w lemma="strong:H01250">of wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03342">and the fats</w> <w lemma="strong:H07783" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall overflow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">with wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03323">and oil</w>.

verses.name: Joel 2:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">to you the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0697">that the locust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath eaten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03218">the cankerworm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02625">and the caterpiller</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01501">and the palmerworm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">my great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">army</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I sent</w> among you.

verses.name: Joel 2:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in plenty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and be satisfied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that hath dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">wondrously</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with you: and my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall never</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be ashamed</w>.

verses.name: Joel 2:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and none else: and my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall never</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be ashamed</w>.

verses.name: Joel 2:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And it shall come to pass afterward</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">upon all flesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and your sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and your daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall prophesy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">your old men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">dreams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0970">your young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02384">visions</w>:

verses.name: Joel 2:29
