verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And also upon the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">and upon the handmaids</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in those days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">my spirit</w>.

verses.name: Joel 2:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">and fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08490">and pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06227">of smoke</w>.

verses.name: Joel 2:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">The sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">into darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03394">and the moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">into blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and the terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">come</w>.

verses.name: Joel 2:32
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whosoever shall call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">on the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be delivered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02022">for in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">shall be deliverance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08300">and in the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall call</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen935" osisID="Joel.2"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For, behold, in those days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and in that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">when I shall bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>,

verses.name: Joel 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I will also gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">all nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will bring them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">into the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and will plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with them there for my people</w> and <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">my heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06340" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whom they have scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and parted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">my land</w>.

verses.name: Joel 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03032" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they have cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lots</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for my people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">a boy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for an harlot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03207">a girl</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">for wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they might drink</w>.

verses.name: Joel 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06865">Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06721">and Zidon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01552">and all the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06429">of Palestine</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">will ye render</w> <w lemma="strong:H01576">me a recompence</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and if ye recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H07031">me, swiftly</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04120">speedily</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01576">your recompence</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon your own head</w>;

verses.name: Joel 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because ye have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">my silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and my gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and have carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">into your temples</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">my goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04261">pleasant things</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">desirable</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">also of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have ye sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121 strong:H03125">unto the Grecians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that ye might remove them far</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">from their border</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the Grecians</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the sons of the Grecians</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will raise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">them out of the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whither ye have sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, and will return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01576">your recompence</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon your own head</w>:

verses.name: Joel 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">your sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and your daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07615">them to the Sabeans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">to a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far off</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Joel 3:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">ye this among the Gentiles</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">wake up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">the mighty men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">let all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">draw near</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them come up</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Prepare</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Sanctify</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Beat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0855">your plowshares</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">into swords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04211">and your pruninghooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07420">into spears</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02523">let the weak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">strong</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pruninghooks</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">scythes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yourselves, and come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">all ye heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and gather yourselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01368">thither cause thy mighty ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H05181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to come down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cause…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the <divineName>Lord</divineName> shall bring down</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">Let the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be wakened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">to the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for there will I sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">all the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Joel 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04038">ye in the sickle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07105">for the harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is ripe</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get you down</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01660">for the press</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is full</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03342">the fats</w> <w lemma="strong:H07783" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">overflow</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07451">for their wickedness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w>.

verses.name: Joel 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01995">Multitudes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">multitudes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">of decision</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">of decision</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>decision</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">concision</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">threshing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">The sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03394">and the moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be darkened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03556">and the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall withdraw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05051">their shining</w>.

verses.name: Joel 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also shall roar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">out of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08064">and the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall shake</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04268">the hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04581">and the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hope</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">place of repair</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">harbour</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">So shall ye know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03389">then shall Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">be holy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and there shall no strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pass through</w> her any more.<note type="study"><catchWord>holy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">holiness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 3:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall drop down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06071">new wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall flow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0650">and all the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall flow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04599">and a fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07851">of Shittim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>flow</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">go</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">shall be a desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0123">and Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">shall be a desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02555">for the violence</w> <transChange type="added">against</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they have shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in their land</w>.

verses.name: Joel 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">But Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">from generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to generation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dwell</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">abide</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joel 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">For I will cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">their blood</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have not cleansed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">even I the <divineName>Lord</divineName> that</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen936" osisID="Joel.3"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen933" osisID="Joel" type="book"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05986">of Amos</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05349">who was among the herdmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08620">of Tekoa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">concerning Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">of Uzziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">two years</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07494">the earthquake</w>.

verses.name: Amos 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will roar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">from Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04999">and the habitations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall mourn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">of Carmel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall wither</w>.

verses.name: Amos 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">For three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and for four</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not turn away</w> <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01758" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof; because they have threshed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">with threshing instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>and…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">yea, for four</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>turn…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">convert it</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">let it be quiet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">But I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02371">of Hazael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">the palaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H01130">of Ben–hadad</w>.

verses.name: Amos 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">also the bar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">from the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0206">of Aven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and him that holdeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the sceptre</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01040 strong:H05731" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of Eden</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go into captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07024">unto Kir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the plain…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Bikathaven</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the house…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Beth–eden</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 1:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">For three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H05804">of Gaza</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and for four</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not turn away</w> <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thereof; because they carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">the whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H01546">captivity</w>, to deliver <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">to Edom</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>away captive…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">them away with an entire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">But I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">on the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05804">of Gaza</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">the palaces</w> thereof:

verses.name: Amos 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0795">from Ashdod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and him that holdeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the sceptre</w> <w lemma="strong:H0831">from Ashkelon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06138">against Ekron</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07611">and the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Amos 1:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">For three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyrus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and for four</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not turn away</w> <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thereof; because they delivered up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">the whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H01546">captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">to Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">not the brotherly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>the brotherly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the covenant of brethren</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">But I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">on the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyrus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">the palaces</w> thereof.

verses.name: Amos 1:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">For three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and for four</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not turn away</w> <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof; because he did pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and did cast off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">all pity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">and his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did tear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">perpetually</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">his wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>did cast…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">corrupted his compassions</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">But I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H08487">upon Teman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">the palaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H01224">of Bozrah</w>.

verses.name: Amos 1:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">For three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and for four</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not turn away</w> <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof; because they have ripped up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02030">the women with child</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that they might enlarge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">their border</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>ripped…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">divided the mountains</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">But I will kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">in the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07237">of Rabbah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">the palaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">thereof, with shouting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05591">with a tempest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05492">of the whirlwind</w>:

verses.name: Amos 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And their king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">into captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">he and his princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen938" osisID="Amos.1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">For three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and for four</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not turn away</w> <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof; because he burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07875">into lime</w>:

verses.name: Amos 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">But I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">upon Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">the palaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H07152">of Kerioth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04124">and Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H07588">with tumult</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08643">with shouting</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">with the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w>:

verses.name: Amos 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, and will slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof with him, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Amos 2:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">For three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and for four</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not turn away</w> <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof; because they have despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have not kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03577">and their lies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">caused them to err</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the which their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have walked</w>:

verses.name: Amos 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">But I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">upon Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">the palaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Amos 2:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">For three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and for four</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not turn away</w> <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof; because they sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H034">and the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">for a pair of shoes</w>;

verses.name: Amos 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07602" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">That pant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">after the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">of the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and turn aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06035">of the meek</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">and a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">and his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will go</w> in unto the <transChange type="added">same</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05291">maid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>maid</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">young woman</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 2:8
verses.text: And they lay <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">upon clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">laid to pledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">every altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">the wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06064" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of the condemned</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of their god</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the condemned</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">such as have fined</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">mulcted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 2:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Yet destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">I the Amorite</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01363">them, whose height</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01363">like the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of the cedars</w>, and he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02634">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0437">as the oaks</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet I destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">his fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">from above</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08328">and his roots</w> from beneath.

verses.name: Amos 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Also I brought you up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and led</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">you forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">through the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorite</w>.

verses.name: Amos 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I raised up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of your sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">for prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0970">and of your young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05139">for Nazarites</w>. <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">not even thus, O ye children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Amos 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05139">But ye gave the Nazarites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to drink</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Prophesy</w> not.

verses.name: Amos 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05781" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I am pressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">under you, as a cart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05781" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">is pressed</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H05995">of sheaves</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I am…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">I will press your place, as a cart full of sheaves presseth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04498">Therefore the flight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07031">from the swift</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">and the strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall not strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">his force</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">neither shall the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">himself</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>himself</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his soul</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither shall he stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that handleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">the bow</w>; and <transChange type="added">he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07031">swift</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall not deliver</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">neither shall he that rideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">the horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">himself</w>.

verses.name: Amos 2:16
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H0533">courageous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">among the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall flee away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06174">naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>courageous</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strong of his heart</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen939" osisID="Amos.2"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against you, O children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">against the whole family</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which I brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Amos 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">You only have I known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of all the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">you for all your iniquities</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>punish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visit upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">Can two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01115">except</w> <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they be agreed</w>?

verses.name: Amos 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0738">Will a lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">roar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">in the forest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02964">when he hath no prey</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03715">will a young lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963 strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cry out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04585">of his den</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">if he have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01115">nothing</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>cry</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">give forth his voice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06833">Can a bird</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">in a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04170">where no gin</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for him? shall <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">from the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">nothing at all</w>?

verses.name: Amos 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07782">Shall a trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be blown</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not be afraid</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07451">shall there be evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in a city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not done</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>?<note type="study"><catchWord>be afraid</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">run together?</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the <divineName>Lord</divineName>…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shall not the <divineName>Lord</divineName> do somewhat?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Surely the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">nothing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he revealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05475">his secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>.

verses.name: Amos 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0738">The lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath roared</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">who will not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">who can but prophesy</w>?

verses.name: Amos 3:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Publish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">in the palaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0795">at Ashdod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0759">and in the palaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">yourselves upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04103">tumults</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06217">thereof, and the oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>oppressed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">oppressions</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For they know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05229">right</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0686" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who store</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">up violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H07701">and robbery</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">in their palaces</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>robbery</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spoil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06862">An adversary</w> <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">even round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he shall bring down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">thy strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">from thee, and thy palaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be spoiled</w>.

verses.name: Amos 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">As the shepherd</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">taketh out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">of the lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03767">legs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0915">or a piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">of an ear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">so shall the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be taken out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">in the corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">of a bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01833">and in Damascus</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06210">a couch</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>taketh</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">delivereth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in Damascus…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">on the bed’s feet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">ye, and testify</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>,

verses.name: Amos 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">That in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I shall visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">the transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon him I will also visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">of Beth–el</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07161">and the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>visit</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">punish Israel for</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H02779">the winter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">with the summer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">of ivory</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05486" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall have an end</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen940" osisID="Amos.3"/>

verses.name: Amos 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06510">ye kine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>, that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which oppress</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which crush</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">the needy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to their masters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us drink</w>.

verses.name: Amos 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">The Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">by his holiness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">that, lo, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon you, that he will take you away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06793">with hooks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0319">and your posterity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05518 strong:H01729">with fishhooks</w>.

verses.name: Amos 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye shall go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">at the breaches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">every</w> <transChange type="added">cow at that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">before her; and ye shall cast</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02038">into the palace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cast…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cast away the things of the palace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 4:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">to Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and transgress</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01537">at Gilgal</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">transgression</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">your sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">every morning</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04643">your tithes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">after three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">years</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>three…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">three years of days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">a sacrifice of thanksgiving</w> <w lemma="strong:H02557">with leaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and proclaim</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">publish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05071">the free offerings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03651">for this</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">liketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">you, O ye children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>offer</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">offer by burning</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>this…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">so ye love</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 4:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I also have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05356">you cleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">of teeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in all your cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02640">and want</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in all your places</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet have ye not returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Amos 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And also I have withholden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">the rain</w> from you, when <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">yet three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">to the harvest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I caused it to rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">upon one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and caused it not to rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">upon another</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was rained</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">upon, and the piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">whereupon it rained</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not withered</w>.

verses.name: Amos 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">So two</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wandered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">unto one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but they were not satisfied</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet have ye not returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Amos 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07711">you with blasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03420">and mildew</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01593">when your gardens</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">and your vineyards</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">and your fig trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">and your olive trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">increased</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01501">the palmerworm</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">devoured</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet have ye not returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the multitude of your gardens, etc. did the palmerworm</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">among you the pestilence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">after the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0970">your young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07628">and have taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">your horses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0889">and I have made the stink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of your camps</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">unto your nostrils</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet have ye not returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>after…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in the way</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>and have…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with the captivity of your horses</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have overthrown</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of you, as God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04114">overthrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">and Gomorrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0181">and ye were as a firebrand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">plucked out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08316">of the burning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet have ye not returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Amos 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore thus will I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto thee, O Israel</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06118">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">this unto thee, prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>.

verses.name: Amos 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For, lo, he that formeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and createth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and declareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">unto man</w> what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07808">his thought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05890">darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and treadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">upon the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">The God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wind</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spirit</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen941" osisID="Amos.4"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">ye this word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I take up</w> against you, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07015">a lamentation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Amos 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01330">The virgin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fallen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">she shall no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">rise</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">she is forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">upon her land</w>; <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none to raise her up</w>.

verses.name: Amos 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05892">The city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that went out</w> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and that which went forth</w> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Amos 5:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye me, and ye shall live</w>:

verses.name: Amos 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">not Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">into Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">not to Beer–sheba</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01537">for Gilgal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go into captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01008">and Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">shall come to nought</w>.

verses.name: Amos 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and ye shall live</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest he break out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">like fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and devour</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, and <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">none to quench</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01008">in Beth–el</w>.

verses.name: Amos 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Ye who turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03939">to wormwood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and leave off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>,

verses.name: Amos 5:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Seek him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03598">the seven stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H03685">and Orion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06757">the shadow of death</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">into the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and maketh the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">with night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that calleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">for the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and poureth them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>:

verses.name: Amos 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01082" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">That strengtheneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07701">the spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05794">against the strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07701">so that the spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">against the fortress</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>spoiled</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">spoil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">him that rebuketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they abhor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him that speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">uprightly</w>.

verses.name: Amos 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03282">Forasmuch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01318" morph="strongMorph:TH8780">therefore as your treading</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01800">upon the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04864">from him burdens</w> <w lemma="strong:H01250">of wheat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01496">of hewn stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but ye shall not dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in them; ye have planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02531">pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but ye shall not drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> of them.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vineyards of desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">your manifold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">and your mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">sins</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the just</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03724">a bribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and they turn aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w> <transChange type="added">from their right</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a bribe</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a ransom</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Therefore the prudent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall keep silence</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in that time</w>; for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">time</w>.

verses.name: Amos 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and not evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye may live</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and so the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be with you, as ye have spoken</w>.

verses.name: Amos 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and love</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">it may be that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will be gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">unto the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>.

verses.name: Amos 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04553">thus; Wailing</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in all streets</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">in all the highways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01930">Alas</w>! <w lemma="strong:H01930">alas</w>! <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall call</w> <w lemma="strong:H0406">the husbandman</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">to mourning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and such as are skilful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05092">of lamentation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04553">to wailing</w>.

verses.name: Amos 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03754">And in all vineyards</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04553">wailing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Amos 5:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">unto you that desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>! <w lemma="strong:H04100">to what end</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">it for you? the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">and not light</w>.

verses.name: Amos 5:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">As if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">a lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01677">and a bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">met</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him; or went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and leaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">on the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05175">and a serpent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bit</w> him.

verses.name: Amos 5:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">not the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">and not light</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0651">even very dark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05051">and no brightness</w> in it?

verses.name: Amos 5:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I hate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">your feast days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07306" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will not smell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06116">in your solemn assemblies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">your holy days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 5:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Though ye offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">me burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">and your meat offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not accept</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">neither will I regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">the peace offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04806">of your fat beasts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>peace…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thank offerings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 5:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Take thou away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">from me the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of thy songs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will not hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02172">the melody</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">of thy viols</w>.

verses.name: Amos 5:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04941">But let judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">run down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">as waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0386">as a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">stream</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>run</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">roll</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 5:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Have ye offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">unto me sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">and offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: Amos 5:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But ye have borne</w> <w lemma="strong:H05522">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of your Moloch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03594">and Chiun</w> <w lemma="strong:H06754">your images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03556">the star</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of your god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye made</w> to yourselves.<note type="study"><catchWord>the tabernacle…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Siccuth your king</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 5:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01973">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">The God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen942" osisID="Amos.5"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> to them <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07600">at ease</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>, <transChange type="added">which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">named</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">to whom the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>are at…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">are secure</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>chief</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">firstfruits</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03641">ye unto Calneh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and from thence go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">ye to Hamath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02579 strong:H07227" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">the great</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">then go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">to Gath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>: <transChange type="added">be they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">than these kingdoms</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01366">or their border</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">than your border</w>?

verses.name: Amos 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05077" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Ye that put far away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07675" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and cause the seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">of violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to come near</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>seat</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">habitation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">That lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">upon beds</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">of ivory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05628" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and stretch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06210">themselves upon their couches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03733">the lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">out of the flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05695">and the calves</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04770">of the stall</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>stretch…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">abound with superfluities</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06527" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">That chant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">of the viol</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">invent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">to themselves instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of musick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">like David</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>chant</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">quaver</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">That drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H04219">in bowls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">themselves with the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">ointments</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">but they are not grieved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">for the affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wine…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in bowls of wine</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>affliction</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">breach</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 6:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore now shall they go captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">with the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that go captive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04797">and the banquet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05628" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of them that stretched</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">themselves shall be removed</w>.

verses.name: Amos 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">The Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">by himself</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08374" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">I abhor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">the excellency</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">his palaces</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">therefore will I deliver up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">with all that is therein</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the fulness thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And it shall come to pass, if there remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they shall die</w>.

verses.name: Amos 6:10
