verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01730">And a man’s uncle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take him up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05635" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and he that burneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">him, to bring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall say</w> unto him that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03411">by the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <transChange type="added">Is there</transChange> yet <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee? and he shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0657">No</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shall he say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02013" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Hold thy tongue</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">for we may not make mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>we…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they will not</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">have not</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For, behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">commandeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07447">with breaches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">and the little</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01233">with clefts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>breaches</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">droppings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 6:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05483">Shall horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">run</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">upon the rock</w>? will <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">plow</w> <transChange type="added">there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01241">with oxen</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for ye have turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07219">into gall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">of righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03939">into hemlock</w>:

verses.name: Amos 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08056">Ye which rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in a thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">of nought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Have we not taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">to us horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H02392">by our own strength</w>?

verses.name: Amos 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">But, behold, I will raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">against you a nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you from the entering in</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hemath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">of the wilderness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>river</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">valley</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen943" osisID="Amos.6"/>

verses.name: Amos 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Thus hath the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto me; and, behold, he formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01462">grasshoppers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08462">in the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of the shooting up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03954">of the latter growth</w>; and, lo, <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03954">the latter growth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01488">mowings</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>grasshoppers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">green worms</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 7:2
verses.text: And it came to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">when they had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of eating</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">the grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">forgive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arise</w>? for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06996">small</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">who of (or, <rdg type="alternate">for</rdg>,) Jacob shall stand?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">repented</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for this: It shall not be, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Amos 7:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0136">Thus hath the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">unto me: and, behold, the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to contend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">deep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and did eat up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">a part</w>.

verses.name: Amos 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">I, O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">cease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arise</w>? for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06996">small</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">who of (or, <rdg type="alternate">for</rdg>,) Jacob shall stand?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">repented</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for this: This also shall not be, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Amos 7:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Thus he shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">me: and, behold, the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon a wall</w> <transChange type="added">made</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0594">by a plumbline</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0594">with a plumbline</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>.

verses.name: Amos 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05986">unto me, Amos</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">what seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou? And I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0594">A plumbline</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0594">a plumbline</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">pass by</w> them any more:

verses.name: Amos 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01116">And the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H03446">of Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04720">and the sanctuaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be laid waste</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">against the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>.

verses.name: Amos 7:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0558">Then Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">of Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">to Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05986">Amos</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">against thee in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all his words</w>.

verses.name: Amos 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05986">For thus Amos</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03379">Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be led away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">out of their own land</w>.

verses.name: Amos 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0558">Also Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05986">unto Amos</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02374">O thou seer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">flee thee away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and there eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and prophesy</w> there:

verses.name: Amos 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">But prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">not again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">any more at Beth–el</w>: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">chapel</w>, and it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">court</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chapel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sanctuary</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>king’s court</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">house of the kingdom</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 7:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05986">Amos</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">to Amaziah</w>, I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">no prophet</w>, neither <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">I a prophet’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>; but I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0951">an herdman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01103" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and a gatherer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08256">of sycomore fruit</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>sycomore…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wild figs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">me as I followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from behind</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 7:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thou the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Thou sayest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">not against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and drop</w> not <transChange type="added">thy word</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">against the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03446">of Isaac</w>.

verses.name: Amos 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802">Thy wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be an harlot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and thy daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">and thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">by line</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt die</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">a polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go into captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">forth of his land</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen944" osisID="Amos.7"/>

verses.name: Amos 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Thus hath the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03619">unto me: and behold a basket</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">of summer fruit</w>.

verses.name: Amos 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05986">Amos</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">what seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou? And I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03619">A basket</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">of summer fruit</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">unto me, The end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">upon my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">pass</w> by them any more.

verses.name: Amos 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07892">And the songs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall be howlings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>: <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H06297">dead bodies</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in every place</w>; they shall cast <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02013" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">with silence</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall be howlings</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall howl</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be silent</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 8:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07602" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">this, O ye that swallow up</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">the needy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-385">even to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06035 strong:H06041" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-385">to fail</w>,

verses.name: Amos 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">When will the new moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be gone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that we may sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07668">corn</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07676">and the sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may set forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01250">wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0374">making the ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06994" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">small</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08255">and the shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05791" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and falsifying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03976">the balances</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">by deceit</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>new…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">month</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">open</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>falsifying…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">perverting the balances of deceit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">That we may buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H034">and the needy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">for a pair of shoes</w>; <transChange type="added">yea</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04651">the refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01250">of the wheat</w>?

verses.name: Amos 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">by the excellency</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05331">Surely I will never</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">any of their works</w>.

verses.name: Amos 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Shall not the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">tremble</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for this, and every one mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therein? and it shall rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">wholly as a flood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it shall be cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248 strong:H08257" morph="strongMorph:TH8738 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8738">and drowned</w>, as <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0216">the flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Amos 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08121">that I will cause the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">at noon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will darken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">in the clear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>:

verses.name: Amos 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">your feasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">into mourning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07892">and all your songs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07015">into lamentation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">sackcloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">upon all loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07144">and baldness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon every head</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">it as the mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03173">of an only</w> <transChange type="added">son</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0319">and the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">thereof as a bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Amos 8:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">a famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">not a famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06772">nor a thirst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">for water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but of hearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Amos 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall wander</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">from sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">to sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">and from the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">even to the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07751" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">they shall run to and fro</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not find</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Amos 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">shall the fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">virgins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">and young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05968" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">faint</w> <w lemma="strong:H06772">for thirst</w>.

verses.name: Amos 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">They that swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">by the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">Thy god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01835">O Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01870">and, The manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">of Beer–sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">even they shall fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and never rise up</w> again.<note type="study"><catchWord>manner</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">way</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen945" osisID="Amos.8"/>

verses.name: Amos 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">standing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03730">the lintel of the door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05592">that the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may shake</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01214" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">them in the head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">all of them; and I will slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">the last</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of them with the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">he that fleeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them shall not flee away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06412">and he that escapeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">of them shall not be delivered</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lintel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chapiter</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">knop</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cut…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wound them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02864" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Though they dig</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">into hell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">thence shall mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them; though they climb up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">to heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thence will I bring them down</w>:

verses.name: Amos 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And though they hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">themselves in the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">of Carmel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will search</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thence; and though they be hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">from my sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07172">in the bottom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thence will I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">the serpent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall bite</w> them:

verses.name: Amos 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And though they go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">into captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thence will I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: and I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">upon them for evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and not for good</w>.

verses.name: Amos 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">And the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it shall melt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therein shall mourn</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">wholly like a flood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08257" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall be drowned</w>, as <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02975">the flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Amos 9:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that buildeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">his stories</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath founded</w> <w lemma="strong:H092">his troop</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that calleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">for the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and poureth them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stories</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spheres</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ascensions</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>troop</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bundle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 9:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">ye not as children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03569">of the Ethiopians</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, O children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Have not I brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06430">and the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03731">from Caphtor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0758">and the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07024">from Kir</w>?

verses.name: Amos 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Behold, the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">upon the sinful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it from off the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0657">saving</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I will not utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Amos 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">For, lo, I will command</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will sift</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among all nations</w>, like as <transChange type="added">corn</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is sifted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03531">in a sieve</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06872">yet shall not the least grain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sift</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cause to move</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>grain</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stone</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02400">All the sinners</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">The evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not overtake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">nor prevent</w> us.

verses.name: Amos 9:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that is fallen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01443" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and close up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">the breaches</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof; and I will raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02034">his ruins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will build</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">it as in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>close</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hedge</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">wall</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That they may possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">and of all the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which are called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that doeth</w> this.<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon whom my name is called</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that the plowman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall overtake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the reaper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the treader</w> <w lemma="strong:H06025">of grapes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him that soweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02022">and the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall drop</w> <w lemma="strong:H06071">sweet wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and all the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">shall melt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>soweth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">draweth forth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>sweet</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">new</rdg></note>

verses.name: Amos 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall build</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and inhabit</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">the wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof; they shall also make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01593">gardens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> of them.

verses.name: Amos 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">them upon their land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they shall no more be pulled up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">out of their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen946" osisID="Amos.9"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen937" osisID="Amos" type="book"/>

verses.name: Obadiah 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02377">The vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H05662">of Obadiah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">concerning Edom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">a rumour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06735">and an ambassador</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye, and let us rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">against her in battle</w>.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">thee small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03966">thou art greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">despised</w>.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02087">The pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath deceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee, thou that dwellest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02288">in the clefts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">whose habitation</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04791">high</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Who shall bring me down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>?

verses.name: Obadiah 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Though thou exalt</w> <transChange type="added">thyself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05404">as the eagle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and though thou set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07064">thy nest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">among the stars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thence will I bring thee down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01590">If thieves</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to thee, if robbers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">how art thou cut off</w>!) <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">would they not have stolen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">till they had enough</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">if the grapegatherers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to thee, would they not leave</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05955">grapes</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>some…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">gleanings?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Obadiah 1:6
verses.text: How are <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">searched out</w>! <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04710">are his hidden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01158" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">things sought up</w>!

verses.name: Obadiah 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">All the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of thy confederacy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have brought</w> thee <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">to the border</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">that were at peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">with thee have deceived</w> thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">prevailed</w> against thee; <transChange type="added">they that eat</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">thy bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04204">a wound</w> under thee: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08394">none understanding</w> in him.<note type="study"><catchWord>that were…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of thy peace</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the men of thy bread</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in him</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Obadiah 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Shall I not in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">even destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">the wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0123">out of Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08394">and understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">out of the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>?

verses.name: Obadiah 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01368">And thy mighty</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08487">O Teman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be dismayed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the end that every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">may be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06993">by slaughter</w>.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>For <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02555">violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">against thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0955">shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thee, and thou shalt be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou stoodest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on the other side, in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">that the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">his forces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05237">and foreigners</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">into his gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03032" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lots</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">upon Jerusalem</w>, even thou <transChange type="added">wast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">as one</w> of them.<note type="study"><catchWord>captive…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">his substance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Obadiah 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But thou shouldest not have looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05235">that he became a stranger</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shouldest thou have rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">over the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of their destruction</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06310">neither shouldest thou have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">proudly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of distress</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>spoken…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">magnified thy mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Obadiah 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shouldest not have entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">into the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0343">of their calamity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, thou shouldest not have looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">on their affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0343">of their calamity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor have laid</w> <transChange type="added">hands</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02428">on their substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0343">of their calamity</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>substance</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">forces</rdg></note>

verses.name: Obadiah 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither shouldest thou have stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06563">in the crossway</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06412">those of his that did escape</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">neither shouldest thou have delivered up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">those of his that did remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of distress</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>delivered up</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shut up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Obadiah 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">upon all the heathen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as thou hast done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01576">unto thee: thy reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon thine own head</w>.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For as ye have drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">upon my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">shall all the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, they shall drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall swallow down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">and they shall be as though they had not</w> been.<note type="study"><catchWord>swallow…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sup up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Obadiah 1:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02022">But upon mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">shall be deliverance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">and there shall be holiness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H04180">their possessions</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>deliverance</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they that escape</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>there…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">it shall be holy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Obadiah 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">shall be a fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03852">a flame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H07179">for stubble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01814" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in them, and devour</w> them; and there shall not be <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08300">remaining</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:19
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">they of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05045">the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>; and <transChange type="added">they of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08219">the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">and the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w> <transChange type="added">shall possess</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w>.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01546">And the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02426">of this host</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">shall possess</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03669">that of the Canaanites</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06886">unto Zarephath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01546">and the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05614">in Sepharad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shall possess that which is in</rdg></note>

verses.name: Obadiah 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And saviours</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">on mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04410">and the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">shall be the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w>. <chapter eID="gen948" osisID="Obad.1"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen947" osisID="Obad" type="book"/>

verses.name: Jonah 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Now the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03124">came unto Jonah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0573">of Amittai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Jonah</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Jonas</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05210">to Nineveh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">that great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">against it; for their wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> me.

verses.name: Jonah 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03124">But Jonah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">unto Tarshish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03305">to Joppa</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">a ship</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">going</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">to Tarshish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so he paid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">the fare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, and went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">into it, to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">with them unto Tarshish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jonah 1:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02904" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">sent out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">into the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and there was a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05591">tempest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">in the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0591">so that the ship</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">was like</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to be broken</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sent out</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cast forth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>was like…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thought to be broken</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04419">Then the mariners</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto his god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02904" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">the wares</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0591">in the ship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">into the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to lighten</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03124">of them. But Jonah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was gone down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">into the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H05600">of the ship</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he lay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07290" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was fast asleep</w>.

verses.name: Jonah 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02259 strong:H07227">So the shipmaster</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to him, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07290" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">upon thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">if so be that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06245" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">will think</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon us, that we perish</w> not.

verses.name: Jonah 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to his fellow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and let us cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07945">for whose cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">this evil</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">upon us. So they cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01486">and the lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03124">upon Jonah</w>.

verses.name: Jonah 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">they unto him, Tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upon us; What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">thine occupation</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0370">and whence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">comest</w> thou? what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thy country</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05971">and of what people</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> thou?

verses.name: Jonah 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> unto them, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05680">an Hebrew</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03373">and I fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03004">and the dry</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the <divineName>Lord</divineName></catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate"><divineName>Jehovah</divineName></rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">Then were the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374 strong:H01419">exceedingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Why hast thou done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">this? For the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that he fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because he had told</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>exceedingly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with great fear</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 1:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they unto him, What shall we do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">unto thee, that the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H08367" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may be calm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">unto us? for the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wrought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05590" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and was tempestuous</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>may…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">may be silent from us</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>wrought…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">grew more and more tempestuous</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Take me up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02904" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and cast me forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">into the sea</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03220">so shall the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H08367" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be calm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto you: for I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07945">that for my sake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05591">tempest</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upon you.

verses.name: Jonah 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">Nevertheless the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02864" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rowed hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03004">to the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">not: for the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wrought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05590" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and was tempestuous</w> against them.<note type="study"><catchWord>rowed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">digged</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>wrought…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">grew more and more tempestuous</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore they cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0577">We beseech thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we beseech thee, let us not perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">for this man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355 strong:H05355" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">not upon us innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as it pleased</w> thee.

verses.name: Jonah 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03124">Jonah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02904" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast him forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">into the sea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03220">and the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ceased</w> <w lemma="strong:H02197">from her raging</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ceased</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">Then the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03374 strong:H01419">exceedingly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">vows</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>offered…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sacrifice unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and vowed vows</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 1:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">Now the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">had prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01709">fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to swallow up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03124">Jonah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03124">And Jonah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">was in the belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01709">of the fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nights</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>belly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bowels</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen950" osisID="Jonah.1"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03124">Then Jonah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01710">out of the fish’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">belly</w>,

verses.name: Jonah 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">by reason of mine affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">me; out of the belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">of hell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">cried</w> I, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou heardest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">out of mine affliction</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>hell</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the grave</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For thou hadst cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04688">me into the deep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the seas</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05104">and the floods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04867">me about: all thy billows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">and thy waves</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passed over</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>midst</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of thy sight</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">yet I will look</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">toward thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">temple</w>.

verses.name: Jonah 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">The waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0661" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">compassed me about</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">to the soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08415">the depth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">closed me round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05488">the weeds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">were wrapped about</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">my head</w>.

verses.name: Jonah 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07095">to the bottoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">with her bars</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">about me for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet hast thou brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">from corruption</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bottoms</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cuttings off</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>corruption</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the pit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">When my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">fainted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">within me I remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H08605">and my prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">unto thee, into thine holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">temple</w>.

verses.name: Jonah 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">They that observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">their own mercy</w>.

verses.name: Jonah 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But I will sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto thee with the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">of thanksgiving</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will pay</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have vowed</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03444">Salvation</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Jonah 2:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01709">unto the fish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06958" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and it vomited out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03124">Jonah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03004">upon the dry</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen951" osisID="Jonah.2"/>

verses.name: Jonah 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03124">came unto Jonah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">time, saying</w>,

verses.name: Jonah 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05210">unto Nineveh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">that great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and preach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07150">unto it the preaching</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I bid</w> thee.

verses.name: Jonah 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03124">So Jonah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05210">unto Nineveh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H05210">Now Nineveh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">was an exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">of three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days’</w> <w lemma="strong:H04109">journey</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>exceeding</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03124">And Jonah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04109">journey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0705">Yet forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05210">and Nineveh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall be overthrown</w>.

verses.name: Jonah 3:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">So the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05210">of Nineveh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and proclaimed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">a fast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">on sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">from the greatest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">of them even to the least</w> of them.

verses.name: Jonah 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">For word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05210">of Nineveh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">from his throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0155">his robe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">from him, and covered</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08242">with sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">in ashes</w>.

verses.name: Jonah 3:7
verses.text: And he caused <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to be proclaimed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and published</w> <w lemma="strong:H05210">through Nineveh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02940">by the decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">and his nobles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">Let neither man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">nor beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">herd</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">nor flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02938" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">taste</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">any thing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them not feed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>published</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">said</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>nobles</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">great men</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">But let man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">be covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">with sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02394">mightily</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, let them turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from his evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02555">and from the violence</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in their hands</w>.

verses.name: Jonah 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who can tell</w> <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and repent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">from his fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we perish</w> not?

verses.name: Jonah 3:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">their works</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from their evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">repented</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of the evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he would do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them; and he did</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> not. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen952" osisID="Jonah.3"/>

verses.name: Jonah 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But it displeased</w> <w lemma="strong:H03124">Jonah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451 strong:H01419">exceedingly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he was very angry</w>.

verses.name: Jonah 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">And he prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0577">I pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not this my saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">when I was yet in my country</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Therefore I fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">unto Tarshish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I knew</w> that thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02587">a gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07349">and merciful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0750">slow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">to anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and repentest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">thee of the evil</w>.

verses.name: Jonah 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore now, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">I beseech thee, my life</w> from me; for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">for me to die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">than to live</w>.

verses.name: Jonah 4:4
