verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">Doest thou well</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to be angry</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Doest…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Art thou greatly angry?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03124">So Jonah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">on the east side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">him a booth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">under it in the shadow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">till he might see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">what would become of the city</w>.

verses.name: Jonah 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H07021">a gourd</w>, and made <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03124">over Jonah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06738">that it might be a shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">over his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">him from his grief</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03124">So Jonah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057 strong:H01419">was exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07021">of the gourd</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gourd</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">palmcrist</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Kikajon</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rejoiced with great joy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">But God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H08438">a worm</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">when the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">rose</w> <w lemma="strong:H04283">the next day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and it smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07021">the gourd</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that it withered</w>.

verses.name: Jonah 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">And it came to pass, when the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">did arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H02759">a vehement</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">east</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08121">and the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">beat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03124">of Jonah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05968" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">that he fainted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wished</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">in himself</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">for me to die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">than to live</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>vehement</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">silent</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03124">to Jonah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">Doest thou well</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to be angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07021">for the gourd</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">I do well</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to be angry</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">unto death</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Doest…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Art thou greatly angry?</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>I do well…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">I am greatly angry</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast had pity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07021">on the gourd</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05998" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for the which thou hast not laboured</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">neither madest it grow</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03915 strong:H01121">which came up in a night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and perished</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915 strong:H01121">in a night</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>had pity</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spared</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>came…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was the son of the night</rdg></note>

verses.name: Jonah 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And should not I spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05210">Nineveh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">that great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">wherein are</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">than sixscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07239">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">persons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that cannot discern</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">between their right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">and their left hand</w>; and <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">cattle</w>? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen953" osisID="Jonah.4"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen949" osisID="Jonah" type="book"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">that came to Micah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04183">the Morasthite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03147">of Jotham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03169">Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">concerning Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Micah 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">all ye people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">hearken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">O earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04393">and all that therein</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">is: and let the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">be witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">against you, the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">from his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">temple</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>all ye…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ye people, all of them</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>all that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the fulness thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For, behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cometh forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">out of his place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will come down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and tread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">upon the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Micah 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">And the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be molten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">under him, and the valleys</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall be cleft</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01749">as wax</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">as the waters</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05064" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H04174">down a steep place</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a steep…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a descent</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06588">For the transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">all this, and for the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>. What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06588">the transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>? <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08111">not Samaria</w>? and what <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01116">the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>? <transChange type="added">are they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">not Jerusalem</w>?

verses.name: Micah 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05856">as an heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04302">as plantings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">of a vineyard</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05064" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will pour down</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">thereof into the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will discover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03247">the foundations</w> thereof.

verses.name: Micah 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06456">And all the graven images</w> <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">thereof shall be beaten to pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0868">and all the hires</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thereof shall be burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06091">and all the idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof will I lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for she gathered</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0868">of the hire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of an harlot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0868">to the hire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of an harlot</w>.

verses.name: Micah 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore I will wail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07758 strong:H07758" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">stripped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06174">and naked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04553">a wailing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">like the dragons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H060">and mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03284 strong:H01323">as the owls</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>owls</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">daughters of the owl</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04347">For her wound</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">incurable</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for it is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">unto Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">unto the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>her…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">she is grievously sick of her wounds</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 1:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Declare</w> ye <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01661">not at Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ye not at all</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01036">in the house of Aphrah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06428 strong:H06428" morph="strongMorph:TH8694 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8690">roll</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">thyself in the dust</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Aphrah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Dust</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Pass ye away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08208">of Saphir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01322">having thy shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H06181">naked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06630">of Zaanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came not forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04553">in the mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01018">of Beth–ezel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05979">of you his standing</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thou…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thou that dwellest fairly</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>inhabitant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">inhabitress</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Zaanan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">The country of flocks</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Beth–ezel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A place near</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For the inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04796">of Maroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">waited carefully</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07451">but evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">unto the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>inhabitant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">inhabitress</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>waited…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">was grieved</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O thou inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">of Lachish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07573" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">the chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07409">to the swift beast</w>: she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07225">the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">to the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06588">for the transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were found</w> in thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>inhabitant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">inhabitress</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore shalt thou give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07964">presents</w> <w lemma="strong:H04182">to Moresheth–gath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0392">of Achzib</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0391">a lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for Moresheth–gath</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Achzib</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">A lie</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Yet will I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">an heir</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto thee, O inhabitant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04762">of Mareshah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05725">unto Adullam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>inhabitant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">inhabitress</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>he…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the glory of Israel shall</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Micah 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07139" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Make thee bald</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01494" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and poll</w> <w lemma="strong:H08588">thee for thy delicate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">enlarge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07144">thy baldness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">as the eagle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they are gone into captivity</w> from thee. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen955" osisID="Mic.1"/>

verses.name: Micah 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">upon their beds</w>! <w lemma="strong:H01242">when the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">is light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they practise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">it, because it is</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">in the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their hand</w>.

verses.name: Micah 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they covet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">fields</w>, and take <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">by violence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">and houses</w>, and take <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so they oppress</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">even a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">and his heritage</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>oppress</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">defraud</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04940">Behold, against this family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">do I devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">from which ye shall not remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">your necks</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall ye go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07317">haughtily</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">for this time</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>.

verses.name: Micah 2:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> shall <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">a parable</w> <w lemma="strong:H05091" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against you, and lament</w> <w lemma="strong:H05093">with a doleful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05092">lamentation</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">We be utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">spoiled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04171" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he hath changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">how hath he removed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8788">from me! turning away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he hath divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">our fields</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a doleful…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a lamentation of lamentations</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>turning…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">instead of restoring</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">a cord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">by lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">in the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Micah 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Prophesy</w> ye not, <transChange type="added">say they to them that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">prophesy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they shall not prophesy</w> to them, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05253" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">shame</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Prophesy ye…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Prophesy not as they prophesy</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Drop</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Micah 2:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>O <transChange type="added">thou that art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">named</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">is the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">straitened</w>? <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04611">these his doings</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01697">do not my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">do good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to him that walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">uprightly</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>straitened</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shortened?</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>uprightly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upright?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0865">Even of late</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">is risen up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as an enemy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye pull off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0145">the robe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H08008">the garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from them that pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">by securely</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">as men averse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">from war</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of late</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">yesterday</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>with the</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">over against a</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">The women</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">have ye cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08588">from their pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05768">from their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have ye taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">my glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>women</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wives</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, and depart</w>; for this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04496">rest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">because it is polluted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">it shall destroy</w> <transChange type="added">you</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04834" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">even with a sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">destruction</w>.

verses.name: Micah 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03863">If</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">walking</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">in the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">and falsehood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03576" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">do lie</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">unto thee of wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941">and of strong drink</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he shall even be the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of this people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>walking…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">walk with the wind, and lie falsely</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 2:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">assemble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">O Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">all of thee; I will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">them together</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">as the sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01224 strong:H01223" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of Bozrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05739">as the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01699">of their fold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01949" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they shall make great noise</w> by reason of <transChange type="added">the multitude of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w>.

verses.name: Micah 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The breaker</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: they have broken up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have passed through</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and are gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">by it: and their king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them, and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the head</w> of them. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen956" osisID="Mic.2"/>

verses.name: Micah 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">I pray you, O heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07101">and ye princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not for you to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>?

verses.name: Micah 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and love</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who pluck off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">their skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07607">from off them, and their flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">from off their bones</w>;

verses.name: Micah 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who also eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07607">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and flay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">their skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06476" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">from off them; and they break</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">their bones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and chop them in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05518">as for the pot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">and as flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H07037">the caldron</w>.

verses.name: Micah 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then shall they cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he will not hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them: he will even hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">from them at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">as they have behaved themselves ill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">in their doings</w>.

verses.name: Micah 3:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">concerning the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">that make my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">err</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bite</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">with their teeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">Peace</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he that putteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">not into their mouths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they even prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w> against him.

verses.name: Micah 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03915">Therefore night</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02377">unto you, that ye shall not have a vision</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02821 strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8675">and it shall be dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto you, that ye shall not divine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08121">and the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">over the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be dark</w> over them.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: vision: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from a vision</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: divine: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from divining</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02374">Then shall the seers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the diviners</w> <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">confounded</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, they shall all cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H08222">their lips</w>; for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04617">no answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lips</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upper lip</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 3:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0199">But truly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">of power</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">by the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and of judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and of might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">his transgression</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and to Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">his sin</w>.

verses.name: Micah 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">this, I pray you, ye heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07101">and princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that abhor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06140" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and pervert</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">all equity</w>.

verses.name: Micah 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They build up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">with iniquity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07218">The heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">for reward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04242">for hire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof divine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for money</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">yet will they lean</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and say</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">us? none evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can come</w> upon us.<note type="study"><catchWord>and say</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">saying</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06726">Therefore shall Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01558">for your sake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be plowed</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">a field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05856">shall become heaps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">as the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the forest</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen957" osisID="Mic.3"/>

verses.name: Micah 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0319">But in the last</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and it shall be exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">above the hills</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05102" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall flow</w> unto it.

verses.name: Micah 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">And many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he will teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">us of his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we will walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">in his paths</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08451">for the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Micah 4:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">among many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and they shall beat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">their swords</w> <w lemma="strong:H0855">into plowshares</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02595">and their spears</w> <w lemma="strong:H04211">into pruninghooks</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">against nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall they learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w> any more.<note type="study"><catchWord>pruninghooks</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">scythes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But they shall sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">under his vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">and under his fig tree</w>; and none shall make <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">afraid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">for the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Micah 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">For all people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we will walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">and ever</w>.

verses.name: Micah 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">her that halteth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">her that is driven out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and her that I have afflicted</w>;

verses.name: Micah 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">her that halted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">a remnant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01972" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and her that was cast far off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">over them in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">from henceforth, even for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: Micah 4:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04026">And thou, O tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H04029 strong:H05739" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of the flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06076">the strong hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee shall it come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">even the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H04475">dominion</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">to the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Micah 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Now why dost thou cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07452">out aloud</w>? <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">no king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in thee? is thy counsellor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">perished</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02427">for pangs</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee as a woman in travail</w>.

verses.name: Micah 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be in pain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01518" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and labour to bring forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like a woman in travail</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for now shalt thou go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">out of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt go</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">there shalt thou be delivered</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">there the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">thee from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of thine enemies</w>.

verses.name: Micah 4:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07227">Now also many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against thee, that say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let her be defiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and let our eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">look</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">upon Zion</w>.

verses.name: Micah 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But they know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">not the thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">neither understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">they his counsel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for he shall gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05995">them as the sheaves</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">into the floor</w>.

verses.name: Micah 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01758" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and thresh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">thine horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">thy hoofs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05154">brass</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01854" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and thou shalt beat in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will consecrate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">their gain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">and their substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the whole earth</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen958" osisID="Mic.4"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01413" morph="strongMorph:TH8704">Now gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">thyself in troops</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">of troops</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">siege</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against us: they shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">with a rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H03895">upon the cheek</w>.

verses.name: Micah 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01035">But thou, Beth–lehem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0672">Ephratah</w>, <transChange type="added">though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06810">thou be little</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">among the thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">out of thee shall he come forth</w> unto me <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to be ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04163">whose goings forth</w> <transChange type="added">have been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06924">from of old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769 strong:H03117">from everlasting</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>everlasting</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the days of eternity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore will he give them up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">until the time</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">she which travaileth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath brought forth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03499">then the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Micah 5:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">in the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01347">in the majesty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall abide</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for now shall he be great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">unto the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>feed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">rule</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 5:5
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">shall be the peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0804">when the Assyrian</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into our land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when he shall tread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">in our palaces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then shall we raise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">against him seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shepherds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05257">principal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>principal</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">princes of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05248">of Nimrod</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">in the entrances</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof: thus shall he deliver</w> <transChange type="added">us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0804">from the Assyrian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when he cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into our land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when he treadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">within our borders</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>waste</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eat up</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">with her own naked swords</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07611">And the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">shall be in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">as a dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07241">as the showers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">upon the grass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that tarrieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not for man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">nor waiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>.

verses.name: Micah 5:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07611">And the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">shall be among the Gentiles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">as a lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">among the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the forest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03715">as a young lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">among the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of sheep</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who, if he go through</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">both treadeth down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and teareth in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and none can deliver</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sheep</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">goats</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">upon thine adversaries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be cut off</w>.

verses.name: Micah 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">thy horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">of thee, and I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">thy chariots</w>:

verses.name: Micah 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892 strong:H06145" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and throw down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">all thy strong holds</w>:

verses.name: Micah 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03785">witchcrafts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of thine hand</w>; and thou shalt have no <transChange type="added">more</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06049" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">soothsayers</w>:

verses.name: Micah 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06456">Thy graven images</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">also will I cut off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04676">and thy standing images</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">of thee; and thou shalt no more worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hands</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>standing…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">statues</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will pluck up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">thy groves</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">of thee: so will I destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892 strong:H06145" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">thy cities</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cities</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">enemies</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05359">vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">and fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">upon the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">such as they have not heard</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen959" osisID="Mic.5"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye now what the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saith</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">contend</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">thou before the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and let the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thy voice</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>before</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">with</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">ye, O mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">controversy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0386">and ye strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04146">foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">hath a controversy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and he will plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">with Israel</w>.

verses.name: Micah 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">O my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what have I done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto thee? and wherein have I wearied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thee? testify</w> against me.

verses.name: Micah 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">For I brought thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thee out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of servants</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">thee Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04813">and Miriam</w>.

verses.name: Micah 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">O my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">now what Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">consulted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01109">and what Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01160">of Beor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07851">him from Shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">unto Gilgal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that ye may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">the righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Micah 6:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Wherewith shall I come before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03721" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">myself before the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall I come before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">him with burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05695">with calves</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of a year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>of a…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sons of a year?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Will the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">with thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of rams</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07233">with ten thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">my firstborn</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06588">my transgression</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of my body</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of my soul</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>body</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">belly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He hath shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">thee, O man</w>, what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and what doth the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">require</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of thee, but to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">justly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0160">and to love</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06800" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">humbly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">with thy God</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>walk…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">humble thyself to walk</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">crieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto the city</w>, and <transChange type="added">the man of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08454">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">ye the rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and who hath appointed</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>the man…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thy name shall see that which is</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 6:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0786">Are there</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">yet the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H07562" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">of wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07332">and the scant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">measure</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02194" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">abominable</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Are…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Is there yet unto every man an house of the</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>scant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">measure of leanness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 6:11
verses.text: Shall I count <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02135" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">with the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03976">balances</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03599">and with the bag</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">of deceitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">weights</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>count…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">be pure with</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Micah 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06223">For the rich men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof are full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">of violence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thereof have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">and their tongue</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07423">deceitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in their mouth</w>.

verses.name: Micah 6:13
verses.text: Therefore also will I make <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">sick</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">in smiting</w> thee, in making <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">because of thy sins</w>.

verses.name: Micah 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but not be satisfied</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03445">and thy casting down</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05253" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of thee; and thou shalt take hold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but shalt not deliver</w>; and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">which thou deliverest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I give up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">to the sword</w>.

verses.name: Micah 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt sow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but thou shalt not reap</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt tread</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">the olives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05480" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but thou shalt not anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">thee with oil</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08492">and sweet wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but shalt not drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w>.

verses.name: Micah 6:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02708">For the statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06018">of Omri</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">are kept</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">and all the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H04156">in their counsels</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I should make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">thee a desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08322">thereof an hissing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore ye shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">the reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>For the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">For he doth much keep the</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>desolation</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">astonishment</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen960" osisID="Mic.6"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0480">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0625">is me! for I am as when they have gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">the summer fruits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05955">as the grapegleanings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01210">of the vintage</w>: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0811">no cluster</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">desired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01063">the firstripe fruit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the gatherings of summer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02623">The good</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is perished</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the earth</w>: and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">none upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">among men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they all lie in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">for blood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they hunt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">with a net</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>good</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">godly</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">merciful</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 7:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07451">That they may do evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">with both hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">earnestly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">asketh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the judge</w> <transChange type="added">asketh</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07966">for a reward</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01419">and the great</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he uttereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01942">his mischievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">desire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05686" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">so they wrap it up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the mischief of his soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">The best</w> of them <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02312">as a brier</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03477">the most upright</w> <transChange type="added">is sharper</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04534">than a thorn hedge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of thy watchmen</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06486">thy visitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cometh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03998">now shall be their perplexity</w>.

verses.name: Micah 7:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">ye not in a friend</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put ye not confidence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0441">in a guide</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of thy mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from her that lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">in thy bosom</w>.

verses.name: Micah 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">For the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">dishonoureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">riseth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">against her mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03618">the daughter in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H02545">against her mother in law</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">enemies</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of his own house</w>.

verses.name: Micah 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Therefore I will look</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">for the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of my salvation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will hear</w> me.

verses.name: Micah 7:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">not against me, O mine enemy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when I fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I shall arise</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when I sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">in darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0216">a light</w> unto me.

verses.name: Micah 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02197">the indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because I have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against him, until he plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">my cause</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for me: he will bring me forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">to the light</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I shall behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">his righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Micah 7:10
verses.text: Then <transChange type="added">she that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">mine enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0955">and shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">her which said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto me, Where is the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04823">her: now shall she be trodden down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02916">as the mire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">of the streets</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Then…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">And thou wilt see her that is mine enemy, and cover her with shame</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>shall she…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">she shall be for a treading down</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 7:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">In</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01447">that thy walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">are to be built</w>, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">shall the decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be far removed</w>.

verses.name: Micah 7:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">In</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">even to thee from Assyria</w>, and <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04693">the fortified</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04693">and from the fortress</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">even to the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">and from sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">to sea</w>, and <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to mountain</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and <transChange type="added">from</transChange> the fortified cities</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">even to the fortified cities</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Notwithstanding the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">shall be desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because of them that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">therein, for the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of their doings</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Notwithstanding</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">After that it hath been</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 7:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">with thy rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of thine heritage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0910">solitarily</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03293">the wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">of Carmel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them feed</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01316">Bashan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">and Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Feed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Rule</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">According to the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of thy coming</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">unto him marvellous</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.

verses.name: Micah 7:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01471">The nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">at all their might</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall lay</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> upon <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">their ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be deaf</w>.

verses.name: Micah 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03897" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">They shall lick</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">like a serpent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall move</w> <w lemma="strong:H04526">out of their holes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02119" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">like worms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall fear</w> because of thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>worms</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">creeping things</rdg></note>

verses.name: Micah 7:18
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like unto thee, that pardoneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and passeth by</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">the transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">of the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of his heritage</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he retaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">not his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he delighteth</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w>.

verses.name: Micah 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He will turn again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he will have compassion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03533" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon us; he will subdue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">our iniquities</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thou wilt cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">all their sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H04688">into the depths</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>.

verses.name: Micah 7:20
