verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou wilt perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">the truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">to Jacob</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">the mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">to Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which thou hast sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of old</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen961" osisID="Mic.7"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen954" osisID="Mic" type="book"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05210">of Nineveh</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05612">The book</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">of the vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H05151">of Nahum</w> <w lemma="strong:H0512">the Elkoshite</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07072">jealous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">revengeth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">revengeth</w>, and <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02534 strong:H01167">furious</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">will take vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">on his adversaries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05201" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he reserveth</w> <transChange type="added">wrath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for his enemies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>God…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is a jealous God, and a revenger</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>is furious</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that hath fury</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0750">slow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">to anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">in power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and will not at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">acquit</w> <transChange type="added">the wicked</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05492">in the whirlwind</w> <w lemma="strong:H08183">and in the storm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">and the clouds</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H080">the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of his feet</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01605" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He rebuketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and maketh it dry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and drieth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">all the rivers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01316">Bashan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">languisheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03760">and Carmel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06525">and the flower</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">languisheth</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">The mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">quake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">at him, and the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8712">melt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at his presence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08398">yea, the world</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all that dwell</w> therein.

verses.name: Nahum 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who can stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">his indignation</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and who can abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">in the fierceness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of his anger</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02534">his fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">like fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06697">and the rocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are thrown down</w> by him.<note type="study"><catchWord>abide</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stand up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04581">a strong hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that trust</w> in him.<note type="study"><catchWord>strong hold</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But with an overrunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07858">flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">an utter end</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">thereof, and darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his enemies</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">What do ye imagine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">an utter end</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06869">affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">the second time</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 1:10
verses.text: For while <transChange type="added">they be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05440" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">folden together</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05518">thorns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05433" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and while they are drunken</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05435">drunkards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">they shall be devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H07179">as stubble</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">fully</w> <w lemma="strong:H03002">dry</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 1:11
verses.text: There is <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of thee, that imagineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01100">a wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">counsellor</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a wicked…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a counsellor of Belial</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; Though <transChange type="added">they be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08003">quiet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and likewise many</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01494" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">yet thus shall they be cut down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when he shall pass through</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Though I have afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee, I will afflict</w> thee no more.<note type="study"><catchWord>Though…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">If they would have been at peace, so should they have been many, and so should they have been shorn, and he should have passed away</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cut down</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shorn</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For now will I break</w> <w lemma="strong:H04132">his yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-386">from off thee, and will burst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04147">thy bonds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-386">in sunder</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath given a commandment</w> concerning thee, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">no more of thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be sown</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of thy gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">the graven image</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">and the molten image</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">thy grave</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou art vile</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">Behold upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">the feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of him that bringeth good tidings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that publisheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>! <w lemma="strong:H03063">O Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02287" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">thy solemn feasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">thy vows</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01100">for the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thee; he is utterly cut off</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>keep…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">feast</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the wicked</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Belial</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen963" osisID="Nah.1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He that dasheth in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before thy face</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04694">the munition</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w>, make <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04975">loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">fortify</w> <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">mightily</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">The disperser</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">hammer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath turned away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">the excellency</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01347">as the excellency</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01238" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for the emptiers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01238" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have emptied them out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and marred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02156">their vine branches</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the excellency of Jacob…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the pride of Jacob as the pride</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Nahum 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04043">The shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of his mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0119" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">is made red</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">the valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08529" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">in scarlet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07393">the chariots</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with flaming</w> <w lemma="strong:H06393">torches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">of his preparation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01265">and the fir trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H07477" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">shall be terribly shaken</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in scarlet</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dyed scarlet</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>flaming</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fiery</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07393">The chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8704">shall rage</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">in the streets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08264" morph="strongMorph:TH8698">they shall justle one against another</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the broad ways</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04758">they shall seem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03940">like torches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">they shall run</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">like the lightnings</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their show</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall recount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0117">his worthies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall stumble</w> <w lemma="strong:H01979">in their walk</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they shall make haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">to the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thereof, and the defence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">shall be prepared</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>worthies</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">gallants</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>defence</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">covering</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">coverer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08179">The gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">of the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be opened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01964">and the palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be dissolved</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dissolved</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">molten</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">And Huzzab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">shall be led away captive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">she shall be brought up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">and her maids</w> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">shall lead</w> <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">as with the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">of doves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08608" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">tabering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">upon their breasts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Huzzab</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that which was established</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">there was a stand made</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>led…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">discovered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05210">But Nineveh</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of old</w> <w lemma="strong:H01295">like a pool</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">yet they shall flee away</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">stand</w>, <transChange type="added">shall they cry</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">but none shall look back</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of old</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from the days that she hath been</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>look back</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cause them to turn</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take ye the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>: for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">none end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08498">of the store</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H02532">out of all the pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">furniture</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and their infinite store</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vessels of desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0950">She is empty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04003">and void</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01110" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and waste</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">and the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">melteth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01290">and the knees</w> <w lemma="strong:H06375">smite together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02479">and much pain</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04975">in all loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and the faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">of them all gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H06289">blackness</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 2:11
verses.text: Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04583">the dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">of the lions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04829">and the feedingplace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">of the young lions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0738">where the lion</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03833">the old lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">walked</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0738">the lion’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01482">whelp</w>, and none made <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">afraid</w>?

verses.name: Nahum 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0738">The lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">did tear in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">enough</w> <w lemma="strong:H01484">for his whelps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02614" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and strangled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03833">for his lionesses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02356">his holes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">with prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04585">and his dens</w> <w lemma="strong:H02966">with ravin</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 2:13
verses.text: Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">against thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">her chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06227">in the smoke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">and the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">thy young lions</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">thy prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">of thy messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall no more be heard</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen964" osisID="Nah.2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">to the bloody</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>! it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04392">all full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03585">of lies</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06563">robbery</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02964">the prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">departeth</w> not;<note type="study"><catchWord>bloody…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">city of bloods</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">The noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07752">of a whip</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07494">of the rattling</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">of the wheels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and of the pransing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07540" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and of the jumping</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">chariots</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06571">The horseman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">lifteth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03851">both the bright</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">and the glittering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">spear</w>: and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07230">a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">of slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03514">and a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06297">number of carcases</w>; and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">none end</w> of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01472">corpses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03782 strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">they stumble</w> <w lemma="strong:H01472">upon their corpses</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>the bright…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the flame of the sword, and the lightning of the spear</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">Because of the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H02183">of the whoredoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580 strong:H02896">of the wellfavoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">harlot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01172">the mistress</w> <w lemma="strong:H03785">of witchcrafts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that selleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H02183">through her whoredoms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">and families</w> <w lemma="strong:H03785">through her witchcrafts</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 3:5
verses.text: Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">against thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and I will discover</w> <w lemma="strong:H07757">thy skirts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon thy face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04626">thy nakedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">and the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H07036">thy shame</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">abominable filth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon thee, and make thee vile</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07210">thee as a gazingstock</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 3:7
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all they that look</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon thee shall flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from thee, and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05210">Nineveh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is laid waste</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who will bemoan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0370">her? whence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall I seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">comforters</w> for thee?

verses.name: Nahum 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Art thou better</w> <w lemma="strong:H0528 strong:H0527" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">than populous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04996">No</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that was situate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">among the rivers</w>, <transChange type="added">that had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02426">it, whose rampart</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02346">her wall</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">from the sea</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>populous…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">nourishing</rdg>, etc: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">No Amon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03568">Ethiopia</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">and Egypt</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06109">her strength</w>, and <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097 strong:H0369">infinite</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06316">Put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03864">and Lubim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">were thy helpers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thy helpers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in thy help</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 3:10
verses.text: Yet <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01473">she carried away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">into captivity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05768">her young children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07376" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">also were dashed in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">at the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">of all the streets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03032" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lots</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">for her honourable men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and all her great men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07576" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">were bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H02131">in chains</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou also shalt be drunken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thou shalt be hid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou also shalt seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because of the enemy</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04013">All thy strong holds</w> <transChange type="added">shall be like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08384">fig trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01061">with the firstripe figs</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">if they be shaken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall even fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">into the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the eater</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Behold, thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> of thee <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall be set wide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">open</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto thine enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">thy bars</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">thee waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">for the siege</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">fortify</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">thy strong holds</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02916">into clay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and tread</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">the morter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">make strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04404">the brickkiln</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">There shall the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">thee; the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall cut thee off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall eat thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03218">like the cankerworm</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">make thyself many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03218">as the cankerworm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">make thyself many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0697">as the locusts</w>.

verses.name: Nahum 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Thou hast multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy merchants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">above the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03218">the cankerworm</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spoileth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and flieth away</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>spoileth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spreadeth himself</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04502">Thy crowned</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0697">as the locusts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02951">and thy captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H01462">as the great grasshoppers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01448">in the hedges</w> <w lemma="strong:H07135">in the cold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08121">when the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ariseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8776">they flee away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">and their place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is not known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0335">where</w> they <transChange type="added">are</transChange>.

verses.name: Nahum 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Thy shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05123" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">slumber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0117">thy nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> <transChange type="added">in the dust</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06335" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and no man gathereth</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>nobles</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">valiant ones</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nahum 3:19
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03545">no healing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">of thy bruise</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04347">thy wound</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is grievous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">the bruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of thee shall clap</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>healing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wrinkling</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen965" osisID="Nah.3"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen962" osisID="Nah" type="book"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H02265">which Habakkuk</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did see</w>.

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">how long shall I cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou wilt not hear</w>! <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cry out</w> unto thee <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02555">violence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thou wilt not save</w>!

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Why dost thou shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">me iniquity</w>, and cause <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">grievance</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07701">for spoiling</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">and violence</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> before me: and there are <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">strife</w> <w lemma="strong:H04066">and contention</w>.

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08451">Therefore the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is slacked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">doth never</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go forth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">for the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03803" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">doth compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">about the righteous</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06127" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">therefore wrong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">proceedeth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wrong</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wrested</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">ye among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and regard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08539" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and wonder</w> <w lemma="strong:H08539" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">marvellously</w>: for <transChange type="added">I</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">will work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">a work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in your days</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye will not believe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">though it be told</w> <transChange type="added">you</transChange>.

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">For, lo, I raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">the Chaldeans</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04751">bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and hasty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which shall march</w> <w lemma="strong:H04800">through the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the dwellingplaces</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> not theirs.<note type="study"><catchWord>breadth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">breadths</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:7
verses.text: They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0366">terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and dreadful</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04941">their judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07613">and their dignity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall proceed</w> of themselves.<note type="study"><catchWord>their judgment…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from them shall proceed the judgment of these, and the captivity of these</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05483">Their horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also are swifter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05246">than the leopards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02300" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and are more fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">than the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H02061">wolves</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06571">and their horsemen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06335" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">themselves, and their horsemen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">from far</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall fly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">as the eagle</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hasteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fierce</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sharp</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">all for violence</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06440">their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H04041">shall sup up</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06921">the east wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02344">as the sand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the supping up of their faces</rdg>, etc: or, <rdg type="alternate">their faces shall look (Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the opposition of their faces</rdg>) toward the east</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07046" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">And they shall scoff</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">at the kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07336" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04890">shall be a scorn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them: they shall deride</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">every strong hold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06651" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they shall heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">dust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and take</w> it.

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:11
verses.text: Then shall <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">change</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall pass over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and offend</w>, <transChange type="added">imputing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02098">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">his power</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">unto his god</w>.

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06924">thou not from everlasting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">mine Holy One</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we shall not die</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast ordained</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">them for judgment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06697">and, O mighty God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast established</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">them for correction</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mighty…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rock</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>established</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">founded</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Thou art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">of purer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">than to behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and canst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not look</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">on iniquity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">wherefore lookest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou upon them that deal treacherously</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">holdest thy tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">when the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">devoureth</w> <transChange type="added">the man that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">more righteous</w> than he?<note type="study"><catchWord>iniquity</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">grievance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And makest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01709">as the fishes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07431">as the creeping things</w>, <transChange type="added">that have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">no ruler</w> over them?<note type="study"><catchWord>creeping</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">moving</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">They take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02443">all of them with the angle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01641" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they catch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">them in their net</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H04365">them in their drag</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore they rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and are glad</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>drag</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">flue net</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Therefore they sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">unto their net</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and burn incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H04365">unto their drag</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01992">because by them</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">their portion</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08082">fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03978">and their meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01277">plenteous</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>plenteous</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dainty</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Shall they therefore empty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">their net</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w>? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen967" osisID="Hab.1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">upon my watch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">me upon the tower</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and will watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">what he will say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto me, and what I shall answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">when I am reproved</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>tower</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fenced place</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>unto me</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in me</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when I am argued with</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon my reproof</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">arguing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Write</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">the vision</w>, and make <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0874" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">upon tables</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he may run</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that readeth</w> it.

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02377">For the vision</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04150">yet for an appointed time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07093">but at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06315" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it shall speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03576" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and not lie</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04102" morph="strongMorph:TH8698">though it tarry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02442" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for it; because it will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">it will not tarry</w>.

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">Behold, his soul</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06075" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is not upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">in him: but the just</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall live</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">by his faith</w>.

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Yea also, because he transgresseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">by wine</w>, <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03093">a proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05115" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither keepeth at home</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">who enlargeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">as hell</w>, and <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">as death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cannot be satisfied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but gathereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">unto him all nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and heapeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto him all people</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Yea…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">How much more</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall not all these take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">a parable</w> <w lemma="strong:H04426">against him, and a taunting</w> <w lemma="strong:H02420">proverb</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against him, and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to him that increaseth</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">not his! how long? and to him that ladeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05671">himself with thick clay</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>Woe…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ho, he</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall they not rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06621">suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that shall bite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, and awake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02111" morph="strongMorph:TH8772">that shall vex</w> <w lemma="strong:H04933">thee, and thou shalt be for booties</w> unto them?

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because thou hast spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">all the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">thee; because of men’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>, and <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02555">the violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07151">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and of all that dwell</w> therein.<note type="study"><catchWord>blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01214" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to him that coveteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">covetousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he may set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07064">his nest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">on high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that he may be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">from the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of evil</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>coveteth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">gaineth and evil gain</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>power…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">palm of the hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast consulted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to thy house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07096" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by cutting off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and hast sinned</w> <transChange type="added">against</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w>.

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H068">For the stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall cry out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">of the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03714">and the beam out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of the timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall answer</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>beam</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">piece</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">fastening</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>answer it</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">witness against it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to him that buildeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">a town</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">and stablisheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">by iniquity</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:13
verses.text: Behold, <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">that the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">in the very</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03816">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03286" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">themselves for very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07385">vanity</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>for…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in vain?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">For the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with the knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">as the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">by knowing the glory</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">unto him that giveth his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05596" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that puttest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02573">thy bottle</w> to <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, and makest <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">drunken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">also, that thou mayest look</w> <w lemma="strong:H04589">on their nakedness</w>!

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou art filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07036">with shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">for glory</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H06188" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03563">the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07022">unto thee, and shameful spewing</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">on thy glory</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">more with shame than with glory</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02555">For the violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H07701">thee, and the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of beasts</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">made them afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">because of men’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02555">and for the violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07151">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and of all that dwell</w> therein.

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">What profiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">the graven image</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that the maker</w> <w lemma="strong:H06458" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof hath graven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">it; the molten image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and a teacher</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">of lies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that the maker</w> <w lemma="strong:H03336">of his work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">trusteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">therein, to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0483">dumb</w> <w lemma="strong:H0457">idols</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>maker of…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fashioner of his fashion</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto him that saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">to the wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Awake</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01748">to the dumb</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it shall teach</w>! Behold, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">over with gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">no breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">at all in the midst</w> of it.

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">temple</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">let all the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02013" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">keep silence</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>let…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be silent all the earth before him</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen968" osisID="Hab.2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08605">A prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02265">of Habakkuk</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07692">upon Shigionoth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>upon…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">according to variable songs</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">tunes, called in Hebrew, Shigionoth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">thy speech</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was afraid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">revive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">thy work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">make known</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07267">in wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">mercy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>speech</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">report</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">hearing</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>revive</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">preserve alive</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0433">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08487">from Teman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">and the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06290">Paran</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01935">His glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was full</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">of his praise</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Teman</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the south</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:4
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05051">brightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">was as the light</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07161">he had horns</w> <transChange type="added">coming</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of his hand</w>: and there <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02253">the hiding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of his power</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>horns…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bright beams out of his side</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">Before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">the pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07565">and burning coals</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">at his feet</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>coals</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">diseases</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He stood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04128" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">and measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he beheld</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05425" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and drove asunder</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05703">and the everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H02042">mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">were scattered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">the perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did bow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01979">his ways</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">everlasting</w>.

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03572">of Cushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">in affliction</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03407">the curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did tremble</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Cushan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ethiopia</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">under affliction</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">vanity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Was the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">displeased</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">against the rivers</w>? <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">thine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">against the rivers</w>? <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05678">thy wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">against the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou didst ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">upon thine horses</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04818">thy chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">of salvation</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">were salvation?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07198">Thy bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06181">was made quite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05783" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">naked</w>, <transChange type="added">according</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07621">to the oaths</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribes</w>, <transChange type="added">even thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0562">word</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou didst cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">with rivers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>earth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">rivers of the earth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">The mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they trembled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02230">the overflowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passed by</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08415">the deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">uttered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07315">on high</w>.

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">The sun</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03394">moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stood still</w> <w lemma="strong:H02073">in their habitation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0216">at the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">of thine arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they went</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05051">at the shining</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">of thy glittering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">spear</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>at the light…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thine arrows walked in the light</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06805" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou didst march through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">in indignation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01758" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou didst thresh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in anger</w>.

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou wentest forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">for the salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03468">for salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">with thine anointed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou woundedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">by discovering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03247">the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">unto the neck</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">making naked</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou didst strike through</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">with his staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H06518">of his villages</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05590" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they came out as a whirlwind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05951">me: their rejoicing</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as to devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04565">secretly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>came…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were tempestuous</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou didst walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">through the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">with thine horses</w>, <transChange type="added">through</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02563">the heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>heap</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mud</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When I heard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0990">my belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">trembled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08193">my lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H06750" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">quivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">at the voice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07538">rottenness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">into my bones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I trembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in myself, that I might rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he cometh up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01464" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he will invade them with his troops</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>invade…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cut them in pieces</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08384">Although the fig tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not blossom</w>, neither <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02981">fruit</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01612">in the vines</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04639">the labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">of the olive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall fail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07709">and the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">no meat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H01504" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H04356">from the fold</w>, and <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01241">no herd</w> <w lemma="strong:H07517">in the stalls</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>fail</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lie</rdg></note>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yet I will rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">in the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of my salvation</w>.

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03069">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02428">my strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0355">like hinds’</w> <transChange type="added">feet</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he will make me to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">upon mine high places</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief singer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05058">on my stringed instruments</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chief…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">overseer</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>stringed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Neginoth</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen969" osisID="Hab.3"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen966" osisID="Hab" type="book"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06846">which came unto Zephaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03570">of Cushi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">of Gedaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0568">of Amariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">of Hizkiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0526">of Amon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I will utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05486" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">consume</w> all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0127 strong:H06440">from off the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I will…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">By taking away I will make an end</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the land</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the face of the land</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05486" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05486" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01709">and the fishes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04384">and the stumblingblocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">with the wicked</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stumblingblocks</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">idols</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will also stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">upon Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and upon all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07605">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">from this place</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03649">of the Chemarims</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">with the priests</w>;

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">And them that worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">upon the housetops</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and them that worship</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and that swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">by Malcham</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>by the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05472" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And them that are turned back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; and <transChange type="added">those</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that have not sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor enquired</w> for him.

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02013" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Hold thy peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">at hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">a sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath bid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">his guests</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bid</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sanctified</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">prepared</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all such as are clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">with strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H04403">apparel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>punish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visit upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the same day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also will I punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01801" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all those that leap</w> <w lemma="strong:H04670">on the threshold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">their masters’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">with violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">and deceit</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">that there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06818">of a cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01709">from the fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03215">and an howling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">from the second</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">crashing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">from the hills</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:11
