verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04389">of Maktesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03667">for all the merchant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are cut down</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05187">all they that bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are cut off</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">And it shall come to pass at that time</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will search</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">with candles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07087" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that are settled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08105">on their lees</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in their heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will not do good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">neither will he do evil</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>settled</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">curded</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">thickened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02428">Therefore their goods</w> <w lemma="strong:H04933">shall become a booty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and their houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">a desolation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall also build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but not inhabit</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but not drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">the wine</w> thereof.

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">The great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w>, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04118">and hasteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01368">the mighty man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06873" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">there bitterly</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">That day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">of wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H04691">and distress</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07722">of wasteness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04875">and desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">of darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0653">and gloominess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">of clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H06205">and thick darkness</w>,

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">A day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">and alarm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">against the fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01364">and against the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">towers</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will bring distress</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">upon men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they shall walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H05787">like blind men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01818">and their blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">shall be poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">as dust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03894">and their flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01561">as the dung</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03701">Neither their silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">nor their gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">them in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">wrath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">but the whole land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">by the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">of his jealousy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">even a speedy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">riddance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all them that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen971" osisID="Zeph.1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07197" morph="strongMorph:TH8703">Gather yourselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07197" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yea, gather together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">O nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03700" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">not desired</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>not…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">not desirous</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02706">Before the decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">bring forth</w>, <transChange type="added">before</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H04671">as the chaff</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">the fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">upon you, before the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> upon you.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06035">all ye meek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which have wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">his judgment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06038">meekness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0194">it may be</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">ye shall be hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05804">For Gaza</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shall be forsaken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0831">and Ashkelon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">a desolation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they shall drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0795">Ashdod</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">at the noon day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06138">and Ekron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be rooted up</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">coast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03774">of the Cherethites</w>! <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03667">against you; O Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I will even destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee, that there shall be no inhabitant</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03220">And the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">shall be dwellings</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03741">cottages</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for shepherds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01448">and folds</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">for flocks</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02256">And the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">shall be for the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thereupon: in the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0831">of Ashkelon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">in the evening</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622 strong:H07622" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">their captivity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">the reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01421">and the revilings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whereby they have reproached</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and magnified</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">against their border</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:9
verses.text: Therefore <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04124">Surely Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">shall be as Sodom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">as Gomorrah</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04476">the breeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02738">of nettles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04417 strong:H04379">and saltpits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769 strong:H05704">and a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">desolation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07611">the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">them, and the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall possess</w> them.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01347">This shall they have for their pride</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because they have reproached</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and magnified</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">against the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H07329" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them: for he will famish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">all the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; and <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">him, every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">from his place</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0339">all the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>famish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">make lean</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03569">Ye Ethiopians</w> <w lemma="strong:H01992">also, ye</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by my sword</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he will stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">against the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">Assyria</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05210">Nineveh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">a desolation</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06723">dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">like a wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05739">And flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of her, all the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06893">both the cormorant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07090">and the bittern</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03730">in the upper lintels</w> of it; <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">shall sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">in the windows</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02721">desolation</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05592">in the thresholds</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for he shall uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H0731">the cedar work</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cormorant</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pelican</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>upper…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">knops</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">chapiters</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>for…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when he hath uncovered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:15
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05947">the rejoicing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">carelessly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in her heart</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0657">none beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">me: how is she become a desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">a place for beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04769">to lie down in</w>! <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one that passeth by</w> <w lemma="strong:H08319" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her shall hiss</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">wag</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen972" osisID="Zeph.2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04754" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to her that is filthy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01351" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and polluted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the oppressing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>her…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">gluttonous</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">craw</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">She obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not the voice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she received</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">not correction</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she drew not near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to her God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>correction</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">instruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Her princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> her <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">roaring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">lions</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">her judges</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06153">evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H02061">wolves</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01633" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they gnaw not the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">till the morrow</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">Her prophets</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06348" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">light</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0900">treacherous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">persons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">her priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02554" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have done violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">to the law</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The just</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof; he will not do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01242">every</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doth he bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">his judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">to light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05737" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">he faileth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05767">not; but the unjust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">no shame</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>every…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">morning by morning</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06438">their towers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are desolate</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02351">I made their streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that none passeth by</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05892">their cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H06658" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are destroyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">so that there is no man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that there is none inhabitant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>towers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">corners</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Surely thou wilt fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, thou wilt receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">instruction</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04583">so their dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">should not be cut off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03605 strong:H0834">howsoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I punished</w> <w lemma="strong:H0403">them: but</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they rose early</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">corrupted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">all their doings</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02442" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Therefore wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">ye upon me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">until the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05706">to the prey</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04941">for my determination</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I may assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdoms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">upon them mine indignation</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02740">all my fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">for all the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">of my jealousy</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For then will I turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">a pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">language</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they may all call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">upon the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">him with one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">consent</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>language</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lip</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>consent</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shoulder</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05676">From beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">of Ethiopia</w> <w lemma="strong:H06282">my suppliants</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of my dispersed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">mine offering</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou not be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">for all thy doings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein thou hast transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against me: for then I will take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05947">of thee them that rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01346">in thy pride</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thou shalt no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be haughty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">because of my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>because…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in my holy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I will also leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">of thee an afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">and poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07611">The remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">nor speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">lies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08649">neither shall a deceitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in their mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they shall feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lie down</w>, and none shall make <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">afraid</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">shout</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">with all the heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thy judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thine enemy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of thee: thou shalt not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> any more.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> thou not: <transChange type="added">and to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">Let not thine hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be slack</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>slack</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">faint</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> of thee <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he will save</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he will rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">over thee with joy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he will rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">in his love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he will joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">over thee with singing</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rest</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be silent</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will gather</w> <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03013" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">sorrowful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">for the solemn assembly</w>, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> are of thee, <transChange type="added">to whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02781">the reproach</w> of it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04864">a burden</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>reproach…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the burden upon it was reproach</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">Behold, at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I will undo</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">all that afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee: and I will save</w> <w lemma="strong:H06760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">her that halteth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">her that was driven out</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will get</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">them praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">and fame</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in every land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">where they have been put to shame</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>get…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set them for a praise</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>where…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of their shame</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">At that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I bring</w> you <transChange type="added">again</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">even in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that I gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you: for I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">you a name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">and a praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among all people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I turn back</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">your captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before your eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen973" osisID="Zeph.3"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen970" osisID="Zeph" type="book"/>

verses.name: Haggai 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">In the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01867">of Darius</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08345">in the sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">came the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H02292">Haggai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02216">unto Zerubbabel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07597">of Shealtiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06346">governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">and to Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03087">of Josedech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>governor</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">captain</rdg></note>

verses.name: Haggai 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">This people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">The time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is not come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">should be built</w>.

verses.name: Haggai 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Then came the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H02292">Haggai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Haggai 1:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for you, O ye, to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05603" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">in your cieled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and this house</w> <transChange type="added">lie</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02720">waste</w>?

verses.name: Haggai 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Now therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03824 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">your ways</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Consider…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Set your heart on your ways</rdg></note>

verses.name: Haggai 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have sown</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">much</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">in little</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ye eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07654">but ye have not enough</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ye drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but ye are not filled with drink</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ye clothe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02527">you, but there is none warm</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and he that earneth wages</w> <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">earneth wages</w> <transChange type="added">to put it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06872">into a bag</w> <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">with holes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with holes</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pierced through</rdg></note>

verses.name: Haggai 1:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03824 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">your ways</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Consider…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Set your heart on your ways</rdg></note>

verses.name: Haggai 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to the mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will take pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">in it, and I will be glorified</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Haggai 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Ye looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">for much</w>, and, lo, <transChange type="added">it came</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">to little</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and when ye brought</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">home</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05301" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I did blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">upon it. Why? saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03282">Because</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of mine house</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02720">waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and ye run</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto his own house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blow…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">blow it away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Haggai 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">Therefore the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">over you is stayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">from dew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is stayed</w> <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02981">her fruit</w>.

verses.name: Haggai 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02721">for a drought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and upon the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01715">and upon the corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">and upon the new wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">and upon the oil</w>, and upon <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0127">which the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bringeth forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">and upon men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and upon cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03018">and upon all the labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">of the hands</w>.

verses.name: Haggai 1:12

verses.name: Haggai 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02292">Haggai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04400">message</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">with you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Haggai 2:3
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">among you that saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">this house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">in her first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and how do ye see</w> it now? <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">not in your eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03644">in comparison</w> of it as nothing?

verses.name: Haggai 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Yet now be strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02216">O Zerubbabel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">O Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03087">of Josedech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">all ye people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and work</w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">with you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>:

verses.name: Haggai 2:5

verses.name: Haggai 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">Yet once</w>, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little while</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and I will shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">and the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02724">and the dry</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange>;

verses.name: Haggai 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">all nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02532">and the desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and I will fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">this house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">with glory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Haggai 2:8

verses.name: Haggai 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03519">The glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">of this latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">shall be greater than</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the former</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04725">and in this place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Haggai 2:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0702">In the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08671">of the ninth</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01867">of Darius</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">came the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H02292">Haggai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Haggai 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">now the priests</w> <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Haggai 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">If one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">in the skirt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of his garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03671">and with his skirt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05138">or pottage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">or wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">or oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03978">or any meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall it be holy</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, No.

verses.name: Haggai 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02292">Haggai</w>, If <transChange type="added">one that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">by a dead body</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">any of these, shall it be unclean</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">It shall be unclean</w>.

verses.name: Haggai 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02292">Haggai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, So <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w>, and so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">this nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; and so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">every work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their hands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and that which they offer</w> there <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>.

verses.name: Haggai 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03824 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And now, I pray you, consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02962">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">a stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">upon a stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">in the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Haggai 2:16
verses.text: Since those <transChange type="added">days</transChange> were, when <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06194">to an heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">of twenty</w> <transChange type="added">measures</transChange>, there were <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w>: when <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03342">to the pressfat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02834" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for to draw out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <transChange type="added">vessels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06333">out of the press</w>, there were <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w>.

verses.name: Haggai 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07711">you with blasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03420">and with mildew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01259">and with hail</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">in all the labours</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of your hands</w>; yet ye <transChange type="added">turned</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">not to me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Haggai 2:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03824 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">now from this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">from the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08671">of the ninth</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">that the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">was laid, consider</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Haggai 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">Is the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04035">yet in the barn</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01612">yea, as yet the vine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08384">and the fig tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07416">and the pomegranate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02132">and the olive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not brought forth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">from this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I bless</w> <transChange type="added">you</transChange>.

verses.name: Haggai 2:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08145">And again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02292">came unto Haggai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">in the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Haggai 2:22

verses.name: Haggai 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02216">thee, O Zerubbabel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07597">of Shealtiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02368">thee as a signet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen976" osisID="Hag.2"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen974" osisID="Hag" type="book"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 1:3

verses.name: Zechariah 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Be ye not as your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">unto whom the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">ye now from your evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w>, and <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">your evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">doings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they did not hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">nor hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Your fathers</w>, where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">they? and the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do they live</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>?

verses.name: Zechariah 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">But my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">and my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did they not take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Like as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02161" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">unto us, according to our ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04611">and according to our doings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so hath he dealt</w> with us.<note type="study"><catchWord>take…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">overtake</rdg></note>

verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0702">Upon the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H06249">of the eleventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H07627">Sebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01867">of Darius</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">came the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">unto Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01296">of Berechiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05714">of Iddo</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Zechariah 1:8

And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with me said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto me, I will shew</w> thee what these <transChange type="added">be</transChange>.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01918">among the myrtle trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, These <transChange type="added">are they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to and fro through the earth</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01918">among the myrtle trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">We have walked to and fro</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and, behold, all the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sitteth still</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and is at rest</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04397">Then the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">how long wilt thou not have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">on Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">and on the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02194" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against which thou hast had indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">these threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>?

verses.name: Zechariah 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that talked</w> with me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05150">comfortable</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">So the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that communed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with me said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I am jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">for Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">and for Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">jealousy</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">And I am very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07110">sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">displeased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">with the heathen</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07600">at ease</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04592">for I was but a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">displeased</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they helped</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">forward the affliction</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">with mercies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">my house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be built</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">in it, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06961 strong:H06957" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and a line</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be stretched forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">upon Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">yet, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05892">My cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">through prosperity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall yet be spread abroad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall yet comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall yet choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prosperity</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">good</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 1:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then lifted I up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and behold four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">horns</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:19

And he answered</w> me, These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which have scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">me four</w> <w lemma="strong:H02796">carpenters</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I, What come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">these to do</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which have scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">so that</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but these are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to fray</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">them, to cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the Gentiles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which lifted up</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to scatter</w> it. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen978" osisID="Zech.1"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again, and looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and behold a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">with a measuring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">line</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:2

And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, To measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04100">what</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> thereof, and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> thereof.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And, behold, the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with me went forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0312">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> him,

verses.name: Zechariah 2:4

verses.name: Zechariah 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">For I, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02346">will be unto her a wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and will be the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> of her.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01945">Ho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01945">ho</w>, <transChange type="added">come forth</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for I have spread you abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">as the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">winds</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01945">thyself, O</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwellest</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">me unto the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">you: for he that toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">you toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0892">the apple</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of his eye</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">For, behold, I will shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">upon them, and they shall be a spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to their servants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> me.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for, lo, I come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of thee, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">And many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and shall be my people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of thee, and thou shalt know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> me unto thee.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:12
