And he said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0374">an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that goeth forth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He said</w> moreover, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">their resemblance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through all the earth</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And, behold, there was lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">a talent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05777">of lead</w>: and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">of the ephah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>talent</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">weighty piece</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07564">wickedness</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">it into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">of the ephah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">the weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05777">of lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">upon the mouth</w> thereof.

verses.name: Zechariah 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then lifted I up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, there came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and the wind</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03671">in their wings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02007">for they had</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">like the wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02624">of a stork</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">the ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">between the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">and the heaven</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">I to the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">with me, Whither do these bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">the ephah</w>?

verses.name: Zechariah 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, To build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">it an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08152">of Shinar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">and it shall be established</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04369">there upon her own base</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen982" osisID="Zech.5"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I turned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-387">and, behold, there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-387">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">from between two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountains</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02022">and the mountains</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">In the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">chariot</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0122">red</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08145">and in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07838">black</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w>;

verses.name: Zechariah 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07992">And in the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07243">and in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01261">grisled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0554">and bay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bay</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">strong</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">unto the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that talked</w> with me, What <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">these, my lord</w>?

verses.name: Zechariah 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> unto me, These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirits</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">from standing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">before the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>spirits</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">winds</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07838">The black</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">therein go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">into the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03836">and the white</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01261">them; and the grisled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08486">toward the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0554">And the bay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">that they might walk to and fro</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get you hence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">walk to and fro</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through the earth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">So they walked to and fro</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through the earth</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0853">he upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me, and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">these that go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have quieted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">in the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Zechariah 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Take</w> of <transChange type="added">them of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01473">the captivity</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02469">of Heldai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02900">of Tobijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03048">and of Jedaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">from Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thou the same day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06846">of Zephaniah</w>;

verses.name: Zechariah 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05850">crowns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and set</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">of Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03087">of Josedech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>;

verses.name: Zechariah 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">Behold the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06780">The BRANCH</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall grow up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">out of his place, and he shall build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>grow…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">branch up from under him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Even he shall build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01935">the glory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon his throne</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">and he shall be a priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon his throne</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06098">and the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">shall be between them both</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05850">And the crowns</w> <w lemma="strong:H02494">shall be to Helem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02900">and to Tobijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03048">and to Jedaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02581">and to Hen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06846">of Zephaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02146">for a memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">in the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:15
verses.text: And they <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">in the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> me unto you. And <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall come to pass, if ye will diligently</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen983" osisID="Zech.6"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0702">And it came to pass in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01867">Darius</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">came unto Zechariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">in the fourth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08671">of the ninth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03691">in Chisleu</w>;

verses.name: Zechariah 7:2

verses.name: Zechariah 7:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priests</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and to the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Should I weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">in the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05144" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">separating</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">myself, as I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">these so many years</w>?

verses.name: Zechariah 7:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Then came the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Zechariah 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and to the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When ye fasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and mourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">in the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">and seventh</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07657">even those seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">did ye at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fast</w> unto me, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> to me?

verses.name: Zechariah 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when ye did eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when ye did drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">did not ye eat</w> <transChange type="added">for yourselves</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and drink</w> <transChange type="added">for yourselves</transChange>?<note type="study"><catchWord>did not ye</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">be not ye they that</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 7:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Should ye</transChange> not <transChange type="added">hear</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">when Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was inhabited</w> <w lemma="strong:H07961">and in prosperity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about her</w>, when <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">inhabited</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H08219">and the plain</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Should…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Are not these the words</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 7:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">came unto Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Zechariah 7:9

verses.name: Zechariah 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And oppress</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">not the widow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">nor the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06041">nor the poor</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let none of you imagine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in your heart</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">But they refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to hearken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05637 strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802 strongMorph:TH8799">and pulled away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">the shoulder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and stopped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">their ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they should not hear</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pulled…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they gave a backsliding shoulder</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>stopped</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made heavy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yea, they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">their hearts</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08068">an adamant stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">lest they should hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">in his spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01419">therefore came a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07110">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 7:13
verses.text: Therefore it is come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as he cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they would not hear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so they cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I would not hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>:

verses.name: Zechariah 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05590" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">But I scattered them with a whirlwind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom they knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">not. Thus the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them, that no man passed through</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor returned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02532">the pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">desolate</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">land of desire</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen984" osisID="Zech.7"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Again the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> came <transChange type="added">to me</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Zechariah 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I was jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">for Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">jealousy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and I was jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">for her with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">fury</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">unto Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">of truth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02022">and the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02205">There shall yet old men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">and old women</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04938">with his staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">age</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>very…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">multitude of days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07339">And the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">of boys</w> <w lemma="strong:H03207">and girls</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">playing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the streets</w> thereof.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">If it be marvellous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">of the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in these days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">should it also be marvellous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in mine eyes</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>marvellous</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hard</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">difficult</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">from the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08121 strong:H03996">and from the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>the west…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the country of the going down of the sun</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and they shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and they shall be my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and I will be their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0571">in truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and in righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">Let your hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye that hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in these days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">by the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8795" type="x-split-388">the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8795" type="x-split-388">was laid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01964">that the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">might be built</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">For before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">these days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">there was</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">no hire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">for man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07939">nor any hire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">for beast</w>; neither <transChange type="added">was there any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to him that went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">or came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">because of the affliction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">for I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">all men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">against his neighbour</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>there was…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the hire of man became nothing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:11
verses.text: But now I <transChange type="added">will</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07611">unto the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">as in the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">For the seed</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">prosperous</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01612">the vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">her fruit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02981">her increase</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">and the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">their dew</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07611">and I will cause the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to possess</w> all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prosperous</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:13
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07045">as ye were a curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so will I save</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">you, and ye shall be a blessing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> not, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">let your hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be strong</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02161" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">As I thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">you, when your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">provoked me to wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and I repented</w> not:

verses.name: Zechariah 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">So again</w> <w lemma="strong:H02161" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in these days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to do well</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> ye not.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the things</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye shall do</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">the truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to his neighbour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">of truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">and peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in your gates</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>execute…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">judge truth, and the judgment of peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And let none</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of you imagine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in your hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">against his neighbour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">no false</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">oath</w>: for all these <transChange type="added">are things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I hate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Zechariah 8:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06685">The fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07243">of the fourth</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06685">and the fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">of the fifth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06685">and the fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">of the seventh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06685">and the fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06224">of the tenth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">shall be to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">and gladness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and cheerful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">feasts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">therefore love</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">the truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">and peace</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>feasts</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">solemn</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">set times</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <transChange type="added">It shall</transChange> yet <transChange type="added">come to pass</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that there shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>:

verses.name: Zechariah 8:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <transChange type="added">city</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">speedily</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go</w> also.<note type="study"><catchWord>speedily</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">continually</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">going</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to pray…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to intreat the face of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Yea, many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">and strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to pray…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to intreat the face of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w> <transChange type="added">it shall come to pass</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">that ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">out of all languages</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">even shall take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of the skirt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064 strong:H0376">of him that is a Jew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with you: for we have heard</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with you. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen985" osisID="Zech.8"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02317">of Hadrach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01834">and Damascus</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04496">the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thereof: when the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">as of all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">toward the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02574">And Hamath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01379" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also shall border</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">thereby; Tyrus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06721">and Zidon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">though it be very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wise</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06865">And Tyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did build</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">herself a strong hold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06651" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and heaped up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">as the dust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02742">and fine gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02916">as the mire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">of the streets</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Behold, the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will cast her out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">her power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">in the sea</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and she shall be devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0831">Ashkelon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05804">Gaza</w> also <transChange type="added">shall see it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and be very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sorrowful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06138">and Ekron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04007">for her expectation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall be ashamed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05804">from Gaza</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0831">and Ashkelon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not be inhabited</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04464">And a bastard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0795">in Ashdod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of his mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08251">and his abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">from between his teeth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">but he that remaineth</w>, even he, <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">for our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">and he shall be as a governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06138">and Ekron</w> <w lemma="strong:H02983">as a Jebusite</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will encamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">about mine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04675">because of the army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because of him that passeth by</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and because of him that returneth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and no oppressor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them any more: for now have I seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with mine eyes</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">shout</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">behold, thy King</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w> unto thee: he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">just</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and having salvation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06041">lowly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and riding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">upon an ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05895">and upon a colt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the foal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">of an ass</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>having…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">saving himself</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">the chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">from Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">and the horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">and the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and he shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">unto the heathen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04915">and his dominion</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">from sea</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">to sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">and from the river</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0657">to the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01818">As for thee also, by the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of thy covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have sent forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0615">thy prisoners</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">out of the pit</w> wherein <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">no water</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">whose covenant is by blood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01225">you to the strong hold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0615">ye prisoners</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">of hope</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">even to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">do I declare</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will render</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">double</w> unto thee;

verses.name: Zechariah 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When I have bent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for me, filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">the bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">with Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">and raised up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06726">O Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">against thy sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03120">O Greece</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">thee as the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of a mighty man</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">over them, and his arrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">as the lightning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0136">and the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05591">with whirlwinds</w> <w lemma="strong:H08486">of the south</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01598" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall defend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them; and they shall devour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03533" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and subdue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07050">with sling</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall drink</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">make a noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">as through wine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04219">like bowls</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02106">as the corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the stones of the sling</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>be…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fill both the bowls</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">them in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">as the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w>: for they <transChange type="added">shall be as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H068">the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">of a crown</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05264" morph="strongMorph:TH8706">lifted up as an ensign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">upon his land</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:17
verses.text: For how great <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02898">his goodness</w>, and how great <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03308">his beauty</w>! <w lemma="strong:H01715">corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">shall make the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05107" morph="strongMorph:TH8766">cheerful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">and new wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">the maids</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cheerful</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">grow</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">speak</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen986" osisID="Zech.9"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04456">of the latter rain</w>; <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02385">bright clouds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">them showers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">of rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">to every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bright…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">lightnings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08655">For the idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the diviners</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">a lie</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and have told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">false</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">dreams</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">in vain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">their way as a flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they were troubled</w>, because <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">no shepherd</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>idols</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">teraphims</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>were…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">answered that</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">Mine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against the shepherds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I punished</w> <w lemma="strong:H06260">the goats</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath visited</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">his flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01935">them as his goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in the battle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>punished</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">visited upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Out of him came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">the corner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03489">out of him the nail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">out of him the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">out of him every oppressor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01368">And they shall be as mighty</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0947" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which tread down</w> <transChange type="added">their enemies</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02916">in the mire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">of the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in the battle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and they shall fight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them, and the riders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">on horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall be confounded</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the riders…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they shall make the riders on horses ashamed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will save</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring them again to place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them; for I have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">upon them: and they shall be as though</w> <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I had not cast them off</w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will hear</w> them.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:7
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">they of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">shall be like a mighty</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">as through wine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">yea, their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be glad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03820">their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08319" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will hiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">for them, and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them; for I have redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: and they shall increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as they have increased</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">them among the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">me in far countries</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall live</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with their children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and turn again</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I will bring them again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">also out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">them out of Assyria</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">and Lebanon</w>; and <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be found</w> for them.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">with affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">the waves</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">in the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04688">and all the deeps</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall dry up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01347">and the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">shall be brought down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">and the sceptre</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall depart away</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and they shall walk up and down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in his name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen987" osisID="Zech.10"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Open</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">thy doors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03844">O Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">that the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">thy cedars</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01265">fir tree</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0730">for the cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fallen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0117">because the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">are spoiled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">howl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0437">O ye oaks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03293">for the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219 strong:H01208" morph="strongMorph:TH8803 strongMorph:TH8675">of the vintage</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come down</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mighty</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">gallants</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the forest…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the defenced forest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03215">of the howling</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the shepherds</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0155">for their glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is spoiled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06963">a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07581">of the roaring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">of young lions</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01347">for the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is spoiled</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02028">of the slaughter</w>;

verses.name: Zechariah 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whose possessors</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and hold themselves not guilty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for I am rich</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and their own shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pity</w> them not.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For I will no more pity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">but, lo, I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">into his neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of his king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and they shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and out of their hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not deliver</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>deliver</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">make to be found</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02028">of slaughter</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03651">you</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06041">O poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flock</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">unto me two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04731">staves</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05278">Beauty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Bands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flock</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>even…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">verily the poor</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Bands</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Binders</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">Three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">also I cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03391">month</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05315">and my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">them, and their soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0973" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also abhorred</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>lothed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was straightened for them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I, I will not feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">you: that that dieth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let it die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and that that is to be cut off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let it be cut off</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and let the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07468">of another</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>another</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his fellow</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">neighbour</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04731">my staff</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05278">Beauty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cut it asunder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I might break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with all the people</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06041">and so the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon me knew</w> that it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>so…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the poor of the flock, etc. certainly knew</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">unto them, If ye think</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">give</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07939">my price</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and if not, forbear</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they weighed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">for my price</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <transChange type="added">pieces</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>If ye…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">If it be good in your eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto me, Cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it unto the potter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0145">a goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03366">price</w> <w lemma="strong:H03365" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I was prised at</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them. And I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">the thirty</w> <transChange type="added">pieces</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them to the potter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I cut asunder</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">mine other</w> <w lemma="strong:H04731">staff</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Bands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I might break</w> <w lemma="strong:H0264">the brotherhood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">between Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Bands</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Binders</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">unto thee yet the instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H0196">of a foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shepherd</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">For, lo, I will raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a shepherd</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">those that be cut off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither shall seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05289">the young one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">nor heal</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that that is broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">nor feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that that standeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">still: but he shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01277">of the fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06561" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-389">and tear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">their claws</w> <w lemma="strong:H06561" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-389">in pieces</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cut off</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hidden</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>feed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bear</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01945">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0457">to the idol</w> <w lemma="strong:H07473">shepherd</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that leaveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flock</w>! <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02220">upon his arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">and upon his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eye</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02220">his arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall be clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dried up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">and his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H03543" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall be utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03543" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">darkened</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen988" osisID="Zech.11"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which stretcheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">forth the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and layeth the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and formeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> him.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">a cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H07478">of trembling</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04692">when they shall be in the siege</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">both against Judah</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>trembling</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">slumber</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">poison</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and also against Judah shall he be which shall be in siege against Jerusalem</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 12:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04614">a burdensome</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for all people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06006" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H08295 strong:H08295" morph="strongMorph:TH8735 strongMorph:TH8800">themselves with it shall be cut in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">though all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be gathered together</w> against it.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">every horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H08541">with astonishment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his rider</w> <w lemma="strong:H07697">with madness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will open</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">every horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05788">with blindness</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0441">And the governors</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in their heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0556">my strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The inhabitants…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">There is strength to me and to the inhabitants</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 12:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0441">the governors</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03595">like an hearth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">among the wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03940">and like a torch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05995">in a sheaf</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">and on the left</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be inhabited</w> again in her own place, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">also shall save</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08597">that the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do not magnify</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">against Judah</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">shall the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01598" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">defend</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and he that is feeble</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">among them at that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">shall be as David</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">as God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">as the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>feeble</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">abject</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fallen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 12:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:10
