verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and upon the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">of grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H08469">and of supplications</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and they shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H01856" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon me whom they have pierced</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04553">and they shall mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for him, as one mourneth</w> for <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03173">only</w> <transChange type="added">son</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and shall be in bitterness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">for him, as one that is in bitterness</w> for <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">firstborn</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall there be a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04553">mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04553">as the mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01910">of Hadadrimmon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H04023">of Megiddon</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall mourn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">every</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">family</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">apart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">apart, and their wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">apart; the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">of Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">apart, and their wives</w> apart;<note type="study"><catchWord>every…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">families, families</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 12:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04940">The family</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">apart, and their wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">apart; the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H08097">of Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">apart, and their wives</w> apart;<note type="study"><catchWord>of Shimei</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of Simeon, as LXX</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 12:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04940">All the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that remain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">every family</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">apart, and their wives</w> apart. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen989" osisID="Zech.12"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04726">there shall be a fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and to the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">and for uncleanness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>uncleanness</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">separation for uncleanness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 13:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H06091">of the idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they shall no more be remembered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05030">and also I will cause the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">and the unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 13:3
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">when any</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall yet prophesy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">then his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, Thou shalt not live</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for thou speakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">and his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01856" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him shall thrust</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">him through when he prophesieth</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02384">of his vision</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when he hath prophesied</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall they wear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">a rough</w> <w lemma="strong:H0155">garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to deceive</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>a rough…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a garment of hair</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>deceive</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lie</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But he shall say</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">no prophet</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0127 strong:H05647 strong:H0376" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">an husbandman</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0120">for man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">taught me to keep cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">from my youth</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 13:6
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w> unto him, What <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04347">these wounds</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hands</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then he shall answer</w>, <transChange type="added">Those</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">with which I was wounded</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of my friends</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 13:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">O sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against my shepherd</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01397">and against the man</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05997">my fellow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the shepherd</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and the sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be scattered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06819" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon the little ones</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 13:8
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">therein shall be cut off</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07992">but the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be left</w> therein.

verses.name: Zechariah 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third part</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">through the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will refine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">them as silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is refined</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will try</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">them as gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is tried</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">on my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: I will say</w>, It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen990" osisID="Zech.13"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cometh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07998">and thy spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">shall be divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> of thee.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I will gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be taken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08155" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">rifled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H07693 strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8735 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8735">ravished</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">into captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">and the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from the city</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Then shall the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">against those nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as when</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">he fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07128">of battle</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07272">And his feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">of Olives</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">on the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">of Olives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">thereof toward the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">and toward the west</w>, <transChange type="added">and there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">valley</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of it toward the south</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall flee</w> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01516">the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01516">for the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall reach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0682">unto Azal</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, ye shall flee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">like as ye fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07494">the earthquake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">of Uzziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">all the saints</w> with thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>the mountains</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">my mountains</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>for the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when he shall touch the valley of the mountains to the place he separated</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0216">the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03368">shall not be clear</w>, <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07087 strong:H07087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675">dark</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>that the…</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">it shall not be clear in some places, and dark in other places of the world</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>clear</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">precious</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>dark</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thickness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">But it shall be one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which shall be known</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">not day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">nor night</w>: but it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">it shall be light</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it shall be…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the day shall be one</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall be in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">living</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02677">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H06931">of them toward the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">of them toward the hinder</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07019">in summer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02779">and in winter</w> shall it be.<note type="study"><catchWord>former</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">eastern</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">shall be king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over all the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">shall there be one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">All the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">as a plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01387">from Geba</w> <w lemma="strong:H07417">to Rimmon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">south</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall be lifted up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and inhabited</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">in her place, from Benjamin’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06434">unto the corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, and <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04026">the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H02606">of Hananeel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03342">winepresses</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>turned</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">compassed</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>inhabited</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shall abide</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:11
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03389">but Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">shall be safely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">inhabited</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall be</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shall abide</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04046">And this shall be the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">wherewith the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06633" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that have fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01320">Their flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04743" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">shall consume away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">while they stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">upon their feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and their eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04743" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall consume away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02356">in their holes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">and their tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H04743" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall consume away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in their mouth</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04103">tumult</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall be among them; and they shall lay hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">on the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">against the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of his neighbour</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">also shall fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02428">and the wealth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of all the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">shall be gathered together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">and apparel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">in great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">abundance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Judah…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thou also, O Judah shalt</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>at</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">against</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04046">And so shall be the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">of the horse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06505">of the mule</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01581">of the camel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and of the ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and of all the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01992">that shall be in these</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04046">as this plague</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">every one that is left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall even go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">to year</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the King</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02287" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">of tabernacles</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:17
verses.text: And it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whoso will not come up</w> of <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the King</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01653">even upon them shall be no rain</w>.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04940">And if the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go not up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and come</w> not, that <transChange type="added">have</transChange> no <transChange type="added">rain</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H04046">there shall be the plague</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">wherewith the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that come not up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02287" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">of tabernacles</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that have no</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon whom there is not</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02403">This shall be the punishment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and the punishment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that come not up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02287" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">of tabernacles</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>punishment</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sin</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04698">shall there be upon the bells</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">of the horses</w>, <inscription><w lemma="strong:H06944">HOLINESS</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">UNTO THE <divineName>LORD</divineName></w></inscription>; <w lemma="strong:H05518">and the pots</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04219">shall be like the bowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bells</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bridles</rdg></note>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05518">Yea, every pot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and in Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">shall be holiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all they that sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">of them, and seethe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">therein: and in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">there shall be no more the Canaanite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen991" osisID="Zech.14"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen977" osisID="Zech" type="book"/>

verses.name: Malachi 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04853">The burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H04401">Malachi</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherein hast thou loved</w> us? <transChange type="added">Was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06215">not Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet I loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>,

verses.name: Malachi 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">his mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">and his heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H08568">for the dragons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0123">Whereas Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07567" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">We are impoverished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but we will return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and build</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">the desolate places</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall build</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but I will throw down</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall call</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">them, The border</w> <w lemma="strong:H07564">of wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and, The people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02194" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">And your eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will be magnified</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">from the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">upon</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 1:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">A son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">honoureth</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and a servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">his master</w>: if then I <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">a father</w>, where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">mine honour</w>? and if I <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">a master</w>, where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04172">my fear</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto you, O priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherein have we despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>?

verses.name: Malachi 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Ye offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01351" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon mine altar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01351" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Wherein have we polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee? In that ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07979">The table</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">contemptible</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>offer…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bring unto</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Malachi 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And if ye offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05787">the blind</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for sacrifice</w>, <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">not evil</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and if ye offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06455">the lame</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and sick</w>, <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">not evil</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06346">it now unto thy governor</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will he be pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee, or accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy person</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">And now, I pray you, beseech</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he will be gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">unto us: this hath been by your means</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will he regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">your persons</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>God</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the face of God</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from your hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 1:10
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">even among you that would shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <transChange type="added">for nought</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">neither do ye kindle</w> <transChange type="added">fire</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">on mine altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">for nought</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02656">I have no pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither will I accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at your hand</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04217">For from the rising</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">of the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">even unto the going down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of the same my name</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the Gentiles</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04725">and in every place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">incense</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02889">and a pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">for my name</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 1:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">But ye have profaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it, in that ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07979">The table</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01351" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">polluted</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05108">and the fruit</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0400">his meat</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">contemptible</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04972">also, Behold, what a weariness</w> <transChange type="added">is it</transChange>! <w lemma="strong:H05301" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and ye have snuffed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">at it, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and ye brought</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">torn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06455">and the lame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the sick</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thus ye brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">an offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should I accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">this of your hand</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and ye have…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">whereas ye might have blown it away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">But cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05230" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the deceiver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">hath in his flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">a male</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and voweth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and sacrificeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">unto the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">a corrupt thing</w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">King</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and my name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">dreadful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in whose flock is</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen993" osisID="Mal.1"/>

verses.name: Malachi 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And now, O ye priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">this commandment</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for you.

verses.name: Malachi 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If ye will not hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and if ye will not lay</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">to heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I will even send</w> <w lemma="strong:H03994">a curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon you, and I will curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">your blessings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, I have cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them already, because ye do not lay</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">to heart</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01605" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will corrupt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">your seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06569">dung</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon your faces</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06569">the dung</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">of your solemn feasts</w>; and <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take you away</w> with it.<note type="study"><catchWord>corrupt</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">reprove</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>spread</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">scatter</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>one…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">it shall take you away to it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">this commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">unto you, that my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">might be with Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01285">My covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">was with him of life</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">and peace</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I gave</w> them to him <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04172">the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherewith he feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">me, and was afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08451">The law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">of truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">was in his mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05766">and iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was not found</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">in his lips</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">with me in peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H04334">and equity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-390">and did turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-390">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">from iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">For the priest’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they should seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">at his mouth</w>: for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But ye are departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">out of the way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">ye have caused many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to stumble</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">at the law</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">ye have corrupted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stumble at</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fall in</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore have I also made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">you contemptible</w> <w lemma="strong:H08217">and base</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">before all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as ye have not kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but have been partial</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>have been…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">lifted up the face against</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">accepted faces</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">Have we not all one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0259">hath not one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">created</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us? why do we deal treacherously</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">against his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">by profaning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our fathers</w>?

verses.name: Malachi 2:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath dealt treacherously</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08441">and an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and in Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03063">for Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath profaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he loved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath married</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">of a strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">god</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>loved</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ought to love</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">this, the master</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the scholar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">out of the tabernacles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and him that offereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the master…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">him that waketh, and him that answereth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And this have ye done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">with tears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01065">with weeping</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0603">and with crying out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">insomuch that he regardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">not the offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">any more, or receiveth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07522">with good will</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at your hand</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 2:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04100">Wherefore</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">Because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath been witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">between thee and the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of thy youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against whom thou hast dealt treacherously</w>: yet <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02278">she thy companion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of thy covenant</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And did not he make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07605">Yet had he the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of the spirit</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0259">And wherefore one</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">That he might seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">a godly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Therefore take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">to your spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let none deal treacherously</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">against the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of his youth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>residue</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">excellency</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>godly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">seed of God</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>treacherously</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">unfaithfully</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">putting away</w>: for <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">with his garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">therefore take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">to your spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye deal not treacherously</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that he…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">if he hate her, put her away</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>putting…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to put away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 2:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Ye have wearied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">with your words</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Wherein have we wearied</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Every one that doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he delighteth</w> in them; or, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w>? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen994" osisID="Mal.2"/>

verses.name: Malachi 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">my messenger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and he shall prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">me: and the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">whom ye seek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06597">shall suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">to his temple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">even the messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02655">whom ye delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in: behold, he shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8772">But who may abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of his coming</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and who shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when he appeareth</w>? for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">like a refiner’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and like fullers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01287">soap</w>:

verses.name: Malachi 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall sit</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">a refiner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and purifier</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and he shall purify</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02212" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and purge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">them as gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that they may offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">in righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04503">Then shall the offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06149" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06931">and as in former</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>former</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ancient</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">to you to judgment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and I will be a swift</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03784" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">against the sorcerers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and against the adulterers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08267">and against false</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">swearers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and against those that oppress</w> <w lemma="strong:H07916">the hireling</w> in <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07939">wages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">the widow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">and the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and that turn aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">the stranger</w> <transChange type="added">from his right</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>oppress</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">defraud</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 3:6
verses.text: For I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I change</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">not; therefore ye sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are not consumed</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 3:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">Even from the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye are gone away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">from mine ordinances</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have not kept</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, and I will return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto you, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But ye said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherein shall we return</w>?

verses.name: Malachi 3:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0120">Will a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06906" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06906" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Yet ye have robbed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me. But ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06906" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherein have we robbed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">thee? In tithes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">and offerings</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 3:9
verses.text: Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03994">with a curse</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06906" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for ye have robbed</w> me, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">this whole nation</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">ye all the tithes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">into the storehouse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02964">that there may be meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in mine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and prove</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">me now herewith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if I will not open</w> <w lemma="strong:H0699">you the windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and pour you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">a blessing</w>, that <transChange type="added">there shall</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be room</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01767">enough</w> <transChange type="added">to receive it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pour…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">empty out</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the devourer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for your sakes, and he shall not destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of your ground</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01612">neither shall your vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">cast her fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">before the time in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">corrupt</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">And all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall call you blessed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02656">for ye shall be a delightsome</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 3:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Your words</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have been stout</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against me, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">What have we spoken</w> <transChange type="added">so much</transChange> against thee?

verses.name: Malachi 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have said</w>, It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01215">and what profit</w> <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that we have kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">his ordinance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and that we have walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06941">mournfully</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>ordinance</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">observation</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>mournfully</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in black</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8764" type="x-split-391">And now we call</w> <w lemma="strong:H02086">the proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8764" type="x-split-391">happy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">yea, they that work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07564">wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are set up</w>; yea, <transChange type="added">they that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">tempt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">are even delivered</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>are set up</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">are built</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 3:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03373">Then they that feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">spake often</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to another</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hearkened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05612">and a book</w> <w lemma="strong:H02146">of remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was written</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">him for them that feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and that thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">upon his name</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall be mine, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when I make up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05459">my jewels</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">them, as a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his own son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that serveth</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>jewels</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">special treasure</rdg></note>

verses.name: Malachi 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shall ye return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and discern</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">between the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">and the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">between him that serveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and him that serveth</w> him not. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen995" osisID="Mal.3"/>

verses.name: Malachi 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For, behold, the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cometh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08574">as an oven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02086">and all the proud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">yea, and all that do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07564">wickedly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07179">shall be stubble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">and the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03857" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall burn them up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that it shall leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">them neither root</w> <w lemma="strong:H06057">nor branch</w>.

verses.name: Malachi 4:2
